Izinga Eliphezulu Lobugebengu Umbuzo 1: Yini ebizwa ngokuthi ubugebengu? Ubugebengu lubhekisela ezimisweni noma ezisebenzelwaneni ezimbi eziphula umthetho. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlukunyezwa kwabanye, ukuthola izimpahla zomunye ngaphandle kwemvume, noma ukulimaza impahla yomphakathi. Ububanzi bobugebengu buyahluka ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi ubungako bubugebengu bunamaphuzu ahlukene. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza ubugebengu bube phezulu? Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu livame ukuba nemiphumela ethile efana nomnotho, izinga lempilo yoluntu, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bephila ezimeni ezinzima njengokungasebenzi, ukuntuleka kwemithombo, noma ukuphathwa kabi kwezinsiza, lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kobugebengu. Noma yiziphi izinyathelo zokuzivikela zingaba nzima uma izimo zempilo kanye nezixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu zingalungile. Umbuzo 3: Yini eholela ekwandeni kobugebengu ezindaweni ezithile? Izindawo ezinomnotho ophansi zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukuhamba okungavikelekile, kanye nemvelo engavikelekile. Abantu abaningi baphila ezimeni ezinzima, futhi ubugebengu buvame ukuba yindlela yokuphila, ikakhulukazi uma kunezinkinga zomndeni noma ukungabi nesiqondiso. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe abantu banamandla okuphikisa ubugebengu? Yebo, abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekunciphiseni ubugebengu ngezimfuno ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha imiphakathi eqinile, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufunda, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo ezisheshayo zokuxhasa abavela ezindaweni ezinzima. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho abantu behlanganyela, ukuqubuka kobugebengu kuvame ukuncipha.
Yebo, abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekunciphiseni ubugebengu ngezimfuno ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha imiphakathi eqinile, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufunda, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo ezisheshayo zokuxhasa abavela ezindaweni ezinzima. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho abantu behlanganyela, ukuqubuka kobugebengu kuvame ukuncipha. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuncishiswe ubugebengu? Izinyathelo eziningi zingathathwa ukuze kuncishiswe ubugebengu, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zemfundo, ukufundisa abantu ngokubaluleka kokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa imiphakathi. Umphakathi kufanele ube nokubambisana nezikhungo zomthetho ukuze kuqashwe ubugebengu kahle. Umsebenzi wabaphathi bendawo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nemindeni ubalulekile ekwakheni isimo esikahle sokuphila. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele uyenze uma ubona ubugebengu? Uma ubona ubugebengu, kubalulekile ukufaka isikhalazo kumaphoyisa. Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumaphoyisa kufanele kube yisisekelo somphakathi. Ukuthola izinsiza ezitholakalayo nezokwazi kumphakathi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ubungozi. Ubulungiswa kufanele bukhuthazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthula emphakathini. Umbuzo 7: Yini ezokwenza umphakathi uyeke ubugebengu? Umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, owakhiwe kahle, ungaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwehliseni izinga lobugebengu. Ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo esezingeni, ukwakha imisebenzi, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ukuze abantu baphile impilo engcono kuyaphakamisa abantu ukuba baphile kahle. Ukufundisa ngezindlela zokuxazulula izingxabano ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ubugebengu kubalulekile, futhi lokhu kungenziwa ngezinhlelo ezithile.
Umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, owakhiwe kahle, ungaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwehliseni izinga lobugebengu. Ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo esezingeni, ukwakha imisebenzi, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ukuze abantu baphile impilo engcono kuyaphakamisa abantu ukuba baphile kahle. Ukufundisa ngezindlela zokuxazulula izingxabano ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ubugebengu kubalulekile, futhi lokhu kungenziwa ngezinhlelo ezithile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nomphakathi? Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zomnotho, ubuhlanga, kanye nokwamukela abantu abavela kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kudala izinselelo eziningi, okubangela ubugebengu obungathandeki. Ukubaluleka kokuhlonipha amagugu nokuhlala kucela ukuxoxisana. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kunezinhlelo zokulawula ubugebengu? Yebo, kunezinhlelo zokulawula ubugebengu ezitholakalayo, futhi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlinzekwa izikhungo zokuphepha, ezokweluleka, kanye nokubambisana nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukamasipala. Ukuqwashisa komphakathi mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvikela zenza abantu bazizwe bephila endaweni evikelekile. Umbuzo 10: Yisiphi isibonelelo somphakathi esitholakalayo? Izikhungo zasendaweni zifanele ukusiza abantu ngezisombululo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsiza zezimali, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezindawo zokuzijabulisa. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abahamba phambili ezinkingeni. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza lokukhulisa impilo engcono kubantu abahlala kule ndawo, futhi kufanele simise izindlela zokubambisana ezikhuthaza izixazululo ezihlala zikhona ekwehliseni ubugebengu.
Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsiza zezimali, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezindawo zokuzijabulisa. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abahamba phambili ezinkingeni. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza lokukhulisa impilo engcono kubantu abahlala kule ndawo, futhi kufanele simise izindlela zokubambisana ezikhuthaza izixazululo ezihlala zikhona ekwehliseni ubugebengu. Ubufakazi obuphuma ezinyathelweni ezithathwayo bukhombisa ukuthi uma sinqoba ububi ngothando, sizonqoba nezinye izinkinga.
Izinkinga Zamanzi: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izinkinga zamanzi? Izinkinga zamanzi zibhekisela ezinselelweni ezihambisana nokutholakala, ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, noma izinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ezindaweni ezithile. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala izinkinga zamanzi? Izinkinga zamanzi zingavela ngenxa yezinto ezahlukahlukene. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, izinguquko zesimo sezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezingasebenzi kahle, konke lokhu kudala izinselelo ezinkulu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izimpawu zokuntuleka kwamanzi? Izimpawu zokuntuleka kwamanzi zifaka phakathi ukuncipha kokutholakala kwamanzi emithonjeni, ukwanda kwezindleko zamanzi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kokutholakala kwamanzi emiphakathini. Abantu bangase baphinde babone ukwanda kwezifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Umbuzo 4: Kungani ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kubalulekile? Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kubalulekile ngoba kuthinta impilo yomphakathi. Amanzi angcolile angaholela ezimeni ezinzima, ezifana nezifo ezithathelwanayo, futhi kungaba nomthelela omubi ezilwaneni nasemvelweni. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izindlela zokulwa nezinkinga zamanzi? Kunezindlela eziningi zokulwa nezinkinga zamanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzayo, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi. Ukuhlanzwa kwemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 6: Yini umthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu ezinkingeni zamanzi? Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi anele.
Ukuhlanzwa kwemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 6: Yini umthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu ezinkingeni zamanzi? Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi anele. Ukushisa okwandayo, izikhukhula, nezomiso zenza kube nzima ukuhlela kahle ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ithola amanzi anele. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani umphakathi ungaba nesandla ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga? Umphakathi ungaba nesandla ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuhlanzeka, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokugcina amanzi, nokwakha imikhankaso yokuvuselela imithombo yamanzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinhlaka, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi? Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzayo. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuxhaswa kahle ukuze zisebenze ngempumelelo. Umbuzo 9: Yini umthelela wezobuchwepheshe ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi? Ubuchwepheshe bungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi. Izixazululo ezinjengokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 10: Kanjani abantu bangakwazi ukusiza ukugcina amanzi?
Ubuchwepheshe bungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi. Izixazululo ezinjengokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 10: Kanjani abantu bangakwazi ukusiza ukugcina amanzi? Abantu bangakwazi ukusiza ukugcina amanzi ngokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, njengokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi emakhaya, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi, nokuhlanza amanzi ngendlela efanele. Ukufundisa abanye ngalezi zindlela kubalulekile ukuze kube nomthelela omuhle. Umbuzo 11: Yini okumele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile? Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile, kudingeka izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi, ukwakhiwa kwemithombo yamanzi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwemfundo kubantu mayelana nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kubalulekile. Umbuzo 12: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola ezinkingeni zamanzi? Izifundo esingazithola ezinkingeni zamanzi zifaka phakathi ukubaluleka kokuhlakanipha ekusetshenzisweni kwamanzi, ukuhlela kahle izinsiza, nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukufunda ngezinkinga zamanzi kusiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yamanzi. Umbuzo 13: Kanjani umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi? Umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi ngokuhlanganisa imikhankaso yokufundisa, ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlanza imithombo yamanzi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi.
Ukufunda ngezinkinga zamanzi kusiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yamanzi. Umbuzo 13: Kanjani umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi? Umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi ngokuhlanganisa imikhankaso yokufundisa, ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlanza imithombo yamanzi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zinto kuzokwenza abantu babe nesibopho sokugcina amanzi. Umbuzo 14: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi? Singathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ngokwenza ucwaningo olujulile, ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, nokubambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ubuchwepheshe bokuphakelwa kwamanzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 15: Kanjani izinkinga zamanzi zingathinta umnotho? Izinkinga zamanzi zingathinta umnotho ngendlela enkulu. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukukhiqiza, ukwanda kwezindleko, kanye nokwehla kokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uyakhula. Isiphetho: Izinkinga zamanzi zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngokuqonda izizathu, izimpawu, kanye nezixazululo, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ukubambisana, ukufundisa, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga.
Ukukhula kwamanani okudla, ikakhulukazi kwezinto ezivame ukudliwa, kube nokukhathazeka kubathengi ezinyangeni ezedlule, futhi bakhathazekile ngokuqhubekayo kokwenyuka kwamanani kabhontshisi. Kuthiwa izizathu zokwenyuka kwamanani zidalwe ukukhula kwamamanani ezimpahla zokulima emhlabeni jikelele kanye nokushoda kwalezi zinto ezweni lethu. Uma siqhathanisa i-Safex price index kanye ne-bread price index ezinyangeni ezedlule, kubonakala ukuthi intengo ye-maize ikhule kakhulu kune-intengo kabhontshisi (I-Grafu 1). Kucacile ukuthi amanani okudla kungenzeka aqhubeke ekhula ezinyangeni ezizayo. Abathengi okwamanje bahlupheka, kodwa kubonakala sengathi bangase babhekane nezimo ezinzima kakhulu esikhathini esizayo. I-Grafu 1: I-bread price index kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye ne-Statistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi ye-Sagis). Ingxenye yamamanani okudla atholakala ezolimini iholele abantu abaningi abanolwazi ukuba bakholelwe ukuthi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kubiza kancane futhi kukhiqiza inzuzo enkulu. Labo balimi abaphumelele eminyakeni edlule ngokugcina ukulima ngesikhathi esinzima ngenxa yokwehla kwamanani kanye nezomiso, okwamanje baphumula kancane. Nokho, uma sicabangela ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima, ukwehla kwamamanani okudla kungaba iphupho kuphela. I-Grafu 2 ibonisa ukuthi phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi kuka-2004 no-2007, intengo ye-maize ayizange ilingane nokukhula kwamanani we-diesel kanye ne-fertilizer - lokhu akukaze kube yinto ehlala njalo. Amanani aphansi akhuthazwa abakhiqizi kanye nezindleko ezikhulayo zokulima kube yimbangela yokuthi abalimi abaningi bame ukutshala ukudla okuyisisekelo.
Nokho, uma sicabangela ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima, ukwehla kwamamanani okudla kungaba iphupho kuphela. I-Grafu 2 ibonisa ukuthi phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi kuka-2004 no-2007, intengo ye-maize ayizange ilingane nokukhula kwamanani we-diesel kanye ne-fertilizer - lokhu akukaze kube yinto ehlala njalo. Amanani aphansi akhuthazwa abakhiqizi kanye nezindleko ezikhulayo zokulima kube yimbangela yokuthi abalimi abaningi bame ukutshala ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu akukhona okuhle uma sicabangela ikusasa labalimi abasha - ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kube inzuzo ukuze abalimi abasha baqale futhi baqhubeke nokulima. Ukukhula kwamanani okudla okwamanje kube yinto ethokozisayo kubalimi, kodwa ukukhuphuka kwezindleko kube nomthelela omkhulu - abalimi bathola kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo uma befuna ukwenza inzuzo. I-Grafu 2: I-price index ye-fertilizer, diesel, kanye ne-maize kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye ne-Statistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi ye-Sagis). I-Grafu 3 ikala i-price index yezindleko zokufaka ezifana ne-diesel ne-fertilizer uma kuqhathaniswa nenani le-bread kanye ne-maize meal. Kucacile ukuthi abalimi bahlaselwa kakhulu yizindleko ezikhulayo zokulima uma kuqhathaniswa namamanani okudla akhathazayo abathengi. Intengo yokuthengisa yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele isebenze kahle ukuze kukhiqizwe ukudla okuningi ngokuhambisana nezindleko zokuqala zokufaka - ngaphandle kwalokhu, abathengi bazophoqwa ukuba bakhokhe kakhulu ukudla. I-Grafu 3: I-price index ye-white bread, maize meal, fertilizer, kanye ne-diesel kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000.
Kucacile ukuthi abalimi bahlaselwa kakhulu yizindleko ezikhulayo zokulima uma kuqhathaniswa namamanani okudla akhathazayo abathengi. Intengo yokuthengisa yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele isebenze kahle ukuze kukhiqizwe ukudla okuningi ngokuhambisana nezindleko zokuqala zokufaka - ngaphandle kwalokhu, abathengi bazophoqwa ukuba bakhokhe kakhulu ukudla. I-Grafu 3: I-price index ye-white bread, maize meal, fertilizer, kanye ne-diesel kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye ne-Statistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi ye-Sagis). Impela, ukukhula okukhulu kwamanani okudla kwezinto ezivame ukudliwa kubangelwe ukukhalipha kukahulumeni ekuphumeleleni ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokulima ezifanele, futhi ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni uphumelele ekusetshenziseni lezi zinhlelo ezikhona isikhathi eside. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) abakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla ukuze kudle abantu emhlabeni wethu bodwa - badinga usizo olufanele kuhulumeni.
Uma ufunda le ncwadi ebizwa ngokuthi Pula-Imvula, uzothola ukuthi kukhona uHlelo Lokuthuthukisa Abalimi nguGrain SA. Esikhathini esedlule, lolu hlelo lwathola uxhaso ikakhulu oluvela kuMaize Trust, ngakho-ke sasingakwazi ukubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezinhlanga. Ubonile futhi ukuthi muva nje saqala ukubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezithelo ze-oyela - lokhu kwenzeka ngoba manje sithola uxhaso oluvela ku-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust. Okwamanje, sijabule ukukwazisa ukuthi sithole ngempumelelo uxhaso oluvela kuWinter Cereals Trust. Ngakho, kusukela kule nyanga kaDisemba, sizophinde siqhubeke nokubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho ibhakiwa khona ngesikhathi sehlobo. Lezi zindaba zizofakwa kuPula-Imvula ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Okwamanje, izindaba ze-wheat zibhaliwe kuphela ngesiNgisi nangesiSesotho futhi zizohlukaniswa nePula-Imvula eFree State. Esicelweni sethu kuWinter Cereals Trust, sicele usizo ngomsebenzi esifuna ukuwenzela ukusiza abalimi abasha be-wheat e-Eastern Free State naseCentral Free State. Sizobeka izindawo ezimbili zokubonisa - eyodwa eModderpoort, eduze kweLadybrand, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentshonalanga, kanti enye eGlen, eduze kweBloemfontein, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentral.
Okwamanje, izindaba ze-wheat zibhaliwe kuphela ngesiNgisi nangesiSesotho futhi zizohlukaniswa nePula-Imvula eFree State. Esicelweni sethu kuWinter Cereals Trust, sicele usizo ngomsebenzi esifuna ukuwenzela ukusiza abalimi abasha be-wheat e-Eastern Free State naseCentral Free State. Sizobeka izindawo ezimbili zokubonisa - eyodwa eModderpoort, eduze kweLadybrand, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentshonalanga, kanti enye eGlen, eduze kweBloemfontein, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentral. Inhloso yokubeka lezi zindawo zokubonisa ukuveza nokufundisa abalimi ukuthi yiziphi izindlela zokulima ezinhle - ukulima ngendlela yokugcina umswakama emhlabathini phakathi nezinyanga zokuqala, ukukhetha izinhlobonhlobo ezifanele, inani leziphuzo ngehektare, inani lefertilizer, nokuphatha izitshalo nezifo - kuhle ukuva ngalezi zinto, kodwa kuhle kakhulu ukuzibona ukuze uqonde ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani kahle. Kukhona izincwadi eziningi ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho kunetha khona ngesikhathi sehlobo, kodwa sithathe umqondo wokuhlanganisa incwadi yokuhola (ikhasi lokuhola) ezobhekana ngqo nezinkinga zabafundi abasha kulezi zindawo. Le ncwadi izochaza kabanzi izindlela zokugcina umswakama emhlabathini - okubaluleke kakhulu kunanoma yini enye ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat ezindaweni ezithola imvula yehlobo kuphela. Le ncwadi izoba nezahluko ezizoxoxa ngembewu, isimo sesitshalo se-wheat, izidingo zokudla kwe-wheat, izindlela zokubeka ezizohambelana nokukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, inani leziphuzo nezikhathi zokubeka, izindlela zokulawula izitshalo ngesikhathi izitshalo zisakhula, ukuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuvuna, ukuhlukanisa, nokumaketha.
Kukhona izincwadi eziningi ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho kunetha khona ngesikhathi sehlobo, kodwa sithathe umqondo wokuhlanganisa incwadi yokuhola (ikhasi lokuhola) ezobhekana ngqo nezinkinga zabafundi abasha kulezi zindawo. Le ncwadi izochaza kabanzi izindlela zokugcina umswakama emhlabathini - okubaluleke kakhulu kunanoma yini enye ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat ezindaweni ezithola imvula yehlobo kuphela. Le ncwadi izoba nezahluko ezizoxoxa ngembewu, isimo sesitshalo se-wheat, izidingo zokudla kwe-wheat, izindlela zokubeka ezizohambelana nokukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, inani leziphuzo nezikhathi zokubeka, izindlela zokulawula izitshalo ngesikhathi izitshalo zisakhula, ukuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuvuna, ukuhlukanisa, nokumaketha. Ngemuva kokuphothula le study, sizohlinzeka ngezifundo zoktraining kwabanye - iseshini eyodwa izogxila ekuqeqesheni abaholi ukuze babelane ngolwazi, kanti ezinye ezimbili zizogxila ekuqeqesheni abalimi - ekuseni sizobheka ulwazi ezincwadini futhi ntambama sizofundisa umsebenzi wezandla. Ukuze sisize abalimi ngendlela efanele, sizozama ukwenza amaqembu amane agxile ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat. Lezi zifundo zizohlangana njalo ngenyanga, futhi konke okukhona okuhlobene nokulima kule nyanga kuzoxoxwa. Siyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokusiza abalimi be-wheat eFree State.
ULawrence Luthango, umphakathi wezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi eGrain SA kule ndawo. UMonica Mathamba uhlala endaweni yeMthatha Mbozisa lapho engum member weMbozisa Farmers' Association. UMonica ulima indawo engama-6 hectares futhi uphumelele ekulimaleni izinkambu zakhe lapho efaka khona amanzi. UMonica uhambele izifundo zokuqeqeshwa zeGrain SA zabafuyi, kuhlanganise nokwethulwa ekukhiqizeni ujeqe kanye nezifundo ezithuthukile zokukhiqiza ujeqe. UMonica ukhuphule umkhiqizo wakhe usebenzisa ulwazi alutholile kwiGrain SA. Ujwayele ukukhiqiza ama-ton angu-3.5 nge-hectare kodwa manje ukukhiqiza ama-ton angu-4.5 nge-hectare. UMonica uthola kanjani uxhaso lokuhlwanyela? Ukuze athole uxhaso lokuqala, UMonica usebenzisa imali ephuma ephaketheni lakhe ngoba umphathi wezimali uvame ukuthola imali ebolekiwe ngemva kokuvuna. UMonica uthola kuphi izinto zokuhlwanyela? UMonica uthi uthenga izinto zokuhlwanyela zakhe zokuqala kwiMthiza Farmers Co-op nase-East Cape Co-op. Intengo ivame ukuba phezulu (zibiza kakhulu) futhi abafuyi banikezwa izeluleko mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezinto lezi. Yiziphi izinselelo ahlangabezana nazo ekulimaleni futhi uphumelelani kulolo work? Uhlangabezana nezinselelo ezidinga abakhiqizi ukuba banikeze imibiko (izeluleko) nezakhono ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe, futhi kufanele banikeze izindlela namathuba okuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo (izakhiwo). UMonica uthi akahlangabezani nalezi zinselelo ngoba sebezixazulule izinqubomgomo zabo lapho kudingeka. UMonica uthi uthini ngempumelelo yakhe eqhubekayo ekulimaleni?
Uhlangabezana nezinselelo ezidinga abakhiqizi ukuba banikeze imibiko (izeluleko) nezakhono ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe, futhi kufanele banikeze izindlela namathuba okuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo (izakhiwo). UMonica uthi akahlangabezani nalezi zinselelo ngoba sebezixazulule izinqubomgomo zabo lapho kudingeka. UMonica uthi uthini ngempumelelo yakhe eqhubekayo ekulimaleni? UMonica uthi impumelelo yakhe ivela othandweni lwakhe olukhulu lokulima kanye nomsebenzi wakhe oqhubekayo onzima. Uyakholwa ukuthi ukusebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (uhlobo lwezimbewu ezimbili ezihlukene), umanyolo ofanele, nokuzama ukulawula izitshalo eziphikisanayo ezinkambini ngekemikhali kuye kwamsiza ukukhuphula umkhiqizo wakhe. Kulonyaka, UMonica ufuna ukuthenga imishini eminingi, ikakhulukazi imishini yokuphonsa.
Umbiko: Ukubhikisha Komphakathi Isingeniso Ukubhikisha komphakathi kube yinto ejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonitshwa. Lezi zibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, njengokungabi khona kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuhlala, noma ukungabikhona kwezinsiza zempilo. Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izimbangela, izindlela, kanye nemiphumela yokubhikisha komphakathi, sihlole izimo ezithile ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene. Izimbangela Zokubhikisha Izimbangela zokubhikisha komphakathi zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala zixhumene nezinkinga ezinzima. Enye yezimbangela ezivame kakhulu yikhono elingaphansi lokuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubandakanya amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bavame ukuhamba phambili ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo uma izinsiza ezisemqoka zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala nezikahulumeni zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubhekaneni nezidingo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngaphandle kokubandakanywa kwabo, lokhu kungaholela ekubhibhisheni. Izindlela Zokubhikisha Ukubhikisha komphakathi kudinga izindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuzuze umphakathi. Ezinye izindlela ezivame ukusetshenziswa zifaka phakathi kokuhlangana emihlanganweni, ukuhlela izinkulumo, nokwakha amaqembu okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo. Ezinye izibhikisho ziba nezimpikiswano ezinzima, lapho abantu behamba emigwaqweni, behlabelela, noma bephakamisa izimpawu ezikhombisa izikhalazo zabo.
Ezinye izindlela ezivame ukusetshenziswa zifaka phakathi kokuhlangana emihlanganweni, ukuhlela izinkulumo, nokwakha amaqembu okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo. Ezinye izibhikisho ziba nezimpikiswano ezinzima, lapho abantu behamba emigwaqweni, behlabelela, noma bephakamisa izimpawu ezikhombisa izikhalazo zabo. Lezi zindlela zikhombisa ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokuzwana. Imiphumela Yokubhikisha Imiphumela yokubhikisha komphakathi ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izibhikisho zingaholela ekutholeni izixazululo ezithile, njengokwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezintsha noma ukulungiswa kwezinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kubonisa ukuthi izwi labantu liyalalelwa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izibhikisho zingaholela ekuphazamisekeni komphakathi, lapho abantu bephikisana, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezimweni ezinzima. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhikisho zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwababhikishi nohulumeni. Izimo Eziyinhloko Zokubhikisha Kunezimo ezithile ezithinta ukubhikisha komphakathi ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene. Isibonelo, eMzanzi, izibhikisho ezivame ukwenzeka zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni eziningi ezingenazo izinsiza ezisemqoka, futhi lokhu kubangela ukunganeliseki okukhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, emazweni athile, izibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinkinga zomnotho, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amathuba okusebenza awatholakali kalula.
Isibonelo, eMzanzi, izibhikisho ezivame ukwenzeka zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni eziningi ezingenazo izinsiza ezisemqoka, futhi lokhu kubangela ukunganeliseki okukhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, emazweni athile, izibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinkinga zomnotho, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amathuba okusebenza awatholakali kalula. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zikamasipala Ukuze izibhikisho zibe nemiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwababhikishi nezikhungo zikamasipala. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana okuhle, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi izinkinga zabo ziyaqondwa. Izikhungo zikamasipala kufanele zibe nezinqubo ezivulekile zokwamukela izikhalazo, futhi zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuveza izinkinga zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. Isiphetho Ukubhikisha komphakathi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokukhombisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Izimbangela zokubhikisha zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala zixhumene nezinkinga ezinzima. Izindlela zokubhikisha zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi imiphumela ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwababhikishi nezikhungo zikamasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga zikhuluma, futhi abantu bathola izixazululo ezidingekayo. Ukubhikisha komphakathi akukhombisi nje ukunganeliseki, kodwa futhi kubonisa umoya wokuzwana nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu.
Abadlali Bebhola Abadumile: Umhlaba Wokudlalela Ubhola Ngaphansi kwelanga elikhanyayo, umhlaba ubonakala uthokozisa ngempela uma kukhulunywa ngabadlali bebhola abadumile. Lezi zinkanyezi zibhakabhaka ezinkundleni, zishaya izigigaba ezimnandi, futhi zishiya izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele ezizokhumbuleka unomphela. Kulokhu, sizobheka abanye babezikhumbuzo ezinkulu emhlabeni wobhola, ababe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umdlalo, nokuthi baphinde bahlonishwe ngempela. U-Diego Maradona: Umphakathi Wokudlala U-Diego Maradona, owaziwa njengenkanyezi ye-Argentina, ungomunye wabantu abavelele emlandweni wobhola. UMaradona, ophumelele kakhulu ngesikhathi sakhe, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani bokudlala bungaguqula umphakathi. Ngonyaka we-1986, waphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba, lapho akhombisa khona ubuchwepheshe obungakaze bubonwe. UMaradona, owaziwa ngempela ngama-dribbles akhe amangalisayo, waba yisithonjana sokuphumelela, futhi usenayo imithombo eminingi yokukhumbula, ehlanganisa nezithombe ezikhumbulekayo. U-Pele: Umhlaba Wokuhlonipha U-Pele, ongumfana waseBrazil, ungomunye wabantu abahlonishwa kakhulu emlandweni wobhola. Njengomdlali ophumelele, uPele waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eBrazil. Uthole ama-trophy amaningi, kuhlanganisa neNdebe yoMhlaba ezintathu, okwenza waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni jikelele. U-Pele uphinde waba umphakathi wokuhlonipha, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene.
Njengomdlali ophumelele, uPele waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eBrazil. Uthole ama-trophy amaningi, kuhlanganisa neNdebe yoMhlaba ezintathu, okwenza waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni jikelele. U-Pele uphinde waba umphakathi wokuhlonipha, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. U-Lionel Messi: Ubuchwepheshe Obuphakeme U-Lionel Messi, owaziwa njengenye yezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni, ubhalwe emlandweni wobhola njengomdlali ophakeme. UMessi, ophumelele izicoco eziningi, unamakhono akhangayo, futhi ubuchwepheshe bakhe buhlale bujabulisa izigidi zabalandeli. U-Messi ubonakale emkhakheni wobhola kusukela esemncane, futhi usaqhubeka nokukhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu eminyakeni engama-15 edlule. Uhlonishwa ngempela, futhi uthole izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganisa neBallon d'Or, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ungomunye wabathandwa kakhulu emhlabeni. U-Cristiano Ronaldo: Umsebenzi Nokuzinikela U-Cristiano Ronaldo, ongumdlali ophumelelayo, ubalulekile emlandweni wobhola. U-Ronaldo, owaziwa ngokusebenza kanzima, uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni amakhono akhe. Uthole izicoco eziningi, futhi ubonakale emakhampasini ahlukahlukene. U-Ronaldo ube yisibonelo sokuthi ukuzinikela nobuqotho kungaholela empumelelweni. Uthole izindondo eziningi, futhi ubona impumelelo emhlabeni wobhola, okwenza kube khona umthelela omkhulu kulabo abalandela umdlalo. U-Zinedine Zidane: Umphakathi Wokuhola U-Zinedine Zidane, ongumdlali ophumelele, ubalulekile emlandweni wobhola.
U-Ronaldo ube yisibonelo sokuthi ukuzinikela nobuqotho kungaholela empumelelweni. Uthole izindondo eziningi, futhi ubona impumelelo emhlabeni wobhola, okwenza kube khona umthelela omkhulu kulabo abalandela umdlalo. U-Zinedine Zidane: Umphakathi Wokuhola U-Zinedine Zidane, ongumdlali ophumelele, ubalulekile emlandweni wobhola. Njengomqeqeshi, uZidane ubonakale eqhuba izinkanyezi eziningi, futhi uphinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wobhola. UZidane, owaziwa ngama-goals akhe amahle, ubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eFrance. Uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi wobhola, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Isiphetho: Umhlaba Wokudlala Ubhola Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlala bephakamisa umhlaba wobhola. Njengoba bephakela izigigaba ezimnandi ezinkundleni, bahlanganisa abantu, benza umphakathi ube munye. UMaradona, uPele, uMessi, uRonaldo, noZidane bangabantu abavelele, futhi imisebenzi yabo ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, abadlali bebhola bazohlala bebalulekile, futhi bazokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele ezizohlala zikhumbuleka.
Ingabe le ndaba izobekwa kubakhiqizi? Kuzo zonke izindaba, kukhona abahle nabangafaneleki - kodwa kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi wokudla ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ukudla kubantu ungumuntu ongafaneleki ekugcineni. Bayahlukunyezwa uma kungekho ukudla, bayahlukunyezwa uma ukudla kungekho okukhona noma izinga lokudla lingahlangabezani nezindinganiso zabo. Uma sibheka indlela, umsebenzi noma uhlelo lokubeka ukudla etafuleni kubantu benhlangano, sizobona ukuthi kunabantu abaningi abenza lo msebenzi futhi sizobona ukuthi kuwumsebenzi odinga isikhathi esiningi. Ingxenye yezinto kufanele ilandele. Kumele bakwazi ukufakwa kahle futhi bathuthwe kahle. Kufanele kudalwe umanyolo ukusiza izitshalo zikhule kahle. Umuthi wezitshalo, izibulali-zinambuzane, kanye nokulawulwa kwezifo kufanele kutholakale ngendlela evikela izitshalo ukuze zime kahle. Futhi konke lokhu kunikezelwa ezinkampanini zokulima. Futhi bathenga izinkwa zokudla. Futhi bathutha umkhiqizo baye ezitolo. Futhi bathengisa umkhiqizo kubakhiqizi (noma ezimakethe zangaphandle). Futhi bapakisha ukudla ngaphambi kokukuletha kubathengisi abakhulu. Bathengisa ukudla okwakhiwe kubathengisi abancane. Bathengisa ukudla kubathengi. Le ncazelo ayichazi kahle zonke izinyathelo ezenzakalayo ngoba izinhlobo zokudla zihluka. Isibonelo: ngemuva kokugaya ummbila, kufanele uphume (uphake) ngaphambi kokuthengiswa, uma ukudla kuyinkwa esetshenziselwa ukuvusa utshwala, kufanele kube nomsebenzi wokuqala ngaphambi kokuthengiswa. Kulomsebenzi wonke, kukhona abantu abaningi nemisebenzi eminingi eyakha uhlelo lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ngamunye wabo ufanele ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nezinkampani zabo.
Isibonelo: ngemuva kokugaya ummbila, kufanele uphume (uphake) ngaphambi kokuthengiswa, uma ukudla kuyinkwa esetshenziselwa ukuvusa utshwala, kufanele kube nomsebenzi wokuqala ngaphambi kokuthengiswa. Kulomsebenzi wonke, kukhona abantu abaningi nemisebenzi eminingi eyakha uhlelo lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ngamunye wabo ufanele ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nezinkampani zabo. Manje singabuza futhi - ingabe le ndaba yokwenyuka kwem prices yokudla ingabekwa kuphela kumlimi (umkhiqizi)? Iyini intengo yotshwala (ubhiya) engaphansi kuka-3% wentengo yemakethe yommbila? Ukusebenzisa ibhizinisi kuhlobene nokungena engozini - zonke izinkampani zibhekana nezingozi ezithile. Abakhiqizi bahlaselwa nje ukuba bamukele intengo yemakethe - abakwazi ukucacisa ukuthi bafuna malini nge-ton yommbila ngoba yonke imikhiqizo yokudla ithengiswa emakethe - banikezwa intengo yosuku. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi uphushwa ukuba wamukele intengo yokuvuna engaphansi kwezindleko zokukhiqiza leyo mvuno. Isibonelo: unyaka odlule eFree State bekubi kakhulu futhi imvula ibingalungile. Ezindaweni eziningi, abalimi bahluleka ukuvuna ngisho ne-ton eyodwa yommbila nge-hectare. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ummbila zishintsha zibe ngu-R4,200 nge-hectare, kanti intengo yemakethe ngaleso sikhathi bekuyi-R3,000 nge-ton. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umlimi evuna i-ton eyodwa nge-hectare, ulahlekelwa (udliwa) ngu-R1,200 nge-hectare. Uma ungumthosi, uzothenga ufulawa bese unquma ukuthi uzothengisela malini imikhiqizo yakho ephekiwe.
Izindleko zokukhiqiza ummbila zishintsha zibe ngu-R4,200 nge-hectare, kanti intengo yemakethe ngaleso sikhathi bekuyi-R3,000 nge-ton. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umlimi evuna i-ton eyodwa nge-hectare, ulahlekelwa (udliwa) ngu-R1,200 nge-hectare. Uma ungumthosi, uzothenga ufulawa bese unquma ukuthi uzothengisela malini imikhiqizo yakho ephekiwe. Uma umthengi engavumi ukukhokha lelo nani, uzokwehlisa intengo yefulawa kanye nokupheka kuze kube intengo yefulawa yehlile. Kodwa uma umlimi ethatha izinyathelo zokuqala zokutshala ukudla, abakwazi ukwehlisa ngaphakathi emsebenzini wabo bese belinda intengo inyuke - sebebhekene nezindleko manje kufanele baqhubeke nokuvuna nokuthengisa leyo mvuno. Abakhiqizi bethu bayinsiza enkulu kithi - basebenza kanzima, bathatha amathuba ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokudla nemisebenzi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi singathenga kuphela ngaphandle uma lezo zizwe zinezakhamizi eziningi zokudla, futhi uma izwe lethu linemali yokuthenga lokho. Uma izimo zezinye izizwe zibi, zizogcina ukudla kwazo, ngakho sizophumelela ukukwazi ukuthenga ngaphandle. Futhi uma intengo yokushintshisana ibangela ukuthi inani le-rand lehle, izwe lethu ngeke likwazi ukuthenga ukudla futhi abantu bazohlupheka, lokhu sibona ezindaweni eziningi e-Afrika. Ngaphambi kokubeka icala kulezo zizwe ngokukhokha izintengo eziphezulu, masibheke le ndaba ukuze sithole ukuthi yini imbangela yokwenyuka kwentengo. Uma singasekeli abakhiqizi bethu ukuze baqhubeke nokutshala ukudla ngokwenzuzo, ngisho lapha abantu bazohlupheka ngendlala.
Isingeniso Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, okwaziwa nangokuthi "izindawo zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni," kube yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi. Lezi zindawo, ezakhiwe ngaphandle kwemvume yohulumeni, zihlala zinezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezomthetho, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Umbhalo lo uzogxila ezimbangweni ezikhokelela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, izimpempe zazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuncishiswe le nkinga. Izimbangela Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Omunye wemibandela eyinhloko eholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni ukuwohloka kwezimo zokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba umnotho uthuthuka, abantu abaningi bahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abampofu ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izindlu eziphuthumayo ezindaweni ezingavunyelwe ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kwemithetho eqinile yokwakha ezindaweni ezithile, kanye nokungabi nezimali ezanele zokwakha izindlu ezisemthethweni, kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kuphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo, lapho izindawo ezisemthethweni zihlupheka ngenxa yokuthi zidinga izinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ngenxa yokungakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokuhlala. Izimpempe Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezimpempe eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo, ezokuphepha, nezomthetho.
Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kuphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo, lapho izindawo ezisemthethweni zihlupheka ngenxa yokuthi zidinga izinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ngenxa yokungakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokuhlala. Izimpempe Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezimpempe eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo, ezokuphepha, nezomthetho. Okokuqala, lezi zindawo zihlupheka ngezinkinga zempilo, njengoba abantu bengenayo imithombo efanele yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okwenza kube nzima ukuba abantu baphile impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zihlala zikhungathekile, futhi lokhu kuholela ezimeni zokweba, udlame, nokuhlukunyezwa. Okwesibili, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho. Abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo bavame ukuba sengozini yokwenziwa kwemithetho, okungaholela ekutheni kube khona ukuhoxiswa kwezindlu zabo. Lokhu kubangela ukungabi nokuqonda kwezokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima ukuba abantu bakhe izimpilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zihlupheka ngezinkinga zomphakathi, njengoba abahlali bengenayo imisebenzi ethile yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Izixazululo Zokunciphisa Ukwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Ukuze kuncishiswe ukwenzeka kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele ahlinzeke ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni ezishibhile, ukuze abantu abampofu bakwazi ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zihlupheka ngezinkinga zomphakathi, njengoba abahlali bengenayo imisebenzi ethile yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Izixazululo Zokunciphisa Ukwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Ukuze kuncishiswe ukwenzeka kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele ahlinzeke ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni ezishibhile, ukuze abantu abampofu bakwazi ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bahlale ezindaweni ezisemthethweni, futhi kuzovikela amalungelo abantu. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisemthethweni, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengamanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Izinhlelo zokwakha kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezizokwenza baphile kahle. Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abanikazi bezindawo, kanye nomphakathi. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezindawo abahlala kuzo, baqonde ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni aziholeli ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela izindawo ezisemthethweni. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kusemqoka kakhulu, futhi kudinga izixazululo ezithile ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abanikazi bezindawo, kanye nomphakathi.
Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela izindawo ezisemthethweni. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kusemqoka kakhulu, futhi kudinga izixazululo ezithile ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abanikazi bezindawo, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni bazohlala bephila impilo enezinkinga eziningi, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Ukubambisana nokuhlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni kuzoba yisixazululo esikhulu ekunciphiseni le nkinga.
ukuxhasa imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ezindaweni zokusebenza kuhulumeni. Ukuqinisa ukuhlonipha phakathi kwabasebenzi nasezikhungweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaqashi nabasebenzi banokuqonda okujwayelekile mayelana nokuziphatha okungafanele nokuziphatha okufanele. Ukukhuthaza indlela evumelekile yokuphatha. Ukuhlinzeka abaqashi nabasebenzi ngezwi elisheshayo nelilula lokubika ukuziphatha okungafanele. Futhi ukuvimbela ukungabheki umthetho noma ukuhlukumeza abasebenzi ngokuqashwa. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyisinyathelo sokulungisa, hhayi sokujezisa. Ukuziphatha okufanele kufanele kwenziwe ngesikhathi, ngendlela evumelekile, ehambisanayo, futhi ethuthukayo. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuy umsebenzi wokuphatha. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithetho kuyadingeka ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ngokushesha nokwelashwa okufanele kwabantu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi: a. banethuba elifanayo lokukhuluma ngezinhlelo ezihlelwe nezingeziwe. b. bahlale bekwazi ngemicimbi yokuziphatha okungafanele eyenzeka kubo. c. bathole izizathu ezibhaliwe zokuphathwa kwanoma yisiphi isinqumo esibhaliwe, futhi d. banelungelo lokuphikisa noma yisiphi isinqumo. Yonke imizamo izokwenziwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlahlandlela yokuziphatha okungafanele iyenzeka endaweni yokusebenza futhi ixhumeke kubo bonke abasebenzi. Uma umphakathi uphatha kabi, lokho kungaba icala, icala elibucayi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isinyathelo sokudlulisa icala ngokwezinhlelo zokusebenza akuphazamisi inqubo yomthetho. Lezi zisho nezindlela ziyizikhombisi kuphela futhi zingashintshwa ngokuya ngezimo ezifanele.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isinyathelo sokudlulisa icala ngokwezinhlelo zokusebenza akuphazamisi inqubo yomthetho. Lezi zisho nezindlela ziyizikhombisi kuphela futhi zingashintshwa ngokuya ngezimo ezifanele. Lokhu kusebenza kuyo yonke imiphakathi ephathelene nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, noma okukhuluma ngazo emthethweni noma ezinqubomgomo. Imithetho, imiyalelo, nezindinganiso zokuziphatha. Ukuziphatha okungafanele okungase kudinge ukuthi umphakathi abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala kuboniswa ku-Anexure A. Lezi zinto aziphelele. Umpheki angahola umphakathi mayelana nokuziphatha kwabo, uma nje beqonda, noma kufanele baqonde ukuthi lokho kuziphatha kudinga isinyathelo sokudlulisa icala. a. ukuveza izinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele kunomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini kahulumeni, emnyangweni wezabasebenzi, nasekukhulumeni. Izindlela zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele. Izeluleko zokulungisa ukuziphatha okungafanele. Ezimweni lapho kubalulekile ukusungula ukubaluleka kokuziphatha okungafanele, umphakathi kufanele akwenze lokhu. a. wazisa umphakathi ngokuqondile ngokuqhubeka kwakhe. b. Chaza kumphakathi icala elibhekene naye, bese umnika ithuba lokukhuluma ngaleso cala abhekene naso. d. Thatha isinyathelo sokulungisa esivumelwene ngaso. Isixwayiso somlomo. Uma umphakathi odabukile edinga isixwayiso, isixwayiso singanikezwa ngomlomo. Umphakathi kufanele wazise umphakathi ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokuziphatha kabi, angase abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala, futhi isixwayiso sizobhalwa phansi. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe.
Uma umphakathi odabukile edinga isixwayiso, isixwayiso singanikezwa ngomlomo. Umphakathi kufanele wazise umphakathi ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokuziphatha kabi, angase abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala, futhi isixwayiso sizobhalwa phansi. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Uma umphakathi ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso esibhaliwe, umphakathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo ezidingekayo uma unikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi. d. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe sithobela umthetho iminyaka eyisithupha. Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele sikhishwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi futhi sibhujiswe. e. Uma umphakathi utholakala enecala phakathi kweminyaka eyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala okufanele azithole. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. Uma umphakathi ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe, umphakathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo ezidingekayo uma unikeza isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi.
b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi. d. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe sithobela umthetho iminyaka eyisithupha. Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele sikhishwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi futhi sibhujiswe. e. Uma umphakathi utholakala enecala phakathi kweminyaka eyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala okufanele azithole. Imicimbi efanayo ephathelene nabasebenzi kufanele ithole izixwayiso ezifanayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe indlela ehambisanayo yokuphatha noma yokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele. Uma icala elibhekene nomphakathi libalulekile kakhulu, kudinga isijeziso esinzima kunezikhumbuzo ezikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, umqashi angase aqale uphenyo mayelana nesijeziso. Umqashi kufanele akhethe ummeleli ukuze aqale uphenyo, okumele kube umphakathi. Isaziso sokuphenya a. umphakathi kufanele anikezwe isaziso okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela. b. Umphakathi kufanele asigne isaziso esiqinisekisa usuku lokulalela. Uma bephika ukusigna, kufanele banikezwe omunye umphakathi ozosigna ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isaziso. Incazelo ephelele yokuziphatha okungafanele, ubufakazi umqashi ozowethemba. Ulwazi ngamalungelo omphakathi, abamele abaphathi noma abamele inhlangano yezabasebenzi evunyelwe, kanye nalabo abazohlinzeka ngobufakazi.
Uma bephika ukusigna, kufanele banikezwe omunye umphakathi ozosigna ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isaziso. Incazelo ephelele yokuziphatha okungafanele, ubufakazi umqashi ozowethemba. Ulwazi ngamalungelo omphakathi, abamele abaphathi noma abamele inhlangano yezabasebenzi evunyelwe, kanye nalabo abazohlinzeka ngobufakazi. a. umqashi angase abambe umphakathi noma amukele imali ngokuphelele, noma amtransfer kuMnyango omunye wenhlangano. Ngaphansi kwalezi zimo; uma umphakathi uthola icala noma uphatha icala elibucayi, futhi umqashi ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela komphakathi emsebenzini kungaphazamisa uphenyo lwecala elibhekene naye, noma kube yingozi empilweni yomuntu noma impahla kahulumeni. c. Uma umphakathi ebhujiswa noma edluliselwa, umqashi kufanele abambe ukulalela phakathi kwenyanga. Umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela uzokwenza isinqumo sokuthi icala lizophumelela. a. Ukulalela kufanele kubanjwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokunikezwa isaziso kumphakathi. b. Umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela kufanele abe sezingeni eliphezulu kunommeleli womphakathi. Uma umphakathi obhekene necala engumholi wesigaba, umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela kufanele kube yisiphathimandla esisebenzayo noma umuntu onolwazi olwaneleyo futhi oqokwe nguMbuso noma umkhandlu wesifunda omkhulu. c. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo (GEMS health facility coordination) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-Green Endeavour for Medical Services, iyisinyathelo esakhiwe ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo ezisemqoka emiphakathini. Isebenza njengomphakathi ohlanganisayo, ihlanganisa izikhungo zezempilo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu basebenzelana kahle nemithombo yezempilo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo kubalulekile? Impendulo: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhweli besiwo sonke izinzuzo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo, ukuthuthwa kolwazi, kanye nokwabelana ngamasu okuheha izinsiza. Umgomo uwukuba abantu bathole imishanguzo kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ngaphandle kokwenza uhambo olude. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinga lezinsizakusebenza, amakhono, kanye noshintsho kumkhankaso wezempilo kuyizinselelo eziphambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele kanye nokwakhiwa komphakathi okukhuthazayo kubalulekile. I-GEMS idinga ukuphendula kulezi zinkinga ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izikhungo zithola ukwesekwa okuyisimanga. Umbuzo 4: Zithini izinzuzo zokuhlanganyela kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zibandakanya ukunciphisa izindleko, ukuhlinza izinsizakalo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, kanye nokwakha umphakathi osekelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kukhulisa ukwakhiwa komthwalo wezithuthi kanye nokuhambela phambili ngokuhlangana kwemininingwane nokwabelana ngolwazi.
Umbuzo 4: Zithini izinzuzo zokuhlanganyela kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zibandakanya ukunciphisa izindleko, ukuhlinza izinsizakalo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, kanye nokwakha umphakathi osekelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kukhulisa ukwakhiwa komthwalo wezithuthi kanye nokuhambela phambili ngokuhlangana kwemininingwane nokwabelana ngolwazi. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuletha ushintsho emphakathini? Impendulo: Nakanjani! I-GEMS ifaka izinguquko ezinkulu ngokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zezempilo, kuphumelele nakwezokusebenza. Lokhu kunciphisa izinga lokugula emiphakathini, ukusiza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, futhi kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kokuphila komphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe izikhungo? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinhlobo zezinqubomgomo zokuqala zihlanganisa ukuqokwa kwezikhulu eziphethe, ukwakhiwa kwemigqa yokuxhumana, ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezinhlelo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngamasu okuphila. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsizakalo kufanele kube ngaphansi kokuhola kweZikhungo zezempilo futhi kuxhaswe nguhulumeni nabanye ababambiqhaza. Umbuzo 7: Yini okumele ibhekwane kakhulu ekuphathweni kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Ukugxila kwezindinganiso zempilo, ugcino noma ukwenza ngcono izikhungo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kumele kube sezinhliziyweni zemisebenzi ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zithola uxhaso olwenziwayo lokugcina izinga eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani imiphumela ye-GEMS iyabhekwa?
Impendulo: Ukugxila kwezindinganiso zempilo, ugcino noma ukwenza ngcono izikhungo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kumele kube sezinhliziyweni zemisebenzi ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zithola uxhaso olwenziwayo lokugcina izinga eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani imiphumela ye-GEMS iyabhekwa? Impendulo: Ukuhlola imiphumela ye-GEMS kwenziwa ngokuhlaziywa kwemibiko, ukubuyekezwa kwezinsizakalo, nokubandakanya imiphakathi. Lokhu kunika umbono ocacile wokuthi kuyasebenza yini imizamo ethile futhi kuyakwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kubalulekile ukuba nodlame lwempilo kumphakathi? Impendulo: Yebo, udlame lwempilo lukhulu emiphakathini. I-GEMS idinga ukwazisa abantu ngendaba yezenhlalo, ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha kahle, kanye nokubhekelela izidingo zamakhosikazi nezinsizwa ezisebenzayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini esikufundile mayelana ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Siyazi ukuthi i-GEMS ikhulisa indlela esisebenzisana ngayo nezikhungo zezempilo. Imizamo yokubambisana ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuqonda kwethu lokho konke okuhlangene, kufanele sikhuthaze imithombo yakho yokuhlala nezinsizakalo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusizakala kwabantu. Isiqedelo, i-GEMS inikeza amathuba amasha.obuchwepheshe futhi iyindlela ebalulekile yokuqhubeka nokukhulisa izinsizakalo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa kuphela kepha kuthokozisa uxhumano phakathi kwabantu nabakhiqizi bempilo. Ngokuhlanganiswa nokuxhumana, sinethemba lokushintsha impilo yabantu, lapho sihamba phambili funa izinzuzo.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Umsebenzi Wokuphepha Kwendawo Nokuphila Komuntu Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo yazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo. Kuwo wonke umhlaba, itholakala emithonjeni ehlukene, kufaka phakathi izifudlana, imifula, nezindawo eziphilayo. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukene ezifana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, imikhuba yokuphila, kanye nokungcoliswa, ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile sekuba yinkinga ezweni lonke, futhi ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo kakhulu. Ukwazi ukubaluleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokuqhubekayo kokuhlelwa kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. NgokweZinhlelo Zenkampani Yezempilo Yomphakathi, amanzi ahlanzekile ayasiza ekugwemeni izifo ezithathelwana emanzini, okwenza kube nezidingo eziqinile zokwenziwa kohlaka lokuphathwa kwamanzi. Izinhlaka ezisemthethweni kumele ziqinise imizamo yokuphatha amanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, kanye nokwehlisa ubugebengu bokungcolisa. Ukuze kuzuze imiphakathi, abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile akupheleli kuphela ekuphileni kahle, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, okusikhombisa ukuthi inhlanzeko yamanzi ibalulekile ekulondolozweni kwemiphakathi futhi ibaluleke kakhulu emithonjeni yemvelo. Ikhwalithi yamanzi ayancikile kuphela kumaphuzu okutholakala, kodwa futhi ivumela inkululeko yokuphila. Ukuze ubheke lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithi: "Amanzi ahlanzekile anika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo." Lokhu kusho ukunciphisa izingozi zokugula, ukukhulisa ukwandisa umkhiqizo kanye nezinga lempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ezindaweni ezinezinsiza eziphansi, lapho kwenziwa khona izinhlelo ezihlose ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile.
Ukuze ubheke lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithi: "Amanzi ahlanzekile anika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo." Lokhu kusho ukunciphisa izingozi zokugula, ukukhulisa ukwandisa umkhiqizo kanye nezinga lempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ezindaweni ezinezinsiza eziphansi, lapho kwenziwa khona izinhlelo ezihlose ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Ukwakhiwa kwemithombo esebenzayo, izivande zokuhlanza amanzi, nemithala yokwelapha, kuzoletha umphumela omuhle ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngaphandle kokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ahlanzekile, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezinamandla zokuqhakambisa indawo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu endimeni yokugcina amanzi futhi nesimo sezulu esinempilo. Ukuze uhlole ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphila, kudingeka umphakathi owodwa, lapho abantu baphila ngokuhlanganyela, bejabulela ubuhlobo bokuthola izinsiza ezihambisanayo, ngaphezu kokukwazi ukuhlanzeka kwemvelo. Ubulungiswa bokuhlala futsi lubalulekile ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba ubhekene nezinqoba ezinzima ezihlobene nezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Izinhlaka ezithintekayo kumele ziqonde ukuthi imiphumela yalezi zinguquko ithinta ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezibuthakathaka zomphakathi. Ukuze sithathe izinyathelo eziphathekayo, kufanele sithathele phezulu ukufundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngezindlela zokuvikelwa kwemithombo yamanzi, ukuvuselela imithombo engcolile, nokugwema uhlelo lwezokuthutha olubi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokunqoba ezimweni ezinzima ezibhekene nezinsiza zomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulula kakhulu ukuhlola ukuvikelwa kwempilo yamanzi.
Ukuze sithathe izinyathelo eziphathekayo, kufanele sithathele phezulu ukufundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngezindlela zokuvikelwa kwemithombo yamanzi, ukuvuselela imithombo engcolile, nokugwema uhlelo lwezokuthutha olubi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokunqoba ezimweni ezinzima ezibhekene nezinsiza zomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulula kakhulu ukuhlola ukuvikelwa kwempilo yamanzi. Izindlela ezithile ezifana nezithuthi eziphumelelayo zifanele zisetshenziswe ukuphatha izinzuzo zamakhaya. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho abantu beqondiswa kahle, imiphakathi ithola amathuba okuphila akhula, futhi amanzi ahlanzekile avikela abantu ezinhlekeleleni eziningi. Ukukhulisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinsiza, ukwabelana ngezinsiza, nokwakha ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukile, kudinga ukhethe; lesi simo kufakazela ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kokuphila kwethu nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ekugcineni, amanzi ahlanzekile anikeza ithuba lokwenza kahle. Imiphakathi edinga amanzi ahlanzekile, kufanele iqaphele ukuthi onke amalungu kufanele athathe isinyathelo sokuphila kahle. Iphuzu elisemqoka ukuthi lowo msebenzi awuphathwa yihhovisi lempilo kuphela, kodwa wonke umuntu unendima okumele iyigcine, futhi kumele kuxhaswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ahlinzekwa, avikelwe, futhi anqandwa ekungcolisweni. Njengoba besiphila ezimweni ezinzima, kudinga ukuba sibe nezindlela eziphumelela, siziphe izinsiza ukuze sibe nempilo enempilo, sigcine futhi sakhe umhlaba onempilo, onezinga eliphezulu lempilo kuzo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo.
Izinhlamvu kanye ne-fertilizer - khumbula ukukala! Amathayi aphakanyisiwe asetshenziswa ukudlulisa amandla. Kunezindlela eziningi zokukala ukuhamba kwezindawo zokubeka izinhlamvu. Indlela evamile kakhulu iyona esebenzisa ipuleti elinamahole (eboniswe lapha ngezansi). Idiski yokukala inezikhala eziningi, usayizi walezi zikhala kufanele uvumele ukuthi inhlamvu eyodwa iwela ngesikhathi. Lapho idiski ijikeleza (iguquka), ihamba (ihamba) phezu kwepuleti elin hole elilodwa. Ingxenye ye-disk inenhlamvu esusa (esula) izinhlamvu eziphezulu kwalokho okukhona emhole lapho idiski iguquka. Phakathi kwalesi sula, kukhona nendawo enesiphethu esihamba phezu kwe-disk sicindezela inhlamvu ukuze iwela emholeni ephezu kwe-disk. Ukuklama nosayizi lwezikhala kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inhlamvu eyodwa kuphela ingena ngesikhathi futhi ayigcini emholeni, ingaphumeleli ukuwa noma ukungena kulowo mhole ephezu kwepuleti ukuze ifike emhlabathini. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-air planters - uhlobo olulodwa lusebenza ngengcindezi ethile (lokhu kusho ukuthi luphusha inhlamvu ukuba ingene emholeni), bese kuba nohlobo olusebenza ngengcindezi phambili (lokhu kusho ukuthi luphonsa inhlamvu ukuba ingene emholeni). Usayizi wezihlahla awubalulekile kakhulu kuma-air planters njengoba izihlahla ziphonswa emholeni, akubalulekile ukuthi zibe zinkulu kangakanani. Inani lezihlahla ezitshaliwe lihambisana nesivinini (isivinini) sepuleti elijikelezayo. Isakhiwo esivamile esiletha i-fertilizer sithiwa i-auger efana nesikhwama. Le screw ihlezi ngaphansi ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede elibamba i-fertilizer).
Inani lezihlahla ezitshaliwe lihambisana nesivinini (isivinini) sepuleti elijikelezayo. Isakhiwo esivamile esiletha i-fertilizer sithiwa i-auger efana nesikhwama. Le screw ihlezi ngaphansi ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede elibamba i-fertilizer). Ngokuvamile, le screw iqhutshwa yicheni evela kumathayi ahamba emhlabeni anikeza amandla. Lapho i-fertilizer ilethwa, ibanjwa ezindaweni ze-screw bese ithuthwa lapho iphuma khona. Indlela yokushintsha ukukala yile: shintsha ama-sprockets aqhuba icheni ngaphakathi kwe-bucket kanye nephayiphi yamandla. Isakhiwo se-disk esikala inani le-fertilizer sithandwa kakhulu kuma-planters angakakhiphi kakhulu. Idiski yokukala ayifani ne-screw ethumela i-fertilizer. Ikakhulukazi, i-fertilizer iyaphuma ebhakeni le-fertilizer futhi idiski yokukala isiza ukukhulula i-fertilizer. Isakhiwo esihamba i-fertilizer siyisithiyo (ridge) phezulu kwe-disk esiza ukuhambisa i-fertilizer ukuze ingene emhlabathini. Ukukala kungashintshwa ngokuvula noma ukuvala umhole noma isango lapho i-fertilizer iphuma. Isakhiwo sokukala esifana nesithwathwa sikhombisa uhlelo lokukala ngqo. I-star wheel ikhuluma ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede) kodwa inezinhlamvu ezikhula (eziphuma) ngaphandle kwe-bucket. Phakathi kwe-bucket, i-fertilizer ibanjwa yizinhlamvu zaleyo wheel, lapho i-wheel ijikeleza, i-fertilizer ikhishwa ukuze iphume ebhakeni futhi iwela emathubeni. Shintsha ama-sprockets ajikelezayo ukuze ajikeze ngokushesha noma kancane. Shintsha i-star wheel ukuze ufake enye enezinhlamvu ezinde noma ezimfishane.
Phakathi kwe-bucket, i-fertilizer ibanjwa yizinhlamvu zaleyo wheel, lapho i-wheel ijikeleza, i-fertilizer ikhishwa ukuze iphume ebhakeni futhi iwela emathubeni. Shintsha ama-sprockets ajikelezayo ukuze ajikeze ngokushesha noma kancane. Shintsha i-star wheel ukuze ufake enye enezinhlamvu ezinde noma ezimfishane. Ezinye izinhlobo ze-star wheels zinegate efana nesakhiwo se-disk sokukala. Lapho uvula isango, i-fertilizer eningi izophuma. Sifunde ukuthi izakhiwo zama-planters ziwuphi futhi zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukukala inani lezihlahla ne-fertilizer - kodwa manje kufanele sibuze ukuthi lezi zakhiwo ziqhutshwa kanjani? Uhlelo lokukala luvame ukuthola amandla kumathayi asekelayo i-planter. Futhi amathayi aphakanyisiwe kwesinye isikhathi asetshenziswa ukudlulisa amandla nokusekela i-planter. Ngesinye isikhathi, ithayi elilodwa lixhunywe kwi-planter elenza lowo msebenzi. Leli thayi lingabamba isisindo esanele kodwa lingacindezelwa ngesiphethu ukuze libambe kahle ngaphandle kokushelela. Kukhona futhi ama-treads nezinye izinto ezingangezwa ukuvimbela ithayi ukuthi lingasheleli kakhulu. Isivinini se-thayi esiqhuba sitholakala ngesivinini se-tractor - uma i-tractor ihamba ngokushesha, leli thayi lizohamba ngokushesha. Uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni lusetshenziswa ukukala isivinini sokuhamba kwezakhiwo ezikala inani lezihlahla, futhi kukhona olunye uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni ukukala ukuhamba kwezakhiwo ze-fertilizer.
Kukhona futhi ama-treads nezinye izinto ezingangezwa ukuvimbela ithayi ukuthi lingasheleli kakhulu. Isivinini se-thayi esiqhuba sitholakala ngesivinini se-tractor - uma i-tractor ihamba ngokushesha, leli thayi lizohamba ngokushesha. Uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni lusetshenziswa ukukala isivinini sokuhamba kwezakhiwo ezikala inani lezihlahla, futhi kukhona olunye uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni ukukala ukuhamba kwezakhiwo ze-fertilizer. Qaphela: ama-planters ahlukene anezakhiwo zokukala ezahlukene - isibonelo, ezinye izinhlobo zine-levers ezingavula noma zivalwe endaweni lapho izihlahla ne-fertilizer ziphuma. Ukushintsha isivinini sezakhiwo kusebenzisa ama-gear ratios - kufanele uqonde kahle ukuthi le mfundiso isebenza kanjani.
iXbox Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukhuluma nawe ngento ethokozisayo, iXbox. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi le midlalwano yevidiyo ibaluleke kangakanani emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla? Ngiyazi, kungenzeka ukuthi abanye bethu sikhuluma ngalezi zinto ezithokozisayo, kodwa iXbox iyinto ethokozisayo kakhulu. Ngizokhuluma ngayo, ngizokhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezihambisana nayo, futhi ngizokwenza kube lula ukuze uqonde kahle. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngokuqala kweXbox. Iqala ngonyaka ka-2001, lapho iMicrosoft yethula khona iXbox yokuqala. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu emhlabeni wezokudlala, njengoba kwavula umnyango omusha kubadlali abaningi. Ngabe ubungakholwa ukuthi iXbox yokuqala yayinekhono lokuxhuma ku-inthanethi? Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokudlala nabantu abavela emhlabeni wonke, okwakungakaze kube khona ngaphambili. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babengakaze bacabange ukuthi bazokwazi ukudlala imidlalo nabantu abavela emazweni ahlukene. Ngemuva kwalokho, iXbox 360 yatholakala, futhi lokhu kwaba yinto enkulu. I-360 yenza kube lula ukudlala imidlalo emisha, futhi yathuthukisa kakhulu izithombe nemiphumela. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi imidlalo efana ne-"Halo" ne-"Gears of War" yathandwa kakhulu? Le midlalwano yenza abantu babe nezinhloso ezithile, futhi ibangele imiphakathi emisha. Abantu babebhalisela iXbox Live, lapho bekhuthazwa khona ukuba badlale imidlalo, baxhumane, futhi benze abangane abasha. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi iXbox ayigcini nje ngokudlala imidlalo? Ibuye ibe yindawo yokubuka amafilimu, ukusakaza umculo, nokwenza izinto eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani.
Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi iXbox ayigcini nje ngokudlala imidlalo? Ibuye ibe yindawo yokubuka amafilimu, ukusakaza umculo, nokwenza izinto eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani. Ngabe ubungakholwa ukuthi ungabuka amafilimu akho owathandayo ngenkathi udlala imidlalo? Lokhu kwenza iXbox ibe yindawo yokuhlala, hhayi nje indawo yokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMicrosoft yathuthukisa iXbox One, futhi lokhu kwaba yinto eyodwa eyayithokozisa kakhulu. I-4K gaming, izithombe ezicacile, nezici eziningi ezithokozisayo zenza kube lula ukujabulisa. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi ungakwazi ukuxhuma iXbox yakho kumakhalekhukhwini? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukudlala noma kuphi, futhi ungakwazi ukujabulisa ngisho nasemsebenzini. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithokozisayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Abadlali Abasebasha: Ukuhamba Komzila Wokukhula Nezinkinga Eziwubuhlungu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadlali abasebasha bakhula ngokushesha ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izigidi zethu ngezinsuku zemidlalo. Abantwana abavela ezindaweni zemidlalo, izikole, nezikole ezimaphakathi, bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi yabo yokudlala. Nokho, ukubhekelela izinzuzo eziqhamukayo kulezi zindawo kudinga ukucaciswa. Abadlali abasebasha banamathuba amaningi emhlabeni wezokudlala, kepha baphinde babhekane nezinselelo ezinzima. Lapho sikhuluma ngabadlali abasebasha, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abanye baphikiswa yizimo eziningi. Okwokuqala, sinama-athletics, imidlalo yeqembu, kanye nezemidlalo ezinzima ezidinga ukuthi abadlali babe nekhono eliphezulu. Abadlali abancane bakhuthazwa ukuba bathathe imidlalo ukuze bathole ithuba lokuphumelela, kepha kanjani, uma umuzwa wokuncintisana ungaholela ekucindezelweni? Lokhu kwempi yoxhaso phakathi kokuzijabulisa nobunzima bokuthola impumelelo kukhombisa isimo esingabi nansi esivame ukwenzeka. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi abezindaba kumele bahloniphe abadlali abasebasha, begcizelela imithetho nezindlela zokuziphatha ezinhle. Ngokuphambene, abanye abakholwa ekutheni imidlalo kufanele ibe yinsika yokufundisa, okukhombisa ukuthi edlini yezenhlalo nabadlalayo abadala kufanele kube neqhaza elikhulu ekunikezeni abantwana abasha ithuba lokukhula. Izingxoxo ezinjalo zishaywa indiva, zikhombisa indlela ezahlukeneyo zokubheka isimo. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi abadlali abasebasha badinga ukuhlonishwa ngebanga locwaningo lokuziphatha, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bajabula kangakanani.
Ngokuphambene, abanye abakholwa ekutheni imidlalo kufanele ibe yinsika yokufundisa, okukhombisa ukuthi edlini yezenhlalo nabadlalayo abadala kufanele kube neqhaza elikhulu ekunikezeni abantwana abasha ithuba lokukhula. Izingxoxo ezinjalo zishaywa indiva, zikhombisa indlela ezahlukeneyo zokubheka isimo. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi abadlali abasebasha badinga ukuhlonishwa ngebanga locwaningo lokuziphatha, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bajabula kangakanani. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuzijabulisa emidlalweni, okukhuthaza abantwana ukuba baqhubeke bezama. Abadlali abaningi basengozini yokucindezelwa, okukhumbuza ukuthi imidlalo akuyona nje into yokuzijabulisa, kepha ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Njengoba abantwana bejolisa emkhakheni wezenhlalo, kudingeka bahlale bexhumana nabazali, othisha, nabaphathiswa abakhuthazayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezikhona zikhula kakhulu, kodwa zidinga ukuhamba phambili emikhankasweni yokuletha izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Imali yokuxhasa abathandi bemidlalo iphakathi kwezinsiza ezibucayi. Abakhiqizi bemidlalo nabaxhasi kufanele bahloniphe imiphumela ethile yokuthuthukiswa kwemidlalo phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kucwaninga kubalulekile ukuze kubhekelwe ukukhula kwempilo nokuxhasa umphakathi. Kodwa ke, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokudlala esebenzayo. Izingane zidinga ukunikezwa amathuba okujabulisa emidlalweni, naye umphakathi kufanele ube nenkathazo yokuthuthukiswa. Othisha, abazali, nabaphathiswa kufanele babe uchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise imiphumela emihlanu yempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha.
Izingane zidinga ukunikezwa amathuba okujabulisa emidlalweni, naye umphakathi kufanele ube nenkathazo yokuthuthukiswa. Othisha, abazali, nabaphathiswa kufanele babe uchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise imiphumela emihlanu yempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi udinga ukuhlanganyela ukuze hushe izinqumo eziphathelene nempilo yamalunga. Ngokukufingqa, abadlali abasebasha babhekwa njengezimpawu zokukhula emphakathini wezemidlalo. Ubuhle bezemidlalo buphinde buhlobene nezinsiza eziphuma ezintweni eziningi. Abadlali abancane badinga ukunakekelwa, abathandi besikhumbuzo, nezinsiza ezinkulu ukuze bakhule. Kusemqoka ukufaka umqondo omuhle kwemidlalo, benesibopho sokugcina impumelelo yezenhlalo. Lokhu kuhambisana nezinhlelo ezinethezekile, ukuxhumana okuhle, nokuqhuba izifundo eziphumelelayo. Kukhona uzhokufa ozodinga ´ukwazi ukubamba kokubili, ukuzijabulisa nokuxhasa imisebenzi ezothuthukisa impilo yabo. Sifuna ukusekela abadlali basebasha ukuze bakhule babe nethuba lokuphumelela, bahloniphe isimo, bemukele uhla lwezinselelo, bese beqhubeka phambili. Ukugcina umhlaba wobuchwepheshe, bawuthumele lokho kuchaza ese, bekwazi ngempela ukwenza njengempilo, bathuthukise umqondo wezemidlalo, negalelo elichaphazelekayo elizogqugquzela ubuchule. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuhamba phambili kwezemidlalo phakathi komphakathi, kuzokwenza umkhakha wezemidlalo ube yinsika ethe xaxa.
