Uhlu lwezincwadi (theses) ezigcinwe yiOfisi Yezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela (Uhlu lutholakala kwiOfisi Yezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela). Izincwadi ezikhona ezikhungweni zeMnyango Wezokuvikela ziqala ngo-1912 lapho i-Union Defence Force (UDF) yasungulwa.
Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekudluliseni kolwazi nasekusekeleni iMnyango Wezokuvikela nasekusekeleni izinhloso zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Uhlu lwezincwadi (theses) ezigcinwe yiOfisi Yezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela (Uhlu lutholakala kwiOfisi Yezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela). Izincwadi ezikhona ezikhungweni zeMnyango Wezokuvikela ziqala ngo-1912 lapho i-Union Defence Force (UDF) yasungulwa. Izincwadi ezikhona ezikhungweni kusukela eminyakeni engu-1912 kuya ku-1969 zikhombisa imisebenzi eyinhloko yazo zonke izingxenye ze-UDF ne-SADF. Imisebenzi emikhulu ihlobene nokusungulwa, ukuphathwa, nezici zobuchwepheshe bezempi futhi iphinde ithinte izenzakalo ngesikhathi sokulwa nangesikhathi sokuthula. Izincwadi zokuthi kwenzekeni zifaka ulwazi ngokuqhathaniswa kweNingizimu Afrika kwiMpi Yezwe I (1914 - 1918) neMpi Yezwe II (1939 - 1945), iBerlin Airlift (1948 - 1949), neMpi yaseKorea (1950 - 1953) kanye nokusungulwa kwezempi nezivivinyo ngesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kwangaphakathi ezweni njengokuhlasela kwemisebenzi kusukela ngo-1914 kuya ku-1922, izinkulumo zokuphikisa kusukela ngo-1914 kuya ku-1915, nezinkinga kusukela ngo-1950 kuya ku-1960. Izincwadi zokuphatha ziqukethe ulwazi lokusungulwa, ukuhlela, nokusebenza kwazo zonke izingxenye ze-UDF ne-SADF, kanye nosizo lwabasebenzi, ukuhlela umsebenzi,
Umbiko Ngomsebenzi KaBlack Coffee Isingeniso UBlack Coffee ungumculi ophumelelayo eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ufinyelele impumelelo enkulu, edlulisela umculo owamukelekile, ohlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene. Umculo wakhe udala izikhumbuzo ezikhethekile empilweni yabantu. Kulolu mbiko, sizobheka izimpumelelo zakhe, izinhlelo ezithinta impilo yakhe, kanye nomsebenzi wakhe. Ukukhula Nokubambisana UBlack Coffee, ogama lakhe langempela linguNkosinathi Maphumulo, wazalelwa eLimpopo ngomhla zingu-11 kuNhlangula ngo-1976. Wakhulela emndenini ophila impilo ejwayelekile, kodwa umculo wamkhanga kusenesikhathi. Ngesikhathi esekhaya, wagxila ekuthuthukiseni ikhono lakhe lokudlala ikhithi ye-DJ, okwakuwuqala wempilo yakhe njengomculi. Waqala ukufaka ama-samples omculo abaculi abanjengoBeyoncé, uDavid Guetta, noKylie Minogue ukuze akhe umculo ophumelelayo. UBlack Coffee usebenzise ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukuze athuthukise umculo wakhe, evula izicabha eziningi ezinhle, kuholele ekubeni abambe iqhaza emicimbini emikhulu, njenge-Coachella ngo-2019. Umculo Nethonya UBlack Coffee uthole udumo ngezinkanyezi zakhe eziningi, ezifana ne-"SBCNCSLY", "Drive", kanye ne-"Inkalakatha". Umculo wakhe uhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene, kusukela kumculo wezizukulwane zasemzini kuze kufike emculweni wezothando. Ungomunye wabaculi abahamba phambili beHouse Music eNingizimu Afrika, futhi uthanda ukusebenzisa izinsiza ze-melody nezithombe eziphilayo ukuze akhe imvamisa abazwanayo. Ukwazisa Umphakathi UBlack Coffee akagcini nje ngemculo, kodwa ube nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi.
Umculo wakhe uhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene, kusukela kumculo wezizukulwane zasemzini kuze kufike emculweni wezothando. Ungomunye wabaculi abahamba phambili beHouse Music eNingizimu Afrika, futhi uthanda ukusebenzisa izinsiza ze-melody nezithombe eziphilayo ukuze akhe imvamisa abazwanayo. Ukwazisa Umphakathi UBlack Coffee akagcini nje ngemculo, kodwa ube nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi. Uxhasa izinhlelo zezemidlalo, izikhungo zempilo, kanye nezifundo zabantwana emiphakathini ehluphekayo. Uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo, edlala indima yokwakha ikusasa elihle. UBlack Coffee futhi ubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, ezigqugquzela ukuhlonipha nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imifino Nezinhlelo Zesikhathi Esizayo Njengoba uBlack Coffee eqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe, ubufakazi bempumelelo yakhe buboniswa ngama-albhamu akhe amasha. Umculo wakhe ungumthombo wokuthokozisa, umqondo, kanye nezifundo kubantu abahlangabezana nezinselelo ezahlukene. UBlack Coffee udinga ukudlalwa ezindaweni ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, lapho athola khona ithuba lokwabelana ngempilo nekusasa elithokozisayo. Isiphetho UBlack Coffee uyisibonelo somsebenzi obalulekile emculweni wethu. Ufinyelele impumelelo enkulu, futhi ukuhamba phambili kwemicabango yakhe kukhombisa amandla omculo. Njengoba eqhubeka nokwakha umbono omkhulu, siphinde simfisele inhlanhla. UBlack Coffee uyasikhumbuza ngothando lwezwi, umculo, kanye nezifiso zethu, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono.
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuguqula izindawo ezingenamibandela luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa futhi luwumsebenzi obalulekile ekusizeni uhulumeni bendawo ukuba babambe iqhaza ngempumelelo ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinhlelo ezisekelayo ngokusebenzisa iMthetho Wokuphathwa KweZindawo Zasemakhaya kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kokwakhiwa komthetho omusha kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wokwakhiwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kanye neMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siqediwe, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesizinda esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zohulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela okwakhiwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphathwa kwamamunicipality kanye nengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukufinyelela izinqumo ezimayelana nezindaba ezifana nezabelomali zamamunicipality, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngokuqonda, okuhlelekile, nendlela ebonakalayo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamamunicipality kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamunicipality.
Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela okwakhiwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphathwa kwamamunicipality kanye nengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukufinyelela izinqumo ezimayelana nezindaba ezifana nezabelomali zamamunicipality, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngokuqonda, okuhlelekile, nendlela ebonakalayo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamamunicipality kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamunicipality. Esikhathini esedlule, amamunicipality avame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu ngenqubo yokuhlela i-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho uhlaka lomthetho. Amamunicipality amaningi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okudlulela Phambili) abengenazo izinsiza nezakhono zokuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe kulezi zimo, noma izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinselelo, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bazuze kakhulu kulwazi abaluqoqile. Kukhona amamunicipality ambalwa athole inqubekela phambili enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Izincwadi zokuhola i-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elinobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene kusuka ku-DPLG esekelwa yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa.
Naphezu kwalezi zinselelo, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bazuze kakhulu kulwazi abaluqoqile. Kukhona amamunicipality ambalwa athole inqubekela phambili enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Izincwadi zokuhola i-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elinobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene kusuka ku-DPLG esekelwa yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukhona uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwezizwe lwezikhulu zamamunicipality, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababamba iqhaza kusuka kumamunicipality. Uhlelo lwezizwe lokweseka izinhlelo zamamunicipality (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zamamunicipality. Inani elikhulu lamamunicipality, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yohulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi yemboni yohulumeni ezweni iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kulolu hlelo olusha lwezincwadi ze-IDP. Nginehope enkulu yokuthi le miphakathi yezincwadi ezishicilelwe izoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela ku-IDP nokuqhubeka kwenu ukwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ebonakalayo. Umhlahlandlela VI: Ukuphatha umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokukhuthaza izidingo ezithile kulolu hlelo lwecebo lokusebenza, ngaleyo ndlela kucaciswe kahle phakathi kwalokho okufanele kwenzeke njengoba kudingwa umthetho kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza neziphakamiso ezingekho emthethweni kulabo abafuna izeluleko ezithile ezimfunweni zokuhlela. a. Kungani kwenziwa?
Nginehope enkulu yokuthi le miphakathi yezincwadi ezishicilelwe izoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela ku-IDP nokuqhubeka kwenu ukwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ebonakalayo. Umhlahlandlela VI: Ukuphatha umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokukhuthaza izidingo ezithile kulolu hlelo lwecebo lokusebenza, ngaleyo ndlela kucaciswe kahle phakathi kwalokho okufanele kwenzeke njengoba kudingwa umthetho kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza neziphakamiso ezingekho emthethweni kulabo abafuna izeluleko ezithile ezimfunweni zokuhlela. a. Kungani kwenziwa? b. Yini elindelwe ephumeleni lenqubo yokuhlela? c. Uhlelo noma uhlelo kufanele lubukeke kanjani ukuze kufezwe umphumela ofunwayo? e. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani? Incazelo ejwayelekile yokuhlanganiswa kwezincwadi ze-IDP. Ukwazisa amaqembu abamba iqhaza ngama-oda alindelekile nezibopho ezidingekayo kule nqubo. Lokhu kubandakanya iminyango yesifunda kanye nezwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ejwayelekile kanye nekhanda elisheshayo lenqubo ye-IDP kulabo abaphethe ukuphatha inqubo. Indaba efingqiwe ihloselwe ukusiza abantu baqonde imvelaphi nenqubo ye-Integrated Development Plan ngaphandle kokugxila kakhulu ezincwadini. Uma ababamba iqhaza befuna ulwazi olunembile, kufanele babheke ezihlalweni abazithakaselayo. I-Integrated Development Plan iyinqubo lapho amamunicipality alungiselela isu lokuthuthukiswa leminyaka emihlanu. I-IDP iyithuluzi eliyinhloko lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa.
Uma ababamba iqhaza befuna ulwazi olunembile, kufanele babheke ezihlalweni abazithakaselayo. I-Integrated Development Plan iyinqubo lapho amamunicipality alungiselela isu lokuthuthukiswa leminyaka emihlanu. I-IDP iyithuluzi eliyinhloko lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa. I-IDP iyisikhumbuzo sokuqala sokuhlela inqubomgomo futhi ibonisa indlela phambili futhi ihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokuhlela, ukuhlukaniswa kwezabelomali, ukuphathwa, kanye nezinqumo ezithathwa kumakhansela noma kumamunicipality. Yini isimo somthetho se-IDPs? NgokweMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya ka-2000, wonke amamunicipality (lezo zedolobha ezinkulu, amamunicipality endawo, kanye nezifunda) kumele alandele inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ukuze akhe ama-IDPs. Njengoba i-IDP iyimfuneko yomthetho, inegunya lomthetho futhi idlula ezinye izindlela ezihola ukuthuthukiswa ezingeni lohulumeni bendawo. NgokweMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya, wonke amaKhansela amasha kanye nalabo abavula amahhovisi ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala kumele alungiselele i-IDP ezothatha iminyaka emihlanu. Ngakho-ke, i-IDP ixhunywe nesikhathi sokusebenza kwamakhansela. IKhansela elisha lingakhetha ukwamukela i-IDP eyakhelwe yibo abaphuma ezikhundleni uma ibona ifanele noma ingaqala i-IDP entsha kodwa kufanele icabangele imibhalo yezinhlelo ezikhona. iv. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda inqubo? Inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ibandakanya ukubambisana nokuxhumana futhi ifaka izakhiwo eziningi ezibamba iqhaza.
iv. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda inqubo? Inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ibandakanya ukubambisana nokuxhumana futhi ifaka izakhiwo eziningi ezibamba iqhaza. Ngenxa yesidingo sokubambisana, kuthatha isikhathi esilinganiselwa ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kuya kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili ukuqeda i-IDP, futhi lesi sikhathi sihambisana kakhulu nesikhathi sokuhlela sezabelomali zamamunicipality. Kubalulekile, ngesikhathi salo, ukwethulwa kwemisebenzi yomphakathi nokuthuthukiswa akumisiwe kodwa kuyaqhubeka. I-IDP ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke, kuholela ezinguqukweni zamasu uma kudingeka. v. Yiziphi izici ezibalulekile noma izimo ze-IDPs? Ukuhlola isimo samanje sokuthuthukiswa, okubandakanya ukukhombisa imiphakathi engekho nezinsiza ezibalulekile zezempilo. Ngamafuphi, i-Integrated Development Plan ibhekana namamunicipality lapho ahlaziya khona izidingo/izinkinga eziphuthumayo, imigomo, nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kubhekwe lezi zinselelo. Isigaba esibaluleke kakhulu se-IDPs ukuhlanganisa uhlelo nezabelomali zamamunicipality (ukuhlukanisa izimali ezitholwe ngaphakathi nezitholwe ngaphandle kwezinto ez
Ukukhetha ukudla okufanele kubalulekile kakhulu kithi sonke, ikakhulukazi uma unegciwane elingapheli njenge-obesity, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV. Ukudla kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphucula uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela ukuze ulwe nezifo, kukhuphule amandla akho omzimba, futhi kukwenze uzizwe ungcono isikhathi eside. Ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo kubantu abaneziguli eziphakeme njengezifo zomdlavuza, obesity, kanye ne-HIV akufanele kuthathwe kalula. Ezinye izifo nemithi esetshenziselwa ukuwaphikisa ivame ukuholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo zizokusiza umuntu onegciwane elingapheli ukuthi abhekane kangcono nezimpawu zalesi simo futhi agweme ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Ubisi olungakawushintshi, ikhrimu, kanye nemikhiqizo yayo (ubisi oluphonswayo, ushizi, i-yogurt) kungangezwa ezidleni ukuze kuhanjiswe amandla engeziwe kanye nephrotheni. Faka amafutha afana ne-margarine, ibhotela, kanye ne-mayonnaise ezidleni ukuze uthole amandla engeziwe futhi uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla. Uma uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ungajabuli ngemva kokwengeza amafutha engeziwe ezidleni zakho, zama ukunciphisa. Ake sithole ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezimpawu zesifo ezingenza ungafuni ukudla. Yini engingayenza uma ngizwa sengathi angifuni ukudla? Izifo, ukudangala, nokuhlukumezeka kungakwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Zama lokhu okulandelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele ukuze ugcine umzimba wakho uqine.
Yini engingayenza uma ngizwa sengathi angifuni ukudla? Izifo, ukudangala, nokuhlukumezeka kungakwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Zama lokhu okulandelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele ukuze ugcine umzimba wakho uqine. Ukudla okufana noshukela, ubisi oluphonswayo, kanye namafutha kuhlinzeka ngamandla amaningi nakuba kudliwa ngezinga elincane. Uma kungenzeka, kufanele kube kuhlanganiswe nezinye izidlo. Zama ukudla nomunye umuntu - ukudla nabanye kukwenza ujabulele ukudla kakhulu. Dla izidlo zakho endaweni ethokomele ukuze ujabulele kakhulu (dlala umculo, ngaphansi kwesihlahla, noma epakini). Ungabambeleli ezikhathini ezinqunyiwe zokudla - dlani noma nini uma uzizwa ufisa ukudla. Ukuhamba kancane kukhuphula umnqweno wokudla. Phuza iziphuzo ezinamandla phakathi nosuku, ezifana neziphuzo ezisekelwe kubisi, iziphuzo ezinamazambane, kanye nesobho esenziwe ekhaya. Dla ukudla okuthandayo - kungenzeka ukuthi uzodla kakhulu ngalendlela. Gwema ukudla okunokuthungwa okuqinile njengekhabhishi nekhofi uma kukwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Uma imithi oyithathayo ikwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno, buza umhlinzeki wezempilo uma ungathatha imithi ngemuva kokudla. Ingabe uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ukuhamba? Dla izigaba ezincane zokudla ngezikhathi eziningi ukuze ugweme ukuzizwa ungaphilile. Linda okungenani amahora amabili ngemuva kokudla ngaphambi kokulala. Gwema ukuphuza nothuli. Bangathuthukisa ukungakhululeki futhi bahlukumeze impilo yakho. Zama ukuphuza amanzi amaningi njengezimpahla ezihlanzekile kanye netiye.
Gwema ukuphuza nothuli. Bangathuthukisa ukungakhululeki futhi bahlukumeze impilo yakho. Zama ukuphuza amanzi amaningi njengezimpahla ezihlanzekile kanye netiye. Zama ukuphuza lezi ziphuzo ngezikhathi lapho ungadli noma ngaphambi kokudla, njengoba lokhu kungakwenza uzwe ukungakhululeki. Ukubhekana nokungakhululeki nokuhamba... Imithi yokwelapha ivame ukuholela ekungakhululekeni nasekuhambeni. Dla izigaba ezincane zokudla ngezikhathi eziningi - ukungakhululeki kuba kubi uma kungekho lutho esiswini. Linda kuze kube uzwa ungcono ngaphambi kokudla, kodwa ungashiyi izidlo. Gwema ukudla okushisayo kakhulu nokunamafutha. Faka kancane uju lwelemons noma ingxenye ye-lemon eziphuzweni ezibandayo. Zama ukudla ukudla okubandayo ukuze iphunga olithola ngesikhathi sokupheka lingakwenzi uzwe ukungakhululeki. Ngokuvamile, umzimba uthokozisa ukudla okubandayo kangcono. Gcina indawo yakho yokuhlala ivulekile kahle. Hlala uphakamile ngemuva kokudla - linda okungenani imizuzu engama-20 ngaphambi kokulala ukuze ugweme ukuhamba. Uma unomkhuhlane, udinga ukufaka amanzi alahlekile uma uphumeza. Phuza amanzi amaningi - ngaphezu kwalokho okudingayo uma ungatholi amanzi. Uma uzwa sengathi awufuni ukudla, ungakha isobho sezinhlanzi, ama-patato, amakharoti, noma noma yiziphi ezinye izitshalo onazo. Lokhu kunganikeza umzimba wakho amandla nezithako. Ungazizwa ungatholi kahle uma kunzima futhi kunzima ukudlula. Gwema ukusebenzisa ama-laxatives nanoma yiziphi ezinye "imikhiqizo yokuhlanzeka kwesisu" efana ne-enemas.
Lokhu kunganikeza umzimba wakho amandla nezithako. Ungazizwa ungatholi kahle uma kunzima futhi kunzima ukudlula. Gwema ukusebenzisa ama-laxatives nanoma yiziphi ezinye "imikhiqizo yokuhlanzeka kwesisu" efana ne-enemas. Ama-laxatives ne-enemas enza ukuthi umzimba wakho ulahlekelwe izithako eziningi ezibalulekile futhi kuyisixazululo esikahle kuphela esingaxazululi inkinga yangempela. Dla ukudla okungakawushintshi futhi okuncane okwenziwe ngeziphuzo ezimhlophe (amakhukhi, ama-pastries, njll.). Hlala usebenza kakhulu! Ukuhamba njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa umnqweno wokuhamba. Ungazizwa ukungakhululeki uma unokuhamba kathathu ngosuku nezinkanyezi ezimanzi. Ukuhamba kungaholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle ngoba ukudla kudlula emzimbeni wakho ngokushesha kakhulu ukuze umzimba wakho ukwazi ukukwamukela. Umuntu uphinde udle kancane ngoba ungenamfuno. Uma unokuhamba, umzimba wakho uzoba ne-dehydration ngoba ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi - lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi yi-dehydration. I-dehydration ibalulekile kakhulu futhi ingaba yingozi. Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma nginokuhamba? Phuza amanzi amaningi nezimpahla ukuze ubuyise amanzi alahlekile emzimbeni wakho. Ukuze wenze isiphuzo esenziwe ekhaya sokubuyisela amanzi alahlekile, thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi aphekiwe bese uvumela ukuba kuphume. Faka ama-teaspoons amane noshukela kanye ne-teaspoon eyodwa ye-salt. Hlanganisa le ngxube ngangokunokwenzeka. Mayelana ne-Mining Qualifications Authority (MQA), iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu (CEO). Umphathi wezokuxhumana anganikeza amandla noma imisebenzi enikezwe kuMphathi Wemininingwane ngaphansi kwalesi sikhungo kumphathi wezokuxhumana ophakeme. I-CEO kumele iqashe umuntu ukuze abe nguMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-MQA iyatholakala kulabo abafuna ukufaka isicelo sokuthola ulwazi olukhona kulabo abafuna amarekhodi. Umphathi Wemininingwane ungumuntu ongakwazi ukuhlela nokubhekelela uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme we-MQA. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi aqukethe ulwazi ngabo, imibono, nemibono yomunye umuntu mayelana nesipho, ithokheni, noma umklomelo onikezwe kulowo muntu lapho imibono noma imibono yomunye umuntu ivela; kanye negama lalowo muntu lapho livela kanye nolwazi lwabo noma luhambisana nalowo muntu noma lapho ukuveza kwegama kuzokhombisa ulwazi ngomuntu osefile isikhathi eside kuneminyaka engama-20. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi ku-MQA. Noma ubani (kubandakanya noma ongagciniwe), uhulumeni wangaphandle, inhlangano yomhlaba wonke engaphezu komfaki-sicelo, futhi futhi ngenhloso yesigaba 34 salolu shintsho, uma kukhulunywa ngencazelo ethi "umuntu" ezigabeni (a) no (b) kufanele ihunyushwe njengokukhuluma ng "umuntu ophilayo." UMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme okuthunyelwe isicelo samarekhodi kuye angakhulisa noma alibambezelele lezi zinsuku eziyi-30 ezikhulunywa esigabeni 25 ngenye iminyaka engama-30 uma isicelo sikhuluma ngenani elikhulu lamarekhodi noma uma kudingeka ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezakhiwo ukuze kutholakale amarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele aziswe ngezizathu zokwandiswa kwesikhathi. Uma isicelo samukelwa, uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ngemali ekhokhwayo ngokwesigaba 10.4 salolu shintsho ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nesicelo. Uma uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ethola ukuthi isicelo sidinga ukubhekwa yisikhungo somphakathi, uMphathi Wemininingwane kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14, asithumele esikhungweni esifanele futhi azise umfaki-sicelo ngaleso sithunywa. Inqubo yokuxoxisana ixhaswa yizakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo ezifana neBhodi, Ikhansela Eliphezulu (EXCO), nezinye izinkomidi ezahlukene. Amarekhodi atholakala lapha yilezi okufanele afakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. La marekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo.
Inqubo yokuxoxisana ixhaswa yizakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo ezifana neBhodi, Ikhansela Eliphezulu (EXCO), nezinye izinkomidi ezahlukene. Amarekhodi atholakala lapha yilezi okufanele afakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. La marekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Izinhlobo zamarekhodi zihlukaniswe zibe yilezo ezitholakala ngokushesha kanye neze ezitholakala ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo njengoba kutholakala emthethweni. Isigaba 5 soMthetho sikhombisa ukuthi i-PAIA isebenza ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona eminye imithetho engase ivimbe noma icishe ukuveza ulwazi futhi engahambisani nezinhloso noma nezinhlinzeko ze-PAIA. Isigaba 55. Amarekhodi akhishwa lapha atholakala kuphela uma efakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. Angaxhumana noMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ukuze athole la marekhodi, atholakala ukuze abhekwe, athengwe, noma athathwe izithombe uma imali ethile enikeziwe esigabeni 11.4 ngezansi ikhokhwe. Amarekhodi akhishwa ngezansi atholakala uma efakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. La marekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Imali yokufaka isicelo iyimali ebekiwe engu-R35.00. Le mali kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sikwazi processing, futhi uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ukuthi kumele akhokhe le mali, ngaphandle uma umfaki-sicelo efaka isicelo solwazi ngaye. Imali yokuhlinzeka ngolwazi ifaka izindleko zokwenza kopi, ukufuna, ukuhlela, nezindleko zokuthumela uma kudingeka. Uma isikhathi sokuhlela sidlula amahora ayisithupha,
Imidlalo Yesikole: Ukuqala, Uhlelo, Nezinga Lemfundo Imidlalo yesikole ibalulekile empilweni yamanje, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni nasebusheni. Le midlalwano ayikhulisi kuphela amandla omzimba, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekuqeqesheni ubuntu nemisebenzi yokubambisana. Isifundo somzimba, esiphakathi kwemfundo yansuku zonke, sifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, kubalwa imidlalo ethokozisayo efana nebhola, ibhola lezinyawo, nezinye eziningi. Kulezi zinsuku, imidlalo yesikole ibalulekile ekwenzeni izingane zibe nekhono, uzwelo, nesimilo esihle. Isingeniso Emidlalweni Yesikole Ukwazi ukuthi imidlalo yesikole ibaluleke kangakanani, kufanele siqale sihlole izinzuzo ezitholakala kulokhu. Izinzuzo zomzimba zingabhekwa njengenye yezinzuzo eziyinhloko imidlalo yesikole. Izifundo zomzimba zingasiza ekwakheni amandla, ukujikeleza, nempilo yenhliziyo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umoya wokuncintisana ubalulekile ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Lapha, abantwana bayakwazi ukufunda ukuthi ukuphumelela kuncike ekusebenzisaneni, ukuzinikela, kanye neqiniso lokuthi akupheli yonke imidlalo. Imiphumela Emihle Yomqondo Nongqondongqondo Ngaphandle kokuba nomthelela omuhle emzimbeni, imidlalo yesikole nayo ibalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Izingane zithola ithuba lokufunda ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo, nokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu empilweni yazo yesikole, ngoba kubasiza ukuthi bafunde ukulawula ukucindezeleka, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi semiphakathi ethina. Ukuze uthole okuningi, imidlalo ibavumela ukuthi bazitholele izindlela ezintsha zokuqhamuka nezixazululo, okwakha ukucabanga okuthuthukile. Ubuciko Bokubambisana Nempumelelo Imidlalo yesikole ifundisa abantwana ukuthi basebenze ndawonye.
Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu empilweni yazo yesikole, ngoba kubasiza ukuthi bafunde ukulawula ukucindezeleka, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi semiphakathi ethina. Ukuze uthole okuningi, imidlalo ibavumela ukuthi bazitholele izindlela ezintsha zokuqhamuka nezixazululo, okwakha ukucabanga okuthuthukile. Ubuciko Bokubambisana Nempumelelo Imidlalo yesikole ifundisa abantwana ukuthi basebenze ndawonye. Ubuciko bokubambisana buvelela lapho izingane zisebenza njengeqembu. Lokhu kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ukusebenza eqenjini kudingeka emikhakheni eyahlukene, kusukela emsebenzini kuya ekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Isimo sokuncintisana nobumbano kungenza abantwana bazwe befana ngoba benza okuhle ngokuhlanganyela. Ukuze sikhulise lezi zinto, izikole kufanele ziqinise izinhlelo zokuhlela imijaho nemidlalo yokubambisana. Izifundo Zokubekezela Zokuhlola Imidlalo yesikole nayo ifundisa abantwana ukubekezela. Izingane zithola ukuthi ukufinyelela empumelelweni kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukwenza umsebenzi obalulekile ekufundeni. Ngokuhlanganyela esigabeni sokubhekana nezithiyo, umntwana ufunda ukuthuthuka, ahlule ubunzima, futhi aqhubeke yini akwenziwa. Lokhu kubalulekile phakathi kwezizukulwane, ngoba kwenza kube lula ukuza nezixazululo ezintsha. Umthelela Wokugqugquzela Nokuqwashisa Ngempilo Ezinhle Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, ukudlala kwemidlalo yesikole kufanele kudlale indima enkulu ekuqwashiseni ngempilo. Izinhlelo zokudla eziphilile, ukwelulekwa kahle, kanye nezindlela zokugcina umzimba unempilo zibalulekile. Uqhakambisa umqondo wokuhlala unempilo, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokuqonda indlela yokuphila kahle ngoba imidlalo ibalulekile ukuze izingane zifeze lokho.
Umthelela Wokugqugquzela Nokuqwashisa Ngempilo Ezinhle Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, ukudlala kwemidlalo yesikole kufanele kudlale indima enkulu ekuqwashiseni ngempilo. Izinhlelo zokudla eziphilile, ukwelulekwa kahle, kanye nezindlela zokugcina umzimba unempilo zibalulekile. Uqhakambisa umqondo wokuhlala unempilo, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokuqonda indlela yokuphila kahle ngoba imidlalo ibalulekile ukuze izingane zifeze lokho. Izikhumbuzo Ezingangeza Ekuphileni Kwemfundo Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ibhodi yezenzo kumele ibuha izindlela zokukhuthaza ukugqugquzela nokuqwashisa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ezinkezi zokuqwashisa ngemiphumela emihle yokudansa phakathi kwemidlalo yesikole. Lokhu kuyindlela yokukhumbuza abantwana ukuthi ukuphila kungenziwa kube okuthokozisayo nempela. Iminhla yokwazi, imicimbi yokugqugquzela amandla okuncintisana, nemikhosi yamasiko kufanele kube yingxenye yenzuzo yephakheji yepolitiki. Umbono Wokugcina Imidlalo yesikole ihloba kakhulu neziqu ezinkulu zemfundo. Izikole, abafundisi, nabazali banelungelo lokusebenzisa lesi sikhali ukuze baqinise umqondo wokubambisana, ukusebenza, nokukhuliswa kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobuciko, nokuzikhandla. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yesikole ayisiyona nje eyomzimba, kepha iyinsiza ebaluleke kakhulu yokwakha umphakathi nosonkanyezi abavulelekile. Emavi emidlalo yesikole, kufanele siqhubeke nokuqhubekisela phambili umoya wokuthola amandla obukhali, ubumbano, nokuqonda impilo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekugcinweni kwempilo nomphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yesikole ayisiyona nje eyomzimba, kepha iyinsiza ebaluleke kakhulu yokwakha umphakathi nosonkanyezi abavulelekile. Emavi emidlalo yesikole, kufanele siqhubeke nokuqhubekisela phambili umoya wokuthola amandla obukhali, ubumbano, nokuqonda impilo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekugcinweni kwempilo nomphakathi ophumelelayo. Kukhona umyalezo ophumelelayo okukhuthaza izingane ukufunda, ukujabulisa, nokuqonda ukuthi imidlalo akukhona nje ukuhlangana, kodwa kuyingxenye ebalulekile yezehlakalo zokuphila.
Izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni (GEMS salary deduction procedures) Ngokwanda kwezidingo zokunakekela impilo, izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezikhethwe ngempela zibe yinsiza ebalulekile kubasebenzi abaningi. Kulokhu, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibonakala njengesisombululo esiqinile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Nokho, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezilula nezicacile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inqubo yokudonswa kwemali emholweni ingaba yinkimbinkimbi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni kubasebenzi. Ngokwesibonelo, abanye abasebenzi bangase bakhathazeke mayelana nezindleko ezihambisana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokwelashwa, futhi lokhu kungabavimbela ekuthatheni izinqumo eziphusile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ihlinzeke ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezindleko ezihambisana nezinhlelo zayo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungasiza abasebenzi ukuba benze izinqumo ezinhle mayelana nokuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo kangcono. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana phakathi kweGEMS nabasebenzi kumele kube kuhle kakhulu. Izikhathi eziningi, abanye abasebenzi bangenza izinqumo ezingalungile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olunembile. Izinqubo zokubhalisela izinhlelo zempilo kufanele zibe lula, futhi abaphathi bamasheya beGEMS kumele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bayazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze babhalisele izinhlelo zempilo. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezifana nezinsuku zokwazisa, kungaba usizo olukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi baqonda kahle izinqubo.
Izikhathi eziningi, abanye abasebenzi bangenza izinqumo ezingalungile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olunembile. Izinqubo zokubhalisela izinhlelo zempilo kufanele zibe lula, futhi abaphathi bamasheya beGEMS kumele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bayazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze babhalisele izinhlelo zempilo. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezifana nezinsuku zokwazisa, kungaba usizo olukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi baqonda kahle izinqubo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, akufanele kube khona ukuphazamiseka ekudonsweni kwemali emholweni. I-GEMS kumele iqinisekise ukuthi le nqubo iyashesha futhi iyasebenza. Ukudonswa kwemali kumele kwenziwe ngokuqondile, ngaphandle kokubangela izinkinga ezinjengokwehluleka kokudlulisela imali ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kwababhalisile ukuthi bahlale beqaphe izindleko zempilo zabo. Kodwa-ke, kunobungozi bokuthi uma izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali zingasebenzi kahle, kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingalungile. Lokhu kungabavimbela abasebenzi ekutholeni ukunakekelwa okufanele, okubanga ukukhathazeka ngemiphumela empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinqubo, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zedijithali ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zokudonswa kwemali. Ukuba nezinqubo ezilungile zokudonswa kwemali akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isithunzi esihle seGEMS. Uma abasebenzi benelisekile ngemisebenzi yeGEMS, bazoba nesifiso sokuyisebenzisa futhi bazokhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlale bephakathi kwalezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela nokwethembana phakathi kweGEMS nabasebenzi.
Ukuba nezinqubo ezilungile zokudonswa kwemali akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isithunzi esihle seGEMS. Uma abasebenzi benelisekile ngemisebenzi yeGEMS, bazoba nesifiso sokuyisebenzisa futhi bazokhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlale bephakathi kwalezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela nokwethembana phakathi kweGEMS nabasebenzi. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni kufanele zibe lula, zicacile, futhi zenziwe ngendlela evumela abasebenzi ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinhlelo zempilo. I-GEMS kufanele iqhubeke nokuthuthukisa lezi zinqubo, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana nabasebenzi, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane iyatholakala kalula. Ngaleyo ndlela, izisebenzi zizokwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko ezikhuphukayo, futhi zizokwazi ukugxila empilweni yazo kanye nokukhula kwabo. Ngokuhlanganisa konke lokhu, iGEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni zisebenza kahle, zithuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bathola umphumela omuhle emisebenzini yabo. Lokhu kuzokwandisa inhlalakahle yomphakathi, futhi kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bamaHulumeni bazogcina bephumelela emisebenzini yabo.
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Ezweni lanamuhla, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngemininingwane, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, ukufakwa kwezikhungo ezinjalo akukhona okungokwemvelo kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukucabangela izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nakho. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezithinta izifo, izindlela zokwelapha, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Uma abantu benolwazi olufanele, bangakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Lokhu kunciphisa izinga lokugula, futhi kunceda ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezinjalo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, ngokubafundisa ngezindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingase zingabi zanele. Ezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale benolwazi olungaphelele, okungaholela ezinqumweni ezingalungile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezinkinga zokwethembeka kolwazi olutholakala ezikhungweni. Kunezikhungo eziningi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi, kodwa akuhlali kucacile ukuthi lezi zikhungo ziwela kuphi.
Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale benolwazi olungaphelele, okungaholela ezinqumweni ezingalungile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezinkinga zokwethembeka kolwazi olutholakala ezikhungweni. Kunezikhungo eziningi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi, kodwa akuhlali kucacile ukuthi lezi zikhungo ziwela kuphi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphatheke kabi, uma bephendukela kulwazi olungalungile. Ukuze izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibe usizo, kubalulekile ukuthi zibe nezinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwayo luyavuma nezifundo zakamuva. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kudinga izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kubandakanya abaphathi abaqeqeshiwe, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Uma izikhungo zinganikezi izinsiza ezanele, kuzoba nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale benolwazi olungaphelele, okungaholela ezinqumweni ezingalungile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Kodwa-ke, uma izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifakwa ngendlela efanele, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nomphakathi. Uma abantu bexhumana nezikhungo, bangakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi baphendule izidingo zabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi kunciphise izinga lokugula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zingaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo, imihlangano, kanye nemicimbi yokwazisa.
Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi kunciphise izinga lokugula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zingaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo, imihlangano, kanye nemicimbi yokwazisa. Uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwabelana ngolwazi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi kunciphise izinga lokugula. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kudinga ukucabangela izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nakho. Izikhungo ezinjalo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nezempilo, kodwa zidinga izinsiza ezanele ukuze zisebenze kahle. Uma izikhungo zifakwa ngendlela efanele, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zisebenza kahle, futhi zifinyelela kubantu bonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila impilo enempilo.
Imfashini Nobuhle: Ukuhlola Izitayela Nezindlela Zokwakha Isithombe Emhlabeni wethu, imfashini nobuhle zihlala zibalulekile, zidalela abantu ithuba lokwakha isithombe esihle, ukukhombisa ubuhle baphakathi kwethu, nokuvula indlela yokubonisa ubunikazi bethu. Namuhla, sizobheka izitayela ezisematheni, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuhle bethu, sikhangela lesi sikhathi esiguqukayo. Izitayela Zamanje: Umthelela Wezokuxhumana Izitayela zemfashini zihlala zishintsha, lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi ezifana nezinkanyezi, izinkulumo zomphakathi, nezinkampani ezinkulu ezithuthukisa imikhiqizo yazo. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhula, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba balandele izitayela ezithile. Uhlobo lwemfashini olukhona luhlanganisa izitayela ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-urban, i-bohemian, kanye ne-classic chic. Izinkampani ezifana neZara, H&M, kanye ne-Nike zisebenzisa izinkanyezi ezidumile ukuze zikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphile kahle nezinye izitayela. Izinkundla zokuxhumana, njenge-Instagram, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngezithombe, okwandisa ukufinyelela ezitayeleni ezahlukene. Ubuhle Obungokwemvelo: Izithako Zokwakha Isithombe Ngaphandle kwemfashini, ubuhle bukhombisa indlela esizithanda ngayo, futhi kudinga izithako ezikhethekile. Ukuze sibe nobuhle, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo efanele isikhumba sethu. Ukufuduka Kwabantu Emakhaya Baya Emadolobheni Isingeniso Ukufuduka kwabantu emakhaya kuya emadolobheni kuyinqubo ehamba phambili emhlabeni jikelele. Lolu shintsho luhilela izizathu eziningi, ezihlanganisa amathuba emisebenzi, izinsiza, kanye nezimo zokuphila. Kulolu bhubhane lwezinguquko, kubalulekile ukuqonda izigaba ezahlukene zalesi sikhathi, ukuze siqonde kahle imiphumela yalesi senzo. Isigaba 1: Izizathu Zokufuduka Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu eziholela abantu ukuba bashiye amakhaya abo. Izizathu ezivame kakhulu zifaka: 1. Amathuba Emisebenzi: Emadolobheni, abantu bathola amathuba amaningi emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezobuchwepheshe, ezokwakha, nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kubenza bakhuthazwe ukuba bashiye amakhaya abo. Izinsiza Nezikhungo: Emadolobheni, izinsiza ezifana nezikole, izibhedlela, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa zikhona kalula. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola imfundo nezinye izinsiza ezidingekayo. Izimo Zokuphila: Abantu baphinde bafuduke ngenxa yezimo ezinzima emakhaya, njengezimo zezulu, ukuntuleka kokudla, noma izinkinga zomnotho. Lokhu kubenza badinge ukuphila impilo engcono emadolobheni. Isigaba 2: Ukulungiselela Ukufuduka Ngaphambi kokufuduka, kubalulekile ukwenza izinhlelo eziqinile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukucwaninga Ngendawo: Qala ngokucwaninga ngendawo ofuna ukuya kuyo. Bheka izindleko zokuphila, amathuba emisebenzi, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko ezizokwakha impilo yakho. Ukwenza Ibhajethi: Dala ibhajethi yokuhamba, ehlanganisa izindleko zokuhamba, izindleko zokuhlala, nezindleko zokuphila zansuku zonke.
Bheka izindleko zokuphila, amathuba emisebenzi, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko ezizokwakha impilo yakho. Ukwenza Ibhajethi: Dala ibhajethi yokuhamba, ehlanganisa izindleko zokuhamba, izindleko zokuhlala, nezindleko zokuphila zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi ungakwazi ukuphila kahle lapho ufinyelela emadolobheni. Ukuxhumana Nezihlobo: Xhumana nezihlobo noma abangane abahlala emadolobheni ukuze uthole izeluleko. Bangakunika imininingwane ewusizo mayelana nezindawo ezinhle zokuhlala, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Isigaba 3: Ukufuduka Uma usulungile, sekuyisikhathi sokufuduka. Nazi izinyathelo okufanele uzithathe: 1. Ukulungisa Izinto: Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlele kahle izinto zakho. Hlanganisa izinto ezibalulekile kuphela, ukuze ungabi nomthwalo omkhulu. Ungasebenzisa izikhwama ezinkulu noma amabhokisi ukuze uhlele kahle. Ukuthola Izinsiza Zokuhamba: Thola izinsiza ezikufanele zokuhamba, njengemoto, ibhasi, noma izindiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthola izinsiza eziphephile nezisheshayo. Ukuhamba: Lapho usuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela izinhlelo zakho. Hamba ngokuqapha, futhi ungakhohlwa ukugcina izincwadi ezisemqoka, ezifana nezitifiketi zokuzalwa, amakhadi ebhange, kanye nezincwadi zokuhamba. Isigaba 4: Ukuqala Impilo Entsha Ngemva kokufika emadolobheni, kubalulekile ukuqala impilo yakho entsha ngendlela efanele: 1. Ukufuna Ikhaya: Qala ngokufuna indawo yokuhlala. Bheka izindawo ezihlukahlukene, njengezindlu ezizimele, amaflats, noma izindawo zokuhlala ezabelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo oyikhethayo ihambisana nebhajethi yakho. Ukufuna Umsebenzi: Sebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole umsebenzi.
Bheka izindawo ezihlukahlukene, njengezindlu ezizimele, amaflats, noma izindawo zokuhlala ezabelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo oyikhethayo ihambisana nebhajethi yakho. Ukufuna Umsebenzi: Sebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole umsebenzi. Ungasebenzisa ama-inthanethi, izikhangiso, noma uxhumane nezinkampani ezikufanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uvuselela i-CV yakho futhi uzilungiselele izingxoxo zomsebenzi. Ukuxhumana Nomphakathi: Xhumana nabantu bendawo ukuze uthole ukuxhaswa. Ungakwazi ukujoyina izinhlelo zomphakathi, izikhungo zokuxhumana, noma izifundo ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uyazizwa uhlelekile endaweni entsha. Isiphetho Ukufuduka kwabantu emakhaya kuya emadolobheni kuyinqubo enezinselelo, kodwa futhi inezinzuzo eziningi. Ngokuqonda izizathu, ukulungiselela kahle, nokwenza izinyathelo ezifanele, abantu bangakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impilo yabo entsha izoba ngempumelelo. Ukuhlonipha izinkolelo zomdabu, ukugcina izixhumanisi zomndeni, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, konke lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni impilo engcono emadolobheni. Ukufuduka akuwona umqondo wokushiya emakhaya kuphela, kodwa kuwumqondo wokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukusebenza Kwama-Ambulensi: Indaba Yomlando Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezimeni eziphuthumayo ube sewandeni, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwama-ambulensi. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi, kubalulekile ukubheka imvelaphi yawo, izinguquko ezenzekile, kanye nomthelela wawo emphakathini. Ekuqaleni, ngaphambi kokuba ama-ambulensi abe yinsiza ejwayelekile, abantu babebhekana nezimo ezinzima lapho kudingeka ukusiza abagulayo noma abalimala. Izithuthi ezinjengezinqola, izinyathi, noma izikebhe zazisetshenziswa ukuze zidlulisele abantu abadinga usizo. Lokhu kwakuyinselele enkulu, njengoba izithuthi zazingenakuhamba kalula ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi abahlinzeki ngosizo babephakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, kwavela umqondo wama-ambulensi njengemoto ethile eyenzelwe ukusiza abantu abagulayo. I-ambulensi yokuqala eyaziwayo yadalwa eNgilandi ngo-1832, futhi yayiyimoto eyayihamba kancane, kodwa yayinezinhlaka ezikhethekile zokuthutha abagulayo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula indlela yokwakha izinhlelo ezihamba phambili zokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo. Ngemva kwempi, ama-ambulensi aqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Kukhona nezinhlaka zokufunda ezibiza u-R10 kuphela ngonyaka. Ukuhlukaniswa kwalezi zinto kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokukhula, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sithatha izigaba ezahlukene ze-GEMS, singabala amalungu anemisebenzi ehlukene, kusukela kulabo abasebenza ezingeni eliphansi kuya kulabo abaphethe izikhundla eziphezulu. Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa akuhlosile ukuveza umehluko phakathi kwamalungu, kodwa kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma amalungu ezwa ukuthi ahlukaniswe, kungaholela ekudumazekeni nasekuphazamisekeni kokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kuhlonipha ubunikazi bawo. Ukwengeza, kufanele kube nezindlela zokuxazulula izingxabano, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe ephephile futhi ehloniphekile. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwamalungu, ukuze bonke bazi ukuthi bangaxhumana kanjani uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS major member classification) kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi uyaziswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Uma sikwazi ukwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukudala umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho wonke amalungu ezwa ukuthi ayingxenye ebalulekile yempumelelo, futhi lokho kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obuqinisa izimpilo zethu sonke.
Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwamavoti nentando yeningi Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubaluleke kakhulu emphakathini wanamuhla. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nemigomo yokuphatha izwe, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho ubudlelwano phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nabantu bubalulekile ekwakheni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. I-ntando yeningi ifakazela ukuthi abantu banelungelo lokukhetha, lokho okwenza ukuthi kube khona izinqumo ezithinta izwe ezingezona ezomuntu oyedwa, kodwa ezibandakanya wonke umuntu. Ukwazi Ngentando Yeningi Intando yeningi ingachazwa njengendlela yokuphatha lapho izinqumo zenzelwa abantu, ngenhloso yokuhlonipha izidingo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bonke abantu, abavoti, banelungelo lokubamba iqhaza ekukhetheni abaholi babo, bephendula izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kuhilela ukhetho, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazibandakanye, baqonde ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abantu ukuthi baqonde ukuthi ubuholi buyingxenye yezenzo zabo eziphilayo, futhi ukudlulisa imiyalezo ebavotayo kulukhuni. Indima Yokuvota Ukuvota kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokubamba iqhaza. Lapho umuntu evota, ubeka phambili imbono yakhe, ukhetha uhulumeni noma abaholi abacabanga ukuthi bazomemezela izinqumo ezinobuhlakani. Ukuvota akuyona nje indlela yokuphendula, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokukhombisa izifiso zomphakathi. Ngokubamba iqhaza kokuvota, abantu bakha umbono omkhulu, begcina ubumbano phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Izingozi Zokunganaki Uma abantu bengavoti, bazibeka engozini. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi abangafanele baphumelele, okungaholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zingagcini kahle.
Ngokubamba iqhaza kokuvota, abantu bakha umbono omkhulu, begcina ubumbano phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Izingozi Zokunganaki Uma abantu bengavoti, bazibeka engozini. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi abangafanele baphumelele, okungaholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zingagcini kahle. Ukunganaki kokuvota kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba abaholi abangahambisani nezidingo zabantu bangathatha izinqumo ezingavumelani nezifiso zamasiko, ezomnotho, nezokuphila. Ukwenqatshwa Kwezinqumo Ukwenqatshwa kwezinto ezithinta imiphakathi kuncike ekubeni abantu baphatheka kahle empilweni yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni izinqumo ezizokwandisa ukuphila kwabantu. Ukuvota kuhilela ukwaziwa komphakathi, nokuhlola izinqumo ezithinta izidingo zabo. Uma abantu benza izinqumo ezithile, banqanda ukwenqatshwa kwezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kubavumela ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa labo. Izifundo Zokubamba Iqhaza Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nakho kunemfundo ebalulekile. Amaphoyisa, izikhungo zemfundo, nezokuxhumana zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi ukubamba iqhaza kwabo kubalulekile. Umphakathi kufanele uthole izifundo ezivumela abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izinqubo zokuvota, izinqumo ezithathwayo, kanye nendlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baziqhenye ngempela ngezinsiza zokuvota, okubasiza ukuba bakhulume ngezinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo. Isiphetho Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kudinga ukuqhubeka nokwenziwa. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke uqwashisa abantu ng importance yokuziqhenya, nendlela yokuvota ngendlela efanele. Ngokuziqhenya, abantu bangakha umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo.
Isiphetho Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kudinga ukuqhubeka nokwenziwa. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke uqwashisa abantu ng importance yokuziqhenya, nendlela yokuvota ngendlela efanele. Ngokuziqhenya, abantu bangakha umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kuwumgogodla wokwakha isizwe esiqinile, esimeme, esikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi intando yeningi ibonakala empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baphatheke, bavote, futhi baqhubeke bephakamisa izwi labo, ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Izidingo zamaphepha omholo zamalungu aqashiwe (GEMS employed member salary slip requirements) Ukuze amalungu aqashiwe e-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) akwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi abenamaphepha omholo afanele. Lezi zidingo zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, futhi akwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo zempilo zabo ngendlela efanele. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaphepha omholo ahlangabezana nezidingo ezisemthethweni. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda amaphepha omholo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amaphepha omholo ayisithombe esicacile sokwaziswa kwemali eyamukelwe emsebenzini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imininingwane efana nemali eyamukelwe, izaphulelo, nezindleko ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amaphepha omholo akhe ahlanzekile, acacile, futhi anembile ukuze akwazi ukuwasebenzisa kalula. Isigaba 2: Izidingo eziyisisekelo zamaphepha omholo Lapho uthola amaphepha omholo, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ahlangabezana nezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, amaphepha omholo kufanele abe nezinombolo ezisemthethweni, ezifana nenombolo yempesheni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi luhambisana nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube nenombolo ye-employee ID, ukuze kube lula ukuhlela nokuhlola izinsiza. Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amaphepha omholo ahambisana nezidingo ze-GEMS. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo ezitholakele zifanele izindleko ezibekwe yi-GEMS. Uma amaphepha omholo engahambisani nalokhu, amalungu kufanele axhumane ne-HR (Human Resources) ukuze athole usizo.
Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amaphepha omholo ahambisana nezidingo ze-GEMS. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo ezitholakele zifanele izindleko ezibekwe yi-GEMS. Uma amaphepha omholo engahambisani nalokhu, amalungu kufanele axhumane ne-HR (Human Resources) ukuze athole usizo. Isigaba 4: Ukubheka izaphulelo Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukubheka izaphulelo ezikhona kumaphepha omholo. Izaphulelo zingase zibe yizindleko zokwelashwa, izindleko zokuhamba, noma ezinye izindleko ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Amalungu kufanele aqonde kahle ukuthi lezi zaphulelo zisebenza kanjani, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izinsiza zabo ngendlela efanele. Isigaba 5: Ukugcina amarekhodi Ngemva kokuthola amaphepha omholo, amalungu kufanele agcine amarekhodi awo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzosiza uma kudingeka ukuthi baphinde baphinde bahlola izinsiza ezitholakele noma uma kudingeka ukwenza izichibiyelo. Ukugcina amarekhodi kahle kuzovikela amalungu ekulahlekelweni yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Isigaba 6: Ukuxhumana ne-GEMS Uma amalungu ebhekene nezinkinga noma udaba oluthile mayelana namaphepha omholo, kufanele axhumane ne-GEMS ngokuqondile. I-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokuxhumana ezihlukahlukene, ezinjengefoni, i-imeyili, noma ngokuqhafaza kwiwebhusayithi yabo. Lokhu kuzovumela amalungu ukuthi athole usizo oludingekayo ngokushesha. Isigaba 7: Ukuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo Ekugcineni, amalungu kufanele ahlale ebheke izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezivela ku-GEMS. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izaphulelo, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukisa impilo.
Lokhu kuzovumela amalungu ukuthi athole usizo oludingekayo ngokushesha. Isigaba 7: Ukuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo Ekugcineni, amalungu kufanele ahlale ebheke izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezivela ku-GEMS. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izaphulelo, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukisa impilo. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale unolwazi olusha nokuthi ufunde ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, amalungu aqashiwe e-GEMS angakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphepha omholo abo ahlangabezana nezidingo ezisemthethweni, futhi akwazi ukuhlela impilo yabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bazuze ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo.
Febhuwari iyinyanga ebalulekile ePhalamende nasemphakathini wonke eNingizimu Afrika. Yisikhathi sokucabangela okwakudlulelwe, ukubheka phambili, nokubhekana nezidingo eziphuthumayo zezwe lethu. Ukukhuluma kweMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe kwenzeka njalo ngoFebhuwari, lapho uMongameli ethula khona inkulumo kubantu njengomholi wezwe. Yini inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe? Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyinkulumo ethulwayo nguMongameli weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kubantu ngesikhathi sokuvulwa kwePhalamende minyaka yonke. Le nkulumo ithulwe kwiHholo Elihlangene lePhalamende - okuyiNdlu Yezwe (eyaziwa kakhulu njenge-NA) kanye neNdlu Yezifunda (efushane njenge-NCOP). Igxile ezithuthukisweni zezombusazwe nezomnotho. Le mhlangano ibizwa nguMongameli futhi iphostelwa nguMsizi weNdlu Yezwe kanye noSihlalo we-NCOP. Lezi yizikhathi ezithile lapho zonke izigaba ezintathu zohulumeni zihlangana endaweni eyodwa ngasikhathi sinye: lapha sithola i-Executive, emelelwa nguMongameli, uMongameli Osenyukwini, kanye noNgqongqoshe; iJaji, emelelwa nguMphakathi Oholayo kanye noJaji; kanye neLegislature, emelelwa ngamalungu ePhalamende (afushane njenge-MPs). Amalungu omphakathi nawo amelelwa enkulumweni yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ukuze abambe iqhaza kulomcimbi obalulekile odlala indima ekwakheni isizwe. Kungani inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ibalulekile? Kule nkulumo, uMongameli ugcizelela impumelelo nezinkinga ezibhekene ne-nyanga edlule futhi uchaza indlela ezolandela ngonyaka lowo.
Amalungu omphakathi nawo amelelwa enkulumweni yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ukuze abambe iqhaza kulomcimbi obalulekile odlala indima ekwakheni isizwe. Kungani inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ibalulekile? Kule nkulumo, uMongameli ugcizelela impumelelo nezinkinga ezibhekene ne-nyanga edlule futhi uchaza indlela ezolandela ngonyaka lowo. Le nkulumo ibandakanya izindaba zezombusazwe, ezomnotho, nezokuxhumana, futhi ibonisa isimo jikelele sezwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Ikhuluma ngezindaba zangaphakathi zezwe kanye nezokuxhumana nezizwe zase-Afrika nakwamanye amazwe. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iphinde isetshenziswe ukuze kugujwe isizwe sethu futhi sakhiwe kabusha. Nini le nkulumo ithulwa? NgoFebhuwari 2010, ukuphuma emkhubeni ojwayelekile, inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe yathulwa ntambama okokuqala, ivumela inani elikhulu labantu baseNingizimu Afrika ithuba lokubona izenzakalo nokulalela inkulumo kaMongameli.

Le shintsho yaholela ekwandeni kokubukwa kukamabonakude kusuka kumamiliyoni amabili kuya phansi kwemamiliyoni emine. Ukubandakanyeka komphakathi kuyisici salomcimbi. Amalungu omphakathi ayamenywa ukuba abambe iqhaza njengabavakashi bePhalamende kulomcimbi. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bavelaphiwe baphumelele kwiCivil Guard of Honour kanye neJunior Guard of Honour. I-Civil Guard of Honour, emukela uMongameli ePhalamende, yakhiwe ngabantu abajwayelekile baseNingizimu Afrika. I-Junior Guard of Honour ihlanganisa izingane ezivela ezikoleni ezikhethiwe ezweni lonke futhi imele intsha, ebhekwa njengethemba nekusasa lesizwe. Kuyajwayeleka ukuthi abantu abavelele baseNingizimu Afrika bamenywe ukuba babe yingxenye yezenzakalo. Bakhishwa ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene futhi bangaba ngabantu abenze umthelela obonakalayo ezweni. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyingxenye yenqubo yokubheka nokubophela. IPhalamende ingahlola ukusebenza kukahulumeni ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uqhubeka nokuphendula kubantu.
Bakhishwa ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene futhi bangaba ngabantu abenze umthelela obonakalayo ezweni. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyingxenye yenqubo yokubheka nokubophela. IPhalamende ingahlola ukusebenza kukahulumeni ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uqhubeka nokuphendula kubantu. UMthethosisekelo unikeze iPhalamende umsebenzi wokuhlola ukuze ibheke futhi ilandele izenzo zikahulumeni. Lokhu kukhuphule izinga lokwethemba kuhulumeni phakathi kwabantu. Ingabe iminyango kahulumeni iphethwe kahle? Umsebenzi wokubheka uholela ekuphathweni kahle kweminyango kahulumeni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile futhi kuqinisekiswe izinga lempilo elingcono kubo bonke abantu. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe, uMongameli uphinde ahlole isimo sezwe futhi abeke imigomo yezenzo kanye nalokho kuzokwenziwa ngonyaka lowo. Lokhu kusekelwe kulezi zinto ezihlosiwe kanye nalokho okukhulunywa ngesikhathi uNgqongqoshe WezeMali ethula inkulumo yeBhajethi yonyaka, evamise ukwenzeka ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari. Imigomo yezenzo kanye nezinyathelo ezihlelwe ziba yisisekelo salokho okufanele kuhulumeni kukwenze ngonyaka lowo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula kubantu mayelana nalokho akwenzile nokuthi yini eyenziwe emphakathini, kanye nokuthi izimali ezichithwe zisetshenziswe kanjani. Kwenzekani ngemuva kokuthi inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ithuliwe? Ngemuva kokuthi inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ithuliwe, kokubili izindlu zePhalamende kuvamise ukuba nengxoxo.
Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula kubantu mayelana nalokho akwenzile nokuthi yini eyenziwe emphakathini, kanye nokuthi izimali ezichithwe zisetshenziswe kanjani. Ngemuva kokuthi inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ithuliwe, kokubili izindlu zePhalamende kuvamise ukuba nengxoxo. Amaphathi ezombusazwe athola ithuba lokukhuluma imibono yabo nokubuza imibuzo ngezindaba eziphakanyisiwe kule nkulumo. Izinkinga zikhuluma, futhi izindaba ezibalulekile zizwe zikhonjiswa. Umphakathi uyamenywa ukuba ube khona futhi ulalele le ngxoxo njengoba kwenzeka kuyo yonke imihlangano yePhalamende. UMongameli uphinde aphendule ezindabeni eziphakanyisiwe nemibuzo ebuzwayo phakathi kwale ngxoxo. Yini isiqubulo sePhalamende salonyaka? Isiqubulo sePhalamende sika-2011 sithi "Siyagubha umnikelo wenkululeko ngokwakha ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwePhalamende nabantu." Ngonyaka wonke, iPhalamende iyamukela isiqubulo esiba yisikhumbuzo semigomo yayo ngaleso sikhathi. Uhulumeni weqiniso weDemokhrasi uthola amandla awo kubantu ngokubamba ukhetho ngezikhathi ezithile futhi ngempela umphakathi uqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza ezinqubweni zokuphatha. Isiqubulo sikhuthaza ubukhona benkululeko yokubamba iqhaza, obonakalayo, kanye nokubophela, lapho abantu bezwa izindaba zomthetho nezokubheka. Kuphikisana indima yePhalamende ekumelelayo abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni wabantu ophatha ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo.
Uhulumeni weqiniso weDemokhrasi uthola amandla awo kubantu ngokubamba ukhetho ngezikhathi ezithile futhi ngempela umphakathi uqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza ezinqubweni zokuphatha. Isiqubulo sikhuthaza ubukhona benkululeko yokubamba iqhaza, obonakalayo, kanye nokubophela, lapho abantu bezwa izindaba zomthetho nezokubheka. Kuphikisana indima yePhalamende ekumelelayo abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni wabantu ophatha ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Umsebenzi wePhalamende kanye namalungu akhe kufanele ugxile ekwenzeni ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nabamele babo abakhethiweyo. Impumelelo yePhalamende itholakala ekubambeni okubonakalayo kwabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubatshela abamele babo abakhethiweyo, abangaba ngamalungu ePhalamende (ama-MPs), kanye naleli zikhungo indlela yokusebenza okudingeka yenziwe. Ungawubamba kanjani umphakathi ePh
Lapha e-Afrika, ukuqhubeka komsebenzi ophathelene ne-bio-fuel emhlabeni jikelele kusinikeza amathuba amahle okwandisa imizamo yethu yokuthuthukisa izimo zezezimali ezweni lethu. Esikhathini esizayo, labo abasebenza kulesi sikhala bazokwazi ukuhlangabezana nalezi zikhala zomsebenzi futhi bathole amandla okuphakamisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu ezikhathini ezizayo. Uma amazwe asempumalanga emhlabeni elungiselela ukusebenzisa ama-bio-fuels, kufanele abheke ukuthuthukisa lo msebenzi ezwenikazi eliseningizimu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubonakala ukuthi isidingo sembewu yokudla kanye nalabo abanamafutha sizokwandisa kabili eminyakeni engama-20 - 30 ezayo. Ngenxa yesidingo sokukhiqiza ukudla kwabantu kanye nezinsiza zokuhamba (ukudla), i-Yoruba kufanele ibheke izinsiza zemvelo ezitholakala emazweni aseningizimu kweSahara e-Afrika. Njengoba kunezinsiza zemvelo eziningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kungahlinzeka ngezindlela zokukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela eshibhile. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba kunezimo zezulu ezinhle kanye nezimo zomhlabathi ezindaweni ezifana ne-Angola, i-Mozambique, kanye ne-Zambia. Nokho, amazwe aseningizimu kweSahara kufanele ahloniphe izimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile uma efuna ukutshalwa kwezimali, ngokwesibonelo, ahloniphe amalungelo okuba nefa emhlabeni nasezimpahleni. Kumele sibe namandla okuthengisa izinsiza zethu ngenani eliphezulu emnothweni kazwelonke ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa umsebenzi wezomnotho ngendlela ephakeme. Ngale ndlela kuphela sizokwazi ukudala ukusebenza okudingekayo emnothweni wezindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara. I-South Africa ihola ezimweni zezimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile uma sibheka ezinye izindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara e-Afrika.
Kumele sibe namandla okuthengisa izinsiza zethu ngenani eliphezulu emnothweni kazwelonke ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa umsebenzi wezomnotho ngendlela ephakeme. Ngale ndlela kuphela sizokwazi ukudala ukusebenza okudingekayo emnothweni wezindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara. I-South Africa ihola ezimweni zezimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile uma sibheka ezinye izindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara e-Afrika. I-South Africa iyadingeka ezindaweni eziseningizimu kweSahara e-Afrika ukuze ibonise umhlaba ukuthi singasekela ukugeleza kwezimali endaweni ephephile ezoletha ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa emnothweni. Uma i-South Africa ingakwazi ukubonisa amazwe asempumalanga ukuthi inekhono nezinsiza zokusebenzisa ingcebo kazwelonke ngendlela efanele, sizophumelela ukusiza ezinye izindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara ukuthola umnotho ozovela ekuthuthukiseni imisebenzi ephathelene ne-bio-fuel ngendlela enhle. Ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi ophathelene ne-bio-fuel emhlabeni jikelele kudala amathuba amahle okuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezomnotho. Abantu abafuna ukusebenza bangangena kulezi zikhala zomsebenzi futhi bakhuphule izinga labo lokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, bazokwazi ukuhweba ukuze bathole ukudla, bakhulise ukudla kwabo, futhi bathole inzuzo engathenga izinto ezinhle. Akufanele siphuthelwe leli thuba lokuthuthukiswa. I-South Africa inomthwalo wemfanelo wokusekela ukuthuthukiswa komnotho kwezinye izindawo lapha e-Afrika. Ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi we-bio-fuel lapha kuzosisiza ukukhiqiza ukudla okudingekayo. Abakhiqizi base-South Africa banolwazi nolwazi lokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi, kodwa akukho maphakathi lapho umkhiqizo ungathengiswa khona. Uma umsebenzi we-bio-fuel uqhubeka, imakethe enhle ingatholakala.
Ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi we-bio-fuel lapha kuzosisiza ukukhiqiza ukudla okudingekayo. Abakhiqizi base-South Africa banolwazi nolwazi lokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi, kodwa akukho maphakathi lapho umkhiqizo ungathengiswa khona. Uma umsebenzi we-bio-fuel uqhubeka, imakethe enhle ingatholakala. Ngokufanayo, ulwazi oluningi luzokwakhiwa esingaludlulisela kwezinye izindawo e-Afrika. Izindleko zokwakha lo msebenzi emhlabeni jikelele ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, ngakho kufanele kwakhiwe izinsiza ezinhle ukuze kusekelwe ukuqhubeka kwalomsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umngcele udinga ukubheka ikusasa eliqhakazile ukuze uthole izikhuthazo ezifanele. Lokhu okukhuthazayo ukuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-USA kube inani elikhulu lokukhiqiza kanye nokushintshwa kwe-MTBE nge-bio-ethanol. Lokhu okukhuthazayo umsebenzi ophathelene ne-bio-fuel lapha e-South Africa ukuvumelanisa nokugcina izinsiza zemvelo noma ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu basemaphandleni. Uma sibheka ukukhuphuka kwezintengo zokudla, sihlangana nesimo esishintshashintshayo emhlabeni jikelele, futhi lokhu akukhuphuki kakhulu emandleni ezimali. Lokhu kuyakhathaza ngoba sidinga imvume yoHulumeni ukuze siqhubeke phambili ngesikhathi esifanele ngokuvota nokunye. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngoba abaholi abakhombisi kahle indlela yokuhamba phambili mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Kodwa kubalulekile ukucabangela lezi zinto ezingaba yingozi mayelana nekusasa elide - ingabe singacabanga kuphela ngezingozi ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo esiseduze?
Lokhu kuyakhathaza ngoba sidinga imvume yoHulumeni ukuze siqhubeke phambili ngesikhathi esifanele ngokuvota nokunye. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngoba abaholi abakhombisi kahle indlela yokuhamba phambili mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Kodwa kubalulekile ukucabangela lezi zinto ezingaba yingozi mayelana nekusasa elide - ingabe singacabanga kuphela ngezingozi ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo esiseduze? I-Grain SA ibona ukuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel njengethuba likahulumeni lokwakha umoya wokubambisana ekudonseni izimali ezweni, futhi kufanele bavunyelwe ukuba bashiye izimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezinkinga ezifana nezitifiketi, imithetho, nezinye izithiyo ezivimbela izindlela zokusebenzisa umkhiqizo njengoba sifuna. Uma sibheka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokutshala, siqaphela ukuthi ushukela akuwona kuphela umkhiqizo wokudla ongasebenzisa ukukhiqiza i-bio-fuel, futhi akufanele sizame ukuqhathanisa izimo zomhlabathi nezimo zezulu nezinye izindawo eziseningizimu. Kunezimakethe eziningi ze-bio-fuel eduze kwezindawo ezikhiqiza ummbila nezinsimbi ezweni lethu, nasezindaweni lapho kukhona ukudla njenge-barley, i-triticale, noma i-wheat ezingasekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel. Ukuze sivalwe umgomo phakathi kokuhlinzekwa kokudla nokuthi yini ebiza kakhulu, kufanele sithole ukuqhubeka okuzoletha inzuzo enhle kubakhiqizi. Uma kuvunyelwe ukuba sithuthuke ngokukhululekile, sikholelwa ukuthi iminikelo ekukhiqizeni i-bio-fuel izovuselela ikhono lokukhulisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo.
Kunezimakethe eziningi ze-bio-fuel eduze kwezindawo ezikhiqiza ummbila nezinsimbi ezweni lethu, nasezindaweni lapho kukhona ukudla njenge-barley, i-triticale, noma i-wheat ezingasekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel. Ukuze sivalwe umgomo phakathi kokuhlinzekwa kokudla nokuthi yini ebiza kakhulu, kufanele sithole ukuqhubeka okuzoletha inzuzo enhle kubakhiqizi. Uma kuvunyelwe ukuba sithuthuke ngokukhululekile, sikholelwa ukuthi iminikelo ekukhiqizeni i-bio-fuel izovuselela ikhono lokukhulisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo. Lokhu kuzovimbela ukwehla kwenani lemikhiqizo yokudla kanye nezinsimbi zamafutha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzovuselela amathuba okuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezolimo ozosiza abantu bethu basemaphandleni. Umphakathi womhlaba kufanele ubone ukuthi i-South Africa ikwazi ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Lokhu akuzokweseka kuphela izimiso ze-ASGISA kodwa kuzosekela nezika-NEPAD ezizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Ukukhathala Kwamahlengikazi Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzini omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, kwavela umoya opholile, ubonisa ukuthi kube nesikhathi eside sokusebenza. Abahlengikazi bendawo, uNokuthula noSipho, babephakathi kokulungiselela usuku olujwayelekile emtholampilo. Njengoba bephuma emakhaya abo, babebona izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza ukuthi, nakuba bephila impilo enzima, umhlaba unikeza ithemba. UNokuthula, owayenobungane obukhulu, wayehlala ebakhumbuza abanye abahlengikazi ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ubalulekile. "Siyabamba izimpilo zabantu, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," wayephendula njalo. Kodwa, ngaphakathi, wayezwa ukukhathala okukhulu. Izinsuku zabe ziphila zifana, ziqhubeka zikhathaza, futhi imithwalo yokukhathazeka yayiqinile. USipho, owayenobuchule bokwelapha, wayehlale edinga izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo. "Sidinga ukuhamba phambili, Nokuthula. Abantu bethu badinga usizo, futhi akufanele sithule," wayekhuluma, kodwa wayezwa umoya wokukhathala emzimbeni wakhe. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, wayehluleka ukulala kahle, imicabango yakhe ibihamba ngezindlela eziningi. Ngelinye ilanga, kwafika umama oneminyaka engama-70, uMama Zodwa, owayenokukhathala okukhulu. Wayefika emtholampilo enezimpawu zokukhathala, kodwa wayehlale eqinile. "Ngiyazi ukuthi ningabahlengikazi, kodwa ngicela ningithumele emuva, ngidinga ukuxoxa," kusho yena. UNokuthula noSipho babemthanda, futhi bazi ukuthi uMama Zodwa wayengumuntu onothando, kodwa izinkinga zakhe zazinzima. Baqala ukuxoxa naye, bahlola izinkinga zakhe, futhi uMama Zodwa wabelana ngendaba yakhe.
"Ngiyazi ukuthi ningabahlengikazi, kodwa ngicela ningithumele emuva, ngidinga ukuxoxa," kusho yena. Ngiyazama ukusiza umndeni wami, kodwa ngiyazizwa ngiphukile," kusho yena. Lokhu kwavusa imizwa eminingi kubo, ngoba babebona ukuthi abahlengikazi nabo bahlupheka, nakuba bephila impilo yokusiza abanye. Ngemuva kokuxoxa, uMama Zodwa wathola umoya omusha. "Ngiyabonga, ngiyazi ukuthi niyakhathala. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngithole amandla," wathi. Lokhu kwavusa umoya omusha kubo bonke abahlengikazi. Bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, ukuxhumana nabantu abanjengoMama Zodwa kwaba yindlela yokubuyisela amandla. Ngesikhathi sokuhlola, uNokuthula noSipho baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imitholampilo. Babefuna ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bekwazi ukusiza omunye nomunye. "Sizokwenza izinhlelo zokuxhumana, sizokwakha imihlangano, sizokwenza ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bahlala behlangene," kusho uSipho. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umoya wokubambisana, futhi abahlengikazi baqala ukujabula. Ngesikhathi edlula emitholampilo, uNokuthula wathola ukuthi abantu bayeza, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, bephuma bezithokozisa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umsebenzi wabo wawubalulekile. "Siyabamba izimpilo, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," wayephinda njalo.
Ngesikhathi edlula emitholampilo, uNokuthula wathola ukuthi abantu bayeza, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, bephuma bezithokozisa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umsebenzi wabo wawubalulekile. "Siyabamba izimpilo, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," wayephinda njalo. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana, uNokuthula noSipho baqala ukubona izinguquko. Abantu bephila kahle, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawukhula. UMama Zodwa waba yisibonelo sokuthi, nakuba abantu behlupheka, ukuxhumana nokuxhasana kungabavusa. Abahlengikazi bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umphakathi wabo wawunamandla. Ekugcineni, uNokuthula noSipho baqonda ukuthi ukukhathala kwabo akukona okungapheli. "Siyabamba izimpilo, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," baphinda, kodwa manje bazi ukuthi, ngokubambisana, bangakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umoya wokubambisana wawunamandla, futhi umhlaba wawunethemba. Ngakho-ke, abahlengikazi baqhubeka nokusebenza, bephila impilo enothando, bejabulisa abanye, futhi bephila impilo enomoya opholile. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umphakathi wabo wawunamandla.
Uhlelo Lokuphakamisa Ababhekene Nezingozi lukhuthaza ukusungulwa nokuhleleka kwezimiso kanye nokubambisana phakathi kweminyango ehlukene kahulumeni noma izinhlelo zezigaba ezahlukene kanye nezinqubomgomo zokweseka, ukuvikela nokuphakamisa ababhekene nezingozi zokudlwengulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. I-VEP igxile kakhulu kwabantu besifazane nasezinganeni. Ababhekene nokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya ezimeni eziphuthumayo bangahlala endaweni yokuhlala isikhathi esiphakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili nezinyanga eziyisithupha, kuye ngemicimbi yabo. Lolu hlelo lutholakala kubabhekene nezingozi zokudlwengulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. Xhumana nanoma yisiphi isikhungo sokweseka ababhekene nezingozi mayelana nendawo yokuhlala yabesifazane nezingane ezihlukunyezwayo, ukuze uthole abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zikahulumeni noma izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni (NGOs) ezibhekene nokunakekela ababhekene nokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya. Umeluleki ohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo, ilungu leMnyango Wezokuphepha Kwamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika (SAPS), noma uphoyisa, umphakathi, uthisha, noma omunye umuntu ophathelene nezidingo zababikeli angasiza ekufakeni isicelo sokuvikela. Qinisekisa ukuthi uma umuntu ongumbhikishi efaka isicelo sokuvikela, kukhona incwadi yokuvuma ebhalwe ngumshushisi ehambisana nesicelo. Ayikho ifomu ethile edingekayo ukuze uthole le mvume - incwadi ebhalwe ngumshushisi evuma imvume iyanele. Umntwana noma umuntu onengqondo engasebenzi kahle uyakhululeka noma uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi lowo muntu akakwazi ukuvuma ngokwabo noma ukuhlinzeka ngovume.

Izixolelo, ukungabi khona, kanye noluhlu lwabo bonke abakhona kufanele kubhalwe phansi. Amagama kaMongameli noMphakathi abhalile imizuzu kufanele abhalwe. Imizuzu yomhlangano odlule kufanele ivunyelwe, kanye nanoma yiziphi izichibiyelo ezenziwe. Idokhumenti kufanele ifake konke okubalulekile okukhulunywe ngakho, kanye nezinqumo ezenziwe ngaleso sihloko. Yini okufanele yenziwe, ngubani, futhi nini. Usuku lomhlangano olandelayo. Uma ikhansela ingumuntu ohlelekile njengomongameli, ingakwazi ukuhlela ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi kwabanye amalungu ekomidi, ngaleyo ndlela iqinisekise ukuthi umhlangano uhamba kahle. Ubuye ubonise futhi uchaze indawo lapho ikomidi lizohlangana njalo. - Khumbula lokhu kufanele kube endaweni yomphakathi, hhayi emzini wangasese. Lokhu kusiza ngoba ikomidi lomphakathi lingahlela isikhathi saso salolo nyaka. Ingabe ulungiselele uhlelo lomhlangano ozayo? Ingabe ucabangele usuku lomhlangano wokuhlela unyaka (Bheka Isahluko 10)? Lezi zindawo zisiza ikhansela kanye nekhabhinethi ukuqonda nokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi. Khetha abantu bezikhundla - kufanele ube noMphakathi ukuze ubone ukuthi mhlawumbe udinga ibhajethi. Emhlanganweni wokuqala, amalungu ekomidi kufanele ahlanganyele lokho abafuna ukukufeza njengamalungu ekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Cela uMphakathi ukuthi akhe uhlu lokuthi amalungu angatholakala kanjani bese wonke amalungu ekomidi athola ikhophi. Lokhu kungaba umhlangano ophuthumayo noma kumkhankaso olandelayo. Izikhundla ezifana nezokwakha, ezempilo, ezokwelashwa, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nezinye. Ukuthatha imizuzu yazo zonke izihlanganiso kuyisibopho sikaMongameli kanye nekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Abantu babuyela emizuzwini ukuze bahlaziye izinqumo ezenziwe emhlanganweni. Nikeza isaziso somhlangano. Nika isaziso ngaleso sikhathi nendawo ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi. Njengoba kushiwo, uMphakathi uyena ophatha lokhu. UMongameli uzovula umhlangano futhi afunde uhlelo ngendlela. Kufanele abhale phansi bonke abakhona. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokuba ne-rekhodi noma uhlu lwabavakashi. Indima kaMongameli ukuhola umhlangano ngokuhambisana nohlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okudingekayo kuyafezeka. UMongameli ufana nomqondisi weqembu, hhayi umculi odlalayo yedwa. Zama ungabi yedwa okhuluma kakhulu kodwa lalela lokho abanye abakukhulumayo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abanakwe emuhlanganweni. Bhala phansi amaphuzu abalulekile ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana. Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlangano uqhubeka ngendlela ehlelekile, okusho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abakhulumi bayahlonishwa, abantu abakhohliwe ukuhleka noma ukukhuluma emhlanganweni. Zama ukuqeda umhlangano ngesikhathi. Ikomidi lomphakathi kufanele lenze izinqumo ngokuvumelana. Imithetho eqinile ingase ichaze ukuthi amaqembu omphakathi kufanele ahambele zonke izihlanganiso zawo, futhi ilungu eliphuthelwa izihlanganiso ezingaphezu kwezintathu ezilandelanayo lingase likhishwe ekomidini lomphakathi. Imithetho eqinile ingase iphinde ichaze ukuthi amalungu angabeka kanjani imibuzo emhlanganweni noma ukuthi bangakhuluma kangakanani ngendaba ethile. Abakwaqashi kufanele baqedele umbiko wabo wezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokuba bazi ngalesi sifo.
