Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Kwakukhanya usuku olukhulu emhlabeni wonkana, usuku lokhetho lukazwelonke. Izixuku zabantu zazihlezi ezindaweni ezihlukene, zithe nikhona isibonda sokukhathalela ikusasa lezwe. Abantu babethokozile, behlanganyela imicabango yabo, bekhuluma ngomfanekiso okhula ezihlalweni zepolitiki. Imithombo yemvelo yayivulelekile, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, umoya uthanda ukuhamba, udlulisa izwi lothando phakathi kwabantu. UMnumzane Dlamini, oneminyaka engama-53, wayephethe izifundo zezombusazwe eNyuvesi. Ngolunye usuku, ngesikhathi enza ucwaningo, wathola ukuthi abantu abaningi abakacacisi kahle ngesinqumo sabo sokuvota. Lokhu kwammangaza, wahlala wacabanga ukuthi kumele enze okuthile. Ngakho, wathola ukuthi kufanele ahlasele umphakathi, achaze abavoti ngendima yabo. Umqondo wakhe washintsha, wathi, "Kumele sikhuthaze abantu bethu ukuba bazi ukuthi ukhetho lwethu luyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa." Uhlanga lwakhe lokuzama ukukhuthaza abantu lwalubhalwe ezincwajaneni, akhipha imiyalezo ehlukahlukene ngezikhalazo zikaHulumeni. Kodwa, njengoba kukhona abantu abaningi abashaya indiva, kwavela izithiyo. Ubuya kulezi zithiyo, wathola isixazululo—ukuphawula imibuzo nezinkinga ezibhekene nezinye izifunda, ukuze abantu baqonde ukuthi ukuvota akusiyona indaba encane. Ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho, uMnumzane Dlamini wadala umkhankaso wokukhuthaza ukuvota. Wahlangana nomphakathi, wafundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, wabela abavoti abakhethiwe. Wazi kahle ukuthi abantu kufanele babenhloso, bangabi nokuphoxa, silindele impumelelo.
Ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho, uMnumzane Dlamini wadala umkhankaso wokukhuthaza ukuvota. Wahlangana nomphakathi, wafundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, wabela abavoti abakhethiwe. Wazi kahle ukuthi abantu kufanele babenhloso, bangabi nokuphoxa, silindele impumelelo. Njengoba usuku lokhetho luzayo, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, izibani zezimoto zikhipha umhlaba wejuba. U-Dlamini ubungane noMfundisi Mkhize, umholi wenhlangano ethile, owawubona impumelelo yomphakathi wabo. UMfundisi Mkhize wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izinkampani ezinkulu, zisize umphakathi. Kwakungesikhathi esemi, abantu babewubona umphakathi wabo uyiqhawe. Emaphandleni, njengoba abantu bebhalisela ukuvota, uNksz. Madisha, owayekhokhela umphakathi, wathola ukuthi kunokuphoxeka. Abantu babengenamali yokuhamba, babelokhu bekhathazekile. Wazi ukuthi kumele athathe isinyathelo, wahlala phansi nabantu abamnyamalalayo emizini yabo, babonge zisize umphakathi bazi, ukwenza imizamo yokuthi bakwazi ukuvota. Ukuthokozisa abantu kwakuhamba phambili, uMadisha wathokoza. Njengoba isikhathi sishiya phezulu, usuku lokhetho lwafika. U-Dlamini, uMfundisi Mkhize noNksz. Madisha banqunywa ukuhamba ndawonye emzini wokuqala. Abantu bejabulile, kunjalo nofuna ukubona izibambo zempumelelo. Babengabukeli phansi, kwavela izivumelwano zenkolo, baqala ukuphila nomoya opholile. Ngokushesha, izinsuku ezedlule zashintsha, abantu babefika ezingxenyeni zokuvota. U-Dlamini wafa amazwi akhe, "Lena yinsuku yethu, asitheni, asivoteni!"

Lapha, izimali zikahulumeni ezabelwe unyaka nonyaka zokwakha izakhiwo nezimali zokusebenza zirekhodwa. Lo msebenzi usitshela ukuthi, ukuze abantu bethu baphumelele, abesifazane bethu nezingane kumele zingasetshenziswanga ukuthwala izidakamizwa ngalezi zigebengu. Sivumelana nesu lokuthuthukisa elinophahla olukhulu futhi investa izinsiza kubantu bethu bonke. Ukulungiselela umhlaba kube kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukusungulwa kwesistimu nokufeza inzuzo enkulu. Futhi kulabo abaseduze kakhulu nezingozi, bahlupheka kakhulu.

Futhi kulabo abaseduze kakhulu nezingozi, bahlupheka kakhulu. Lezi zindawo ngokuvamile zikhululwa ngaphansi kwemifantu, lapho ikhwalithi yamanzi iphansi futhi ingase ibangele ingozi ezintweni eziphilayo emanzini. Lezi zinkomba zithunyelwe kubachwepheshe bezilimi ukuze bahlolisise. Umnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zinkomba njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ukuhlolwa kwabafundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela kumigomo yokuhlola imfundo esekelwe kumiphumela, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze izibonelo zezindlela zokugcina amarekhodi. Okuqukethwe kwale ncwadi kuhlukaniswe ngezahluko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sikhuluma ngezinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo kanye noqeqesho jikelele - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, kanye nezinga eliphezulu. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lwezemfundo eNingizimu Afrika. Uhloswe ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika enobudlelwano nezwe elihlangene elingakwazi ukudlala indima yalo efanele njengombuso ozimele phakathi kwezizwe ezihlukahlukene zomhlaba. Imfundo nomgomo wesikole kudlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso. Umgomo wesikole uhlose ukuthuthukisa amandla abafundi bonke ukuba babe ngamalungu aphelele omphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enobudlelwano. Imfundo esekelwe kumiphumela iyisisekelo somgomo wesikole eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloswe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi bangathola ulwazi ngokwezinga labo lokwazi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlela imiphumela okukhulunywa ngayo ukuthi abafundi kufanele bayifinyelele ekupheleni kwemisebenzi yonke. Lokhu kuvumela abafundi ukuba baveze ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba wenziwe ngempahla ehlukahlukene, futhi ukuthi isizathu sokuxazulula izinkinga asikwazi ukuhlukaniswa. Bakwazi ukuzama izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda ngempumelelo. Bangaqhuba njengamalungu aphumelelayo emiphakathini abahlala kuyo, kokubili endaweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bangaqonda futhi baphathwe yizinkolo nezimfashini ezikhona ezimweni ezihlukahlukene phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Futhi ukuze bakhe amathuba ebhizinisi.
Bangaqhuba njengamalungu aphumelelayo emiphakathini abahlala kuyo, kokubili endaweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bangaqonda futhi baphathwe yizinkolo nezimfashini ezikhona ezimweni ezihlukahlukene phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Futhi ukuze bakhe amathuba ebhizinisi. Isimemezelo esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole sikazwelonke sezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni) sikhombisa isu eliphelele eligcizelela izidingo ezincane zabafundi bonke. Zonke izimemezelo zezifundo zihlokoma ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphila ngendlela efanele, amalungelo abantu, indawo ephephile nephilile ezibambile, kanye nokufakwa kwabo bonke. Abafundi baphinde bakhuthazwe ukuba bazi futhi baqonde ukuhlukahluka kwezinto ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngamasiko, inkolo, kanye nobuzwe, okuyizici ezivelele zalo ukuhlukahluka. Isimemezelo ngasinye se-subject sikhombisa imiphumela yokufunda okulindelekile okufanele umfundi ayifinyelele ekupheleni kwesigaba sika-9. Isimemezelo ngasinye se-subject sikhombisa kahle izindlela zokuhlola eziholela ekufezekiseni imiphumela yokufunda okulindelekile. Isimemezelo esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole sikazwelonke sihlose ukwandisa ukuzinikela nolwazi phakathi kwabafundisi, abazoqhamuka ukuze babambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zabo zemfundo. Ukuze kusekelwe leli qophelo, Umnyango Wezemfundo uzokwethula umgomo oholayo okhishwe esimemezelweni ngasinye se-subject. Izifunda nazo zizoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela yazo ukuze zihlolisise ukuhlukahluka okukhona ukuze zicabangele umehluko phakathi kwezifunda. Imigomo nezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala esimemezelweni esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole kanye nezimemezelo zezifundo ziyisisekelo sezinhlelo zokufunda. Njengoba izindawo zezifundo zigcizelela ukufezwa kolwazi, amakhono, nezinto ezibalulekile zemfundo ngesisekelo nesigaba, izinhlelo zomgomo ziqhakambisa ukwakheka kwalokho okuzofundwa nokuthi umsebenzi uzohlolwa kanjani ezingeni ngalinye lemfundo. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, kukhona izinhlelo zomgomo ezintathu: ikhono lokufunda nokubhala, ikhono lokubala (ukusebenza nezibalo), nolwazi lwezempilo. Ezinye izinhlelo zomgomo kufanele zithuthukiswe yizikole ngemva kokuthola imvume kuMnyango Wezemfundo wesifunda. Izifunda ngokwazo kufanele zenze izinqumo mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezifundo ezinganikezwa kuzo zonke izifunda eziphezulu ezingeni eliphakathi. Ezingeni eliphezulu, kukhona izinhlelo zomgomo eziyisishiyagalombili ezisekelwe ezindaweni zezifundo. Ukwabiwa kwesikhathi kwezifundo ngakunye kunqunywa kuzo zonke izigaba nezinga. Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi esebenzayo nehloniphekile. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, kubalulekile ukubheka emuva emlandweni, lapho lezi zinhlelo ziqala khona. Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyikhulu edlule, izinkampani ziqala ukuqonda ukuthi abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, abanolwazi, bangaba nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni nasekuthuthukiseni ibhizinisi. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkampani ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, zabe seziqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi bazo. Lokhu kwavela ngenxa yokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, okwakudinga abantu abaneziqu ezithile ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zathuthuka. Emazweni amaningi, ikakhulukazi eYurophu naseNyakatho Melika, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benolwazi olusha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nezifundo ezisemthethweni, izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezisemkhakheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zathuthuka zaba nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene. Izinkampani zaziqala ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhlangene, okwakuhlanganisa izifundo zokuqeqesha ezisemqoka nezifundo ezithile ezithinta imisebenzi ethile. Lokhu kwavumela abasebenzi ukuba bathole amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zathuthuka zaba nezinjongo eziningi.
Izinkampani zaziqala ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhlangene, okwakuhlanganisa izifundo zokuqeqesha ezisemqoka nezifundo ezithile ezithinta imisebenzi ethile. Lokhu kwavumela abasebenzi ukuba bathole amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zathuthuka zaba nezinjongo eziningi. Kwakukhona ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okwakuhloswe ngqo ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, kodwa futhi kwakukhona nezinhlelo ezazihloselwe ukwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kwavumela abasebenzi ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuphumelela kwazo akuncikile kuphela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abasebenzi, kodwa futhi kusemqoka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana, ezazihloselwe ukuvumela abasebenzi ukuba babelane ngemicabango yabo, iziphakamiso, nezinkinga ababhekana nazo emsebenzini. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezimboni, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zathuthuka zaba nezinhloso ezinkulu. Izinkampani zaziqala ukubona ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle akugcini nje ngokwandisa amakhono, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabantu. Lokhu kwavumela abasebenzi ukuba babe nemibono emisha, futhi baqhamuke nezixazululo ezintsha ezizothuthukisa ibhizinisi. Kwakukhona ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okwakuhloswe ngqo ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, kodwa futhi kwakukhona nezinhlelo ezazihloselwe ukwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kwavumela abasebenzi ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkampani zaziqala ukufaka izindlela zokuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kwavumela izinkampani ukuba ziqonde kahle ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zisebenza kanjani, futhi zikwazi ukwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa eziphumelelayo, ezazihlinzeka ngempumelelo emkhakheni wezokusebenza. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphendula izidingo zokuqeqeshwa. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezisheshayo, izinkampani zaziqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezikwi-inthanethi, ezazivumela abasebenzi ukuba baqeqeshe ngezikhathi zabo. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abaningi ukuba bathole ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Namuhla, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zikhona ezimbonini eziningi, futhi zihlala zishintsha ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo ezithuthukayo. Izinkampani ziqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzi, futhi ziqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Izinkampani ziqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzi, futhi ziqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokutshala imali ezinhlelweni zokuqeqeshwa, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala bephumelela, bephumelele, futhi bekwazi ukubhekana nezinguquko ezizayo emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube namandla, futhi kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wethu.
Osaziwayo Nodumo: Amaphupho, Izinselele, Nezimpilo Ake sibheke izimpilo zethu zansuku zonke. Sihlala sibonile izithombe ezinhle, izikhangiso ezikhangayo, nezindaba ezimnandi eziphathelene nosaziwayo. U-‘celebrity’ uvela lapho ibhizinisi lemidlalo, umculo, noma izinto zokuzijabulisa selitholakala emhlabeni. Kepha, kuyini ukuthanda osaziwayo, futhi kuyini okukhuluma ngempilo yabo? Ngibheke lokhu phakathi kwami, ukuze ngidwelise kahle. Kukhona okuthandayo lapho kukhuluma ngosaziwayo. Inhliziyo yezenhlalo ifuna ukwazi okuningi ngabo – abashadile, abanakanga, abanesithunzi, abani imali eningi. Phakathi nemihlangano, sihlangana nezifiso zokuba yibo, ukuphila ukuphila okuthandwa umphakathi. Kodwa kufanele sikhumbule, akekho umuntu ophelele. Abaningi bamele i-photogenic, kodwa abanezinkinga ezinzima zangaphakathi. Kukhona futhi ububi obuhambisana nodumo. Amasiko athwele kanzima futhi ahluphekile. Osaziwayo bahlala ngaphansi kwekhamera, abakwazi ukuphila impilo ejwayelekile. Cabanga nje, lapho uthola lo mculi omncane socela ukuthi uthumele isithombe, uvuma ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, udinga ukukwazi ukwakha ikhono lokuphila, okwenza umcabango ukuthi ungumuntu ophila njengabo bonke. Kukhona abampofu abavela ezindabeni, abafuna uthando nesikhumbuzo. Ngabe abavela ezindawenikazi, banelungelo lokubhekwa? Esikhathini esiningi, izinkinga zashintsha, okusho ukuthi abaculi bahlupheka kakhulu. Uphethwe izingcindezi zokubukeka, ukwenziwa kwezakhamuzi, nokugcina umphakathi uyajabula. Kodwa akufanele sibhale ngeso lokugxila kuphela. Abanye, abavela ezindaweni ezizimele, bazama ukwakha ibhizinisi labo.
Uphethwe izingcindezi zokubukeka, ukwenziwa kwezakhamuzi, nokugcina umphakathi uyajabula. Kodwa akufanele sibhale ngeso lokugxila kuphela. Abanye, abavela ezindaweni ezizimele, bazama ukwakha ibhizinisi labo. Ukuze bazame ukusiza, kukholelwa ukuthi uma nje uma bezithola, baqala ukufuna kuphela impilo elungile. Ngaleyondlela, kudinga ukucabanga ngobuchule, bahlala bephakathi kokuba abamukeli umphakathi. Ngabe kukhona okungase kube khona okungcono? Lokhu kudinga ukuphikelela ukuze kube nesizathu sokuphumelela. Khumbula, ikusasa labaculi alilula njengokufana nomkhiqizo. Ngibukele abanye abavela kuNetflix, behlola izinkanyezi ezithuthukayo. Uhlobo lokupthelwa kwabo kwabangela ukungaqondi kahle, bezama ukuzinza, futhi bazame ukuhlinzeka ngothando. Kwenziwa ngothando nolwazi, ngakho-ke abaphile njengoba bekulindelekile. Ngabe umculi wethu ubonakala njengomuntu odlula phezulu? Abaculi bahlala bebidinga ukwakha umgwaqo wabo. Abesifazane abahlakaniphile, bephakathi kwezinkanyezi zothando, bayazi ukuthi baqinisa imikhono yabo. Kwenziwa ngendlela yokuba balwe, balwe ukuze bafeze imali, nokuthola ikhono. Ngabe ungakuthola kahle lokhu okuvusa izithakazelo? Khumbula, umjikelezo omkhulu uyaqhubeka nolaka. Abakhiqizi bayazifaka impilo ezintsha, bezama ukukhiqiza abaculi abasha, abanye bakhokha imali engakwenzi. Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uminyaka uthisha umculi ofuna ukungena, phela izinsiza zenza kube nzima ukuya phambili. Ezemfundo, ezemidlalo, kufana nezinhlelo eziningi exubile. Akamfuni umphakathi, kufanele acacise izifiso zezehlo, imikhankaso nezizathu.
Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uminyaka uthisha umculi ofuna ukungena, phela izinsiza zenza kube nzima ukuya phambili. Ezemfundo, ezemidlalo, kufana nezinhlelo eziningi exubile. Akamfuni umphakathi, kufanele acacise izifiso zezehlo, imikhankaso nezizathu. Impilo ithokozisa kakhulu uma ubona ulwazi lwenkanyezi, ungathola ukuphila ehla ngaphezu kwezindonga ezimnyama. Uyazi kusho ukuthini. Lokhu kumele kube ngogqozi, ukuze uziqhenye futhi ukwazi ukubaluleka kokuba uyiqaba yabalungiselela izifiso zabo. Ngakho, lapho sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, asikho sehluko phakathi kwezinkanyezi eziphakeme nezempilo ezinokungafani. Ubulili, ubuchwepheshe, unaphi zenzwayo lilokhu silungiswa phakathi kwezinto ezilindelekile. Ngabe siyazi kahle okukhuluma ngakho? Ngcuka uma lokho kudinga izinkanyezi ezithile, sikhumbule ukuthi konke kuhlangene, njengenhliziyo elungisa konke. Ngamafuphi, impilo yosaziwayo iyinkimbinkimbi. Phezu kwakho konke, nezinto ezithile zikhona. Akekho ophelele, futhi abanye bahlala befuna ukuzijabulisa. Isikhathi sishintsha, futhi izinkanyezi ziyashintsha. Ngakho-ke, hamba izinto ezinhle, uzoba nezinselele, ukuze usebenze ngezindlela eziningi. Lokhu kubalulekile, usaziwayo nalowo ogcizelela umoya obalulekile. Ubudlelwano, uthando, nezinkanyezi – konke kushintsha. Ngiyabonga.
Uhlelo Lobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika: Ingxoxo-mpikiswano Uzinzo lwezombusazwe nokuthula kwabantu bamaZulu, maSotho, amaXhosa, kanye nezinye izizwe eNingizimu Afrika, kudinga ukuxoxwa ngendaba ethile eyayihawukele intshonalanga kwezombusazwe: uhlelo lobandlululo. Le nhlangano ibonakala iyindaba yokuphikisana, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinzuzweni kanye nemiphumela eyayibangelwa yalesi simo esihlukumezayo. Uhlanga lobandlululo lwakha umgwaqo owawuhleleke kahle ezintweni eziningana, kuqala ngenkohlakalo yomqondo wokuhlukaniswa kwabantu. Kukho abakholelwa ukuthi lo mbono wahlomula imiphakathi ethile, ikakhulukazi abantu abamnyama, ngokuhlinzeka ngemfundo, amathuba omsebenzi, kanye nokuhlala emakhaya afanele. Nokho, abanye bakhombisa ukuthi uthathwa njengomgibeli onzima kakhulu njengoba uqinisekiswa empilweni yabo. Uhlelo lobandlululo lwakha izinhlaka zomthetho ezikhethekile ezihambisana nomthetho oyisisekelo. Lezi zinhlelo zenza umphakathi wamaNgisi ukuwina izinzuzo ezithile ezikhokhelwa ngabantu abamnyama. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphikisi baphakamisa ukuthi uhlelo lobandlululo lwadala amakha umhlaba, sikhumbuze izifundo ezinzima kakhulu ezitholakala emlandweni. Ukwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili nabanye nasekuzameni ukuthola umqondo womphefumulo wobuntu.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi ubona izinzuzo ezithile kumphakathi ophila ngaphansi kohlanga lobandlululo. Kodwa okulindelekile kumakhaya amancane akhulisa izinga lokuphepha, kanti kuyavusa amasha amakhaya. Lokhu kuhambisana okukhaliphile ngazo zonke izindlela zezezimali, eventual ukwehliswa kwi-railway manufacturing queries ngenxa yemoto encane kakhulu. Uphiko lwamadodakazi olwandulela umphakathi lunika abantu amandla okukhuluma ngeziqukathi zabo, kodwa lokhu kungakhuthaza kakhulu ukungahlangani nokuqhubeka kwezombusazwe ngendlela. Inhloso yokugcina iyiphuzu elisemqoka kulolu hlelo lokuphila kubantu, okuyisizathu esikhulu sokubamba umuntu ongaqhubeka nohlanga olukhanyayo kube phezulu. Leli qhinga lokukhomba umphakathi, uhambise izinyathelo eziyinqaba ezilungisayo ukucacisa uhlelo lobandlululo. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lobandlululo lungabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene: njengenhliziyo yengxoxo yokuthi umphakathi uzokwazi kanjani ukucabanga ngendlela ekhululekile. Lokhu kuhlaziya kuqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene, kanti kuphinda kube umkhondo omuhle emlandweni wethu. Syngama ophakeme kanye nabahlali bangakhuthazwa ekuphileni ngendlela abantu bonke abebezama ukuyifinyelela nesikhathi esihambisanayo. Njengoba sikhuluma, sikhumbula ukuthi kukhona abaphikisi bephikisana nolimile embonini yakhe nezinye zezinhlelo ezithile. Ngokuvamile, uhlelo lobandlululo lweNingizimu Afrika luthuthukisa izithakazelo ezithile, amafutha okuhlanganyela okukhona. Izimpendulo ezithile zikhombisa ukuqhubeka kwabangazi zingakhulumi ngothando. Lokhu kuhlola kuqeda amaphutha nabanye. Lokhu kuhamba kancane ukusebenza ngaphakathi nemigomo yeMiphakathi yokuhlukunyezwa kobandlululo, okuyindida ezehla emiphakathini. Ukubuyiswa kokukhumbula ukuthi kunciphisa ukungalingani komphakathi. Uhlanga lobandlululo lungahlaziya izinkinga ezithile ziholele emikhakheni emisha yokuphila, nokuqhubekela phambili emvothweni ejulile, ijubane elihamba phambili kulolu hlelo kuyakhanya. Kumele sicabangele ukuthi, njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, nezinkolelo nokwenza kusebenza kumele kuhlale ngaphansi kokuhlaziya. Umphakathi asetshenziswa uthando lobuntu kumaphuzu ahlukahlukene ukuze uthuthukise inhloso eyiyo. Ngako konke lokhu, uhlelo lobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika kulokhu luyisifundo esiqinile, esikhuluma ngephupho lokukwazi okukhulu kokuhlala sobala emhlabeni wonke, ngenkathi sikhumbula ukugcina ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu bazo zonke izizathu. Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika 1. Isingeniso Umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika ubonakale ukhula ngokushesha eminyakeni edlule. Lokhu kukhula kubangelwa yizizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukwanda kwezidingo zamakhasimende, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. Le dokhumenti izobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nokukhula komkhakha wama-call centre, izinzuzo, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta lo mkhakha. Izizathu Zokukhula 2.1 Ubuchwepheshe Obuthuthukisiwe Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wama-call centre. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-CRM (Customer Relationship Management), zenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izingcingo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwenza ama-call centre akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende ngokushesha. 2.2 Ukukhula Kwezidingo Zamakhasimende Njengoba izinkampani zikhula, zidinga izinsizakalo ezinhle zokuxhumana namakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwama-call centre, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende athola usizo olusheshayo nolusezingeni eliphezulu. 2.3 Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umsebenzi Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umsebenzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, zikhuthaza ukukhula komkhakha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olufanele lokuphatha izingcingo, okwandisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Izinyathelo Zokukhula Komkhakha 3.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Izinkampani kufanele zihlale zihlola ubuchwepheshe obusha.
2.3 Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umsebenzi Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umsebenzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, zikhuthaza ukukhula komkhakha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olufanele lokuphatha izingcingo, okwandisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Izinyathelo Zokukhula Komkhakha 3.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Izinkampani kufanele zihlale zihlola ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ukusebenzisa ama-bots ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo kubasebenzi, nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlaziya ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. 3.2 Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala befundiswa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, izinqubo ezintsha, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abasebenzi bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni ezihlukahlukene. 3.3 Ukuphathwa Kwekhwalithi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakhasimende athola insizakalo engcono, izinkampani kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuphatha ikhwalithi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuphendula, isikhathi sokulinda, kanye nezinga lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Izinzuzo Zokukhula Komkhakha 4.1 Ukudala Imisebenzi Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre kuholela ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, lapho bezama ukunciphisa izinga lokungasebenzi. 4.2 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimali Umkhakha wama-call centre ungumthombo omkhulu wezindleko. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba izinkampani zikhula futhi zikhulisa imisebenzi yazo.
Lokhu kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, lapho bezama ukunciphisa izinga lokungasebenzi. 4.2 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimali Umkhakha wama-call centre ungumthombo omkhulu wezindleko. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba izinkampani zikhula futhi zikhulisa imisebenzi yazo. 4.3 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zamakhasimende Njengoba umkhakha ukhula, izinkampani zikhuthazwa ukuba zithuthukise izinsizakalo zazo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende, okubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani namakhasimende. Izinselelo Ezithinta Umkhakha 5.1 Ukuncintisana Okukhulu Njengoba umkhakha ukhula, kukhona ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwezinkampani. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zihlale ziqhamuka nezixazululo ezintsha ukuze zihlale zikhangisa amakhasimende. 5.2 Izinga Lokuphila Kwabasebenzi Izinga lokuphila kwabasebenzi emkhakheni wama-call centre lingase libe phansi. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi bazo, ukuze kugwenywe ukushiya emsebenzini. 5.3 Izinguquko Ezemthethweni Izinguquko emthethweni zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni. Izinkampani kufanele zihlale ziqaphele izinguquko ezisemthethweni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Isiphetho Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa amathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunezinselelo ezithile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokuphatha ikhwalithi ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa amakhasimende. Ngale ndlela, umkhakha ungakhula futhi ube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.

Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Isingeniso Ukuthathwa komhlaba kuyinqubo ebalulekile emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo ekwakheni izinhlelo zokwakha, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Nokho, le nqubo ibhekene nezimpikiswano eziningi zomthetho, okuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, izinqubo ezisemthethweni, kanye nemithetho ethinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Le doku mentsi ihlose ukukhombisa izimpikiswano ezisemqoka ezihlobene nalolu daba, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo ihambisana nemithetho nezimiso zokuhlalisana kahle. Izimpikiswano Zomthetho 1. Umlando Wokuthathwa Komhlaba Ukuthathwa komhlaba kwenzeka ngezizathu ezahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, izinhlelo zokwakha ezinkulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlanza izindawo. Nokho, umlando walolu daba ubonisa ukuthi le nqubo ibiyinkimbinkimbi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu bahlala khona. Izimpikiswano zihlala zikhona phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Amalungelo Abantu Omunye wemibuzo ebalulekile ngalesi sihloko ubandakanya amalungelo abantu. Umthetho ubonisa ukuthi abantu banamalungelo athile uma kuziwa ekuthathweni komhlaba, okuhlanganisa amalungelo okuthola izinxephezelo ezifanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bangavuma noma baphikise ukuthathwa komhlaba, futhi baphinde bathole izinxephezelo ezikhona. Izinyathelo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinyathelo zokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngendlela efanele, ezimweni ezithile.
Umthetho ubonisa ukuthi abantu banamalungelo athile uma kuziwa ekuthathweni komhlaba, okuhlanganisa amalungelo okuthola izinxephezelo ezifanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bangavuma noma baphikise ukuthathwa komhlaba, futhi baphinde bathole izinxephezelo ezikhona. Izinyathelo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinyathelo zokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngendlela efanele, ezimweni ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izindawo ezithintekayo, ukuxhumana nabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezizathu zokuthathwa komhlaba. Ukuhlola izimo zomhlaba, izinsiza, kanye nemiphakathi ethintekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zenzelwa ngesisekelo esiqinile. Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezivela lapho kuthathwa umhlaba ukuhamba kahle kokuxhumana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezihlukene. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo bahlala bezwa ukuthi abaphathi abavumelani nabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuphikisaneni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavumelana, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezibandakanya izithakazelo zomphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Izinqubomgomo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinhlelo zokuthathwa komhlaba kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezihambisana nezimfuneko zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinqubomgomo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo zokuthathwa komhlaba zenzelwa abantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinxephezelo ezikhona zikhona.
Izinqubomgomo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinhlelo zokuthathwa komhlaba kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezihambisana nezimfuneko zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinqubomgomo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo zokuthathwa komhlaba zenzelwa abantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinxephezelo ezikhona zikhona. Izixazululo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kuhamba kahle, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izixazululo zingabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo, ukuze baqonde izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba, kanye nezindlela zokuphikisa uma kudingeka. Isiphetho Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo ihamba kahle, futhi ibhekelela amalungelo abantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo bayavumelana, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana, izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuthathwa komhlaba kufanele kube inqubo esebenza kahle, ehlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi eqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izithakazelo zikhuluma ndawonye ukuze kuzuze umphakathi wonke. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi noma ukusiza, sicela uxhumane nezikhungo ezifanele zomthetho noma ezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingase zibe usizo ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezihlobene nokuthathwa komhlaba.
Othisha: Izinyembezi, Izinhliziyo Nempilo Yokufundisa Siyavuma, othisha bethu bangabantu abalungile. Ngemuva kwesikole, bahlala bezama ukusithuthukisa, ukusifundisa, futhi baqonde izinselelo zethu. Noma ngabe ngabe umnyango wezemfundo ungawazi, thina sazi kahle ukuthi othisha bethu baphila ngaphakathi kwezinkinga eziningi. Abanye bethu basuke bahamba kancane, bebambisene nabafundi, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukuze sifunde kahle. Uma sikhuluma ngothisha, sizokhuluma ngama-grit, impilo, nezifundo eziphathekayo. Abafundi bahlala bebhekene nezinkinga eziningi, futhi othisha bethu bahlala bejolise ekuqondeni lezi zinkinga, bezama ukusisiza. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi othisha abahlala belungiselela izifundo zabo? Bangama-hero bempilo yethu, balungiselela izifundo ezinhle, behlola izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa. Ngabe ubuchwepheshe bwuye buphumelele emkhakheni wemfundo? Impela! Kukhona izinsiza eziningi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nemibhalo ehlukene okwenza kube lula ukufundisa. Othisha badinga ukufunda lezi zinto ukuze basebenze kahle, ukuze baqhubeke nokwandisa ulwazi lwabo. Kukhona izinsuku lapho ubuchwepheshe bujabulisa, kanti kwezinye izinsuku, kudinga umqondo omkhulu. Kodwa othisha bethu bahlala bejolise kumfundi, bezama ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngale kwalokhu, sikhumbula ukuthi othisha bethu bahlala bephila ngezinkinga zabo. Lokhu akukhona nje ngezimali, kodwa nakwezinye izinto. Umsebenzi wothisha uhlanganisa ukugxila, ukuzimisela, nokubekezela. Abanye bethu basuke bephila nemindeni emincane, bahlala bejuggling phakathi komsebenzi namakhaya.
Lokhu akukhona nje ngezimali, kodwa nakwezinye izinto. Umsebenzi wothisha uhlanganisa ukugxila, ukuzimisela, nokubekezela. Abanye bethu basuke bephila nemindeni emincane, bahlala bejuggling phakathi komsebenzi namakhaya. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi baphile ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, bathole isikhathi sokuphumula, futhi baphinde banakekele izidingo zabo. Yize kunjalo, kunzima ukusho ukuthi othisha baningi abaphila kahle. Kukhona abanye abahlala bephila ngaphansi komthwalo omkhulu, bephoqeleka ukuba benze izinqumo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Abanye bahlale bephila ngezinkinga zempilo, kanti abanye bahlala bejolise ezintweni ezingezinhle. Kodwa, bahlala besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi bazama ukwenza kahle. Ngabe singakuphakamisela kanjani lokho? Noma yiziphi iziphakamiso ezitholakalayo? Kukhona izinsiza eziningi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezindlela ezihlukene zokubambisana. Othisha bethu badinga ukwakha imikhankaso yokuxhumana ukuze basize omunye nomunye. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, kumqoka ukuba sibe nezingxoxo, sabelane ngolwazi, futhi sifeze izinjongo ezihlangene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufundisa, futhi kuzoholela ekuphumeleleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, othisha bethu bahlala bejolise eminyakeni edlule, behlola izindlela eziphumelelayo zokufundisa. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola izifundo, ukuhlela izinhlelo, nokuhlola izifundo ezihluke kakhulu. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kakhulu, futhi kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni komfundi. Uthisha, ngokwenhloso, uyakwazi ukusizakala kuzo zonke izifundo, abamba izifundo ezichelekileyo, futhi aqhubele phambili izifundo. Noma kunjalo, akukona konke okwenziwa othisha. Bahlala belwela ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabafundi.
Uthisha, ngokwenhloso, uyakwazi ukusizakala kuzo zonke izifundo, abamba izifundo ezichelekileyo, futhi aqhubele phambili izifundo. Noma kunjalo, akukona konke okwenziwa othisha. Bahlala belwela ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabafundi. Othisha bethu badinga ukufundisa ngezinhliziyo zabo, benze abafundi babe nomdlandla, bejabulisa. Noma ngabe umphakathi unzima, othisha bethu baphila ngaphakathi kwalokho, bahlala bezama ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhlobene. Ngokuphetha, othisha bethu bahlala bekhuthaza, bejabulisa, futhi bezama ukusiza abafundi. Othisha babalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sibabonge ngakho. Lokhu akuyona nje imfundo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngakho, asiqhubekeni sabelane ngothisha bethu, sibabonge, futhi sihloniphe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula, futhi kuzoholela ekuphumeleleni. Ngiyabonga.
Irrigation - kuyini lokhu? Umhlaba wonke unenkinga ngamanzi ngoba inani labantu liqhubeka likhula, kodwa amanzi atholakalayo awakhuli. Imephu elandelayo ikhombisa izindawo lapho kukhona amanzi emhlabeni. Kunabantu abaningi emhlabeni abangakwazi ukufinyelela kokudla namanzi ahlanzekile, njalonjalo. Ukukhiqiza ukudla/izitshalo ngamanzi agcinwe ezindaweni lapho ukuna kwemvula kuncane noma akuzinzile. Ukusebenzisa amanzi agcinwe endaweni ethile kubalulekile. Ukunciphisa ingozi yokufa kwezitshalo ezitshalwe futhi kuvuselela ukuqhubeka kokukhiqizwa kokudla ezweni. Ukwandisa umkhiqizo ngaphezulu kwehektare. Ukukhiqiza ukudla phakathi nezikhathi ezomile nezimanzi. Ukukhiqiza ukudla kabili ngonyaka. Ukusebenzisa imali etholakale ebhizinisini ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlinzeka ngemakethe ekhula ngokwakha ukudla okwanele. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye nemikhiqizo. Ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemaphandleni. Ukukhiqiza izinhlobo ezikhethiwe zezithako ezindaweni ezomile (lapho imvula ingafiki ngezikhathi ezingafanele ezingenza umkhiqizo ube sengozini). Kunezindawo eziningi ezishisayo nezomile lapha eNingizimu Afrika, lapho kukhona ukwehla kwamanzi kakhulu futhi akuhlali kuthola imvula. Kulokhu, kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ejwayelekile ngaphandle kokungenisa amanzi endaweni ethile. Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngaphandle kokufaka amanzi kubizwa ngokuthi: ukuncika emvuleni kuphela, noma ukukhiqiza ezindaweni ezomile. Isimo sezulu esihlala sishisayo nesishisayo sikhuthaza ukukhula kwezithako ezithile, futhi eziningi zikhula kahle uma kukhona amanzi anele okokufaka.
Kulokhu, kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ejwayelekile ngaphandle kokungenisa amanzi endaweni ethile. Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngaphandle kokufaka amanzi kubizwa ngokuthi: ukuncika emvuleni kuphela, noma ukukhiqiza ezindaweni ezomile. Isimo sezulu esihlala sishisayo nesishisayo sikhuthaza ukukhula kwezithako ezithile, futhi eziningi zikhula kahle uma kukhona amanzi anele okokufaka. Ngokubheka kwethu, u-40% wezindawo ezinomjikelezo wamanzi zisetshenziswa ngabantu ngabanye, u-26% uphathiswa uhulumeni, kukhona u-4% abakhiqizi abancane, kanti u-30% osele uphathiswa uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi 'izinhlelo zokulima amanzi'.
Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ngendlela Efana Nama-ATM: Ukubuyekezwa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye balungisa izindlela eziningi zokuphila kwethu, futhi izikhungo zokusebenza zikhombisa lokhu ngokucacile. Njengoba abantu besebenzisa ama-ATM (Automated Teller Machines) ukuze bathole imali, izikhungo ezithile ziya zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufanayo ukuze ziqhube izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ekusebenzeni kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM, okubandakanya izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokusebenza. Izinzuzo Zokusebenza Kwezikhungo Njengama-ATM Okokuqala, ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi kumakhasimende. Njengoba ama-ATM ethola ukufinyelela okusheshayo nemali, izikhungo ezisebenzisa le ndlela zikhuthaza ukufinyelela okuphumelelayo ezinsizakalweni zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokusebenza kungaba nzima. Ngokusebenzisa izikhungo ezizimele, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ngaphandle kokulinda isikhathi eside. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhungo ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ngaso sonke isikhathi. Njengoba ama-ATM ethola imali 24/7, izikhungo ezisebenza ngale ndlela nazo zikhuthaza ukufinyelela okungapheli. Lokhu kubalulekile kumakhasimende afuna izinsizakalo ngesikhathi esifanele, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemidlalweni, emsebenzini, noma emakhaya. Ukusebenza okungapheli kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpilo zabo, kunciphise ukucindezeleka, futhi kwandise ukwaneliseka. Izinselelo Ezihambisana Nokusebenza Kwezikhungo Nokho, njengoba kunamathuba amaningi, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezihambisana nokusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM.
Lokhu kubalulekile kumakhasimende afuna izinsizakalo ngesikhathi esifanele, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemidlalweni, emsebenzini, noma emakhaya. Ukusebenza okungapheli kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpilo zabo, kunciphise ukucindezeleka, futhi kwandise ukwaneliseka. Izinselelo Ezihambisana Nokusebenza Kwezikhungo Nokho, njengoba kunamathuba amaningi, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezihambisana nokusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu iwukuphepha. Njengoba ama-ATM ebhekana nezinkinga zokuphanga, izikhungo ezisebenza ngale ndlela nazo zidinga ukuvikela ulwazi lwamakhasimende. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela ulwazi, ukuqapha okungapheli, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bazi kahle ukusebenza kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, abantu bangathola usizo olufanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zisebenza kahle, kudinga ukufundiswa okuqhubekayo kwabantu abasebenza khona, ukuze bahlale bebheke izinguquko zobuchwepheshe. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi zisebenzise izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi, okuvumela amakhasimende ukuthi athole izinsizakalo ngaphandle kokuvakashela ezikhungweni. Lokhu kungenza kube lula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zingasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende angathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ngempumelelo.
Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi, okuvumela amakhasimende ukuthi athole izinsizakalo ngaphandle kokuvakashela ezikhungweni. Lokhu kungenza kube lula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zingasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende angathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ngempumelelo. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, izikhungo zingakwazi ukwazisa amakhasimende ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izinguquko, kanye nezinsizakalo ezintsha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumakhasimende ukuhlela izikhathi zabo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuthi baphendule izidingo zamakhasimende. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM kubonisa indlela entsha yokuphila, enezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi nezinselelo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, izikhungo kufanele ziqhubeke zithuthukisa izindlela zazo zokusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumakhasimende, kunciphise izinkinga, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zikhona. Ngalesi sikhathi sokushintsha, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze ziqhubeke zikhonza abantu ngendlela efanele.
Ingxenye 3 yeMthetho ibeka ukuthi umthetho wezintela uzophumelela ngosuku lokuqala lwezintela olwakhiwe yiMuniisipali ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Lo mbhalo uchaza umthetho we eThekwini Municipality futhi kufanele ufundwe ndawonye ne-MPRA. Ngokulandela umthetho wezintela, iMuniisipali izohlangabezana nezidingo ze-MPRA kanye ne-MFMA, kuhlanganise nanoma yiziphi izinhlinzeko ngaphansi kwalezi zMthetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le mthetho isebenza kulokhu okulandelayo. Umhlaba wezolimo ungumhlaba noma izakhiwo ezibambe isiqinisekiso sezolimo. I-Bed & Breakfast iyindawo yokuhlala enamagumbi okwamukela izivakashi angama-4. Isikhathi sokukhokha izintela kusukela ekuqaleni sibhaliwe njengedebhithi kuze kube usuku lokukhokha. Indlu yokwamukela izivakashi iyindawo yokuhlala enamagumbi okwamukela izivakashi phakathi kwe-5 no-10. Umuntu omdala ungumuntu oneminyaka engaphezu kweyi-60. Impahla lapho umnikazi ehlala khona iyimpahla umnikazi ayihlala kuyo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Isikole esingekho phansi kwemali siyi-sikole esizimele noma esingekho kuhulumeni esibhalisa abafundi kusukela ezingeni le-0 kuya kwele-12 esingatholi uxhaso olukhulu kuhulumeni. Izinga liyintela ethathwa yiMuniisipali emhlabeni, njengoba kulindelekile esigabeni 229 (a) soMthethosisekelo.
Impahla lapho umnikazi ehlala khona iyimpahla umnikazi ayihlala kuyo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Isikole esingekho phansi kwemali siyi-sikole esizimele noma esingekho kuhulumeni esibhalisa abafundi kusukela ezingeni le-0 kuya kwele-12 esingatholi uxhaso olukhulu kuhulumeni. Izinga liyintela ethathwa yiMuniisipali emhlabeni, njengoba kulindelekile esigabeni 229 (a) soMthethosisekelo. Ngaphezu kwabantu abachazwe kuMthetho, "umnikazi" ubhekisela kumuntu ongena ohlelweni lokubambisana, ngaphandle kokuhlala okune-garage, indawo yokupaka, indawo yokuhlala eyenzelwe abantu abadala enezidingo zokuhlala, noma indawo yokugcina, enenhloso yayo, ibhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla kuphela ngokwezinsika 7.3 lapha; b umnikazi wezimpahla ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ubhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla kuphela ngokwezinsika 7.2 no-7. Indlu yokuhlala iyindlu eyingxenye yempahla yokuhlala esetshenziselwa ukuhlala abantu, noma izindlu eziningi ezifana nalokhu endaweni lapha akukhulumi ngendawo lapho okungaphezu kokuthathu kwabelwana ngayo okuthile ngaphandle kokuhlala, noma ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, B&B, indlu yokwamukela izivakashi, noma efana naleyo eqashiswa nsuku zonke. Impahla ekhokha izintela ezikhethekile iyindawo eyenzelwe lapho abanikazi bezimpahla ngaphakathi kwayo bevuma ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo ezengeziwe ezingaphezu kwalokho okunikezwa yiMuniisipali. Lokhu kukhokha kwenziwa ngokwengeza enye imali ezinteleni ezikhokhiswa kumakhadi abanikazi bezimpahla kule ndawo.
Indlu yokuhlala iyindlu eyingxenye yempahla yokuhlala esetshenziselwa ukuhlala abantu, noma izindlu eziningi ezifana nalokhu endaweni lapha akukhulumi ngendawo lapho okungaphezu kokuthathu kwabelwana ngayo okuthile ngaphandle kokuhlala, noma ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, B&B, indlu yokwamukela izivakashi, noma efana naleyo eqashiswa nsuku zonke. Impahla ekhokha izintela ezikhethekile iyindawo eyenzelwe lapho abanikazi bezimpahla ngaphakathi kwayo bevuma ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo ezengeziwe ezingaphezu kwalokho okunikezwa yiMuniisipali. Lokhu kukhokha kwenziwa ngokwengeza enye imali ezinteleni ezikhokhiswa kumakhadi abanikazi bezimpahla kule ndawo. Imisebenzi yezohwebo ifaka: Izikhumulo zezindiza; indawo esetshenziswa uMnyango weGas weMuniisipali; indawo yokulahla udoti; Izakhiwo/Izindawo zokupaka, izakhiwo zemakethe, indawo esetshenziswa uMnyango weMvula weMuniisipali. Ukulethwa kwamakhadi noma izitatimende kunoma ngubani kubhekwa njengokwenziwe kubo bonke. I-Muniisipali kufanele iqoqe izintela ngezinkokhelo ezilinganayo zanyanga zonke ezinyangeni eziyi-12 kanye nanoma yiziphi ezingeziwe. I-Muniisipali ingaqoqe izintela minyaka yonke kubanikazi abanama-akhawunti ezintela angama-50 noma ngaphezulu uma bephakamisile. I-Muniisipali ingakhokha minyaka yonke izintela emhlabeni kaHulumeni kanye nomhlaba wesifunda. I-Muniisipali ingashicilela izinguquko eziningi ohlwini lwezintela ezengeziwe zempahla phakathi nonyaka ngokuhambisana nesigaba 78 se-MPRA. Izintela zizokhokhwa ngokususelwa ohlwini olushintshile lwezintela ezengeziwe zempahla. I-Muniisipali ingase iphazamise isibopho sokukhokha, yehlise noma yehlise inani elikhokhiswa ngamasigaba athile abanikazi, kuye ngaleso sikhathi sendawo. I-Muniisipali ingase futhi yehlise ngenye izintela ezengeziwe inani lendawo ngokuhambisana nesinqumo seBhodi esabelweni sayo sonyaka. Inhloso yale miphumela yokwehliswa kokukhokha ukunciphisa umthwalo kubantu abadala abakhungathekile ngokwezimali futhi bangase bengenayo indlela. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, bonke abantu abadala baphumule isibopho sokukhokha ukuze babasize ekubhekaneni nomthwalo wentela owadalwa yi-MPRA. Ukuqinisekisa Ukunakekelwa Kwezinga Eliphezulu (GEMS Quality Care Assurance) Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu, okubizwa nangokuthi i-GEMS (Good, Effective, and Meaningful Services), kubalulekile emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi kwezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Lezi zinsizakalo zidinga ukuba ziqinisekiswe ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi, zikhuthaze impilo engcono, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. I-GEMS iyinsika ebalulekile yokuhlola nokuphucula izinga lezinsizakalo, iqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezisetshenziswayo zihlala ziphumelela futhi zisebenza kahle. Ukuze siqonde kahle i-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokuqonda izimiso eziyisisekelo ezihambisana nayo. Lezi zimiselo zihlanganisa ukwethembeka, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuhlonipha abathengi. Ukuthembeka kubalulekile ukuze kube nokwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo kanye nabathengi bazo. Ubuchwepheshe, ngakolunye uhlangothi, buhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza kahle. Ukuhlonipha abathengi, okungukuthi, abathengi bazo kanye nezidingo zabo, kubalulekile ekwakheni izinsizakalo ezizokhuthaza ukwaneliseka. I-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo ezikhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinsizakalo kufanele zihlolwe njalo, ziqhathaniswe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi zihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuhlola kwezimali, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle futhi zisebenza ngokufanele.
I-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo ezikhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinsizakalo kufanele zihlolwe njalo, ziqhathaniswe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi zihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuhlola kwezimali, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle futhi zisebenza ngokufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibaluleka ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezizokwazi ukusiza ekuqondeni izidingo zomphakathi kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nalezo zidingo. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukwaziswa nokwazisa, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. I-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze izinsizakalo zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, kufanele kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle.
Lokhu kubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaze impilo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, izinsizakalo kufanele zihlolwe njalo, ziqhathaniswe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi zihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo.
Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ngokuphetha, i-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaze impilo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. I-GEMS, ngakho-ke, iyinsika ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elikhanyayo.
Njengomnikazi wezinsiza nemishini, kufanele wazi ukuthi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokubheka abantu abasebenza nalezi zinto. Izimo ezinjengalezi zivame ukudala ubungozi. Ungasebenzisi imishini yokuvikela. Sebenzisa imishini ngenkathi isahamba. Sebenzisa amathuluzi afanele: ungasebenzisi amathuluzi amancane ukwenza umsebenzi wamathuluzi amakhulu. Gcina amathuluzi enempilo: qinisekisa ukuthi akhanya kahle, alinganisiwe futhi uwacwebezele njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-pins aqinile. Sebenzisa izing glasses zokuvikela uma usebenza. Sebenzisa umask uma kukhona uthuli oluningi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokuphepha iyasebenza kahle. Vimbela izingane ukuthi zingangeneli. Bonke abavakashi endaweni yokusebenza (isitolo) akufanele basondeze endaweni lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Gcina indawo yokusebenza ikhanya kahle. Izinto eziphukile yonke indawo zidalela ubungozi. Beka amathuluzi kude ngemva kokuwasebenzisa - awadingeki lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Vala wonke amathuluzi anogesi. Gqoka izingubo ezifanele. Izingubo ezikhululekile zingabamba emishini. Qinisa umsebenzi wakho: sebenzisa ama-clamps nezinsiza zamathuluzi owasebenzisayo. Kungcono ukubamba ngezandla ngoba manje uzokwazi ukusebenzisa zombili izandla uma usebenza. Ungazami ukwenza amathuluzi akho enze imisebenzi emikhulu kakhulu. Ungazami ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Qinisekisa ukuthi ume kahle njalo. Donsa i-lever - ungacindezeli. Uma kunzima ukudonsa, sebenzisa isikhumba sesandla sakho ukusunduza. Amathuluzi akhanyayo akufanele abhekiswe emzimbeni wakho. Lokhu kungavimbela izingozi uma ithuluzi lishayisa. Xhuma yonke imishini enogesi emhlabeni (umhlaba). Sebenzisa i-plug enezinhlangothi ezintathu kuphela.
Lokhu kungavimbela izingozi uma ithuluzi lishayisa. Xhuma yonke imishini enogesi emhlabeni (umhlaba). Sebenzisa i-plug enezinhlangothi ezintathu kuphela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukukhanya okwanele nokuhamba komoya endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-bench akhanya kahle futhi umoya ongcolile uyakhishwa njalo eshopheni. Ngokufanayo, gcina ithuluzi lokwelashwa elibalulekile liseduze. Phendula noma yiziphi izingozi ezincane ngokushesha ukuze uvimbele ingozi enkulu ekwenzekeni.
Umbiko NgamaMamelodi Sundowns Isingeniso AmaMamelodi Sundowns, eqembu elidumile lemidlalwano yebhola eliseGauteng, eNingizimu Afrika, ligama elaziwayo hhayi kuphela ezweni, kodwa nakwamanye amazwe. Leli qembu, elasungulwa ngo-1965, selidale igama elihle emlandweni wombhoxo, libe nomthelela omkhulu kumphakathi nasemidlalweni jikelele. Ngomlando walo ogcwele impumelelo, amaSundowns abhekwa njengelinye lamakilabhu aphambili e-Afrika. Umgomo Nokuqhuba AmaMamelodi Sundowns ahlale enezinga eliphakeme emqhudelwaneni wePremier Soccer League (PSL), njengoba liphumelele isicoco sePSL ezinyangeni eziningi. Umdlalo wabo omkhulu, owaziwa ngothando ngegama elithi "Masandawana", uphumelele izicoco eziningi, okuhlanganisa neTelkom Knockout, iNedbank Cup, neCAF Champions League. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwabo nokuqina kwabo emdlalweni. Ukuthuthukiswa Kweqembu Ukuze amaSundowns agcine izinga eliphezulu, abaphathi beqembu benze kahle ekukhetheni abadlali, begxila ekwakheni ithimba elinamandla. Abadlali abanjengoBongani Zungu, Percy Tau, noMosa Lebusa baye bathuthukisa umphakathi weqembu, baphinde banike umthelela omuhle emnothweni. Umdlali oncomekayo, uPeter Shalulile, ubukeka njengomfanekiso omuhle, njengoba ehamba phambili ezinhlelweni zokuhlangabezana nezinhloso zeqembu. Imiphumela Nezibalo Ngokubhekisisa ezibalweni, amaMamelodi Sundowns abamba izikhala eziphezulu kwiPSL.
Abadlali abanjengoBongani Zungu, Percy Tau, noMosa Lebusa baye bathuthukisa umphakathi weqembu, baphinde banike umthelela omuhle emnothweni. Umdlali oncomekayo, uPeter Shalulile, ubukeka njengomfanekiso omuhle, njengoba ehamba phambili ezinhlelweni zokuhlangabezana nezinhloso zeqembu. Imiphumela Nezibalo Ngokubhekisisa ezibalweni, amaMamelodi Sundowns abamba izikhala eziphezulu kwiPSL. Njengoba uhlu lwezibalo luyaqhubeka, leli qembu lidlale imidlalo engama-30, linqoba imidlalo engu-20, liphinde libe nezinkanyezi eziyisithupha emidlalweni engama-10. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi bahlala benza kahle, baphinde banikeze umphakathi izizathu zokujabula. Isiko Nempumelelo AmaMamelodi Sundowns akhombisa isiko elihle, lapho abadlali, abaphathi, nabalandeli behlangana ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Uhlanga lwezikhathi ezikhethekile, lapho abadlali behlonishwa khona ngempumelelo yabo, lubalulekile. Ukuhamba phambili kwabo emqhudelwaneni, kunikeza igunya elikhulu kulabo abalandela ibhola, kwazise abanye bahlala bezilungiselela ukujabulisa abalandeli. Ikhono Lokuphatha Abaphathi beqembu, ikakhulukazi uPitso Mosimane, benze imizamo emikhulu yokuthuthukisa amaSundowns. Uqinisekisile ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zisebenza kahle ukuze kugcinwe ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabadlali nokuqanjwa kwezindlela ezintsha zomdlalo. Lokhu kuphumelela kwesikhala sokuphatha kudlale indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni amaSundowns abe qembu elihloniphekile.

Ukujabulisa Abalandeli Abalandeli beMamelodi Sundowns bangabantu abanjalo, behlale beseka iqembu labo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi imiphumela ibukeka kanjani. Ukubamba imicimbi ehlukene, njengezikhumbuzo zomphakathi, kuhlobene nokubaluleka kokuba nemiphakathi eqinile, nokuxhasa abadlali ngesikhathi somsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweqembu nabalandeli. Isiphetho AmaMamelodi Sundowns aqhubeka nokuba ngempumelelo enkulu, ebonisa isibindi, ubuchule, nokuzinikela emqhudelwaneni. Ngokusebenza kanzima, izinqumo ezicacile, nezinsizakalo eziyinkanyezi, leli qembu liqhubeka lishaya izinhlelo eziphakeme zokudlala. Ngaphandle kokubhaliswa kwezikhalazo, amaSundowns ayisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi, ubudlelwano, nokuba neqhaza emiphakathini kungaba namandla amakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile emhlabeni wombhoxo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, amaMamelodi Sundowns azohamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika, futhi sizobona impumelelo yabo eminyakeni ezayo. Hamba uMasandawana!
Izinguquko Zomthetho: Ukubuyekezwa Izinguquko zomthetho ziwumgogodla wokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Njengoba izwe lethu lihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi umthetho ulandele izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uhambisane nezimo zamanje, izidingo zabantu, kanye nezimfuno zomnotho. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzobheka izinguquko ezithile zomthetho, izizathu ezikhona, kanye nemiphumela ethile ezithinta umphakathi. Isizathu Sokuguqulwa Kwezomthetho Izinguquko zomthetho zidingeka ngenxa yokushintsha kwezimo zomphakathi. Njengoba abantu bephila ezimweni ezihlukahlukene, izidingo zabo ziyaqhubeka zishintsha. Isibonelo, izinguquko emthethweni wezokuphepha, ezokuhlala, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komnotho zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izakhamuzi zithola amalungelo azo. Ukungahambisani phakathi kwemithetho esesikhathini eside nezinselelo ezikhona kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bengavikelekile, okungaholela ekuphuleni kwemithetho. Izinguquko Eziyinhloko Okwamanje, izinguquko eziningi zomthetho ziqhakambisa izici ezibalulekile ezifana nokuvikelwa kwamalungelo abantu, ukulwa nobandlululo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho. Umthetho wezokuhlala, ngokwesibonelo, ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezithengekayo, ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ophathelene nokulwa nobandlululo ube nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselelwa kwemithetho yokuvikela amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu.
Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezithengekayo, ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ophathelene nokulwa nobandlululo ube nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselelwa kwemithetho yokuvikela amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu. Izinguquko zikhuthaza ukufakwa kwemithetho eqinile yokuvikela abesifazane, izingane, kanye nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi unelungelo lokuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba. Imiphumela Yokuguqulwa Kwezomthetho Izinguquko zomthetho zinezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi zibuye zibe nezinselelo. Ngokwenyuka kwemithetho ethile, abantu bangase bazizwe bephakanyiswa, kodwa uma imithetho ingahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi, kungaholela ekuphikisaneni. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bezomthetho baqonde kahle izidingo zabantu ukuze baphendule kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko zomthetho zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uyakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kubonakala ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomthetho, izakhamuzi, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze izinguquko zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalezi zikhungo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi imithetho ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Isiphetho Izinguquko zomthetho zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Njengoba izwe lethu lihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi umthetho ulandele izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uhambisane nezimo zamanje. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abaphathi bezomthetho, izakhamuzi, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho iyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi.

Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, nolungile, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi unelungelo lokuphila kahle.
Ngicela/Ngivumela ukuthi ukhokhe inzuzo yami uma siphumelele esicelweni sokuhambisa imali kule akhawunti yasebhange elandelayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukudluliswa kwemali okukhishwe lapha kwenziwa ngohlelo lwekhompyutha olwaziwa ngokuthi i-ACB, futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi akukho ulwazi lokukhokha olunikezwa ebhange lami kodwa ulwazi lokukhokha luzobhalwa embikweni wami wasebhange. (lokhu akusebenzi uma ibhange lingajwayele ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi noma imibiko yasebhange, ngokwesibonelo, i-akhawunti yokonga noma uhlobo olufanayo). Le mvume ingakhanselwa ngami ngokunika isaziso esibhaliwe sezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Qaphela: Ubufakazi obubhaliwe be-akhawunti yasebhange (ngokwesibonelo, umbiko wesikhwama, iphepha elivela kwi-ATM, i-check ekhishwe) kumele kuhlanganiswe. Igama lomnikazi we-akhawunti... Ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olukhululiwe ngenhla luyiqiniso kuleli sikhathi futhi lugcwele ngazo zonke izindlela futhi uMphathiswa we-Inshurensi Yokungasebenzi akabhekiwe nganoma yiziphi ukukhokha okungalungile okungavela ngenxa yolwazi olungaphelele noma olungaqondile olunikezwe ngami.
