Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana (GEMS doctor authorization and communication) Isingeniso Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ibalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zokugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. Umbiko lo uzogxila ekuchazeni lezi zinqubo, izinselelo ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bathola usizo olufanele. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo zikhokhelwa yi-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo zokwelashwa, ezivame ukuhlinzekwa odokotela abaqeqeshiwe. Ukuze umtholampilo uthole ukugunyazwa, kudingeka ukuthi udokotela ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile, efana nezizathu zokwelashwa, izivivinyo ezidingekayo, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nalokho. Izinsizakalo ezidinga ukugunyazwa zifaka phakathi, kodwa azikhawulelwe kulokhu: ukuhlinzwa, izivivinyo ezithile, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi odokotela baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa, ukuze bazi ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwabo nabathengi. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo.
Izinsizakalo ezidinga ukugunyazwa zifaka phakathi, kodwa azikhawulelwe kulokhu: ukuhlinzwa, izivivinyo ezithile, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi odokotela baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa, ukuze bazi ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwabo nabathengi. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS inikeza izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana, okuhlanganisa izingcingo, ama-imeyili, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bangathola ulwazi oludingekayo mayelana nezinsizakalo zabo, izinqubo zokugunyazwa, kanye nezimo ezithile ezithinta impilo yabo. Kubantu abathintekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi bakwazi ukufinyelela odokotela babo kalula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi odokotela babe nekhono lokuxhumana kahle, ukuze bakwazi ukuchaza izinqubo ezithile, izinzuzo, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nezinsizakalo ezithile. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. Izinselelo ezihambisana nokugunyazwa kodokotela Noma kunjalo, kunezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nokugunyazwa kodokotela. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu wukuthi abathengi bavame ukungaqondi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokwelashwa, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo.
Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu wukuthi abathengi bavame ukungaqondi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokwelashwa, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Odokotela nabo bahlushwa izinselelo ezithile, njengokungabi nesikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo yokugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abathengi bangatholi ukwelashwa okudingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe zokugunyazwa. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa ukugunyazwa kodokotela Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugunyazwa kodokotela, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubodokotela ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele kubathengi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izicelo zokugunyazwa zifinyelela ngesikhathi. Okwesibili, i-GEMS ingase ibheke ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile ezivumela abathengi ukuba bafake izicelo zokugunyazwa kalula, kanye nokuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubathengi ukufinyelela odokotela babo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isiphetho Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo.
Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile ezivumela abathengi ukuba bafake izicelo zokugunyazwa kalula, kanye nokuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubathengi ukufinyelela odokotela babo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isiphetho Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS idinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinqubo zisebenza kahle ukuze abathengi bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezi zinqubo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubodokotela, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, i-GEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola usizo olufanele, ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zikhona kubo bonke abathengi.
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okufanele Abasebenzisi Isingeniso Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okufanele abasebenzisi kubalulekile emiphakathini yanamuhla, njengoba kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abahlukahlukene. Lokhu kubaluleka kuvela emibonweni yamakhasimende, abavakashi, kanye nezinhlaka ezisebenzisa izikhungo ezahlukene. Ukuze izikhungo ziphumelele, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izici zikhangisa futhi zihlala zisebenziseka, ukuze abantu bahlale bejabule futhi bephumelelayo. Ukubaluleka Kokwakheka Okusebenziseka Kahle Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo engcono akukhona nje ukwakha imishini, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlonipha izidingo zabantu. Izikhungo ezikhiqiza umuzwa ophumelelayo zikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi nabavakashi, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuhlonipha izidingo ezihlukene zabantu, ikakhulukazi labo abaphila nezinkinga ezithile ezifana nezokuhamba, ukuze kuthuthukiswe umuzwa wabo. Izici Zokwakheka Okusebenziseka Kahle Kunezici eziningi ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe uma kukhulunywa ngokuqhuba ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi. Lezi zici zihlanganisa ukufinyelela kalula, ukwakheka kwezindawo, ukuvumelana, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile. Ukufinyelela kalula kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zokufunda, nezitolo, ukuze abantu abanezinselelo zokuhamba bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni. Ukuklama izikhala ezivulekile, ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kuyasiza ekwakheni umuzwa ophumelelayo nokuthuthukisa ukuhamba kwezakhamuzi.
Lezi zici zihlanganisa ukufinyelela kalula, ukwakheka kwezindawo, ukuvumelana, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile. Ukufinyelela kalula kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zokufunda, nezitolo, ukuze abantu abanezinselelo zokuhamba bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni. Ukuklama izikhala ezivulekile, ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kuyasiza ekwakheni umuzwa ophumelelayo nokuthuthukisa ukuhamba kwezakhamuzi. Ukwakhiwa Kwezikhungo Zokufunda Ezikhungweni zokufunda, ukwakheka okuhlinzekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo ethokomele, enezinhlamvu ezifanele, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukile, kubalulekile ekukhuthazeni abafundi. Ukwakheka okufanele, okufaka izindawo zokuphumula, izindawo zokubhalela, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana, kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi, kungakhathaliseki ngezinga labo, banomuzwa wokwamukelwa. Ukusebenzisana Nabantu Abakhombisa Izidingo Ezikhethekile Kubhalwe kahle futhi ukufaka abakhombisa izidingo ezikhethekile ekuhloleni nasekuthuthukiseni izikhungo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abantu abanezinselelo zokuhamba, abanesidingo sokuxhaswa, kanye nabantu abaphila nezingane. Ukubamba izinhlelo zokuhlola nokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezikhethekile. Izikhungo ezikhipha izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu zizokwandisa umphakathi futhi ziqhubele phambili ukufinyelela kwezinsiza. Ukwamukela Izimvo Zabasebenzisi Ukubaluleka kokwamukela izimvo zabasebenzisi akuphikiswa.
Ukubamba izinhlelo zokuhlola nokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezikhethekile. Izikhungo ezikhipha izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu zizokwandisa umphakathi futhi ziqhubele phambili ukufinyelela kwezinsiza. Ukwamukela Izimvo Zabasebenzisi Ukubaluleka kokwamukela izimvo zabasebenzisi akuphikiswa. Izikhungo ezibheka izidingo zomphakathi zikhuthaza ukuhlanganyela, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni izikhungo ezizophumelela. Ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlanganyela, ukuthola imibono, nokuhlola izimo ezikhona, kuyasiza ekwenzeni izinguquko ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kukhuthaza umqondo wombuso ovulekile, okuholela ekwakheni izikhungo ezihlala zisebenziseka. Izingozi Nezinselelo Nokho, kunezingozi ezithile ezihambisana nokwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi. Ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinsiza ezanele, izinsizakusebenza, nomqondo wokwakha ohlakaniphile. Uma lezi zinto zingekho, izikhungo zingaba nezinkinga zokungasebenzi kahle, okukhathaza abathengi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukwakha izinqubo eziqinile zokugcina izikhungo ziphila njalo, nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezishiwo ngabasebenzisi. Isiphetho Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zisetshenziswa kahle, zihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabavakashi nezisebenzi, kubalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi ejabule.
Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukwakha izinqubo eziqinile zokugcina izikhungo ziphila njalo, nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezishiwo ngabasebenzisi. Isiphetho Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zisetshenziswa kahle, zihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabavakashi nezisebenzi, kubalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi ejabule. Umqondo wokwakha izikhungo ezihlonipha izidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo ethokomele, nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu abanemikhuba ehlukene. Njengoba sithuthukisa izikhungo zethu, kufanele siqhubeke sithuthukisa izindlela zethu zokwakha, ukuze sithole izikhungo ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zethu zanamuhla nezangomuso.
Isingeniso Ezentela, okungukuthi umthetho wemali owukhipha uhulumeni ukuze uxhaso izinhlelo zosasaziso nezenhlalo, iyinsika ebalulekile yezomnotho. Kumphakathi wethu, ezentela idlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithinta zonke izingxenye zokuphila kwabantu, ezokwakha izikhungo zemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nemigudu yokuthuthukisa umnotho. Inhloso yokubhalwa kwalolu cwaningo iwukuhlola ukuthi ezentela zisebenza kanjani, ubuhle bazo, kanye nemiphumela emihle nephuzi engabangelwa ukuhlela kwazo. Ukwakha Uhlaka Lwezentela Ezentela zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi izentela zomhlomulo, ezomnyango, nezemali. Izentela zomhlomulo, njengoba igama lisho, zikhokhelwa abantu abathola umholo, kanti ezomnyango zifaka imalini ethathwa emabhizinisini. indlela yokuhlela ezentela ibandakanya nezentela ezikhokhwayo kumanxusa nezikhali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakheka kwesigaba somphakathi nakho kudlala indima ebalulekile, njengoba abaholi bezinhlangano zezombusazwe belinganisa izidingo zomphakathi ukuze baphakamise izinqumo zokuhlela ezentela. Izizathu Zokuthuthukisa Uhlelo Lwezintela Uhlelo lwezentela lushayelwa ikakhulukazi amandla oHulumeni okuphatha. Ngokusebenzisa izimali ezitholakalayo, uhulumeni uthuthukisa izinhlelo ezibalulekile, ezifana nezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zentuthuko. Uhlelo lwezentela oluhle lungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zemfundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, okukhuthaza ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga labo bophezo. Umphakathi ophilayo, owakhelwe phezu komnotho owaphumelela, ubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuphila.
Ngokusebenzisa izimali ezitholakalayo, uhulumeni uthuthukisa izinhlelo ezibalulekile, ezifana nezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zentuthuko. Uhlelo lwezentela oluhle lungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zemfundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, okukhuthaza ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga labo bophezo. Umphakathi ophilayo, owakhelwe phezu komnotho owaphumelela, ubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuphila. Ubuhle Bezintela Ubuhle bezentela bukhulu, njengoba zikhona ezinye izinzuzo ezifaka ukwakhiwa kokulinganiselwa kwemali, ukwelulwa kokubhuka kwezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokweseka, ezithinta izakhamuzi ezidinga usizo. Ukubhaliswa kwezintela kuhlinzeka ngendlela yokunciphisa ubumpofu, njengoba uhulumeni engathola insiza yokusebenza ukuze enze izinhlelo zokusiza. Ukuxhaswa kwezidingo eziphuthumayo, njengokwelashwa, ukudla, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi, zithuthukiswa ngezimali ezitholwe ngezintela. Ngakho-ke, ububi bokungakhokhi izintela buveza umthelela omubi emphakathini. Izinselelo Zohlelo Lwezintela Noma kube nezinzuzo eziningi, ezentela nazo zibhekene nezinselelo ezehlukene. Ukwehluleka kokuphatha kahle izimali kungaholela ezinkingeni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezifana nokukhwabanisa okwenziwa ngezintela, okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali okukhulu kuhulumeni. Umthelela wezintela eziphezulu emnothweni ungaholela ekutheni amabhizinisi anciphe, okusho ukwehla kwezimali ezitholakalayo kuhulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabazimele kanye nohulumeni kungaholela ekungqubuzaneni okukhulu kancane.
Ukwehluleka kokuphatha kahle izimali kungaholela ezinkingeni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezifana nokukhwabanisa okwenziwa ngezintela, okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali okukhulu kuhulumeni. Umthelela wezintela eziphezulu emnothweni ungaholela ekutheni amabhizinisi anciphe, okusho ukwehla kwezimali ezitholakalayo kuhulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabazimele kanye nohulumeni kungaholela ekungqubuzaneni okukhulu kancane. Ukubheka Phambili Ngokuhlola ubuhlobo phakathi kwezintela kanye nokuphathwa kwemali, kubalulekile ukuthi kuqondwe indlela ezentela ezithinta ngayo umnotho ubumbe impilo yabantu. Kufanele kube nezinyathelo eziqinile ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuhlela izintela. Kuze kube manje, iqiniso elibalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni kumele abambe isibopho sokwandisa ulwazi lwezintela phakathi kwabantu ukuze kuqashelwe ibhizinisi elingasebenzi kahle kanye nezinsizakalo. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa indlela ezentela ezihlose ukuba ngcono, kubalulekile ukuqonda umthelela wazo empilweni nasemnotho. Ukuhlela kahle, ukuxhumana okwanele, kanye nokuqonda izidingo zomphakathi kuyizinto ezisemqoka ekwakheni uhlelo lwezentela oluphumelelayo. Umphakathi wezwe kufanele udlale indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izintela ezisenza sibe nempilo engcono, enobulungiswa, nehlala njalo. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa okukhulu, uhulumeni angase angathembeki ekwenzenjeni ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuze umphakathi jikelele, okuholela ekuhluphekeni okungabangelwa ukungatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ezentela, kukhona inkambo yokuzihlanganisa, isikhumbuzo sokuthanda umphakathi, nokuhlola izindlela ezinjalo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuvimba izinkinga, kuhlehlisa izinqumo ezinzima esikhathini esizayo.
Izidingo zemoto ezisebenzisa uphethiloli uma kuqhathaniswa nefektri yokuhlanganisa zingahlukaniswa ngezindawo ezifana nalabo abasebenza ogwini nalabo abasebenza emakhaya. Izimoto ezakhiwe ngaphambi kuka-1996 - Sebenzisa uphethiloli ongu-93 RON ongashintshwa ngefektri yokuhlanganisa (ULP). Bheka itshathi ekhombisa ukuhambisana noma xoxa nochwepheshe bendawo bezimoto ukuze uthole ukuthi kudingeka yini ukusebenzisa isengezo sokwesekwa ukuvimbela i-VSR uma imoto isebenza ngenjini esheshayo ku-ULP. Izimoto ezakhiwe ngemuva kuka-1996 - Sebenzisa uphethiloli ongahlanganisiwe onenani elifanele le-RON. Bheka ulwazi lwe-Naamsa ezitolo zokulungisa izimoto zendawo ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi. Izimoto ezakhiwe ngaphambi kuka-1996 - Sebenzisa uphethiloli ongahlanganisiwe onenani elifanele le-RON. Bheka ulwazi lwe-NAAMSA ezitolo zokulungisa izimoto zendawo ukuze uthole ukuthi kudingeka yini ukusebenzisa isengezo sokwesekwa ukuvimbela i-VSR uma imoto isebenza ngenjini esheshayo. Qaphela. Ezinye izimoto zingase zidinge ukulungiswa kwenjini. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, bheka ulwazi lwe-NAAMSA ezitolo zokulungisa izimoto zendawo futhi uthole iseluleko. Izimoto ezakhiwe ngemuva kuka-1996 - Sebenzisa uphethiloli ongahlanganisiwe onenani elifanele le-RON. Iziphakamiso mayelana ne-octane component equkethwe kulwazi lwe-Naamsa zingathuthukisa izinjini ezigcinwe kahle esimweni sazo esifanele. Izinjini ezishintshiwe nganoma iyiphi indlela ukusuka esimweni sazo sokuqala zingase zidinge i-octane component ehlukile.

Iziphakamiso mayelana ne-octane component equkethwe kulwazi lwe-Naamsa zingathuthukisa izinjini ezigcinwe kahle esimweni sazo esifanele. Uma injini noma ikhanda lesilinda kushintshiwe, kungase kudingeke ukufaka ivali elihambisana noma elifanele uphethiloli ongahlanganisiwe.
Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imihlahlandlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi abanelungelo lokuthola izinzuzo zokudlulisela ngesikhathi belindele umsebenzi bakwazi ukuzifinyelela. Iqondiswe ngokwezisebenzi ezithile ezikhiqizwayo, hhayi ngokusekelwe endimeni noma osayizi. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusiza ngezindleko abasebenzi abahlangabezana nazo uma bengaseduze nezindawo zabo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Ukubuyiselwa okufanele kunikezwa yiphakheji uma abasebenzi bekhuphuka emsebenzini, okuzothokozisa futhi umnyango. Kuyacaca ukuthi lezi zinzuzo zifana kubasebenzi bazo zonke izinga ngaphakathi komnyango. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikhefu linikezwa kuphela kubasebenzi abaphakathi kwezimo ezivumela ukuthi bakwenze, futhi ukuthi kubasiza ngokungabi khona emsebenzini. Izinhlinzeko zenziwe ngezikhathi zokuhlola, ukuya ezifundweni, ukuhamba ukusuka lapho umuntu ehlala khona, ucwaningo, nezemidlalo, uma umuntu engumrepresentative wabasebenzi ezinkulumweni, uma umuntu eya ukuzobamba iqhaza emkhandlwini yedolobha, nokunye. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusetha izibopho zomnyango uma kudluliswa umsebenzi ukusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye. Umnyango uzokhokhela izindleko zokuhamba, kungakhathaliseki izinga noma isikhundla. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula umhlahlandlela wokubuyisela abasebenzi abahamba ukuze kuzuzwe umnyango, kanye nalabo abasebenzi abakhishwe emsebenzini, noma labo abashonile. Kubalulekile lapha ukuthi kuphela abasebenzi abaphakathi kwezindima ezithile bazosebenzisa lezi zinhlinzeko. Kucacisiwe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izothola izinzuzo ezifanele kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma ubulili. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imihlahlandlela nezinhlinzeko mayelana nokuphela komsebenzi womuntu emnyangweni.
Kubalulekile lapha ukuthi kuphela abasebenzi abaphakathi kwezindima ezithile bazosebenzisa lezi zinhlinzeko. Kucacisiwe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izothola izinzuzo ezifanele kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma ubulili. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imihlahlandlela nezinhlinzeko mayelana nokuphela komsebenzi womuntu emnyangweni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuvula uhlelo oluzoba nolungile nolucacile kubo bonke abasebenzi emnyangweni. Ngokufanayo, noma iyiphi indlela yokucwaswa eyenzekile esikhathini esedlule kufanele isuswe. Ukugxila kugxile kakhulu emsebenzini othile okumele wenziwe ezingeni elithile lohlelo lomsebenzi. Ukukhokha kuzohambisana nemali eyenziwa ngumsebenzi, futhi ukukhokha akwenziwe ngamahora. Ukukhokha kwe-ovetime kulawulwa ukutholakala kwemithombo yezimali. Ukukhokha kwe-ovetime akufanele kudlule ku-30% yemali eyenziwa ngumsebenzi. Lo mthetho ubheka ukuthi umuntu kufanele enze ini mayelana nomsebenzi, bese ucabanga ngesikhundla sabo. Bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi babhale izivumelwano zabo ezihlobene nokuphathwa komsebenzi wabo nezindlela ezizosebenza lapho kuhlolwa ukusebenza kwabo. Lo mthetho unikeza uhlaka oluphatha umsebenzi kanye nezinga lalo ngendlela yokubambisana, futhi usetha okulindelwe kubantu mayelana nomsebenzi wabo. Ekupheleni, umthetho ophatha izinga lomsebenzi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono abantu asetshenziswa ngokuphelele futhi ezinye izinsiza zithinte kahle imiphumela yomsebenzi, okuyimizamo yokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuguqula kuMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bahambisana nohlelo lokuguqula umsebenzi futhi iphinde ibheke ukuthi izinguquko ezivela ezimfundisweni zomthetho ziphathwa kanjani. Iphinde inikeze uhlaka lokuhlola uma kukhona izinguquko futhi ibeke umthetho.
Ekupheleni, umthetho ophatha izinga lomsebenzi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono abantu asetshenziswa ngokuphelele futhi ezinye izinsiza zithinte kahle imiphumela yomsebenzi, okuyimizamo yokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuguqula kuMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bahambisana nohlelo lokuguqula umsebenzi futhi iphinde ibheke ukuthi izinguquko ezivela ezimfundisweni zomthetho ziphathwa kanjani. Iphinde inikeze uhlaka lokuhlola uma kukhona izinguquko futhi ibeke umthetho. Ikhuthaza futhi ikhuthaza ukuvuleka nokucacile, futhi ukuze abasebenzi babambe iqhaza ukuze baqinise ubudlelwano bokwethembana, ukubambisana, nokwethembeka kubaphathi, kanye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinhlelo zabasebenzi ezizoba yisisekelo salolu hlelo. Ukususwa kwezinyathelo zokucwaswa ezihlobene nobuhlanga, ubulili, nezinye izici... Abasebenzi abanokucela ukuhlolwa komsebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa komsebenzi wabo, kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwesimo sabo, futhi kungenzeka futhi ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwabo kungancishiswa. Uma kudingeka ukunciphisa isikhundla somsebenzi, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo yokuvimbela lokho ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile kulowo msebenzi. Izinqubo zokuhola kufanele ziqinisekise ubulungiswa, ukungacwaswa, nokufinyelela kumathuba, kanye nokuba nesigaba esisebenzela umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Zonke izikhala kufanele zivuleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, inkolo, ubuzwe, izinkolelo zezombusazwe, isiko, ubudala, ulimi, ukungasebenzi, isimo somshado, nezinye izimo ezihlukahlukene.
Uma kudingeka ukunciphisa isikhundla somsebenzi, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo yokuvimbela lokho ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile kulowo msebenzi. Izinqubo zokuhola kufanele ziqinisekise ubulungiswa, ukungacwaswa, nokufinyelela kumathuba, kanye nokuba nesigaba esisebenzela umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Zonke izikhala kufanele zivuleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, inkolo, ubuzwe, izinkolelo zezombusazwe, isiko, ubudala, ulimi, ukungasebenzi, isimo somshado, nezinye izimo ezihlukahlukene. Izikhangiso kufanele zicacise kahle ukuthi iSikhungo Sezikhungo Zomphakathi sizibophezele ekungacwasweni emsebenzini, ekuvumelaneni kwabasebenzi, futhi ukuthi izicelo ezivela ezindaweni ezithile zomphakathi ezake zaba nezinselelo zikhuthazwa. Izinga elisetshenzisiwe lapho kukhethwa abasebenzi kufanele libe nolungile futhi lihlobene nezidingo zomsebenzi futhi kufanele lisetshenziswe ngokuqhubekayo ngezikhathi zonke. Inqubo yokuhola izobandakanya wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nalabo abavela ezindaweni eziphansi nezomphakathi, futhi nakuba bamenywa ukuba bafake izicelo zemisebenzi, akufanele bacwaswe futhi kufanele baphathwe ngendlela efanele futhi enhlonipho. Uma umuntu engenayo imfundo edingekayo, iziqu, noma amakhono olimi, noma ufunde ngaphezu kwezidingo zomsebenzi, noma usebenze isikhathi eside, zonke lezi zinto ezingahlangene nomsebenzi akufanele zibe izizathu zokukhetha umuntu ophuma emphakathini owake waba nezinselelo, futhi ngenxa yalokho, amathuba abantu abavela ezindaweni eziphansi akufanele ancishiswe.
Intsha YaseNingizimu Afrika: Umqondo Wokwakha Ikusasa Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lethu. Njengoba sikhula, sithola ithuba lokubona izinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini yethu. Kodwa-ke, le ntsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ub unemployment, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, kanye nezinkinga zokufunda. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sithuthukise izimo zabo. Ngokokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi intsha iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Izinselelo ezibhekene nabo zidinga ukuxhaswa, hhayi kuphela nguhulumeni, kodwa nakubantu abadala. Ukuze sithuthukise intsha, kufanele sibe nezinhlaka ezizokwenza kube lula kubo ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa amakhono, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokusebenza, kanye nokwakha amathuba okuziphilisa. Ngokwesibili, intsha idinga ukugqugquzelwa ukuze ibonakale. Kumele sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibonise amakhono ayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuciko, ezemidlalo, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba bathole amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ubuqotho bokwakha umphakathi obumbene busekelwe ekutheni intsha ibonakale futhi ibonise izifiso zayo. Ngokwesithathu, kufanele sikhulume ngokuqhubekayo ngempilo yengqondo yentsha. Izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zikhula kakhulu, futhi intsha ibhekene nezimo ezinzima. Ukuxhaswa kwezinhlelo zokwelashwa, kanye nezikhungo zokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuze intsha ikwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga zayo.

Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe, kanye nezingane zabo, bathola usizo olufanele, oluphumelelayo nolwakusasa. Lezi zinsizakalo zihlala ziguquguquka, zihlala zizinzile, futhi zisebenza ukuze zifeze izidingo ezahlukahlukene zabantu. Umbiko lo uzobheka izici ezahlukene zezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, kuhlanganiswe nezinga lokuphumelela, izinselelo, nezindlela zokuthuthukisa. Uhlaka Lwezinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ziqala ngezinqubo zokuhlola nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile kumama abakhulelwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, ukuhlola isimo sokukhulelwa, kanye nokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bazi ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokusiza abesifazane abakhulelwe nabagula. Izinsiza Nezinto Eziphumelelayo Izibhedlela zinezinzuzo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuba nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezifana nezibhedlela ezinomoya opholile, abahlengikazi abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nodokotela abanolwazi. Lezi zinsiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bahlala benempilo, futhi lezi zinsizakalo zikwazisa ukuthi ukubeletha kungenzeka kuphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zihlala zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili obusiza ekwehliseni ubunzima bokubeletha. Ukuphumelela Kwezinsizakalo Izibhedlela eziningi zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuphumelela kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha.
Lezi zinsiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bahlala benempilo, futhi lezi zinsizakalo zikwazisa ukuthi ukubeletha kungenzeka kuphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zihlala zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili obusiza ekwehliseni ubunzima bokubeletha. Ukuphumelela Kwezinsizakalo Izibhedlela eziningi zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuphumelela kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha. Lokhu kuboniswa inani elincane labantu abahlala bephila emva kokubeletha, kanye nenani eliphansi labesifazane abathola izinkinga ezigulayo. Izibhedlela ezinkulu zinamathuba amaningi okwenza izifundo ezithuthukisa izinsizakalo, okuvumela ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokwelapha. Izinselelo Ezinqunyelwe Naphezu kokuphumelela, izinsizakalo zokubeletha zibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuntuleka kwemithombo, ukungabi neziguli ezanele ezibhedlela, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthi abesifazane bathole usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsizakalo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo ukuze zihlale zisebenza kahle. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokubeletha, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubahlinzeki bezinsiza ukuze baqhubeke nokuthola ulwazi olusha. Okwesibili, abesifazane kufanele babe nolwazi olunembile ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Okwesithathu, izibhedlela zingasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokwelapha Ukuze izinsizakalo zokubeletha zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukubambisana nezikhungo ezahlukene zokwelapha.
Okwesibili, abesifazane kufanele babe nolwazi olunembile ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Okwesithathu, izibhedlela zingasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokwelapha Ukuze izinsizakalo zokubeletha zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukubambisana nezikhungo ezahlukene zokwelapha. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisana nezinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngempilo yomama, izikhungo zocwaningo, kanye nezikhungo ezixhumanisa izinsiza. Ngokubambisana, izibhedlela zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi ephelele, engcono kakhulu. Isiphetho Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi zidinga ukunakwa okuqhubekayo ukuze zisebenze kahle. Ngenxa yokuphumelela kwezinsizakalo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, abesifazane bathembele ezibhedlela ukuze bathole usizo olufanele. Nokho, izinselelo ezithile zidinga ukuba ziqashelwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezi zinsizakalo. Ukubambisana, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zihlala zisebenza kahle, kube nomphumela omuhle ezinganeni nasemiphakathini.
Umkhandlu wendawo weMatjhabeng kanye nezinkomiti zawo zezakhamuzi ziye zanikela ngemininingwane ebalulekile nezifundo eziyisisekelo le bhukwana elakhiwe ngazo. Umxhumanisi wase-Australia uNkk. Pauline Peel usebenze ngokubambisana nomphakathi nomphakathi uMnu. George Moahloli ophuma kumkhandlu, kanye nomkhulumeli wombuso uMnu. TV Matsepe, iminyaka eyishumi ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezimiso ezingathuthukisa ukuzibandakanya komphakathi ngezikomiti zezakhamuzi. Amalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi uqobo nawo abambe iqhaza ekuqulweni naku ukuthuthukiswa kwaleli bhukwana. Ngesikhathi sokuqala uhlelo olusha lukamasipala ngo-2000, sakhombisa ukuthi lokhu kwakuyisici esibalulekile sokuphatha futhi sikhona ukuze sinikeze incazelo ecacile nephumelelayo yokuzibophezela esisekelweni sezepolitiki, okungukuthi, abantu bazokhulumela. Sabatshela abantu bethu ukuthi ndawonye nohulumeni bendawo, sizoletha ubuhlakani lapho uhlala khona. Embonini yethu yokuhulumeni bendawo, saphakanyiswa ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga ezisemqoka ezifana nokuthuthukiswa okunganele, ukungasebenzi, ukuhamba kancane, kanye nobuphofu. Izinkomiti ezisunguliwe zomkhandlu zidlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Njengemikhakha yomphakathi kanye nezakhamuzi, kumele zixwayise umkhandlu ngezifiso, amakhono, nezinkinga zabantu. Kumele futhi zakhe umgwaqo ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwecouncil nomphakathi abawumelwa. Umthetho wombuso wendawo unikeza ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ezizoba yinxenye ehlanganisa abantu nohlelo lwethu lokuphatha.
Njengemikhakha yomphakathi kanye nezakhamuzi, kumele zixwayise umkhandlu ngezifiso, amakhono, nezinkinga zabantu. Kumele futhi zakhe umgwaqo ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwecouncil nomphakathi abawumelwa. Umthetho wombuso wendawo unikeza ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ezizoba yinxenye ehlanganisa abantu nohlelo lwethu lokuphatha. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekubambeni nasekuthatheni izinqumo ezisemqoka zomkhandlu, njengeHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe, ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali zomkhandlu, kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu. Ngaphandle kwazo, uhlelo lwethu lokuphatha ngokobuhlakani kanye nokuthuthukiswa kukamasipala ngeke lube nomthelela wokubheka abantu. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi seziqhamuke ezindaweni ezingaphezu kuka-80% zezakhamuzi. Lezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi zinekhono elihlukene lokusebenza. Ngokuhlola amazinga okusebenza kwalezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi kanye nomsebenzi wokwakha ubulungiswa phakathi kwalabo abasala, sizokwandisa lokho okutholakalayo kubahlali ukuze sifikise nakakhulu kubantu bethu. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngamasu anembile, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Lezi zinkomiti azikona nje amalungu abasebenzi; zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuxhumana okufanele phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zethu zohulumeni. Isici esibaluleke kakhulu kulokhu kuzodingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zihlangana njalo futhi zisebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe. Le bhukwana ihlinzeka ngamasu anembile, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zezinkantolo uma lezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi zisebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, le bhukwana izokwandisa ekugqugquzeleni ukubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithathwa ngababusi nezomkhandlu. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngababusi kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe lapho besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ngababusi kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuhlinzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe lapho besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Ukuze kugqugquzelwe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ezindabeni zikamasipala. Isixwayiso: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlola izinto ezisemqoka zomkhandlu nendawo yakho uma usebenzisa imibono neziphakamiso ezitholakala kule bhukwana.
Le bhukwana yakhelwe ngababusi kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuhlinzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe lapho besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Ukuze kugqugquzelwe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ezindabeni zikamasipala. Isixwayiso: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlola izinto ezisemqoka zomkhandlu nendawo yakho uma usebenzisa imibono neziphakamiso ezitholakala kule bhukwana. Ezinye zezinto eziphakanyisiwe zingase zidinge ukulungiswa noma ukuguqulwa ukuze zihlangabezane nesimo esithile somkhandlu wakho nendawo yakho. Nansi uhlu lokuhlola lokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe nokuthi yini esivele yenziwe mayelana nezinto ezibalulekile zomthetho okufanele uqonde ukuze wazi ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze njengomuntu osemkhandlwini. Le mithetho nemiyalelo izosiza futhi uqonde izinhlobo zezinto ezizokwenziwa izinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuze zisekele imiphakathi kanye nababusi bazo. Ukuze ukusiza ukuba ulandele lokho okufundile, sebenzisa amabhokisi ukuze umake lapho usuphelile ukufunda. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 - Isahluko 7 Ingxenye 152 - Imisebenzi yokuphatha kwendawo. Isinqumo esithathwe umkhandlu wakho sokusungula uhlelo lwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Ihhovisi lakho lokukhulumela umkhandlu lingakuhlinzeka ngama kopi wonke wemithetho nemiyalelo ephumile. Uma usuthole ikhophi yedokhumenti ngayinye, ungayifaka kule bhukwana. Inhloso yezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuqinisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuphathweni kukamasipala.
Ihhovisi lakho lokukhulumela umkhandlu lingakuhlinzeka ngama kopi wonke wemithetho nemiyalelo ephumile. Uma usuthole ikhophi yedokhumenti ngayinye, ungayifaka kule bhukwana. Inhloso yezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuqinisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuphathweni kukamasipala. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi ziyi ndlela yokukhombisa ukukhathazeka ngezindaba zomphakathi kumabusi wezindawo, ukuze kube nevozhi ezinqumweni, ukuhlela, nasezenzweni ezithathwa ngumbusi noma umkhandlu ezizothinta indawo. Umphakathi wezindawo ungumholi wezinkomiti zezakhamuzi, ngakho-ke ungumuntu obalulekile kule komidi. Umphakathi umela izintshisekelo zendawo futhi unegunya elivela kumkhandlu lokudlala indima ekusekeleni umphakathi wezindawo kule ndawo. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwabahlali bendawo ezinqumweni ezithathwa kumkhandlu, njengoba bengabo abakwazi ukuxhumana nekhansela ngqo noma ngokuqondile njengabamele indawo bendawo abaxhasa iqembu lezepolitiki kumele babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezifana nenqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu, isabelomali sonyaka, imisebenzi yephalamende, nezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile nezinhlelo njengoba zonke lezi zinto zithinta umphakathi ukuze ubone futhi uqale imisebenzi eqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu endaweni ngenkathi usekela umphakathi ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokusebenza komkhandlu, nokubhekana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nezinsalela, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka, ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo njengoba amalungu azi imiphakathi yabo nezidingo zayo.
Umphakathi wezindawo ungumholi wezinkomiti zezakhamuzi, ngakho-ke ungumuntu obalulekile kule komidi. Umphakathi umela izintshisekelo zendawo futhi unegunya elivela kumkhandlu lokudlala indima ekusekeleni umphakathi wezindawo kule ndawo. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwabahlali bendawo ezinqumweni ezithathwa kumkhandlu, njengoba bengabo abakwazi ukuxhumana nekhansela ngqo noma ngokuqondile njengabamele indawo bendawo abaxhasa iqembu lezepolitiki kumele babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezifana nenqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu, isabelomali sonyaka, imisebenzi yephalamende, nezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile nezinhlelo njengoba zonke lezi zinto zithinta umphakathi ukuze ubone futhi uqale imisebenzi eqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu endaweni ngenkathi usekela umphakathi ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokusebenza komkhandlu, nokubhekana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nezinsalela, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka, ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo njengoba amalungu azi imiphakathi yabo nezidingo zayo. Khumbula ukuthi umphakathi wezindawo kumele abheke lokho okulindelwe yindawo yabo kanye nokuthi kulindelwe yinhla yabo yezepolitiki. Lokhu kwenza indima yabo ibaluleke kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda lokhu futhi ucacise indima yomphakathi ukuze ukwazi ukuza nemibono emihle yokukh
Izindlela Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Incazelo Engenhla Ukubeletha kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ukuhlangana komama nezinsana zabo. Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidlala indima enkulu ekunikezeni ukuhlinzeka okufanele nezindlela zokuphepha. Lezi zindlela zingatholakala emabhodleni ahlukene, ezibhedlela eziphakeme, kanye nasemakhaya. Kulesi sikhathi, sizoqhubeka nokuchaza izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokubeletha ezibhedlela, izinyathelo ezibandakanyekile, kanye nezinzuzo zazo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha ziqala kanjani. Umama ofikela esibhedlela ukuze abelethe, uqala ngesikhashana sokuhlola impilo neqhaza labodokotela. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi komama nabahlinzeki bezempilo, ukuze kubonakale ukuthi kudingeka ziphi izinyathelo ezithile. Ngokuvamile, umama udinga ukuhlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi uhlelwe yini kahle, futhi lokho kusemqoka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi impilo yomama nephaya bana iyi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi umama azizwe ephumile njengezinga przicional, ukuze abe nesithakazelo nempilo nomntwana wakhe. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, umama uzodinga ukufaka isikhumbuzo sokubeletha. Lokhu kuvame ukuhamba ngesikhatsi sokuphuma kokuphila, lapho umama ethola izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze akhululeke ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Indlu yesikhumbuzo isetshenziswa ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula kothile ukugibela izinyathelo ezibalulekile. Ikakhulukazi, umama uzokhumbuza ezokuphila njengoba lezi zinyathelo ziphuma khona.
Lokhu kuvame ukuhamba ngesikhatsi sokuphuma kokuphila, lapho umama ethola izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze akhululeke ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Indlu yesikhumbuzo isetshenziswa ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula kothile ukugibela izinyathelo ezibalulekile. Ikakhulukazi, umama uzokhumbuza ezokuphila njengoba lezi zinyathelo ziphuma khona. Ngokuphathelene nezinyathelo ezibandakanyekayo, uma umama esefikile esibhedlela ngemva kokuba isikhumbuzo sikhishwe, Umdalayo uthola izinsiza ezithile ezifana nezinxushunxushu, izinsiza zokuhlinzwa, nemishini ethile yokubona impilo. Umdalayo uzophinde ahlolisise ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, ezakhiweni, nokuxhumana. Kunezindlela ezimbili ezinkulu zokubeletha ezibhedlela: ukubeletha ngemuva kokuphila kwezamathumba, kanye nokubeletha kweziguli ngokuhlinzwa. Ukubeletha ngemuva kokuphila kwezamathumba kuhlanganisa izindlela zokuhlinza ezinjengokukhupha izinsana eziboshwa emakwevini. Lokhu kuyindlela evamile emakhosini hebe kayiphumeleli, kanti ihlinzeka ngemiphumela emihle uma umama enganeliseki. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukukhethwa kokubeletha kweziguli ngokuhlinzwa kuvame ukuba yisinqumo esithathwe ngabeziqu ezininzi, ikakhulukazi uma umama ebambe izinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngemiphumela eminengi ethokozisayo, ikakhulukazi uma umama ezwa ubuhlungu obukhululekile. Isinyathelo sokugcina siza ngemva kokubeletha, lapho umama ehlola ukuthi umntwana wakhe unjani futhi nabantu abamzungezile babe impilo enhle. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umama azigcine ethokozisa ngombono wokusebenza kwalezi zinyathelo. Uma kunezinkinga, kudinga ukuxoxa nezokwelapha abawifune kumgibeli.
Isinyathelo sokugcina siza ngemva kokubeletha, lapho umama ehlola ukuthi umntwana wakhe unjani futhi nabantu abamzungezile babe impilo enhle. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umama azigcine ethokozisa ngombono wokusebenza kwalezi zinyathelo. Uma kunezinkinga, kudinga ukuxoxa nezokwelapha abawifune kumgibeli. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zithuthukile kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ofanele oqondiswe ekwenzeni izinqubo zibe ngcono, ukugwema inselelo, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomama nomntwana. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubeletha, umama kumele ahlale ethola usizo nezinsiza ezigcwele ukuze bandakanyeke. Lokhu kudinga ukuzijwayeza nemikhuba elungile. Ngakho, emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zizodwa, ziletha umuzwa omuhle, futhi zenze kube nokubekezela kwalezi zinyathelo eziyisisekelo ezidalwa njengomfazi ophakeme konogada. Ngalesi sikhathi, umama ushayela imoto ethokozisa ubudlelwane phakathi kokuphila nezinsana zakhe, nokwenza kube lula ngemfanelo engcono. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene ezikhetha kanjani, kepha iziguli zidinga ukunika umthetho kweminye imikhuba. Ngaleyo ndlela, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela yokubeletha ukuze uthole izinzuzo ezithile ezivela kuyo, ukuhamba phambili ngemifezelo yephakademiki kulezi zinyathelo. Uma umama noMbala behamba phambili kwezehlakalo, bahlala besaba impumelelo, ukuthuthukisa izinkinga zomphakathi nezingane zizo zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukufezwa kwimithetho ethile, futhi ukwenza ukuthi sithole ulwazi oluqhubekayo ukuze sibe nempilo enhle. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinqubo zakha indima ebalulekile ekuphuculeni impilo yamasiko nezinsizakalo zomama kanye nezinsana.
Imfashini Nobuhle: Izinyathelo Zokwakha Isitayela Esihle Isingeniso Imfashini nobuhle kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Zihlanganisa indlela esiziphatha ngayo, indlela esibukeka ngayo, kanye nezinto esizikhethayo ukuze sikhombise ubuhle bethu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile ezizosisiza ukuba sakhe isitayela esihle, esihambisana nezidingo zethu, futhi esikhombisa ubuntu bethu. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Isitayela Sakho Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi isitayela sakho siwubani. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ucabangele izinto ezifana nezinto ozithandayo, imibala ethokozisayo, nezinto ezikwenza uzizwe kahle. Thola izithombe ezikukhombisa kahle, noma ubuke izincwadi zemfashini ukuze uthole ugqozi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha izingubo ezizokwenza uzizwe uthokozile. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Izingubo Ngemva kokuba uqonde isitayela sakho, isikhathi sokukhetha izingubo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukhetha izingubo ezihambisana nezimo zomzimba wakho. Uma unomzimba omncane, ungakhetha izingubo ezikhululekile, kanti uma unomzimba omkhulu, ungakhetha izingubo ezihlanganisa kahle umzimba. Ungakhohlwa ukufaka imibala ehlukahlukene, kodwa qiniseka ukuthi imibala oyikhethayo ihambisana. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlanganisa Izingubo Ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izingubo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye ezihambelana kahle. Isibonelo, uma ugqoke ijezi elikhulu, ungakhetha amabhulukwe amancane ukuze udale ibhalansi. Futhi, ungakhetha izesekeli ezifana nezikhwama, amabhande, noma izicathulo ezihambisana nezimpahla zakho.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye ezihambelana kahle. Isibonelo, uma ugqoke ijezi elikhulu, ungakhetha amabhulukwe amancane ukuze udale ibhalansi. Futhi, ungakhetha izesekeli ezifana nezikhwama, amabhande, noma izicathulo ezihambisana nezimpahla zakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukunakekela Ubuqotho Bakho Ubuqotho bethu buwubuhle obukhulu. Ukuze ugcine ubuhle bakho, kubalulekile ukunakekela isikhumba sakho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukugeza, ukusebenzisa ama-moisturizers, kanye nokusebenzisa izithako ezithile ezithuthukisa isikhumba. Futhi, ungakhetha ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo yemvelo, ngoba imikhiqizo enezithako zemvelo ivame ukuba nezinzuzo eziningi. Isinyathelo 5: Ukusebenzisa Izinwele Izinwele zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi uzenza kahle, futhi ungakhetha isitayela esihambisana nezimo zakho. Uma ungenayo isikhathi sokwenza izinwele, ungakhetha izixazululo ezilula ezifana nezikhwama noma ama-braids. Futhi, ungakhetha imikhiqizo yokunakekela izinwele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangayo. Isinyathelo 6: Ukugqoka Ngokufanele Ukugqoka ngendlela efanele kubalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungagqoki kakhulu noma kancane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde izimo ezahlukene, njengezikhathi zomsebenzi, imicimbi, noma amaholide. Futhi, ungakhetha izingubo ezihambisana nezimo zomoya, ukuze uzizwe ukhululekile. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuzithokozisa Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuzithokozisa. Imfashini nobuhle akufanele kube umthwalo, kodwa kufanele kube yindlela yokuziveza. Zama izinto ezintsha, udlale ngemibala, futhi ungazithokozisi uma ungathandi okuthile.
Isinyathelo 7: Ukuzithokozisa Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuzithokozisa. Imfashini nobuhle akufanele kube umthwalo, kodwa kufanele kube yindlela yokuziveza. Zama izinto ezintsha, udlale ngemibala, futhi ungazithokozisi uma ungathandi okuthile. Ukuzithokozisa kuzokwenza ube nekhono lokwakha isitayela esihamba phambili. Isiphetho Imfashini nobuhle kuyindlela yokuziveza, futhi kufanele kube yinto ethokozisayo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha isitayela esihle, esihambisana nezidingo zakho, futhi esikhombisa ubuhle bakho. Khumbula, ubuhle bukhona ngaphakathi, futhi imfashini iyindlela yokukubonisa. Qhubeka uzithokozise, futhi ungavumeli imfashini ikuphazamise. Ubuqotho bakho bukhulu, futhi kufanele bukhanye.
Ukukhala kokukhuluma: "Umhlabathi uyifa labantu futhi bonke abantu abathokozile benhlangano: umhlaba ungowethu. Umhlabathi uyindawo yokukhula zonke izinhlobo zokudla futhi udala umsebenzi wezolimo. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakufaka esikhundleni. Ngakho, thina njengabantu sinezibopho zokugcina leli th Treasure lethu ngokukhuthaza njalo, silisebenzise ngendlela efanele, ukuze sakhe umhlaba onempilo ngoba umhlaba onempilo ungakha kuphela ezimpahleni zomhlabathi eziphilayo." - JC Ross. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakufaka esikhundleni. Ngaphakathi kwayo, akukho okushintshayo. Konke okwenzeka, njengokuphuma komhlabathi, kubangele umhlabathi ukuba wakhiwe ezitokisini. Nokho, kufanele sihlukanise phakathi kokushintsha kwemvelo nokushintsha okwenziwa abantu. Ukwakhiwa komhlabathi kwemvelo kuthatha izinkulungwane zeminyaka, kodwa umuntu angawuchitha konke lokhu ngosuku olulodwa uma engasebenzisi umhlabathi ngendlela efanele futhi ezolimo ngendlela engahambisani nezimiso zokulima eziqhubekayo. Ukuphatha kahle ukuhamba komhlabathi kuzuza umlimi kanye nabantu bonke emhlabeni - kusiza umnikazi ukugcina umhlabathi nomswakama (amanzi) ngaphakathi komhlabathi, kusiza abanye ukuvimbela imifula ukuthi ingawashiyi impahla yabo, kuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi emifula acacile futhi kuqinisekisa umhlaba emhlabeni jikelele. Ukulahleka komhlabathi nokukhiqiza kwawo. Ukulahleka kwamanzi agijimayo angasetshenziswa. Ukuwohloka kwezindawo zokulima nomhlabathi ongakhiqizi ukudla. Izikhukhula (zamanzi amaningi) kanye nezomiso ezinzima. Ukwehla kwenani lemakethe yomhlaba. Ukwehla kwemikhawulo yokwenza inzuzo kwezolimo.
Izikhukhula (zamanzi amaningi) kanye nezomiso ezinzima. Ukwehla kwenani lemakethe yomhlaba. Ukwehla kwemikhawulo yokwenza inzuzo kwezolimo. Izindawo zokulima azisakhiqizi, zishiywe. Izitshalo ezikhula kahle. Kukhona izinto ezintathu eziyinhloko ezibangela ukuhamba komhlabathi: amanzi, umoya, kanye neqhwa. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sibhekene kakhulu nokuhamba kwamanzi, bese sihamba sihlole ukuhamba komoya. Ukuhamba kwamanzi kwenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuhamba kwamanzi phezulu nokwakhiwa kwemifula. Ngokuvamile, umhlabathi lapho kuzolima khona ulungiselelwe kahle, uyakhululwa, uyathambile, uyazinzile. Okwamanje, sisebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi ukulima okuncane - umhlabathi awusulungiswanga ngendlela evamile ukuvimbela ukulahleka komhlabathi ophakeme. Isikhathi sokulima siphinde sibe yisikhathi sezikhukhula ezinzima. Lapho kuwa imvula enkulu kulomhlabathi olulungiselelwe, umhlabathi uvame ukujula, kodwa kuvame ukuba khona amakhompiyutha amancane omhlabathi azohamba namanzi. Ngemuva kwemvula yokuqala, amanzi amaningi aqala ukuhamba futhi agijime lapho kukhona ukwehla, ethwele umhlabathi nezinye izinto. Lokhu kungaqhubeka isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuba kubonakale kalula. Ekugcineni, umlimi uzobona ukuthi izinkulungwane zamathani omhlabathi zilahlekile ngonyaka. Ngokuvamile izindawo zokulima azihambisani, ezinye ziphakeme, ezinye zisezingeni eliphansi, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Amanzi avame ukuhamba ngaphansi kwezindawo eziphakeme, akha imifula emincane yokukhula. Lapho ukuhamba kwenzeka endaweni enokwehla, lezi zimpophoma zixubana ukuze zakhe imifula engavezwa ngamagatsha ezihlahla - bese kwakhiwa imifula emikhulu.
Ngokuvamile izindawo zokulima azihambisani, ezinye ziphakeme, ezinye zisezingeni eliphansi, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Amanzi avame ukuhamba ngaphansi kwezindawo eziphakeme, akha imifula emincane yokukhula. Lapho ukuhamba kwenzeka endaweni enokwehla, lezi zimpophoma zixubana ukuze zakhe imifula engavezwa ngamagatsha ezihlahla - bese kwakhiwa imifula emikhulu. Lapho amanzi eqala ukuhamba emifula ethile, amandla ale mfula ayanda futhi ukuhamba nakho kukhula kakhulu. Lapho ukuhamba okufana nezithupha kufika endaweni lapho imifula eyakhiwe ingasapholisa, kufika ezingeni lokuhamba okufana nezithupha. Lokhu kukhuphuka okusheshayo kwemifula kungalimaza izindawo ezinkulu zomhlaba futhi kuvimbe ukuqhubeka kokulima kulezo zindawo. Izizukulwane zethu ezizayo zinethemba lokuthi sizogcina umhlabathi ukuze bakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ngokuphatha umhlabathi kahle, singaqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uzosasebenza kusasa nakusasa.
Ukwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukuthenga sekuphenduke umkhuba obalulekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba izimpilo zethu ziba zisheshayo, izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu ziyaqhubeka nokwanda, zifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni indlela esithenga ngayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izizathu ezibangela lokhu kukhula, izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezinyathelo zokuthi sikwazi ukuthola okuhle kakhulu kulezi zindawo. Izizathu Zokwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Isizathu sokuqala sokwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu sitholakala ekukhuleni komnotho. Njengoba imakethe yama-ejensi ibonisa ukukhula, abantu banemali eningi yokuthenga. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukugcina abasebenzisi bazo behleli behlelekile, behlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi ngaphakathi kwebhizinisi elilodwa. Okwesibili, izifiso zabathengi ziye zashintsha. Abantu baphakathi kwezimo ezisheshayo, futhi bayakufuna ukuhamba nge-‘one-stop shop’ — indawo lapho bengathola khona konke abakudingayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudla, izingubo, izinto zokubhala, nezinsiza zansuku zonke. Izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zinikeza lezi zinsizakalo, ngaleyo ndlela zikhulisa ukuthengiswa kwazo. Izinzuzo Zokuthenga Ezindaweni Ezinkulu Izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zikhulisa umbono wabathengi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abathengi bangakhetha izinto eziningi, beqhathanisa amanani futhi benze izinqumo ezicacile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ethengiswa ngamanani aphansi, okuyinto ephumelela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila.
Okokuqala, zikhulisa umbono wabathengi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abathengi bangakhetha izinto eziningi, beqhathanisa amanani futhi benze izinqumo ezicacile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ethengiswa ngamanani aphansi, okuyinto ephumelela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila. Okwesibili, izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zivame ukuhlinzeka ngezaphulelo ezithile. Lokhu kuvumela abathengi ukuthi bathole izimpahla ezinhle ngamanani aphansi. Izitolo ezinzima zihlala zikhanga abathengi ngama-promotions, okuyinto edala umuzwa omuhle wokuthi abathengi benza okungcono uma bethenga. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nokwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Naphezu kwezinzuzo, kukhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nokwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuncipha kwemakethe yama-smes (small and medium enterprises). Njengoba izindawo ezinkulu ziqhuba, izitolo ezincane ziyaqhamuka, ziphumelele. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bephuma emisebenzini. Okwesibili, izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zingaphazamisa imvelo. Ukwakha izitolo ezinkulu kudinga indawo enkulu, futhi lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemvelo okuhlobene nezilwane nezitshalo. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu, njengoba umphakathi kufanele uqaphele imiphumela yezenzo zawo. Izinyathelo Zokusebenzisa Ngempumelelo Izindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Ukuze sithole okuhle kakhulu ezindaweni zokuthenga ezinkulu, kunezinyathelo ezithile okufanele ziqhutshelwe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi babheke kahle izintengo. Ukuqhathanisa amanani ezitolo ezahlukene kungasiza ukuthola izaphulelo ezinhle. Okwesibili, abathengi kufanele bahlale behlola izikhangiso nemikhankaso yokuthengisa.
Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi babheke kahle izintengo. Ukuqhathanisa amanani ezitolo ezahlukene kungasiza ukuthola izaphulelo ezinhle. Okwesibili, abathengi kufanele bahlale behlola izikhangiso nemikhankaso yokuthengisa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde ukuthi yiziphi izitolo ezibeka izaphulelo ezinhle, futhi bagweme ukuhamba ezitolo ezithengisa ngamanani aphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi kufanele basebenzise izinhlelo zokunxenxa. Izinhlelo zokunxenxa ziyindlela enhle yokuthola izinzuzo ezengeziwe, njengokuthola ezinye iziphakamiso noma amanani aphansi, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa omuhle wokuthenga. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu kudala izinketho eziningi kubathengi, kodwa kudinga ukuqashelwa izinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuthenga ngokucophelela. Imiphumela yokuthenga ezindaweni ezinkulu ingathinta kakhulu impilo yempilo yethu, ngakho-ke kufanele sibe nokuqonda okuhle nokuqaphela indlela esithenga ngayo. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo eziningi ezivela kulokhu kukhula, siphephe nemiphumela emibi.
Umkhiqizo kufanele uncike emakethe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uthole ukuthi abathengi bafuna ini (izidingo), bese ukhiqiza (uhlinzeka) lowo mkhiqizo ukuze uthengise ukuze uthole inzuzo. Uma intengo ikhula, abathengi bazothenga kancane, kodwa uma intengo yehlile, bazothenga kakhulu noma izinhlobo ezahlukene zemikhiqizo. Thola izidingo nezintandokazi zabathengi ngokwenza ucwaningo lwemakethe. Ikhwalithi ibaluleke kakhulu. Kufanele ibe mnandi futhi ibukeke kahle! Intengo ibalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ube nenqwaba yokuthengisa. Ukuhlinzeka kubalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ngithole njalo futhi ngesikhathi. Thola ukuthi yiziphi zalezi zimpahla ezifanele ukukhiqiza. Hlela ukukhiqizwa komkhiqizo. Phanda isivuno bese uyivuna uma isilungele ukuvuna. Khetha umgudu wokumaketha osebenza kahle kakhulu futhi lapho ungathola khona inzuzo eningi. Uchungechunge lokuthengisa lunezinto ezihambayo ezithatha umkhiqizo usuka kumlimi uye kumthengi. Ungazuza ngokwengeza inani kumikhiqizo ukuze wandise intshisekelo yakho ngokubandakanya ukuwashwa, ukupakisha, ukugcina, ukucubungula, nokuhweba. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi imbewu, umanyolo, ama-pesticides, amathuluzi, imishini, uphethiloli, umsebenzi, njll. Izindleko zokuhweba zifaka phakathi ukuthuthwa, ukukhangisa, nokugcina. Izindleko zokupakisha zifaka phakathi ukwehlukanisa, izinto zokupakisha, umsebenzi, ukugcina, umshwalense, njll. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi izinto, ukuthuthwa, ukupakisha, ukuhlanganisa, umsebenzi, ugesi, njll. Ukuze unciphise izindleko emugqeni wokuthengisa, ungasebenzisa umgudu omfushane ngokuthengisa ngqo kumthengi.
Izindleko zokupakisha zifaka phakathi ukwehlukanisa, izinto zokupakisha, umsebenzi, ukugcina, umshwalense, njll. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi izinto, ukuthuthwa, ukupakisha, ukuhlanganisa, umsebenzi, ugesi, njll. Ukuze unciphise izindleko emugqeni wokuthengisa, ungasebenzisa umgudu omfushane ngokuthengisa ngqo kumthengi. Ukwengeza inani ngokupakisha nokugcina izintengo ukuze zenze zibe nentshisekelo kukhiqiza imali eningi. Ukwengeza inani ngokucubungula kukhuphula inani lomkhiqizo ngamunye futhi kukhuphula imali engenayo... Abalimi bathengisa imikhiqizo ngqo kubathengi. Abalimi bathengisa kubathengi noma abantu abathenga ukuze bathengise. Ukuthengiswa kwenziwa ngababambiqhaza bemakethe abathengisa kumlimi futhi bathola ikhomishini. Ikhwalithi, ukupakisha, nokubukeka kubalulekile kakhulu, futhi umkhiqizo kufanele uhambisane nezindinganiso zokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi ezamukelekayo nezindinganiso zokupakisha. Izikhungo ezivalwe zokukhiqiza izilwane zinikeza umsebenzi wokuthengisa kubalimi. Umlandeli uthengisa ngqo kumhwebi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokwakha. Ikhwalithi, intengo, nokulethwa kubalulekile kakhulu. Inhlangano yababalimi ithengisa isivuno ngokuhlanganyela emakethe esemthethweni. Urelationship phakathi kwezindleko nentengo = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa.

Isithombe 4: Ubungozi obukhulu buqhamuka ezilwaneni ezilimazayo emapulazini. Uma lezi zilwane ziningi kakhulu, ukukhiqiza izitshalo kungase kungabi nenzuzo. Kukhona izilwane ezilandelayo ezilimini ezingathi zikhathaza - eziningi azinabungozi ezitsholeni. Izilwane ezibangela ubungozi yilezo ezivame ukudla ngempela izitshalo ezikhulayo, izimpande, noma ukudla okukhulayo. Ukuphatha izilwane ezilimazayo kuhilela ukusebenzisa ama-pesticides (imikhiqizo emitholakala ngemithi ebulala izilwane ezilimazayo), ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi esifanele, kanye nenani elifanele le-pesticide - ikakhulukazi ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ethile eqondile ezilwaneni ezithile. Kukhona i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ebulala zonke izilwane ezilimazayo ezidla izitshalo. Uma usebenzisa le pesticide, uzothola imiphumela emihle. Kufanele uhlanganise izindlela ezahlukene ukuze ulawule izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Le nhlanganisela izosiza ukuvimbela ukwanda kwezilwane ezithile ezivame ukubangela ubungozi ezitsholeni zakho. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezilimazayo ezidla izitshalo, njengokuthi: ama-cutworms, ama-beetles anemibala, nezinye. Lezi zilwane zinciphisa inani lezitshalo ezikhulayo - uma zingaphathwa kahle, kuzodingeka ukuphinda zifakwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi kemikhono kufanele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kulawulwe izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha lezi zinkinga akubizi kakhulu kodwa kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ukuvimbela ukuthi zidalule ubungozi ezikhathini zokuqala zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukulima ebusika kuzophinde kusize ukubulala izilwane eziningi ngoba ebusika zihlala ezinsalela zezinto ezishiwo ezisemathafeni.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi kemikhono kufanele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kulawulwe izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha lezi zinkinga akubizi kakhulu kodwa kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ukuvimbela ukuthi zidalule ubungozi ezikhathini zokuqala zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukulima ebusika kuzophinde kusize ukubulala izilwane eziningi ngoba ebusika zihlala ezinsalela zezinto ezishiwo ezisemathafeni. Uma zihlala ngaphandle kwezitshalo eziphilayo izinsuku ezingama-35, izinkinga eziningi ezidalwa lezi zilwane zizokwenyuka. Imbewu ezizofakwa ingaphathwa ngama-pesticides noma i-pesticide ingafakwa emhlabathini lapho kufakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokubeka i-bait emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Umhlabathi ungaphinde uphuziswe nge-pesticide efanele. I-corn earworm (astylus atromaculatus), i-cutworm (agrotis segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ifile (protostrophus sulcatifrons), kanye nama-harpalus beetles angabangela ubungozi obukhulu ezitsholeni, futhi inani lezitshalo ezinhle lingancipha ngaphandle kokuba nenzuzo. I-African bollworm (helicoverpa armigera) iyalimaza ikhanda lesitshalo futhi ingadala ukuvuleka kwe-fungus rhizopus microsporus. Izilwane ezinjenge-nysius nataensis zingaphinde zilimaze izitshalo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-pesticides abhalisiwe ukuze abulale izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezilimazayo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezibangela ubungozi. Ngaleso sikhathi uzokwazi ukukhetha i-pesticide efanele - qaphela ukufaka i-pesticide ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nasemazingeni afanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo kanye nosayizi wesitshalo.
Kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezibangela ubungozi. Ngaleso sikhathi uzokwazi ukukhetha i-pesticide efanele - qaphela ukufaka i-pesticide ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nasemazingeni afanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo kanye nosayizi wesitshalo. Ukufaka ama-pesticides kungavimbela ukuncipha kokukhiqiza, kodwa umbulali kufanele abe nekhono ngoba kuhilela izindleko. Kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle uma izilwane ezilimazayo zibangela ubungozi obukhulu, noma kungase kubize kakhulu ngaphandle kokusiza ngoba izindleko zizodlula inzuzo. Akukhuthazeki ukuphuzisa izitshalo uma izilwane ezilimazayo zingakabi nengozi enkulu. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi kukhona abaphangi bemvelo abawadla ezinye izilwane ezilimazayo. Uma uphuzisa kakhulu, lezi zilwane ezidla izilwane ezilimazayo zizobulawa, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi izilwane ezilimazayo zizokwazi ukujwayela i-pesticide uma ifakwa kaningi futhi ngeke zife. Imikhiqizo emitholakala ngemithi nayo iyingozi futhi iyalimaza umhlabathi, ngakho kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela uma kudingeka kakhulu. Ukulima ngaphambi kokufaka kusiza ukuvimbela ubungozi bezilwane ezilimazayo. Nokho, inani lezilwane ezilimazayo kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zikwazi ukuphathwa ngempumelelo. Ngokuvamile, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokuvikela ubungozi bezilwane ezilimazayo - sebenzisa indlela ehambisana nohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo ngesikhathi esifanele sesitshalo esithile. Ukuphatha izilwane ezilimazayo kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezitshalo ngoba kuzokhombisa ukuthi kuzoba nenzuzo ekulimaleni nasekukhiqizeni noma cha.
Nokho, inani lezilwane ezilimazayo kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zikwazi ukuphathwa ngempumelelo. Ngokuvamile, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokuvikela ubungozi bezilwane ezilimazayo - sebenzisa indlela ehambisana nohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo ngesikhathi esifanele sesitshalo esithile. Ukuphatha izilwane ezilimazayo kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezitshalo ngoba kuzokhombisa ukuthi kuzoba nenzuzo ekulimaleni nasekukhiqizeni noma cha. Izifo zezihlahla zinciphisa inani kanye nekhwalithi yokukhiqiza futhi zingabangela ubungozi empilweni yezimpahla nasemphakathini uma zidliwa. Izifo zezihlahla zidalwa ikakhulukazi ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus. Lezi zingalimaza zonke izingxenye zesitshalo - izimpande, iziqu, amahlamvu, amafulegi, kanye nezimbewu ezidliwayo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezifo zidinga izimo ezahlukene ukuze zikhule. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma sithintana nezimo zezulu kanye nendawo, uma kukhona isitshalo esifanele futhi isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingabhekwa njengesisekelo sokusabalala kwesifo. Uma enye ingekho, isifo ngeke sikhule futhi sithinte. Isifo esithile esingase sibe khona endaweni ethile kulonyaka singase singabi khona kule ndawo ngonyaka ozayo uma imvelo yendawo nezimo zezulu zihluka kulonyaka. Ngenxa yokulibaziseka okukhulu ekuqaleni kokufaka izitshalo, ngokuvamile akuvumelekile ukuphatha lezi zifo ngama-chemicals ngoba kubiza kakhulu. Ezinye izifo zihlala zikhona kodwa azikhuli ngoba azithintani nesitshalo noma nezimo zezulu. Izifo ziphathwa ngokuqinisekisa nokuvikela. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izifo ngokuvikela.
Ezinye izifo zihlala zikhona kodwa azikhuli ngoba azithintani nesitshalo noma nezimo zezulu. Izifo ziphathwa ngokuqinisekisa nokuvikela. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izifo ngokuvikela. Kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhuliswe ukuze zibe nokumelana nezinye izifo. Lokhu kumelana kwesitshalo kubhekisela ekulweni nesifo esithile; akusho ukuthi ezinye izifo azikwazi ukulimaza lelo sitshalo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yisiphi isifo esivame ukubangela ubungozi endaweni yakho bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungakwazi ukumelana nalolo sifo. Ukuphatha ngama-chemicals kusho ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ukuze ubulale izifo ezithile ze-fungal kanye ne-bacterial ezimweni ezithile. Kufanele ucabange kahle izindleko zokuthenga i-pesticide - kungase kube kuhle ukufuna iseluleko kumeluleki wezokulima mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwemithi ethile. Ukulima umhlabathi kungaba yinto ebalulekile uma uzama ukuphatha izifo - ezinye izifo zihlala ezinsaleni ezishiwo ezisemathafeni, ngakho kufanele wazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona bese ukhetha indlela efanele yokulima umhlabathi. Ukushintsha izinhlobo zezihlahla kusho ukuhlinzeka isikhathi sokuthi izinsalela ezishiwo ezisemathafeni zife. Kubalulekile ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezithanda yiziphi izitshalo bese ubhekana nalolo daba ngokushintsha izinhlobo zezitshalo ozifakayo. Isikhathi sokufaka sithinta futhi ukukhula kwesifo esithile - ukufaka ngaphambi kwesikhathi noma emva kwesikhathi kungavimbela isifo esithile ekukhuleni nasekubangeleni ubungozi. Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: Q&A Umbuzo: Yini imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi? Imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibandakanya izenzakalo ezihlosiwe ukwandisa ulwazi, ukuqwashisa, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Lezi zenzakalo zingaba yizinkundla zokuxhumana, imihlangano, noma imicimbi yokwenziwa kwesimo esithile, ezinjengokugqugquzela impilo engcono noma ukuphucula izinga lempilo emphakathini. Umbuzo: Kungani imicimbi yezempilo ibalulekile? Imicimbi yezempilo ibaluleke kakhulu ngoba ikhulisa ulwazi nokwaziswa kwabantu ngezinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo, njengezifo ezithathelwana, izindlela zokuphila ezinhle, nezinsiza ezitholakala ezindaweni zabo. Futhi, imicimbi enjalo inika abantu ithuba lokuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokuxhumana nabanye, okwakha umphakathi onempilo. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izibonelo zemicimbi yezempilo? Izibonelo zemicimbi yezempilo zifaka phakathi ama-workshops wempilo, izinsuku zempilo, imihlangano yokukhuluma ngezikhalazo ezithinta impilo, kanye nemikhankaso yokugoma. Ngokwesibonelo, izinsuku zempilo zingahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-screening nezinsiza zempilo mahhala, kanti imikhankaso yokugoma ingagqugquzela abantu ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zibhukha izigulane zazo. Umbuzo: Abantu bangayithola kanjani imicimbi yezempilo? Imicimbi yezempilo ivamise ukukhushulwa emiphakathini ngezindlela ezahlukene, njengezikhangiso ezisemaphandleni, izikhangiso eziphepheni, nakuma-social media.
Ngokwesibonelo, izinsuku zempilo zingahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-screening nezinsiza zempilo mahhala, kanti imikhankaso yokugoma ingagqugquzela abantu ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zibhukha izigulane zazo. Umbuzo: Abantu bangayithola kanjani imicimbi yezempilo? Imicimbi yezempilo ivamise ukukhushulwa emiphakathini ngezindlela ezahlukene, njengezikhangiso ezisemaphandleni, izikhangiso eziphepheni, nakuma-social media. Abantu bangathola ulwazi ngemihlangano ethile ngokuvakashela ezindaweni zomphakathi, njengezikhungo zempilo, izikole, noma izikhungo zokuxhumana, lapho imicimbi ivame ukwenzeka. Umbuzo: Yimaphi amasu angasetshenziswa ukuze imicimbi ibe nempumelelo? Ukuze imicimbi yezempilo ibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu babezobandakanyeka, nokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emkhankasweni. Lokhu kungafaka ukufaka izinhlelo zokukhuthaza ukuxhumana, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imicimbi iyathinta futhi iyasiza abantu. Umbuzo: Yini edinga ukunakwa ekuxhumaneni ngezempilo? Ekuxhumaneni ngezempilo, kubalulekile ukugwema amagama angathandeki noma angacacile. Lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni noma ekuhlanekeleni kwabantu. Ukukhuluma ngempilo kufanele kube kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile, kanye nokuhlola amaqhinga athinta izithakazelo zomphakathi. Umbuzo: Imicimbi yezempilo iyasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo?
Lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni noma ekuhlanekeleni kwabantu. Ukukhuluma ngempilo kufanele kube kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile, kanye nokuhlola amaqhinga athinta izithakazelo zomphakathi. Umbuzo: Imicimbi yezempilo iyasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo? Imicimbi yezempilo iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo ngokukhulisa ulwazi, ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, nokwandisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zempilo. Lapho abantu bejolise emicimbini, baqonda kangcono izindlela zokuzivikela ezindaweni zabo, baphinde bahloniphe izinqumo ezinzima mayelana nezempilo zabo. Umbuzo: Ingabe imicimbi yezempilo ibandakanya amalungelo abantu? Yebo, imicimbi yezempilo ibalulekile ekukhulumeni ngezindlela zokuvikela amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa emithini yokwelapha, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, nokuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuqwashisa ngalokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde izimfuno zabo kanye nezinsiza ezingavela kubo. Umbuzo: Yini eyodwa ongayikhumbula mayelana nemicimbi yezempilo? Okubalulekile ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukwakhiwa kokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, okukhuthaza impilo engcono. Uma umphakathi ujolisa ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo, izinga lempilo liphumelela, futhi lokho kuyinzuzo kubo bonke. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nemicimbi yezempilo? Izinkinga ezithinta imicimbi yezempilo zihlanganisa ukungafinyeleli kwabantu, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezithiyo eziphathelene nokuxhumana.
Uma umphakathi ujolisa ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo, izinga lempilo liphumelela, futhi lokho kuyinzuzo kubo bonke. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nemicimbi yezempilo? Izinkinga ezithinta imicimbi yezempilo zihlanganisa ukungafinyeleli kwabantu, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezithiyo eziphathelene nokuxhumana. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, imiphakathi idinga ukwakha izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuxhasa imicimbi, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlukene ukuze kuxhunywe izinsiza ezidingekayo. Umbuzo: Imicimbi yezempilo ingaba yindlela yokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu? Imicimbi yezempilo ingaba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokuxhumana, nokwadlula ukweseka impilo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, obusiza abantu ukuba bazitholele izixazululo eziphumelelayo, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxisana ngezinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo. Umbuzo: Yini esiyifisayo ngezempilo yomphakathi esikhathini esizayo? Sifisa ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo iqhubeke nokukhula, ithuthukise amakhono abantu, futhi iqinisekise ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zempilo kubo bonke. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onolwazi, futhi okwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhlanganyela, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi kumele ziqhubeke nokuba nomthelela omuhle, zikhuthaze abantu ukuba babe nempilo engcono, futhi zifake imizamo yokwakha umphakathi onempilo nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubo bonke.

Umbiko: Ukuqinisekisa Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ngokufana Nama-ATM Isingeniso Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, izikhungo ziye zathola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Okwamanje, ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM sekuthandwa kakhulu, njengoba kwenza kube lula, kusheshise, futhi kwandise ukufinyelela ezinsizweni kubantu abaningi. Lo mbiko uzophenya ukuthi lezi zikhungo zisebenza kanjani, izinzuzo zazo, kanye nezinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Izikhungo ezisebenza njengama-ATM zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokuthengisa, ezokwelapha, nezokuthutha. Njengoba ama-ATM evumela abantu ukuthola imali, lezi zikhungo nazo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ezithile. Isibonelo, izikhungo zokuthengisa zingaba nezindawo ezizimele ezivumela abantu ukuthi bathenge imikhiqizo ngaphandle kokulinda, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izinto ezibalulekile. Izikhungo zokwelapha, ezifana nezikhungo zokuhlola, nazo zisebenzisa le ndlela. Abantu bangabhalisela ukuhlolwa noma izinsizakalo ngefoni noma ku-inthanethi, bese bephuma kuphela uma sekukhona isidingo sokuhlolwa. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda futhi kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizweni zezempilo. Izinzuzo Zokusebenza Kwezikhungo Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM yenzeka lapho abantu befika kalula ezinsizweni abazidingayo ngaphandle kokulinda emgqeni omude. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho ukufinyelela ezinsizweni kungaba nzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza ukuzimela, njengoba abantu bangakwazi ukwenza izinqumo zabo ngaphandle kokuncika kwabanye, okusebenza kahle kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi.
Izinzuzo Zokusebenza Kwezikhungo Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM yenzeka lapho abantu befika kalula ezinsizweni abazidingayo ngaphandle kokulinda emgqeni omude. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho ukufinyelela ezinsizweni kungaba nzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza ukuzimela, njengoba abantu bangakwazi ukwenza izinqumo zabo ngaphandle kokuncika kwabanye, okusebenza kahle kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi. Izinselelo Ezihambisana Nokusebenza Kwezikhungo Nokho, ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM akukhululekile ngokuphelele. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemfihlo. Njengoba abantu bephuma besebenzisa lezi zikhungo, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi zikhona izingozi zokuphepha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphephile, futhi ziqinise izinqubo zokuvikela. Enye inkinga ibangelwa ukungabi nalwazi olufanele, ikakhulukazi kubantu abakhuluma isiZulu, okudinga izikhungo ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM kuyindlela ebalulekile yokwenza izinsizakalo zibe lula, zisheshise, futhi zandise ukufinyelela. Nakuba kunezinselelo, izinzuzo zikhombisa ukuthi le ndlela iyasiza kakhulu emiphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo, ziqinise ukuphepha, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nempilo engcono, futhi uthuthuke ngendlela efanele.
I- National Electronic Media Institute of South Africa (NEMISA) yasungulwa ngaphansi kwegama le-South African Broadcasting School; inhlangano eyasungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 21, futhi yashintsha igama yayo ngomhla ka-8 kuJuni 1999. Ngokwehlelo 3 ingxenye A yePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA) ka-1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999), njengoba kuguqulwe, futhi ngenxa yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, i-NEMISA inesibopho sokubhala le mmanual ezosetshenziswa njengedokhumenti yomphakathi ngendlela yokuthi umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kumarekhodi ethu. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlela inani labathuthukisi be-ICT abanolwazi kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezivela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo, nokwandisa amakhono emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. I-NEMISA ihlose ukugcina abafundi abahlukene enanini elikhulu labesifazane. Umbono we-NEMISA uwukuba ibe yisikhungo semfundo esilandela izindlela ezintsha ezigxile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana. Sihlose ukuba amandla aphambili ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakamiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihlinzeka ngezidingo zezimboni emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngempahla egxile kubantu, eshibhile, futhi efanele imboni ngokudlulisa ulwazi nobudlelwano. Isu le-NEMISA ukuhlela nokukhiqiza abafundi abanolwazi oluphakeme abazoba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana nezokukhuluma ngohlelo oluhlukahlukene, izifundo, nezinto ezintsha. IBhodi Yabaphathi ibophelelekile kubanikazi bezabelo ngokulandela izimiso ezibekwe yi-PFMA. IBhodi Yabaphathi ibheka izindaba ze-NEMISA futhi iqinisekisa ukufezeka kwezinhlelo ze-NEMISA, kanye nokuhola, ukuqondisa, nokulawula izenzo ze-NEMISA. I-NEMISA igcizelela indlela yokuphatha yokubambisana kanye nokuziphatha okuhle, njengoba kuchazwe kwi-King Report mayelana nokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nePublic Finance Management Act. Ikomidi le-Audit liqokwa yiBhodi ngokuhambisana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla. Ikomidi le-Audit lisunguliwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-NEMISA igcina isimo sezezimali esiqinile, esiphelele, nesicacile, kanye nezingozi, kanye nezokulawula ngaphakathi. Okwamanje, linamalungu eBhodi kuphela, kodwa le komidi linokhetho lokuqoka amalungu angeziwe. Le komidi ibika kwiBhodi ye-NEMISA ngemiphumela ye-audit nangokwethembeka nokuba khona kokuphila okukhulunywe ngakho. I-NEMISA, ngokubambisana neNational Services Commission (USA), ikwi ndlela yokusungula ikomidi le-audit langaphakathi elinamalungu amathathu, elilodwa elivela kwelinye isikhungo kanye nelinye elizimele. Le komidi izosebenza ngokuzimela kokuphatha, iBhodi ye-NEMISA, kanye nekomidi le-audit.

Inhloso eyinhloko yale komidi ukusungula izinqubomgomo nezindlela mayelana nokuphathwa kwangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Le komidi izobika kokubili ukuphatha kanye neKomidi le-Audit le-NEMISA. I-NEMISA ibheka isenzo sokuphakanyiswa njengokubalulekile ezinqubweni zayo zokuhweba, igxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni kwabesifazane. Le nkampani izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni indawo yokusebenza ephephile.
