Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kwamakhono, ukuxhumana kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokukhuluma ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngababhalisile ngamakhono okusebenza okuphumelelayo ezingeni le-strategic lemisebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zitholakala emikhakheni ehlukahlukene yokukhuluma, umsakazo kanye ne-television, futhi zifaka izifundo ezimfishane, izifundo zomphakathi, izifundo eziphelele, kanye nemikhankaso edumile. Uhlelo lunemakethe ethile eqondiwe. Abantu abavela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo. Thumela isikhalazo sakho kwiKomidi Lezikhalazo mayelana nesinqumo somphakathi wolwazi. Uma umfakisicelo enganelisekile ngesinqumo seBhodi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olufanele enkantolo. Lolu lwazi luzotholakala kuphela uma luceliwe.
Inkululeko YaseNingizimu Afrika yakhula emakhaya amaningi, lapho umoya wokukhathazeka ubhujiswa yizinyembezi zothando, umoya wokulwa, nezimo ezinzima. Kwakukhona izinsizwa nezintombi ezazithumele izinkanyezi zokukhanya ezinyangeni ezinzima, zihlabelela izinkanyezi ezingavumi ukuncipha. Lezi zinkanyezi zaziwubukhona bezwi labantu abahluphekayo, abebebhujiswe yizinhlelo zokubandlulula. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yombuso wobandlululo, abantu bahlangana, behlanganyela izimpilo zabo ukuze bakhe ithemba. Kwalapho kwavela khona amaqhawe, abantu abanjengoNelson Mandela, uOliver Tambo, noWalter Sisulu, ababehlonishwa njengezikhumbuzo zekhuluma. Laba bantu baphila ngesibindi, behamba emigwaqweni, behlukanisa imikhuba emibi, bejolisa ekutheni abantu bonke baphile ngokulingana. Ngonyaka ka-1960, kwenzeka umcimbi omkhulu eSharpeville, lapho abahlali bejolisa ekuphikeni ukuhamba kwezokuphepha ezazihambisana nomthetho wobandlululo. Lapho, abantu abavota ngokukhululekile, futhi okwakungamaphoyisa abavikela abanye, bathi bahamba phambili, baphikisa, kodwa ukuhlangabezana nempumelelo bekukude kakhulu. Izinsizwa zathi ziqhamukile, zikhala ngezikhathi ezinzima, kwagcina sekutholakala ukuphila okungaphezu kwemingcele. Ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka kokuphikisana, umoya wezemidlalo, ubuciko, nezincwadi zaba yizikhumbuzo eziqhubekayo zomzabalazo. Ababhali, abaculi, nabanye abathandi bezemidlalo babhalela ukulwela ukukhululeka.
Izinsizwa zathi ziqhamukile, zikhala ngezikhathi ezinzima, kwagcina sekutholakala ukuphila okungaphezu kwemingcele. Ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka kokuphikisana, umoya wezemidlalo, ubuciko, nezincwadi zaba yizikhumbuzo eziqhubekayo zomzabalazo. Ababhali, abaculi, nabanye abathandi bezemidlalo babhalela ukulwela ukukhululeka. UThami Mnyele, uMiriam Makeba, noHugh Masekela, babamba umoya wabantu, behlanganisa izinkanyezi zomculo, bekhombisa umoya wokulwa, ukulwa nenkohlakalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imikhankaso eyahlukene, efana ne-ANC (African National Congress), yahlangana nemibono emisha yokusebenzisa izindlela ezithile zokuphikisana. Kwavela izinkulumo, izinkomfa, nemihlangano ebivame ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Lokhu kwakhuthaza abantu abaninzi ukuba bahlanganyele, bese bephikisa lesi simo esinzima. Izinhlaka zomphakathi zazinokubaluleka okukhulu, futhi abantu baphila ngokwakha umndeni omkhulu, bejabulile ngokukhululeka. Kuyaqhubeka ukulwa, izimpi zazikhula, futhi umoya wokuphikisa wawukhula. Izinsuku zashintsha, phakathi kwamathafa aseNingizimu Afrika, abantwana babona imikhankaso yokugcina yokulwa. Kwazalwa izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa izinsizwa zikhumbula imizamo yazo, zifuna ukwakha izimpilo ezinhle. Umphakathi wawugqugquzela, ugxile ezintweni ezinhle, ubonisa uthando, uhlanganisa ubumbano. Ngonyaka ka-1990, kwavulwa ithuba elisha. UNelson Mandela, ngemva kweminyaka engama-27 esebenzisa ubuhlungu, wakhululwa. Kwakungumcimbi omkhulu, umhlaba wonke wawujabule, uMandela waba yisithonjana sokukhululeka. Ukubuyisana nezizathu eziphambili kwavula indlela yokwakha ikusasa elinobungane.
UNelson Mandela, ngemva kweminyaka engama-27 esebenzisa ubuhlungu, wakhululwa. Kwakungumcimbi omkhulu, umhlaba wonke wawujabule, uMandela waba yisithonjana sokukhululeka. Ukubuyisana nezizathu eziphambili kwavula indlela yokwakha ikusasa elinobungane. Izinsizwa nezintombi zafuna ukuphila, zathi: "Siyavuma! Sizokwakha ikusasa elihle." Ngemuva kokukhululeka kwalezi zinsizwa, kwavela umoya wokubuyisana. Abantu abavuka emnqamlezweni, baphuma ebumnyameni, babonisa ukuthi basafuna ubumbano. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi inkululeko iyinsika yokwakha ubumbano. Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibona izizukulwane eziningi eziphila ngaphansi kwenhloso yokwakha isizwe esihlangene. Amathuba abhalwe phansi, izindlela zokukhuluma zafaka umoya wokuphila. Izinsizwa nezintombi zifunda izifundo zenkululeko, ziqhubeka nezinyathelo, zifuna ukukhumbuza abantu ukuthi umoya wokulwa awupheli. Umgomo wokuhlonipha, ubumbano, nokubambisana akukaze kuphele, kusho ukuthi inkululeko iyajabula, iyaphila. Nakuba izinkinga zisekhona, umoya wokulwa phambili usaqhubeka. Abantu bazi ukuthi inkululeko iyinsika yempilo, futhi bazokwakha umhlaba omuhle, izinsuku ezizayo zibe yizinsuku zokuthula, ubumbano, nokukhululeka. Ngale ndlela, ukulwa kwenkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika kwaba yindlela yokwakha isizwe esithokozisayo, esihloniphekile, nesithokozisayo. Ngaphandle kwemikhankaso, izinsizwa nezintombi zafuna ukuphila okungcono, zathi: "Siyavuma, sizokwakha ikusasa elihle!"
Umculo we-Gospel: Uhambo Lwenhliziyo Ekuqaleni, emaphandleni ase-Afrika, umculo wawungelula. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, izinsimbi eziphakeme, nezwi elivela enhliziyweni. Umculo wawungowokukhuluma, wokukhumbula, nokukhuthaza. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo ezinkulu, izinkanyezi ezazihamba phambili emhlabeni. Kodwa, phakathi kwalezi zinkanyezi, kwavela umculo we-gospel, umculo owayezokhombisa uthando, ithemba, nokholo. Umculo we-gospel waqala ukuvela phakathi kwabantu abahluphekayo, ababephila ezimeni ezinzima. Kwakukhona ubuhlungu, kodwa futhi kwakukhona ngethemba. Abantu babengakwazi ukuxoxa izindaba zabo ngezingoma. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo we-gospel wawungowokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa wawuphinde ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Abantu babengakholwa ukuthi, noma bahluphekile, uNkulunkulu ubakhumbula, ubabheka, futhi ubathanda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel wathuthuka. Kwakukhona abaculi abaninzi ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, behamba behamba, bejolise ekukhulumeni izindaba zabo. UThandi, umculi owayenothando olukhulu lokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, waba yisibonelo esihle. UThandi wayengumuntu ophila empilweni enezinkinga, kodwa umculo wakhe wawuhamba phambili. Waqala ukucula izingoma ezazikhuluma ngothando lukaNkulunkulu, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uyasithanda, noma ngabe sikhona esikhathini esinzima. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, umoya wokukhuluma, umoya wokukhumbula. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Ingxenye -14 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ibeka ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, ilunga lomphakathi kumele libhale incwadi ethile enhlangano yomphakathi abakhona kuyo phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ekuqaleni kwale ngxenye. Le mfuneko ithobela ukuvunywa kokwandiswa kwesikhathi nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa nokushicilela le ncwadi kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Ukushicilelwa kwale ncwadi kuGazethi esemthethweni kunika amandla iziphakamiso ez contained in Section -14 kanye nokunika umuntu ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yinhlelo yomphakathi efanele ukuze kufezwe noma kuvikelwe noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zabo. I-ICD iyingxenye yenhlangano ngaphansi komkhakha kaHulumeni. I-ICD iyisigaba soHulumeni saseNingizimu Afrika futhi ihlelwe ezingeni likazwelonke nasephakathini. Ezingeni likazwelonke, umphakathi wayo nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi, bese kuba noMphathi wePhakathi ezingeni lephakathini. Abaphathi bezifunda ze-ICD bathumela imibiko futhi baphathwa nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi. UMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kulandela inqubo ethile eyakhelwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokubambisana neKomidi Lezomthetho. Ingxenye ethile yabasebenzi be-ICD yakhiwe ngamalunga aqokwe nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho. Lokhu kwenzeka kulandela imithetho ephethe insizakalo yomphakathi kanye nabantu abathile abathunyelwa kwezinye izigaba ngenhloso yokusiza noma ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwi-ICD.
UMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kulandela inqubo ethile eyakhelwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokubambisana neKomidi Lezomthetho. Ingxenye ethile yabasebenzi be-ICD yakhiwe ngamalunga aqokwe nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho. Lokhu kwenzeka kulandela imithetho ephethe insizakalo yomphakathi kanye nabantu abathile abathunyelwa kwezinye izigaba ngenhloso yokusiza noma ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwi-ICD. Umsebenzi oqala ngalokho okukhulunywe ngumthetho (ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wesevisi Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika, iMthetho No. 68 ka-1965) we-ICD ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) kanye neMuni Police Service (MPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe. Lapha umthetho ubonisa kahle ukuthi u-ICD unikezwa umthwalo nomsebenzi wokubheka umphakathi mayelana ne-SAPS njengoba kuboniswe kuNgxenye -222 yeMthethosisekelo Wokushintsha ka-1993. Le ngxenye ibeka ukuthi "Kuzoba khona indlela ezimele, esunguliwe futhi ephethwe nguMthetho Wezomthetho ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okukhulunywa ukuthi kwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe." a ngokuthanda kwakhe noma ngemva kokuthola isikhalazo, uhlola noma yisiphi isenzo esingafanele noma ukuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe yilunga le-SAPS noma le-MPS. c ingahlola noma yisiphi isimo esiqondiswe kuyo nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho noma ngaphakathi komkhandlu wesifunda.
Le ngxenye ibeka ukuthi "Kuzoba khona indlela ezimele, esunguliwe futhi ephethwe nguMthetho Wezomthetho ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okukhulunywa ukuthi kwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe." a ngokuthanda kwakhe noma ngemva kokuthola isikhalazo, uhlola noma yisiphi isenzo esingafanele noma ukuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe yilunga le-SAPS noma le-MPS. c ingahlola noma yisiphi isimo esiqondiswe kuyo nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho noma ngaphakathi komkhandlu wesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywe ngenhla, imisebenzi nezibopho ze-ICD zanda ngokwengeziwe nguMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya (DVA), ka-1998 (iMthetho No. 112 ka-1998). Lo mthetho uthi uma ilunga le-SAPS lingahambisani nezibopho ezichazwe kuMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya (DVA) noma imiyalo yeZwe eyakhishwa ngokomthetho (DVA), le nto ibhekwa njengokungafaneleki ngokuhumusha kweMthetho we-SAPS. Ngakho-ke, i-ICD kumele ibhunyulwe ngalesi sikhala esibikwe kwi-SAPS. Umqondo ocacile wale mfuneko ukuthi i-ICD kumele isebenzise amandla nemisebenzi yayo ukuze ibheke umphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zikhalazo zokungafaneleki zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe yi-SAPS. I-DVA iphinde ibeke ukuthi i-SAPS kumele ithathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene nalunye ilunga le-SAPS olukhulunywa ukuthi aluhambisani nezibopho ezilawulwa yi-DVA, ngaphandle uma i-ICD ikhetha okuphambene ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile.
Ngakho-ke, i-ICD kumele ibhunyulwe ngalesi sikhala esibikwe kwi-SAPS. Umqondo ocacile wale mfuneko ukuthi i-ICD kumele isebenzise amandla nemisebenzi yayo ukuze ibheke umphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zikhalazo zokungafaneleki zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe yi-SAPS. I-DVA iphinde ibeke ukuthi i-SAPS kumele ithathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene nalunye ilunga le-SAPS olukhulunywa ukuthi aluhambisani nezibopho ezilawulwa yi-DVA, ngaphandle uma i-ICD ikhetha okuphambene ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Umqondo wale mfuneko ukuthi i-ICD kumele ithathe umsebenzi owengeziwe wokuphatha izikhalazo ezicela ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene namalunga e-SAPS. Ngokwenza lokhu, i-ICD iqhuba umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo zokulungisa azigxiliwe yi-SAPS ezimweni lapho kudingeka ukuthathwa lezo zinyathelo zokulungisa ezifanele. a I-ICD ayingxenye futhi ayiwela ngaphansi koMnyango WezeMthetho, ihlala ikhululekile, icacile ingxenye yenhlangano yokusebenza komphakathi nakuba ixhunywe kumNgqongqoshe oyedwa - uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho - kanye ne-SAPS. b I-ICD inebhajethi yayo eyabelwe nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi kanye nebajethi yonyaka ehambisana nayo. Le bhajethi inefund yokuhlukile eyabelwe nguMthetho. Abasebenzi be-ICD bachaza futhi bahlanganisa wonke umuntu ophatha isikhundla esichazwe ngenhla.
b I-ICD inebhajethi yayo eyabelwe nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi kanye nebajethi yonyaka ehambisana nayo. Le bhajethi inefund yokuhlukile eyabelwe nguMthetho. Abasebenzi be-ICD bachaza futhi bahlanganisa wonke umuntu ophatha isikhundla esichazwe ngenhla. Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi agcinwe yi-ICD kumele senziwe ngombhalo lapho ummangali egcwalisa ifomu A, elaziwa ngokuthi: "Isicelo Sokufinyelela Kumarekhodi Enhlangano Yomphakathi." a ehhovisi leMenenja Yolwazi elinokuxhumana okukhulunywe kuNgxenye 2.2 ngenhla; noma b ehhovisi lesifunda le-ICD elichazwe kuNgxenye 1.1 yale ncwadi. f Uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye, ubufakazi bokwakhiwa kommangali kumele buphakanyiswe ngendlela ethokozisa uMenenja Yolwazi. a Thumela noma phakamisa isicelo esibhaliwe kuMenenja Yolwazi njengoba kuchazwe kuNgxenye -2.2 yale ncwadi. Isicelo kumele sithunyelwe kule ndawo yeMenenja Yolwazi noma ku-nombolo ye-fax, noma kwe-imeyili; noma b Thumela isicelo ngqo ehhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze nezinsuku ezichazwe kuNgxenye -1.1 yale ncwadi. Kulokhu, ihhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze lizohlinzeka ummangali ngerekhodi eqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sitholiwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD njengoba kuchazwe kuNgxenye -4.1.2 kanye -4.1.2 yale ncwadi kodwa ongakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yokungafundi noma ukungasebenzi, unelungelo lokwenza isicelo somlomo. a Emenenja Yolwazi echazwe; noma b KuMphathi wesifunda noma ehhovisi lesifunda elinikezwe lapho isicelo somlomo senziwa.
Kulokhu, ihhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze lizohlinzeka ummangali ngerekhodi eqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sitholiwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD njengoba kuchazwe kuNgxenye -4.1.2 kanye -4.1.2 yale ncwadi kodwa ongakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yokungafundi noma ukungasebenzi, unelungelo lokwenza isicelo somlomo. a Emenenja Yolwazi echazwe; noma b KuMphathi wesifunda noma ehhovisi lesifunda elinikezwe lapho isicelo somlomo senziwa. Umenenja Yolwazi uzobhala isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze ummangali kopi yalolo suku. Uma ummangali efika kuMphathi wesifunda okukhulunywe kuNgxenye -4.1.4(b) yale ncwadi, uMphathi wesifunda ofanele uzobhalela isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze ummangali kopi yalolo suku. Uma ummangali ezisa uMenenja Yolwazi noma uMphathi wesifunda / umphathi osethekwini ngentshisekelo yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD, uMenenja Yolwazi uzohlinzeka ngalolu sizo mahhala ngoba kubalulekile ukuthi ummangali ahambisane ngokuphelele nezinhlinzeko -4.
Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu: Umqondo Wami Isimo sezulu sithinta impilo yethu nsuku zonke. Njengoba ngibuka emoyeni, imishayo, nezinganekwane zemvelo, ngizizwa ngikhathazekile kakhulu ngezinguquko eziqhubekayo ezibalwa njengokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngokwehla noma ukukhula kokushisa, kodwa kukhomba ebuchwepheshini bokuhlanganyela kwezinselelo esibhekene nazo emphakathini. Leli sonto, ngithanda ukwabelana nombono wami ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusona isinqumo esincane. Iziphumo zalesi simo zibhalwe emlandweni wethu, zisuka ezingeni lemvelo, zifika ezingeni lempilo yomhlaba wonke. Isigaba sokuqala esikhombisa izinguquko ezibalulekile yizimo zemvelo ezibuhlungu, ezimake—kukhona ukwehla kokuphuma kwelanga, izikhukhula ezivamile, kanye nezikhungo zempilo ezithinteka ngezikhukhula nemvula eziningi. Kulesi sihloko, sengikhuluma ngempela ngezimo eziphawulekayo ezizayo uma sisheshe senze izinyathelo. Ukwehla kokuphuma kwelanga kwenza kube nzima ukuqhubekela phambili izimboni zemfundo, ezolimo, nolwazi. Izimvula ezinkulu zithinta amasimu okwaziyo ukunciphisa umkhiqizo, okwenza izinduna zomhlaba badinge ukulinda imikhiqizo eminingi. Ngokuqinisekile, uhlelo lokukhiqiza, olwakha izinsiza zokudla, lubalulekile ekuphuculeni izinga lempilo, futhi uthintwa ngqo yizinguquko zesimo sezulu. Lokhu kuyisifundo esidala sokuthi uma kungenzeka kulungiswe kabusha, kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezimbili. Ukusebenzisana nabalawuli, izinkampani, kanye nezimboni ezahlukahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuguquka okuhle.
Ngokuqinisekile, uhlelo lokukhiqiza, olwakha izinsiza zokudla, lubalulekile ekuphuculeni izinga lempilo, futhi uthintwa ngqo yizinguquko zesimo sezulu. Lokhu kuyisifundo esidala sokuthi uma kungenzeka kulungiswe kabusha, kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezimbili. Ukusebenzisana nabalawuli, izinkampani, kanye nezimboni ezahlukahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuguquka okuhle. Ngokwendaba, akukaze kube ngcono lapho sizama ukuqonda impilo yethu. Izinselelo ezivela ezinkampanini ezisebenza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokusiza abantu ezindaweni eziphansi zikhombisa umqondo ophumelelayo. Abesifazane abagqugquzela izinhlelo zokuvuselela, ukukhiqiza izinkanyezi, baneqhaza elikhulu ekuguqulweni kwemikhuba yokuphila. Ngokukodwa ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kwazulu, ukufundisa, umugqa wezinqubomgomo, ukuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze siqede ukudla okwenziwe ngenxa yokuguquka kwezimo. Ngokucacile kukhona izinkinga eziningi ezibangelwa ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi ngibe nemibono yokuthuthukisa — akukhona nje ukuthumela izinsiza ezithile, kodwa ukuxhumana. Ulimi lwezinto ezizokwenziwa lwaluphumelelisa, nokuthi akufanele kuthathwe ngezinyathelo ezithathekayo ukuze kugwenywe izingozi zempilo, izinkinga zemali, nezibalo. Ngakhoke, ukuhlola izinyathelo ezintsha nemishayo enezinhloso ezithile kulungile — ukuzama ukwakha uhlelo oluhlukile ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela weziningi ezithinta izikhalazo zansuku zonke. Ngemuva kwalolu hlangothi, kusemukelekile ukucabanga ngamathuba angeziwe. Hamba, fundisa! Ukukhuthaza amathuba okusebenza, kuphumelelisa zonke izinkampani ezizimele.
Ngemuva kwalolu hlangothi, kusemukelekile ukucabanga ngamathuba angeziwe. Hamba, fundisa! Ukukhuthaza amathuba okusebenza, kuphumelelisa zonke izinkampani ezizimele. Isifundo sokwenza izimboni, izindlela eziphumelelayo zokukhuthaza ukuqonda, kuyacashelwa. Ngaleyondlela, sizoqhuba impilo yethu ukuze siphushe izimo ezibalulekile ezizokhula, sizame izindlela zethu ezikhandiweyo. Njengoba kuncike empilweni yabantu, ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha ezithandwayo neziqukethe amalungelo kubalulekile, kuyilapho kudala ubuhlobo phakathi kwabezobuchwepheshe nezinhlelo ezenzakalayo. Ekugcineni, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhona nje okuhlobene nezinkinga, kodwa kuyinzuzo yokubambisana. Sinokuhlangenwe nakho okukhulu emhlabeni wemvelo, futhi njengoba sibona izinguquko ezinkulu ezintweni ezincane, kufuneka senze isifungo sokuthanda imvelo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sihlanganyela, singenza umehluko. Ngakho-ke, asithumeli kuphela izimvo eziphakeme, kodwa masithathe izinyathelo ezivamile, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba omusha uyathuthuka — umhlaba ophilayo, omangalisayo, nocansi — ohlala phakade. Uthando lwephuzu lokuzenzela izinguquko ezinhle lukhona, kanti sizokwenza njengoba sikhuthaza izinhlelo ezithile. Ngithanda ukukholwa kulokhu encane, elwa nokuguquka kwezimo — uyinto engakhi izinga lethu lokuphila, impilo yethu, nomphakathi wethu. Ngakho-ke, sizibophezela ekusebenza ndawonye — umhlaba wethu uyaqhakaza! Sinakho konke ukuphila okukhululekile nesinokukhanya. Qhubekani (siyaphi) ekwenzeni izindaba zesizukulwane esisha. Kukhishwe nguMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo weZizwe Ezihlangene. Pheka ukudla okungokwemvelo noma okukhuliswe kahle emasimini. Ukudla okungokwemvelo okufana nezinhlanzi, izithelo, nezitshalo kungathwala nomkhuhlane wecholera, kodwa lo mkhuhlane ungafa uma ukudla kuphisiwe, ngakho qiniseka ukuthi awudli ukudla okungaphekwanga, futhi kufanele uhlanze izandla zakho ngemva kokudla. Uma ukudla kuphakathi, umkhuhlane uyakhula. Ngakho, dlani ukudla okushisayo noma kuphise kabusha ngemva kokudla. Gwema ukuxhumana phakathi kokudla okungokwemvelo nokudla okuphisiwe. Ukudla okuphekiwe okuphephile nakho kungathwala umkhuhlane wecholera ngenxa yokuxhumana okuncane nokudla okungokwemvelo. Lokhu kuxhumana kungenzeka uma usika izinhlanzi eziphilile ngenkathi usika ukudla okuphisiwe ngaphandle kokuhlanza izandla. Ezindaweni ezithintekile yi-cholera, ukudla okufana nezithelo nezitshalo akuphephile ngaphandle kokuphekwa, njalonjalo. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokuqala ukulungisa ukudla nangaphambi kwanoma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka, njengokushintsha noma ukuhlanza ingane, ukusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Hlanza izandla zakho futhi ngemva kokuphothula ukulungisa ukudla okufana nezinhlanzi nezitshalo ngemva kokuthinta ezinye ukudla. Indawo lapho ulungisa khona ukudla kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile; cabanga ukudla okungadliwa noma indawo engahlanzekile njengoba ikhipha umkhuhlane. I-cloth yokuhlanza izitsha kufanele ishintshwe nsuku zonke noma iphisiwe ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Hlukanisa i-cloth yokusula okufanele ihlanzwe njalo.
Indawo lapho ulungisa khona ukudla kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile; cabanga ukudla okungadliwa noma indawo engahlanzekile njengoba ikhipha umkhuhlane. I-cloth yokuhlanza izitsha kufanele ishintshwe nsuku zonke noma iphisiwe ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Hlukanisa i-cloth yokusula okufanele ihlanzwe njalo. Ukusebenzisa amanzi aphephile kokupheka kubalulekile njengokuwasebenzisa kokuphuza. Phisa amanzi ngemva kokulungisa ukudla kwengane. I-bleach noma i-iodine ingasetshenziswa esikhundleni samanzi aphisiwe. Faka isipuni esisodwa se-bleach noma i-iodine kumalitha angama-25 wamanzi, bese ulinda amahora amabili noma ubusuku bonke ngemva kokuyisebenzisa. II. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe ukudla okulungisayo kuphephile? Pheka kahle zonke izidlo ezifana nenyama, izinhlanzi, nezitshalo. Dla ukudla okuphekiwe ngesikhathi kuse-hot. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. Hlanza izitsha ngamanzi nosawoti. Hlanza indawo lapho usika khona izinhlanzi nezitshalo, njll., ngamanzi nosawoti. Dla izithelo ezisikiwe ezifana nezorhwe, noma amabanana. Gcina ihlanzekile - pheka, hlanzisa, nezinye izinto ukuze umise! Pheka ukudla kwakho. Phisa ukudla kwakho. Hlanza ukudla kwakho. Ingabe amanzi akho aphisiwe noma aphephile? Ingabe amanzi akho agcinwe endaweni ephephile? Amanzi ahlanzekile angathwala umkhuhlane uma engagcinwanga endaweni ephephile. Gcina amanzi ebhodweni elihlanzekile elinovolo. Sebenzisa amanzi agciniwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-24. Thela amanzi ebhodweni noma sebenzisa ikomishi ukuyiphakela. Gcina ihlanzekile - gcina amanzi akho ephephile. VI.
Thela amanzi ebhodweni noma sebenzisa ikomishi ukuyiphakela. Gcina ihlanzekile - gcina amanzi akho ephephile. VI. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe uhlanza izandla zakho? Ukungcola okuningi ezandleni zakho kungakwenza uthole i-cholera ngaphandle kokwazi? Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ukuhlanza ingane. Ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. Ngemva kokudla. Ngemva kokunikeza ingane yakho ukudla. Yini indlela engcono yokuhlanza izandla zakho? Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa usawoti njalo. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile njalo. Hlanza izandla zakho njalo ngemva nangaphambi, phakathi kwezitho zakho, nasemathanjeni. Gcina zihlanzekile - hlanza izandla zakho? VII. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe usebenzisa indlu yangasese? Umuntu ohlanzekile angathola i-cholera endlini yangasese. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa indlu yangasese njalo? Phumula udoti lwengane endlini yangasese noma ulufake phansi. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nosawoti ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina ihlanzekile - sebenzisa indlu yangasese. Phuza amanzi avela emthonjeni ophephile noma ovikelwe. Pheka ukudla noma kuphise kabusha, bese udla ngesikhathi kuse-hot. Hlanza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokuthinta udoti noma ukuchama, ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. I-cholera ayizokubulali uma iphathwa kahle. Shesha umguli ophukile uye esibhedlela ukuze uphathwe. Nika umguli amanzi.

Sifinyelele ekupheleni konyaka omunye wokuxhaswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho kohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa KweBalimi. Njengoba kwenzeka kwenye indawo ethuthukayo, intuthuko kwesinye isikhathi ibonakala ihamba kancane - abanye abantu bafunda ngokushesha kodwa abanye bathatha isikhathi ukuze bajolise ezintweni ezintsha zokusebenza ukuze sifinyelele endaweni lapho singathi sithuthuka. Kulo hlelo, sisebenza kanzima ukuthatha abalimi abakhona okwamanje esimweni (esingafani kubo bonke) bese sibabeka esimweni esidingekayo lapho bengathi ngiyabalimi bezomnotho, ngimiqondiso futhi ngizokwenza umsebenzi wami wezolimo. Imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwalolu hlelo ihlose ukuxazulula izidingo zabalingani abahlukene. Lolu hlelo lusaphathwa eBothaville. Ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somsebenzi seGrain SA, uhlelo luhlanganiswa ngaphansi kwesigaba seZinsizakalo Zenkampani esiphethwe nguMnu. Nico Vermaak. Ihlobo elidlule lidlule kube nzima kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemvula ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi sehlobo - kukhona abalimi abahluleka ukutshala, abanye batshala kodwa bangatholi umkhiqizo, kanti ezinye izindawo zithole imvula ejwayelekile.

Ihlobo elidlule lidlule kube nzima kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemvula ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi sehlobo - kukhona abalimi abahluleka ukutshala, abanye batshala kodwa bangatholi umkhiqizo, kanti ezinye izindawo zithole imvula ejwayelekile. Njalo abalimi batshala ngemali ebolekiwe - baphokophela ezibankini noma emabhizinisini aboleka imali yokulima (noma ama-Co-ops amadala) - futhi abambalwa bathatha umshwalense ukuvikela inani lemali abakhokhela ukuze baqale ngoba inzuzo iphansi futhi abafuni ukufaka izindleko ezengeziwe. Ngonyaka onjengalowo, kukhona abalimi abathile abahluleka ukukhokha izindleko zabo zokukhiqiza, ngalokho bahluleka ukuthola imali yokutshalwa kabusha. Uma sisebenza nabalimi abasha abangenayo imali ebekiwe, unyaka odlule ubeka ingozi enkulu engavimbela intuthuko yesikhathi esizayo ekwakheni abalimi bezomnotho. Uhlelo lwethu lwezinga eliphezulu lwebalimi luhamba kahle futhi sesethule abalimi abakhethiwe kuhlu lwethu lweMfundo Yezolimo. Sibona ukwethulwa kwalolu suku nomsebenzi olandelayo njengokuphetha kohlelo oluzosiza umbalimi ukuba abe umbalimi ongenza imali. Le nkambo ihlanganisa lonke ulwazi olukhona oluvela kwezinye izifundo futhi ihlose ukukhombisa umbalimi izindawo okufanele agxile ekuthuthukiseni, izici ezibalulekile uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla ngempumelelo ngesikhathi esifanele nangemikhuba efanele. Uhlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abalimi lugcwele eminyakeni eminingi - ngezikole ezingaphezu kuka-80 kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2006 kuya kuSepthemba 30, 2007.

Lezi zikole ziqhutshelwa kusukela kuFebhuwari kuya kuNovemba ngonyaka - kwesinye isikhathi abalimi babephakathi emasimini abo futhi bengenayo isikhathi sokuhambela izifundo. Ngesikhathi sehlobo, sizama ukuhlela iziboniso zabalimi lapho bezama khona ukwenza umsebenzi wezolimo, futhi simema amalungu ezigaba zokufunda ukuba bahlangane, futhi sizama ukusiza umbalimi ngamunye ngokwehlukana. Siphinde sathola impendulo enhle evela eziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi ngokusebenza nezinsizakalo zezolimo futhi silindele ukusiza bona ngonyaka omusha wezomnotho lapho kuzoba nezikole ezengeziwe ezifundisa umsebenzi ophathekayo - ukusebenza emhlabeni ngezandla kube inselelo enkulu kulezi ziphathimandla, behluleka ukukhombisa abalimi ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kahle. Amalungu omphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele ayamenywa ukuba aphakamise amalungu eNational Heritage Council (NHC). Inhloso ye-NHC ukuhlinzeka, ukuthuthukisa, nokuvikela ifa lemvelo laseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuletha ukulingana ekuphathweni kwefa lemvelo. Izothola ukuvunywa kwephalamende kwiMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko futhi izohlinzeka, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngoxhaso lwezimali ngezimali ezithunyelwa ngababhalisi ezikhungweni nakumaphrojekthi/imisebenzi ngaphansi kwazo ezithunyelwe. I-NHC yasungulwa njengomzimba wezomthetho ngaphansi kweNational Heritage Council Act ka-1999 (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999). Amalungu e-NHC azoba nesibopho sokuphumeza izinhlinzeko zalesi simiso futhi kulindeleke ukuthi azijwayeze ukuphathwa kwe-NHC ngokuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999). Abaphakanyisiwe kumele babe nolwazi emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, amasiko okukhuluma, umlando, nokuvikelwa, kumele bahlonishwe ngalesi sikhungo emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, kumele baziwe njengabantu abanesithunzi abazinikele ekuvikeleni nasekuvikelweni kwefa lethu eliyingqayizivele lemvelo, futhi akumele babe nesikhundla kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yezepolitiki. Amalungu e-NHC awazotholi umholo wanyanga zonke kodwa azokhokhelwa izindleko ezithathwe emsebenzini wabo ne-NHC. Amalungu azothola futhi uphawu lokubonga ngempumelelo yabo. Ikhompuyutha yokukhetha izosungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze idale uhlu lweziphakanyisiwe zayo yonke indawo, kulandelwe izingxoxo zomphakathi nezasezifundazweni.

Ikhompuyutha yokukhetha izosungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze idale uhlu lweziphakanyisiwe zayo yonke indawo, kulandelwe izingxoxo zomphakathi nezasezifundazweni. Incazelo yeKomidi esunguliwe izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kuhlanganisa wakhiwo ezivela kuzo zonke izigaba ze-heritage kazwelonke, zonke izindawo, nobulili bobabili, nokuthi ukukhethwa okuphelele kusezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu. Ikhompuyutha yokukhetha izozisa uhlu lwezithakazelo ezingu-15 kuNgqongqoshe, ozokwenza ukukhethwa kokugcina kwe-NHC kulolu hlu. Okungenani amalungu amahlanu e-NHC angakhethwa ngale ndlela, futhi i-MEC enesibopho sefa lemvelo nokuvikelwa kwazo zonke izifundazwe kumele ikhethe ummeleli oyedwa kulowo mhlaba. a Incwadi equkethe amagama aphelele, ikheli, izinombolo zocingo, nezifakazelo zabaphakanyisiwe, kanye nezizathu zokuphakanyiswa kwabo. b I-curriculum vitae noma umlando ophathelene nezimpilo zomphakanyisi ochaza iziqu zabo zokubekwa. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe, esibonisa ukuvuma kokuphakanyiswa. d Amagama nezixhumanisi zababoni ababili. Akukho ukuphakanyiswa okuzokwamukelwa uma konke okukhulunywe ngenhla kungafakiwe. Ukuphakanyiswa kumele kufike kuMphakathi Osebenzayo, uMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, ngaphambi kosuku lwe-14 kuFebhuwari 2003.

Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo/nabathatha impesheni (GEMS self-employed/pensioner income verification) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kuqhubeka nokuba yinkinga ebalulekile kubantu abaningi. Ikakhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, abantu basemakhaya nakwezomnotho bacela izinsiza, futhi ukwethembeka kwemali engenayo kubalulekile ukuze bathole izinzuzo ezithile ezibhekelele impilo yabo. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo okugcinwe ngaphansi kweMithetho ye-GEMS, okuyinsika yokuphila kahle kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Emavikini ambalwa edlule, kuvele izinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuhlola izincwadi zokuphila kwabathola izinzuzo. Abanye basebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokukhombisa imali engenayo, ezihlanganisa izinqwaba zamadokhumenti ezisemthethweni, kodwa lokhu akuhlali kuhambisana nemigomo ebekiwe. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kubalulekile, ikakhulu uma kubhekwa ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo. I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano ehlanganisa izinsiza zezempilo, ibonisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kunomthelela omkhulu ekwanelisekeni kwabantu. Njengoba abantu besebenzisa izinsiza zabo, bakhombisa ukuthi imikhuba yokuphila, njengokudla, izokwelapha, nezinye izidingo, kufanele ihambisane nemali abayitholayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlolwa okuqinile kwezincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhombisa imali engenayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola lezi zinsiza bangakhokha izindleko zabo. Ngokwesimo samanje, izithiyo ezivela kwezokuxhumana nezokusebenza zenza kube nzima kwabanye abantu ukuthola lezi zinsiza.
Njengoba abantu besebenzisa izinsiza zabo, bakhombisa ukuthi imikhuba yokuphila, njengokudla, izokwelapha, nezinye izidingo, kufanele ihambisane nemali abayitholayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlolwa okuqinile kwezincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhombisa imali engenayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola lezi zinsiza bangakhokha izindleko zabo. Ngokwesimo samanje, izithiyo ezivela kwezokuxhumana nezokusebenza zenza kube nzima kwabanye abantu ukuthola lezi zinsiza. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zidinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS nabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze baqinisekise imali yabo, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu abafanele bathola ukuhlinzekwa, i-GEMS ihlose ukwenza izinguquko ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okuxhumana nabazisebenzayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabathola izinsiza. I-GEMS iphinde ibonise ukuthi izinsiza zayo zidinga ukwandiswa ukuze zifinyelele nakubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza. Ngokubheka uhla lwemibuzo evamile, kubonakala ukuthi abathola izinzuzo bangakhathazeki uma bezama ukuqinisekisa imali yabo, uma bezwa ukuthi kukhona izinqubo ezilula ezitholakalayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo, i-GEMS izokwenza izinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa nokwazisa abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uthola ukukhululeka ngalezi zinguquko, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu basebenzisane ne-GEMS ukuze bathole imininingwane efanele.
Ngokubheka uhla lwemibuzo evamile, kubonakala ukuthi abathola izinzuzo bangakhathazeki uma bezama ukuqinisekisa imali yabo, uma bezwa ukuthi kukhona izinqubo ezilula ezitholakalayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo, i-GEMS izokwenza izinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa nokwazisa abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uthola ukukhululeka ngalezi zinguquko, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu basebenzisane ne-GEMS ukuze bathole imininingwane efanele. Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza kanjani kuzokwandisa ukwaneliseka komphakathi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibonisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezithile zidinga ukwenza ngcono ukuzibophezela kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale bexhumene nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze bazi kahle izinqubo zokubhalisela izinzuzo. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa imali engenayo luzoba yinsika enkulu yokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizeni abakudingayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo, bahlale bexhumene, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS izobe iqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu abathola izinzuzo bahlala befinyelele ekuphumeleleni kwempilo yabo. Lokhu kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho wonke umuntu engathola khona okudingayo ukuze aphile impilo enempilo.
Ulwazi luthathwe kuhlelo lwezemfundo ephakeme lokukhiqiza u-sorghum. Umkhiqizi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi kubalulekile lapho ethuthukisa isu futhi ngaphambi kokutshala, njengoba lokhu kuzokwandisa ithuba lokuthola umkhiqizo ophelele njengoba kuhlobene nazo zonke izenzo ezenziwa umphathi. Lezi ezilandelayo yizinto ezingathinta ikhwalithi yezitshalo ezivunyiwe (izinkwa): ukulungiswa komhlaba, ubukhulu bomhlaba, pH, ibhalansi yezimayini, ukugcina umswakama emhlabeni, uhlobo lwezithombo, umanyolo ofanele, ukuphathwa kwezihlahla nezifo, ukuvunwa ngesikhathi esifanele nokuphathwa, ukuhlanza izinkwa, ukuwasha izinkwa, nezindlela zokugcina (ukubeka) izinkwa. Ukuvunwa kuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu lapho kutshalwa u-sorghum. Siqala ukuvuna ngaphambi kokwenza ezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinkwa ezifana nokucubungula, ukugcina, nokuvikela umkhiqizo. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindawo lapho ukuvunwa, ukugcina, nokuvikela izenzo zihlukaniswe. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nokuvuna ngezandla bese konke okukhishwayo kubekwe ukuze kuvunwe kamuva uma sekomile ezindaweni ezincane. Bese kuqhubeka ezindaweni zokulima ezinkulu lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna izinkwa. Ngokuvamile, u-sorghum uvunwa kanye no-maize futhi uvunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma usetshenziswe kusenesikhathi, kanti omunye uvunwa ngoMeyi uma usetshenziswe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvunwa kwe-maize kuqale. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezincane lapho ama-combine angavuna u-sorghum no-maize.
Ngokuvamile, u-sorghum uvunwa kanye no-maize futhi uvunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma usetshenziswe kusenesikhathi, kanti omunye uvunwa ngoMeyi uma usetshenziswe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvunwa kwe-maize kuqale. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezincane lapho ama-combine angavuna u-sorghum no-maize. Umkhiqizi noma umuntu othile uzothola umqashi onemishini ekwazi ukuvuna u-sorghum no-maize. Isikhathi esisuka ekuthuthukisweni kwezinkwa kuya ekuvunweni kufanele sibe mfushane - lokhu kuzovimbela ubungozi obubangelwa izinyoni nokuphuka kwezinkwa nezifo ezahlukene. Izitshalo ze-sorghum zikhula kahle lapho umbala ngemuva kwezinkwa ushintsha, ekuqaleni umbala ubuhlalu bese ushintsha uba mnyama. Lokhu kushintsha kuvame ukwenzeka ngaphambi kokuthi izinkwa zome ukuze zivuziwe. U-sorghum otshalwe kamuva uzobe usulungile kuphela emva kokuhwa kokuqala ebusika. Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuvuna, sebenzisa umshini wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uhlole umswakama wezinkwa uma seziqala ukuvuthwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uzovuna ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma ungenayo imishini yokuhlola umswakama, thina izibonelo zezinkwa kumphathi wesilo eduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna. Ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kwezinkwa ngenxa yokuminyana ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nobungozi bezinyoni, u-sorghum ungavunwa uma umswakama usuka ku-20% kuya ku-25% bese umiswa emshinini wokumisa kuze kube sekufinyelele ku-9.5%. Lokhu kuminyana kuhle ukuze kubekwe (kugcinwe) u-sorghum ezibayeni.
Uma ungenayo imishini yokuhlola umswakama, thina izibonelo zezinkwa kumphathi wesilo eduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna. Ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kwezinkwa ngenxa yokuminyana ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nobungozi bezinyoni, u-sorghum ungavunwa uma umswakama usuka ku-20% kuya ku-25% bese umiswa emshinini wokumisa kuze kube sekufinyelele ku-9.5%. Lokhu kuminyana kuhle ukuze kubekwe (kugcinwe) u-sorghum ezibayeni. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, kungcono ukushiya u-sorghum emhlabeni ukuze umiswe kahle ngaphambi kokuvuna. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uma umswakama uphansi kuka-10%, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha umgubo. Isivinini se-combine kufanele sibe phakathi kuka-5 kuya ku-8 kilometers ngehora. Isivinini esiphezulu phambili sizohambisana nomswakama wezinkwa ze-sorghum nosayizi womkhiqizo. Isivinini kufanele sincishiswe uma umswakama uphansi ukuvimbela izinkwa ukuthi zibhujiswe uma zingena emshinini. Ungakwazi ukuhamba uma umswakama usuka ku-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Izinkwa ezinomswakama ophakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% zizobhubhisa kalula uma zingena kwi-cylinder. Izinkwa ezingabujwa ngokuphelele zihlala phansi. I-'concave' ivulekile kakhulu. Kunemathambo amaningi asala. Ukuphuma komoya okuphansi, ukonakala kwi-cylinder kwenzeka ngokushesha. Ukuvuleka kwe-'chaffer' kuncane kakhulu. Imfucumfucu eminingi iyashiywa kwi-'waste' bin.
Ukuphuma komoya okuphansi, ukonakala kwi-cylinder kwenzeka ngokushesha. Ukuvuleka kwe-'chaffer' kuncane kakhulu. Imfucumfucu eminingi iyashiywa kwi-'waste' bin. Ukonakala okuphezulu kakhulu, i-cylinder esheshayo, i-'concave' eqinile, umoya ophumayo uhamba kancane, ama-augers avulekile kakhulu. Izinkwa eziphukile zifihliwe. I-cylinder esheshayo, ukuvuleka okuncane kwe-'concave'. Izinkwa zifihliwe kodwa ngaphandle kusemoyeni. Ukuvuleka kwe-'concave' kuncane kakhulu. Izinkwa eziphukile nezihlahla ezikhululekile. Isivinini se-cylinder/rotary siphakeme kakhulu noma kukhona okuncane okusele. Izinkwa ezingabujwa ngokuphelele zihlala phansi. Amabhodi nekhanda akahambelani kahle. Izinkwa ziphuma ngemuva kwe-combine. Isivinini/ukuphuma komoya, hamba kancane emshinini futhi isivinini sokuphuma komoya. Ukulahleka komkhiqizo kungaba ngu-3% - 5% kodwa kungakhula kube ngu-10% - 15% ngezikhathi. Imishini yokuvuna kufanele ihlolwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isebenza kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuyihlola ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi mangaki alahlekile. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umkhiqizi angakwazi ukuqala ukuphatha ukuvunwa nomswakama kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nendlela yokuhlola izinkwa zakho. Uma umkhiqizo wakho muhle, thenga umshini wakho wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uvimbele ukuhamba kwezinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kubalulekile lapho kukhiqizwa nokumakethwa kwezinkwa zokudla. Ukonakala kwezinkwa uma zimanzi kakhulu bese zibekwe ezibayeni uma kubanda kakhulu noma ezibayeni ezisebenzisa umoya okhona kuphela.
Uma umkhiqizo wakho muhle, thenga umshini wakho wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uvimbele ukuhamba kwezinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kubalulekile lapho kukhiqizwa nokumakethwa kwezinkwa zokudla. Ukonakala kwezinkwa uma zimanzi kakhulu bese zibekwe ezibayeni uma kubanda kakhulu noma ezibayeni ezisebenzisa umoya okhona kuphela. Izindleko zingavela uma izinkwa zivunwa uma zimanzi kakhulu. Ukukhula kwezinkwa nezindleko zokumisa lezo zinkwa. Ukulahleka kwenani lomkhiqizo. Ukuze wenze ukuhlolwa okuqondile, kufanele uqale uthole isampuli enhle ezokhombisa inani lemikhiqizo yonke. Nansi sithatha isampuli ezitshalo ezingakavunwa (emhlabeni) ukuze sithole ukuthi izinkwa zimanzi kakhulu, lokhu kungasiphazamisa, futhi sithola ukuvuna kube sekwedlule, hhayi ngesikhathi esifanele. Vuna ingxenye bese uyi-test. Hlanganisa amakhanda ezitshalo ozikhethile emhlabeni wonke, uziphumeze kuze kube izinkwa ziphuma. Thatha ukuhlolwa okuthathu kulezi zinkwa futhi uthole okungaphakathi. Thumela le sampuli kumphathi wesilo ukuze enze ukuhlolwa okuqondile. Yenza lokhu njalo uma amakhanda eshintsha abe mnyama ukuze izinkwa zivuziwe ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze kulethe umkhiqizo omuhle. Lokhu kungaba kuhle kumlimi osanda kufika kulabo abizwa ngokuthi abalimi bezohwebo. Kukhona izibaya ezenziwe ngesinyithi esigcwele ezisuka ku-10 kuya ku-30 tons. Uma kungekho mali eningi, izibaya ezincane (10 tons) zingasetshenziswa ekuqaleni, bese lokhu kungakhuliswa njengohlelo lwezibaya ezizokwenziwa njengoba ukulima kuqhubeka. Izinto ezihlobene nokuvuna nokugcina izinkwa zimi kanje: umlimi akanayo indawo yokugcina umkhiqizo wakhe, noma unendawo yokugcina ingxenye yomkhiqizo noma yonke imikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe.

Abafundi Basemanyuvesi: Izifundo, Izinselelo Nezinto Eziwusizo Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, njengoba bephakamisa izinga lemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lezi zifundo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kubafundi uqobo, kodwa nakumphakathi wonke. Ukuze siqonde kahle indima yabafundi basemanyuvesi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izifundo abahlangabezana nazo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezinto eziwusizo ezitholakala kulolu hambo. Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe Nezokufunda Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bejolise ekutholeni ulwazi olujulile nolwakhiwe. Izifundo ezitholakala emanyuvesi zihluke kakhulu, kusukela ezifundweni zezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe, ezemfundo, ezomnotho, nezobuciko. Lezi zifundo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bacabange ngokuqhubekayo, bakhe amakhono amasha, futhi bathuthukise ubuchwepheshe babo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwezifundo zabo nezidingo zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo ezinkingeni ezithile. Izinselelo Abafundi Abahlangabezana Nazo Noma kunjalo, abafundi basemanyuvesi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yizindleko zemfundo. Imali yokufunda, izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nezindleko zokuphila zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abafundi badinge ukusebenza ngenkathi befunda, okungase kube nomthelela ekutheni bakwazi ukugxila ezifundweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka kuyizinkinga ezivamile phakathi kwabafundi.
Imali yokufunda, izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nezindleko zokuphila zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abafundi badinge ukusebenza ngenkathi befunda, okungase kube nomthelela ekutheni bakwazi ukugxila ezifundweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka kuyizinkinga ezivamile phakathi kwabafundi. Ukuphila emanyuvesi kudinga ukuzivocavoca, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nokuphila phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bazizwe bedangele noma bephazamisekile, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ekufundeni kwabo. Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi badinga izinsiza ezihlinzekwa emanyuvesi, ezifana nezikhungo zokwelashwa kwengqondo, izifundo zokuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa. Izinto Eziwusizo Nezixazululo Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi basemanyuvesi badinga ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zemfundo zihlala zinikeza izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, ezihlanganisa izifundo ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banethuba lokuthola usizo lapho kudingeka khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Abafundi basemanyuvesi baphinde babe nethuba lokuthola ulwazi olungaphezulu ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzithandela, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kobuholi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono amasha, bathuthukise ubuholi, futhi bakhe izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwabo nabanye.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Abafundi basemanyuvesi baphinde babe nethuba lokuthola ulwazi olungaphezulu ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzithandela, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kobuholi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono amasha, bathuthukise ubuholi, futhi bakhe izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwabo nabanye. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Noma bephakathi kwezinselelo eziningi, izifundo abahlangabezana nazo zikhuthaza ukukhula kwabo, kokubili njengabantu kanye nabafundi. Ukuze baphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, baphinde basebenzise amathuba okuthuthukisa amakhono abo. Ngokwenza lokhu, abafundi basemanyuvesi bangaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo, bephakamisa izinga lemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumphakathi wonke.

Uma ubhenele emshadweni ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngaphambi kwalolu suku, kusho ukuthi umshado wakho uyavunywa ngaphansi kwalomthetho omusha. Uma indoda isenayo omakoti abangaphezu koyedwa, bonke laba bashadile bayavunywa ngaphansi kwalomthetho omusha. Lo Mthetho uvuma imishado yamasiko eyenziwe ngemuva kwalolu suku, kanye nokubeka phambili izimfuneko okufanele abantu abashadayo ngaphansi komthetho wesiko balandele ukuze imishado yabo ivunywe. Qaphela ukuthi le mishado yamasiko ibivunywa njalo ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Kufanele ngibhalise umshado wami nini? Uma ubhenele emshadweni ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngaphambi kukaNovemba 15, 2000, umshado wakho kufanele ubhaliswe kwiMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Uma ushade ngemuva kokuba umthetho udlulile, kufanele ubhalise umshado wakho phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu. Imishado yamasiko nokwabelana ngempahla Zonke imishado yamasiko eyenziwe ngaphambi kokuba lo mthetho ungene emsebenzini kusho ukuthi yenziwe ngaphansi kokwabelana ngempahla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umyeni nomkakhe banamalungelo alinganayo empahleni, imali, noma izimpahla, futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi babelana ngezinsizakalo. Uma bobabili bephakanyiswa ukuthi umshado wabo ungabi ngaphansi kokwabelana ngempahla, kufanele bangene esivumelwaneni ngaphambi kokushada esaziwa ngokuthi isivumelwano sokushada. Uma befisa ukushintsha lokhu ngemuva kokushada, kufanele bafake isicelo eNkantolo Ephakeme. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokwenziwa Kwezivumelwano Zomshado, umkakhe unamalungelo alinganayo nesimo njengomyeni ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nokuthi kwenzekeni kuphahla.
Uma bobabili bephakanyiswa ukuthi umshado wabo ungabi ngaphansi kokwabelana ngempahla, kufanele bangene esivumelwaneni ngaphambi kokushada esaziwa ngokuthi isivumelwano sokushada. Uma befisa ukushintsha lokhu ngemuva kokushada, kufanele bafake isicelo eNkantolo Ephakeme. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokwenziwa Kwezivumelwano Zomshado, umkakhe unamalungelo alinganayo nesimo njengomyeni ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nokuthi kwenzekeni kuphahla. Umkakhe oshadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko unelungelo lokungena esivumelwaneni ngaphandle kokusiza komyeni wakhe. Kwenzekani uma umyeni wami efuna ukushada omunye umkakhe? Umyeni kufanele angene esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe, esizokhombisa ukuthi kwenzekeni kuphahla, futhi umyeni kufanele futhi afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze wamukelwe lesi sivumelwano esibhaliwe. I-ndlu yesigaba kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo empahla wonke omakoti avikelwe. Kwenzekani uma sifuna ukungena emshadweni wezomthetho ngemuva kokuba seshadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko? Uma umyeni wakho engenayo eminye imakoti, ungashada ngaphansi komthetho wezomthetho kanye nasemthethweni wesiko. Nokho, noma wena noma yena ngeke nikwazi ukungena emshadweni wesiko nabanye abantu ngenkathi nisenemshado wezomthetho. Umyeni noma umkakhe bangabhalisa umshado ehhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Kunconywa ukuthi nobabili niye ndawonye ukubhalisa umshado ukuze kusheshiswe ukubhaliswa. Nokho, uma omunye wenu engavumi, ungabhalisa wedwa, kodwa ngokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obudingekayo.
Umyeni noma umkakhe bangabhalisa umshado ehhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Kunconywa ukuthi nobabili niye ndawonye ukubhalisa umshado ukuze kusheshiswe ukubhaliswa. Nokho, uma omunye wenu engavumi, ungabhalisa wedwa, kodwa ngokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obudingekayo. Inombolo yakho yokukhomba, amagama, nezinsuku zokuzalwa, kanye namagama omyeni wakho namagama abazali bomyeni wakho kanye nabazali bomkakhe, kanye negama lomholi wesiko, imininingwane yesivumelwano se lobola, kanye nabantu ababili ababe ngofakazi bomshado, incwadi evela kumholi wesiko noma isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe esivela kumameleli bezomthetho. Umphathi wokubhaliswa, noma umuntu ogunyaziwe nguMphathi-Jikelele ukwenza lezi zisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko zomsebenzi, uzothumela isicelo ehhovisi eliseduze lesifunda noma lesifunda leMnyango ukuze ubhalise le mininingwane emgqeni wabantu bonke. Gcina isitifiketi endaweni ephephile, njengoba kubalulekile. Isitifiketi sesikhashana sikhishwa ngokushesha. Isitifiketi esiphelele sithatha izinsuku eziyisithupha kuya kwezingu-8. Umphathi wokubhaliswa uzokwazi ukukwazisa uma bephika ukubhalisa umshado wesiko njengoba kuchaziwe ngumthetho, bechaza izizathu zokuphika kwabo. Imali yokufaka isicelo nokuthola umgqigqo womshado wesiko noma eminye imibhalo esekela umgqigqo ingu-R53. Imali engu-R11 ikhokhwa yiphezu kumuntu ogunyaziwe mayelana nesicelo sokubhaliswa komshado wesiko, ethunyelwa kulowo muntu ogunyaziwe. Uhlelo lwezohwebo kanye nesu lokusebenza kwemisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo lukhonjiswa kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha futhi luvunywa ngaye minyaka yonke, ngendlela yesicelo (uhlelo lwezohwebo) oluhlanganisa nolwazi olunembile. I-SAMSA yenza imisebenzi yezomthetho nezok regulation, egameni likaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha kanye neMnyango Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke (NDOT). Ngakho-ke, i-SAMSA yenza imisebenzi ekhethiwe ezingeni lokusebenza, kanti i-NDOT isebenza ezingeni lesu, lapho ithuthukisa khona izinqubomgomo zokuthutha nezikhombisi-ndlela ezibalulekile kumaphrojekthi. I-SAMSA iqhubeka nokuxhumana nabathintekayo emikhakheni yezokuthutha, ngamakomidi ahlukahlukene ezokuthutha nangokubamba imihlangano yokuxhumana nezinye izindlela ezingezona ezisemthethweni. Inhloso ye-SAMSA ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezimpahla nokuphila olwandle, ukuvikela nokulwa nokungcoliswa okuthinta imvelo yolwandle yezikebhe, nokukhulisa izintshisekelo zezimali zeRiphabhulikhi. Phakathi kwezinye izenzo, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulezi, kukhona ukuhlolwa kwezikebhe, imishini, kanye nezimpahla, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isikebhe nezikebhe zifakwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe. I-SAMSA iphinde ikhiphe futhi inikeze izitifiketi okufanele zibe nazo abantu uma besebenza ezikebheni. Izimemo ezitholiwe zokuhamba/nokuxhumana namanye amazwe/izinhlangano/okungabandakanya amaklayenti nomphakathi. Akukho sikhumbuzo esishicilelwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho. I-SAMSA iphethe ukuvikelwa kokungcoliswa kanye nekhono lokuphendula, ngokubambisana neMnyango Wezokuphila Nendawo. Ukwethulwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kumele kuthunyelwe ku-CEO we-SAMSA. Uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sikhanselwa noma sithathwa ngokuhambisana Nezikhala 22, 26, noma 29 zoMthetho, umceli angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi. Omnye umuntu angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi, ukuze afune ukufinyelela kulwazi. Isikhalazo kumele sithunyelwe ngendlela ebekiwe ku-2, bese sithunyelwa kuMenenja Yolwazi kwikheli leposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhonjiswe ku-2 ngenhla, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola isikhumbuzo sokwenqaba. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yesikhalazo. Uma umceli engakakhokhi imali yesikhalazo (uma kudingeka), isinqumo ngesikhalazo sangaphakathi singabambezela, kuze kube yilapho imali ikhokhiwe.
Isikhalazo kumele sithunyelwe ngendlela ebekiwe ku-2, bese sithunyelwa kuMenenja Yolwazi kwikheli leposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhonjiswe ku-2 ngenhla, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola isikhumbuzo sokwenqaba. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yesikhalazo. Uma umceli engakakhokhi imali yesikhalazo (uma kudingeka), isinqumo ngesikhalazo sangaphakathi singabambezela, kuze kube yilapho imali ikhokhiwe. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isikhalazo, ukuthi ingaqinisekisa yini isikhalazo noma yenze isinqumo esisha esikhundleni sayo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Uma i-SAMSA ingahlinzeki umceli ngesikhumbuzo ngesinqumo sokusikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokufaka isicelo, i-SAMSA izobhekwa njengokwenqaba isikhalazo sangaphakathi. Umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu angasondela enkantolo ukuze athole usizo olufanele kuphela ngemva kokuthi umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu esebenzisile zonke izinqubo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi mayelana nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi. Uma umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu ehluphekile ngesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi noma izicelo zabo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi ziye zaphumelela, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kwesinqumo sokusikhalazo. Ikhaya elinethuba lokufaka lesi sicelo yikhaya eliphezulu noma enye inkantolo enezimfanelo ezifanayo. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahambisane nezimfuneko zokusebenza ezitholakala kuMthetho, eziphathelene nesicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi.
Uma umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu ehluphekile ngesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi noma izicelo zabo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi ziye zaphumelela, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kwesinqumo sokusikhalazo. Ikhaya elinethuba lokufaka lesi sicelo yikhaya eliphezulu noma enye inkantolo enezimfanelo ezifanayo. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahambisane nezimfuneko zokusebenza ezitholakala kuMthetho, eziphathelene nesicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu elibekiwe ku-1, bese elithumela, kanye nemali yesicelo kanye ne-deposit (uma kudingeka), kuMenenja Yolwazi kwikheli leposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhonjiswe ku-2 ngenhla. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yomfaki-sicelo. Uma isicelo sithunyelwa egameni lomunye umuntu, khona-ke umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthi unegunya lokwenza lesi sicelo egameni labo. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngokubhala ukuthi ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe noma kuhanjiswa. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna izizathu zesinqumo ngenye indlela, kumele akhombise indlela nemininingwane ezodingeka. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqedela ifomu ngenxa yokuthi akakwazi ukufunda noma ubuthakathaka, lowo muntu angafaka isicelo ngenkulumo. Umceli kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ngaphambi kokuthi kwenzeke noma yisiphi isenzo. Futhi imali yokufinyelela, ebaliwe ngokubheka izindleko zokuphrinta kabusha, ukukhangwa, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zesicelo kanye neposi.
Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqedela ifomu ngenxa yokuthi akakwazi ukufunda noma ubuthakathaka, lowo muntu angafaka isicelo ngenkulumo. Umceli kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ngaphambi kokuthi kwenzeke noma yisiphi isenzo. Futhi imali yokufinyelela, ebaliwe ngokubheka izindleko zokuphrinta kabusha, ukukhangwa, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zesicelo kanye neposi. Uma isicelo sitholiwe nguMenenja Yolwazi, lowo msebenzi uzodinga isikhumbuzo sokuthi umfaki-sicelo, ngaphandle kokufaka isicelo, kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nokucubungula isicelo. Umfaki-sicelo onikezwe ukufinyelela kumarekhodi kumele akhokhe imali yokufinyelela yesicelo, kanye nokuphinda kukhishwe, ukulungiselela, nesikhathi esidingekayo sokufinyelela ezikhathini ezithile zesicelo nokulungiselela kwamarekhodi okuzokhishwa, kuhlanganise nokwenza amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo. Uma isicelo sokurekhoda senziwe futhi irekhodi silungisiwe ukuze sikhishwe, kuhlanganise nanoma yiziphi amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo, kudinga amahora ngaphezu kwalawo abekiwe emthethweni ngenhloso, uMenenja Yolwazi uzokwazisa umfaki-sicelo ukuthi akhokhe, njengediphozi, ingxenye ebekiwe yemali yokufinyelela okudingeka ikhokhwe uma isicelo sivunywa. UMenenja Yolwazi uzogcina irekhodi kuze kube isikhathi lapho umfaki-sicelo ekhokha izimali ezibekiwe. Uma idiphozi ikhokhiwe mayelana nesicelo sokufinyelela esinquelekile, khona-ke uMenenja Yolwazi ophathwayo uzobuyisela idiphozi kumfaki-sicelo.
Uma isicelo sokurekhoda senziwe futhi irekhodi silungisiwe ukuze sikhishwe, kuhlanganise nanoma yiziphi amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo, kudinga amahora ngaphezu kwalawo abekiwe emthethweni ngenhloso, uMenenja Yolwazi uzokwazisa umfaki-sicelo ukuthi akhokhe, njengediphozi, ingxenye ebekiwe yemali yokufinyelela okudingeka ikhokhwe uma isicelo sivunywa. UMenenja Yolwazi uzogcina irekhodi kuze kube isikhathi lapho umfaki-sicelo ekhokha izimali ezibekiwe. Uma idiphozi ikhokhiwe mayelana nesicelo sokufinyelela esinquelekile, khona-ke uMenenja Yolwazi ophathwayo uzobuyisela idiphozi kumfaki-sicelo. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo, ukuthi ivume noma inqabe isicelo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Isikhathi esingu-30 sezinsuku lapho i-SAMSA kumele yenze isinqumo sokuvuma noma sokwenqaba isicelo singandiswe sibe esinye isikhathi ngokuhambisana noMthetho 26.
Izinguquko Zesimo Sezulu: Ingxoxo Yamanje Namuhla, sikhuluma ngezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta izimo zokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu. Lezi zinguquko zithinta imvelo, ukuphila kwethu, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela zethu zokuphila. Sifuna ukuhlola izici ezahlukahlukene ezithinta le ndaba, okuhlanganisa izakhamuzi, umnotho, nezemvelo, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizoletha ukuthula nokuphila kahle. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde izinguquko ezithinta isimo sezulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwanda kokushisa emhlabeni, ukuphazamiseka kwemvula, nezimo zokuphila zamaphilisi. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukushisa komhlaba sekukhuphuke ngamaphesenti amabili eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu edlule, okungabangelwa ukuvela kwemikhuba yokugcina imfucuza, ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokungcola emoyeni. Izizathu eziningi zikhona ezibangela lezi zinguquko, kodwa ubuchwepheshe bethu buphambili bunemiphumela emibi. Izinjini zomkhiqizo, izinto zokwakha, nezinsiza ezisontekile zenza kube nzima ukuthola izixazululo ezilula. Umnotho udinga izinqubomgomo ezizinzile, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Kunemibono eminingi mayelana nezinguquko ezidingekayo, kanti abanye bakholelwa ukuthi kudingeka izinguquko ezinzima ekuphakamiseni imikhuba yokuphila, ukuze sihambisane nemvelo. Naphezu kwemiphumela emibi, abanye bakholelwa ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke nendlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bethu bokuthuthukisa amandla kumele buhlonishwe. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma kahle ngalezi zinguquko; kubalulekile ukuthi sifeze izixazululo ezintsha.
Naphezu kwemiphumela emibi, abanye bakholelwa ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke nendlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bethu bokuthuthukisa amandla kumele buhlonishwe. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma kahle ngalezi zinguquko; kubalulekile ukuthi sifeze izixazululo ezintsha. Ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obuhlukeneyo nokwenza izinqubomgomo ezicacile ezikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zikusize ekugcineni imvelo kahle, kubalulekile. Ukuze siphumelele, lezi zinguquko zidinga ukusiza ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlanzekile, ezazisa umnotho nemvelo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izifundiswa, nohulumeni kuyadingeka ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizinzile. Uma sithola umthelela omubi wezimo, izindawo ezivulekile zidinga ukuhlela umkhakha wezolimo, umnyango wezokwakha, kanye nemithombo yokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza ukusebenzisa imithombo yezezimali futhi kudinga ubuchwepheshe bokubika kahle. Umhlaba udinga ukuzwa izidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kudinga isimilo esithile. Kulezi zimo, abantu badinga ukuqonda isimo sezulu esingaphezulu kwazulu. Izenzo ezifanele zingaveza umphumela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izindlela ezizinzile zokuphila. Ukuzama ukunciphisa ukuncika kwezinto ezilimazayo kumele kube yinjongo eyinhloko. Kukhona abahlola izifundo ezikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinzima lapho izimo zezimali zixhumene kakhulu nezinguquko ezidalwa yizimo zezulu. Lokhu kuveza umxholo omubi, okungekho emthethweni. Ngakho-ke, umbono wethu kumele ube umphakathi ophilayo, osebenzayo, futhi ohlakaniphile. Umphakathi kumele uzame ukufunda ngezinto ezithinta isimo sezulu futhi senze izinqumo eziqinile.
Lokhu kuveza umxholo omubi, okungekho emthethweni. Ngakho-ke, umbono wethu kumele ube umphakathi ophilayo, osebenzayo, futhi ohlakaniphile. Umphakathi kumele uzame ukufunda ngezinto ezithinta isimo sezulu futhi senze izinqumo eziqinile. Ukuze sithole isixazululo esihle, kufanele sihloniphe abakhiqizi bemvelo, sikhuthaze ukuzinakekela emhlabeni ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kuzokwenza kube nokukhula okuhle, kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nesizotha nezimiso eziqinile. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kumele uqhubeke nezenzo ezihloniphekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubomgomo zethu kumele ziqhubele phambili ukusimama nokukhulisa izinyathelo ezihlanzekile. Umhlaba udinga izixazululo ezithinta ngemfanelo, ezenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Njengoba sithatha izinyathelo ezithe xaxa, kufanele sihlale sihamba phambili nemibono emisha, sihloniphe imiphakathi kanye nezinselelo ezivelelayo. Ekugcineni, ukuze sikhulume ngezokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, kudingeka sihlale sihamba phambili. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda izimo ezithinta izimpilo zethu, ukuze siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela ezinhle zezimali, ezokuhamba, kanye nemvelo. Umhlaba wethu uyahluka, kodwa uma umphakathi uhlanganisa, akukho okungakwazi ukusivimbela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo nelungelo lokuphila kahle. Singenza umehluko, kudingeka sizakhele umhlaba ongcono.
Izinga Eliphezulu Lobugebengu: Izimbangela Nezixazululo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lobugebengu emadolobheni amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika lidlulelwe emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, elikhathaza izakhamuzi, abaholi, kanye nohulumeni. Kulokhu kuhlola, sizobheka izimbangela ezahlukene zokwanda kobugebengu kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuncishiswe ubugebengu. Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu lihlobene kakhulu nezimo zomnotho, ububha, nezinkinga zempilo engokwengqondo, okuyizinto ezidinga ukujoliswa ngeso lokho. Izimbangela Zobugebengu Okwamanje, ukuqonda izimbangela zobugebengu kudinga ukuhamba ngemigudu ethile. Ubugebengu buhlala buphakathi kokungabi namsebenzi nokuntuleka kwemali. Emakhelwaneni anobuphofu, abantu bavame ukwenza ubugebengu ukuze bathole imali yokuphila, ikakhulukazi uma izinsiza zikhona kodwa zingasebenzi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubudlelwane obunzima phakathi kwabantu, ukuntuleka kokuthula, nokwehluleka kwesistimu yomthetho kudala izimo ezikhuthaza ubugebengu. Izinga lokuhlukunyezwa komphakathi, okungaholela ebudhedeni nasezinkingeni zomphakathi, lizingela kahle lapho bukhona ubugebengu. Imiphakathi engafinyeleli ezinsizweni ezifanele, njengezemfundo, imisebenzi, nezokwelapha, ibhekana nemiphumela emibi yokuphila, okwenza ubugebengu bube yindlela yokuphila. Ubukhulu Bobugebengu Ubukhulu bobugebengu, obubhalwe ngempela emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu, bufaka kakhulu izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa, ubudlandawonye, nokulwa kwemibango. Ukubulawa kwabantu, izigameko zokweba, kanye nezidakamizwa kuyizinto ezivamile ezidala ukwesaba phakathi kwabantu.

Ukubulawa kwabantu, izigameko zokweba, kanye nezidakamizwa kuyizinto ezivamile ezidala ukwesaba phakathi kwabantu. Abantu banokuhlakazeka, kodwa abadlondlobalisa izigameko zobugebengu abathembi kakhulu emadolobheni, okwenza kube nzima ukwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela. Imithelela Emiphakathini Ukuhlaziywa kwezimo zamakhaya kusiza ukuqonda imithelela yobungozi emiphakathini. Ukuqhuma kwezinga lobugebengu kudala umqondo wokwesaba phakathi kwezinsiza, okwenza umphakathi ube nomqondo wokuhlukana. Lokhu kukhuthaza umkhuba wokuhamba ngaphandle komphakathi, lapho abantu baphuma ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze baphunyeze izinhlelo noma bahlangane. Izixazululo Ezingaba Nempumelelo Ukulwa nobugebengu kudinga imizamo eqinile nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka. Umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngokwakha izinhlelo zemfundo ezichaza izingozi zebhizinisi eziphathelene nobugebengu. Imikhankaso yokulwa nokweba nokuhlukunyezwa, efaka phakathi ukuthola izinsizakusebenza ezifanele, iza nokuzwakala. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibenokubambisana nabantu abahluphekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni eziyimfuneko. Ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi namaphoyisa kubalulekile; lokhu kuzodala ithuba labantu lokwazisa amaphoyisa ngezinkinga zendawo zabo, okwenza kube lula ukumela izinhlelo zokuvikela umphakathi.
Imikhankaso yokulwa nokweba nokuhlukunyezwa, efaka phakathi ukuthola izinsizakusebenza ezifanele, iza nokuzwakala. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibenokubambisana nabantu abahluphekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni eziyimfuneko. Ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi namaphoyisa kubalulekile; lokhu kuzodala ithuba labantu lokwazisa amaphoyisa ngezinkinga zendawo zabo, okwenza kube lula ukumela izinhlelo zokuvikela umphakathi. Isikhumbuzo Sokusebenza Ngokubambisana Ukuze sikwazi ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuqapha izinga lobugebengu emiphakathini yethu. Kufanele sifundise abantu ngezingozi zokuhlukunyezwa futhi sinikeze inkuthalo kumaphrojekthi okuzithandela. Izikhungo zempilo zidinga ukwandiswa ukuze zibe khona ezindaweni eziningi, ukuze zikwazi ukukhuthaza ukwelashwa kwempilo engokwengqondo. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhuthaza imisebenzi engama-hybrid, efaka phakathi izinhlelo zokufunda, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola amakhono ahlukeneyo, egqugquzela ukuhlinzeka ngezindawo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwehlisa izinga lobugebengu, kufinyelele izifiso zempilo engcono. Isiphetho Ngakho-ke, izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu liyinselelo ephakathi nayo yonke imiphakathi. Ukuze kuncishiswe lobu bugebengu, kudinga imizamo eqinile yokubambisana phakathi kwezinsiza, uhulumeni, nezakhamuzi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwezithakazelo, ukudala amathuba okukhula, nokuhlonipha umuntu ngamunye, kusemqoka ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ongenabungozi. Emphakathini lapho abantu bezwa bephila ngaphandle kokuzenzisa, izinga lobugebengu lingancipha, futhi lokhu kuzothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu abaningi.
Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS Ngokuhambisana nezidingo zempilo zabantu abavela ezimbonini ezehlukene, i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS) iyinsiza ebalulekile yokugcina ukuphila kahle kwemisebenzi. Le scheme ithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kumasebenzi kahulumeni futhi ibavumela ukuba bathole imishwana ehlukene yokwelashwa. Okwamanje, i-GEMS inemiphakathi emikhulu, futhi ukwazi okwabiwe kweminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile. Ukuhlelwa Kwezimali Zobulungu Ukuze ube yilungu le-GEMS, kubalulekile ukwenza iminikelo ethile. Le midlalwa ikhokhwa njalo ngenyanga, futhi isebenzisa amazinga ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine. Lokhu kwizinsuku ezisemthethweni, izinkokhelo zibalwa ngemali ethile phakathi kokuhlela abadlali, kufaka phakathi abahlala ngaphansi kwezinsiza eziyisisekelo, eziphakeme, ezibhekelele izimo ezinzima nezifanele. Ezinsukwini zamuva, i-GEMS ithuthukise izinhlelo zayo ukuze zithuthukise ukuhamba kwemali nokwenza kube lula ukwazisa amalungu ngeminikelo yabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile ngababalelwa ezindleleni zokukhokha, okwandisa ukuqonda kwabantu ukucia okukhona emalini abayikhokhayo. Njengoba ukuhlonishwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kudinga ukusekela, kubalulekile ukugxila ekwenzeni iminikelo ngokwakho. Izinsiza Ezinikezwayo Ngokungeziwe kumaholo okhulu, i-GEMS inika ububanzi bezinsiza eziqinile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izikhungo zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukwelashwa emtholampilo, nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile.
Njengoba ukuhlonishwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kudinga ukusekela, kubalulekile ukugxila ekwenzeni iminikelo ngokwakho. Izinsiza Ezinikezwayo Ngokungeziwe kumaholo okhulu, i-GEMS inika ububanzi bezinsiza eziqinile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izikhungo zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukwelashwa emtholampilo, nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile. Ubufakazi bokuba sevesheni yaseGEMS kwaziswe ngabahlali, bethola izinsizakalo ezibhekelela kahle izidingo zabo zempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ilunga le-GEMS kumele azise ngokuqhubekayo ngemali abayikhokhayo ukuze aqiniseke ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Ngokwezinsizakalo eziphezulu, i-GEMS iyasebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zokwelashwa zihlonishwa, futhi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bayaneliseka ngabantu abakhokhelwa. Uhlelo lwama-urgent care lunikezwa ukuze lwenze kube lula ukuhamba kwemali, noyedwa oyisithupha uyakwazi ukukhokha ngamaholo athile. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Nakuba i-GEMS ibonisa ukuphumelela ezindlelweni zayo, akukhona kokuphela okuhle. Abanye amalungu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene babe nezinselele zokukhokha izindleko eziziphakeme, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezidingweni ezimazombezombene. Lokhu kuphakanyiswa kwezimali eziphezulu ezimbalwa kuhlangene nezimo ezingathandeki, njengezindleko eziphezulu zokuhlola kanye nezikhungo zokwelashwa. Ngokuqaphela lokhu, i-GEMS isebenzisa izinqubo ezikhethekile ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga. Amabhodi afaka ukunikeza izixazululo zamasosha ezinkulu ukuze abavote ezindleleni zokuphila. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba phambili kwemali, kulindeleke ukuthi i-GEMS izoshintsha ukuphathwa kwezimali zobulungu bayo.
Ngokuqaphela lokhu, i-GEMS isebenzisa izinqubo ezikhethekile ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga. Amabhodi afaka ukunikeza izixazululo zamasosha ezinkulu ukuze abavote ezindleleni zokuphila. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba phambili kwemali, kulindeleke ukuthi i-GEMS izoshintsha ukuphathwa kwezimali zobulungu bayo. Abalungiswa be-GEMS bahlala bekhuthaza amalungu ukuba babhalise futhi bakhokhe ngokukhululeka. Njengoba impilo ibalulekile, ukuqonda imininingwane ye-GEMS kanye nokukhumbula izidingo zabo, kulindeleke ukuthi i-GEMS ibe yinsiza ebonakalayo phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isiGEMS siyakhula, futhi lichaza ukuthi wonke umuntu onamakhono aweGEMS kufanele aqhubeke nokunakekela, ahlanganise izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, nezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzokhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kabusha kwezempilo walabo abahlala emazweni athile. Ngokujulile, i-GEMS iyinsiza eyaziwa phakathi kwabantu abaningi, futhi iminikelo yubulungu bayo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zihamba phambili. Ukubambisana phakathi kwe-GEMS, amalungu, nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo kuzoba yinsiza eqhubekayo ethinta izizukulwane ezizayo.
Ukufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS (GEMS eligibility and requirements) Ingxoxo noMnu. Zulu, Umeluleki wezeMali Umphakathi: Sawubona, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngokuqonda okufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ungangichazela ukuthi iyini i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyindlela yokwelapha eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi kanye nezihlobo zabo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ungachaza ukuthi ubani ofanele ukujoyina i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ukuze umuntu abe ne-GEMS, kumele abe ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abasebenzi bezikhungo zomphakathi, abaphathi, kanye nabanye abasebenzi abahlinzekwa nguhulumeni. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengeminyango ehlukene, bangakwazi ukujoyina. Umphakathi: Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi i-GEMS igxile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngabe kukhona izidingo ezithile okufanele zifeziwe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujoyina? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kunezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele kube nesivumelwano sokuqashwa esiqhubekayo, okusho ukuthi umsebenzisi kufanele abe ngumsebenzi osebenzayo, hhayi ophumile emsebenzini. Okwesibili, kufanele kube nesivumelwano esibhalwe phansi sokuba ne-GEMS, esivunyelwene phakathi komsebenzi nomqashi. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile okufanele umuntu azithathe ukuze aqinisekise ukufaneleka kwakhe? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, zikhona izinyathelo.
Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile okufanele umuntu azithathe ukuze aqinisekise ukufaneleka kwakhe? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, zikhona izinyathelo. Okokuqala, umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ubhaliswe kahle emnyangweni wakhe, ukuze ulwazi lwakhe luhambisane nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ngemva kwalokho, kufanele ahlole izinhlelo ezitholakalayo ze-GEMS ukuze akhethe eyamukelekayo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kulula. Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile zokuba ne-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, ihlinzeka ngempilo engcono, inezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwelashwa. Okwesibili, inikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha ezahlukene, kusukela ezikhungweni ezinkulu kuya ezincane, futhi inikeza izaphulelo ezinkulu ezindlekweni zokwelashwa. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinto ezithile okufanele abantu bazi ngazo uma bejoyina i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi izinqubo zokubhalisela i-GEMS. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqonda izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, izindleko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukufaneleka ne-GEMS kudinga ukuqonda okuhle. Unganikeza izeluleko kubantu abacabanga ngokujoyina? Mnu. Zulu: Ngempela. Okokuqala, ngincoma ukuthi bahlale bephapheme futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Bafanele baphendule imibuzo ethile, njengokuthi, "Yiziphi izinsizakalo engizidingayo?" noma "Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo?" Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezifanele. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu.

Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukukwabelana ngakho mayelana ne-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baqonda ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsiza ewusizo, kodwa kufanele bazi kahle izinqubo nezidingo ukuze bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa kahle. Futhi, bahlale bexhumana nomnyango wezabasebenzi ukuze bazi izinguquko ezithinta i-GEMS. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinto eziningi ezithakazelisayo. Ukufihla ngokuphelele - ulwazi lwakho lwezokwelapha lugcinwa luqinisekisiwe ngaso sonke isikhathi - ngisho kumqashi wakho. Ukuxhumana namalungu ngezikhathi ezifanele. Bheka: Yimiphi imibhalo okudingeka uyithumele nencwadi yakho yesicelo? Uma ungathanda ukujoyina i-GEMS, kuzodingeka uhlinzeke ngezinkomba eziqinisekisiwe zemibhalo ethile, njengokukhomba wena nomndeni wakho, kanye nefomu lakho lesicelo. Xhumana newebhusayithi www.gems.gov.za ukuze uthole uhlu oluphelele lwemibhalo ongase uyidinge ukuthumela isicelo sakho, noma shayela iCall Centre yethu ku-0860 00 4367. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi uma ungathumelanga zonke izimfuno ezidingekayo, i-GEMS ngeke ikwazi ukukhipha isicelo sakho, futhi kuzoba nezikhathi zokulinda kuze kube zonke izimfuno zatholwa. Njengoba kuvamile, i-GEMS izama ukuk bringa izinzuzo zempilo ezinhle ezihambelana nephakheji yakho. Kuze kube manje, sikwazile ukugcina ukwanda kokuhlanganyela kwakho ngokuhambisana nokwanda kwezindleko zempilo. Ukuhlinzeka ngeminye imikhankaso kuyisibopho sethu kuwe. Kukho inketho yezinzuzo ehambelana nezidingo zempilo zomndeni wakho kanye nephakheji yakho! Lokhu kuyisibopho esiphelele sokuhlanganyela kubo bonke amalungu futhi akukhombisi isibopho somqashi. Uma umqashi elungele ukuthola isibopho somqashi, umqashi uzokhokha ingxenye yesibopho, kanti isiqeshana sizokhokhwa ngumsebenzi.
Kukho inketho yezinzuzo ehambelana nezidingo zempilo zomndeni wakho kanye nephakheji yakho! Lokhu kuyisibopho esiphelele sokuhlanganyela kubo bonke amalungu futhi akukhombisi isibopho somqashi.
