Ithelevishini: Umcimbi Wokuxhumana Nezindaba Ithelevishini, njengomkhiqizo wezobuchwepheshe, ibalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Iqala ukuvela emhlabeni ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1920, kodwa yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu kuphela ngasekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1950. Ngalesi sikhathi, ithelevishini yaguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo ulwazi, behlola izindaba, nezokungcebeleka. Namuhla, ithelevishini isiyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Umcimbi wokwethulwa kwe-thelevishini ungumcimbi obalulekile, owawuhlelwe ngonyaka odlule eGoli. Kwakukhona izinkampani eziningi ezazihlanganyela, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinhlelo ezintsha, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile, lapho abaphathi bephakamisa izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ithelevishini, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile. Baphinde bagcizelele ukuthi ithelevishini ayisiyona nje indlela yokubuka, kodwa iyinsiza yokufundisa, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezethulo ezahlukene ezazihlanganisa izinhlelo ezahlukene, kusukela ezinhlelweni zezingane, ezokungcebeleka, nezokuhlola izindaba. Abadlalayo, ababhali, nabakhiqizi baveze izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezikhuthazayo, nezifundisayo. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo phakathi kwabantu, lapho bekhuluma ngendaba yokuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.
Abadlalayo, ababhali, nabakhiqizi baveze izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezikhuthazayo, nezifundisayo. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo phakathi kwabantu, lapho bekhuluma ngendaba yokuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Abathuthukisi baveze izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana, ezifana ne-4K ne-8K, ezithuthukisa ikhwalithi yokubuka. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphendule ngempela, bephakamisa imibuzo mayelana nezindleko, ukufinyelela, kanye nezidingo zokubuka ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, njengokufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkampani ezinkulu ezikhiqiza ithelevishini, ezazikhombisa izindlela ezintsha zokukhangisa. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi, ababhali, nabadlalayo, njengoba izinkampani zifuna izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezizokhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphinde babuke. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi ezithokozisayo, ezihlanganisa izindaba, ubuciko, nezokungcebeleka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi. Abantu baphakamisa izinkinga ezithinta izinhlelo ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo enkulu, lapho abantu bephakamisa imibono yabo, bephinde bahlola ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi. Abantu baphakamisa izinkinga ezithinta izinhlelo ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo enkulu, lapho abantu bephakamisa imibono yabo, bephinde bahlola ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkampani ezahlukene, abaculi, nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi ezithokozisayo, ezihlanganisa izindaba, ubuciko, nezokungcebeleka. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngokuphetha, ithelevishini iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Umcimbi wokwethulwa kwe-thelevishini ubonisa ukuthi ithelevishini ayisiyona nje indlela yokubuka, kodwa iyinsiza yokufundisa, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sikhuluma ngendaba yokuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yethu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ithelevishini iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Umlando Wezisebenzi Zasezimayini: Iphrofayela kaMnumzane Sipho Mthembu UMnumzane Sipho Mthembu, owazalwa emzaneni ongaphansi kweMkhanyakude, ungumuntu ophuma emndenini wezisebenzi zasezimayini. Uthole imfundo yakhe eyisisekelo esikoleni samabanga aphansi, lapho athola khona ukuqonda okukhulu ngempilo yabantu abasebenza ezimayini. U-Sipho, njengabanye abaningi, wakhulela emndenini owawuhlonipha umsebenzi wezokumbiwa, okwakubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi wakhe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, u-Sipho waqala ukusebenza ezimayini zensimbi, lapho aqala khona khona ukuthola ulwazi olujulile ngalesi sikhungo. Waqala njengomsebenzi ophansi, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bukhula, wathola amathuba okukhula emsebenzini. Wazama ukufunda ngokuqhubekayo, efunda izifundo ezahlukahlukene eziphathelene nezimayini, ukuze akwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono akhe. Njengoba uSipho eqhubeka nokusebenza, waba ingxenye yeqembu elikhulu labantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lezi zisebenzi zazihlanganyela izinkumbulo, zabelana ngemicabango, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ubuholi phakathi kwezisebenzi, waphinde waba yisithombe esihle sokusebenza ngokubambisana. Waqonda ukuthi ukusebenza ndawonye kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuphumelela emsebenzini. Ngaleso sikhathi, waba umholi ophumelelayo, owaziwa ngokukhuthaza abanye, futhi ethuthukisa izinga lempilo yezisebenzi. Ukwazi kwakhe ngemigomo yokusebenza kwaholela ekutheni abamba iqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yokuphucula izimo zokusebenza. Waqala imikhankaso yokuphucula impilo yezisebenzi, efaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izifundo zokuphepha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. U-Sipho wayehlonishwa kakhulu ezindaweni zokusebenza, futhi abantu babemfuna ukuze babonise izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuba uMphakathi Wokusebenza, lapho ahola khona imihlangano yokuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nezikhungo zempilo. Waba yisikhumbuzo sokubambisana, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule izinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo. U-Sipho waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, owawuhlonipha izisebenzi, futhi wathuthukisa izinga lempilo yomphakathi. U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ohloniphekile, ophumelele, futhi onobuholi obuhle. Uhlonishwa kakhulu emkhakheni wezokumbiwa, futhi ubufakazi bokusebenza kwakhe buveza ukuthi, ngokuqhubekayo, abantu bangathuthukisa izimo zabo. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, abantu bangakha imiphakathi eqinile, futhi baphumelele emsebenzini. Uhlanga lwezisebenzi zasezimayini luhlala luhlobene noSipho, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka kumuntu wonke ophila ngaphansi komoya wezokumbiwa. Umlando kaSipho Mthembu ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi, ngokuqhubekayo, abantu bangathola impumelelo ezimayini, futhi baphumelele ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho usaqhubeka nokuba yisibonelo, futhi uthokozisa abanye ukuba balandele izinyathelo zakhe. Uhlanga lwezisebenzi zasezimayini luhlala lukhumbula imizamo yakhe, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele.
Ngonyaka owedlule, ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezwe, uMongameli uMbeki wathi, "Kucacile ukuthi izifiso zabantu bethu zikhombisa ukuthi izwe lethu selingene esigabeni esisha sethemba." Leli themba kube umbiko esiwamukele kubo bonke abantu bethu njengoba sahlala phakathi kwabo sixoxa ngezindaba zokwabiwa kwezimali. Ngesikhathi sihlanganisa le bhajethi, sahamba kuwo wonke amapulazi ale ndawo silalela izifiso zomphakathi ofuna ukubona lezi z allocation zezimali zethulwa namuhla zifeziwe. Abantu abaningi bakhathazekile kakhulu ngendlu, nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezifana namanzi nempilo. Amazwe athuthukayo, kanye nalawo abamba iqhaza emphakathini womhlaba, awanazo izindlela zokwenza izinto zifinyeleleke kubantu ohlelweni lwezimali lapho kutholwa khona izikweletu. Umsebenzi wabantu abampofu ufana nezinkampani ezingakwazi ukukhipha amasheya ukuze zithole ezinye izimali zokusebenza. Ngaphandle kokukwazi ukwenza lokhu, umsebenzi wabo ufana nokuba dead. Abantu abaningi abahlala kulezi zizwe abanakho ukufinyelela izimpahla zabo ukuze zibe yisibambiso sezikweletu. Lokhu kwenza ukukhula komnotho kulezi zizwe kube nzima, nakuba abantu benza zonke izinto ezwenziwa amazwe aseNtshonalanga. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yezomnotho wezokuthengisa. Saqala le ndlela yokuthuthukiswa ngonyaka owedlule sazi kahle ukuthi le ndlela ibanzi futhi izothatha iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokufinyelela endaweni yethu. Saziswa ukuthi singaqala kahle. Asizukushintsha indlela esiqale ngayo. Sizokwenza njalo kulonyaka njengoba siqala. Umthetho Wokwabiwa Kwezimali Wabantu bethu udinga ukuthi silalele imizwa nemibono yabantu abahlukene. Senze kanjalo kulonyaka futhi.
Sizokwenza njalo kulonyaka njengoba siqala. Umthetho Wokwabiwa Kwezimali Wabantu bethu udinga ukuthi silalele imizwa nemibono yabantu abahlukene. Senze kanjalo kulonyaka futhi. Ukubekwa kwezimali kwabantu ngo-2006/07 lapha esifundazweni nasemhlabeni jikelele kubeka izindlela ezicacile ezihlinzeka ngempendulo kulezi zicelo zomphakathi. Ngonyaka ka-2007, akekho ozosisebenzisa amabhakede njengama-toilets. Lesi sifundazwe asizukuhluleka ekufezeni lezi zinhloso zokuthuthukiswa. Yingakho kule bhajethi yalo nyaka kukhona izimali ezengeziwe kuzo zonke izinketho, ikakhulukazi kugcizelelwa uxhaso lwezokwakha. Lokhu kubekwa kwezimali kuzokhombisa izimali ezibekwe eceleni zephrojekthi ezithathwe njengezibalulekile nguMongameli ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezifundazwe ngesonto eledlule. Uma impilo yethu ibiyinhle, sizokwenza siphezu kwani ngoba unyaka udlule? Sethule uhlelo lokuguqula umnotho walesi sifundazwe ngonyaka owedlule ngenkathi sithumela ukwakhiwa kwezimali kuka-2005/06. Njengoba singena esikhathini esisha seminyaka emithathu yokwabiwa kwezimali, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngombiko wokuthi senze kanjani kulezi zabelo ezivela ngonyaka owedlule. Sibe nemiphumela emihle kakhulu ngonyaka owedlule emizamweni yokukhulisa umnotho nokwandisa utshalomali.
Sethule uhlelo lokuguqula umnotho walesi sifundazwe ngonyaka owedlule ngenkathi sithumela ukwakhiwa kwezimali kuka-2005/06. Njengoba singena esikhathini esisha seminyaka emithathu yokwabiwa kwezimali, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngombiko wokuthi senze kanjani kulezi zabelo ezivela ngonyaka owedlule. Sibe nemiphumela emihle kakhulu ngonyaka owedlule emizamweni yokukhulisa umnotho nokwandisa utshalomali. Inhloso yethu enkulu ukuhlela lesi sifundazwe sibe sendaweni ehamba phambili ekuxhumaneni namazwe angaphandle nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukuhlelwa kwalesi sikhwama kuphelile. Ngokufanayo, ibhodi ezobhekelela ukusebenza kwalesi sikhwama ngaphansi kukaThala isiqokonyiswe. Umkhulumeli, lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi siqale lesi sikhwama ukuze sithinte umehluko. Ngakho-ke, simema abatshalizimali abazimele ukuba bazise izinhlelo ezinjalo ezingaphathwa ngaphansi kwalesi sikhwama. Ngonyaka owedlule savakashela ezindaweni ezinhlanu ukuze sikhangise abatshalizimali bangaphandle. Lokhu kuyindlela ebalulekile yokwenza ukuthi lesi sifundazwe sithole izimali ezilethwa ngaphandle. Sihambe sazi eJalimane, e-Italy, eKorea, eJapane, naseNdiya ngonyaka owedlule. Ulwazi oluningi luzothunyelwa esikhathini esizayo mayelana nokusebenza kwalezi zinhlelo. Angidingi ukukukhumbuza ukuba izithunywa ezihloniphekile ukuthi ngonyaka owedlule sathumela ukwakhiwa kwezimali okwakuyisisekelo sokulwa nobuphofu nokwandisa amathuba abantu emnothweni. Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Kwakukhona idolobha elincane, elalaziwa ngokuqina kwalo emsebenzini, elalibizwa ngokuthi uMzimkhulu. Kulolo dolobha, abantu babebambisene ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi lokho kwakuhlanganisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi bawo. Uhlelo lokuqeqesha abasebenzi lwaluvele lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka njalo. Ngolunye usuku, umphakathi waMzimkhulu wahlangana emhlanganweni ophakeme. Umholi wendawo, uMnumzane Mthethwa, wakhuluma ngezinhlelo ezizayo zokuthuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi. "Sifuna ukuba nezinye izindlela zokufunda, ezizokwenza ukuthi sikwazi ukuhamba phambili," kusho yena. "Sizoba nezifundo ezihlukahlukene, ezizothuthukisa amakhono ethu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla." Abasebenzi babebonisa intshisekelo enkulu, futhi balindele ukuba nezinye izifundo ezizobavulela amathuba amaningi. Uhlelo lwabhaliswa, futhi abantu abaningi baphendula ngentshisekelo. Kwakukhona izifundo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe, nezokuphatha. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, njengoba abantu bejabulela ukufunda okusha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, izifundo zaqala. UThandiwe, owayengumsebenzi ophakathi kwezokuxhumana, wathola ithuba lokuhola isifundo sokuxhumana. Wazizwa ejabule, ngoba wayefuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono akhe ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini wakhe. Izifundo zakhula zaba yindawo yokuhlangana, lapho abantu behlanganyela izimvo, benza imisebenzi ethokozisayo, futhi bezama izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana.

Ezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya, noma ngesiNgisi "rural development," yisihloko esibalulekile esihlobene nokukhuphula izinga lempilo kanye nezinga lemfundo, emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Lesi sikhala sithinta izinhlelo ezahlukene ezihlosiwe, ezibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezingqalasizinda. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile, kubalulekile ukubheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izindawo zasemakhaya zihlukaniswe nokutholakala kwezinsiza, izikhungo zezempilo, nezikhungo zemfundo ezikahle. Izindawo eziningi zasemakhaya zihlupheka ngokuntuleka kwezinsiza eziyisisekelo, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile, ukwakha izikole ezinamazinga aphakeme, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo eziphephile, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu basemakhaya. Okwesibili, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho kubaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni komphakathi. Imikhakha efana nezolimo, ubuchwepheshe befu, nezinsizakusebenza kufanele ithuthukiswe ukuze inikeze amathuba emisebenzi. Ngokwesibonelo, ukuvuselela izindlela zokulima, ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nokwakha izimakethe ezikahle ukuze kubonakale imikhiqizo yendawo, kungasiza ekukhuphuleni umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekwakheni imisebenzi emisha, okwenza kube nokwanda kwemali engenayo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesithathu, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele, kungasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya.
Ngokwesibonelo, ukuvuselela izindlela zokulima, ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nokwakha izimakethe ezikahle ukuze kubonakale imikhiqizo yendawo, kungasiza ekukhuphuleni umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekwakheni imisebenzi emisha, okwenza kube nokwanda kwemali engenayo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesithathu, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele, kungasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya. Uhlelo lwezokuthuthukiswa lwezindawo zasemakhaya luyoba khona uma kunokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalezi zingxenye. Lokhu kubambisana kudinga izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bakhuliswa, baziqhenya ngezindawo zabo, futhi babe nesibopho sokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yabo. Imibono efana nokwakha amaqembu omphakathi, ukwakha izikhungo zokufundisana, kanye nokuxhumana ngezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, kuyasiza ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kubalulekile ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo eqhubekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zibhekelele futhi zivikele imvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo ngendlela sustainable, ukwenza izinhlelo zokuqinisa umhlaba, kanye nokuthi abantu basemakhaya bazi kahle ngendaba yokuvikelwa kwemvelo. Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingafunda ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nokwandisa isimo sokuphila kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zidinga ukuhunyushwa ngenhlonipho kumasiko, izinkolelo, kanye nezifiso zabantu bendawo. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqhuba ucwaningo olujulile ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zomphakathi.
Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingafunda ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nokwandisa isimo sokuphila kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zidinga ukuhunyushwa ngenhlonipho kumasiko, izinkolelo, kanye nezifiso zabantu bendawo. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqhuba ucwaningo olujulile ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezifiso nemigomo yomphakathi. Uhlelo oluhambisana nemigomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya lukhombisa ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba babambe iqhaza ezingxoxweni ezithinta izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kudinga ukuqhubeka nokugqugquzela izinguquko ezizwakalayo. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlobene, kanye nokuhlola imiphumela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi izinqubomgomo zithinta kanjani abantu, kanye nokuthi zidinga yini ukuhunyushwa kabusha ukuze zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngakho, ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya akusikho nje kuphela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza, kodwa kuyinqubo ebanzi edinga ubuhlakani, ubumbano, kanye nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwazo zonke izingxenye zomphakathi. Ngaleyondlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela izindawo zasemakhaya, sinikeze abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi sikhulise umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izindawo ezithokozisayo, ezihloniphekayo, nezikhula ngokwezimali, ezilungele ikusasa.
URobertson Colleens unikeza incazelo ebanzi nephakathi kwezobuciko ohlwini lwezenzo ezihlobene ezisemqoka ezihlanganiswa nesiko lesizwe. Isiko lesizwe iyiqoqo lolwazi lwansuku zonke namasiko amakhulu, izici zomphakathi, imibala, nezinkolo. Yakhiwa ngesikhathi nasemcabangweni, okungase kufake isikhathi esisodwa, uhlobo oluhlukile olungakaze luphindwe, futhi, olunzima ukukopisha, izakhiwo, izindawo zokukhulekela, izindawo zokwakha, izinto zomlando. Kodwa ngaphezu kwezakhiwo, ngaphezu kwezinto, sithola ulwazi oluhlelwe noma olungahlelwanga lwezimpilo, imizwa, ukuvuka kwenhliziyo, imibala, amakhambi, nezwi endleleni. Iyiqoqo lezimiso, ukudla, izixazululo, nezindlela zokuziphatha; indlela abantu ababingelelana ngayo, bathandana ngayo, bazonda ngayo, bashadile ngayo, futhi babhujiswa ngayo. Iziphuzo zabo nezimpahla zemakethe yabo. Imali nendlela abayitholayo, bayibala, futhi bayisebenzisa. Indlela abantu abagqoka ngayo, bahamba ngayo, baphuza ngayo, badansa ngayo, bafa ngayo, bahlupheka ngayo, babonga ngayo, futhi ngisho bangenela impi ngayo. Iphunga labo emigwaqweni, izithandazo zabo ezindlini zokukhulekela, nezinkanyezi zabo ezindaweni zokudlala. Imidlalo, abadlali, nezinkundla zezemidlalo. Indlela izingane ezifunda ukuyifunda nokubhala. Izikhali, amathuluzi, amafabrics, amadoli, izindawo zokungena, umculo, amathuluzi, imaski, amabhokisi, amabhidi, imithwalo, izimbiza, izikhali, ama-charm anenhlanhla, ukudla, amaposta, ama-veil, ukukhetha, amakhanda, nezindlela zokuhweba. Imithi, amatshe, izindlela, izintaba, ubuciko bezindlu, izindlu zomlando, kanye nocwaningo lwezinto zakudala.
Indlela izingane ezifunda ukuyifunda nokubhala. Izikhali, amathuluzi, amafabrics, amadoli, izindawo zokungena, umculo, amathuluzi, imaski, amabhokisi, amabhidi, imithwalo, izimbiza, izikhali, ama-charm anenhlanhla, ukudla, amaposta, ama-veil, ukukhetha, amakhanda, nezindlela zokuhweba. Imithi, amatshe, izindlela, izintaba, ubuciko bezindlu, izindlu zomlando, kanye nocwaningo lwezinto zakudala. Iyiwo umhlaba nomqondo wabahlali besikhathi, umuzwa wabo wesikhala, kanye nendaba yabo yemvelo.
Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uSipho, umfana ophuma edolobheni elincane, wathola ithuba lokuba ne-iPhone. Le foni yayiyinsiza ethokozisayo, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezobuchwepheshe. U-Sipho wayephupha ngale foni isikhathi eside, ngenxa yokuhamba kwayo phambili, izici zayo ezithokozisayo, kanye nokuxhumana okungakaze kube khona. U-Sipho wayehlala ekhaya, edlala imidlalo yevidiyo, efunda izincwadi, kodwa wayephupha ngalesi sikhumbuzo esisha. Ngemva kokusebenza kanzima emasimini, uSipho wathola imali eyanele yokuthenga i-iPhone. Wazizwa ejabule kakhulu, njengoba le foni yayizokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabangani bakhe, futhi wayengakwazi ukulinda ukufaka izithombe ezinhle. Ngemuva kokuthenga i-iPhone, uSipho wathola ukuthi le foni yayihamba phambili kakhulu kunalokho ayekucabanga. Izithombe ezithathwe ngale foni zazicace, zikhanya, futhi zikhumbuza izikhathi ezinhle. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ungathumela imiyalezo, abhale izincwadi, futhi abuke amavidiyo kalula. Waqala ukuhamba phambili, efunda izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uSipho waqala ukubona izinselelo ezihambisana ne-iPhone. Abangani bakhe babebonisa izithombe ezinhle, kodwa uSipho wathola ukuthi akakwazi ukuhamba phambili njengabo. U-Sipho waqala ukuzizwa engaphansi, njengoba abanye bejabulile, kanti yena ezwa ubuhlungu bokungabi nalokho abanye abanakho. Waqonda ukuthi i-iPhone, nakuba iyinsiza enkulu, ayikwazi ukuxazulula zonke izinkinga. Wafunda ukuthi ukuxhumana okungokoqobo, okwenziwa ngamehlo, kungcono kunokuxhumana ngefoni. Waqala ukuphila impilo enempilo, edlala ngaphandle, ehamba nabangani, futhi ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle.
Waqonda ukuthi i-iPhone, nakuba iyinsiza enkulu, ayikwazi ukuxazulula zonke izinkinga. Wafunda ukuthi ukuxhumana okungokoqobo, okwenziwa ngamehlo, kungcono kunokuxhumana ngefoni. Waqala ukuphila impilo enempilo, edlala ngaphandle, ehamba nabangani, futhi ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-iPhone yayiyinsiza, kodwa akufanele ibe yinto eyodwa kuphela empilweni yakhe. Waqhubeka nokusebenzisa i-iPhone, kodwa wayephinde abuyele ezindleleni zakhe zendabuko. Waqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano obuqinile nabangani bakhe, kanye nezikhathi ezijabulisayo, zibaluleke kakhulu kunokuba ne-iPhone. Ekugcineni, uSipho wathola ibhalansi phakathi kokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kanye nokuphila impilo enempilo. Waqhubeka nokuthokozisa izithombe ezinhle, kodwa wayephinde abuyele emhlabeni wangempela, lapho ubudlelwano bukhula khona. U-Sipho waba nesifundo esibalulekile: i-iPhone ingaba yinsiza, kodwa impilo yangempela iyinhloso enkulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho wathola injabulo empilweni yakhe, eqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano, uthando, nokuxhumana okungokoqobo kuyizinto ezibaluleke kakhulu. I-iPhone yayiyinsiza, kodwa impilo yayiyinsiza enkulu. U-Sipho waphila impilo egcwele, ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle, futhi waba nesifundo esibalulekile sokuthi ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube yinsiza, hhayi umphumela. Ngakho, uSipho waqhubeka nokuphila impilo yakhe, ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle, futhi eqonda ukuthi i-iPhone yayiyinsiza, kodwa ubudlelwano bukhula kakhulu.
Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izigameko Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuphathwa ngokushesha nangokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphepha kweziguli. Ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zinyathelo, kubalulekile ukuba neziqu ezithile, ulwazi, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Nansi imiyalelo ecacile yokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela. Isigaba 1: Ukubona Isimo Esiphuthumayo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukubona isimo esiphuthumayo. Lokhu kungaba yisiguli esingaphenduli, esinezinhlungu ezinzima, noma esinokuphazamiseka kokuphefumula. Uma ubona isimo esinjalo, qinisekisa ukuthi ungena endaweni ephephile. Bheka izimpawu ezithile, njengokushaywa kwenhliziyo, ukungaphefumuli, noma ukungaphenduli. Isigaba 2: Ukuxhumana Nethimba Lezempilo Ngemuva kokubona isimo, xhumana nethimba lezempilo ngokushesha. Lokhu kungafaka ukushaya ucingo kumphakathi wezokwelapha noma ukucela usizo kumphakathi wezokwelapha. Qinisekisa ukuthi unikeza imininingwane ecacile, efana nesimo sesiguli, izimpawu ezibonakalayo, kanye nezinyathelo ozithathile. Isigaba 3: Ukuphatha Isimo Esiphuthumayo Uma usuthole usizo, qala ukuphatha isimo. Lokhu kungafaka: 1. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlungu: Uma isiguli sikhala ngezinkinga, sebenzisa izindlela zokuphatha izinhlungu ezifanele, njengokunikeza imithi yokuthambisa. Ukuphefumula: Uma isiguli singaphenduli kahle, hlola ukuphefumula kwaso. Uma kudingeka, sebenzisa izindlela zokuphefumula ezifanele, njengokusebenzisa umshini wokuphefumula. Ukubeka Isiguli Endaweni Ephumelelayo: Qinisekisa ukuthi isiguli sikhululekile futhi sikhululekile.
Ukuphefumula: Uma isiguli singaphenduli kahle, hlola ukuphefumula kwaso. Uma kudingeka, sebenzisa izindlela zokuphefumula ezifanele, njengokusebenzisa umshini wokuphefumula. Ukubeka Isiguli Endaweni Ephumelelayo: Qinisekisa ukuthi isiguli sikhululekile futhi sikhululekile. Lokhu kungafaka ukususa izinto eziphazamisayo noma ukuhlela indawo ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela. Isigaba 4: Ukuqapha Isimo Sesiguli Ngemuva kokuphatha isimo, qhubeka uqapha isiguli. Bheka izinguquko ezinkulu ezimweni zempilo, njengokushintsha kokuphefumula, ukushaywa kwenhliziyo, noma izimpawu zokuphuma. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinguquko ezidinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Isigaba 5: Ukubika Isimo Ngemuva kokuphatha isimo, kubalulekile ukubika isimo kumphakathi wezokwelapha. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezidingekayo zokwelashwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi ubika zonke izinyathelo ozithathile, izimpawu ezibonakalayo, kanye nezinguquko ezitholakele. Isigaba 6: Ukubuyekeza Nokufunda Ngemuva kokuphatha isimo, kubalulekile ukubuyekeza izinyathelo ezithathwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda ezimweni eziphuthumayo ezizayo. Bheka ukuthi yini eyasebenza kahle, nokuthi yini engasebenza kangcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Isigaba 7: Ukuqeqesha Abasebenzi Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazi kahle izinqubo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazithatha kanjani.
Isigaba 7: Ukuqeqesha Abasebenzi Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazi kahle izinqubo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazithatha kanjani. Isigaba 8: Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokwelapha Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukubambisana nezikhungo zokwelapha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi unokuxhumana okuhle nezikhungo zokwelapha, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo zilandelwa. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela ngempumelelo. Kubalulekile ukuba neziqu ezithile, ulwazi, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uqinisekise impilo nokuphepha kweziguli. Qhubeka uqeqesha futhi uthuthukise izinqubo zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungakwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngempumelelo.
Ezomshwalense: Ukuqonda Kwezinsizakalo Zokuqinisekisa Ezomshwalense, noma insurance ngesiNgisi, ziwumqondo obalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Kukhona izimo eziningi ezithinta abantu, imindeni, kanye nezinkampani, futhi ezomshwalense ziwusizo ukuze kuphumelelwe ukuvikela abantu kulokhu okungase kwenzeke. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba empilweni, asikwazi ukwazi ukuthi imiphumela ezithile izoba kanjani, futhi ezomshwalense ziwusizo ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi, uma kwenzeka okuthile, sizobe sinesiqinisekiso sokuthi sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ukwakhiwa Kwezomshwalense Umqondo wezomshwalense uqala ngezimali, lapho umuntu noma inkampani ekhombisa isifiso sokuvikela impahla yabo noma impilo yabo. Lokhu kuvame ukwenza ngokuhola imali ethile, eyaziwa ngokuthi imishwalense, enhlanganweni ethile eyaziwayo njengezinkampani zomshwalense. Lezi zinkampani ziwumgogodla wezomshwalense; zenziwa ukuze ziqoqe le mali, bese ziwasebenzisa ukuze zikhokhele abanikazi bazo uma beface izinkinga ezithile. Izinhlelo Zomshwalense Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zomshwalense, futhi ngasinye sinezinjongo ezithile. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngomswalense wezempilo, ovikela abantu ezindlekweni zempilo, ezifana nezindleko zokwelashwa. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izindleko zokwelapha zingase zibe phezulu kakhulu, futhi zingabiza abantu impilo yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umshwalense wezempilo ungase unikeze umuntu ithuba lokwelashwa ngokushesha, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Okwesibili, kukhona umshwalense wezimpahla, okhathalela ukuvikela impahla yomuntu, njengemoto, ikhaya, noma impahla yebhizinisi.
Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izindleko zokwelapha zingase zibe phezulu kakhulu, futhi zingabiza abantu impilo yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umshwalense wezempilo ungase unikeze umuntu ithuba lokwelashwa ngokushesha, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Okwesibili, kukhona umshwalense wezimpahla, okhathalela ukuvikela impahla yomuntu, njengemoto, ikhaya, noma impahla yebhizinisi. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi impahla yephukile, ibhuloshiwe, noma ibhujiswe, umshwalense ungakhokhela umnikazi wayo izindleko zokulungisa noma zokuthenga entsha. Okwesithathu, sikhuluma ngomswalense wokuphila. Le nhlangano ivikela umndeni uma umnikazi wemishwalense eshintsha, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi umndeni uthola imali ethile ukuze uqhubeke nokuphila ngendlela efanayo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu, njengoba kungasiza ukuvikela abantu abaseduze nomnikazi ngesikhathi sokulahlekelwa. Ukubaluleka Kwezomshwalense Ukubaluleka kwezomshwalense akungabazi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uma kwenzeka okuthile, abantu abathintekayo bazoba nekhono lokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Ngaphandle kwesimo sokwelashwa, umshwalense ungavikela umuntu emishwalense ethinta izimo zokuphila, ezinjengokuphazamiseka emsebenzini noma ukulahlekelwa yimpahla. Izingxoxo ezijulile zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abathola umshwalense bahlala benokuthula kwengqondo, ngoba bazi ukuthi bakhululekile uma kwenzeka ukuphazamiseka. Izindleko Zomshwalense Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda nezindleko ezithintekayo. Imishwalense ivamise ukutholakala ngemali ethile, futhi lezi zindleko zingahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomshwalense, izinga lokuvikeleka, kanye nezimo zomuntu.
Izingxoxo ezijulile zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abathola umshwalense bahlala benokuthula kwengqondo, ngoba bazi ukuthi bakhululekile uma kwenzeka ukuphazamiseka. Izindleko Zomshwalense Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda nezindleko ezithintekayo. Imishwalense ivamise ukutholakala ngemali ethile, futhi lezi zindleko zingahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomshwalense, izinga lokuvikeleka, kanye nezimo zomuntu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba abantu bahlolisise kahle izinketho zabo, ukuze bakhethe umshwalense ofanele izidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi izindleko zomshwalense zikhula uma umkhawulo wempilo yabo noma uma izinga lempilo lishintsha. Ukukhetha Umshwalense Lapho ukhetha umshwalense, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akukhona konke okubukeka kahle okukhangayo. Kubalulekile ukufunda imibiko, ukuqhathanisa izinkampani ezihlukene, nokuhlola izibuyekezo zabanye abantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba ukhethe inkampani yezezimali enokwethenjelwa, ehloniphekile, futhi enezinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ukuhlola lezi zinto kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela umakhalekhukhwini, umndeni, noma ibhizinisi. Isiphetho Ezomshwalense ziwumqondo obalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Zisiza ukuvikela abantu, imindeni, kanye nezinkampani ezimeni ezinzima, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu basenkingeni bangathola usizo olufanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukufunda nokwazisa izinsizakalo zomshwalense, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nezihlakaniphile ekukhetheni umshwalense ofanele izidingo zabo. Ngale ndlela, sizoba nekhono lokubhekana nezimo ezinzima, sibe nekhono lokuphila impilo enokuthula kwengqondo.
Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona: Ukuhlola Umthelela Wazo Empilweni Yethu Izifo ezingamahlalakhona, ezaziwa nangokuthi izifo ezihlala isikhathi eside, zibe yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni wonke. Lezi zifo, ezifana nesifo sikashukela, umoya, nezinto eziningi ezihlobene, zihlala zikhona empilweni yomuntu futhi zishiya umthelela omkhulu emzimbeni nasempilweni yengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zifo zidinga ukwelashwa okuqhubekayo, futhi zishintsha indlela esiphila ngayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi izifo ezingamahlalakhona azithinti kuphela umguli, kodwa ziba nomthelela emndenini nasemphakathini. Umuntu onezifo ezingamahlalakhona ubhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukwelashwa okungapheli, izindleko eziphezulu zokwelashwa, kanye nezinguquko ezinjengokuphila kwansuku zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukusekelwa okuqinile, hhayi kuphela kumndeni, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Umndeni udinga ukufunda ukuhamba nomguli, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle nokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhombisa ukuthi impilo yethu iyinselele. Umuntu ophila nesifo sikashukela, isibonelo, udinga ukulawula ukudla kwakhe, ahlale eqapha amazinga akhe kashukela, futhi aqaphele impilo yakhe yonke. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu, futhi kungaholela ekudambiseni umoya uma umguli engatholi ukwesekwa okwanele. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde lezi zinkinga ukuze kusebenze ekwakheni izixazululo. Njengoba izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhula, ziba yinkinga enkulu kwezempilo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izifo ezinjengokukhuluphala, umoya, nesifo sikashukela zikhula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile, ngenxa yezinto eziningi ezifana nezindlela zokuphila, ukudla okungafanele, kanye nezinga lokungasebenzi.
Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde lezi zinkinga ukuze kusebenze ekwakheni izixazululo. Njengoba izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhula, ziba yinkinga enkulu kwezempilo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izifo ezinjengokukhuluphala, umoya, nesifo sikashukela zikhula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile, ngenxa yezinto eziningi ezifana nezindlela zokuphila, ukudla okungafanele, kanye nezinga lokungasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, siqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukudla okunempilo, futhi sithuthukise imikhuba yokuzivocavoca. Nokho, akusikho konke okubi; izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Abantu abaningi baye bathola ukuthi uma bephila kahle, bahlala bejabulile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona. Ekugcineni, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhombisa ukuthi impilo yethu ayilula, futhi zidinga ukusekelwa okuqinile. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda lezi zinkinga ukuze sikwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi. Asithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi. Izifo ezingamahlalakhona zingaba yinkinga enkulu, kodwa uma sikhuthaza impilo enempilo, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, okuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Faka isicelo ngokwezidingo zakho! Ubani ongafaka isicelo sezidingo? Noma ubani ngaphandle kwezinkampani ezibhaliswe ngokuqondile emthethweni kanye nezinhlangano. Umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 kumele asizwe ngumzali wakhe noma umgibeli ofanele. Ubani ongafunwa ngezidingo? Ngaphandle kukahulumeni, noma ubani angafunwa kuhlanganise nezinkampani, izinhlangano, imiphakathi, kanye nanoma yini esebenza endaweni ephethwe yilelo qembu. Yimalini engaphezulu kokuthi ingafunwa? Imali engaphezu kuka-R7000. Uma izidingo zakho zidlula u-R7000, ungafaka izicelo zemali engaphansi kwalokho ukuze isicelo sakho samukelwe enkantolo yezicelo ezincane. Yiziphi izimangalo ezingathathwa kule nkantolo? Izicelo zemali ezidlula u-R7000. Izicelo eziphikisana nohulumeni. Izicelo ezihlobene nesimo sokucabanga somuntu. Izicelo ezicela isenzo esithile esingavumeli ukukhokhelwa, ngaphandle kwezimo ezihilela ukudluliswa kwezinsiza noma impahla ezinzile noma ezihambayo ezidlula u-R7000 ngenani. Ingabe udinga ukufaka enkantolo yezicelo ezincane? Cha, ungakhetha ukuthi ufuna ukufaka enkantolo yezicelo ezincane noma enye inkantolo engakwazi ukulalela icala lakho. Ukuze uthole ummeli kanye nosizo lwabo ekulungiseleleni isicelo. Awuvunyelwe ukuba umelwe ummeli ojwayelekile noma omdala. Nokho, ngentengo yakho, ungacela iseluleko kumemeli ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke. Abasebenzi benkantolo kanye nosizo lwezomthetho enkantolo yezicelo ezincane bangakusiza ngaphandle kokukhokha. Noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika lungasetshenziswa kule nkantolo.
Nokho, ngentengo yakho, ungacela iseluleko kumemeli ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke. Abasebenzi benkantolo kanye nosizo lwezomthetho enkantolo yezicelo ezincane bangakusiza ngaphandle kokukhokha. Noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika lungasetshenziswa kule nkantolo. Kumele uhambisane kusenesikhathi nomlomo wenkantolo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona umhumushi uma ubufakazi buzokhulumelwa ngolimi olungaqondakali kahle komunye wabantu abathintekayo. Xwayisa umphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa naye isicelo) ngqo, ngocingo, noma ngencwadi, ubacela ukuthi banelise izidingo zakho. Uma umphikisi engaphenduli esicelweni sakho, bhala incwadi yokufunwa (echaza zonke izimo zokufunwa, kuhlanganise nenani lezidingo zakho) ubanikeze ezinsukwini eziyi-14 kusukela ngosuku abathola ngalo incwadi yokufunwa ukuze banelise izidingo zakho. Thumela incwadi yokufunwa kumphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa naye isicelo) ngesandla noma ngeposi ebhalisiwe. Ngemva kwezinsuku eziyi-14, kumele uye ngqo kumlomo wenkantolo ulethe ubufakazi bokuthi uthumele incwadi yokufunwa kumphikisi. Noma iyiphi incwadi yokuvumelana noma ukuqinisekiswa kwezimo zokufunwa kwakho. Igama eliphelele kanye nekheli (ikhaya, kanye nekheli lomsebenzi, uma likhona) kanye nenombolo yocingo yomphikisi. Bona kanye nosizo lwabo lwezomthetho bazobuyekeza imibhalo onayo futhi bakusize ekubhaleni isikhumbuzo esilula. Uzobhala isikhumbuzo abasinikezayo. Yini okufanele uyenze ngesikhumbuzo? Ungasithumela ngesandla kumphikisi. Ungaphinde unikeze isikhumbuzo kumshushisi (umuntu) lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, ukuze umshushisi akwazi ukusithumela kumphikisi.
Yini okufanele uyenze ngesikhumbuzo? Ungasithumela ngesandla kumphikisi. Ungaphinde unikeze isikhumbuzo kumshushisi (umuntu) lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, ukuze umshushisi akwazi ukusithumela kumphikisi. Yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo? Uma usithumele kumshushisi, kumele uthole ubufakazi bokuthi wenze kanjalo ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela. Gcina incwadi yokuvumelana noma noma iyiphi incwadi eqinisekisa izimo zesikhumbuzo osenzayo. Xwayisa abafakizolo bakho ngalesi sikhathi nosuku lokulalela bese uhlela ukuba babe khona enkantolo ngaleso sikhathi esishiwo. Bangase basebenze ekwenzeni izidingo zomfaki-sicelo. Bangathumela isitatimende esibhalwe phansi kumlomo wenkantolo, esiqukethe imininingwane nezimo zokuzivikela kwabo, bese bethumela ikhophi kumfaki-sicelo. Bangafaka izicelo zabo zokuphikisa ngokuletha isitatimende esiqukethe imininingwane edingekayo yesikhumbuzo kumlomo wenkantolo. Uma kukhona izicelo zokuphikisa noma izicelo zokuphikisa, icala kufanele liqhubeke nokulalela. Yini okufanele uyenze uma umphikisi ebelise izidingo zakho? Xwayisa ummemezeli wenkantolo ngokushesha ukuthi izidingo zakho zanelisiwe futhi ukuthi awusoze uqhubeke nalesi sihloko. Yini okufanele uyenze ngosuku nosuku lokulalela? Kumele uvele enkantolo uqobo. Inqubo yokulalela ayisemthethweni futhi ilula. Umphakathi wenkantolo uzokubuza ukuthi uveze icala lakho. Bika icala ngamagama akho ngokucacile nangokunembile. Awuvunyelwe ukubuza imibuzo phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, ngemvume yomphakathi, ungabuza imibuzo embalwa kumphikisi.
Bika icala ngamagama akho ngokucacile nangokunembile. Awuvunyelwe ukubuza imibuzo phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, ngemvume yomphakathi, ungabuza imibuzo embalwa kumphikisi. Lalela kahle umphikisi uma echaza, futhi uma ucabanga ukuthi abakhulumi kahle, qaphela noma yiziphi izingxenye ukuze uzilethele emqondweni womphakathi. Uma umphakathi esekhulume ngalokho okukhuluma wena nomphikisi kanye nabafakizolo abangase babe khona, inkantolo izokhipha isinqumo. Umphakathi angase akwazise ukuthi uzokuthumelela isinqumo sabo ngokubhala kamuva. Akekho ophikisa isinqumo noma umyalo wenkantolo. Ukuphathwa kwalolo cala kubalulekile kakhulu. Isinqumo senkantolo siyi-final, ngaphandle uma kukhona isizathu esivumelekile sokuphikisa. Khokha noma yiziphi izindleko ezibekwe yinkantolo kuwe. Izindleko ezingaba khona yilezo umphaki-sicelo angazithola ngokukhokha umshushisi. Landela isinqumo senkantolo. Umphikisi uzokhokha inani lesinqumo kuwe ngokushesha uma enalo. Mnika i-receipt yalolo nani ngokushesha. Uma umphikisi engakwazi ukuhambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ngokushesha, inkantolo izobuza ngesimo sabo sezimali nokuthi bangakukhokhela yini mayelana nesinqumo nezindleko futhi izokhipha isinqumo ngalokho. Uma umphikisi othole icala engahambisani nesinqumo noma isinqumo senkantolo yezicelo ezincane futhi ufuna ukuqhubekisela phambili leso sinqumo, icala lidluliselwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, futhi lizolalelwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wenkantolo YamaMagistrate, 1944 (Umthetho 32 ka-1944). Kubalulekile ukuthola ummeli ukuze ulalelwe kwalolu cala.
Uma umphikisi engakwazi ukuhambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ngokushesha, inkantolo izobuza ngesimo sabo sezimali nokuthi bangakukhokhela yini mayelana nesinqumo nezindleko futhi izokhipha isinqumo ngalokho. Uma umphikisi othole icala engahambisani nesinqumo noma isinqumo senkantolo yezicelo ezincane futhi ufuna ukuqhubekisela phambili leso sinqumo, icala lidluliselwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, futhi lizolalelwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wenkantolo YamaMagistrate, 1944 (Umthetho 32 ka-1944). Kubalulekile ukuthola ummeli ukuze ulalelwe kwalolu cala. Le pamphlet ikwazisa ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele zilandelwe mayelana nokufaka isicelo enkantolo yezicelo ezincane. Uma udinga usizo nganoma yini, ikheli nenombolo yocingo yomlomo wenkantolo yezicelo ezincane zitholakala enkantolo yakho yendawo ye-magistrate. Uhlelo lunikeza isikhathi esiphelele semizuzu engama-30 nezinsuku eziyisithupha zokuzilolonga. Izikhathi ezitholakalayo zisetshenziselwa ukusukela ngo-08:30 kuya ku-15:00, okuhlanganisa nemizuzu engama-30 yokuphuza itiye, imizuzu engama-30 yokudla, nemizuzu eyi-10 yokwethula nokuphetha. Lokhu kushiya amahora ama-5 nemizuzu engama-30 yokuzilolonga. Kubalulekile kumfundisi ukuba aqonde izikhathi zokuphuza itiye nokudla. Izikhathi ezitholakalayo zabelwa ngaphezulu, futhi abafundisi kumele bahlale beqaphela isikhathi sohlelo ngalunye ukuze bangaphuthelwa. Le mikhombandlela izokhombisa umfundi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda isigaba ngasinye sokuzilolonga. Ungazami ukusebenzisa amagama abhalwe njengoba kukhulunywa encwadini yokuzilolonga. Sebenzisa amagama akho. Le yindlela kuphela ongazwakala ngayo kahle futhi uqiniseke. Futhi, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka ngqo kubabambiqhaza ngesikhathi sokuzilolonga ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bayabambisana nalabo obasiza. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle uhlelo lokuzilolonga nokuthi ufundile zonke izigaba zencwadi yokuzilolonga ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuzilolonga. Amalungu eqembu angakubuza imibuzo mayelana nezinkinga ezizobhekwa ezigabeni ezilandelayo zencwadi yokuzilolonga, futhi kuzongasiza isikhathi uma ungabatshela ukuthi imibuzo yabo izophendulwa njengoba ukuzilolonga kuqhubeka. Qaphela ukuthi ezinye imibuzo zingase zingaphendulwa kulezi zifundo kodwa zingase zibe nezincazelo ezizayo. Incwadi yokuzilolonga ibhalwe futhi ihlelwe ikakhulukazi njengethuluzi lokubuyisela emuva noma nini uma kudingeka ulwazi oluthile.
Amalungu eqembu angakubuza imibuzo mayelana nezinkinga ezizobhekwa ezigabeni ezilandelayo zencwadi yokuzilolonga, futhi kuzongasiza isikhathi uma ungabatshela ukuthi imibuzo yabo izophendulwa njengoba ukuzilolonga kuqhubeka. Qaphela ukuthi ezinye imibuzo zingase zingaphendulwa kulezi zifundo kodwa zingase zibe nezincazelo ezizayo. Incwadi yokuzilolonga ibhalwe futhi ihlelwe ikakhulukazi njengethuluzi lokubuyisela emuva noma nini uma kudingeka ulwazi oluthile. Zama ukuthola abafundi kuzo zonke izigaba zencwadi yokuzilolonga ukuze ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo zokubuyela uma bedingeka emva kokuzilolonga. Ngamanye amazwi, umsebenzi obalulekile walezi zifundo ukwenza incwadi yokuzilolonga ibe lula ukuyisebenzisa futhi iqonde kahle ukuze ibe yisisekelo solwazi esingabuyiselwa emuva esikhathini esizayo. Qiniseka ukuthi abafundi baqonda ukuthi ngeke bavule ikhasi le ncwadi eliphezu - kunalokho, bazothunyelwa ezigabeni ezithile ezibalulekile. Yiba nomusa kulabo abangase babe nezinkinga zokufunda nokubhala. Nakuba imisebenzi kule ncwadi ilandela indawo yokubhala izimpendulo, kubalulekile ukugqamisa ukuthi kuncike kumuntu ngamunye ukuthi ufuna yini ukubhala encwadini yabo. Batshele ukuthi njengoba iningi lale misebenzi lizokwenziwa ngamaqembu, kulungile ukuthi abantu babambe iqhaza ngokuqhubekayo kuphela. Gqamisa ukuthi abantu akufanele bakhathazeke ngokubuza imibuzo. Batshele wonke umuntu ukuthi kungenzeka kube nabanye abanemibuzo efanayo kodwa besaba ukuyibuza. Uma abantu bebuza imibuzo, bakhombisa ukulangazelela ukufunda izinto ezintsha, okungukuhle - kumele bakhumbule, "ulwazi luwumsebenzi!" Chaza ukuthi ungubani. Khuluma ukuthi kunezigaba ezintathu zokuzilolonga ezihlanganisa izihloko ezahlukene eziphathelene nomsebenzi wezinkomidi zomphakathi.
Uma abantu bebuza imibuzo, bakhombisa ukulangazelela ukufunda izinto ezintsha, okungukuhle - kumele bakhumbule, "ulwazi luwumsebenzi!" Chaza ukuthi ungubani. Khuluma ukuthi kunezigaba ezintathu zokuzilolonga ezihlanganisa izihloko ezahlukene eziphathelene nomsebenzi wezinkomidi zomphakathi. Uma unolwazi, batshele abafundi ukuthi uzilolonga nini futhi kuphi izifundo ezimbili ezilandelayo. Baphathe ngemininingwane yonke ephathelene nalokho okukhuluma ngakho. Kuphi izindawo zokuhlala ngesikhathi sokuphuza itiye nokudla, futhi nini ukufunda kuphetha? Yini ezikhulumayo ezihambelana nezinhlelo zokuhamba, njengoba kushiwo yilabo abathunyelwe yihhovisi elizokhokhela, hhayi uMnyango noma i-DBSA? Izikhathi zokubhema azikhuthazwa ngoba isikhathi sinqunyelwe futhi sibalwa. Amafoni kufanele apagwe. Khuluma kafushane ngendlela incwadi yokuzilolonga ehlelwe ngayo. Chaza ukuthi ulwazi olungeziwe lutholakala ngasohlangothini futhi ukuthi uphawu ngalunye lumele ulwazi oluthile oluhlukile. Khuluma kafushane ukuthi uphawu ngalunye lumele ini. Umhlahlandlela womfundisi wokusebenzisa incwadi yokuzilolonga. Kungani ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kubalulekile? Thola esigabeni a-d ngaphansi kokwethulwa ukuthi iyiphi imithetho ephethe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yiziphi izindawo ezibalulekile zeMthetho Wezindleko Zempahla Zomkhandlu ezidinga ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yenza lo msebenzi ngamaqembu ama-4 noma ama-5. Buza amaqembu ukuthi abhale izindlela umphakathi angabamba ngazo iqhaza ezindabeni zikamasipala. Batshele iqembu ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kube isigaba esibaluleke kakhulu kule ncwadi yokuzilolonga. Yenza umsebenzi kuqala ukuze uthole ukuthi izindawo zabo zokukhathazeka zikhona kuphi.
Buza amaqembu ukuthi abhale izindlela umphakathi angabamba ngazo iqhaza ezindabeni zikamasipala. Batshele iqembu ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kube isigaba esibaluleke kakhulu kule ncwadi yokuzilolonga. Thola isigaba 7 - khombisa ukuthi imikhawulo yemikhombandlela kufanele ifakwe. Thola isigaba 2 - khombisa ukuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha kufanele ifakwe. Batshele iqembu ukuthi "ihhovisi lesikhulumi" kufanele likwazi ukubanika isibonakaliso sokuthi bangathola kuphi amakhophi emithetho efanele abadinga ukuyazi. Ngomkhandlu womkhandlu - bheka 6. Khansela umkhandlu - bheka 6. Amalungu omkhandlu - bheka 6.4 esigabeni. Yini indima yesikhulumi kulolu hlelo Inombolo 7.3 esigabeni ixoxa ngenkhetho yamalungu omkhandlu - chaza kafushane ukuthi umphakathi wesikhulumi nomkhulumeli kufanele benze ini kulolu hlelo lokhetho lwamalungu omkhandlu? Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi isigaba 6 singabatholela ulwazi olufingqiwe ngenketho nezindlela zokuvota. Yini ukwakhiwa kwamakhono? Ukukhuthaza amalungu ukuba bakwazi ukusebenzisa amandla abo, ukwenza imisebenzi yabo, nokudlala izindima zabo. Kungani kudingeka sakhe amakhono? Yenza lo msebenzi ngamaqembu ama-4 noma ama-5. Thola inombolo 5 yesigaba - khuluma kafushane ngezinto ezinemibhalo. Umkhandlu ungawuqinisekisa kanjani ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezithengekayo? Gqamisa ukuthi kubalulekile kumphakathi ukuba wazi ngezinsizakalo abazozithola. Ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ikakhulukazi, abantu bavame ukuqhathanisa izinsizakalo zabo nezasezindaweni ezincane nezinkulu, futhi ngalokho abaneliseki nhlobo.
Umkhandlu ungawuqinisekisa kanjani ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezithengekayo? Gqamisa ukuthi kubalulekile kumphakathi ukuba wazi ngezinsizakalo abazozithola. Ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ikakhulukazi, abantu bavame ukuqhathanisa izinsizakalo zabo nezasezindaweni ezincane nezinkulu, futhi ngalokho abaneliseki nhlobo. Batshele iqembu ukuthi kubalulekile kumkhandlu wabo ukuba acacise amazinga wezinsizakalo futhi abakhombise ithebula inombolo 4.1 nokuthi amazinga wezinsizakalo axhunyaniswe nalokho abantu abangakwazi ukukhokha. Ubani onesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo? Ikakhulu umkhandlu, kodwa kaningi umkhandlu awukwazi ukwenza lokhu ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zezimali/ukusebenza. Chaza kafushane ngakho konke okukhuluma ngenhla - bheka inombolo 3 yesigaba yiziphi indima yomkhandlu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo? Xoxa ngemithetho ehola umkhandlu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo. Chaza imithetho yokuphatha kahle - inombolo 8. Kungani imikhandlu inama-MSP? Ngesinye isikhathi imikhandlu ayinazo izinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Chaza iqembu ukuthi indima yabo njengomkhandlu inqubo ye-IDP! Isahluko 1: Ukwethula Isihloko Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo. Le nqubo ibandakanya ukuqoqa imininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nesiguli, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Lokhu kubhaliswa kungabandakanya imininingwane efana negama lesiguli, iminyaka, ikheli, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukubhaliswa kweziguli akusizi kuphela odokotela, kodwa futhi kusiza iziguli uqobo ukuze ziqonde izinqubo ezithinta impilo yazo. Isahluko 2: Izizathu Zokubhaliswa Izizathu zokubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela ziningi. Okokuqala, lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi isiguli sithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngaphandle kokubhaliswa, odokotela bangase bangazi kahle umlando wezempilo wesiguli, okungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingalungile. Okwesibili, ukubhaliswa kusiza ekulawuleni izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izibhedlela zidinga ukwazi ukuthi zingakanani iziguli ezizozidinga ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele. Isahluko 3: Inqubo Yokubhaliswa Inqubo yokubhaliswa kweziguli ivamise ukuba lula. Ngokuvamile, isiguli siza ezibhedlela, sithola ifomu lokubhaliswa, bese sithumele imininingwane edingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa igama, ubudala, ikheli, nemininingwane yokuxhumana, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokwelashwa edingekayo. Ngemuva kokugcwalisa ifomu, izisebenzi zezempilo zihlola imininingwane futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane ibhalwe kahle. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okuphuthelwe, okungaholela ezinkingeni ngesikhathi sokwelashwa. Isahluko 4: Imininingwane Ebalulekile Imininingwane ethile edingekayo ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa ibalulekile.
Ngemuva kokugcwalisa ifomu, izisebenzi zezempilo zihlola imininingwane futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane ibhalwe kahle. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okuphuthelwe, okungaholela ezinkingeni ngesikhathi sokwelashwa. Isahluko 4: Imininingwane Ebalulekile Imininingwane ethile edingekayo ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa ibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa umlando wezempilo wesiguli, okungaba khona kwezifo ezithile, imishanguzo ethathwayo, kanye nemikhuba yokuphila. Lokhu kusebenza njengesisekelo sokuhlola isiguli, ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukuhlela ukwelashwa okufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imininingwane yokuhlanganyela, njengezithombe zempilo, ingase ibaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isiguli sithola ukunakekelwa okuhle. Isahluko 5: Ukubaluleka Kokubhaliswa Okuhle Ukubhaliswa okuhle kubaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imininingwane edingekayo kufanele igcinwe iphephile futhi ifinyeleleke kalula. Izibhedlela kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zilandela izinqubo ezilungile zokuphatha imininingwane, ukuze kugwenywe ukuvuza kolwazi olubucayi. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, izibhedlela zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bazo, ukuze baqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina imininingwane iphephile. Isahluko 6: Izinkinga Ezihlobene Nokubhaliswa Naphezu kokubaluleka kokubhaliswa, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene nale nqubo. Ezinye iziguli zingase zibe nesithukuthezi sokugcwalisa amafomu, noma zingase zingabi nalwazi olufanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelweni kokwelashwa.
Isahluko 6: Izinkinga Ezihlobene Nokubhaliswa Naphezu kokubaluleka kokubhaliswa, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene nale nqubo. Ezinye iziguli zingase zibe nesithukuthezi sokugcwalisa amafomu, noma zingase zingabi nalwazi olufanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelweni kokwelashwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziguli ezithile zingase zibe nokukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemfihlo yazo, okungaholela ekutheni zingafuni ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqonde lezi zinkinga futhi zisebenze ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Isahluko 7: Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Le nqubo ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zezempilo, futhi inikeza odokotela ithuba lokuhlola isiguli ngempumelelo. Ukuze lokhu kuqhube kahle, izibhedlela kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinqubo ezilungile zokuphatha imininingwane, futhi ziqonde izinkinga ezihlobene nokubhaliswa. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu.
Imikhawulo ekubonakalisweni nasekufundiseni kwezilwane ezisetshenziselwa imisebenzi kanye nezinja ezisetshenziselwa ukuvikelwa. Isigaba 1 soMthetho Inombolo 7 ka-1991 sishintsha isigaba 1. UMagistrate angakhupha ilayisense yokubonakalisa nokufundisa izilwane ezibandakanyeka ezindleleni zokusebenza noma ukusebenzisa izinja ukuze ziqaphe. - Noma ubani ofuna ukubonakalisa noma ukufundisa isilwane ukuze sibe nombukiso, noma usebenzisa inja ukuze iqaphe, angafaka isicelo ngokubhala esebenzisa le fomu ebekiwe kumagistrate wesifunda lapho lowo muntu ehlala khona, edlala, noma enza ibhizinisi, efuna ilayisense yokwenza kanjalo, futhi uMagistrate uzokhipha ilayisense. c UMagistrate angaphika ukuvuselela isicelo seleyisense uma kungekho isizathu esihle nesifanele; futhi d UNgqongqoshe, ngokukhupha imithetho, angakhetha ifomu elizosebenzisa ukufaka isicelo seleyisense, imiqathango ehambisana nale layisense, kanye nezimali ezikhokhwayo zeleyisense noma yokuvuselela. Isitifiketi mayelana nezilwane ezineleyisense. - Umuntu onelayisense okukhulunywa ngayo esigabeni 2 akavunyelwe ukubonakalisa noma ukufundisa noma iyiphi isilwane noma ukwenza ukuthi ibonakaliswe noma ifundiswe ukuze kube nombukiso noma ukusebenzisa inja ukuze iqaphe ngaphandle kokuba bane sitifiketi esivumela ukuba babonakalise, bafundise, noma basebenzise lezo zilwane ezineleyisense. Isitifiketi okukhulunywa ngaso esigabeni 1 sizokhishwa nguMagistrate esebenzisa ifomu elibekiwe ngemva kokuthi umnikazi weleyisense ethumele ulwazi kubo. Isitifiketi sizochaza ukuthi ukufundiswa, ukubonakaliswa, nokusebenzisa kwesilwane noma izilwane ez covered by the certificate kuzokwenziwa kanjani.
- Umuntu onelayisense okukhulunywa ngayo esigabeni 2 akavunyelwe ukubonakalisa noma ukufundisa noma iyiphi isilwane noma ukwenza ukuthi ibonakaliswe noma ifundiswe ukuze kube nombukiso noma ukusebenzisa inja ukuze iqaphe ngaphandle kokuba bane sitifiketi esivumela ukuba babonakalise, bafundise, noma basebenzise lezo zilwane ezineleyisense. Isitifiketi okukhulunywa ngaso esigabeni 1 sizokhishwa nguMagistrate esebenzisa ifomu elibekiwe ngemva kokuthi umnikazi weleyisense ethumele ulwazi kubo. Isitifiketi sizochaza ukuthi ukufundiswa, ukubonakaliswa, nokusebenzisa kwesilwane noma izilwane ez covered by the certificate kuzokwenziwa kanjani. UMagistrate uzoba namandla okushintsha leso sitifiketi uma umnikazi weleyisense efaka isicelo sokushintsha isitifiketi... Ilungelo lokungena. - Ngaphezu kwamandla anikezwe emaphoyiseni ngaphansi komthetho noma yimuphi omunye, amaphoyisa ang... b ahlole lezo zilwane, izinja, noma izindawo, noma izimoto futhi angahlola ngokuphelele izinyathelo nezindlela ezisetshenziselwa ukulawula, ukufundisa lezo zilwane noma izinja nokuthi zondliwa kanjani lezo zilwane nezinja; futhi c ngesikhathi sokubonakaliswa kwezilwane ezifundisiwe noma ngenkathi usebenzisa izinja ukuze ziqaphe noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, angangena ezindlini, endaweni, noma emotweni noma engxenye yayo ephathelene nalokho okubukwayo noma ukusetshenziswa ukuze ahlole lezo zindawo, indawo, noma imoto noma izilwane noma izinja ezikhona kulowo mkhakha kanye nesimo lapho zigcinwa, zilawulwa, noma zondliwa ngesikhathi sokubonakaliswa noma ukusetshenziswa noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ukugcina. - Akukho okukhulunywa ngalo Mthetho okuzosebenza ekugcineni noma ekufundiseni kwezilwane ezisetshenziselwa izinjongo zempi, amaphoyisa, noma ezemidlalo noma ezokuboniswa kwezolimo, imibukiso yezinyathi, imibukiso yezinja, imibukiso yezinyoni ezitholakala emakhaya, noma noma iyiphi imibukiso yomphakathi mayelana nokuphila kwezilwane, emjaho noma emncintiswaneni wezempilo noma amaphoyisa noma noma iyiphi imibukiso efanayo noma yokuboniswa kwezilwane noma ukusetshenziswa kwezilwane ezibhekwa ngesevisi yokuphepha yaseNingizimu Afrika, noma isevisi yamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika noma uMnyango Wezokulungisa. Isihloko esifushane. - Lo Mthetho uzobizwa ngokuthi uMthetho Wokuvikela Izilwane Zokusebenza zika-1935.
Uphenyo Lokuvuza Kwamaphepha Kamatikuletsheni Umbuzo 1: Yini ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni kubhekisela ekuveleni kolwazi oluyimfihlo lwemali, ibhizinisi, noma imininingwane yomuntu siqu ethunyelwa noma ikhululwa ngaphandle kwemvume. Lokhu kwenzeka kakhulu ezinkampanini, lapho izimfihlo zomkhiqizo, izinkontileka, noma izinqubomgomo zenzeka ukuba zivele emphakathini, okubangela ukubaluleka kwalesi sifo. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kungadalwa izizathu eziningi, ezifana nokungagcini kahle izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, ukwephula umthetho wabasebenzi, ubuchwepheshe obuphukile, noma ubudlelwane bobungozi phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase baveze imininingwane ngenxa yokubusa kwamafilosofi ahlukene noma ukufuna ukusiza abanye. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izingozi zokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni? Impendulo: Izingozi zokuvuza zingaba ziningi kakhulu. Okokuqala, kungase kubangele ukulahleka kokwethembeka kwezimali noma izinkampani, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwamakhasimende. Okwesibili, izinkampani zingaba nezingqinamba zomthetho, njengokubhalelwa amacala okubhayiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuza kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle ezimpilweni zabantu abathintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma imininingwane ehambisana nezokuphepha kube khona. Umbuzo 4: Yini okungaqhathaniswa nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphepha.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuza kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle ezimpilweni zabantu abathintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma imininingwane ehambisana nezokuphepha kube khona. Umbuzo 4: Yini okungaqhathaniswa nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa abasebenzi ngokubaluleka kokugcina izimfihlo, ukuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuvikela, njengokufaka amakhodi okungena, ukuhlola ukuphathwa kwesistimu, nokuphatha ngokuphepha amafayela anemininingwane ebalulekile. Umbuzo 5: Yini umthelela wokuqhamuka kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni emhlabeni wonke? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni akugcini nje kuphela endaweni ethile, kepha kuthinta abantu emhlabeni wonke. Imininingwane ethunyelwa ngaphandle ingase ibangele ukungathembeki phakathi kwezinkampani, kuthumele imibuzo mayelana nokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zemali, futhi kudale ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kumakhasimende. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ezinkampanini ezinkulu, lapho ukuphathwa kwemali kudinga ukuqashelwa okukhulu. Umbuzo 6: Ziyini izinyathelo okumele zithathwe uma ukuvuza kwenzeka? Impendulo: Uma ukuvuza kwenzeka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezisheshayo zokubhekana nakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusiza abathintekayo, ukuvula uphenyo olunembile, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zihlanzwe. Ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukulawula lezi zinkinga, izinkampani kufanele zikhumbule ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluccelayo futhi ziqikelele ukusiza abathintekayo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izibonelo ezidumile zokuvuza kwamaphepha?
Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusiza abathintekayo, ukuvula uphenyo olunembile, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zihlanzwe. Ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukulawula lezi zinkinga, izinkampani kufanele zikhumbule ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluccelayo futhi ziqikelele ukusiza abathintekayo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izibonelo ezidumile zokuvuza kwamaphepha? Impendulo: Kunezibonelo eziningi ezidumile zokuvuza, njenge-Whistleblower Edward Snowden, owavula imininingwane eyimfihlo ye-NSA ngendlela eyahluka kakhulu ekukhulumeni ngedijithali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezinjenge-Wikileaks zaveza amaphepha amaningi akhombe izinqubo ezizimele, okwakuholela ekwenzeni izinguquko eziningi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuzwakalisa indima enkulu yokukhuluma kwempilo elula emphakathini. Umbuzo 8: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba abantu bazi ngalezi zindaba? Impendulo: Kulula ukuba abantu bakhumbule ukuthi ulwazi lwasemphakathini luyisibopho, futhi kunomthelela empilweni yabo. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zindaba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi izingozi ezihambisana nokungena kwemali nokuhlala kusesimweni sokuvikela izimfihlo zabo. Lokhu kungalawula izingozi zokuphazamiseka kwezimali noma ukulahlekelwa ukufaka izinhlelo ezithile kumasiko. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokubhekana nokuvuza? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezisemthethweni zokubhekana nokuvuza, lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa abaqondisi abahlola ukuphepha kwedatha, izinhlelo zokubikela ukuvuza, nakho konke okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvikela. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele ukuphatha izinkinga ezithile, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zigcina izimfihlo zazo kubalulekile.
Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokubhekana nokuvuza? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezisemthethweni zokubhekana nokuvuza, lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa abaqondisi abahlola ukuphepha kwedatha, izinhlelo zokubikela ukuvuza, nakho konke okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvikela. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele ukuphatha izinkinga ezithile, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zigcina izimfihlo zazo kubalulekile. Umbuzo 10: Yini okwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqolobane zokuvikela? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqolobane zokuvikela, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha okusezingeni eliphezulu kubasebenzi, kanye nokwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphepha. Ukuze ukuqina kokukhethwa kwezokuphepha, izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise uhlaka lwezobuchwepheshe olwakhiwe, kanjalo nezinhlelo zemvelo zokugcina ukuzwelana nesikhungo sabo. Isiphetho: Uphenyo lokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni luyisihloko esibalulekile emkhakheni wezokuphepha, okudinga ukuqonda okujule nokusebenza okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikeleke imininingwane eyimfihlo. Izinkampani nezinhlaka kufanele ziqhubeke nokwakha izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ukuvuza akwenzeki, futhi uma kwenzeka, kube nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokubhekana nakho. Kulokhu, abantu bangenza izinqumo eziphusile futhi bazidalela ikusasa eliqinile.
Izinkinga Zemfundo: Uhlanga Oluhlukahlukene LweZinkinga Nezixazululo Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imfundo ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kodwa-ke, izinkinga eziningi zikhona, ezithinta abafundi, othisha, nezikole. Lezi zinkinga zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emfundweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu. Okokuqala, sithola izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsiza. Ezinye izikole, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziyisisekelo ezifana nezincwadi, amakhompyutha, nezinto zokufundisa. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abafundi bangakwazi ukufunda kahle, njengoba bengenayo imithombo edingekayo yokuthola ulwazi. Ukungabi nazo lezi zinsiza kubangela ukuthi abafundi bahlale behluleka, futhi lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongekho emthethweni wokungafundi kahle. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngothisha. Othisha bahlala bebalulekile emfundweni, kodwa bahlushwa izinkinga eziningi. Abanye bahlala bengekho kahle, ngenxa yokungabi namathuba okuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiholo ephansi kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezinzima zenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Uma othisha bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi, kungenzeka badinge ukwenza izinto eziphuthumayo, okuthinta ikhwalithi yemfundo abayihlinzekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zempilo zikhona, ezithinta abafundi. Ukuphila kahle kubalulekile ukuze umfundi akwazi ukufunda kahle. Kodwa-ke, izinkinga ezinjengokushoda kokudla, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, kanye nezifo zempilo zenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuba bagxile ezifundweni zabo.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zempilo zikhona, ezithinta abafundi. Ukuphila kahle kubalulekile ukuze umfundi akwazi ukufunda kahle. Kodwa-ke, izinkinga ezinjengokushoda kokudla, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, kanye nezifo zempilo zenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuba bagxile ezifundweni zabo. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi ekufundeni, njengoba abafundi bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni, imiphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo basebenzisane ukuze bahlale beqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banempilo enhle. Okwesine, sikhuluma ngokuqwashisa. Kwezinye izindawo, imfundo ayithathwa ngokubaluleka. Abanye abazali bahlala bephikisana nemfundo, becabanga ukuthi akubalulekile. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, njengoba izingane zingatholi ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuze zifunde kahle. Ukuze sithuthukise imfundo, kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabazali nemiphakathi, ukuze baqonde ukuthi imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokubheka lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele anikeze izinsiza ezanele ezikoleni, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda kahle, futhi kuzothuthukisa ikhwalithi yemfundo. Okwesibili, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kochwepheshe bempilo, ukuze othisha bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi baphile kahle, futhi baphinde baphendule kahle ezimfanelweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abazali ukuba babe nesithakazelo emfundweni yezingane zabo.
Okwesibili, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kochwepheshe bempilo, ukuze othisha bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi baphile kahle, futhi baphinde baphendule kahle ezimfanelweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abazali ukuba babe nesithakazelo emfundweni yezingane zabo. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuqwashisa, imiphakathi kufanele ibambe imicimbi yokukhuthaza imfundo, ukuze abazali bazi ukuthi imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi izingane zifune ukufunda, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zemfundo zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emfundweni. Imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sibe nesibopho sokwenza kube lula ukuze bonke abafundi baphumelele. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi, okuzokwenza sibe nempumelelo esikhathini esizayo.
Ikhophi yeSikhumbuzo seSikhungo itholakala kubakhiqizi boMnyango noma uMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Yini inhloso yeSikhumbuzo seSikhungo? ISikhumbuzo seSikhungo sichaza izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi bezihlahla kanye nabanye abasebenzi bezihlahla, kuhlanganise nezinto ezifana nezinsuku zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane yokusebenza, kanye nokupheliswa kokusebenza. Iphinde ichaze nemiholo encane okufanele ikhokhwe ngabaphathi. Bonke abahlwanyela izihlahla; abaqashi bezikhathi ezithile; abaqashi abachitha isikhathi esiningi emsebenzini wezihlahla; bonke abahamba embonini yezihlahla; umsebenzi wasekhaya oqashwe endaweni lapho kuhlwanyelwa khona izihlahla; umgibeli oqashwe ehlathini kodwa engaphansi kwenkampani yokuvikela eyimfihlo. Ubani ongengxenye yalezi? Abaphathi abangahlanganisi izigaba zokuhlwanyela; amahlathi omphakathi; amahlathi okugcina imvelo; noma noma ubani oqashwe noma obandakanyeka emsebenzini wezihlahla ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo seSikhungo noma ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esivumelanayo nebhodi labasebenzi njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wezobudlelwano Babasebenzi ka-1995, isibonelo, umthetho ophatha ngaphansi kweBhodi Labashayeli Bezokuthutha kanye nomsebenzi wokusika nokuguqula izihlahla zibe omunye umkhiqizo, ngokuhlanganyela nomkhakha wezinkuni nephepha, nokunye. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nemiholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bakhokhelwe okungenani imiholo efana naleyo echazwe etafuleni elingezansi. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla bathola imiholo efanayo? Bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bathole okungenani imiholo echazwe etafuleni 1.
Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bakhokhelwe okungenani imiholo efana naleyo echazwe etafuleni elingezansi. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla bathola imiholo efanayo? Bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bathole okungenani imiholo echazwe etafuleni 1. Nokho, abasebenzi bezihlahla abathola ngaphezu kwemali ebekiwe bazoqhubeka bethola imiholo ephezulu. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi ongenaminyaka engu-15 noma ngaphezulu kodwa engakafiki eminyakeni engu-18 osebenza amahora angama-35 ngesonto okungenani imali ethile echazwe etafuleni 1. Ngemuva konyaka owodwa sokuthi iSikhumbuzo seSikhungo sibe semthethweni, imiholo izonyuka ngama-2% we-CPI (Consumer Price Index). Umphathi nomsebenzi wezihlahla bangavuma ngokubhala ukuthi umsebenzi wezihlahla uqedela umsebenzi wezimpahla ngezikhathi ezichaziwe. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla oqashwe ngaphansi kwalesi simo, ukukhokha akufanele kube ngaphansi kwemiholo encane kanye nezinga elisebenzayo ngaphansi kwalesi simo. Noma yini ebalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga lokuphepha nempilo. Umphathi angakhipha imali kuphela ngezizathu ezihlinzekwe yiSikhumbuzo seSikhungo. Abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bavume ngokubhala ukuncishiswa. Akukho ukuncishiswa kokuhlala okufanele kudlule ama-10% emiholweni yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Ukuncishiswa kokudla akufanele kudlule ama-10% emiholweni yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Uma kukhona abasebenzi bezihlahla ababili noma ngaphezulu abahlala endaweni yokusebenza, inani eliphelele lemali elingancishiswa kubo bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla abahlala kufanele lingadluli ku-25% ethathwe ezingeni lemiholo eliphansi kumuntu osebenza ehlathini.

Uma kukhona abasebenzi bezihlahla ababili noma ngaphezulu abahlala endaweni yokusebenza, inani eliphelele lemali elingancishiswa kubo bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla abahlala kufanele lingadluli ku-25% ethathwe ezingeni lemiholo eliphansi kumuntu osebenza ehlathini. Ngamanye amazwi, uma kukhona abasebenzi bezihlahla abahlanu abahlala ngaphakathi kwenkampani, inani eliphezulu elingancishiswa kumuntu ngamunye lingama-5%. Indlu kumele ibe nekhono elikhulu elingama-30 square meters okungenani. Abasebenzi bezihlahla banesibopho sokubheka impahla yomphathi wabo. Impahla yomphathi ifaka imishini noma ezinye amathuluzi asetshenziswa ngabo ngesikhathi besebenza. Uma umsebenzi wezihlahla engaziphathi kahle ekubhekeni impahla yabo, umphathi angancisha imali ngenxa yokulahleka noma ukonakala. Kumele banikeze umsebenzi wezihlahla ithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi kungani imali ingancishiswa emiholweni yabo. Qinisekisa ukuthi inani elincishisiwe alidluli ingxenye eyodwa ye-quarters yemiholo yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Amalungelo nezibopho zabaphathi kanye nabasebenzi bezihlahla emkhakheni wezihlahla akhishwa ngendlela efuna ukuxazulula izidingo zombili izinhlangothi. Amahora ayisishiyagalolunye ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu noma ngaphansi kwesonto; noma amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezingaphezu kwezihlanu ngesonto. Isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo kumele sinikezwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kusukela ngosuku lokuqala umsebenzisi athola ilungelo lokuphumula. Nokho, isivumelwano sokubhala singakhulisa lesi sikhathi sibe yizinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyisihlanu ngesonto. Ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyisihlanu ngesonto. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla noma yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakele zokusebenza ngosuku lokuphumula ngosuku lokukhokhela ejwayelekile. Abaphathi kumele baziqhenye ngabasebenzi bezihlahla abajwayele ukuba basebenze ebusuku mayelana nezimo ezibucayi ezihambisana nomsebenzi kanye nelungelo labasebenzi ukuba bahlolwe uma bebuza njalo lapho izindleko zikhokhelwa umphathi. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla olindele umcalla inzuzo yokulinda. Le nzuzo kumele ibe okungenani u-10% wemiholo ejwayelekile yomsebenzi. Isivumelwano singasusa isikhathi sokuphumula sokudla kumsebenzi wezihlahla osebenza ngaphansi kwamahora ayisithupha ngosuku. UDonald Trump – Umfanekiso Wokuphikisana Nokuhamba Phambili UDonald Trump, igama elidumile emhlabeni, akusikho nje igama lomuntu, kodwa kube yimpikiswano enkulu. Ngonyaka ka-2016, uTrump waba ngumengameli wokuqala waseMelika ongene emsebenzini ngaphandle kokuba neziqu ezinkulu kwezombusazwe. Lokhu kwavusa izwi elikhulu phakathi kwabantu, kwaba nezinkolelo eziphikisanayo ezimayelana nezindlela zakhe zokuphatha. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uTrump ubaluleke kangakanani emlandweni wezombusazwe. UTrump ungumuntu ophikisanayo, onobuntu obuhlukile. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuholi bakhe, kufanele sihlole izici ezithile ezimqoka. Okokuqala, uTrump unokukhanga okukhulu. Ubuye abe nekhono lokukhuluma kahle, okwenza abantu bamthande noma baphikise izinqumo zakhe. UTrump waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umqondo wokuthi uzokwenza izinto zibe ngcono, okwakubukeka kuyiphupho elihle kubantu abaningi. Nokho, uTrump uphinde waba nemiphumela emibi. Izinkulumo zakhe ezivame ukuba nezinsolo zashiya abantu abaningi bephikisana. Ubuye waba nesikhumbuzo esibi sokuhlukumeza abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngama-immigrants. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemiphakathi ehlukene, lapho abanye bebona uTrump njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye bebona yena njengomphikisi wezokuhlalisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uTrump ube neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezomnotho. Wazama ukususa izinqubomgomo eziningi ezazikhona ukuze akhe umnotho ophumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo ezithile ezathokozisa abanye, kodwa zashiya abanye bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, uTrump ube neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezomnotho. Wazama ukususa izinqubomgomo eziningi ezazikhona ukuze akhe umnotho ophumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo ezithile ezathokozisa abanye, kodwa zashiya abanye bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. UTrump waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni imboni yezokwakha, kodwa lokhu kuza nezindleko ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini ezithintekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uTrump waba yisithombe esiphathekayo sokuphikisana. Abantu abaningi baveze imizwa ehlukene ngaye, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Abanye baphakeme kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe, kanti abanye baphikisa izinqumo zakhe, bekhathazekile ngempilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kuphakamisa umbuzo: ingabe uTrump ubonisa indlela yokuphatha efanele, noma ingabe ubeka abantu engcupheni? Ukwazi kahle uTrump kusho ukuqonda ukuthi akasikhumbuzi kuphela ngezinto ezinhle noma ezimbi. Ubuye ubonise ukuthi ubuholi bungenziwa ngezindlela ezahlukene, futhi akukhona konke okwenziwayo okuhle. UTrump ungumfanekiso wempikiswano, okukhombisa ukuthi ubuholi bungenza abantu bahlukaniseke, kodwa futhi buphinde bahlale bexhumene. Ekugcineni, uDonald Trump ungumuntu ophikisanayo, ohluke kakhulu kwabanye abaholi. Ubuye waba nesandla esikhulu emlandweni wezombusazwe, kodwa imiphumela yokuphatha kwakhe iyahluka. Njengabantu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuholi bukhona ezimfanelweni zethu, futhi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinqumo zethu, sihlole ukuthi zishintsha kanjani impilo yabantu.

UTrump uyisibonelo sokuthi ubuholi bungenza izinguquko ezinkulu, kodwa kufanele sihlole ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziwusizo noma ziwubungozi. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngoDonald Trump, asikhulumi nje ngempumelelo noma ukwehluleka, kodwa sikhuluma ngempilo, izinqumo, nezindlela zokuphatha ezithinta wonke umuntu. Umthetho Wezakhiwo Zedolobha uhlanganisa noma umphakathi omunye oqokwe ukwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. Umthetho Wezakhiwo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezakhiwo Zedolobha ka-1998 Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998. Umthetho Wezinhlelo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezinhlelo Zedolobha ka-2000 Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000. Ukuhumusha nokunquma komphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yile mithetho nemigomo kumele kubhalwe emaminitheni emhlanganweni wekhansela noma ikomidi. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele ugcine uhlu lwezinqumo nemibono yezomthetho. Noma yimuphi umphakathi ungacela umphakathi wedolobha, ngokubhala phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zesenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo mayelana nokuhumusha nesinqumo kanye ne-rapothi ye khansela noma ikomidi. Ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngemva kokubheka i-rapothi ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, kumele iqinisekise, ilungise, noma ishintshe isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yiziphi izimfanelo ezingase zithinte noma yiliphi ithathu ngenxa yesinqumo, futhi zonke izinqumo ezithinta amalungelo abanye kumele zibhalwe, futhi izizathu zalezi zinqumo kumele zibhale. Ibhodi kumele libe nemihlangano yebhodi ejwayelekile okungenani kanye njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu.
