Ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngemva kokubheka i-rapothi ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, kumele iqinisekise, ilungise, noma ishintshe isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yiziphi izimfanelo ezingase zithinte noma yiliphi ithathu ngenxa yesinqumo, futhi zonke izinqumo ezithinta amalungelo abanye kumele zibhalwe, futhi izizathu zalezi zinqumo kumele zibhale. Zonke imihlangano yebhodi kanye naleyo yeziqu kumele ivulelwe umphakathi, futhi ibhodi noma ikomidi lingakhipha umphakathi emhlanganweni, ngaphandle kokuthi ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngenxa yokuthi umqondo ophathelene nendaba ekhuluma ngayo noma uma ukuvezwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kungaphazamisa izinhloso zedolobha, ibone isizathu esifanele sokwenza njalo ngokuhambisana nezimiso zokuphatha okuvulekile kanye nedemokhrasi. Isinqumo sokungena esivumelwaneni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Noma iyiphi enye indaba ehlinzekwe ngumthetho. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele unikeze isaziso somphakathi, ngendlela evunyelwe yibhodi, ekhombisa isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yazo zonke imihlangano ejwayelekile yebhodi noma ikomidi kanye nanoma yimuphi umhlangano wesikhashana noma ophuthumayo, ngaphandle kokuthi isikhathi asivumeli ukuba kwenzeke njalo.
Isinqumo sokungena esivumelwaneni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Noma iyiphi enye indaba ehlinzekwe ngumthetho. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele unikeze isaziso somphakathi, ngendlela evunyelwe yibhodi, ekhombisa isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yazo zonke imihlangano ejwayelekile yebhodi noma ikomidi kanye nanoma yimuphi umhlangano wesikhashana noma ophuthumayo, ngaphandle kokuthi isikhathi asivumeli ukuba kwenzeke njalo. Umphakathi kumele abize imihlangano yebhodi, okungenani izikhathi ezine ngonyaka, "ngokubhalwa kwemihlangano yebhodi" esayiniwe, ekhombisa usuku, indawo, nesikhathi somhlangano kanye noma i-akhawunti yaleso sikhathi esiphakanyisiwe. Futhi ezinsukwini ezimbili zezikhalazo ngaphambi kosuku lomhlangano ophuthumayo, kumele abize umhlangano ophuthumayo. Isitifiketi Sobungcweti Zabasebenzi Bakahulumeni: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinga Lokusebenza Ngokubhekisela ekuthuthukiseni ikhwalithi yezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni, ukuthengwa kwezitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni kuqhubeka nokubaluleka okukhulu. Lesi simo sithinta izisebenzi ezahlukene ezisebenza ezikhungweni zikamasipala, ezikhungweni zokuphatha izinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanye nakwezinye izigaba ezihlinzekayo. Ngokuthola lezi zitifiketi, abasenzi bahlomula ngempela, benza izinga lokusebenza liphumelele. Umgomo walesi simo uwukwandisa ikhono labasebenzi, ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezidingweni zomphakathi. Ngokwenziwa kokuhlolwa kwezinga lobungcweti, abanye abasebenzi bathola amathuba okuthola imiholo engcono, izikhundla eziphakeme, nezinsiza ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kudala umkhuba omuhle ezinkampanini zikahulumeni, okujolise ekwenzeni ngcono imiphumela yokusebenza. Uhlelo lwezikhungo zokufundisa luhlose ukufundisa izisebenzi ezihlala ezindaweni ezibhekelwe kakhulu, njengokusebenza kwamakhaya, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi, nezokuphatha. Kusukela ekutholeni lezi zitifiketi, ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa, kuthuthukisa umphakathi, futhi kugqugquzela izinga lokusebenza emsebenzini. Lokhu kuqinisa isiko lokusebenza phakathi kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni, okuhlose ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi. Umqondisi wocwaningo olwenziwe kuMnyango Wezabasebenzi, uNdunankulu uMthethwa, usho ukuthi lezi zitifiketi zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokusebenza. "Sifuna ukuba nezisebenzi ezibambisene, ezisenza uthando lomsebenzi wazo.
Lokhu kuqinisa isiko lokusebenza phakathi kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni, okuhlose ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi. Umqondisi wocwaningo olwenziwe kuMnyango Wezabasebenzi, uNdunankulu uMthethwa, usho ukuthi lezi zitifiketi zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokusebenza. "Sifuna ukuba nezisebenzi ezibambisene, ezisenza uthando lomsebenzi wazo. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa kuhulumeni," kuchaza uMthethwa. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamahhovisi kahulumeni nabafundi kudala izifundo ezithakazelisayo nezithuthukisa. Lokhu kubambisana kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaqeqeshi bahlala besekela izisebenzi, benza kube lula ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa. Lezizifundo ziqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela ezihambisanayo, zifaka entweni amakhono amasha, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze isisebenzi sikhule. Ngokuphendula izidingo zabantu, uhulumeni uthathe izinyathelo eziqinile zokwakha uhlelo lwezokuhlola lwalolu hlelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izisebenzi zithola izimpendulo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kwenza abasebenzi bazi ukuthi imisebenzi yabo iyabhekwa futhi ibalulekile ekwenzeni ngcono impilo yomphakathi. Uhlelo lokuthola izitifiketi luthathwa njengomkhankaso owaziwa, owakuveza obala imiphumela emihle. Izinhlelo zokuhlola zanyatheliswa ezinkampanini ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abangathanda ukufunda bamukelekile. Lesi simo sithuthukisa ukwaziswa nokwakhiwa kobungcweti, kunciphisa izingozi zokumiswa, nokwandisa impumelelo ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi. Uhlanga lwenhlangano olubambisene nolohulumeni, luzama ukwenza imisebenzi yethu ifinyeleleke kalula, ikakhulukazi kubantu abancinane.
Izinhlelo zokuhlola zanyatheliswa ezinkampanini ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abangathanda ukufunda bamukelekile. Lesi simo sithuthukisa ukwaziswa nokwakhiwa kobungcweti, kunciphisa izingozi zokumiswa, nokwandisa impumelelo ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi. Uhlanga lwenhlangano olubambisene nolohulumeni, luzama ukwenza imisebenzi yethu ifinyeleleke kalula, ikakhulukazi kubantu abancinane. Lokhu kubukeka kuyisinyathelo esihle sokuvula amathuba, futhi kulandela izimpumelelo zethu zesikhathi eside. KuMnyango Wezemfundo, kubhekeziwe umthelela wezinhlelo zokufunda kulabo abafuna ukuthola izitifiketi zobungcweti. Imiphumela yocwaningo ibonisa ukuthi ukuqinisekisa ubungcweti kunciphisa isikhala sokusebenza phakathi kwabantu. Lezi zinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhuthaza ukuhlela kahle izinsiza zomphakathi, okwenza abantu baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zitifiketi zingaphinda zibe nemiphumela emihle engcwele ezingeni lokuphila, ikhulisa izinga lokuphila nokugcina izinga lokucindezelwa. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu kanye noHulumeni, kube nemiphumela emihle eqhubekela phambili, kuyinto ewusizo emiphakathini yethu. Izinsiza ezinqunyelwe kulabo abawaqhamukayo aziziswa kuphela ngokwakhiwa kolwazi, kodwa futhi kwiSikhumbuzo sezinqumo eziphusile. Ukwakha ozakwethu abagulayo, kuza sekuthuthukisa izinsiza zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezindaweni ezingenamathuba. Umphakathi ubonile ukuthi ungathola kanjani izinzuzo kulolu hlelo.
Izinsiza ezinqunyelwe kulabo abawaqhamukayo aziziswa kuphela ngokwakhiwa kolwazi, kodwa futhi kwiSikhumbuzo sezinqumo eziphusile. Ukwakha ozakwethu abagulayo, kuza sekuthuthukisa izinsiza zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezindaweni ezingenamathuba. Umphakathi ubonile ukuthi ungathola kanjani izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kuyasiza ukudala izinkampani ezisebenzayo ngokuthunikwa ngesandla izinselelo, ukuhamba phambili kwesizukulwane esisha sokusebenza, nokwakha umbono oqondile wokuphila okungokoqobo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokusebenza, ukwakhiwa kobungcweti, kanye nokwandiswa kokuhweba, kuzoqhubeka kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti zabaqeqeshi zihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izisebenzi zethu nakwezobuchwepheshe. Ekuhambeni kwalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni qhubeka nokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezithuthukisi ukuze abantu bathole amathuba afanayo. Njengoba sikhula, siphinde siphinde siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, kuhlanganisa nezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nathi. Ngaleyo ndlela, sihamba phambili emsebenzini wabo bonke abaqeqeshi, sithuthukisa ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umlando Wokhetho Luka-1994 Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 eNingizimu Afrika ungomunye wezikhathi ezibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisigaba esisha sokuphila kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, lapho kwavulwa amathuba amasha emiphakathini ehlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle leli phepha, kubalulekile ukubheka izigameko ezaholela kulolu khetho, izinqubo ezazisetshenziswa, kanye nemiphumela yalo. Ngonyaka ka-1990, umholi we-ANC, uNelson Mandela, wakhululwa ejele, lapho abesebenza khona iminyaka engama-27. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, kwavula umnyango wokuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukukhululwa kukaMandela kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlangano eziningi ezazifuna ukulwa nokucindezelwa, futhi kwavula ithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngonyaka ka-1994, izinkulungwane zabantu zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhetheni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubuyisana, lapho abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene behlangana ukuze bakhe ikusasa elisha. Ukuze kube nokhetho oluqondile, izinhlelo zokuvota zaphakanyiswa, futhi izikhungo zokuvota zavulwa ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abaningi, kuhlanganise nabesifazane, ukuba bavote, okwakungakaze kube khona ngaphambili. Uhlelo lokhetho lwaluqukethe izinyathelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokuvota ezisemthethweni. Ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa, abantu bahlala emigqeni emide, bekhombisa isifiso sabo sokuba neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubambisana, lapho abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bephakamisa izwi labo. Ukwamukelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho kwaba yisikhathi esijabulisayo.
Ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa, abantu bahlala emigqeni emide, bekhombisa isifiso sabo sokuba neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubambisana, lapho abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bephakamisa izwi labo. Ukwamukelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho kwaba yisikhathi esijabulisayo. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwashintsha, futhi kwavulwa amathuba amasha emikhakheni ehlukene, kuhlanganise nezemfundo, ezempilo, nezomnotho. Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 awugcini nje ngokuba yisigameko esibalulekile, kodwa ubonisa amandla abantu uma behlanganyela. UNelson Mandela waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi wakhombisa ukuthi ubumbano lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Abanye abahloniphekile abakhona lapha engingabakhumbuli; Bafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Izinselelo ezimangalisayo esibhekene nazo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, sizama ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo obekwe ezikhwameni zethu ngenxa yokwehla okukhulu kwezinga lobubha okwenza umsebenzi wethu ube nzima kakhulu. Masihlangane njengabantu baleli gumbi elihle kulolu hlelo lokulwa nobubha, ukwephulwa kwamalungelo abesifazane nezingane, izifo, nokukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwethu ekunakekeleni amalungelo abantu kanye nobuntu bomuntu ngamunye. Izindaba zezempilo kanye namalungu abahloniphekile yizihloko eziyinhloko ezixoxwa ezinkundleni ezibhekana nokuthuthukiswa kokuphila komphakathi kanye nomnotho. I-International Rural Women's Conference ibanjwe eThekwini njengoba sikhuluma. Siyazi ukuthi kuleli gumbi, abesifazane benza u-53% wabantu bonke futhi iningi labo bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, izifo, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwezinsiza.
Izindaba zezempilo kanye namalungu abahloniphekile yizihloko eziyinhloko ezixoxwa ezinkundleni ezibhekana nokuthuthukiswa kokuphila komphakathi kanye nomnotho. I-International Rural Women's Conference ibanjwe eThekwini njengoba sikhuluma. Siyazi ukuthi kuleli gumbi, abesifazane benza u-53% wabantu bonke futhi iningi labo bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, izifo, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Kukhona amazwe athuthukayo athole umehluko omkhulu kulezi zinselelo esibhekene nazo. Sithemba ukuthi le nkulumo izohlinzeka ngethuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yokuthi singabhekana kanjani nalezi zindaba ezibhekene nabesifazane kuleli sikhathi. Umsebenzi wethu njengomnyango wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngokulandela umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kusukela ezingeni eliphansi, sigxile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu bonke ngokulinganayo, sithinta umphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo futhi sibambisane nazo zonke izigaba ezikhona kuleli. Isikhungo sokuqala sokunakekelwa kwezempilo sasungulwa endaweni yasePholela lapha eKwaZulu-Natal ngo-1948, iminyaka engamashumi amathathu ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwe-Alma Ata Declaration ngonyaka ka-1978, njengendlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu. Umndeni wezempilo emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezweni elithuthukayo, uyavuma ukuthi kufanele siqinise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo uma sifuna ukubhekana kahle nomthwalo wokulwa nezifo. Sibe nemicimbi ehlukahlukene ngonyaka odlule lapho sakhuluma ngezaziso ezihlukahlukene zezempilo kumiphakathi.
Isikhungo sokuqala sokunakekelwa kwezempilo sasungulwa endaweni yasePholela lapha eKwaZulu-Natal ngo-1948, iminyaka engamashumi amathathu ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwe-Alma Ata Declaration ngonyaka ka-1978, njengendlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu. Umndeni wezempilo emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezweni elithuthukayo, uyavuma ukuthi kufanele siqinise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo uma sifuna ukubhekana kahle nomthwalo wokulwa nezifo. Sibe nemicimbi ehlukahlukene ngonyaka odlule lapho sakhuluma ngezaziso ezihlukahlukene zezempilo kumiphakathi. Kulonyaka sizokwakha kulokho njengesisekelo sigxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunomthelela ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi sisebenze ndawonye ekuxoxeni ngezihloko noma izindaba ezihlobene nezempilo, futhi ngaleyo ndlela sizokhula ndawonye. Ngithemba ukuthi ngalokhu sizobona intuthuko nezinkomba zokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo. Sibhekene nezinga lobubha elingu-54.3% kuleli, kanti kwezinye izindawo zasemaphandleni izinga lobubha lilinganiselwa ku-80%. Sake sakhuluma ukuthi izinga lokungabi nokudla linamandla kakhulu ku-70%. Kuleli, kuphela u-32% wabantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile (kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-79% futhi u-24% wezindlu unazo izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kuleli kanti kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-62%). Lezi yizinselelo ezifanayo ezithinta izindawo zasemaphandleni ezizungeze amadolobha lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo ezanele, kanye nezifo ezihlukahlukene.
Sake sakhuluma ukuthi izinga lokungabi nokudla linamandla kakhulu ku-70%. Kuleli, kuphela u-32% wabantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile (kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-79% futhi u-24% wezindlu unazo izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kuleli kanti kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-62%). Lezi yizinselelo ezifanayo ezithinta izindawo zasemaphandleni ezizungeze amadolobha lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo ezanele, kanye nezifo ezihlukahlukene. Izifunda ze-Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Umzinyathi, Zululand, nezinye izingxenye zendawo ye-Ilembe zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobubha elikhonjiswa ngezinkomba zomnotho. Izifunda ze-Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Umzinyathi, ingxenye esentshonalanga ye-Uthukela, ne-Zululand, ingxenye enyakatho ye-Umkhanyakude zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobubha kanye nokuntuleka kokuphila komphakathi (kuhlanganisa nezinga eliphansi lemfundo, ubuningi babantu, iningi labantu liyi- youth, abantu abadala, nabantu abaneziphene). Izindawo zasemaphandleni e-Umzinyathi, Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Zululand, Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Isisonke zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuntuleka kokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo ezibalulekile kuhlanganisa amanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwesistimu yokuphathwa kwemfucumfucu okudala inkinga enkulu kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ngaphansi kwegama le-Alma Ata, kufanele sisebenze ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba ezikhona ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa ukuze sithathe izinselelo eziphazamisa impilo yomphakathi futhi zehlise ukuzinza komnotho.
Izifunda ze-Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Umzinyathi, ingxenye esentshonalanga ye-Uthukela, ne-Zululand, ingxenye enyakatho ye-Umkhanyakude zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobubha kanye nokuntuleka kokuphila komphakathi (kuhlanganisa nezinga eliphansi lemfundo, ubuningi babantu, iningi labantu liyi- youth, abantu abadala, nabantu abaneziphene). Izindawo zasemaphandleni e-Umzinyathi, Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Zululand, Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Isisonke zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuntuleka kokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo ezibalulekile kuhlanganisa amanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwesistimu yokuphathwa kwemfucumfucu okudala inkinga enkulu kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ngaphansi kwegama le-Alma Ata, kufanele sisebenze ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba ezikhona ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa ukuze sithathe izinselelo eziphazamisa impilo yomphakathi futhi zehlise ukuzinza komnotho. Njengengxenye yalolu hlelo, sifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo yomphakathi eduze komphakathi futhi futhi sikhuthaze imikhankaso yokuphila kahle nezinhlelo zokufundisa ngezempilo ezihloselwe ukwazisa, ukufundisa, nokukhulisa ukuqwashisa kumiphakathi ngempilo. Abasebenzi bethu bezempilo bazoba nendima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi lolu hlelo luphumelele. Iyunithi egxile ezinkampanini ezincane, i-Targeted Enterprises Unit, yasungulwa kulo mnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi abanikazi abamnyama adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthengweni kukamasipala ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobubha kuleli futhi kuthuthukiswe izimo zezempilo nokwakha ikusasa eliphephile neliphumelelayo.
Njengengxenye yalolu hlelo, sifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo yomphakathi eduze komphakathi futhi futhi sikhuthaze imikhankaso yokuphila kahle nezinhlelo zokufundisa ngezempilo ezihloselwe ukwazisa, ukufundisa, nokukhulisa ukuqwashisa kumiphakathi ngempilo. Abasebenzi bethu bezempilo bazoba nendima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi lolu hlelo luphumelele. Iyunithi egxile ezinkampanini ezincane, i-Targeted Enterprises Unit, yasungulwa kulo mnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi abanikazi abamnyama adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthengweni kukamasipala ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobubha kuleli futhi kuthuthukiswe izimo zezempilo nokwakha ikusasa eliphephile neliphumelelayo. Okwamanje, kugxilwe ezinkampanini ezibambisene, ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu (SMMEs) ikakhulukazi lezo ezake zaba ngaphansi. Kukhona izinhlelo ezihloselwe ngqo abesifazane, intsha, nezinkampani eziphethwe abantu abaneziphene. Inani le-R81 million linikezwe ngaphansi kohlelo lokunikeza amabhizinisi ithuba lokuncintisana kunokuthumela izimemo kumabhizinisi athile ukuze ancintisane ngamanani abekwe emsebenzini odingekayo. Lolu hlelo luveze intuthuko ekwazini ukuphatha umkhankaso wezisebenzi emkhakheni wezokubambisana. Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuzibophezela komnyango ekulweni nezifo, ukulwa nobubha, nokunikeza ithemba kubantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Kunobufakazi obucacile bokuthi uma ubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni impilo nemfundo yabesifazane, uthuthukisa isimo sempilo yezingane zabo okuyisisekelo senhlangano enempilo enekusasa elikhanyayo.
Lolu hlelo luveze intuthuko ekwazini ukuphatha umkhankaso wezisebenzi emkhakheni wezokubambisana. Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuzibophezela komnyango ekulweni nezifo, ukulwa nobubha, nokunikeza ithemba kubantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Kunobufakazi obucacile bokuthi uma ubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni impilo nemfundo yabesifazane, uthuthukisa isimo sempilo yezingane zabo okuyisisekelo senhlangano enempilo enekusasa elikhanyayo. Izimayini: Izinzuzo Nezingozi Izimayini, noma mining, yindlela ebalulekile yokukhipha izinsiza ezisemhlabeni, ezifana nezinsimbi, amalahle, nezinsiza zemvelo. Le mboni inezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi ibhekene nezingqinamba ezithile ezidinga ukucutshungulwa. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nezimayini, ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi le mboni ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yethu. Izinzuzo Zezimayini Okokuqala, izimayini zidlala indima enkulu emnothweni wezwe. Ukukhipha izinsiza ezisemhlabeni kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi, okwenza kube nezisebenzi eziningi ezithola imiholo. Lokhu kuholela ekukhuleni komnotho, njengoba abantu bethola imali yokuphila. Umsebenzi wezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezimboni zidinga lezi zinsiza, futhi lokho kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. Okwesibili, izimayini zenza kube nokwabelana ngempumelelo kwezimali. Izinkampani ezinkulu ezisebenza emayini zikhokha izintela ezinkulu, okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izikole, izibhedlela, nezinsiza zomphakathi, okwenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimayini zenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, njengoba izinkampani zidinga izindlela ezintsha zokwenza umsebenzi wazo ube lula futhi uphumelele. Izingqinamba Nezingozi Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Izimayini zibuye zibe nezingozi eziningi. Okokuqala, imiphumela yemvelo iyinkinga enkulu. Ukuvuna izinsiza kudala umonakalo omkhulu emithonjeni yamanzi, emhlabathini, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kubangela ukonakala kwemvelo, okukhathaza kakhulu izakhamuzi ezihlala eduze kwezindawo zokumba.
Okokuqala, imiphumela yemvelo iyinkinga enkulu. Ukuvuna izinsiza kudala umonakalo omkhulu emithonjeni yamanzi, emhlabathini, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kubangela ukonakala kwemvelo, okukhathaza kakhulu izakhamuzi ezihlala eduze kwezindawo zokumba. Ukungcola okukhishwa emayini, njengamagesi nemfucumfucu, kubangela izinkinga zempilo kubantu abaseduze. Okwesibili, izimayini zidalela abantu izimo ezinzima zokusebenza. Imisebenzi emayini ivamise ukuba yingozi, futhi izisebenzi zihlala zibhekene nezingozi ezinkulu. Ukushisa, ukungcoliswa, kanye nezingozi zokuhlaselwa yizinto ezinjengemishini yokumba, konke lokhu kudala izimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zikhokhe izindleko ezinkulu zokuvikela izisebenzi, kodwa kwezinye izikhathi, lokhu akwenziwanga ngendlela efanele. Ukubheka Phambili Ukuze sithuthukise izimayini, kudingeka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuphucula izinqubo zokusebenza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo emvelweni. Izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izindlela zokumba ezihlanzekile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela emibi iyancishiswa. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimayini zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuvikela izisebenzi. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanele nokuphathwa kwezimo zokusebenza kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi zikhululekile futhi ziphephile emsebenzini wazo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini, okukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa, izimayini zinezinto ezinhle nezimbi.

Inyama Yenkomo: Incazelo Nokuqonda Inyama yenkomo ibalulekile empilweni yamaZulu, njengoba ibonisa isiko, ubuchwepheshe bokulima, kanye nempilo yokudla. Ngaphandle kokuba umthombo omkhulu wokudla, inyama yenkomo iyinsika yamasiko amaningi, ikakhulukazi emishadweni, ezinsukwini zokugubha, kanye nasezikhumbuzweni zamasiko. Lokhu kubaluleka kwenyama yenkomo kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezinto ezihambisana nayo, okubandakanya indlela yokuyilungisa, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezindlela zokuyisebenzisa. Ukwakhiwa Kwenkomo Inkomo, njengezilwane ezinkulu, zikhula zibe zikhulu futhi ziqhuba impilo yazo ngokudla okukhululekile. Zivame ukugcina ezindaweni ezivulekile, lapho zikhula khona zisebenzisa izitshalo eziphilayo. Ukwakhiwa kwenkomo kudinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu, okuhlanganisa ukudla okufanele, amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala ezinempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi inyama yenkomo izoba nekhwalithi enhle, okubalulekile emkhakheni wezokudla. Ukwelashwa Kwenkomo Ukuze inyama yenkomo ibe nekhwalithi ephezulu, kubalulekile ukuthi zihlale zihlanzekile futhi ziqinisekiswe ukuthi aziguli. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu, abanikazi bezinkomo bahlola impilo zazo njalo, beqaphela izimpawu zokugula. Ukwelashwa okukhona kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngama-vaccine, ukudla okunempilo, nokunakekela izimo zempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi inyama ethengiswa emakethe iyahlangabezana nezidingo zempilo yomphakathi. Ukwenza Inyama Yenkomo Inyama yenkomo ingahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, njengezitho, izinqe, nezinye izingxenye. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zenyama zinezindlela ezihlukene zokupheka.
Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi inyama ethengiswa emakethe iyahlangabezana nezidingo zempilo yomphakathi. Ukwenza Inyama Yenkomo Inyama yenkomo ingahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, njengezitho, izinqe, nezinye izingxenye. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zenyama zinezindlela ezihlukene zokupheka. Ngokwesibonelo, izinqe zihlala zisetshenziswa ekuphekeni okuthile, njengezimbiza, kanti izitho zisetshenziswa kakhulu ezithelweni ezijwayelekile. Ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela yokupheka efanele, ukuze inyama igcine ukunambitheka kwayo. Izinzuzo Zokudla Inyama Yenkomo Inyama yenkomo inezinzuzo eziningi empilweni. Iqukethe amaprotheni amaningi, amavithamini, namaminerali abalulekile, njengensimbi ne-zinc, okuyinto ebalulekile emzimbeni. Amaphrotheni asiza ekwakheni imisipha, kuyilapho amavithamini edlula emzimbeni, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inyama yenkomo iyinsika yokwakha izinkonzo ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezimweni zokugubha. Izindlela Zokusebenzisa Inyama Yenkomo Inyama yenkomo ingasetshenziswa ngezindlela eziningi. Isetshenziswa kakhulu ekuphekeni, kodwa futhi kungaba yinsika yokwakha izitsha ezahlukene. Izitsha ezidumile zifaka phakathi i-braai, i-stew, kanye ne-biltong. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi inyama yenkomo ingaba yinto ethokozisayo, ethokozisayo, futhi efanele ukuphakanyiswa emakhaya nasemphakathini. Isiko Nezinkolelo Inyama yenkomo ibalulekile emikhubeni yamaZulu. Isetshenziswa ezinsukwini zokugubha, emishadweni, nasezikhumbuzweni. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuhlanganisa imindeni.
Isiko Nezinkolelo Inyama yenkomo ibalulekile emikhubeni yamaZulu. Isetshenziswa ezinsukwini zokugubha, emishadweni, nasezikhumbuzweni. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuhlanganisa imindeni. Izinkolelo ezihambisana nenyama yenkomo zikhombisa ukuthi inhlonipho nokuqonda kwamasiko kubalulekile empilweni yamaZulu. Ukugcina Nokuthuthukisa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithuthukisa izindlela zokulima nezokugcina izinkomo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono yezinkomo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlala ziqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi inyama yenkomo iqhubeke ibalulekile empilweni yethu. Isiphetho Inyama yenkomo ayigcini nje ngokuba umthombo wokudla, kodwa ibalulekile emlandweni, ezwenikazi, nasempilweni yamaZulu. Ukuqonda kahle inyama yenkomo, izinzuzo zayo, nezindlela zokuyilungisa, kubalulekile ukuze sihloniphe futhi sigcine lesi siko. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokugcina lezi zinkolelo, sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokulima, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi inyama yenkomo iyinsika yempilo yethu.
Ubusuku buyafika emva kwesizini esomileyo esandulelayo nesizini yemvula. Njengoba isimo sezulu sihle kule nkathi, izindawo zokufuywa zihlala zikhona kahle, kodwa lokhu kusho nokuthi utshani obumile nezinkambu zingaba yingozi enkulu yomlilo kulo nyaka. Umlilo owodwa ungabhubhisa futhi ubulale izinkulungwane zamahhektare omhlaba ezindaweni zokufuya. Imililo ezinkambeni ivame ukwenzeka ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuvuna ngoba ngaleso sikhathi izitshalo zomile futhi izinkambu zihlanzekile. Izingane akufanele zidlale nomlilo. Ungaphoseli umnqamulajuqu ongenalutho noma isiqholo emalini eyomile, noma ezithelweni ezomile noma ezihlahleni. Ungaqali umlilo ongawulawuli ngaphandle ezinkambeni noma uma kunomoya onamandla. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imililo oyivulile iphelile ngokuphelele uma usuqedile. Uma ubona umlilo ezinkambeni noma ezitshalo, shesha wazise ozakwenu nomphathiswa wezomlilo kule ndawo. Batshele kahle ukuthi umlilo uphi. Shiya abanye abantu ekhaya ukuze banikeze ulwazi ngommilo kwabanye. Uma uneradiyo noma ifoni, ungayisebenzisa ukuze abanye bakwazi ukukuthinta uma kwenzeka kukhona olunye ulwazi ngommilo. Uma ungumnikazi wefamu, kufanele wazise umnikazi ngokushesha ngendawo yomlilo. Susa zonke izilwane nezinsiza endaweni ephephile. Izinto zokucisha umlilo - amanzi noma isand. Dala izithiyo zomlilo usebenzisa ama-rubber bands endala noma amabhakede amanzi. Uma udala izithiyo zomlilo ngeziqeshana noma amabhakede, ususa umoya (okhanyayo) odingekayo ukuze umlilo uphume. Ngaphandle kokhanyayo, umlilo uzokhanya kancane kancane kuze kufe.
Dala izithiyo zomlilo usebenzisa ama-rubber bands endala noma amabhakede amanzi. Uma udala izithiyo zomlilo ngeziqeshana noma amabhakede, ususa umoya (okhanyayo) odingekayo ukuze umlilo uphume. Ngaphandle kokhanyayo, umlilo uzokhanya kancane kancane kuze kufe. Sebenzisa amapompo aqinile ezansi ukuze umise utshani ezindaweni ez sides nasephakathini komlilo. La mapompo angasetshenziswa futhi uma ucabanga ukuthi umlilo usuphume kuzo zonke izindawo ngemva kokuzama ukucisha umlilo okukhulu. Sebenzisa izikhwama zamanzi namapompo ukuze unikeze amanzi anele. Izithiyo zomlilo nezithiyo zingasetshenziswa ukudala isithiyo somlilo utshani ukuze kuvinjelwe umlilo ukuthi ungadluli kwezinye izindawo. Ungakha nomlilo omusha oqala kulolu sithiyo somlilo lapho umoya uvuma khona. Isimo somlilo siwumkhakha ofana nomgwaqo lapho kungekho utshani ongabamba umlilo. Sebenzisa izithiyo zomlilo nezithiyo ukuze ucishe umlilo ngesand nesihlabathi. Futhi sebenzisa lezi zinto ukususa utshani obomile obungabamba umlilo kalula. Sebenzisa amathuluzi angathwalwa ngesandla ukusika utshani obomile ngaphambi kokufika komlilo. Ngena emlilweni ezindaweni ez sides noma ezimaphakathi lapho umlilo uphume ukuze unciphise ukuhamba komlilo. Uma kukhona isithiyo somlilo noma isithiyo semvelo efana nomfula, zama ukuphonsa umlilo kuleyo zindawo. Beka abantu ezindaweni lapho bengakwazi khona ukulwa nomlilo lapho umlilo ungase uqale khona. Umoya ungathwala imicibisholo yomlilo ibanga elingafika kumakilomitha amabili.
Uma kukhona isithiyo somlilo noma isithiyo semvelo efana nomfula, zama ukuphonsa umlilo kuleyo zindawo. Beka abantu ezindaweni lapho bengakwazi khona ukulwa nomlilo lapho umlilo ungase uqale khona. Umoya ungathwala imicibisholo yomlilo ibanga elingafika kumakilomitha amabili. Kubalulekile ukudala izithiyo zomlilo ezizobuyisela utshani obushisayo ngaphakathi komlilo ukuze imicibisholo ingaflanga utshani obomile lapho umlilo ungavutha khona. Hlola njalo indlela yomoya - ivela kuphi, iya kuphi? Qinisekisa ukuthi akukho bantu abalimele. Hamba kuwo wonke amakhaya lapho umlilo ubhujiswe khona isikhathi esingama-3 ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi akukho zindawo lapho umlilo uqale khona kabusha. Buyisela zonke izinsiza endaweni yazo. Phinda ugcwalise izikhwama zamanzi. Lungisa izinsiza eziphukile noma ezonakele. Bonke abanikazi bomhlaba noma abalimi lapho umlilo ungase uqale khona ongabamba leyo fomu noma udlule kwezinye izifundazwe kufanele bakhe isithiyo somlilo emingceleni ye-famu yabo nezinye izifundazwe. Kungumthwalo wakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umlilo awuqali efamu yakho. Ukwakha izithiyo zomlilo efamu yakho kungasiza ekuvikeleni ngoba kungakuvikela wena nefamu yakho (ifamu, izakhiwo, izitshalo, izilwane) ezinsongweni. Ozakwenu bangavuma ukwakha nokugcina izithiyo zomlilo emingceleni ye-famu zabo. Akufanele sibe nezinto ezingabamba umlilo kalula futhi zidlule emkhakheni. Thola izindlela zokufinyelela nokufinyelela emlilweni.
Uhlaka: Ulwazi luthathwe kuHlelo lweMfundo Ephakeme lokukhiqiza iSorghum. Umkhiqizi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphathwa kokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi kubalulekile lapho kuthuthukiswa izinhlelo futhi ngaphambi kokutshala, njengoba lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthi kube nokukhiqiza okuphelele njengoba kuhilela zonke izenzo ezenziwa umphathi. Lezi ezilandelayo yizici ezingathinta ikhwalithi yezinsalela ezivunyiwe (okwakhiwa): ukulungiswa komhlabathi, ukujula komhlabathi, i-pH, ibhalansi yezimayini, ukugcina umswakama emhlabathini, uhlobo lwez plants, umanyolo ofanele, ukuphathwa kwezihlahla nezifo, ukuvuna ngesikhathi esifanele nokuphatha, ukuhlanza okwakhiwa, ukuwasha okwakhiwa, kanye nezindlela zokugcina (ukubeka) okwakhiwa. Ukuvuna kuyinselelo ebalulekile uma kutshalwa i-sorghum. Siqala ukuvuna ngaphambi kokwenza ezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kokwakhiwa njengokucubungula, ukugcina, nokugcina umkhiqizo. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindawo lapho ukuvuna, ukugcina, nokugcina imisebenzi kuhlukaniswe. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nokuvuna ngezandla bese yonke imikhiqizo ibekwe ukuvuna kamuva uma isomile emapulazini amancane. Bese kuqhubeka emapulazini ezohwebo lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna okwakhiwa. Ngokuvamile, i-sorghum ivunwa ndawonye ne-maize futhi ivunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma itshalwe kusenesikhathi, kuyilapho enye ivunwa ngoMeyi uma itshalwe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuna kwe-maize kuqale.
Bese kuqhubeka emapulazini ezohwebo lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna okwakhiwa. Ngokuvamile, i-sorghum ivunwa ndawonye ne-maize futhi ivunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma itshalwe kusenesikhathi, kuyilapho enye ivunwa ngoMeyi uma itshalwe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuna kwe-maize kuqale. Lokhu kubalulekile emapulazini amancane lapho ama-combine angavuna i-sorghum ne-maize. Umkhiqizi noma umuntu othile uzothola umqashi onemishini ekwazi ukuvuna i-sorghum ne-maize. Isikhathi esivela ekuphumeleleni kokwakhiwa kuya ekuvuneni kufanele sibe mfushane - lokhu kuzovimbela izingozi ezidalwa yizinyoni nokonakala kokwakhiwa nakwezinye izifo. Izitshalo ze-sorghum ziba zikhulile lapho umbala ngemuva kokwakhiwa ushintsha, ekuqaleni umbala ubuhlalu bese ube mpunga. Lokhu kushintsha ngokuvamile kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba okwakhiwa kumiswe ukuze kuvunwe. I-sorghum etshaliwe kamuva izoba ready kuphela emva kokufriza kokuqala ebusika. Ngaphambi kokuqala ukuvuna, sebenzisa umshini wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uhlole okuqukethwe komswakama kokwakhiwa uma kuqala ukuvuthwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uzovuna ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma ungenawo umshini wokuhlola umswakama, thola amasampula okwakhiwa kumphathi wesilo oseduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna.
I-sorghum etshaliwe kamuva izoba ready kuphela emva kokufriza kokuqala ebusika. Ngaphambi kokuqala ukuvuna, sebenzisa umshini wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uhlole okuqukethwe komswakama kokwakhiwa uma kuqala ukuvuthwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uzovuna ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma ungenawo umshini wokuhlola umswakama, thola amasampula okwakhiwa kumphathi wesilo oseduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna. Ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kokwakhiwa ngenxa yomswakama ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nezingozi zezinyoni, i-sorghum ingavunwa ngesikhathi sokugcina umswakama esiphakathi kuka-20% kuya ku-25% bese yoma emshinini wokoma kuze kube kufinyelela ku-9.5%. Lokhu kuqukethwe komswakama kufanelekile ukuze kubekwe (kugcinwe) i-sorghum ezindongeni. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, kungcono ukushiya i-sorghum emhlabeni ukuze yomile kahle ngaphambi kokuvuna. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uma okuqukethwe komswakama kuphakeme kuka-10%, kuzodonsa kalula umswakama. Isivinini se-combine kufanele sibe phakathi kuka-5 kuya ku-8 kilometers ngehora. Isivinini esiphakeme phambili sizohambisana nokwakhiwa komswakama kwe-sorghum kanye nosayizi womkhiqizo. Isivinini kufanele sinciphise uma okuqukethwe komswakama kuphansi ukuvimbela okwakhiwa ekonakaleni uma kungena emshinini. Ungasisebenzisa uma okuqukethwe komswakama sishintsha sibe phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okwakhiwa okukhona phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% kuzonakala kulula ukonakala uma kungena kwi-cylinder.
Ungasisebenzisa uma okuqukethwe komswakama sishintsha sibe phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okwakhiwa okukhona phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% kuzonakala kulula ukonakala uma kungena kwi-cylinder. Okukhishiwe okungekho ngokuphelele okonakaliswe kuhlala emhlabeni. I-'concave' ivulekile kakhulu. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezisele. Ukuphuma komoya okuphansi, ukonakala kwi-cylinder kwenzeka ngokushesha. Ukuvuleka kwe-'chaffer' kuncane kakhulu. Izinto eziningi eziphukile zikhishwa ebhakedeni 'lokulahleka'. Ukonakala okuphezulu kakhulu, i-cylinder esheshayo, i-'concave' eqinile, umoya ophumayo uhamba kancane, ama-augers avulekile kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okuphukile kufihlwe. I-cylinder esheshayo, ukuvuleka okuncane kwe-'concave'. Okukhishiwe kufihlwe kodwa ngaphandle kusempilweni. Ukuvuleka kwe-'concave' kuncane kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okuphukile kanye nezinsalela ezikhululekile. Isivinini se-cylinder/rotary siphakeme kakhulu noma kukhona okuncane okusele. Okukhishiwe okungekho ngokuphelele okonakaliswe kuhlala emhlabeni. Amabhodi nekhanda akahambisani kahle. Okukhishiwe kuphuma ngemuva kwe-combine. Isivinini/ukuphuma komoya, hamba kancane emshinini futhi isivinini sokuphuma komoya. Ukulahleka komkhiqizo kungaba ngu-3% - 5% kodwa kungakhula kube ngu-10% - 15% ngezikhathi ezithile. Imishini yokuvuna kufanele ihlolwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isebenza kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuyihlola ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi mangaki alahlekile.
Isivinini/ukuphuma komoya, hamba kancane emshinini futhi isivinini sokuphuma komoya. Ukulahleka komkhiqizo kungaba ngu-3% - 5% kodwa kungakhula kube ngu-10% - 15% ngezikhathi ezithile. Imishini yokuvuna kufanele ihlolwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isebenza kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuyihlola ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi mangaki alahlekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhiqizi angakwazi ukuqala ukuphatha ukuvuna nokwakhiwa komswakama ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela zokuhlola okwakhiwa kwakho. Uma umkhiqizo wakho uhamba kahle, thenga umshini wakho wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uvimbele ukuvuvukala esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kubalulekile lapho kukhiqizwa futhi kuthengiswa okwakhiwa kokudla. Ukonakala kokwakhiwa uma kuphumelelwe kakhulu bese kubekwe ezindongeni uma kubanda kakhulu noma ezindongeni ezisebenzisa umoya olemukelekayo kuphela. Izindleko zingavela uma okwakhiwa kuvunwa uma kuphumelelwe kakhulu. Ukukhula kokwakhiwa nezindleko zokomisa lezi zakhiwa. Ukulahleka kwenani lomkhiqizo. Ukuze wenze ukuhlola okuqondile, kufanele uqale uthole isampula enhle ezokhombisa inani lomkhiqizo wonke. Lapha sithatha isampula ezitshalo ezingakavunwanga (emaphandleni) ukuze sithole ukuthi okwakhiwa kuphumelelwe kakhulu, lokhu kungasiphazamisa, futhi sivame ukuvuna kamuva, hhayi ngesikhathi esifanele. Vuna ingxenye bese uhlola. Hlanganisa amakhanda ezitshalo ozithathile ngezandla emaphandleni, ucindezele kuze kube okwakhiwa kuphuma. Thatha ukuhlola okuthathu kulokhu okwakhiwa bese uthola ngaphakathi. Thumela le sampula kumphathi wesilo ukuze wenze ukuhlola okuqondile.
Hlanganisa amakhanda ezitshalo ozithathile ngezandla emaphandleni, ucindezele kuze kube okwakhiwa kuphuma. Thatha ukuhlola okuthathu kulokhu okwakhiwa bese uthola ngaphakathi. Thumela le sampula kumphathi wesilo ukuze wenze ukuhlola okuqondile. Yenza lokhu njalo uma amakhanda eshintsha abe mpunga ukuze okwakhiwa kuvunwe ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa komswakama esifanele ukuze kulethe umkhiqizo omuhle. Lokhu kungaba yinto enhle kumfuyi osanda kufika kulokho okubizwa ngokuthi abapheki bezohwebo. Kukhona izindonga ezenziwe ngegalvanized steel ezisuka ku-10 kuya ku-30 tons. Uma kungekho imali eningi, izindonga ezincane (10 tons) zingasetshenziswa ekuqaleni, bese lokhu kungakhuliswa njeng
Namuhla sikhona lapha njengeMnyango WezokuHulumeni Nezamasiko ukuze sisize futhi sisekele iRoyal House ekufezeni imisebenzi yayo, ehlanganisa ukufakwa kwezinkosi ngokwezinkolo nangokuhambisana nomthetho. Nanku, uMnumzane, umthetho osebenzayo uveza ngokusobala ukuthi ukufakwa kwezinkosi kwiRoyal House kungenziwa kuphela ngokuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko. Lo mthetho esiwakhe esifundazweni uveza ukuthi kuphela iRoyal House enegunya lokufaka izinkosi; ngaphandle kwalokho, uNgqongqoshe angasebenza kuphela ngalolu hlelo ngemvume yeRoyal House, uma singakwazi ukuba khona mathupha. Inkosi Hlongwane inguNkosi yesithupha okufakwe ngokusemthethweni esikhathini esifushane kusukela le nhlangano yamanje esifundazweni sethu iqale umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sokubusa ezindaweni ezifanele. Le ndawo, isivinini esihamba ngaso sikhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubukhosi busebenza njengephuzu elibalulekile lokuhola ngaphansi kukahulumeni onobulungiswa. Abaholi bendabuko ngesikhathi sokucindezelwa bavame ukungabhekiwe kulomsebenzi obalulekile wokufaka izinkosi. Ngesikhathi se-apartheid, lo msebenzi obalulekile wokufaka izinkosi wawunikezwa kumakhosana nabanye osomabhizinisi. Umthetho WamaBlack Authorities ka-1951 wawuhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuholi bendabuko buba ithuluzi elilula labacindezeli. Umsebenzi wezinkosi wokubika kwiRoyal House ungumkhuba wendabuko oneminyaka eminingi futhi uyisisekelo sokubusa. Uhulumeni esinawo njengamanje esifundazweni uqale uhlelo lwezomthetho oluhloselwe ukubuyisela isithunzi nesikhundla sobuholi bendabuko ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zokubusa eziphathwe nguMthethosisekelo.
Umthetho WamaBlack Authorities ka-1951 wawuhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuholi bendabuko buba ithuluzi elilula labacindezeli. Umsebenzi wezinkosi wokubika kwiRoyal House ungumkhuba wendabuko oneminyaka eminingi futhi uyisisekelo sokubusa. Uhulumeni esinawo njengamanje esifundazweni uqale uhlelo lwezomthetho oluhloselwe ukubuyisela isithunzi nesikhundla sobuholi bendabuko ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zokubusa eziphathwe nguMthethosisekelo. Njengohulumeni, siyazi ngomonakalo owenziwe yimithetho edlule emqondweni wobuholi bendabuko. Siyaqonda, Mhlaba Womhlabathi, ukuthi uthole ukuthi ungabhekiwe emicimbini yokufakwa kwezinkosi nakwezinye ezaziphethwe abaholi bendabuko kodwa zaphathwa osomabhizinisi. Nokho, namuhla siqinisekisa wena, Mhlaba Womphakathi, ukuthi ukufakwa kwezinkosi ngeke kusetshenziswe njengemivuzo noma ukuheha ukwesekwa kweziphathimandla zezombusazwe. Ubukhosi buwumsebenzi ophakanyisiwe emthethweni wethu. Yingakho uhulumeni ephakamisa izinhlelo zomthetho ezifanele zokubambisana (IGR) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkosi nezinye izigaba zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Ngikhuluma lapha namuhla ngoba uhulumeni wethu wesifunda saseKwaZulu-Natal uqale isifundo sokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kukahulumeni, ubuholi bendabuko kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Ngifuna ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ukuthi izinkosi nonke sikhishwe emthethweni wamaHulumeni adlule ekubambeni iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Kodwa kusukela manje, le nhlobo ingumlando.
Ngikhuluma lapha namuhla ngoba uhulumeni wethu wesifunda saseKwaZulu-Natal uqale isifundo sokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kukahulumeni, ubuholi bendabuko kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Ngifuna ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ukuthi izinkosi nonke sikhishwe emthethweni wamaHulumeni adlule ekubambeni iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Kodwa kusukela manje, le nhlobo ingumlando. Kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa "ukubuyiselwa" kwesithunzi sobukhosi njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuphathwa. Nokho, kuyadabukisa ukuthi abanye bethu sebebhekene nokusebenzisa ubuholi bendabuko ngezizathu zezombusazwe nangokuzuza kwabo siqu. Esikhathini esedlule, abezombusazwe nabaphathi bakhuphula ezinye izinkosi phezulu kwezinye. Lo hulumeni wamanje uzokwamukela kuphela ukuphakanyiswa okuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko futhi kuqinisekiswe yiRoyal House. Ekupheleni konyaka odlule, ngihambele umhlangano wokuthuthukisa amasu okusebenza kwemnyango wami. Kumele ngithi le njongo ihlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha isikhungo sobukhosi ukuze sisebenze ngaphandle kokungabaza. Kungalesi sizathu nakwezinye engikhuluma ngazo ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa okuhle, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha kwezintela ezikhokhwayo ezindaweni zobukhosi. Ngakho-ke, Mhlaba Womphakathi, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngiqinisekise neRoyal House ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kwezinkosi ohulumeni ophathayo esifundazweni kuyisiko elihle elilandelwa emhlabeni jikelele.
Kumele ngithi le njongo ihlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha isikhungo sobukhosi ukuze sisebenze ngaphandle kokungabaza. Kungalesi sizathu nakwezinye engikhuluma ngazo ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa okuhle, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha kwezintela ezikhokhwayo ezindaweni zobukhosi. Ngakho-ke, Mhlaba Womphakathi, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngiqinisekise neRoyal House ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kwezinkosi ohulumeni ophathayo esifundazweni kuyisiko elihle elilandelwa emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kugcinwa ngezindinganiso ezahlukene kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukene okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe lesi sithunzi; akufanele kusetshenziswe ukukala izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko uma kuqhathaniswa nezikhundla ezahlukene zikahulumeni. Izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko ngaphansi kwesakhiwo sobukhosi ziyingxenye yalowo mphakathi ngaphansi kwenkosi. Ngaphezu kokusiza imiphakathi ezindaweni zobukhosi kanye nabaholi bendabuko ukuze bathole ukuhlonishwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona, imnyango yami isebenza ngokwakha kabusha izikhungo zokuphatha zendabuko. Lokhu kuhilela ukuguqula lezi "zinkantolo zobukhosi" ezazaziwa ngaphambili zibe izakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukusungula ubudlelwano nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza abaholi bethu bendabuko nezakhiwo zabo ukuba bathathe ithuba lezi zinhlelo ezichazwe emthethweni kazwelonke mayelana nokuphathwa kwezendabuko (njengokuphakanyiswa nguMthethosisekelo waseKwaZulu-Natal).
Ngaphezu kokusiza imiphakathi ezindaweni zobukhosi kanye nabaholi bendabuko ukuze bathole ukuhlonishwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona, imnyango yami isebenza ngokwakha kabusha izikhungo zokuphatha zendabuko. Lokhu kuhilela ukuguqula lezi "zinkantolo zobukhosi" ezazaziwa ngaphambili zibe izakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukusungula ubudlelwano nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza abaholi bethu bendabuko nezakhiwo zabo ukuba bathathe ithuba lezi zinhlelo ezichazwe emthethweni kazwelonke mayelana nokuphathwa kwezendabuko (njengokuphakanyiswa nguMthethosisekelo waseKwaZulu-Natal). Enye yalezi zithuba ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni zokubambisana nezinsiza zikahulumeni ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi ethile lapho isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sinokwakha ukwenza kanjalo. Ngokwesibonelo, mhlawumbe isakhiwo sokuphatha senkosi singasiza umphakathi ngezincwadi zokufaka izicelo zomsebenzi, ukuqeqesha abantu ngamakhono amasha e-computer. Izinkosi zingamalungu ohulumeni abekwe phambili. Ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuze sihambisane nezakhiwo zabo nezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezimisiwe. Kumele ngiqinisekise namuhla ukuthi le nhlangano ihloselwe kuphela izinjongo zokusebenza. Kuyinhloso yokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza nokuthuthukiswa. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkosi noMeya abukhombisi ukufana ezikhundleni. Kungaba yiphutha ukususa inkosi ezindabeni zendawo ngenxa yokuthi, emicabangweni yethu, kufanele ikhulume nomlingani wayo eKapa noma ePitoli. Singase sibe nalolo cabango olukhuluma ngempela.
Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkosi noMeya abukhombisi ukufana ezikhundleni. Kungaba yiphutha ukususa inkosi ezindabeni zendawo ngenxa yokuthi, emicabangweni yethu, kufanele ikhulume nomlingani wayo eKapa noma ePitoli. Singase sibe nalolo cabango olukhuluma ngempela. Nokho, sikhumbuza namuhla ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu, obuhlanganisa izakhiwo ezahlukene zikahulumeni, bugxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kuhanjiswa ngokushesha ezizweni zobukhosi. Zonke izinkosi ziyazi ukuthi sikhona kude ekuthumeleni izinsiza ezindaweni zabo, futhi sidinga ukuba baxhumane nathi njengohulumeni ekuhlinzekeni ngokushesha kwalezi zidingo. Inkosi Hlongwane nomphakathi, njengendawo yaseKwaZulu-Natal, sibhiyozela intuthuko esiyenzayo ekubuyiseni isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko, ukuguqulwa kwaso, kanye nokuhambisana nezinye izakhiwo zokuphathwa, ikakhulukazi ezingeni likamasipala. Ngithatha leli thuba ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ngezinto ezibalulekile ezihlobene nesiko lokufakwa kwezinkosi ngokusemthethweni. Kukho umthetho ongakakwenziwa esifundazweni onikeza ulwazi olunembile ngalesi sihloko. Namuhla kuhle ukugcizelela ukuthi umndeni wobukhosi udlala indima ebalulekile ezinqum
Ezocwaningo: Umgudu Wokuhlola Nokuthola Iqiniso Ekuqaleni kwalesi sahluko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezocwaningo akuhambisani kuphela nezinsiza noma imiphumela ethile; kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha ulwazi nokwabelana ngakho emphakathini. Kwezamazwe amaningi, ezocwaningo sekuvele kwaba nendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ezempilo, imfundo, nezobuchwepheshe. Ukucwaninga, ngesinye isikhathi, kuyindlela yokwakha izinsiza ezisemqoka nokuthola izixazululo ezintsha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wezocwaningo ufike walungiswa futhi wathuthuka. Ezinye izinsiza zokuqala zicafula eminyakeni edlule, lapho izazi ezifana no-Aristotle no-Plato bezama ukuqonda umhlaba wabo ngokuhlola nokuhlola. U-Aristotle, owakhayo umhlaba wefilosofi, wahlola izikhumbuzo ezidala, ehlola izinyathelo zokuhlola izimfanelo zempilo yezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kwakuhlosiwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile akuyena owodwa kuphela, kepha nabanye. Kwakuyisinyathelo sokuqala ekwakheni umqondo wezocwaningo njengoba sazi namhlanje. Njengoba izikhathi zedlula, isiko lokucwaninga ladlulela Phambili. I-Scientific Revolution yakhulela abantu ukuba bacwaninge izincazelo zezinqubo zemvelo. Abaphenyi bahlola izimo ezinjengokukhanya, amandla, nezinqubo zemvelo, bese bejolisa emiphumeleni engapheli ebudlelwaneni bethu nemvelo. Lokhu kwakhulisa umsebenzi wezinkanyezi, kobuchwepheshe nemikhakha eminingi. Kodwa-ke, awekho wonke amakhamandela akhula angathanda ukusebenza ezocwaningo. Kwakukhona izinzwa ezithile nezinhlobonhlobo, lapho imiphumela ethile yocwaningo yayicwengobile.
Lokhu kwakhulisa umsebenzi wezinkanyezi, kobuchwepheshe nemikhakha eminingi. Kodwa-ke, awekho wonke amakhamandela akhula angathanda ukusebenza ezocwaningo. Kwakukhona izinzwa ezithile nezinhlobonhlobo, lapho imiphumela ethile yocwaningo yayicwengobile. Lokhu kubangele ukuthi abacwaningi bahlale bejula ngezinye izinkulumo zokwakha ibhodi lemigomo ye-protocol yokuhlola, stave izimiso ezithile zokulwa nobuqolo bokungabi nemiphumela emisha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wezocwaningo wathola ulwazi olunembile noluhloniphekile. Nbaza, eminyakeni yezi-1900 ukuza phambili, kwaqala ukusebenza ezinkampanini eziningi zezeMfundo, okukhombisa ukuthi ezinye izikhungo zenhlalphephendaweni zaziqala ukuthola izinsiza ezihamba phambili zokuhlola. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nemiphumela eminingi engakholeki. Ubufakazi bokuthi ezocwaningo bukhula ngendlela emangalisayo kungenziwa ngezigigaba ezifananezicelo ezithile njengokuthi “Ezocwaningo lwe-Genetic” noma izincwadi ezahlukene ezihamba phambili ekuthulaseni ubuchwepheshe bokugcina bahlola izinkanyezi. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni imikhakha eyahlukeneyo, evumela abacwaningi ukuba benze izifundo ezihlukene ezithinta abantu, imiphakathi nempilo. Ngokubambisana, izikhungo zemfundo zihlinzeka ngezimali ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni ezocwaningo. Lolu hlelo lwaqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso ezazitholwa ngezinsuku ezedlule zitholakala zisebenzayo. Abacwaningi bajejezelwa ukuphathwa okunembile kwezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, koko kulindeleke ukuthi ezobuchwepheshe zikhule zihlale kulungile. Ezocwaningo kanti umgudu eziyindlela yokuzithokozisa.
Lolu hlelo lwaqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso ezazitholwa ngezinsuku ezedlule zitholakala zisebenzayo. Abacwaningi bajejezelwa ukuphathwa okunembile kwezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, koko kulindeleke ukuthi ezobuchwepheshe zikhule zihlale kulungile. Ezocwaningo kanti umgudu eziyindlela yokuzithokozisa. Isibonelo, uqhubeka uqedwa thina kufanele sibe nezinye izibonakaliso ezibonakalayo zokuhlola abanye. Kungaxisize ukwandisa umqondo wezocwaningo kudaleke ubudlelwano obusha, nokwandisa uzalo lwezinsiza olwakha izinsuku zangempela. Umgudu wokunciphisa izinkinga ezibhekene nezeNgqungquthela zamakhulu okusebenza kuyasivula umnyango omkhulu wezimfanelo. Ukucwaninga akuphumi nje ekusebenzelaneni kwezempilo, impilo yempilo, nokuxhobisa ubuchwepheshe obubuchopho. Yiphuphuni elunele nokukhula kokuhlola imicabango ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Ubumbeko benzo bukhonkolo ebudlelwaneni bethu nezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Kanjalo, imiphumela iyasilungiselela imicabango, ifanisa ukuxhumana kwezokuxhumana. Ngokuzayo, kufanele sigqoke izifiso zethu, sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wokucwaninga awupheleli. Njengoba siqhubeka siphenya futhi sihlole, sizothola izindlela ezintsha zokuthula izinkinga ezibucayi ezithinta umhlaba, ukuze sithole izinsiza ezinzima nezibalulekile ekusizeni abantu. Umgudu wezocwaningo, njengobukhulu beli qiniso, uphakathi nendawo ezama ubuchopho. Usiqondisa ukuthi ibhalwe ngezindlela ezizozama phambili ukuze sithole ukuqonda okukhulu, izixazululo ezisebenzayo kwaye sithole iqiniso elijulile lokwakha isizwe esiqinile nempilo engcono.
Njengoba siqhubeka siphenya futhi sihlole, sizothola izindlela ezintsha zokuthula izinkinga ezibucayi ezithinta umhlaba, ukuze sithole izinsiza ezinzima nezibalulekile ekusizeni abantu. Umgudu wezocwaningo, njengobukhulu beli qiniso, uphakathi nendawo ezama ubuchopho. Usiqondisa ukuthi ibhalwe ngezindlela ezizozama phambili ukuze sithole ukuqonda okukhulu, izixazululo ezisebenzayo kwaye sithole iqiniso elijulile lokwakha isizwe esiqinile nempilo engcono. Lokhu kusemqoka ukuze sikhumbule ukuthi izinsizakalo ezinikezwayo ezinqubweni zamanje zidinga ukuqhubeka nokubaluleka emiphakathini yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kube nefuthe elikhulu ekuchazeni izimo ezahlukene ezibukhoma nangezindlela zokuphila. Ngakho-ke, ezocwaningo akukhulukazi nje ukucwaninga, kodwa kufana nokuvuleka komzuliswano wokubumbana nokudala, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwempilo nemisebenzi yempilo. Uma siphakamisa umbono wezocwaningo, sikhumbula ukuthi lokhu kuyazimisela, kuncedisa, kucacisa, futhi kuvule iminyango emisha.
Izinkinga Zemigwaqo: Uhlanga Olungaphumeleli Emadolobheni amaningi, izinkinga zemigwaqo zibe yinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa. Imithetho yokwakha imigwaqo ihlale ingahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuhamba kahle. Lezi zinkinga zifaka phakathi izimbobo ezinkulu, izindlela eziphukile, kanye nezimpawu zokuphepha ezingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima, futhi akusizi kuphela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo, kodwa futhi kubathinta nabashayeli bezimoto. Ekuqaleni, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yezimbobo. Izimbobo ezinkulu ezisemigwaqweni zikhula ngezinsuku, futhi zenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Abashayeli bahlala bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kuholela emaphutheni amaningi. Abanye bahamba benesaba sokuthi imoto yabo izonqamuka, kanti abanye bahlala bekhathazekile ngempilo yabo. Lezi zimbobo zenza kube nzima ukuhamba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamakhaya, lapho izindlela zingaphumeleli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindlela eziphukile zenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Ezinye izindawo zinesimo esibi kakhulu, futhi abashayeli bahlala bephazamisekile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezingozi eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma abantu behamba ngezinyawo. Izindlela eziphukile zenza kube nzima ukuhamba, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baphume emakhaya abo ukuze bathole izixazululo. Abantu bahlala bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka. Izimpawu zokuphepha ezingasebenzi kahle nazo zenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Ezinye izimpawu azikhanyisi kahle, kanti ezinye zikhona kodwa azifundeki. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlale bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima. Abashayeli bahlala bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka. Abantu badinga izimpawu ezicacile, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba kahle.
Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlale bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima. Abashayeli bahlala bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka. Abantu badinga izimpawu ezicacile, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zemigwaqo ziya ziba zimbi. Umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kodwa imigwaqo ayithuthuki. Lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka, futhi abantu badinga izixazululo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo bakhe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imigwaqo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba kahle. Izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga ukunakwa, futhi abantu badinga izixazululo. Ukugcina imigwaqo iphephile, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezimoto zabo. Abashayeli badinga ukuqonda ukuthi imigwaqo ingase ibe yingozi, futhi kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi bahlala behamba nezinye izimoto. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphele, futhi baziqhenye ngezimoto zabo. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomoya wokuhlanganyela, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ephephile. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga ukunakwa. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomoya wokuhlanganyela, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ephephile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo bakhe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imigwaqo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba kahle. Izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga izixazululo, futhi abantu badinga ukuhamba kahle. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomoya wokuhlanganyela, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ephephile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Ngakho-ke, masithathe izinyathelo zokwakha imigwaqo ephephile, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba kahle. Imininingwane ibalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukuhamba kahle.
Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Ngakho-ke, masithathe izinyathelo zokwakha imigwaqo ephephile, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba kahle. Imininingwane ibalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukuhamba kahle. Izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga ukunakwa, futhi umphakathi kufanele ube nomoya wokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Masithathe izinyathelo, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ephephile.
Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izibhedlela zikahulumeni? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni yizikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo eziphathwa nguhulumeni. Lezi zibhedlela zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo esezingeni eliphezulu kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenamali yokukhokhela izinsizakalo ezibucayi. Zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukene, kusukela ekwelapheni izifo ezilula kuya ekunakekeleni izimo ezinzima. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zihlinzeka ngempilo ebanzi, okuhlanganisa: - Ukwelashwa kwezifo ezahlukene - Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo - Ukuthola imithi - Izinsizakalo zokubeletha - Ukunakekela iziguli ezibhedlela - Izinhlelo zokuvikela izifo Lezi zinsizakalo zenzelwe ukusiza umphakathi, ikakhulukazi abantu abangenamali. Umbuzo 3: Kanjani umuntu angathola usizo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni? Ukuthola usizo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, umuntu kufanele aqale ahlole izidingo zakhe. Uma kudingeka, angaya ezibhedlela eziseduzane, lapho angabhalisela ukuvakashelwa. Ngokuvamile, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zidinga ukuthi abantu babhalise, futhi lokho kungafaka ukufaka imininingwane yabo, njengokuthi bahlala kuphi, izinkinga zempilo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nemininingwane yokwelashwa edlule. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni zonke? Yebo, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezisemaphandleni.
Ngokuvamile, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zidinga ukuthi abantu babhalise, futhi lokho kungafaka ukufaka imininingwane yabo, njengokuthi bahlala kuphi, izinkinga zempilo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nemininingwane yokwelashwa edlule. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni zonke? Yebo, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Nokho, kunezindawo ezithile ezingenayo izibhedlela ezinkulu, kodwa ziba nezikhungo ezincane ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Uhlelo lukahulumeni luhlose ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zempilo, noma ngabe umuntu usesigodini noma edolobheni. Umbuzo 5: Kukhona yini izinkinga ezihambisana nezibhedlela zikahulumeni? Yebo, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ezinye zazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka kwemithombo, njengezimali, abasebenzi, nezinsiza - Ukukhathazeka ngekhwalithi yokunakekelwa - Ukuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo ngenxa yokwandiswa kwabantu - Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi Lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze izibhedlela zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Umbuzo 6: Kuthiwani ngekhwalithi yokunakekelwa ezibhedlela zikahulumeni? Ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa ezibhedlela zikahulumeni iyahluka. Kwezinye izindawo, izibhedlela zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela, kanti kwezinye, izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwabasebenzi nabathengi bempilo zingaholela ekwehliseni ikhwalithi. Uhlelo lukahulumeni luhlongoza ukuthuthukisa le khwalithi ngokwandisa izinsiza, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokwenza ngcono izinqubo zokusebenza.
Ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa ezibhedlela zikahulumeni iyahluka. Kwezinye izindawo, izibhedlela zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela, kanti kwezinye, izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwabasebenzi nabathengi bempilo zingaholela ekwehliseni ikhwalithi. Uhlelo lukahulumeni luhlongoza ukuthuthukisa le khwalithi ngokwandisa izinsiza, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokwenza ngcono izinqubo zokusebenza. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyenze uma unganelisekile ngensizakalo ethile? Uma unganelisekile ngensizakalo ethile ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, ungaba nezinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ungakhuluma nomphakathi wezempilo ukuze uvezwe izinkinga zakho. Futhi, ungathola izeluleko ezivela kumalungu omphakathi noma izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngempilo. Uma kudingeka, ungabhalela izikhalazo ezisemthethweni ukuze kube nokuhlonzwa kwezinselelo ezikhona. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani uhulumeni angathuthukisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni? Ukuze uhulumeni athuthukise izibhedlela zikahulumeni, kudingeka: - Ukwandisa izimali ezitholakalayo - Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezempilo - Ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, njengezibhedlela nezinsiza zokwelapha - Ukuxhumana nomphakathi ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zabo - Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezizimele ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo Lezi zinyathelo zingasiza ekwakheni izibhedlela ezisebenzayo, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Umbuzo 9: Yini umphumela omuhle wezibhedlela zikahulumeni emphakathini? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zineqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zihlinzeka ngempilo engcono, zinciphisa izifo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle.
Umbuzo 9: Yini umphumela omuhle wezibhedlela zikahulumeni emphakathini? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zineqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zihlinzeka ngempilo engcono, zinciphisa izifo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo elungile kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi abahlwempu, kwenza kube nokuthula emphakathini, kunciphisa ukungalingani, futhi kukhuthaza intuthuko. Umbuzo 10: Uphi umbono wakho mayelana nekusasa lezibhedlela zikahulumeni? Ngokubona kwami, ikusasa lezibhedlela zikahulumeni libonakala linokukhanya. Uma uhulumeni eqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, ukwandisa izinsiza, nokubambisana nomphakathi, sizobona izibhedlela ezikhiqiza izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ogculisayo, futhi ophumelelayo. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi zidinga ukwesekwa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, umphakathi, nezikhungo ezizimele kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umculo we-Gospel: Uhlanga Olwakha Uthando Nokuqonda Umculo we-gospel ungomunye wemikhakha emikhulu yomculo, futhi uhlanganisa izici eziningi ezithokozisayo nezibalulekile empilweni yamaKristu. Kodwa, njengoba umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokwanda, kube nezinkulumo eziningi eziphikisanayo mayelana nendlela umculo lo okumele ubonakale ngayo, izinjongo zawo, kanye nomthelela wawo emphakathini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nomculo we-gospel, futhi sizokhuthaza ingxoxo ebanzi ngale ndaba. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo we-gospel ungumculo ophuma enhliziyweni, futhi uhambisana nezinkolelo zenkolo. Uhlanga lwawo luthinta imizwa, lukhuthaza, futhi luhlinzeka ngethemba kulabo abawulalelayo. Ngakho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo omkhulu wokukhuthaza ukholo, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Lokhu kubonakala emishinini eminingi ye-gospel, lapho abaculi bechaza izinselele zabo, bezama ukwabelana ngothando lukaNkulunkulu. Nokho, abanye abantu bakhathazekile ngokuqhubeka komculo we-gospel. Bakholelwa ukuthi umculo we-gospel usuphenduke umkhiqizo, udinga ukujolisa kumakhasimende kunokuhlonipha izinjongo zawo zokuqala. Lokhu kubonakala ekwandeni kwemali edlalwa emicimbini ye-gospel, lapho abaculi behluleka ukugcina ubumsulwa bomculo wabo. Lokhu kungase kube yinkinga, njengoba umculo we-gospel ungase ube yinsiza yokukhuthaza, kodwa uma uphenduka umkhiqizo, ungase uphumelele kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kube sekuphazamiseka umqondo wawo wokuqala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wokuhlanganyela emphakathini.
Lokhu kubonakala ekwandeni kwemali edlalwa emicimbini ye-gospel, lapho abaculi behluleka ukugcina ubumsulwa bomculo wabo. Lokhu kungase kube yinkinga, njengoba umculo we-gospel ungase ube yinsiza yokukhuthaza, kodwa uma uphenduka umkhiqizo, ungase uphumelele kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kube sekuphazamiseka umqondo wawo wokuqala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wokuhlanganyela emphakathini. Abaculi abaningi be-gospel baphumelela ekwakheni imiphakathi ethokozisayo, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngothando, bahlabelela, futhi baphile impilo enothando. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, futhi ungakhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Nokho, uma umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuphenduka umkhiqizo, kungase kube nzima ukugcina le miphakathi ibumbene. Kodwa-ke, kumele siqaphele ukuthi umculo we-gospel awuwona umculo owodwa, kodwa uhlanganisa izitayela eziningi ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo we-gospel ungavuma ukufaka izitayela ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-hip-hop, i-R&B, kanye ne-blues. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umculo we-gospel ungaba yindawo yokuhlanganyela kwezinkolo ezahlukene, futhi ungakhuthaza abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Nokho, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukwamukela izitayela ezihlukahlukene kungaphazamisa umqondo wokuqala we-gospel, okungase kube yinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungaba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinkolelo zenkolo. Abaculi be-gospel bahlala bephakamisa izinkolelo zabo, bencenga abalandeli babo ukuthi baphile impilo enokholo.
Nokho, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukwamukela izitayela ezihlukahlukene kungaphazamisa umqondo wokuqala we-gospel, okungase kube yinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungaba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinkolelo zenkolo. Abaculi be-gospel bahlala bephakamisa izinkolelo zabo, bencenga abalandeli babo ukuthi baphile impilo enokholo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo ungaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enobuntu, futhi baphile ngokuhlonipha abanye. Nokho, uma umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuphenduka umkhiqizo, kungase kube nzima ukugcina lezi zinkolelo zihlala ziqinile. Ekugcineni, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo omkhulu wokukhuthaza, ukuxhumana, nokwakha imiphakathi ethokozisayo. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nomculo lo, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezingxoxo eziphusile mayelana nendlela umculo we-gospel okumele ubonakale ngayo. Kumele sihloniphe izinjongo zawo zokuqala, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuba yinsiza yokukhuthaza uthando, ukholo, kanye nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Umculo we-gospel ungaba yindlela yokwakha umhlaba ongcono, uma siqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela zokwenza umculo lo ube yinsiza ethokozisayo nehloniphekile.

Ibonisa i-DWAF njengenhlangano ehamba phambili emkhakheni wezokusebenza ekwakheni indawo enezimo ezinhle zokukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ngokusebenzisa izihlahla eziphathwayo kahle. Lokhu kubhekisisa labo abaqashwe ngqo emisebenzini yokulima izihlahla (ehhovisi elikhulu nasemazingeni enhlangano) kanye nabanye abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano ye-DWAF yonke abanezindima nemisebenzi ethinta izinto ezikhuthazayo zendawo. Kubheka ukuthi kuphi umthetho nemigomo okufanele kukhuthaze imiphumela emihle kubampofu, ukuthi izinhlelo zingatholakala kanjani futhi zibe nezincazelo ezithile ezihlobene nalokhu, nokuthi isakhiwo semakethe nendlela yokusebenza ivulekile kangakanani ezidingweni zabangenayo abasha nabakhiqizi abancane. Ihlanganisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuphatha izihlahla (ndawonye nezinhlelo ezihlanganisiwe ezihlobene) ezingathinta imizamo ehlukene yokuthuthukiswa komnotho nomphakathi njengengxenye yesu lokwehlisa ubumpofu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqonda izindaba ezihlobene nokwenziwa kwemali nezinye izici zobumpofu bomphakathi kanye namathuba ezihlahla okuthuthukisa izimpilo. Kugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa indlela ye "forestry yabantu" ekwakheni, ukwesekwa kwezimali, nasekusebenzeni kokuqala kwezinhlangano ezisebenza emkhakheni wendawo.

Le yindawo yokubika ubugebengu esebenza amahora angama-24, ebhekene nezikhalazo nezikhalazo ezivela emphakathini. Ungashaya ucingo usebenzisa umugqa we-Telkom noma ngefoni ephathekayo. Uma unokukhala okungaphuthumayo noma ufuna nje ukubuza imibuzo ngendlela ejwayelekile, shaya isiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo yakho. Shaya inombolo: 10111 noma ngabe uphi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngizibophezela ekubhekaneni nanoma yiziphi izinto ezitholwe ngilungu lelibhary yami kanye nelungu lelibhary yengane yami, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zitholwe ngami noma omunye umuntu, kanye nokukhokhela noma yiziphi izinxephezelo, izindleko zezinto ezilahlekile, nezindleko ezithathwe ngelibhary lapho kuthengwa lezo zinto noma ekukhokheni. Ngiphinde ngiyavuma ukukwazisa ngokushesha nganoma yiziphi izinguquko kwi-adresi yami, inombolo yefoni, noma yimuphi omunye ulwazi olukhulunywe ngenhla. Sicela usinikeze ubunikazi bazo zonke izingane noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa kanye nezinkomba esizogcina kumarekhodi ethu.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV Licence ye-SABC Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wahlangana emcimbini obalulekile owayenzelwe ukuxoxa ngezimpikiswano eziphakanyiswe ngoxhaso lwe-TV licence ye-SABC. Lo mcimbi, owawubanjelwe eGoli, waba nethuba lokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nabamele izinkampani, abezindaba, nabantu abajwayelekile, ukuze baxoxe ngale ndaba ebalulekile. I-SABC, okuyinhlangano enkulu yokukhangisa eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nokho, izinkinga ezithinta ukungabikhona kwemali, ukunganeliseki kwabathengi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali zikhuluma kakhulu emiphakathini. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yeMenenja ye-SABC, uNkk. Thandiwe Mthembu, owakhuluma ngokuqinile ngendaba yokuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence akusizi kuphela i-SABC, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi onolwazi. Uthe, "Uma singatholi uxhaso olufanele, sizobe sithola ubunzima ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezifundisayo." Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano phakathi kwabantu ababephakathi, abanye bephikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube okwenziwe ngababhalisile kuphela, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhasa. Uhlelo lwemibono lwaluhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nababukeli, abezindaba, nabaphathi bezokuxhumana.
Uthe, "Uma singatholi uxhaso olufanele, sizobe sithola ubunzima ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezifundisayo." Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano phakathi kwabantu ababephakathi, abanye bephikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube okwenziwe ngababhalisile kuphela, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhasa. Uhlelo lwemibono lwaluhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nababukeli, abezindaba, nabaphathi bezokuxhumana. UJohn Nkosi, umphakathi ophakathi, waphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuxhasa, njengokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezizokwazi ukuheha ababukeli abaningi. "Uma i-SABC ingakwazi ukuheha ababukeli, izokwazi ukuthola uxhaso olungcono," kusho uNkosi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNkk. Sipho Dlamini, ongumsebenzi wezokuxhumana, waphikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube yinto ejwayelekile, futhi akufanele kube nomkhawulo. "Sidinga i-SABC ukuze ibonise izindaba zethu, izinkolo zethu, nezamasiko ethu. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, hhayi yokuhlukanisa," kusho uDlamini. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokuxoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ukuze ikwazi ukufinyelela kubabukeli abaningi. Lokhu kuhlangene nezidingo zomphakathi, njengoba abantu abaningi behamba phambili besebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokubuka izinhlelo.

MANJE, ngokulandela isigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000, uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi, njengomsebenzi womphakathi weBhodi Yamanzi, kumele abhale incwadi ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oluhambelana neBhodi Yamanzi. NGAKHOKE, MANJE uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi uletha lokhu, emphakathini, incwadi yeBhodi Yamanzi ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yiBhodi Yamanzi, njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi komthetho. Ukuzwa izicelo zokukhokhelwa njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 soMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Isicelo sokukhokhelwa kumele sithunyelwe kwiBhodi Yamanzi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela esinqumweni esithathwe yiziphathimandla eziphethe. Ibhodi Yamanzi inegunya lokunquma inani lokukhokhelwa kanye nenani elizokhokhwa kulandela lesi sigaba. Azikho izinsiza ezikhona. Izinsiza zizolandela umsebenzi. Uma umfaki-sicelo enganelisekile nganoma yisiphi isinqumo mayelana nolwazi, umfaki-sicelo angafaka ukukhala kuNgqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nezihlahla ngokulandela isigaba 74 soMthetho. Uma umfaki-sicelo (owokukhala) enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, angaphikisa lesi sinqumo enkantolo ngokulandela izigaba 79 kuya ku-82 zoMthetho. Umfaki-sicelo noma umuntu omunye angafaka icala emaphoyiseni ngokulandela isigaba 90 soMthetho.
Idokhumenti losizo elivela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini linikeza amakhasimende awo ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi okulindelwe umphakathi mayelana nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo kuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Umphakathi uyazi ukuthi angaxhumana kanjani neMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini. Indlela yokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende isekelwe ekukhetheni ukuhambisana nezindinganiso zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ezishicilelwe ngenkathi kuhambisana namalungelo amakhasimende. IMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini izokweseka futhi ikusize njengamakhasimende ethu, izinga lenkonzo ongakulindela njengamakhasimende ethu, indlela ongasisiza ngayo ukuthi sikuhlinzekele kangcono, nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani iziphakamiso zokuthuthukiswa, kanye neziteshi ongazilandela njengamakhasimende uma ufisa ukuveza ukwaneliseka kwakho ngezinga lethu lenkonzo. Zonke ofisi zikhomba lapho izindaba ezihlobene namanzi ziphathwa khona. Ukulethwa kwamanzi aphakanyisiwe kuza ngqo emakhaya ukusuka kumapayipi omasipala. Amalitri angama-200 wamanzi ngosuku atholakala emtankini ophansi ogcwalisa nsuku zonke - kulingana namalitri angama-6,000 wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga. Amathaphu emigwaqo afakwe ezindaweni zomphakathi ezithintekile okwethula isikhathi esithile. Amathangi amanzi afinyelela lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okukhulu. Uhlanga lwezinkalanga luthuthwa ngepayipi ejwayelekile usebenzisa amanzi - xhumana nezinsiza zokuhlanza. Ukulethwa kwezingcindezi ngepayipi usebenzisa amanzi kudluliselwa emgqonyeni - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nalo.
Amathangi amanzi afinyelela lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okukhulu. Uhlanga lwezinkalanga luthuthwa ngepayipi ejwayelekile usebenzisa amanzi - xhumana nezinsiza zokuhlanza. Ukulethwa kwezingcindezi ngepayipi usebenzisa amanzi kudluliselwa emgqonyeni - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nalo. Lapho amanzi esetshenziswa, kudluliselwa emgqonyeni lapho imoto izofika khona ukuze igcwalise ithangi layo futhi ithwale izingcindezi kwenye indawo. Bonke amakhasimende athola ama-kilolitri ayisithupha okuqala kwamanzi mahhala ngenyanga, nezindleko zikhula kulabo abakhasimende abathola amanzi aphakanyisiwe noma aphansi, nezindleko eziyisisekelo kulabo abakhasimende abathola amanzi aphakanyisiwe abasebenzisa ngaphezu kwama-kilolitri ayisithupha ngenyanga futhi behlala ezindaweni ezibiza ngaphezu kwe-R40,000 ngokwezinhlelo zomphakathi. Noma yimuphi umthengi onenani lempahla elingaphansi kwe-R36,000 ngokwezinhlelo zomphakathi futhi ongakhokhi ukuthuthwa kwezingcindezi uzothola le sevisi mahhala. Noma iyiphi ithoyilethi ye-VIP ihlinzekwa mahhala iminyaka emihlanu. Ukuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngemininingwane ye-GIS, izithombe zomoya, izikhalazo, nezinye izibalo... I-A4 nayo iyamahhala. Ukwamukela/Ukudlulisela kwezinhlelo zokwakha mayelana nokuthuthwa kwezingcindezi. Izindaba eziphuthumayo zixazululwa phakathi kwamahora amane.
Amakhophi ale ndatshana ephelile angatholakala ehhovisi leMenenja: Ukuxhumana Kwezwe Nezifunda, uMnyango Wezemfundo, ePitoli. UMnyango Wezemfundo uveza ngokuqhakazile lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo sezinga le-R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zeNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha kwalolu work akuzange kube umsebenzi olula. Izikhathi eziningi, labo ababephatha lo msebenzi wokuhumusha baphoqeleka ukudala amagama amasha ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lezi zindatshana zathunyelwa kubachwepheshe bezilimi ukuze bahlolisise. UMnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zindatshana njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufunda ukuthi asebenzise lezi zindatshana njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Yini umphumela wokufunda? Yini indlela yokuhlola? Indlela yokuhlola ihluke kanjani kumiphumela yokufunda? Ukuhlela kabusha umgomo wesifundo wesizwe kuyinselelo kokubili isizwe kanye nezwe. UMnyango Wethu Wezemfundo uphinde uveze umgomo wawo wesifundo ohlobene nombono esinawo kanye nendlela esibona ngayo umphakathi wethu, esiwubona ngokubheka izingane nabafundi esikhiqiza ngokuya kulolo mgomo esiwusebenzisa. Ngesikhathi sokukhetha okumele kufakwe emgomeni, ukunakwa kwanikezwa kulokho okubalulekile ekwakheni 'imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu'. Lo mgomo wabhala ngamaNingizimu Afrika, wenzelwe amaNingizimu Afrika, ugcizelela izimiso nezindinganiso zedemokhrasi. Lo mgomo uhlanganisa iphupho esinalo kubafundisi nabafundi.
