Kumele babe abantu abakhathazekile ngezindaba ezithinta indawo yabo futhi bazokwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ezizobhekana neNingizimu Afrika eminyakeni engamashumi amabili nanye ezayo. Nokho, kumele sibhekane neqiniso lokuthi kunezici zomgomo wesifundo ezizophumelela nezizophumelela. Ukungalingani nobubha kuqhubeka nokuphazamiseka kwemfundo kwemindeni eminingi nezingane zethu ezweni lethu. Umgomo wesifundo uvame ukuhunyushwa ngezindlela ezahlukene ezimweni ezahlukahlukene. Nokho, sizokwenza umzamo wokuthuthukisa umgomo wethu wesifundo futhi siphinde silwe ukuze siwuphumeze ngempumelelo. Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli phupho lethu liyafezeka ngokubhekana nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokufunda nokufundisa lapha ezweni lethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu nokuthi wonke umuntu ophakathi kwemfundo udlale indima ebalulekile. Sidinga ukubambisana okuphelele phakathi kukamasipala, abazali, abafundisi, abafundi, nomphakathi wonke ngoba laba abathintekayo bangamaphakethe empumelelo yemfundo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo sizohlanganisa izifiso ezizokhuthaza ukubambisana okuhlanganisa wonke umuntu kuleli zwe laseNingizimu Afrika.

Emhlanganweni ngoJuni 2000, iBhodi Labaphathi Bezemfundo yamukela ukuthi lo mgomo wesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 kufanele ubuyekezwe ngokuhambisana neziphakamiso zembiko yeqembu lokuhlola (enombolo ethi Meyi 31, 2000) mayelana nendlela nokuhlelwa kabusha komgomo wesifundo ka-2005. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwasungulwa ikomidi, elikhethwe ngababusi, ukuze lihlele futhi liqondise ukuhlela kabusha umgomo wesifundo ka-2005. Inqubo yokuhlola yaqala ngoJanuwari 2001 nabasunguli abayi-150 balolu mgomo bevela emkhakheni wezokufunda. NgoJulayi 31, umgomo wesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wathunyelwa emphakathini ukuze ube nemininingwane yabo isikhathi esingama-3. NgoNovemba, umphakathi wanikezwa enye ithuba lokuxoxa ngalolu mgomo. Ngemuva kokuthi umphakathi uthumele impendulo yabo neziphakamiso, lezi zahlaziywa ngamaqembu akhethiwe eqembu lokuhlola labaphathi futhi zaba yisichasiso ngoDisemba 2001 ukuze kufakwe izinguquko eziphakanyisiwe. Lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo siwumphumela womsebenzi okhuluma ngenhla.

Uhlelo oluhle lokusebenza luzosungulwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhunyushwa kwalesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe kuphumelele. Umthetho wokuhlola okukhona odatshana ethi Disemba 23, 1998 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 19640) kanye nomthetho wezilimi emfundweni odatshana ethi Julayi 14, 1997 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 17997) kumele kufundwe ndawonye nesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni). Umthetho wokuhlola kumele ufundwe ndawonye nesigaba esihlobene sesitatimende sesigaba ngasinye sokufunda. Uhulumeni wedemokhrasi waseNingizimu Afrika wamukela ohulumeni bangaphambili uhlelo lwezemfundo olwalungalingani. Ngaphansi kukahulumeni wobandlululo, iNingizimu Afrika yayinezigaba eziyi-19 ezihlukene zemfundo. Lezi zigaba zazihlukaniswe ngohlanga, ngezindawo lapho abantu bahlala khona, nangombono wezombusazwe waleso sikhathi. Lolu hlobo lwemfundo lwalulungiselela izingane ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene, kwezomnotho nangokwezombusazwe ngaphansi kobandlululo. Kuwo wonke lawa magunya, uhlelo lwezemfundo ludlale indima ebalulekile ekugcizeleleni ukungalingani phakathi kwabantu.

Isahluko 1: Ukuqala KweZikhathi Zobandlululo Ngonyaka ka-1948, iNingizimu Afrika yathola umthetho obizwa ngokuthi yi-Apartheid, owawuhloselwe ukuhlukanisa abantu ngokobuhlanga. Lezi zikhathi zashintsha impilo yabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abamnyama, ababephila ngaphansi kwemithetho eqinile eyabavimbela ekutholeni amalungelo afanele. Umhlaba wawuhlelwe ngendlela yokuthi abantu abamnyama bahlala ezindaweni ezikude, kanti abamhlophe bekhululekile ukuhamba, ukwenza, nokuphila impilo yabo ngendlela abafunayo. Isahluko 2: Ukuphucwa KweMhlaba Ngalesi sikhathi, ukuphucwa komhlaba kwaba yinto eyaziwayo. Abantu abamnyama babengavunyelwe ukuba nomhlaba omningi, futhi imizamo yokuthola umhlaba owawubhalwe kubo yayiphikiswa ngokuqinile. Izindawo eziningi ezazithathwe kubantu abamnyama zathunyelwa kubantu abamhlophe, kanti abamnyama baphuma ezindaweni zabo, behlupheka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kube nezimpi eziningi, iziteleka, kanye nemizamo yokuphikisa umthetho wobandlululo. Isahluko 3: Izinyathelo Zokuphikisa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu abamnyama baqala ukuhlanganisa imizamo yabo yokuphikisa. Imikhankaso efana ne-ANC (African National Congress) yahlanganisa abantu abaningi, izinyathelo zayo zafaka phakathi iziteleka, ukuhamba emigwaqweni, nokwenza imibhikisho. UNelson Mandela, owayengumholi ophambili, waba isibonelo sokuzimisela nokungapheli amandla. Kwakukhona umoya wokuphila, nokukholelwa ekutheni kuzofika usuku lapho ubandlululo luzosuswa.

Isahluko 4: Ukuhlangana Kwamandla Ngonyaka ka-1960, kwenzeka umcimbi owawubizwa nge-Sharpeville Massacre, lapho abantu abamnyama ababephikisa imithetho yobandlululo babulawa. Lokhu kwashiya umphakathi ubuhlungu, kwavusa umoya wokuphikisa. Ngaleso sikhathi, izwe lonke laqala ukuhamba phambili, kanti izwe labamhlophe labona ukuthi kufanele kube nezinguquko. Isahluko 5: Izinguquko Zokuqala Ngonyaka ka-1990, uNelson Mandela wakhululwa ejele, futhi lokhu kwaba uphawu lokuthi izinguquko ziqala. Uhlelo lokubuyisana kwamalungelo abantu lwaqala, kanti abantu abaningi babenokholo lokuthi ubandlululo luzophela. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezingxoxo ezinzima phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, futhi abantu babezama ukuthola izixazululo ezizokhulula umhlaba. Isahluko 6: Ukukhululwa KweMhlaba Ngonyaka ka-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yathola ukuvota okukhululekile kokuqala, futhi uNelson Mandela waba nguMongameli wokuqala omnyama. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile emlandweni, njengoba abantu abamnyama benza izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nezwe labo. Ukuphucwa komhlaba kwaba yinto ebalulekile, futhi izinhlelo zokubuyisela umhlaba zathuthukiswa, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abamnyama bathola ithuba lokubuyisela umhlaba owawuthathwe kubo.

Isahluko 7: Ukubuyisana Nokuqhubeka Ngemuva kokukhululwa, izwe laqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokubuyisana, ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Kodwa-ke, izinselelo zakhula, njengoba abantu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, futhi umhlaba wawusadingeka ukuhlinzekwa. Ukuphucwa komhlaba kwaba yinto engapheli, njengoba abantu besafuna indlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Isahluko 8: Isiphetho Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa ukuphucwa komhlaba ngesikhathi sobandlululo kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Abantu bahlala bephila ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene, futhi imizamo yokwakha ubumbano iqhubeka. Umlandvo wobandlululo usafundisa izifundo eziningi, futhi abantu bahlala bekhumbula ukuthi umhlaba wabo ungaphezu kwemikhawulo yobuhlanga. Ukuphucwa komhlaba akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka, njengoba abantu bezama ukwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Ikomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithole igunya ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo ka-1996 ukuze ikhulise futhi iqinisekise izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha kwabantu abaphakathi kwezikhundla ezisebenzela isizwe. Ngo-1997, ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi kwamenyezelwa futhi kwathuthukiswa ngokubizelwa kwemihlangano kanye nochwepheshe bezomthetho ezingeni likazwelonke nelokuhlala. Kwakubalulekile ukuthuthukisa incwadi yokuhola mayelana nokuziphatha ukuze kusizwe abantu baqonde kahle futhi basebenzise lokho. Engxenyeni yeKomishini esebenza isizwe, ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukwethula incwadi echaza ukuziphatha okufanele kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyisisekelo esibalulekile sokuphatha nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Lokhu kuziphatha futhi kukhuphula izindaba ezifana nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abantu, umthetho, ukuzinikela, ukuveza uhulumeni, ukuziphatha komuntu siqu, nokujabulela okwakhe. IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi icela bonke abasebenzi, kusukela kulabo abasezingeni eliphansi kuya kwezinga eliphezulu, ukuba baveze ukuqonda okubonakalayo kwenqubo, iziqondiso, nezincwadi ezitholakala ekuziphatheni okufanele. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okubalulekile kodwa kungasivumela ukuba sihlangabezane nezidingo ezifanele zabantu bethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi labo abaphakathi kwezikhundla benze izinto ngokomthetho, bagweme ukwamukela amathuba nezipho, njengoba lokhu kungabhekwa njengenkohlakalo. Sifisa ukuhlabela izinkanyezi bonke abaphathi nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla abathintekayo ekukhuliseni ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ngiyakhuthaza ukuba niqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi omuhle ngaphandle kokuphenduka ezinselelweni zokuthuthukisa ikhodi yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi.
Kubalulekile ukuthi labo abaphakathi kwezikhundla benze izinto ngokomthetho, bagweme ukwamukela amathuba nezipho, njengoba lokhu kungabhekwa njengenkohlakalo. Sifisa ukuhlabela izinkanyezi bonke abaphathi nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla abathintekayo ekukhuliseni ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ngiyakhuthaza ukuba niqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi omuhle ngaphandle kokuphenduka ezinselelweni zokuthuthukisa ikhodi yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithemba ukuthi le ncwadi echazayo izoba yisikhombandlela esifanele ekukhuliseni ubuqotho nokwethembeka endaweni yokusebenza futhi futhi idale amathuba amakhulu kithi sonke ukuze sifeze isiko lokungamukeli inkohlakalo eNingizimu Afrika. Ekugcineni, ngifisa bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi baqinisekise ukuthi ukuziphatha okufanele kuhambisana nendlela evumelekile yokuphatha nokuphatha umphakathi futhi baziqhelanise nokuziphatha okufanele kanye nale ncwadi echazayo. Umphathi: IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Iminyango kazwelonke neyomphakathi iyawusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi echazayo futhi iphinde ifake imibono ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni kwayo. Ihhovisi leMphakathi elivikela liphinde lafaka umnikelo ekuthuthukiseni le ndatshana ngemibono ebalulekile. Izinhlangano nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bomphakathi zibe nezingxoxo eziningi nemihlangano futhi zenze iziphakamiso ezibalulekile. Ekugcineni, siyabonga ukwesekwa kukahulumeni waseBrithani ekuthuthukiseni amazwe angaphandle ngokuhlinzeka ngemali yokushicilela le ncwadi echazayo mayelana nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ephelele yokuqukethwe kokuziphatha okufanele.
Izinhlangano nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bomphakathi zibe nezingxoxo eziningi nemihlangano futhi zenze iziphakamiso ezibalulekile. Ekugcineni, siyabonga ukwesekwa kukahulumeni waseBrithani ekuthuthukiseni amazwe angaphandle ngokuhlinzeka ngemali yokushicilela le ncwadi echazayo mayelana nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ephelele yokuqukethwe kokuziphatha okufanele. Ukumisa ngokomthetho ukuziphatha okufanele kudinga isibindi, ukuqonda, kanye nohlelo lwezichazamazwi ezisemthethweni. Le ncwadi ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi baqonda kahle lokhu kuziphatha. Le ncwadi ayethuli imithetho emisha noma ilandele isakhiwo nemithetho njengemibhalo ephathelene nokuziphatha, ukuze kube lula ukuhlukanisa. Lapho usebenzisa le ncwadi, iminyango kumele izame ukufaka izibonelo zabo ezihambisana nomongo wabo wendawo. Kumele kugcizelelwe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi kuyinqubo ebalulekile futhi kuzodingeka ukuhlolwa njalo, njengokuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha. Ekukhuliseni izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha okufanele endaweni yokusebenza, abasebenzi kumele bakhuthazwe ukuba bacabange futhi baziphathe kahle. Ngakho-ke, le ncwadi kufanele ibonwe njengethuluzi ekuthuthukiseni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okufundisa kubo bonke abasebenzi. Le ncwadi iphinde iqukate izibonelo ezikhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele endaweni yokusebenza okufanele kuthathwe njengesisekelo sokufundisa nezifundo ezenzakalayo. Njengomngane wale kuziphatha, le ncwadi izosiza ukuqinisa ukuzethemba okwangempela nokungakhethi phakathi kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuncane kokuziphatha okufanele nokubonakalayo. Kuyinto evunyelwe ukuthi umuntu ufunda ngokuqwashisa nangesenzo.
Le ncwadi iphinde iqukate izibonelo ezikhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele endaweni yokusebenza okufanele kuthathwe njengesisekelo sokufundisa nezifundo ezenzakalayo. Njengomngane wale kuziphatha, le ncwadi izosiza ukuqinisa ukuzethemba okwangempela nokungakhethi phakathi kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuncane kokuziphatha okufanele nokubonakalayo. Kuyinto evunyelwe ukuthi umuntu ufunda ngokuqwashisa nangesenzo. Indima ebalulekile ibekwe kumqashi, ikakhulukazi labo abanamandla okusebenza (Omakhulu kanye noMECs) ezingeni lezepolitiki, kanye nabaphathi kuzo zonke izinga zezinsizakalo zomphakathi, ukuze bakhe indawo lapho indlela efanele yokuziphatha ingaboniswa futhi isibonelo esihle sikhonjiswe kubo bonke abasebenzi. Ingxenye 195 (a) yoMthethosisekelo ifuna ukuthi izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha likhuthazwe futhi ligcinwe. Mayelana nesivumelwano esivamile (Isixazululo sePublic Service Coordinating Bargaining Council 2 ka-1999), bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi banendima yokudlala ekulandeleni izimiso ezichazwe ekuziphatheni okufanele. Njengoba lokhu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile esakhiwe ekwenzeni kahle nasekuziphatheni kahle, umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi ngokuqondile ukuziphatha okufanele. Kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi umgomo oyinhloko wokuziphatha ukuthi okwamukelekayo, okuwukukhuthaza isibonelo esihle sokuziphatha. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umphakathi angase azithole noma abhekane nezinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele mayelana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla, bese ebhekiswa ngaphansi kweZigaba 18 kuya ku-27 eziphakanyiswe ekuziphatheni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi zika-1997, uma umuntu engalandeli ukuziphatha okufanele okumiswe.
Njengoba lokhu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile esakhiwe ekwenzeni kahle nasekuziphatheni kahle, umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi ngokuqondile ukuziphatha okufanele. Kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi umgomo oyinhloko wokuziphatha ukuthi okwamukelekayo, okuwukukhuthaza isibonelo esihle sokuziphatha. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umphakathi angase azithole noma abhekane nezinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele mayelana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla, bese ebhekiswa ngaphansi kweZigaba 18 kuya ku-27 eziphakanyiswe ekuziphatheni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi zika-1997, uma umuntu engalandeli ukuziphatha okufanele okumiswe. Umsebenzi kumele ube nethembekile kuMbuso futhi ahloniphe noMthethosisekelo ngenkathi egcina noma emukela imisebenzi abekwe kuyo nsuku zonke. Okuhambisana noMbuso kumele kubonakale njengokuhambisana ne "zinsizakalo zomphakathi" eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisidingo esiyinhloko esikhombisa ubuqotho bonke abasebenzi. UMthethosisekelo uthinta lezi zindaba eziphathelene namalungelo nezinto ezanelisayo kubo bonke obala. Lezi zinkomba zokuziphatha zidinga nje ubuqotho babantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi enqubweni yokuphatha ngaphansi kohlelo lwezombusazwe. Okwesibili, ukubaluleka koMthethosisekelo kumele kwamukelwe futhi kuhlinzekwe ngabo bonke. Okwesithathu, bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele baqonde kahle okuqukethwe nenhloso yoMthethosisekelo njengendlela yokuvikela nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle. Isibonelo 1: Abasebenzi bomphakathi ezingeni elihlukahlukene bavunyelwe ukuhlela futhi benze iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo. Lezi ziphakamiso kumele zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphikisi umoya noma izigaba ezithile zoMthethosisekelo.
Okwesithathu, bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele baqonde kahle okuqukethwe nenhloso yoMthethosisekelo njengendlela yokuvikela nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle. Isibonelo 1: Abasebenzi bomphakathi ezingeni elihlukahlukene bavunyelwe ukuhlela futhi benze iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo. Lezi ziphakamiso kumele zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphikisi umoya noma izigaba ezithile zoMthethosisekelo. Ukunakekelwa Kwamadoda Nabesifazane Abadala Ngiyavuma, ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kubalulekile empilweni yethu. Kukhona ukufaneleka okukhulu kokuthi abantu abadala banelungelo lokunakekelwa kahle. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukubanika uthando, ukunakekela, nokuhlonipha. Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bethu sithola kunzima ukuhlela isikhathi sokunakekela, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abadala banelungelo lokuphila impilo enempilo, okudinga imizamo yethu. Sithanda ukucabanga ukuthi abantu abadala baphila kahle, kodwa akukhona njalo. Abaningi bahlushwa izinkinga ezihlukahlukene ezifana nokukhathala, ukungabi namandla, noma izinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinhloso ezicacile zokubasiza. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enhle kubalulekile, futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubo ezithile, njengokuhlinzeka ngezokudla okunempilo, indawo yokuhlala ethokomele, nokubavikela ezinkingeni ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abadala badinga ukuxhumana nabanye ukuze bazi ukuthi abakhululekile, futhi bazi ukuthi banabantu ababalulekile empilweni yabo. Ukuxhumana nabanye kungasiza ekunciphiseni umuzwa wokuhlukana, futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinhloso zokuhlela imicimbi yokuxhumana, njengokuhlela izikhathi zokuhlangana noma imicimbi yokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazizwe bephila futhi bazi ukuthi abakhululekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukubanika ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinhloso zokuhlinzeka ngempilo, njengokuhlinzeka ngezokudla okunempilo, indawo yokuhlala ethokomele, nokubavikela ezinkingeni ezithile.
Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazizwe bephila futhi bazi ukuthi abakhululekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukubanika ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinhloso zokuhlinzeka ngempilo, njengokuhlinzeka ngezokudla okunempilo, indawo yokuhlala ethokomele, nokubavikela ezinkingeni ezithile. Ukudla okunempilo kubalulekile empilweni, futhi abantu abadala badinga ukudla okunempilo ukuze baphile kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu abadala badinga ukuxhumana nabanye ukuze bazi ukuthi abakhululekile. Ukuxhumana nabanye kungasiza ekunciphiseni umuzwa wokuhlukana, futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinhloso zokuhlela imicimbi yokuxhumana, njengokuhlela izikhathi zokuhlangana noma imicimbi yokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazizwe bephila futhi bazi ukuthi abakhululekile. Ngokuphetha, ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga imizamo yethu, futhi kufanele sibe nezinhloso zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ukuze baphile kahle. Kubalulekile ukubanikeza uthando, ukunakekela, nokuhlonipha, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abadala banelungelo lokunakekelwa kahle. Ngakho, asiqhubekeni sikhumbule ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga imizamo yethu.
Isingeniso Ukuphuculwa kwemisebenzi noma ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yomuntu. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha njalo, izidingo nezifiso zabantu nazo ziyaqhuba. Ukuphuculwa kwemisebenzi akuphikisani nje nezidingo zomsebenzi, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi obumbene futhi ophumelelayo. Kulokhu, sizobe sikhuluma ngezizathu ezinamandla zokuthi kungani ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kufanele kubekwe phambili, izinselelo ezitholakala kule ndawo, kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nazo. Isizathu sokubaluleka kokuphuculwa kwemisebenzi Okokuqala, kufanele kucace ukuthi ukuphuculwa kwemisebenzi kukhuthaza ukukhula komuntu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bathole amathuba okwandisa amakhono abo, futhi lokhu kusekelwe ekutheni umqondo wokuphuculwa kwemisebenzi uyajabulisa. Umuntu ophuculayo, wazi kahle ukuthi ukwaziswa kwakhe kudinga ukuthi kube kwebhizinisi elihamba phambili. Lokhu kuhlotshaniswa nendlela abantu abaphila ngayo, futhi kunciphisa izigigaba zokungasebenzi. Okwesibili, ukwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwemisebenzi nezifundo kunganikeza abantu ithuba lokwakha izindlela zomsebenzi ezintsha. Ukuqhubeka nokufunda kubalulekile, ngoba umhlaba uvulelekile emathubeni, kanti abantu abaneziqu eziphakeme nomnotho ophumelelayo bahlala behamba phambili. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akusizi kuphela abantu ngezinga elikhulu, kodwa kushiya umthelela omuhle emphakathini. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nokuphuculwa Kwezisebenzi Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene neziqu eziwumsuka ekuphuculeni kwemisebenzi. Enye yalezi zinselelo iwukungabikhona kwezinsiza ezanele, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izinhlelo zokuqashwa akuvamile ukutholakala, futhi lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka kokukhula kwabantu.
Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nokuphuculwa Kwezisebenzi Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene neziqu eziwumsuka ekuphuculeni kwemisebenzi. Enye yalezi zinselelo iwukungabikhona kwezinsiza ezanele, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izinhlelo zokuqashwa akuvamile ukutholakala, futhi lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka kokukhula kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abakwazi ukuqhubeka nokuthola iziqu zabo ngoba bengekho ezikhungweni zokuxhasa. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga zokuhambisana kwemisebenzi nezifundo. Abantu abaningi banemfundo ethile, kodwa bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi ehambisana naleyo mfundo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izidingo zemakethe zishintsha ngokushesha, kanti abantu abafuna umsebenzi bavele bahluleka ukuhambisana nalezi zidingo. Lokhu kubangela ukukhathazeka, kwandiselezikhathi zokungasebenzi, okuthinta umnotho. Izindlela Zokuqhubeka Nokuqeda Lezi Zinhlamvu Ukuze silungise lezi zinkinga, kunendaba yokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokufundisa. Izikhungo zobuchwepheshe kufanele zisebenze eduze nezinkampani ukuze kuqhamukele izifundo ezihambisana nezidingo zakho. Lokhu kungabandakanya izifundo ezifanele ezindaweni ezikhulayo zezimboni, futhi lokhu kuzokunikeza abantu amandla okwandisa amakhono abo. Ngokufanayo, izinhlelo zokwakha amakhono kufanele zihloswe ukuze zifinyelele izindawo ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphumelela kulabo abanglezinga eliphakeme lemfundo. Ukusimama kokuhweba nezinkampani ezincane nakho kubalulekile, ukuphucula ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kumele kube phakeme kakhulu kulabo abafuna ukukhula nokuqhubeka empilweni.
Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphumelela kulabo abanglezinga eliphakeme lemfundo. Ukusimama kokuhweba nezinkampani ezincane nakho kubalulekile, ukuphucula ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kumele kube phakeme kakhulu kulabo abafuna ukukhula nokuqhubeka empilweni. Lokhu akukhona nje ukunakekela abantu, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, izindlela ezihlukahlukene zingatholwa ukuze kubhekelelwe lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sisebenze ngokubambisana – izikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, futhi umphakathi ngokwawo. Uma sikhuthaza imisebenzi yokuphuculwa kwemisebenzi, sizoba nempilo engcono, umnotho ophumelelayo, kanye nemiphakathi eqinile. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho oluhle empilweni yabantu, futhi kube umthombo wezenzo ezinhle emhlabeni wonke.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini iziteleka zabasebenzi? Iziteleka zabasebenzi yizenzakalo lapho abasebenzi behlangana khona ukuze baphikise izimo zokusebenza zabo, kakhulu ezihlobene nezisebenzi, amaholo, nokunye okuthinta ukusebenza kwabo. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonishwanga, noma uma befuna izinguquko ezithile ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo emsebenzini. Umbuzo 2: Yini ebangela iziteleka? Izimbangela eziyinhloko zeziteleka zibuye zibe eziningi. Kakhulu, iziteleka zenzeka uma abasebenzi befuna ukunyukelwa kwemiholo, izinzuzo ezithe xaxa, noma izimo zokusebenza eziphephile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga ezinjengokungabi bikho kwezinsiza, ukuphazamiseka kwemikhawulo yokusebenza, noma ukuphathwa ngendlela engafanele kungenza abasebenzi baphume bayokwakha iziteleka. Umbuzo 3: Ziwusizo yini iziteleka zabasebenzi? Iziteleka zabasebenzi zingaba usizo olukhulu. Zivame ukuhlinzeka ngekhono lokubeka izinkinga ezibalulekile phambi kwemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezinhlaka zikaHulumeni. Lokhu kungenza kube nokucwaningwa nokuqonda okukhulu ngezidingo zabasebenzi, futhi kwezinye izikhathi, kudala izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ezijulile. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izingozi ezihambisana neziteleka? Noma iziteleka zingaba nezinhlelo ezinhle, zinezingozi zazo. Abasebenzi abangase babe nezinkinga uma kuneziteleka, ezinjengokuvalelwa emsebenzini, ukuvinjwa kwemiholo, noma ukungaphenduli kahle emsebenzini. Ngezinye izikhathi, iziteleka zingaholela ekuphazamisekeni komkhiqizo, okuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu kwibhizinisi. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyavunyelwa ngokomthetho?
Abasebenzi abangase babe nezinkinga uma kuneziteleka, ezinjengokuvalelwa emsebenzini, ukuvinjwa kwemiholo, noma ukungaphenduli kahle emsebenzini. Ngezinye izikhathi, iziteleka zingaholela ekuphazamisekeni komkhiqizo, okuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu kwibhizinisi. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyavunyelwa ngokomthetho? Yebo, iziteleka zabasebenzi zivunywa ngokomthetho eziningi zezwe. Kokubili umthetho kazwelonke nezifunda zikhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi banezikhala zokuphikisana uma izinkampani zingakholwa izidingo zabo. Nokho, imithetho ingahluka kakhulu ezwenikazi nasemikhakheni ehlukene, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baqonde amalungelo abo. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele uyenze uma ubamba iqhaza ezitelekeni? Uma ubamba iqhaza ezitelekeni, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle amalungelo akho. Ukuze kukhulunywe ngesivumelwano esifanele, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nezenzo ezithile ezilawulwa imo yokuphepha. Kubalulekile futhi ukuzijwayeza nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezivumelwano zomsebenzi eziphathelene neziteleka. Umbuzo 7: Zithini izibonelo zeziteleka zabasebenzi ezidumile? Kuneziteleka eziningi ezidumile emhlabeni jikelele. Isibonelo, iziteleka zabasebenzi bezokusebenza ezinkampanini zokuqashwa kwezimoto eMelika zabe ziveza izinkinga ezinzima zokusebenza. Ezinye izimo ziqhakambisa izitesi ezilawulayo, iziteleka zabakhweli bezokuxhumana, kanye neziteleka zomsebenzi wezempilo, okukhombisa izinkinga eziwohlokayo ezikhona emikhakheni ehlukene. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngokubuyiselwa kwempahla nempilo ngemva kweziteleka?
Isibonelo, iziteleka zabasebenzi bezokusebenza ezinkampanini zokuqashwa kwezimoto eMelika zabe ziveza izinkinga ezinzima zokusebenza. Ezinye izimo ziqhakambisa izitesi ezilawulayo, iziteleka zabakhweli bezokuxhumana, kanye neziteleka zomsebenzi wezempilo, okukhombisa izinkinga eziwohlokayo ezikhona emikhakheni ehlukene. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngokubuyiselwa kwempahla nempilo ngemva kweziteleka? Ngemva kweziteleka, kungabakhona ukubuyiselwa kwezimali nempilo, kodwa lokhu kuxhomekeka ezivumelwaneni ezithathiwe ngesikhathi soberhelekileyo. Kwezinye izimo, izinkampani zingase zigxile ekubuyiseleni izimali ezichithwa ngaphambi kweziteleka, zigcine synto efanayo. Ukubuyiselwa kwempilo kuzodinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni ungaphatha ngezindlela ezinhle. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyavuma okuhlangenwe nakho emhlabeni? Yebo, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziye zathandwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho bahlala bephikisana nezinqubo zezimali, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlinzeko ngezintela zokusebenza. Izibonelo zikhona emakethe enkulu, nasemazweni ahlukeneyo, lapho izimpendulo ezihlukahlukene ziphuma khona. Umbuzo 10: Ingabe umphakathi unendima ekuxhaseni iziteleka? Umphakathi ungaba nendima ebalulekile ekuxhaseni iziteleka. Ukuze kusebenze kahle, ukuphakanyiswa kwezabelo zokuxhaswa kungakhale ukuphumeza izifiso zabathintekayo. Izinkampani kumele zibe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo nezindawo zokusebenzisana, ezokuxhasa iziteleka. Ngakho-ke, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wethu.
Ukuze kusebenze kahle, ukuphakanyiswa kwezabelo zokuxhaswa kungakhale ukuphumeza izifiso zabathintekayo. Izinkampani kumele zibe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo nezindawo zokusebenzisana, ezokuxhasa iziteleka. Ngakho-ke, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Zihlinzeka ngamathuba okuphikisa ngezinkinga ezithinta abasebenzi, ukuze kube nezinguquko ezinhle ukuze kube nokusebenza okungcono, nempilo engcono kubo. Qhubeka uqwashise ngezimo ezithile, futhi uthole ulwazi oluqondile ukuze uqonde kahle amagugu ezimpilo zabasebenzi.
Uhambo Lwansuku Zonke: Izimpilo Zethu Zansuku Zonke Uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Njengoba sithokozisa izinsuku zethu, sithola ukuthi lezi zinsuku ziqala ngokuhamba. Lokhu kuhamba, kungaba ngezinyawo, ngemoto, ngebhasi, noma ngolunye uhlobo lokuhamba, kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano bethu nemiphakathi esiphila kuyo. Ngokujwayelekile, uhambo lwansuku zonke luqala ekuseni, lapho abantu bephuma ezindlini zabo, bejolise emsebenzini, ezikoleni, noma kwezinye izindawo zokusebenza. Umoya ungena emoyeni, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, futhi umgwaqo ugcwele abantu abahamba ngezinyawo, abahamba ngemoto, nabahamba ngebhasi. Lezi zinsuku ziqala ngokuthokozisa, kodwa zibuye zibe nezinselelo zazo. Abantu abaningi bahlala emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho uhambo lwansuku zonke lungaba yinkinga. Izithuthi zihlala zigcwele, futhi isikhathi sokuhamba siba sikhulu. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphazamiseka, lapho abantu behamba bejolise emsebenzini, kodwa bephinde bahlale bephikisana nezithuthi eziningi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale bephapheme, beqaphela, futhi bahlale bejabulile, nakuba izimo zingase zibe nzima. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uhambo lwansuku zonke lungaba yithuba lokucabanga. Abantu bangaqonda izinkinga zabo, baphinde bacabange ngezinto ezibalulekile empilweni yabo. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokuzindla, sokubhala, noma sokulalela umculo. Abanye abantu bathola ukuthi uhambo lwabo luwumsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, lapho bejabulela umculo opholile noma izincwadi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi uhambo lwansuku zonke akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyithuba lokukhula nokuzithokozisa.
Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokuzindla, sokubhala, noma sokulalela umculo. Abanye abantu bathola ukuthi uhambo lwabo luwumsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, lapho bejabulela umculo opholile noma izincwadi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi uhambo lwansuku zonke akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyithuba lokukhula nokuzithokozisa. Uhambo lwansuku zonke luhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Abantu abahamba ngebhasi bahlala behlangana, bexoxa ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi bejabulela ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu bebonana, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhambo lwansuku zonke lungaba yithuba lokufunda. Abantu bangafunda izifundo ezahlukene, baphinde bahlale beqaphela izimo ezithile. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokufunda izincwadi, ukufunda izindaba, noma ukufunda ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezitholakala emgwaqweni. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi kudala umqondo wokuthi impilo ayipheli, kodwa iqhubeka njalo. Noma kunjalo, uhambo lwansuku zonke akukhona kuphela ukuhamba. Kukhona nezikhathi zokuphumula, lapho abantu behlala bezilungiselela izinsuku zabo. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokuphuza ikhofi, sokudla isidlo sasekuseni, noma sokuxoxa nabangani. Lezi zikhathi zibalulekile, ngoba zenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yethu. Luhlanganisa izimo eziningi, izinselelo, nezikhathi zokujabula.
Lezi zikhathi zibalulekile, ngoba zenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yethu. Luhlanganisa izimo eziningi, izinselelo, nezikhathi zokujabula. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho, nakuba uhambo lwansuku zonke lungase lube nzima, luyithuba lokukhula, lokufunda, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi impilo iyinhle, futhi uhambo lwansuku zonke luyingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu.
Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Ukusebenza Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha Komphakathi Isingeniso Ukuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula. Le dokhumenti ihlola izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi, izinjongo zazo, kanye nezindlela ezizokwenza kube nokuthula nokuphepha ezindaweni zethu. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Izinjongo Zokusebenza Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha 1. Ukuthuthukisa Ukuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zomphakathi ziphephile, kunciphisa izigameko zobugebengu, futhi kuthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabantu. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano: Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwezakhamuzi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphepha ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Ukuqwashisa Ngobungozi: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nezinsiza zokufundisa abantu ngezingozi ezikhona nezindlela zokuzivikela. Ukwandisa Ukubambisana: Ukuhlanganisa izakhamuzi ekuthatheni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphepha komphakathi, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuqinile. Izindlela Zokusebenza 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinkundla Zokuxhumana: Ukusungula izinkundla ezivumela izakhamuzi ukuba zabelane ngemininingwane, izinkinga, nezixazululo ezithinta ukuphepha. Izinhlelo Zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphepha nezindlela zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziya: Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha ezikhona, ukuhlaziya izigameko ezedlule, nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphepha: Ukusebenzisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, amaphoyisa, kanye nezinye izikhungo zokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphepha.
Izinhlelo Zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphepha nezindlela zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziya: Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha ezikhona, ukuhlaziya izigameko ezedlule, nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphepha: Ukusebenzisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, amaphoyisa, kanye nezinye izikhungo zokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. Ukubandakanywa Kwezizinda Zomphakathi Ukubandakanywa kwezizinda zomphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni izinkundla zokuphepha eziphumelelayo. Izakhamuzi kufanele zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthatheni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphepha kwazo. Lokhu kungafaka: 1. Izinhlelo Zokubambisana: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokubambisana phakathi kwezizinda nezakhamuzi ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Ukubamba Imihlangano: Ukuhlela imihlangano evulekile ukuze izakhamuzi ziveze imicabango yazo, izinkinga, nezixazululo. Ukwakha Amathimba Okusebenza: Ukusungula amathimba ahlanganisa izakhamuzi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo zokuphepha ukuze kube nokubambisana okuhle. Izinsiza Zokuxhasa Ukuze le nqubomgomo isebenze kahle, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Izinsiza Zezimali: Ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo zezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphepha. Izinsiza Zokuqeqesha: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezokuphepha, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkinga Kubhalwe ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphepha komphakathi.
Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphepha. Izinsiza Zokuqeqesha: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezokuphepha, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkinga Kubhalwe ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphepha komphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Izinhlelo Zokuphendula: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlola Izimo: Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo. Ukwazisa Umphakathi: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze izakhamuzi zazi kahle ngezinsiza zokuphepha. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kudinga ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwezizinda, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Le nqubomgomo ibeka izisekelo ezibalulekile zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onokuthula, futhi ophephile. Ngokusebenza ndawonye, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zethu zihlala ziphephile, futhi izakhamuzi zethu zinethemba lokuthi zikhona izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphepha.
Sanibonani nonke, ngithemba ninempilo enhle. Namuhla, ngifuna ukwabelana nani ngenguquko ezithinta ubulungu bethu be-GEMS. Njengoba sazi, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi izinguquko ezithinta ubulungu zibalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi ziwusizo kanjani kithi. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-GEMS ibhekelele izidingo zethu zempilo, okusho ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zenzelwe ukusiza wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani. Kukhona izinguquko ezithile ezizokwenziwa ezindaweni ezithile, ezizothinta indlela esithola ngayo izinsiza zempilo. Kubalulekile ukuba nolwazi oluqondile ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Okwamanje, i-GEMS izobe ibuyekeza izinhlelo zayo zokubhalisela ubulungu, okubandakanya izinhlelo ezintsha ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukukhetha okokwelapha abakuthandayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuhlela izindleko zabo zempilo futhi bathole usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzoba nezinhlelo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithile, okungaba usizo olukhulu kubantu abanesidingo esikhethekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona nezinguquko ezithinta izindleko zokubhalisela ubulungu, okuzoba nomthelela ekutheni sikwazi ukuhlela izimali zethu. I-GEMS izobe ibheka izindleko zempilo ezikhulayo, futhi izozama ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi. I-GEMS izobe ibuyekeza futhi izinqubo zokubhalisela ubulungu, okuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuthi babhalise, futhi baqonde kahle izinqubo ezithinta ubulungu babo.
Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona nezinguquko ezithinta izindleko zokubhalisela ubulungu, okuzoba nomthelela ekutheni sikwazi ukuhlela izimali zethu. I-GEMS izobe ibheka izindleko zempilo ezikhulayo, futhi izozama ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi. I-GEMS izobe ibuyekeza futhi izinqubo zokubhalisela ubulungu, okuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuthi babhalise, futhi baqonde kahle izinqubo ezithinta ubulungu babo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuhlela izinsiza zempilo, futhi bathole usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngiyazi ukuthi lezi zinguquko zingase zibe nezinkinga, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nesineke. I-GEMS izobe ibheka izidingo zethu, futhi izozama ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba nolwazi oluqondile ukuze sikwazi ukuzenza izinqumo ezifanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona nezinguquko ezithinta izinsiza zempilo ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS izobe ibheka izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi izozama ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi. Ekupheleni, izinguquko zobulungu be-GEMS zibalulekile, futhi kufanele sibe nolwazi oluqondile ukuze sikwazi ukuzenza izinqumo ezifanele. Ngiyabonga nonke ngokulalela, futhi ngithemba sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili ndawonye, sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bethu. Hamba kahle, futhi ngiyabonga!
