Thola: Zama ungazithwesi kakhulu ngezinto ezahlukene ngoba uzolahlekelwa ithuba elibalulekile elidingekayo ukuze ukhiqize kahle. Njengoba abakhiqizi bezinhlamvu bephupha njalo ukuthi unyaka ozayo uzoba ngcono, bakha umsebenzi wabo unyaka nonyaka. Ngesikhathi esifushane, kungenzeka kube nethuba lokuqhubeka mhlawumbe kanye ngonyaka. Abakhiqizi bavame ukuphuthelwa amathuba okunciphisa izindleko nokuvimbela ukulahleka kokukhiqiza ngoba baphuthelwa ithuba lapho kusen isikhathi. Amathuba amahle angavela ngesikhathi sokulungiselela ukutshala kanye nakuzo zonke izikhathi lapho izitshalo zikhula. Vula amehlo akho ukuze ubone izinto ezinhle ezithengiswa ngamanani aphansi. Qaphela kakhulu ngesikhathi sokukhula ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinto ozisebenzisayo epulazini zisebenza kahle noma cha. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukukhetha izinto ezizokwenza kahle. Ikhadi lokuthengisa elinamanani aphansi lingaba usizo olukhulu kusasa. Lokhu kuyithuba elivame ukuphuthelwa yizinkulungwane zabafuyi. Ngokuvamile, imishini engalungiswanga kahle idala ukulahleka kwesikhathi, ivimbela ukutshala ngesikhathi. Ekupheleni kokutshala, isikhathi esihle sokuhlola nokulungisa imishini yakho. Ngemva kokulungisa nokuvimbela ukuwa, kufanele ibekwe endaweni ezoyivikela kwezinye izingozi. Ngokufanayo, akufanele kuthathe isikhathi ukulungisa imishini lapho isikhathi sokutshala sifika, futhi izindleko zizoba phansi. Lapho isikhathi sokutshala sifika, kufanele wazi ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, uzokwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho kahle. Uma kuvela imvula enamandla, kungaba yingozi enkulu ezitshalweni. Uma umhlabathi uphume, awukwazi ukuwubuyisela.
Lapho isikhathi sokutshala sifika, kufanele wazi ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, uzokwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho kahle. Uma kuvela imvula enamandla, kungaba yingozi enkulu ezitshalweni. Uma umhlabathi uphume, awukwazi ukuwubuyisela. Nokho, ukugcina umhlabathi kuyinto okufanele yenziwe njalo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ipulazi, futhi abafuyi kufanele baphinde babheke izindawo lapho ukuhuzuka komhlabathi kungase kube khona. Imvula ingavela ngezikhathi ezingalindelekile. Uma ubona ukuthi kukhona indawo ethambile emasimini, kufanele uyilungise ngokushesha. Lokhu kungaba ithuba lakho lokuvimbela ukuhuzuka komhlabathi wakho. Kukhona amakhemikhali amahle abulala izihlahla ezivela emakhanda, kodwa noma ngabe le herbicide isebenza kahle, kufanele ihambisane nezimo zezulu ezifanele. Thola ithuba lokufaka le herbicide ngosuku lapho kungekho umoya noma lapho kushisa kakhulu noma lapho kumanzi. Usayizi wezihlahla ubalulekile uma ufuna ukuzibulala kahle. Ngokuvamile, kungcono ukubulala izihlahla uma zisencane. Kubalulekile ukuhlola njalo ukuthi zingaki izitshalo - uhlobo lwezikhukhukazi nezihlahla. Kungcono ukubulala izihlahla ngokushesha. Izilokazane ezifana nalabo abahlala em wood zingaba yingozi enkulu uma kukhula uhlobo lwezikhukhukazi nezihlahla. Lokhu kungenzeka ngokushesha. Izilokazane eziningi zingabulawa ngokushesha ngamakhambi. Kodwa uma uthatha isikhathi eside ukufaka le herbicide, ingase ingasebenzi kahle. Uma ama-larvae (ama-caterpillar) ethola isikhathi sokukhula, le herbicide ayisasebenzi kahle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola njalo izitshalo zakho ukuze ukhethe isikhathi esifanele sokufaka le herbicide ezosebenza kahle. Kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla okufanele zikhishwe ngesikhathi esithile esifanele.
Uma ama-larvae (ama-caterpillar) ethola isikhathi sokukhula, le herbicide ayisasebenzi kahle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola njalo izitshalo zakho ukuze ukhethe isikhathi esifanele sokufaka le herbicide ezosebenza kahle. Kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla okufanele zikhishwe ngesikhathi esithile esifanele. Isibonelo, ngeziqhamo, uma uthola ngaphambi kwesikhathi noma uthatha isikhathi eside ukuhluza, izinga lokudla lizoba phansi. Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi isikhathi esifanele sokuhluza sithi kufanele kuholele umfuyi ukuba acabangele izinto eziningi: umbala wezithombo, izimo zezulu, kanye nezifo ezingase zenzeke. Ngezinye izikhathi, ungathola ukuthi isivuno siba sibi emasimini njengoba sikhula. Uma umfuyi ethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuhluza, lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni ukudla okuningi. Ungaphuthelwa ithuba lokuqoqa zonke izikhukhukazi uma uhluza.
Uhlola kanjani ukuthi i-planter ilungiswe kahle ukuze ifeze ukutshala? Thola zonke izingxenye ze-planter ezingalungisa ukulungiswa (ama-sprockets, ama-gears, nezitsha). Qonda ukuthi i-planter ithengisa kanjani uma kuqhathaniswa nezimpande nez fertiliser ngamanani akhona. Linganisa ububanzi ngaphakathi kwezingxenye ze-planter ukuze unqume ububanzi bezigaba zokutshala - lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukala inani lezigaba ezizotshalwa ngaphezulu kwe-hectare (Isibonelo: ububanzi be-hectare bungama-100 meters, uma ububanzi ngaphakathi kwezigaba bungama-0.9 m, khona-ke 100 m / 0.9 m = 111 izigaba nge-hectare). Beka indawo endaweni engama-10 m. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezimpande nez fertiliser emabhokisini (ama-hoppers) - futhi uqinisekise ukuthi usayizi wezimpande uhambisana nezimbobo ezikuma-plates - kufanele kube ne-1 seed kuphela ehla ngesikhathi. Qinisa ipulasitiki emaphethelweni aphehla fertiliser ukuze ukwazi ukukala isisindo se-fertiliser ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Phusha i-planter kule ndawo engama-10 m (qinisekisa ukuthi amavili anokuxhumana okuhle nomhlabathi). Bala inani lezimpande eziphume kule ndawo engama-10 m. ku-100 m (khumbula ukuthi i-hectare iyalingana no-100 m x 100 m). uma ububanzi bethu bungama-0.9 m, kusho ukuthi kune-111 izigaba ku-100 m. Isibonelo: sithola ukuthi ama-30 seeds aphumelele kule ndawo engama-10 m. futhi ama-300 seeds ku-100 m. phinda: x 300 = 33,300 izitshalo nge-hectare. ama-sprockets ukuze i-planter ihambe ngokushesha.
Bala inani lezimpande eziphume kule ndawo engama-10 m. ku-100 m (khumbula ukuthi i-hectare iyalingana no-100 m x 100 m). uma ububanzi bethu bungama-0.9 m, kusho ukuthi kune-111 izigaba ku-100 m. Isibonelo: sithola ukuthi ama-30 seeds aphumelele kule ndawo engama-10 m. futhi ama-300 seeds ku-100 m. phinda: x 300 = 33,300 izitshalo nge-hectare. ama-sprockets ukuze i-planter ihambe ngokushesha. Thola isisindo se-fertiliser ephumelele kule ndawo engama-10 m. Manje phinda lowo nombolo ngenani lezigaba ezikhona ku-100 m (esibonelweni sethu, ububanzi ngaphakathi bube ngu-0.9 m okusho ukuthi kune-111 izigaba endaweni efanayo no-100 m). Isibonelo: kungaba nama-100 g (0.1 kg) kule ndawo engama-10 m. Lokhu kulingana nama-1,000 grams (1 kg) ku-100 m. Kune-111 izigaba nge-hectare, x 1000 = 111,000 grams, okusho ukuthi uzofaka ama-111 kg nge-hectare). Uma inani olitholayo lidlula lokho okufunayo, shintsha ama-sprockets e-planter ukuze iphumuzi eliphehla ama-plates lingahambi ngokushesha kakhulu (hamba kancane) (Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma inani le-fertiliser eliceliwe lincane, shintsha ama-sprockets ukuze iphumuzi ihambe ngokushesha). Phinda le nqubo kuze kube uthola inani elifanele le-fertiliser.
Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni kweminyaka ye-1990, uMzansi Afrika wabhekana nezinguquko ezinkulu. Lezi zinguquko, ezihlelwe ngamalungelo abantu, zashaya umoya omusha emakholweni ezehlakalo zomphakathi. Nokho, phakathi kwalokhu kuzama ukuguqula isimo sezinto, intsha yayibhekene nenkinga enkulu: ukungasebenzi. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enobuhlungu, ethinta izigidi zabantu abasha, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu afana noNxamalala, eGoli, naseKhayelitsha. Intsha yayinokufunda okukhulu, kodwa ukuphuma emsebenzini kwakungathiwe. Izifundo ezitholakalayo zazingahambisani nezidingo zemboni. Ngalesi sikhathi, izifundo eziphezulu zathola ukugxekwa, njengoba abantu abasha bephokophele emikhakheni ethile yokufunda, kodwa imakethe yebhizinisi yayingenakho ukuphuma kwezikhala zomsebenzi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi baphinde bahlale emakhaya, bezama izindlela zokuphila ezizimele. Kwakukhona umuzwa ophakathi kwentsha, umuzwa wokuphikisana nezinqubomgomo ezithile zehulumeni. Njengoba umnotho wawuhlupheka, abantu abasha bahlola izindlela zokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo. Izinkulumo ezazihambisana nomkhankaso wezomnotho zazisuswa emakhaya nasemaphandleni, zifaka phakathi imihlangano, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezibopho zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibono emisha, ebandakanya umqondo wokuthi intsha inemfanelo yokubamba iqhaza ekuqhamukeni kwezixazululo. Njengoba lesi sikhathi sikhula, izinkinga zokuqala zaba nzima kakhulu. Umnotho waqala ukuphuka, futhi izinkampani ezinkulu zathola izinkinga zokuthola abasebenzi abaneziqu ezithile.
Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibono emisha, ebandakanya umqondo wokuthi intsha inemfanelo yokubamba iqhaza ekuqhamukeni kwezixazululo. Njengoba lesi sikhathi sikhula, izinkinga zokuqala zaba nzima kakhulu. Umnotho waqala ukuphuka, futhi izinkampani ezinkulu zathola izinkinga zokuthola abasebenzi abaneziqu ezithile. Abantu abasha, abahlala bezama ukufunda, babona ukuthi akubona bonke abaphumelelayo. Lokhu kwabavusa umuzwa wokuziqhenya, bephakamisa izwi labo, begcizelela ukuthi badinga ukwaziwa. Izinyathelo ezithile zathathwa ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo. Uhulumeni waqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokufundisa, ezakhelwe ukusiza abantwana ukuthi bathole amakhono adingekayo emsebenzini. Lezi zinhlelo zafaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe, izifundo ezihambisanayo nezimiso zokuphila, okwakuhloselwe ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abasha. Nokho, okwenzeka kwakungekho okwanele ukuxazulula inkinga enkulu yokungasebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukuqonda ukuthi akusikho kuphela ukuthi abantu badinga imisebenzi, kodwa badinga nemisebenzi ehambisana nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kwaholela emishinini emisha, izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, kanye nezinkampani ezincane ezandleni zabantu abasha. Ngalesi sikhathi, ibhizinisi le-entrepreneurship laqala ukuthandwa, lapho abantu abasha bezama ukudala imisebenzi yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zinguquko zaziholela ekubeni intsha iqale ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi eyahlukene. Ubumqoka babuhamba phambili, futhi abantu abasha baqala ukuzithokozisa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, bakha amabhizinisi amancane ahamba phambili.
Ngalesi sikhathi, ibhizinisi le-entrepreneurship laqala ukuthandwa, lapho abantu abasha bezama ukudala imisebenzi yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zinguquko zaziholela ekubeni intsha iqale ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi eyahlukene. Ubumqoka babuhamba phambili, futhi abantu abasha baqala ukuzithokozisa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, bakha amabhizinisi amancane ahamba phambili. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi intsha ingakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo, uma ibhentsha izinsiza ezikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi yaqala ukubona impumelelo. Abantu abasha baqala ukuthola imisebenzi, besebenzisa amakhono abawafundile. Lokhu kwaba yiphupho eliphumelela empilweni yabo, kwadalela umqondo wokuthi intsha ingaba yinsika yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Noma kunjalo, izinselelo zasuwa, kodwa intsha yahlala iqhubeka nokulwela amalungelo ayo, iqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokumangalisayo, ukungasebenzi kwentsha akukaze kube yinkinga eyodwa kuphela. Kuveza ubuhle bokubambisana, ubuhlakani, nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu abasha. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, intsha ibonisa ukuthi inamandla okushintsha umphakathi, nokuqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezikhuluma ngempumelelo nempilo engcono. Namuhla, inkinga yokungasebenzi kwentsha isaxazululeka, kodwa kumele siqhubeke sisekela izinhlelo ezihlinzekayo. Imizamo yokukhuthaza abantu abasha ibalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukudala ikusasa eliqhakazile, elikhanyayo, neliphelele. Uhlelo lokusebenza kwabantu abasha alupheli, kodwa luhlala lukhula, lukhula, futhi luthuthuka. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi intsha ifuna ukwaziwa, ifuna ukusebenza, futhi ifuna ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono.
Imizamo yokukhuthaza abantu abasha ibalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukudala ikusasa eliqhakazile, elikhanyayo, neliphelele. Uhlelo lokusebenza kwabantu abasha alupheli, kodwa luhlala lukhula, lukhula, futhi luthuthuka. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi intsha ifuna ukwaziwa, ifuna ukusebenza, futhi ifuna ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, intsha iyinhloso yethu, futhi izizathu zayo ziqhubeka zikhuthaza ubuhlakani, umoya wokwakha, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuveza amandla okwenza ushintsho, futhi sikholelwa ekutheni impumelelo iyavela lapho abantu benza isiqiniseko sokuthi bawela izithiyo, bazitholele izindlela zabo, futhi baphokophele phambili.
Ezemisebenzi: Indaba kaThandiwe Kwakukhanya kahle emini, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu zikhuluma ngezindaba zazo. UThandiwe, intombazane encane eyaphila edolobheni elincane, wayenokubona okuhle ngempilo yakhe. Wayefisa ukuba ngumsebenzi ophumelelayo, kodwa wayazi kahle ukuthi ukufinyelela kulokho kwakunzima. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokusebenza endaweni yokudlela eyaziwa kakhulu edolobheni. Lokhu kwamjabulisa kakhulu, ngoba wayekwazi ukuthi kuzomnika ithuba lokufunda nokukhula. Njengoba eqala ukusebenza, wathola ukuthi akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kudingeka azikhandle, afunde, futhi akhulise amakhono akhe. UThandiwe wayenobungane futhi wayehlonipha wonke umuntu, okwenza abaphathi bakhe bamthande. Njengoba edlula ezinsukwini, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenza kahle akukhona kuphela ukugcina izinga, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuxhumana nabanye. Waqala ukufunda ngezifundo zokuphatha abantu, futhi lokhu kumenze waba ngumsebenzi ophumelelayo. Ngesikhathi esebenza, uThandiwe wathola izinselelo eziningi. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho wayezwa sengathi akakwazi ukuqhubeka. Kodwa wayazi ukuthi umndeni wakhe ubelokhu umkhuthaza, futhi lokhu kumenze waba namandla. Wafunda ukuthi uma ebhekene nezinkinga, kufanele abheke izixazululo, hhayi izithiyo. Ngemuva kokusebenza unyaka, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokukhuphuka esikhundleni. Lokhu kwamjabulisa kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi umphakathi wakhe wawumjabulisa. UThandiwe waqala ukufundisa abanye abasebenzi, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu bayamthanda.
Lokhu kwamjabulisa kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi umphakathi wakhe wawumjabulisa. UThandiwe waqala ukufundisa abanye abasebenzi, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu bayamthanda. Ngesikhathi esehola, waqala ukufunda ngezindlela zokuphatha ezahlukene, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphatha abantu akukhona nje ukulawula, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola izifundo ezahlukahlukene ezimfundisayo, futhi lokhu kwamnika amandla okuba ngumholi omuhle. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi, uThandiwe waba umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawuhamba phambili. Waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yakhe, nokuthi wayefuna ukwabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye. Waqala umphakathi wokuqeqesha abantu abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele ezemisebenzi. UThandiwe waba umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ukuthi izinselelo zempilo zazingamphazamisa, kodwa zazingamfundisa. Waqhubeka nokukhula, wathola ukuthi ukuphila kahle akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukusiza abanye. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphumelela akukhona nje ngokuthola umsebenzi omuhle, kodwa kubandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano, ukufunda, nokukhulisa abanye. Waqonda ukuthi ezemisebenzi akukhona nje umgudu, kodwa kuwumsebenzi ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu edlala indima yakhe. Ngakho, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe yayigcwele izifundo, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele, bazi ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza umsebenzi oncomekayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yakhe yokuphila, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle emiphakathini yabo bonke ababephila edolobheni.
Waqonda ukuthi ezemisebenzi akukhona nje umgudu, kodwa kuwumsebenzi ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu edlala indima yakhe. Ngakho, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe yayigcwele izifundo, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele, bazi ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza umsebenzi oncomekayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yakhe yokuphila, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle emiphakathini yabo bonke ababephila edolobheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi izifundo zempilo zazingapheli, futhi wayejabule ngokuthi waqhubeka nokukhula, efundisa abanye, futhi ebakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi umsebenzi awupheli, kodwa uhlala uqhubeka, futhi umphakathi uhlala unamathuba amaningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi impilo ayikhathalekile, kodwa ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sithokozise izinselelo zethu, ngoba ziwusizo empilweni yethu. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma sikhuthazekile, singafinyelela phezulu, futhi sithole impumelelo ezemisebenzi.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Umsebenzi Wokulwa Nempilo Engcono Iziteleka zabasebenzi, umkhankaso ovamile emhlabeni jikelele, ziwumkhiqizo ophawulekayo wezinkinga ezibhekene nezisebenzi. Lezi ziteleka ziveza amaphutha, ubuhlungu, nezinkinga ezibhekene nabasebenzi ezindaweni zokusebenza. Lokhu akukhona ukujolisa emsebenzini, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayalwela amalungelo abo, izinjongo, kanye nemigomo yokuphila kahle. Ngokwemvelo, iziteleka zabasebenzi zikhombisa ukuvuma kokuthi izisebenzi zidinga ukuba nomthelela ezinqubweni ezithinta ukuphila kwazo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yabasebenzi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi akukhona kuphela izinzuzo eziphathelene nemali. Uhlanga lwemali luhamba phambili, kodwa imiphumela ethile yokusebenza engafanele, njengezimo zokusebenza ezingafanele, ukungabi naluphi uhlelo lokuphepha, kanye nezinga lokuphila eliphansi, kudinga ukubonwa. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zisebenza njengendlela yokulwa nalezi zinkinga. Izimbangela ezivame ukuholela ezitelekeni zabasebenzi zihluke. Ukuncishiswa kwemiholo, isikhathi eside sokusebenza, nemigomo engafanele yokusebenza, konke kuyizinto eziphakamisa ithuba lokuthi abasebenzi bakhethe ukuphikisana. Noma kungenzeka kube nezizathu ezikhethekile ezifana nokuhluleka kwezimboni ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile, noma ukungabibikho kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, lezi zimo zikhombisa ukuthi izisebenzi zikhathazekile futhi zidinga ukuzwa izwi lazo. Ngokubheka iziteleka zabasebenzi, kumqoka ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinyathelo azilungile. Lokhu akushintshi umqondo wokuthi izisebenzi zidinga ukuzwa ukuthi zibalulekile. Iziteleka zingakha umoya wokuphikisana, kodwa futhi zikhuthaza umqondo wokubambisana.
Ngokubheka iziteleka zabasebenzi, kumqoka ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinyathelo azilungile. Lokhu akushintshi umqondo wokuthi izisebenzi zidinga ukuzwa ukuthi zibalulekile. Iziteleka zingakha umoya wokuphikisana, kodwa futhi zikhuthaza umqondo wokubambisana. Izinhlangano zabasebenzi zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi ziyaqondwa, futhi zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ukwengeza, iziteleka zabasebenzi zikhumbuza umphakathi wobuchwepheshe bokusebenza. Ubulungiswa, ubumbano, nokubambisana yizinto ezibalulekile ezidingekayo ukuze kube khona impumelelo emsebenzini. Uma izisebenzi zisebenza zodwa, ungakubona lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, iziteleka zikhumbuza umphakathi ukuthi umoya wokubambisana udinga ukuhamba phambili, futhi izisebenzi zidinga ukusekela izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwazo. Ngokuphawula, iziteleka zabasebenzi zenziwe ngezizathu eziningi, kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi ziyindlela yokuzwakalisa ukuphikisana. Abasebenzi bahlala bebhekene nezinkinga ezithinta izimo zabo zokusebenza. Inhloso yezi ziteleka akukhona nje kuphela ukuvuselela izinkinga, kodwa futhi ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo ethile phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi izisebenzi zifune ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabaphathi, okungaholela ekutholeni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi nabaphathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izisebenzi kufanele zikhulume ngezinkinga zazo, zifune izixazululo, futhi zihlale ziqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zazo ziyaqondwa. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zidinga ukuhamba phambili, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi ziyaqonda ukuthi zibalulekile. Ubulungiswa emsebenzini akukhona kuphela isifiso, kodwa isidingo sokuphila ngendlela efanele.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi izisebenzi kufanele zikhulume ngezinkinga zazo, zifune izixazululo, futhi zihlale ziqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zazo ziyaqondwa. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zidinga ukuhamba phambili, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi ziyaqonda ukuthi zibalulekile. Ubulungiswa emsebenzini akukhona kuphela isifiso, kodwa isidingo sokuphila ngendlela efanele. Ngokubuka phambili, iziteleka zabasebenzi zizohlala zibalulekile empilweni yabasebenzi. Zizokhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza bujolise kanjani emigomweni yokuphila. Uma izisebenzi ziqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, zikhuthaza umphakathi ukuze ube nesimo esihle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuphila kahle, okukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Ekugcineni, iziteleka zabasebenzi zingabhekwa njengendlela yokukhombisa lokho abantu abakufunayo empilweni yabo. Zikhombisa ukuthi izisebenzi zidinga ukuba nomthelela ezinqubweni ezithinta ukuphila kwazo. Ngaleyo ndlela, iziteleka ziba yisikhumbuzo sokubaluleka kwezisebenzi emnothweni. Akukhona kuphela ukulwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi obumbene, onobudlelwano obuhle, kanye nempilo engcono kubo bonke. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zihlala zikhumbuza umhlaba ukuthi abantu bayahlonishwa, futhi amalungelo abo adinga ukuvikelwa.
Ukulima kanye nekusasa: kungani kuthatha isikhathi eside? Sizamile ukuvuselela abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono ukuze babe abalimi abakwazi ukuziphilisa ngokwabo esikhathini esizayo. Njengoba isimo sezimali samanje emhlabeni sikhathazekile, lokhu kuzoba nzima - nokho, ungumuntu ophawulekayo. Uma ukulima eNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuqhubeke, kudingeka sifeze uguquko olugcwele emhlabeni wezolimo ukuze sikwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezivamile. Ukulima akulula; abalimi babhekana nezinto eziningi futhi kwesinye isikhathi bazibeka engcupheni. Amanani aphansi wezimpahla zokudla enza kube nzima kubalimi ukuba bathole inzuzo ezimpahleni zabo. Izinga lenzalo liphansi kakhulu futhi izindleko zemishini ziphezulu kakhulu. Abalimi abanamakhono kwezomnotho nabo babhekana nezinselelo (bakhathazekile!) - singasho ukuthini ngabo abasha? Uhulumeni angabasiza kanjani? Okwamanje, ukukhiqiza izimpahla zokudla ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo kunzima; abalimi abasha bangase bangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokulima esikhathini esizayo. Sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha; amanani okudla azophakama futhi. Kodwa okwamanje, kudingeka sisekele abalimi ngezimali, njengokuxhaswa - ukusiza ngezindleko zokuqala zokutshala noma ukuhlinzeka ngama-bonuses ezimpahleni zokudla ezikhiqizwayo. Le mikhankaso izoqinisekisa ukuthi labo abasebenza kanzima bazothola ama-bonuses - lokhu kuzosisiza abalimi abanamakhono ukuba babe nenzuzo. Enye inkinga enkulu yisimo semishini nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa abalimi abasha - kudingeka sibe nesisekelo sezimali ukusiza abalimi ukuthi balungise imishini yabo. Kukho ingxenye yezigaba zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngempahla nemishini kubalimi.
Le mikhankaso izoqinisekisa ukuthi labo abasebenza kanzima bazothola ama-bonuses - lokhu kuzosisiza abalimi abanamakhono ukuba babe nenzuzo. Enye inkinga enkulu yisimo semishini nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa abalimi abasha - kudingeka sibe nesisekelo sezimali ukusiza abalimi ukuthi balungise imishini yabo. Kukho ingxenye yezigaba zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngempahla nemishini kubalimi. Lokhu kungasiza esikhathini esifushane, kodwa labo abalimi kudingeka baqeqeshelwe ukuphatha le mishini kahle. Uma imishini isetshenziswa ngamaqembu abantu, akekho ozothatha umthwalo wokuphatha - kaningi imishini iyashiywa inganakekelwa futhi ngokushesha iba ingasebenzi. Lo msebenzi awukwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Izikhungo ezabelana ngolwazi nazo kumele ziqeqeshelwe ukuze ziqhubeke nomsebenzi wazo kahle - kukhona izikhungo eziningi ezinjalo, futhi kufanele zikwazi ukusiza abalimi ezindaweni zokulima. Ingxenye yezinselelo abalimi abasha ababhekana nazo ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali zokuqala zokulima. Kukho abaningi abanomhlaba nezinsiza (mhlawumbe ezinye azisebenzi kahle), baqeqeshelwe futhi baxhaswe, kodwa badinga imali. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphezulu kakhulu - kudingeka R4,000 kuya ku-R5,000 ukuze utshale ihektare eyodwa. Ekuqaleni, sathokoziswa ukubona amabhizinisi ezolimo esiza abalimi abasha ngoxhaso lokuqala, futhi kusekhona amabhizinisi ezolimo axhasa abalimi ukuba babe nenzuzo. Asebenzisa abalimi ekulungiseni nasekuphatheleni izinsiza zabo nemishini. Kanjani kufanele kusetshenziswe abaqashi emkhakheni wezolimo? Ingxenye yezindlela zokuqala zokulima umhlaba iwukusebenzisa abaqashi abakhulu.
Asebenzisa abalimi ekulungiseni nasekuphatheleni izinsiza zabo nemishini. Kanjani kufanele kusetshenziswe abaqashi emkhakheni wezolimo? Ingxenye yezindlela zokuqala zokulima umhlaba iwukusebenzisa abaqashi abakhulu. Lokhu sekwenziwe izikhathi eziningi, futhi kuthiwa umqashi uzosetshenziswa kuphela ekuqaleni, ekugcineni umalimi uzosebenza ngokwakhe. Umalimi akatholi inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza nemishini. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ziya zanda. Imali ekhokhwayo ukuze uthole umqashi ingasetshenziswa ukulungisa nokugcina izinsiza nemishini. Abalimi abangasebenzi nomqashi, ngakho, abaqondi kahle ukuzenzela. Isimo sezulu esomile ezindaweni eziningi lapha senza isikhathi sokutshala, ukutshala, nokuvuna sibe mfushane; kaningi umsebenzi awuqhutshekanga ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi umalimi ulahlekelwa umkhiqizo wabo (ukutshala nokufaka umanyolo sekwephuzile). Umqashi ukhokhelwa ngehektare elitshaliwe, hhayi ngokusekelwe kwekhwalithi yomsebenzi wabo - noma umalimi enza inzuzo noma cha, umqashi uthola ukukhokhelwa kwakhe. Kukho abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abalimayo futhi banemithombo. Laba abalimi kufanele bakwazi ukuqasha amapulazi kwabanye abanikazi bomhlaba abangafuni noma abangakwazi ukulima. Okwamanje, amapulazi amaningi akhishwa ngamabhizinisi ezolimo, ngakho-ke abanye abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakwazi ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Lapho kukhona abalimi abangenazo izinsiza, kuthiwa bazokwazi ukwenza inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza. Kodwa lokhu akuphumeleli - inzuzo etholakala ekulimaleni kwezimpahla zokudla incane kakhulu, futhi abaqashi baphinde baphinde banciphise inzuzo.
Okwamanje, amapulazi amaningi akhishwa ngamabhizinisi ezolimo, ngakho-ke abanye abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakwazi ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Lapho kukhona abalimi abangenazo izinsiza, kuthiwa bazokwazi ukwenza inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza. Kodwa lokhu akuphumeleli - inzuzo etholakala ekulimaleni kwezimpahla zokudla incane kakhulu, futhi abaqashi baphinde baphinde banciphise inzuzo. Bonke abasebenza emkhakheni wezolimo kufanele basebenzisane ukuze basize abalimi. Abalimi bafuna ukusebenza ngokwabo; abafuni ukuba balimelwe ngabanye. Nika umalimi ithuba lokuqala ukulima ngalokho abanako - ukuqala ngezimpahla ezincane endaweni encane akubeki engcupheni enkulu. (Khumbula ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukulima emhlabeni wabo usuphila kule ndawo. Uma bengakwazi ukwenza inzuzo encane kuphela ngaphezu kwalokho ababephila ngakho, kungabasiza kakhulu. Ngokusebenza kanzima, umalimi uzokhula ekulimaleni). Ungacindezeli umalimi ukuba aqashe umqashi; kungcono ukusiza ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yabo nemishini ukuze balime ngokwabo ngalokho abanako - mhlawumbe kungcono kubo ukuqasha amapulazi abangawaphatha. Ukusebenza nomuntu onolwazi (umeluleki) kuzobasiza kakhulu - kodwa umeluleki kufanele akhethwe ngokucophelela! Kufanele kube umuntu ozinikele ofuna ukusiza umalimi akhule - ozothatha isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono futhi abaxhase. Kufanele bahlangane futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye kahle. Hlinzeka abalimi ngemininingwane futhi ungathathi izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuhlangana nabo. Kuthiwa - asifuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu - futhi kufanele kube njalo lapha.
Kufanele bahlangane futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye kahle. Hlinzeka abalimi ngemininingwane futhi ungathathi izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuhlangana nabo. Kuthiwa - asifuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu - futhi kufanele kube njalo lapha. Ukuxhasa abalimi ngokuhlola nokunquma zonke izimpahla zabo epulazini, amapulazi, izinsiza, imishini, izinkomo, izitshalo, nezinye izinsiza, njll. Kufanele baqonde kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani ekulimaleni. Isibonelo: bangaki ama-kW (amandla) umalimi adingayo ukuze alime amapulazi athile? Qinisekisa ukuthi umalimi ungene ohlelweni oluzomfundisa futhi luthuthukise. Ukuba umalimi onguye osemthethweni kuthatha isikhathi, futhi kukhona izinhlangano eziningi ezingasiza ukuthuthukisa abalimi. Hlola isimo soqeqesho esinikezwayo. Kukho abaqeqeshi abaqoshiwe abangawenzi kahle umsebenzi ngoba nabo baphuthile amakhono okusebenza (awukwazi ukufunda ukulima ngokufunda kuphela izincwadi!). Qinisekisa ukuthi awuqali ngephrojekthi enkulu kakhulu. Abalimi abasha badinga isikhathi nokuxhaswa; uma iphrojekthi ikhuliswa kakhulu, izinto ziba nzima, futhi konke kuqhekeka. Kungase kube kuhle ukuxhasa abalimi abangama-50 noma ngaphezulu (kuqala), kodwa kaningi lokhu kuqhekeka ngoba kungekho izandla ezanele zokwenza umsebenzi. Kungcono ukuqala ngabalimi abangu-15 - 20 bese wandisa inani ngonyaka.
Imidlalo Yamazwe Ngamazwe (International Sports) Umbuzo 1: Yini imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ibhekisela emncintiswaneni yokudlala okubandakanya amaqembu, abanolwazi, noma abadlali abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Le midlalwano ibonisa ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kweqembu, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwemibuso eminingi. Imidlalo efana ne-Olympics, iFIFA World Cup, neNHL All-Star Game iyingxenye enkulu yalezi zinhlelo. Umbuzo 2: Kuthini ukukhethwa kwale midlalo? Ukukhethwa kwemidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe kuncike kakhulu ekuhlonipheni izindinganiso zendawo. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, ezifanele ukweluleka izwe, zikhulisa izinhlelo ezidinga ukuqeqeshwa okuhle, ukuhlela kahle, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala efanele. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baqeqeshe abadlali. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zezimidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Izinsiza ezinkulu zezimidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ziqhakambisa ubuchwepheshe, amandla, kanye nokuvuselela umoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, kuthuthukisa ubuhlobo, futhi kukhuthaza inhlonipho phakathi kwabantu bamasiko ahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwenza kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezimali, njengoba imidlalo ithinta ezomnotho. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ikhulisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizwe? Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe iyinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Abadlali bavela ezizweni ezahlukene, bahlala behlangene bemema abanye ezimweni zempilo. Lokhu kudala amandla okuthola ulwazi nokuhlonipha izinkolelo ezahlukene.
Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe iyinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Abadlali bavela ezizweni ezahlukene, bahlala behlangene bemema abanye ezimweni zempilo. Lokhu kudala amandla okuthola ulwazi nokuhlonipha izinkolelo ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaqembu ahlangene ancintisana afinyelela izinjongo ezijolile, okukhuthaza ukubambisana kuzo zonke izici zempilo. Umbuzo 5: Iyini indima yokuhlanganyela kwemiphakathi emidlalweni? Ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo kubalulekile emidlalweni yamazwe ngamazwe. Umphakathi udinga ukusekela abadlali, kuhlanganise nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, ukuzibophezela, kanye nokuthokozisa abanye. Lokhu kunceda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali banikezwa ithuba lokwenza kahle emncintiswaneni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthuthukisa ubuqotho, uhlanga, kanye nobumbano phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 6: Yini ezobangela utshani kumazwe anezimidlalo? Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezithinta izwe lapho imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ibanjwe. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, izinkinga zokulawula, kanye nezinkinga zokukhethwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanye amazwe angazithola ezithombeni ezimbi ngezomenzi, okwenza kube nzima ukudala umphakathi onokuthula. Kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle imicimbi yezemidlalo ukuze kuzuzwe okungcono kumazwe. Umbuzo 7: Eziphumelelayo, yiziphi izindlela ezitholakalayo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Ukuze imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ithuthuke, kunendlela ezahlukene ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle, izinsiza, imishini, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kudlala indima enkulu.
Umbuzo 7: Eziphumelelayo, yiziphi izindlela ezitholakalayo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Ukuze imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ithuthuke, kunendlela ezahlukene ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle, izinsiza, imishini, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kudlala indima enkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe kudinga ukuhlela imicimbi engaguquki, ukuze kuqhakambiswe ubuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 8: Kungani imidlalo iyinto eqhubekayo ewusizo emphakathini? Imidlalo imvakasha njengendlela yokuhlonipha, ukubambisana, kanye nokucija imidlalo. Imidlalo ikhulisa ukuzethemba, ibaluleka empilweni, futhi igqugquzela abantu abaningi. Lokhu kwenza abantu babonakale behlangene, banelisa, futhi behlanganyela ngemikhuba emisha nezindlela zokuphuza. Umbuzo 9: Kanti, kise nzima ukuthola uxhaso lwemali ezimweni eziningi? Yebo, uthola uxhaso lwezimali kube yinkinga eziningi imidlalo. Lokhu kuncika ekutheni izizinda zenza kanjani nezizathu zokuthola uxhaso. Abaningi bathola izindlela zokuxhasa imidlalo, bese besiza imiphakathi ihthe zuza kumathuba amasha. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani, ubumba, kanye neziqondiso eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 10: Imuphi umphumela omubi ongawathola emidlalweni? Ngokudlula kwabanye, imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ingathola ubungozi bezokuphepha, ukuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlonipha. Lokhu kungase kubangele ukungabi nempumelelo emiqhudelwaneni futhi kuthinte izinkolelo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukugwema lokhu ngokuhlela kahle imicimbi nezindlela zokuvikela, ukuze ukuziphatha kuhlonishwe.
Ngokudlula kwabanye, imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ingathola ubungozi bezokuphepha, ukuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlonipha. Lokhu kungase kubangele ukungabi nempumelelo emiqhudelwaneni futhi kuthinte izinkolelo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukugwema lokhu ngokuhlela kahle imicimbi nezindlela zokuvikela, ukuze ukuziphatha kuhlonishwe. Ukwakha imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe akusitshali kuphela ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwana; kudala futhi ithuba lokuthi sabone ukuthi imidlalo iyisithombe esidala sokubumbana nokuhlonipha. Imidlalo ingaba umthombo onamandla wokuhola izifundo ezinqabile zokuphila, obonisa ukuthi noma ngabe sitholakala kuphi emhlabeni, kunomoya wokubambisana okhula njalo, okuyinto eveza amandla ethu njengezizwe ezihlangene.
Iphasi lemvume yokuthatha umhlalaphansi linikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukuthatha umhlalaphansi eNingizimu Afrika. Nikeza ubufakazi bokuthi unengeniso engaphezulu kuka-R25,000 ngenyanga evela emalini yokuthatha umhlalaphansi noma emalini yokuthatha umhlalaphansi engabuyiswanga, noma ezimpahleni ezingaphansi kuka-R15 million. Uma ufuna ukusebenza, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi akekho umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ongakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yendawo ofaka kuyo isicelo. Nikeza inkontileka yokusebenza evela enkampanini ozosebenza kuyo enemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana naleyo nhlangano. Isethaphu yokuvakasha yokugomela umkhuhlane wombala ophuzi iyadingeka uma uhamba noma uhlose ukuhamba endaweni eyaziwa ngokuba nomkhuhlane wombala ophuzi. Lesi sitifiketi asidingeki uma uhamba, noma uhlose ukuhamba kule ndawo, noma uma isicelo senziwa eNingizimu Afrika. Khokha idiphozi. Le diphozi ngeke ibuyiselwe kumfaki-sicelo ngemuva kokuhamba noma ngemuva kokukhishwa kwemvume yakho. Idiphozi ingakhokhwa ngekhadi lesikhwama eliqinisekisiwe noma ngekhadi lesikweletu ezindaweni lapho le nsiza itholakala khona. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuhlola kwezepolitiki, kanye nezincwadi zezempilo noma ama-x-ray. Akudingeki ukuthi izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-12 kanye nabesifazane abakhulelwe babe nezincwadi zama-x-ray. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.
Thina, njengabasebenzi boMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, sithole izinsiza ezahlukene zik government ezibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwethu ukuze sizibhekele. Ngokwesiqondiso seMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi, izinsiza zik government kufanele zihlale zibalwa; ngakho-ke, kufanele sisebenzise imithetho yokuphatha futhi siqinisekise izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze sigweme ukulahlekelwa okuhambisanayo. Enye yale mithetho yokuphatha wukusebenzisa imithetho yokuphepha efana nokuhlola zonke izinto zomuntu ezithwalwa ngesandla, izimoto, noma izinto ezithwalwayo. Umthetho Wokufinyelela Ezindaweni Zomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wezimoto, No. 53 ka-1985, unikeza abasebenzi bezokuphepha amandla okwenza ezinye izenzo ngokuhambisana neSigaba 2 soMthetho Wezimoto ka-1985 (njengokwenza ukuhlola, ukuvimbela ukungena noma ukuphuma, njll.). [Uceliwe ukuthi uhlole izaziso ezikhangisiwe ezindaweni zethu]. Kuyiqiniso futhi ukuthi le ndlela yokuphepha ingaba nzima kubasebenzisi ukuba babe nesipiliyoni esihle. Ukufika kule ndawo kudinga ukubambisana nokuqonda kubasebenzi. Uyanxuswa ukuba uzizwe ukhululekile ukuxhumana noMnu. Van Rooyen uma kukhona okungacacile mayelana nemithetho yethu yokuphepha nezinhlelo.
Ishadi lokungenisa lemidlalosemhlabeni elitholakala ezweni lidingeka lapho kuhanjiswa iziphuzo ezine-alcohol eNingizimu Afrika. Ishadi lokungenisa noma ikhophi yalo kuzodingeka ngaphambi kokuthi umthwalo ukhululwe epulazini lokungena. Umthengisi kufanele afake isicelo se-shadi lokungenisa lempahla. Ngemuva kwalokho, ishadi lokungenisa lingasetshenziswa, uma kungabikho shintsho ekwakhiweni, ngaphakathi, usayizi wephetshana, kanye nelebuli yaleyo mveliso. Lihloselwe ukusetshenziswa komuntu siqu kulowo muntu, umndeni wabo, kanye nezivakashi zabo ezingathengi leyo alcohol. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo. Isicelo esisodwa kufanele sibe ne-sampuli ye-750ml yomkhiqizo okukhuluma ngawo. Uma kukhulunywa ngokungeniswa kwamabhodlela, kufanele uthumele isampuli ebhodleleni elinlebhuli, njengoba ithengiswa. Thumela isampuli ye-alcohol engenisiwe ebhodleleni ejwayelekile ye-750ml. Thumela isampuli ehhovisi leMikhiqizo yeziqhamo eStellenbosch. Thumela isitifiketi sokuhlaziywa esikhishwe yelabhorethri esemthethweni yaleso sizwe esitholakala khona i-alcohol. Uma lokhu kungatholakali, iMikhiqizo yeziqhamo izokwenza ukuhlaziywa kwekhemikhali ngesampuli. Mayelana ne-alcohol engenisiwe emabhodlelweni, ilebuli yebhodlela izohlolwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ihambisana nezidingo zomthetho weziqhamo, iMthetho weMikhiqizo yeziqhamo, 1989. Ngokungeniswa okukhulu, umkhiqizo ofikayo uzohlolwa. Ilebuli ibhekwa uma ufaka isicelo sesitifiketi sokuthengisa. Umnyango kufanele ukhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi bakhiphe ishadi lokungenisa ezweni.
Ngokungeniswa okukhulu, umkhiqizo ofikayo uzohlolwa. Ilebuli ibhekwa uma ufaka isicelo sesitifiketi sokuthengisa. Umnyango kufanele ukhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi bakhiphe ishadi lokungenisa ezweni. Ishadi lokungenisa lizokhishwa uma ngaphakathi kanye nelebuli, mayelana nokungeniswa kwamabhodlela, kanye ngaphakathi, uma kukhulunywa ngokungeniswa okukhulu, kuhambisana nezidingo zeMthetho weMikhiqizo yeziqhamo, 1989. Umthwalo wemikhiqizo ungangeniswa. I-Division Quality Audit kufanele ixwayiswe amahora angama-48 noma nini uma umthwalo oneshadi elikhiphayo ufikiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Lapho i-alcohol ifika eNingizimu Afrika, abangenisi kufanele bathole iphasela kwi-Division Quality Audit ukuze bakhiphe i-alcohol epulazini eyangena, noma esikhungweni, ukuya lapho befisa ukuyithatha. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevice.
Ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kubalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi njengoba umnotho wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo. Ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukuthola izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kubalulekile ukuhlanganiswa kahle kweminikelo yomqashi. Lokhu akuhlinzeki kuphela ngempilo, kodwa futhi kudala umphakathi onempilo. Ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi kudinga ukucabangela izici eziningi. Okokuqala, iminikelo yomqashi ibalulekile empilweni yabantu. Abasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi iminikelo yabo ihlanganiswa ngendlela efanele ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni abazidingayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi, abaqashi, nezisebenzi. Uma lezi zingxenye zingahlangani kahle, kungaholela ekutheni abasebenzi bangatholi izinsiza abazidingayo, okungathinta impilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuyiqiniso. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo kungasiza ukwenza le nqubo ibe lula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukugcina, nokuhlaziya imininingwane yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza futhi ekuhlinzekeni ngemininingwane kubasebenzi, ukuze bazi kahle indlela iminikelo yabo esebenza ngayo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngobuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ukuze le nqubo isebenze kahle, abaqashi kufanele baqonde izidingo zabasebenzi.
Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngobuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ukuze le nqubo isebenze kahle, abaqashi kufanele baqonde izidingo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuvulekile, lapho abasebenzi bezwakalisa khona izinkinga zabo, kanti abaphathi benza konke okusemandleni ukusiza. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okuzoholela ekwanelisekeni okuphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi kudinga ukucabangela izimo zomphakathi. Abasebenzi abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bangase babe nezidingo ezihlukile, futhi abaphathi kufanele bahlale beqaphele lezi zimo. Ukuze kube nokuhlanganiswa okuhle, abaqashi kufanele bazi ukuhluka kwezidingo zomphakathi, futhi baphendule ngale ndlela. Ngokuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi, sithola ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa kudala umnotho onempilo. Uma abasebenzi bezizwa beqinisekisiwe futhi bekwazi ukuthola izinsiza abazidingayo, bazoba nekhono elikhulu lokusebenza kahle, okuzoholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza. Kodwa, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi akusikho okwenziwa kalula. Kuningi okudingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo iyaphumelela, okudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nokuqonda izimo zomphakathi. Uma lezi zinto ziqinile, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bethu. Ekugcineni, ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi ku-GEMS akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo.
Kuningi okudingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo iyaphumelela, okudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nokuqonda izimo zomphakathi. Uma lezi zinto ziqinile, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bethu. Ekugcineni, ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi ku-GEMS akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho, sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi sibe nezinhloso ezicacile. Uma sikwazi ukwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu, futhi sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeni nokusebenza ndawonye ukuze sifeze lezi zifiso.
Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi Emhlabeni wethu ongenamkhawulo wezinto eziphuthumayo, ukuphendula ngokushesha nangendlela efanele kubaluleke kakhulu. Izimo eziphuthumayo, njengokulimala kwabantu, izingozi zomgwaqo, noma izimo zokuphuthuma kwezempilo, zidinga ukuxhaswa okuphuthumayo. Kulokhu, izimoto eziningi ziba yinsiza ebalulekile, kodwa zikhona izinselelo ezihambisana nalokhu. Ngalesi sihloko, ngizobe ngihlola ukuthi izimoto eziningi zingasiza kanjani ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izimoto eziningi zikhona ukuze ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimoto zokuphuthumayo, ezokwelapha, nezokuthutha. Uma kwenzeka ingozi, izimoto eziningi zingathola indlela yokufika endaweni yengozi ngokushesha, ziqinisekisa ukuthi usizo lufika ngesikhathi. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zingase zenzeke ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi izimoto eziningi zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezimoto eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto eziningi zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo. Izinsizakalo zezokwelapha zidinga ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezithile ngokushesha, futhi izimoto eziningi zingasiza ekuthumeleni odokotela, izinyanga, nezisebenzi zezempilo endaweni ethile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezimo eziphuthumayo, lapho isikhathi singenza umehluko phakathi kokuphila nokufa. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle lapho sikhuluma ngezimoto eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezihambisana nokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngale ndlela, ukuhamba komgwaqo.
Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezimo eziphuthumayo, lapho isikhathi singenza umehluko phakathi kokuphila nokufa. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle lapho sikhuluma ngezimoto eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezihambisana nokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngale ndlela, ukuhamba komgwaqo. Emadolobheni, ukugxila kwezimoto kungaba yinkinga enkulu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izimoto eziningi zibe nzima ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezidinga usizo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma izimoto eziningi ziqhubele phambili, lokhu kungadala ukucindezeleka, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola indlela yokuphuma. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto eziningi zidinga ukuba zibe nezinsiza ezithile ukuze zisebenze kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abashayeli abaqeqeshiwe, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokuphendula. Uma lezi zinto zingekho, izimoto eziningi zingase zibe nzima ukukhiqiza umphumela owufunayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza, ukuze izimoto eziningi zikwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ukwengeza, izimoto eziningi zidinga ukuba neziqinisekiso zokuphepha. Izimo eziphuthumayo zihlala zinezingozi, futhi abashayeli kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi baphila ngokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abashayeli bengaqinisekile, kungaholela ezingozeni ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezibhekelela izimoto eziningi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abashayeli baphila ngokuphepha. Ngokuphetha, izimoto eziningi zineqhaza elibalulekile ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi usizo lufika ngesikhathi, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezimo ezinzima.
Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezibhekelela izimoto eziningi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abashayeli baphila ngokuphepha. Ngokuphetha, izimoto eziningi zineqhaza elibalulekile ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi usizo lufika ngesikhathi, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Nokho, zikhona izinselelo ezihambisana nalokhu, ezifana nokuhamba komgwaqo, izinsiza ezidingekayo, kanye nezinsiza zokuphepha. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde lezi zinto ukuze sikwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izimoto eziningi zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sikhuthaze izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisebenzayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, futhi sithuthukise izimo zokuphila zabantu bethu.
Abavakashi emnyangweni wezokubeletha bazovunyelwa ukufika kusukela ngo-09H00 - 10H00, emva kwalokho bazongena ngezikhathi ezichaziwe zokuvakasha. Abavakashi emnyangweni wezifo ezinzima bazovunyelwa ukufika kusukela ngo-09H00 kuze kube ngu-08H00 ebusuku, kodwa isikhathi abangahlala kuso sizokwenziwa ngabasebenzi bomnyango. Abavakashi emnyangweni wezifo ze-tuberculosis kanye nalabo abanezingqondo eziphukile bazongena ngezikhathi ezichaziwe zokuvakasha. Abathengisi abavunyelwe emhlabeni wesibhedlela. Zonke izikhungo zik government zikhishwe njengendawo lapho izivakashi zingavakashela khona, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bendawo bahloniphe le mthetho. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha azivunyelwe ukuvakashela esibhedlela. IMISEBENZI. Isibhedlela sinezinhlelo nemigomo ethinta ukukhangiswa nokuholwa kwabasebenzi. Izikhala ezitholakalayo zikhangiswa ezincwadini zendawo nezizimele, kuye ngendawo yesikhala somsebenzi. Bonke abathanda lo msebenzi kufanele bathumele izicelo zabo kule ndawo ethile. NB. Zonke izicelo kufanele zithunyelwe ngeposi njengoba kuchaziwe kukhangiso. Izicelo ezithunyelwe ngesandla azizokwenziwa. Labo abavunyelwe kuzokhishwa uhlu bazomenywa ezivivinyweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abahlangabezana nezimfuneko ezidingekayo bayaqashwa. IBHODI YESIBHEDLA. Laba ngabantu bomphakathi abaqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Bakhonza njengoxhumana phakathi kwesibhedlela nomphakathi. Banikeza izeluleko kubaphathi besibhedlela ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi kanye nezidingo ezingasiza umphakathi njengoba behlela isibhedlela.
Laba ngabantu bomphakathi abaqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Bakhonza njengoxhumana phakathi kwesibhedlela nomphakathi. Banikeza izeluleko kubaphathi besibhedlela ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi kanye nezidingo ezingasiza umphakathi njengoba behlela isibhedlela. Baphakamisa ulwazi mayelana nesibhedlela, besebenzisa izakhiwo zomphakathi, futhi besebenzisa ulwazi abaluqoqayo kubaphathi besibhedlela; njengoba ibhodi iyisakhiwo esisemthethweni esixhumana nabaphathi besibhedlela. Uma umphakathi udinga ukucaciselwa ngezindaba ezithile ezithinta isibhedlela, lesi yisakhiwo esiqondile esizokwenza izincazelo njengoba sithola iningi lolwazi lwethu emihlanganweni eyenziwa njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu nabaphathi besibhedlela... Baphinde bahlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo ngaphansi kwemigomo yombuso nezifundazwe, bephakamisa ukubambisana kwezempilo nomphakathi. Qeqesha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi. Thuthukisa, uthuthukise izinga lethu, futhi uhlaziye njalo. Qinisekisa indawo ephephile kubo bonke. Igumbi lokuhlola nokweluleka kulabo abahamba ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV. Igumbi labanye amadoda. Igumbi lokugcina igazi. Omunye wemigomo nezinhlelo zomnyango wezempilo ukubring izinsizakalo zezempilo zibe seduze nomphakathi. Lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi uhulumeni uqeqeshe odokotela abahlinzeka ezikhungweni, ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga zezempilo ezilethwa abantu ezikhungweni; ikakhulukazi njengoba inqubo yamanje ibalula ukuthi umuntu kufanele aqale aye ezikhungweni ngaphambi kokuthi aye esibhedlela. Umdokotela osezikhungweni ngu-oyokhombisa umuntu esibhedlela uma ebona ukuthi udinga usizo oluphuthumayo.
Omunye wemigomo nezinhlelo zomnyango wezempilo ukubring izinsizakalo zezempilo zibe seduze nomphakathi. Lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi uhulumeni uqeqeshe odokotela abahlinzeka ezikhungweni, ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga zezempilo ezilethwa abantu ezikhungweni; ikakhulukazi njengoba inqubo yamanje ibalula ukuthi umuntu kufanele aqale aye ezikhungweni ngaphambi kokuthi aye esibhedlela. Umdokotela osezikhungweni ngu-oyokhombisa umuntu esibhedlela uma ebona ukuthi udinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Umthengi ukhumbuleka ukuthi kufanele anikeze incwadi yokudluliselwa evela ezikhungweni ezimthumelayo esibhedlela. Izimo eziphuthumayo azifakiwe kulolu hlelo; ngaphandle kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele usebenzise izikhungo njengoba ziseduze futhi insizakalo iyamahhala. Izincwadi zokudluliselwa uma uya esibhedlela 2..1. Abathola umhlalaphansi. Labo abangenamsebenzi kodwa baye basebenza ngaphambili kufanele bathwale iphasela kanye nebhukwana eliluhlaza. Labo abangenamsebenzi futhi abanasibhamu esiluhlaza kufanele bathwale amaphasela bese besayina isiqinisekiso ehhovisi lababhalisi noma ehhovisi lamaphoyisa ukuze bathole usizo. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha kufanele zibe namakhadi ezinqubomgomo. Uma usufika esibhedlela.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni: Isimo Esididayo Ezweni Lethu Isingeniso Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi eNingizimu Afrika, enezinhlobonhlobo zemiphumela emphakathini nasemnotho. Kulolu cwaningo, sizobheka umlando, izimbangela, izimpawu, nemiphumela yenkohlakalo kuhulumeni, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo zokulwa nalolu hlobo lwesimo. Umlando Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni eNingizimu Afrika ayisiyona into entsha. Ibangelwa yizimo zomlando ezahlukene, okubandakanya ubuhlanga, ukuhwebelana kwemali, kanye nokungabi nezinqubomgomo ezinamandla. Ngemuva kokuthola ukuzimela ngo-1994, ubuholi bokuqala babhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu zokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isithombe sibe sibi ngenxa yokungathembeki kwabaphathi. Izimbangela Zenkohlakalo Izimbangela zenkohlakalo ziningi futhi zihluke. Okokuqala, izikhala ezivumela ukuziphatha kabi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Imihola ephakeme, ukuntuleka kokubekwa kwentela, kanye nezinsongo zokungabi nezimo ezihle, kudala amathuba okwenza okungafanele. Okwesibili, ukungabikho kokubeka obala nokuqapha kwemisebenzi yomphakathi kuholela ekubeni kube lula ukwenza inkohlakalo. Izimpawu Zenkohlakalo Izimpawu zenkohlakalo kuhulumeni zibonakala ezindleleni eziningi. Isibonelo, ukusungulwa kwezinkampani zomphakathi ezithola izinkontileka ezinkulu, noma ukungena ezikhungweni ezizimele ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ezithinta izinjongo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye baphathe amaholo aphezulu ngokubambisana nezinyunyana, kanti abanye abantu bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Izimpawu zingabonakaliswa nasekuthathweni kwezinyathelo ezingafanele, lapho abanye bephatha izinqumo ngendlela engalungile.
Isibonelo, ukusungulwa kwezinkampani zomphakathi ezithola izinkontileka ezinkulu, noma ukungena ezikhungweni ezizimele ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ezithinta izinjongo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye baphathe amaholo aphezulu ngokubambisana nezinyunyana, kanti abanye abantu bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Izimpawu zingabonakaliswa nasekuthathweni kwezinyathelo ezingafanele, lapho abanye bephatha izinqumo ngendlela engalungile. Imiphumela Yenkohlakalo Imiphumela yenkohlakalo kuhulumeni ibonakala ekuthuthukisweni kwezobuchwepheshe, emnotweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Ukwanda kwenkohlakalo kuholela ekuncipheni kokufaka imali ezweni, okubangela umphakathi uthole imiphumela engalindelekile. Lokhu kubangela ukudumazeka phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaholi bembula ukuthi izinqumo zabo zenzelwe izinzuzo zabo kuphela. Ukuqashwa okuphakeme nokunganelisekile kuholela ekubeni abantu bacabange kabusha ngezinto abazifunayo empilweni. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nenkohlakalo Ukuze sihlule inkohlakalo, kudingeka izinyathelo ezicacile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezisekela ukuphepha komphakathi zikhona, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokubika, kanye nokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokulwa nenkohlakalo kubalulekile. Uhlelo lokuhlola izinqumo zomphakathi kanye nokubandakanya imiphakathi ezinqumweni kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ukwakha imithombo enomthelela emiphakathini kungasiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Isiphetho Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eqhubekayo eNingizimu Afrika, ethinta bonke futhi ichaphazela impilo yansuku zonke. Ukuze silwe nale nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezinqala, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuqiniswa kwemithetho ukuze sithole uhulumeni onokholo.
Ukwakha imithombo enomthelela emiphakathini kungasiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Isiphetho Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eqhubekayo eNingizimu Afrika, ethinta bonke futhi ichaphazela impilo yansuku zonke. Ukuze silwe nale nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezinqala, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuqiniswa kwemithetho ukuze sithole uhulumeni onokholo. Ngalendlela, singakha izifunda ezinzima ezisiza bonke abantu, futhi sithuthukise ukuzethemba phakathi kwabantu. Ukuhlola impumelelo yokulwa nenkohlakalo kuzobe kuhlale kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi uzithokozise empilweni yabo.
Imicimbi yokuphepha nemisebenzi ye-ofisi... Ukucubungula kwezezimali ngaphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamasiko. I-ofisi ephethe ukudalwa kwezimpawu. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhlanganiswa kwamasiko, isayensi, nobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni, inhlalakahle yomphakathi ekuphakamiseni ubunikazi nasekuphakamiseni amanani ahlukahlukene ezwe lethu. Emculweni, ifa lesiko, kanye namagugu, ngokuhlonipha ukuhlukahluka, nokuxhasa izinhlelo zezimali. Ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ezweni lethu njengendlela yokuphakamisa wonke umZulu ukuba abe nengxenye empilweni yokuxhumana, yezepolitiki, nezomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa okulinganiselwe ukuze kugcinwe, kugcinwe, kuvikelwe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando wethu, izimpawu zethu zenkululeko, ifa, namagugu kuyavunywa. Ukubheka emuva konyaka odlule, kube nempumelelo ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe ngomhla we-DACST. Ulwazi lwasekhaya/nolwakho olunye lungaba umthombo wokukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona ingozi yokuthi lolu lwazi lungasetshenziswa ngamasu angaphandle angabheki ulwazi lomphakathi njengolwakhe. I-ethnomedicine ne-ethnopharmacology iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo, ezilwane, kanye nefa lesiko nokuhlonipha izinkampani, imvelo yokudla kwezitshalo, indlela amasiko aphathwa ngayo, kanye nokwakhiwa/ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezithile. Kukhona imithombo yokuxhasa ucwaningo lwezokwazi imvelo nezinsiza ezibekwe ngaphansi kwe-Human Research Council ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuvikelwe ulwazi lwasekhaya/nolwakho. Isitifiketi sokuhlola kwezepolitiki esiqinisekisa ukuthi ummangali akanacala lobugebengu ezweni abahlala kulo isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Incwadi kadokotela njengobufakazi bokuthi ummangali uphilile kahle. Abammangali ngeke bakwazi ukungena eNingizimu Afrika kuze kube izicelo zabo zamukelwe. Abammangali abamukelwe bazonikezwa i-visa evumela ukuba bangene futhi baphume ezweni nge-visa yokungena kabusha kaningi. Abancane kufanele banikeze imininingwane yomuntu ongumZulu waseNingizimu Afrika ozoba ngumgibeli. Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwabavoti Nentando Yeningi Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kubalulekile ekwakheni intando yeningi, okuyisimo lapho izinqumo zomphakathi zithathwa ngokuvota. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi izwi labantu lisizwa, futhi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izifiso nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti akukhona nje kuphela umthetho, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke. Ngokwesiko, intando yeningi ibonakala njengendlela yokuphatha lapho abantu benza izinqumo ezibalulekile ngokuvota. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukhetho lwezikhulu, izinqumo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ukuze kube nentando yeningi eqinile, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babe neqhaza elikhulu ekubhekaneni nezindaba zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bazi kahle amalungelo abo, futhi baqonde ukuthi ukuvota kwabo kunomthelela omkhulu. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kuhilela izici eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukufundiswa, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuhlanganyela. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvota, kudingeka ukuthi bazi kahle izinketho zabo, izikhumbuzo, nezinhlelo ezithinta izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kudinga imizamo yokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinhlelo zohlelo lokhetho, izinqumo ezithathwayo, kanye nezizathu zokuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuvota. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zokufundisa ezizokhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabavoti nabaholi bempilo yomphakathi kubalulekile. Abaholi kumele bahlale bexhumana nabavoti, bephendula imibuzo yabo, futhi bechaza izinqumo ezithathwayo.
Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zokufundisa ezizokhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabavoti nabaholi bempilo yomphakathi kubalulekile. Abaholi kumele bahlale bexhumana nabavoti, bephendula imibuzo yabo, futhi bechaza izinqumo ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bazizwe behlanganyela, futhi bazizwe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izifiso zabo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakhuthazwe ukuba bavote, futhi bazizwe bebalulekile ekwakheni intando yeningi. Ukwengeza, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti akupheli kuphela ekukhetheni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ezindabeni zomphakathi ngemuva kokhetho. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlela imihlangano, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bahlale bexhumene nezindaba zomphakathi, futhi bazizwe bebalulekile ekwakheni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngokubheka izinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kunezithiyo eziningi ezivimbela abantu ekubambeni iqhaza. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukungabi nolwazi, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kudingeka imizamo eqhubekayo yokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuvota. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, ukwakha izikhungo zokuvota ezikahle, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ekugcineni, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kudingeka imizamo eqhubekayo yokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuvota. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, ukwakha izikhungo zokuvota ezikahle, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ekugcineni, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu babe neqhaza elikhulu, bazi kahle amalungelo abo, futhi bahlale bexhumene nezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka imizamo eqhubekayo yokufundisa, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuhlanganyela. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha intando yeningi eqinile, lapho izwi labantu lisizwa, futhi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izifiso nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube namandla, ube neqhaza, futhi ube nempilo engcono.
Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal Isifo sofuba, esaziwa nangokuthi i-tuberculosis (TB), singenye yezifo ezibulalayo ezivame kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kubangelwa yizinto eziningi ezifana nezindawo zokuhlala ezivulekile nezingcolile, ukungena kwezinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokushoda kwemisebenzi. Ukuze kuqedwe lokhu, uhulumeni waseKwaZulu-Natal, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele, bahlele izinhlelo ezahlukene zokulwa nesifo sofuba. Okokuqala, imfundo iyinsika ebalulekile ekulweni nesifo sofuba. Izinhlelo zokuqwashisa umphakathi ziqhutshelwa phambili ngendlela yokwazisa abantu ngezimbangela, izimpawu, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela lesi sifo. Iminyaka edlule ibonise ukuthi uma umphakathi unolwazi olwaneleyo, kubalulekile ekwenzeni kube nokuncipha kokushaqeka kwemiphumela yesifo. Uhlelo olukhona luhlanganisa ukudlulisela ulwazi ezinkampanini, ezikoleni, nasezikhungweni zokwelashwa, okwenza abantu bakwazi ukuhlonipha izizathu zokuvakasha kumaphoyisa wezempilo. Okwesibili, kwesinye sezinyathelo ezibalulekile, uhulumeni uhlela uhlelo lwezokwelapha oluhlanganisa ukwelashwa kumahhala kwabo bonke abathola isifo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba isifo sofuba sithinta ikakhulukazi abantu abahlala ezindleleni eziphansi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kumaphayiphi emithi yamahhala eluthathwa khona, okusiza ukubuyisela amandla kwabaphila nesifo lokhu, okwenza kube lula ukubagqokisa abathola usizo. Uhlaka lokuxhaswa kwezemiti lubuyekezwa njalo emihlanganweni yakhe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izinga lokulashwa lisebenze kahle.
Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba isifo sofuba sithinta ikakhulukazi abantu abahlala ezindleleni eziphansi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kumaphayiphi emithi yamahhala eluthathwa khona, okusiza ukubuyisela amandla kwabaphila nesifo lokhu, okwenza kube lula ukubagqokisa abathola usizo. Uhlaka lokuxhaswa kwezemiti lubuyekezwa njalo emihlanganweni yakhe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izinga lokulashwa lisebenze kahle. Ukusetshenziswa kwemithi esemthethweni, ngokuhambisana nemigomo esebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abanesifo sofuba bathola usizo olwanele. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ukugqugquzela ukuhlolwa okuvamile kwempilo kubalulekile. Ukuhlolwa kwe-TB kudinga ukuba kube yinto evamile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezizinda eziphakeme zokushayelwa yilesi sifo. Uhlelo lokuhlola oluhlanganisa ukubamba izithombe zokuqagela nokuhlolwa kwe-viral liqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banikela ngeziqu zempilo zabo futhi, uma kungenjalo, bathole ukwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Uhlaka lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwehliseni izinga lokwanda kwesifo. Ukuze kulandwe empumelelweni, izikhungo zezempilo zidinga ukuxhumanisa imisebenzi yazo nemiphakathi, ngokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhuba imiphumela emihle, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukufinyelela olwazini oluthile nokwelashwa okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesoftware nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezinamathuba okubhekana nezinsiza zokwelapha kudinga ukuhlanganyela okunomsoco emazingeni ahlukeneyo, kuhlanganise noHulumeni, ozimele, nabantu basekhaya.
Ukuze kulandwe empumelelweni, izikhungo zezempilo zidinga ukuxhumanisa imisebenzi yazo nemiphakathi, ngokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhuba imiphumela emihle, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukufinyelela olwazini oluthile nokwelashwa okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesoftware nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezinamathuba okubhekana nezinsiza zokwelapha kudinga ukuhlanganyela okunomsoco emazingeni ahlukeneyo, kuhlanganise noHulumeni, ozimele, nabantu basekhaya. Ukuze uHulumeni ube nempumelelo yalesi sifo, kudinga ukuba kube kudalwe isikhala sokusebenzisana phakathi kwazo zonke izinhlangano ezibhekelele ezempilo. Okwesibili, kudinga imithombo eyengeziwe yokuxhasa abantu abane-TB, okubandakanya imithombo yezezimali yokwenza ucwaningo olujulile. Lokhu kulungisa imithombo ethize yokwenziwa kocwaningo lokwelapha kombuso, okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlela ezintsha neziphumelelayo zokwelapha ziyaqhubeka nokutholakala. Ucwaningo oluqinile luphethe amathuba amasha okuthola imithi emisha yokwelapha, okuyinto ethokozisayo ehlinzeka udaba lwempumelelo kumqondisi. Ekugcineni, ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, nezinhlaka eziphezulu zibalulekile ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zibe nomphumela omuhle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abanye abafundi, abafana nabangamaTBB, baxhaswa, kuhlinzeka umqondo wokuthi umphakathi ungalwa kanjani ne-TB ngokuhlanganyela. Yingakho ukubambisana phakathi kwezinsiza, izinsiza zemibono, kanye nezinhlelo ezisemthethweni zibalulekile ekulweni nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal.

Ukuze siphumelele kulokhu, kudinga ukugqugquzela ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwazo zonke izindima zomphakathi, kuhlanganisa izikole, izibhedlela, nabahlinzeki bendawo okubekezela okubambisene. Lezi zinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba ziyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nempilo yesizwe, sigqugquzele ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu ukuze basebenze kahle ekunciphiseni isifo. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela efanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokwelapha ziba nezinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini yaseKwaZulu-Natal, okuzokwenza kube nokwehla kwezenzakalo zomhlaba jikelele eziqhamuka nesifo sofuba.
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya: Indaba Yomlando Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi edlule, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Enye yezinguquko ezibaluleke kakhulu kube ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, okwenze izimpilo zabantu zashintsha kakhulu. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezahlukene zomlando, kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zikagesi, kuze kube sekutholakaleni kagesi emakhaya. Ekuqaleni, emakhaya amaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, abantu babebhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuntuleka kukagesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babebhekene nezindlela zendabuko zokukhanyisa, njengezibani ezisebenzisa amafutha, okwakwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokukhanya. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale besebenzisa izindlela ezithile zokuphila, ezazivame ukuba nzima futhi zidinga isikhathi esiningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, eminyakeni yama-1900, izinkampani zokuqala zikagesi zaqala ukuvela, ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, kodwa kwaba nezithiyo eziningi. Izindleko zokufaka ugesi emakhaya zaziphezulu, futhi abantu abaningi babengenakukwazi ukukhokhela lezi zindleko. Ngaleso sikhathi, ugesi wawungatholakali kalula, futhi abantu abaningi babengakaze bakwazi ukuwusebenzisa. Ngemva kweminyaka ethile, uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezihlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zikagesi zathuthukiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezindaweni ezikude.

Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba kwavula amathuba amasha emikhakheni ehlukene, njengokuhweba, ezemfundo, nezokwelapha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Abantu baqala ukusebenzisa ugesi ukuze bakhe izindawo zokuhlala ezinhle, futhi izimpilo zabo zashintsha kakhulu. Izibani zikagesi zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinto eziningi ezisebenzisa ugesi, njengezinto zokupheka, izinsiza zokuhlala, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokutholakala kwemisebenzi, njengoba abantu beqala ukwakha amabhizinisi amancane asebenzisa ugesi. Nokho, nakuba ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kwaba nezinzuzo eziningi, kwavela nezinselelo. Izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zashintsha, futhi abantu abaninzi babebhekene nezinkinga zokukhokha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokunciphisa lezi zindleko, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kagesi kalula. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zathuthukiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezindaweni ezikude. Namuhla, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya sekuyinto ejwayelekile, futhi abantu abaningi baphila impilo engcono ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile ngokuba negesi emakhaya.

Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa ugesi ukuze bathuthukise izimpilo zabo. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akukona nje kuphela ukwakha izindawo ezinhle, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ugesi ube yinsika yokuthuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izimpilo ezinhle ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kube yisinyathelo esikhulu sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ngakho-ke, le ndaba yokutholakala kukagesi emakhaya ibalulekile, njengoba ibonisa indlela abantu abashintshile ngayo impilo yabo ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Ugesi ube yinsika yokuthuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokwakha izimpilo ezinhle, bejabulile ngokuba negesi emakhaya. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kube yisinyathelo esikhulu sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Izwe lethu libhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezithinta imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihlobene ne-GEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme). Lezi zinhlinzeko zenzelwe ukuvikela izinsizakalo zempilo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zigcizelela izindinganiso ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS iwuhlelo olwakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zisebenza kahle, imikhawulo ethile ibekwe ukuze igweme ukusetshenziswa okungafanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvikela izinsiza zokwelapha ezibhekelele izidingo zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kanti kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzisi bayawuqonda umthetho ophathelene nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo. Okwesibili, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibandakanya izinqubomgomo ezithile ezikhomba indlela izinsizakalo zempilo ezisetshenziswa ngayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izivumelwano zokusebenza ezithinta izinsizakalo ezithile, njengezokwelapha, izivivinyo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zingase zingatholakali uma zisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemigomo ethile, okungaholela ezinkingeni zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imikhawulo ibalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lempilo kubasebenzisi. I-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zingase zingatholakali uma zisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemigomo ethile, okungaholela ezinkingeni zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imikhawulo ibalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lempilo kubasebenzisi. I-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukungena ezinsizakalweni zempilo ngaphandle kokuhlonza izidingo zomsebenzisi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, okungaholela ekutheni izinsizakalo zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibalulekile ekugcineni ukwethembeka kwenhlangano. Uma izinsizakalo zisetshenziswa ngendlela engafanele, lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zokuphatha, okungase kubangele ukungathembeki phakathi kwe-GEMS nabasebenzisi bayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhawulo iyagcinwa, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zihlala zisebenza. Kubahlali, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ayigcini nje ngokuvikela izinsizakalo, kodwa iphinde ibaluleke ekwakheni umqondo wokuziphatha phakathi kwabantu. Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo ngendlela engafanele kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okuhle nokuhlonipha imithetho. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, imikhawulo kufanele ifundiswe kubasebenzisi, ukuze baqonde kahle izinzuzo nezingozi zokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo.

Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo ngendlela engafanele kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okuhle nokuhlonipha imithetho. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, imikhawulo kufanele ifundiswe kubasebenzisi, ukuze baqonde kahle izinzuzo nezingozi zokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi i-GEMS idlala indima ebalulekile ekuphatheni lezi zinsizakalo. Ukuze lezi zinsizakalo zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola, izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisa ukuqonda kwabantu. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuvikela izinsizakalo zempilo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo, ngale ndlela sithuthukisa izinga lempilo kubantu bonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzisi be-GEMS baqonde imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zempilo, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile futhi ezivumelekile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, oqinile, nolwazi, futhi okwazi ukuvikela izinsizakalo zempilo kubo bonke abasebenzisi.
Amaqembu Ebhola AseNingizimu Afrika: Umfanekiso Wokukhula Nokwazisa EBhola, impilo yamaAfrikaans, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, iyinsika ebalulekile yamasiko nezenhlalakahle. Amaqembu ebhola anjengomlingani, akhulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela nokwazisa okuvelayo phakathi kwabantu, okuhambisana nemisebenzi eminingi yombono wezenhlalo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngamaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela abathinteka ngayo empilweni nasemiphakathini. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukujula kuhlelo lwamasiko olwakhiwe yile midlalwano. Amaqembu afana neKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns awaze wathela ithoni ehluke kakhulu emhlabeni wethu. Lokhu akuhlangene nje nokuthokozisa, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa, izifundo zempilo, kanye nezikhuthazo zokuziphatha kahle emiphakathini. AmaChiefs nePirates awangama ‘derbies’ akhangayo, akhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, bejabulisa izinkulungwane ezibukele emidlalweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sihlangabezana nokukhula nokuguquka kwezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika. I-South African Premier Soccer League (PSL) iyinsika yalo mkhakha, igcwalisa izinkanyezi eziningi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Akusikho ukuhamba phambili kuphela kwezikhwama zemali, kodwa futhi nakuqala kokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe obusetshenziswa emidlalweni. Njengoba imiphakathi ihamba phambili, amaqembu abona izinselelo zabo ezithile, efaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, nokugcina abasebenzisi bawo benelisekile. Lokhu kwenza kube sobala ukuthi izinkolelo eziwumgogodla wokulwa nezinkinga zempilo yesikhumbuzo njalo zikhona.
