Imithetho nemigomo yesikhwama se-GEMS (GEMS scheme rules and regulations) Isikhwama se-GEMS, esimele i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, siwumsebenzi obalulekile emiphakathini yethu, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Njengoba sithokozisa izinzuzo ezihlinzekwa yilesi sikhwama, kubalulekile ukuqonda imithetho nemigomo ehambisana naso, ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza. Isingeniso Ukuba yilungu le-GEMS kuwukhetho oluhle kakhulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, njengoba luhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Nokho, ukuze sithole lezi zinsiza, kufanele siqonde kahle imithetho nemigomo ehambisana nesikhwama. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokubhalisela ukujoyina, izinzuzo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimo ezithinta ukwamukelwa kwezicelo zokwelashwa. Ukubhalisela ukujoyina Ukuze ujoyine i-GEMS, umsebenzisi kufanele ahlangabezane nezimo ezithile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuba ngumsebenzi kahulumeni, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvunywa. Imithetho ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ibeka izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ahlangabezana nezidingo ezithile. Ukuze ube yilungu, kufanele uqedele ifomu lokubhalisela, ulethe nemininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu, kanye nemininingwane yezezimali ethile. Izinzuzo ezitholakalayo I-GEMS inikeza izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinsizakalo zempilo, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zezokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Imithetho nemigomo ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ichaza ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kumalungu, kanye nemikhawulo ethile.
Ukuze ube yilungu, kufanele uqedele ifomu lokubhalisela, ulethe nemininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu, kanye nemininingwane yezezimali ethile. Izinzuzo ezitholakalayo I-GEMS inikeza izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinsizakalo zempilo, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zezokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Imithetho nemigomo ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ichaza ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kumalungu, kanye nemikhawulo ethile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukuhlela kahle izindleko zempilo zabo, futhi akwazi ukujwayela izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Izimo zokwamukelwa kwezicelo Uma umsebenzisi efuna ukwamukela izinsizakalo, kufanele aqonde kahle izimo ezithinta ukwamukelwa kwezicelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngamadokhumenti adingekayo, kanye nemikhawulo ethile yokwelashwa. Imithetho ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ibeka izimiso ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izicelo zihlolwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu awatholi izinsizakalo ezithile ngaphandle kokuhambisana nemigomo ebekiwe. Ukuphathwa kwezimali I-GEMS ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali, futhi imithetho nemigomo ibalulekile lapha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yezezimali, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukuqonda kahle lezi zimo kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuhlela izindleko zabo zempilo, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi awatholi izinsiza ezingekho emthethweni. Izinkinga nezixazululo Njengoba sithokozisa izinzuzo ze-GEMS, kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda izinkinga ezingavela.
Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yezezimali, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukuqonda kahle lezi zimo kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuhlela izindleko zabo zempilo, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi awatholi izinsiza ezingekho emthethweni. Izinkinga nezixazululo Njengoba sithokozisa izinzuzo ze-GEMS, kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda izinkinga ezingavela. Imithetho nemigomo ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ibeka izinqubo ezidingekayo zokubika izinkinga, kanye nezindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu anelungelo lokubika izinkinga zabo, futhi athole usizo oludingekayo. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezihlinzekwa yalesi sikhwama. Ukuqonda kahle lezi zimo kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi sithole izinsizakalo eziphusile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke amalungu aqonde imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS, ukuze bakwazi ukujabulisa izinzuzo ezihlinzekwa yilesi sikhwama. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS izoba yisisekelo sokuphila okukhululekile nokunempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokufunda nokuhlola lezi zimo ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa kahle izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo.
Ukubhujiswa Kwenziwa Ngenxa Yezimayini Ngiyanibingelela, ngithanda ukucacisa ngendaba ebalulekile ethinta impilo yethu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo zihlala khona. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izimayini zineziphumo ezinzima emvelweni? Lokhu akukhona okungaqondakali, kodwa kuyinto esiyibona nsuku zonke. Masikhulume ngalezi zimayini. Ziyindawo lapho kudingeka khona izinsiza eziningi ukuze kuqhubeke imisebenzi yokumba, okwakha izinkinga ezinkulu zemvelo. Lokhu kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemvelo, okuvulela indlela yokubhubhisa izitshalo nezilwane. Uma umhlaba uthinteka, izitshalo ziningi ziya phezulu, kanti izilwane zihlala zikhathazekile. Ucabanga kanjani uma izimayini ziqala? Umhlaba ushintsha ngendlela engalindelekile. Izingadi zethu, izindawo ezijabulisayo, zonke ziye phansi. Lokhu akukhona nje ukubhujiswa, kodwa kudala izinkinga zempilo ezinzima. Abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo ezinezimayini bahlupheka kakhulu. Uhlanga lwezempilo lungaphazamiseka, futhi imiphumela ingaba yingozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngamanzi. Izimayini zikhona ezindaweni eziningi ezinamachibi, imifula, nezindawo zokugcina amanzi. Lapho kudingeka ukumba, amanzi angase aphazamiseke, okwenza kube nzima kubantu nabanye abahlala kulezi zindawo. Ucabanga ukuthi kuzoba kanjani uma amanzi engatholakali? Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomoya omncane. Njengoba izimo zokusebenza zikhula, izimayini zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenzise izindlela eziphusile, kodwa akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi lezi zindlela zinezinselelo. Abanye abanikazi bezimayini bazama ukwenza kahle, kodwa abanye bahlala bejolise kuphela emalini.
Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomoya omncane. Njengoba izimo zokusebenza zikhula, izimayini zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenzise izindlela eziphusile, kodwa akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi lezi zindlela zinezinselelo. Abanye abanikazi bezimayini bazama ukwenza kahle, kodwa abanye bahlala bejolise kuphela emalini. Lokhu kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwabantu, izimayini, nemvelo. Uma sikhuluma ngoMhlaba, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Ihlangene nezinhlobonhlobo zempilo, futhi uma ibhujiswa, sithola ukuthi sibhujiswa sonke. Uhlanga lwezinto eziphilayo luyahluka, futhi uma sikhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zonke zibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baye baqala ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Sifuna ukugcina izindawo zethu zihlanzekile, futhi imithombo yethu yamanzi icace. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imvelo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imizamo yokuvikela imvelo ibalulekile? Izinkampani ziyaqonda ukuthi uma ziqhubeka nokwenza izimayini ngaphandle kokucabangela imvelo, kuzoba nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokumba, ukuvuselela izindawo ezibhujiswe, nokwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola imiphumela yemisebenzi yezimayini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baye baqala ukwakha imiphakathi yokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi imvelo iyathinteka. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo iyingxenye yokuphila kwethu. Njengoba izimayini ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Ngabe sithanda ukuphila endaweni enempilo?
Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Ngabe sithanda ukuphila endaweni enempilo? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imvelo iyaphila. Uma sikhuluma ngezinyathelo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zonke zibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi imvelo iyakha impilo. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Ngakho, ngabe sithanda izimayini? Yebo, kodwa kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela. Ngabe uneminye imibuzo?
Ngiyavuma, le ndaba yokuhlaziywa kokusalela emuva kokwelashwa komdlavuza ingeyodwa enokuthakazelisa kakhulu. Ngicabanga ukuthi abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi kwenzekani ngemuva kokwelashwa, futhi ngiyafuna ukukwabelana ngalokhu. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngalesi simo sokwelashwa. Umdlavuza ungumkhuhlane onzima, futhi ukwelashwa kwawo kungaba nzima kakhulu. Abantu bahlala bejolise ekwelashweni, kodwa akuwona wonke umuntu obona ukuthi kukhona okuthile okuzolandela. Ngemuva kokwelashwa, abantu bahlala bephakathi kokukhathazeka, ukungabaza, nokuthi bazozizwa kanjani empilweni yabo. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi ukwelashwa komdlavuza kungashiya imiphumela eminingi emzimbeni nasemoyeni? Abantu abaningi bahlala bephinde baphinde bahlola izimpawu zabo, baphinde bacabange ukuthi umdlavuza ungabuyela kanjani. Lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu. Ngabe umngani wakho ushadile? Ucabanga ukuthi uzokwazi ukuhlala uthokozile? Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu kumuntu ongakaze abhekane nalesi simo. Ngokuphathelene nezempilo, ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala benokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo. Imithi yokwelapha isebenza, kodwa ingase ibangele imiphumela emibi. Abantu bangase bazizwe benesimo sokukhathazeka, futhi lokhu kungakhathaza impilo yabo. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala bephila kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa, kodwa abanye bahlala bezwa ubuhlungu obungapheli? Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Umdlavuza ungashiya izilonda ezinzima, futhi abantu abaningi bahlala bephila nezinye izinkinga zengqondo, njengokudangala noma ukukhathazeka. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka?
Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Umdlavuza ungashiya izilonda ezinzima, futhi abantu abaningi bahlala bephila nezinye izinkinga zengqondo, njengokudangala noma ukukhathazeka. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka? Ngoba umqondo ubonisa indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi uma umqondo ungenankinga, impilo iphindaphindeka. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bathole usizo lwezengqondo ukuze baphumelele ekulweni nalokhu. Ngabe uyangithanda? Ngithanda ukucabanga ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlala bephila ngezindlela ezahlukene. Abanye abantu bangase baqonde kahle ukuthi kufanele baphile kanjani ngemuva kokwelashwa, kanti abanye bahlala bephakathi kokungaqondi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuxhaseni abantu abaphila nalokhu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imindeni ingaba nomthelela omkhulu? Imindeni iyasiza, kodwa futhi ingaba nomthwalo omkhulu. Abantu abahlala bephila nezinye izinkinga, futhi imindeni ingase ibhekane nezinkinga eziningi. Lokhu kungaba nzima, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi imindeni ibheke phambili. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi abanye abantu badinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze baphumelele? Ngabe uyazi ukuthi kunezindlela eziningi zokuthola usizo? Ukuze abantu baphile kahle, kudingeka ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo, usizo lwezengqondo, futhi bahlale bephila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu bahlala bephila ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuxhumana nabanye? Lokhu kungasiza kakhulu. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokusekela zingaba usizo? Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakala, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ngazo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa.
Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokusekela zingaba usizo? Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakala, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ngazo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa. Ucabanga ukuthi imiphakathi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuxhaseni abantu? Ngiyavuma, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye kungasiza kanjani? Uxhumano lwemindeni, abangani, nabanye abaphila nezinkinga ezifanayo lungasiza kakhulu. Lokhu kuza nomthelela omkhulu empilweni. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi abawedwa, futhi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle. Ngokuphathelene nokuphila kahle, ngicabanga ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi impilo ibalulekile. Ukudla kahle, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphila impilo enempilo kuyasiza. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izindlela zokuphila zihluke kanjani kumuntu nomuntu? Lokhu kubalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi yini ehamba kahle kubo. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukujabula? Ukuphila kahle akukhona nje ngokungabi nomdlavuza, kodwa futhi nokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukujabulisa impilo yabo. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi ukujabulisa impilo yakho kungaba yindlela yokubhekana nezinkinga? Ngokuphetha, ukuhlaziywa kokusalela emuva kokwelashwa komdlavuza kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu bahlala bephila nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi bathole usizo. Ukuxhumana, ukuxhaswa, nokuphila impilo enempilo kubalulekile. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi baphile kanjani ngemuva kokwelashwa? Ngiyavuma, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile.
Isithombe 1: I-header ejikayo emaphakathi ikhombisa inani elikhulu lokufakwa kwamanzi okwenzeka ekugcineni lapho amanzi ehla khona. Khumbula ukuthi ingaphandle kwe-header ihamba ibanga elide ngaphambi kokufika lapho iqala khona, ngakho amanzi amaningi aphonswa ekugcineni kwezimpondo. I-sprinkler yokuqala eyayikwazi ukuhamba yona ngokwayo yatholwa ngo-1948 futhi yafakwa iphethini ngo-1952 nguFrank Zybach e-Eastern Colorado e-United States of America. Lokhu kwaba isisekelo semishini yamanje enama-header ajikayo nalawo ahamba ngokuqonda. Zingafaka amanzi ngendlela elawulwayo. Zisebenza ngamandla azo ngaphandle kokudinga abantu abaningi ukuze zisebenze. Zifaka amanzi ezindaweni ezinkulu ngendlela efanele. Zingafaka amanzi ngendlela eshibhile futhi zingafaka umanyolo ohlangene namanzi ukuze izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi zikwazi ukulinywa. I-header ejikayo inama-frames namapayipi axhaswe njalo ngemitha engama-50 nge-frame ehamba ezinyaweni ezimbili. Lokhu kuqinisa i-header endaweni eqinile ngoba zonke ezinye izingxenye ezihambayo zixhunywe kule header. I-header ikakhulu yakhiwe ngophahla olukhulu oluhambisa amanzi, i-frame exhasa le pipe, kanye nemishini ehambisa konke. Ubude be-span abudingi ukuba bufane ngoba kuzodingeka bube bufushane noma bube bukhulu kuye ngesisekelo sebhakabhaka noma isimo somhlabathi. Le pipe encane enama-sprinklers iqinisiwe ngama-cables athuthukayo ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze wandise indawo efakwe amanzi. Ama-sprinklers asebenza kahle kakhulu angabekwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufakwa kahle kwamanzi ngisho nasezindaweni ezikhaleni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula imitha engama-1,000 ubude.
Le pipe encane enama-sprinklers iqinisiwe ngama-cables athuthukayo ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze wandise indawo efakwe amanzi. Ama-sprinklers asebenza kahle kakhulu angabekwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufakwa kahle kwamanzi ngisho nasezindaweni ezikhaleni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula imitha engama-1,000 ubude. Izinhlobo ezithile zamapayipi kanye nezindawo zingatholakala ngenombolo ethile yemishini. Lokhu kuyahluka uma imishini yakhiwa ngabakhiqizi abahlukene. Umkhiqizi we-header ethile uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuphakama kwe-span kumshini othile. Ukuphakama kungahluka kusuka kumitha ezi-4 kuya kumitha ezi-0.3 kumshini othile. Umshini ongahanjiswa kuphela ungathengwa uma kukhona izindawo ezahlukene emasimini lapho i-header izobekwa - lokhu kungase kwenzeke uma kukhuliswe izitshalo ezahlukene emasimini awodwa. Isimo somhlabathi nesimo sebhakabhaka - kungaba umswakama noma umhlaba owomile - kungavimbela kalula ukuhamba kwe-header. Kunenani elilinganiselwe le-span ezingahanjiswa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umgwaqo ongamitha ezi-6 udingeka ezindaweni lapho ama-header ebekwe khona. Qaphela lapho uhamba lapho kukhona izithiyo nezimbobo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-span - kukhona izinhlobo ezingathuthwa. Khulula amandla ngaphambi kokuhambisa umshini. Ukugoba kwe-header. Iziphuzo eziqinisekisiwe ezingagoba kancane zizovumela umshini ukuba uhambise ezindaweni eziphakeme ezingu-14% - 30% kokubili phansi noma phezulu.
Khulula amandla ngaphambi kokuhambisa umshini. Ukugoba kwe-header. Iziphuzo eziqinisekisiwe ezingagoba kancane zizovumela umshini ukuba uhambise ezindaweni eziphakeme ezingu-14% - 30% kokubili phansi noma phezulu. Umshini onama-header ajikayo ngaphandle kwe-header eyakhiwe ngepipi ngaphakathi kwendawo yokufakelwa amanzi angafinyelela ku-360°, kodwa angavinjwa ezindaweni ezincane hhayi emjikelezweni wonke. Ungafaka amanzi ku-80-90% wendawo yebhakabhaka. Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi u-75% wezitshalo ukhula engxenyeni yangaphandle yomjikelezo, kanti ingxenye yangaphakathi yomjikelezo (50%) inezitshalo ezingu-25% zendawo yonke. Iconsume amanzi, amandla (ugesi), kanye nemali. Abakhiqizi abafaka amanzi abahlola njalo izinga lokumunca komhlabathi bavame ukugcina amanzi namandla, bakhulise umkhiqizo, bavimbele ukuwa komhlabathi, futhi banciphise ukungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukuphathwa kahle kokufakwa kwamanzi kusho ukudala indawo lapho izitshalo zingakhula kahle, okusho ukuthi kubhekwa umhlabathi, akufanele kube umswakama kakhulu noma owomile kakhulu. Akekho omunye onolwazi olufana nolwakho ngamasimu akho, izitshalo zakho, kanye nokufakwa kwamanzi. I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokufaka amanzi ezitshalweni, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengazo zonke izinsiza. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izinto okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza nalesi sikhali. Le mishini inikeza ithuba lokufaka amanzi ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, kanye nezinye izifo, nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezithombo.
I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokufaka amanzi ezitshalweni, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengazo zonke izinsiza. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izinto okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza nalesi sikhali. Le mishini inikeza ithuba lokufaka amanzi ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, kanye nezinye izifo, nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezithombo. Le mishini ingafaka amanzi amancane njalo, kodwa lokhu kungaphindwa. Uma umlimi eqala ukufaka amanzi ngalesi sikhali, kufanele aguqule indlela yakhe yokufaka amanzi. Bangase babe used to ukufaka amanzi angu-30mm noma 50mm njalo, manje kufanele bafake leyo manzi kodwa hhayi konke ngasikhathi sinye - bangafaka leyo manzi ngokuphindaphinda noma ukuphindwe kathathu. Uma kufakwa amanzi amaningi ngasikhathi sinye, kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwamanzi futhi kwenze amawheels ahambe kanzima. Phinde ukhumbule ukuthi umlimi uphatha inani lamanzi ezimpandeni. Uma bethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukufaka amanzi, kuzoba nzima ukuvimbela umonakalo ezitshalweni. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga kulabo abalimayo abasha abafaka amanzi ngalolu hlobo ngoba abazi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze i-arm ijike futhi ifike lapho iqala khona. Ungaphuthelwa ukuhamba i-header ejikayo, izokuletha inzuzo. Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ithuba lokugcina amanzi uma ifakwe kahle. Njengazo zonke izindlela zokufaka amanzi, lapha futhi izinga lokumunca komhlabathi kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ufake amanzi kuphela uma kudingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukusindisa amanzi namandla ngenkathi izitshalo zikhula.
Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ithuba lokugcina amanzi uma ifakwe kahle. Njengazo zonke izindlela zokufaka amanzi, lapha futhi izinga lokumunca komhlabathi kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ufake amanzi kuphela uma kudingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukusindisa amanzi namandla ngenkathi izitshalo zikhula. I-header ejikayo ibiza kakhulu futhi ibekwe ngaphandle emasimini, ngakho-ke abalimayo abaningi bayakhohlwa ukuthi kunezinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa nokugcinwa njalo. Uma usebenza emshinini wakho, cabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezilandelayo. Khipha uwoyela kuzo zonke izigubhu zamagiya ezinyaweni nasezikhwameni ze-header bese ufaka uwoyela omusha. Sebenzisa uwoyela ophakanyiswa umkhiqizi womshini. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo eminyakeni emithathu uma umshini usebenza kahle. Uma umshini usebenza ngaphezu kwamahora angama-1,000 ngonyaka, ungashintsha uwoyela minyaka yonke noma eminyakeni emibili. Hlola ibhodi eliqoqayo isihlabathi futhi uhlanze uma kukhona isihlabathi. Qiniseka ukuthi umshini ume ngokuqinile phansi. Khipha amanzi wonke ku-header nakumapayipi axhunywe ku-header. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi uma umshini uphuka ngesikhathi edingeka ukufakwa kwamanzi, kungadala ingozi enkulu.
Izinga Lentela eNingizimu Afrika: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika latholakala emlandweni omude, elihambisana nezinguquko eziningi ezweni. Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinhlelo zentela ezisemthethweni, abantu babebhekana nezindleko ezihlukahlukene, futhi izimali zentela zaziphuma ezindleleni ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, futhi izinga lentela lalingakabi yinto ebucayi njengamanje. Ngemva kokuphuma kwezwe eMhlabeni, iNingizimu Afrika yathola uhlelo lwezintela olwakhiwe ukuze kube nezimali ezanele zokuphatha izwe. Ngonyaka ka-1910, lapho iNingizimu Afrika ithola uzibuse, kwavulwa amathuba amaningi okwakha izinhlelo zentela. Izinga lentela laqala ngokuba phezulu, futhi kwaba nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali ezitholakalayo zisetshenziswa kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lentela lathuthuka futhi lathola izinguquko eziningi. Ngonyaka ka-1948, umthetho we-Apartheid wathinta kakhulu izinga lentela. Izinhlelo zentela zaguqulwa ukuze zihlukanise phakathi kwabantu abamnyama nabamhlophe, okwakuholela ekubeni abantu abamnyama bahlupheke kakhulu. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu, futhi kwakhula ukungalingani phakathi kwezigaba zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-Apartheid ngonyaka ka-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yathola ithuba lokwakha uhlelo lwezintela olusha, olwakhelwe phezu kokulingana nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinga lentela laqala ukwenyuka, kodwa kwaba nezinhlelo eziningi zokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zomphakathi.
Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu, futhi kwakhula ukungalingani phakathi kwezigaba zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-Apartheid ngonyaka ka-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yathola ithuba lokwakha uhlelo lwezintela olusha, olwakhelwe phezu kokulingana nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinga lentela laqala ukwenyuka, kodwa kwaba nezinhlelo eziningi zokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Umthetho wezezimali wathuthukiswa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinga lentela lihlala lilingana, futhi uhulumeni waqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala ukuze athuthukise izimo zokuphila zabantu. Eminyakeni edlule, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala lishintsha, kuxhomeke ezimweni zomnotho. Ngonyaka ka-2018, uhulumeni waphakamisa izinga lentela eliphezulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga eziningi, njengoba abanye abantu bephikisana nezinguquko ezazenziwa. Kodwa-ke, izinga lentela lihlala linomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi nabakhiqizi bayakwazi ukuphila kahle, uhulumeni uhlele izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukwandisa izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nokwenza ngcono izinhlelo zokunakekela impilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala liphakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu. Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi.
Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala liphakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu. Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi. Ngokuphetha, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala lishintsha, lihlala linomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokuhlupheka, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinhlelo zentela ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zithola ithuba lokuphila kahle. I-Ningizimu Afrika ibheke phambili, ibheke ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo, futhi izinga lentela lizoba yinsika ebalulekile kulokhu kuqhubeka.
Ngiyavuma ngesikhathi sokuhlangana kokugcina kwezomthetho, okukhuluma ngesimo sezwe, ngifisa ukuhamba phambili ngithumele imiyalezo emihle kubalulekile bezomthetho ngonyaka omusha ophumelelayo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi unyaka ka-2008 uzoba yisikhathi esibalulekile kuhulumeni wethu wezwe uma sisebenza ndawonye ukuze sifeze amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngiyakhuluma lokhu ngoba, ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwethu, akuvamile ukuthi izwe libizwe ukuthi lidlule emizamweni emikhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe amaphupho abantu. Umlando usibeke kuleli qophelo. Ngikhuluma kini namuhla, Mnumzane Ohloniphekile, phambi kukamama wami owangithola, u-Epainette Mbeki, uMaMofokeng, okhona lapha enomlayezo ocacile wabantu basezindaweni ezisemaphandleni eTranskei lapho ahlala khona iminyaka eminingi. Uthi laba bantu bafuna ukuthi sibeze njengabaholi babo ukuthi ngabe sizimisele yini ukwenza ikusasa libe ngcono kunanamuhla. Ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalombili ezedlule, ngomhla kaFebhuwari 16, umama wami uzogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-92. Iphuzu elilodwa esingamnika lona ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa yiqiniso. Ngiyabonga kuye ngokunginika ithuba lokuba nani namuhla, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi ngeke simdumele. Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukuze ngibingelele uMongameli uNelson Mandela, omunye wabakhi abavelele kuhulumeni wethu wezwe ozogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-90 ngomhla kaJulayi 18 kulo nyaka. Namuhla samukela uMnu. Arthur Margeman omele abakhankaseli bokukhululeka ababe khona ngesikhathi ama-bhasi eqalwa e-Alexandra eminyakeni engu-50 edlule, futhi uNelson Mandela wayekhona kulolo suku.

Namuhla samukela uMnu. Arthur Margeman omele abakhankaseli bokukhululeka ababe khona ngesikhathi ama-bhasi eqalwa e-Alexandra eminyakeni engu-50 edlule, futhi uNelson Mandela wayekhona kulolo suku. Sibusisiwe ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMiss Jann Turner, indodakazi kaRick Turner owabulawa ngababambiqhaza kuhulumeni wobandlululo eminyakeni engama-30 edlule. Sijabule kakhulu ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMnu. Dinilesizwe Sobukwe, indodana yeqhawe elalilwela izwe lethu, uRobert Sobukwe, owasishiya eminyakeni engu-30 edlule ngemuva kokubekelwa icala lokuhlala ejele iminyaka eminingi, ebanjwa, nakwezinye izindlela zokucindezelwa. Sikhumbula abasunguli be-United Democratic Front, abanye babo siwabonga phakathi kwethu. Bonke laba bahlonishwa bamele inkumbulo nethemba, futhi ubu presence babo busikhumbuza ukuthi umsebenzi wethu ufana nomjaho wokudlulisela phambili amaphupho okuphila kahle kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngempela, laba baqhawe bamele ukukhumbuza ngesithakazelo esiqinile sabantu bethu futhi banika nethuba lokuziphatha ngendlela engaphuli noma engaboni izifiso zabantu bethu. Silungiselela ukuqala unyaka wezimali wokugcina weseshini yesithathu yohulumeni wezokhetho, ngemuva kwalokho sizoya kokhetho lwesine lwezwe. Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima ayidlalile mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi sithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni izithembiso esazenzile kubantu ngo-2004.

Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima ayidlalile mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Njengoba sisondele ekupheleni kwesikhathi esinikeziwe, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokubeka phambili Imisebenzi Ebalulekile edinga ukwenziwa, ehleliwe ngokubaluleka, okuzokwenziwa uhulumeni ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezilindelwe abantu kuhulumeni. Ngiyabonga ngoba inkulumo yesimo sezwe inginike ithuba lokubika kubo bonke abamele uhulumeni nabezizwe ngalezi zenzakalo eziyi-24 ezihleliwe ukuze ziqedwe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke kwiwebhusayithi kahulumeni ngesonto elizayo. Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile ezidinga ukwenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke kusho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezwe, izifunda, nezindawo, eziphethwe nokuphathwa, zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele, zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Zonke izinhlelo zikahulumeni zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi esikhathini esizayo zizozama ukufezekisa kuzo zonke izindawo ukuze zifeze imiphumela elindelekile - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma nge-Inqubo Engajwayelekile, asikhulumi ngokuthi izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sikhuluma ngesivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, amandla nokusebenza okuzophumelelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphila kwabantu kuthuthuka ngokushesha.
Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile ezidinga ukwenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke kusho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezwe, izifunda, nezindawo, eziphethwe nokuphathwa, zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele, zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Zonke izinhlelo zikahulumeni zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi esikhathini esizayo zizozama ukufezekisa kuzo zonke izindawo ukuze zifeze imiphumela elindelekile - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma nge-Inqubo Engajwayelekile, asikhulumi ngokuthi izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sikhuluma ngesivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, amandla nokusebenza okuzophumelelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphila kwabantu kuthuthuka ngokushesha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka, sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza kube nokuhleleka kokuthi izimali zisetshenziswe minyaka yonke, ezizokhishwa nguNgqongqoshe WezeMali ngaphambi kokuphela kwale nyanga, kuvumeleke ukuthi sifeze lezi zenzakalo ezidinga ukwenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke. Sizokwandisa ukuvumelanisa nezindawo ezibalulekile ekubambisaneni namanye amazwe, sigxile ezindabeni zase-Afrika nasezikhathini eziphathelene neNingizimu. Isimo esibhekene naso nomsebenzi esizibophezela kuwo sidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlangane njengomuntu oyedwa ukuze sifeze zonke izabelo ezidingekayo, singakukhohlwa ukuthi sonke siphethe ikusasa lethu ezandleni zethu! Uthe namuhla ekuseni, njengoba ngibhekene nezinselelo esinazo, ngikhumbule amazwi adumile kaCharles Dickens aqala incwadi yakhe ethi A Tale of Two Cities. "Kwabe kuyizikhathi ezinhle, kwabe kuyizikhathi ezimbi, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokuhlakanipha, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokuphoxeka, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokukholwa, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokungakholwa, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokukhanya, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokumnyama, kwabe kuyisikhathi sephupho, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokudabuka, sasinakho konke phambi kwethu, sonke sasiya ngqo eMhlabeni, sonke sasiya ngqo kwenye indlela - ngokufingqa, lesi sikhathi sasingafani kakhulu nesikhathi samanje, ukuthi abanye bayo baphakamisela ukuba sithathe, noma ngabe kahle noma kabi, ngokweqile."

Emhlanganweni owenziwe kahle ukuze kuqhubeke kuxoxwa ngendaba esesimeni, uMongameli wemihlangano uqinisekisile ukuthi isaziso sokubiza umhlangano wesithathu weMihlangano Yonyaka yeziqubulo, kanye nohlelo lwezinhlelo zomhlangano, umbiko weBhodi Yabaphathi, izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe zonyaka, kanye nombiko we-auditor, sathunyelwa kumalungu ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMeyi 2009 ngokuhambisana Nezikhumbuzo zeMihlangano. UMongameli wemihlangano uqinisekisile ukuthi amalungu awathumelanga iziphakamiso eziphakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho 28.1.5 we-GEMS, okwakuphakamisa ukwamukelwa kohlelo olunikezwa amalungu etafuleni lokubhalisela. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi ezinye amalungu asetshenzisile amafomu okhetho ukuze athumele iziphakamiso zawo kwiMihlangano futhi lezi zindaba zizophakanyiswa ngesikhathi sokubuza nokuphendula. U-Mnu. Adriaan Van Wyk uphakamise ukuthi uhlelo lwamukelwe futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. John Themba. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi izinhlinzeko zeMithetho yeMihlangano, iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kunoma yimuphi umhlangano wonyaka kufanele kube ngendlela yokuvota kwenani elikhulu lamalungu abukhoma futhi amelelwe ngu-proxy. UMongameli wazisa umhlangano ukuthi iMihlangano yamukela amafomu okhetho angama-207 asemthethweni avela kumalungu ngosuku lokugcina lukaJuni 19, 2009. Inani eliphelele lama-48 amafomu amelelayo adingeka ukuthi asuswe njengoba aqukethe izinombolo zokubhaliswa ezingalungile noma ezingafundeki noma abamenyiwe ngabantu abangamalungu eMihlangano njengabamele.

Inani eliphelele lama-48 amafomu amelelayo adingeka ukuthi asuswe njengoba aqukethe izinombolo zokubhaliswa ezingalungile noma ezingafundeki noma abamenyiwe ngabantu abangamalungu eMihlangano njengabamele. Umhlangano uqaphele futhi ukuthi amalungu eMihlangano abamenye ezinye amalungu ukuze avote kubo bonke abaphathi nabalungu beQembu Eliphezulu leMihlangano. Abantu abakhethiweyo bakhombisa ngosuku lukaJuni 23, 2009, emhlanganweni weBhodi Yabaphathi ukuthi bafuna ukuvota kanjani kuzo zonke iziphakamiso ezethulwe emhlanganweni. Ngemuva kokwethulwa nokuxoxwa ngazo zonke iziphakamiso eziphakanyisiwe, uMongameli wazisa amalungu ukuthi abamele abathunywe bavote kanjani futhi wabe esethula iziphakamiso zokwamukelwa. UMongameli wethula imizuzu yokwamukelwa. Imizuzu yeMihlangano Yesibili Yonyaka yamukelwa ngemuva kokuthi uMnu. Manganyi Abraham uphakamise ukuthi umhlangano wamukele imizuzu, futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. Nxumalo Themba. UMongameli wemihlangano wethula izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2008, zokwamukelwa futhi wazisa umhlangano ukuthi amalungu anikezwa izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe ngaphambi komhlangano.
Manganyi Abraham uphakamise ukuthi umhlangano wamukele imizuzu, futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. Nxumalo Themba. UMongameli wemihlangano wethula izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2008, zokwamukelwa futhi wazisa umhlangano ukuthi amalungu anikezwa izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe ngaphambi komhlangano. UMongameli watshela amalungu abukhoma ukuthi ngokuhambisana namafomu amelelayo amukelwe, amalungu angama-205 avote ekwamukeleni izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ka-2008 ngenkathi kungekho ilungu elivote ngokumelene nokwamukelwa kwezitatimende zezimali. Amalungu amabili afuna ukuhamba phambili ekuvoteni. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi inqubo yokuvula izikhangiso ilandelwe ukuze kuqashwe inkampani ye-auditors yangaphandle ukuze iqashwe njengama-auditors angaphandle eMihlangano unyaka wezezimali ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2009. IMihlangano yaqhubeka nokukhula ngo-2009 nangaphezulu kwalokhu kukhula okuqhubekayo, usayizi jikelele webhizinisi nezinkinga ezavela, kube nempumelelo enkulu eyenzeka ngo-2009. IBhodi Yabaphathi ye-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngentuthuko eyenziwe yiMihlangano nokuthi izinkinga ezavela ngo-2009 zaphathwa kanjani nokuthi izindaba ezisemqoka zamalungu ngaphansi kwe-GEMS zivikela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngamathuba alinganayo ukuze babe nezinzuzo zempilo ezibizayo. Uhlelo lokuphathwa kweMihlangano oluqinile ludinge ukusungulwa kohlelo lwecebo lesikhashana nelide oluhola futhi lukhombise ibhizinisi leMihlangano.
IBhodi Yabaphathi ye-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngentuthuko eyenziwe yiMihlangano nokuthi izinkinga ezavela ngo-2009 zaphathwa kanjani nokuthi izindaba ezisemqoka zamalungu ngaphansi kwe-GEMS zivikela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngamathuba alinganayo ukuze babe nezinzuzo zempilo ezibizayo. Uhlelo lokuphathwa kweMihlangano oluqinile ludinge ukusungulwa kohlelo lwecebo lesikhashana nelide oluhola futhi lukhombise ibhizinisi leMihlangano. Impumelelo ye-GEMS ikalwa ngamandla ezakhiwo zayo zokuphatha nokuphatha, kanye nezinqubo zayo zokuhlela amacebo - lezi zinto ziqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS inerekhodi yokuphumelelisa kahle amacebo ayo e-strategic wonyaka futhi ifinyelela izinhloso eziqukethwe kuyo. IBhodi yenza ukuhlela amacebo ka-2009 ngokuqonda ukuthi iMihlangano isibe inhlangano esezingeni eliphezulu esakhe indawo yokusebenza ephelele nezinhlelo zokuphatha zezimali eziqondile. Ukuhlela kwenziwa ngenhloso yokubeka i-GEMS njengemihlangano yokunakekelwa kwezempilo ehamba phambili, esebenzayo, futhi ephumelelayo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. IBhodi ibuyekeze ukwakheka kweKomidi okwakusungulwa yiBhodi ngo-2009 ngenhloso yokusebenzisa kahle amakhono nolwazi lwabaphathi kanye namalungu eKomidi ezimele. Ukuhlola kweBhodi kubuye kubheke ukufaneleka kwezimo zokubhekisela kumaKomidi futhi izinguquko ezincane zadingeka. Abaphathi basebenza kumaKomidi ngo-2009 njengoba kubikwe ezicini 7 no-8 zeMibiko yeBhodi. IBhodi yamukela ekuhlolweni kokusebenza kweBhodi yonyaka ukuthi amaKomidi asebenza kahle nokuthi ukubika kwiBhodi kuhle kakhulu.
Ukuhlola kweBhodi kubuye kubheke ukufaneleka kwezimo zokubhekisela kumaKomidi futhi izinguquko ezincane zadingeka. Abaphathi basebenza kumaKomidi ngo-2009 njengoba kubikwe ezicini 7 no-8 zeMibiko yeBhodi. IBhodi yamukela ekuhlolweni kokusebenza kweBhodi yonyaka ukuthi amaKomidi asebenza kahle nokuthi ukubika kwiBhodi kuhle kakhulu. Amalungu eKomidi ezimele babambe iqhaza ekuhloleni kweMihlangano, amaKomidi e-Ex Gratia kanye ne-Emergency aqashwe yiBhodi ukuze asebenze ehhovisi isikhathi esingamashumi amathathu eminyaka futhi isikhathi samalungu siphela ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa. IBhodi iphinde yaqasha wonke la malungu eKomidi ngasikhathi sinye futhi isikhathi sokusebenza siphela ngo-2012. Ukuhlolwa kokuphatha okuhle okuwenziwe yiMihlangano kwathuthukiswa ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa nokwethulwa kwenqubo yokuhlola abaphathi, amalungu eKomidi ezimele, nabasebenzi. Inqubo yokuhlola iyingxenye ye-framework yokuphatha okuhle kweMihlangano ethinta izakhiwo zokuphatha nezenhlalakahle, Ukuphathwa Kokuhola Abasebenzi, Ukuphathwa Kwabaphakeli, Uhlelo lwezokuphepha kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ubugebengu. Ukuhlolwa Kokusebenza Konyaka kweBhodi yeMihlangano kwenziwa kusukela kuSepthemba kuya ku-Okthoba 2009. IBhodi yathola ukuhlola kokuzihlola okuqhutshwa yinkampani ezimele ehlole izincwadi nezokusebenza zeBhodi kanye namaKomidi atholakele ukuthi kulungile. Ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibhalwe phansi ze-GEMS, isikhathi sokusebenza samaphesenti angama-50 abaphathi abakhonza kwiBhodi Yabaphathi yamanje sizophela ngoJulayi 2010. IBhodi entsha izokwakhiwa ukuze iqale ukusebenza ngoJulayi 21, 2010.
IBhodi yathola ukuhlola kokuzihlola okuqhutshwa yinkampani ezimele ehlole izincwadi nezokusebenza zeBhodi kanye namaKomidi atholakele ukuthi kulungile. Ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibhalwe phansi ze-GEMS, isikhathi sokusebenza samaphesenti angama-50 abaphathi abakhonza kwiBhodi Yabaphathi yamanje sizophela ngoJulayi 2010. IBhodi entsha izokwakhiwa ukuze iqale ukusebenza ngoJulayi 21, 2010. Kuze kube manje, amalungu amakhulu eMihlangano azokhetha abaphathi abasha abathathu kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nezokuphathwa uzokwenza futhi abaphathi abasha bazokwakha amaphesenti angama-50 eBhodi. Uma iBhodi, ngemuva kokubuyekeza umbiko womuntu noma umzimba ozimele, ikholwa ukuthi ukhetho lwenzeka ngokuhambisana nenqubo eyasungulwa yiBhodi
Masijabule ukufungiswa kukaMongameli wethu omusha! Amamiliyoni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abambe iqhaza ekhetho ngomhla ka-22 kuMbasa 2009. Ngokuvota, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathatheka enhlanganweni yezenkolo yokukhetha uMongameli omusha. Manje njengoba sesazi imiphumela yokhetho, sekuyisikhathi sokufungisa uMongameli omusha. Yini ukufungiswa kukaMongameli? Ukufungiswa kukaMongameli kuyisenzakalo esisemthethweni esiqala isikhathi sokuphatha kuk governo omusha. Kulolu suku, uMongameli omusha ufungiswa nguMphakathi Oyinhloko waseNingizimu Afrika. Oomongameli abavela kwamanye amazwe, izikhulu zikahulumeni, kanye nezithunywa ezivela kuhulumeni bamanye amazwe bayavakashela leli eventi elibalulekile. Kuzoba nomculo nemidlalo yendabuko ekugubheni leli suku. Ngabe ukufungiswa kukaMongameli kuzokwenzeka nini? Kulonyaka, uMongameli uzofungiswa ngomhla ka-9 kuNhlangulana 2009 kuqala ngo-11 a.m. eZakhiweni zeUnion ePitoli. Kungani leli suku libalulekile? Kulolu suku, sibhiyozela impumelelo yezwe lethu ngokusebenzisa ubudlelwano bezepolitiki kanye namalungelo namathuba esinawo eNingizimu Afrika aphathwa ngedemokhrasi, ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga noma ngocansi. Leli suku singahlangana njengomphakathi ukuze siqhubeke sakha iNingizimu Afrika esingayigqaja ngayo. Ungaba kanjani yingxenye yokugubha ukufungiswa kukaMongameli? Iziteshi eziningi zethelevishini nezomsakazo zizokwenza ukusakazwa kokufungiswa bukhoma ngomhla ka-9 kuNhlangulana 2009 - uzobe ulalela? Kukhona nezinye izenzakalo ezihlelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni - yiba yingxenye yayo!
Ungaba kanjani yingxenye yokugubha ukufungiswa kukaMongameli? Iziteshi eziningi zethelevishini nezomsakazo zizokwenza ukusakazwa kokufungiswa bukhoma ngomhla ka-9 kuNhlangulana 2009 - uzobe ulalela? Kukhona nezinye izenzakalo ezihlelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni - yiba yingxenye yayo! Uma udinga ulwazi ngemicimbi endaweni yakho, shayela u-1020 (inombolo yokushayela engenamali uma ushayela kusuka kumakhalekhukhwini). Ndawonye sihlangene ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo!
Izinga Lentela eNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-2023, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika libe nendaba ebalulekile emphakathini, njengoba izinqumo ezithathwe uhulumeni ziqhubekile nokuthinta izigidi zabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle lesi simo, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi izinga lentela sisho izinga elisetshenziselwa ukukhokha intela kumholo, ezentela zokuthengiselana, kanye nezinto zokusebenza. Kuqala, sithola ukuthi izinga lentela yomuntu siqu ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Izinhlaka zikanxusa zihlala ziqwashisa abantu ukuthi intela ethile iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi, njengemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinselelo zokuntuleka kwemali nemithombo yezimali zihlala zikhona. Nokho, izinga lentela elikhulayo lingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Lokhu kwaziswa ngengqikithi yokuthi uma izinga lentela lenyuka, umphakathi ubhekana nezindleko ezengeziwe. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bacabangele kabusha indlela abaphila ngayo, bese kudingeka izindlela ezintsha zokuphila ukuze bakwazi ukukhokha izindleko. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhulumeni uthathe izinyathelo ezahlukene ukuze athuthukise izinga lentela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo ezithile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqhamuka ezindaweni eziphansi. Kukho imizamo yokunciphisa izinga lentela kumholo ophansi, ukuze abantu bahlale bezithokozisa futhi baphile kahle. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko, akusiyona nje impendulo yokuthi izinga lentela lenyuka noma lehlisa, kodwa kumele sihlolisise imithelela ehambisana nalezi zinguquko.
Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo ezithile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqhamuka ezindaweni eziphansi. Kukho imizamo yokunciphisa izinga lentela kumholo ophansi, ukuze abantu bahlale bezithokozisa futhi baphile kahle. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko, akusiyona nje impendulo yokuthi izinga lentela lenyuka noma lehlisa, kodwa kumele sihlolisise imithelela ehambisana nalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinkinga zokungalingani, lapho abanye abantu besaba ukuncipha kwamathuba ngenxa yokwanda kwentela, kuyilapho abanye besebenzisa lezi zinguquko njengezindlela zokuzithuthukisa. Izinsuku zokuqala zika-2023 zafika nezinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta izinga lentela. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bamaNingizimu Afrika bahlala behlonipha izimiso ezikhona, uhulumeni wenze imizamo yokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe obuhambisana nezinga lentela. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlola nokukhipha intela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izigameko zomphakathi, ezifana nezinkulumo zokwakha ubumba phakathi kwezinkampani, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nezwi elinothile ekuphakamiseni izinga lentela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi izinga lentela alinakho ukufana phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokho kudinga isixazululo esinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi izinga lentela lihlala ligubungele izimpilo zabo bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abasha, ikakhulukazi, badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhokha intela ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baphumelele emisebenzini yabo nasemphakathini, futhi kube nethuba lokukhulisa izinga labo lemali. Naphezu kwazo zonke izinkinga ezikhona, umphakathi unokuthile okukhuthazayo.
Abantu abasha, ikakhulukazi, badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhokha intela ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baphumelele emisebenzini yabo nasemphakathini, futhi kube nethuba lokukhulisa izinga labo lemali. Naphezu kwazo zonke izinkinga ezikhona, umphakathi unokuthile okukhuthazayo. Imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nabantu ibalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana nezokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu baphila kahle zikhuthaza ukufunda nokwaziswa ngezinto ezibhekene nezinga lentela. Ekugcineni, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala linomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhokha intela akukhona nje ukwenziwa kwemali, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ohlanganyela. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kumele uqhubeke uvulelekile ekuxoxeni ngalezi zindaba, futhi usebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela eliphusile nelithuthukayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula nelibumbene eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwabavoti Nentando Yeningi Isingeniso Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumula, futhi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi ubani okufanele ahole, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ezikhombisa izifiso nezidingo zomphakathi. Sizobheka izinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokubamba iqhaza kwabavoti ukuze siqonde indlela yokwakha intando yeningi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Indima Yabavoti Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abavoti banendima ebalulekile ekwakheni intando yeningi. Abavoti bamele izwi labantu, futhi kufanele baqonde ukuthi izinqumo zabo zinefuthe elikhulu ezinqumweni ezithathwayo. Ukuze abavoti baqonde kahle, kufanele bahlale befundiswa ngamalungelo abo, izinqubo zokhetho, kanye nezinketho ezikhona. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubhalisela Ukhetho Isinyathelo esilandelayo ukubhalisela ukuvota. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuphela abavoti ababhaliwe abavuma ukuvota. Ukuze ubhalise, kufanele uvakashele ihhovisi lezakhamizi lendawo yakho noma usebenzise izinsiza eziku-inthanethi. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwakho luyiqiniso. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvota ngosuku lokhetho. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izinketho Zokhetho Ngemuva kokubhalisela ukuvota, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinketho zokhetho. Lokhu kusho ukufunda ngababambiqhaza, izinhlelo zabo, kanye nezinto abazimisele ukuzifeza uma bephumelela. Ungafunda ngezinhlelo zabo ezisemthethweni, ubuke izinkulumo zabo, futhi uxoxe nabanye abantu ukuze uthole imibono ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha umuntu ofanele.
Lokhu kusho ukufunda ngababambiqhaza, izinhlelo zabo, kanye nezinto abazimisele ukuzifeza uma bephumelela. Ungafunda ngezinhlelo zabo ezisemthethweni, ubuke izinkulumo zabo, futhi uxoxe nabanye abantu ukuze uthole imibono ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha umuntu ofanele. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuvota Lapho usuku lokhetho lufika, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela zonke izinyathelo zokuvota. Vakashela endaweni yokuvota ebekiwe, uthathe ubufakazi bokubhaliswa kwakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulandela imiyalelo yokuvota. Khumbula, ukuvota akuwona umcimbi ophuthumayo; thatha isikhathi sokucabangela kahle ukukhetha kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izwi lakho lizwa. Isinyathelo 5: Ukubamba Iqhaza Ngemva Kokhetho Ngemuva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukulandela izinqumo ezithathwayo, ukuhlinzeka ngombono, noma ukufaka iziphakamiso kumalungu omphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza ngemuva kokhetho kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bahlala bephendula ezidingweni zomphakathi. Isiphetho Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi akupheli ngosuku lokhetho. Kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza, bahlale befundiswa, futhi baphakamise izwi labo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, futhi onokuthula. Qhubekani nibambe iqhaza, nikhumbule ukuthi izwi lenu linamandla!
Ukubhaliswa kokuzalwa kwenzeka ngemva kwesikhathi uma ukubhaliswa kwenziwa ngemuva konyaka kulandela ukuzalwa kwengane. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-24/1 lokubhaliswa kokuzalwa ngemuva konyaka, kodwa kungadluli eminyakeni engu-15. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-24/15 lokubhaliswa kokuzalwa ngemuva kweminyaka engu-15. Thumela ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesazisi somama uma abazali bengashadile noma ikhophi yokuvuma kukababa ukuba ngumzali. Uma ubaba evuma ukuba ngumzali, thumela amakhophi aqinisekisiwe wezazisi zombabili abazali. Thumela isitifiketi esivela esibhedlela noma endaweni yokubeletha lapho ingane yazalwa khona. Isitifiketi kumele sibe sesigciniwe umuntu ophatha futhi kumele sibe negama elisemthethweni lesikhungo kanye ne-stamp. Thumela isitatimende ngemininingwane yengane njengoba kuboniswe ohlwini lwezikole noma esitifiketini sesikole lapho ingane iqale khona, esisayiniwe nguMphakathi. Isitatimende kumele sibe nenombolo yeMphakathi ephepheni elisemthethweni elinestamp yesikole nosuku. Futhi thumela isitifiketi sokubhapathizwa kwengane uma sikhishwe phakathi kweminyaka emihlanu yokuzalwa kwengane. Uma abazali bengabikho, kufanele kuthunyelwe isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe esivela kumndeni oseduze, kodwa okungenani oneminyaka engu-10 edlula ingane, futhi owazi imininingwane yokuzalwa kwengane, okumele kuhambisane nezazisi nesimo sengane. Thumela isitatimende esivela kumuntu onolwazi ngababazali bomfakisicelo. Lo muntu kufanele ahambisane nomfakisicelo eMnyangweni Wezasekhaya lapho umfakisicelo nalowo muntu bazobuzwa ezindlini ezahlukene. Izicelo zingathatha ezinyangeni ezi-3 kuya kwezi-6. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Lo muntu kufanele ahambisane nomfakisicelo eMnyangweni Wezasekhaya lapho umfakisicelo nalowo muntu bazobuzwa ezindlini ezahlukene. Izicelo zingathatha ezinyangeni ezi-3 kuya kwezi-6. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze ukuze uthole usizo.
Bheka ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lwezokugunyazwa oludingekayo bese ugcwalisa ifomu elifanele. Izicelo zokukhululwa okukhulu kufanele zidluliselwe ngemicimbi ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokutshala. Izicelo zokuph continueda ngaphansi komsebenzi othile zizovunyelwa kuphela uma lowo msebenzi ugunyazwe esikhathini esedlule. Khokha imali echaziwe okufanele ikhokhwe. Thumela umbiko wezinto ezenziwe esikhathini esedlule. Thumela ubufakazi benkomba ejwayelekile. Ikhomidi yokweluleka ibuyekeza ulwazi lwezesayensi oluthunyelwe nezesicelo futhi yenze isiphakamiso mayelana nokuphepha komsebenzi ophakanyisiwe, bese iwethula kwiKhansela eliphezulu. Umqondisi wamukela imibono ejwayelekile ngesikhathi esivunyelwe. Ikhansela eliphezulu lenza isinqumo ngesicelo, ibheka isicelo, isiphakamiso sekhansela yokweluleka, imibono ejwayelekile, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona emikhakheni efana nezolimo, impilo, imvelo, umsebenzi, ukuhweba, kanye nentuthuko yesayensi nobuchwepheshe. Uma isinqumo seKhansela eliphezulu sihambisana nesicelo, umqondisi ugunyazwe ukuba akhiphe imvume. Umqondisi ukhipha imvume efanele. Zonke izimvume zisebenza ngaphansi kwezimo zokunciphisa. Ukuphikiswa okuvela kuMnyango Wezolimo kugadla ukuhambisana nezimo zemvume.
U- Ms. Jane uthi... Wow, bekumnandi ukuba yilungu leqembu elikhethe uMlimi Wonyaka kulolo mncintiswano! Imisebenzi eminingi ibihilelekile ethathwe iminyaka eminingi ukuze siqalisise uhlelo lwethu lokuthuthukisa abalimi, futhi bekumangalisa ukubona ukuthi abanye abakhiqizi bayephi. Ukukhetha labo abaphakanyisiwe bekunzima kakhulu ngoba bonke basebenze kanzima isikhathi eside futhi benze kahle. Nokho, kuyamangalisa futhi kujabulisa ukubona intuthuko yabanye abakhiqizi, kuyasiphoxa ukubona abanye abangaphumeleli nhlobo. Ngisho nakuze kube manje sisabona abalimi abangawenzi kahle izinto ezisemqoka - njengokulungisa umhlabathi kahle, ukusebenzisa umanyolo, ukukhetha izinhlobo ezinhle zezithombo, nokulawula izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Uma ungakwenzi lokhu kahle, awukwazi ukuqhubeka ube umlimi wezomnotho. Njalo abantu bakutshela ukuthi abakwazi ukwenza lezi zinto kahle futhi bakunika izizathu zokwenza lokhu - abanye bathi abanakho ama-traktor, abanye bathi izithombo nomanyolo kubiza kakhulu, abanye bathi kuhulumeni ophoqayo. Kodwa, uma ufuna ukuba umkhiqizi omuhle, kufanele uthuthukise amasu ukuze uqhubeke phambili. Sibone izitshalo ezinhle kakhulu zikhula ngesandla - isiqeshana esincane somhlaba singakhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle uma ulungisa umhlabathi kahle, ufaka izithombo ezinhle, ufaka umanyolo ofanele, futhi ulawula izihlahla eziphikisanayo ngempumelelo. Kungcono kakhulu ukufaka endaweni encane (ongayikhokhela) futhi wenze konke kahle kunokufaka endaweni enkulu kodwa umsebenzi wakho awuqediwe kahle. Uma usukwazi ukufaka kahle endaweni encane, ungakwazi ukuqala ukwandisa umsebenzi wakho wokufaka.

Uma intuthuko ingabonakali ezindaweni, sizophonswa ingcindezi yokuvala izinhlelo kulezo zindawo. Kuzoba usuku olunzima ukusika ukwesekwa kulabo abalimi - kodwa lokho kusezandleni zabo. Uma uthola usizo ngokuqondiswa kwethu nokuqeqeshwa, kufanele ushintshe futhi ulandele izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza. Inkinga Yokubhalisa Emanyuvesi: Indaba Yomlando Emhlabeni jikelele, ukubhaliswa emanyuvesi kube yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. ESouth Africa, le nkinga ibonakala ikakhulukazi phakathi neminyaka yezi-2000, lapho izinga lokufunda liphakamisa izinselelo eziningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kubalulekile ukubheka izizathu eziholela ekubeni kube nezinkinga zokubhaliswa, kanye nemiphumela ethinta abafundi, iminyango kahulumeni, kanye nemfundo jikelele. Ngonyaka ka-2000, iNyuvesi yaseCape Town yathola ukwanda okukhulu kwabafundi abafuna ukufunda. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokubhaliswa, njengoba izinsiza ezikhona zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Abafundi abaningi babebhekene nezithiyo eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezinsuku ezide zokulinda, izinhlelo eziphukile, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abafundi baphumelele ekubhaliseni, kanti abanye bahlala bengabhaliswanga, okwakuholela ekutheni baphuthelwe amathuba okuthola imfundo. Ngonyaka ka-2015, inkinga yokubhalisa yafinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, lapho izikole eziningi ziqala ukuveza izikhalazo ezinkulu. Abafundi baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisana nezinhlelo zokubhaliswa ezazibonakala zingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezazihlosiwe, kodwa izinkinga zaphinde zaphinda zaphakanyiswa. Abafundi baphinde baqhamuka nezindlela zokuxhumana, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Ngalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqala ukubona ubukhulu benkinga yokubhaliswa.

Yini ekhuthaza abanikeli ukuba banikele? Ukukhuthaza izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali ukuba zamukele izibopho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakwa okufanele nokugcinwa kwezinga eliphezulu ezinqubweni: ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwethembeka; ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele; ukuhweba ngempumelelo; ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nohulumeni, imiphakathi ethintekile, abanikeli, abaxhasi, kanye nomphakathi; ukuphatha ihhovisi lenhlangano ngokucophelela; nokuziphatha ngokuhlonipha. IPhiko Lezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi lisungule umgomo ohambisana nezidingo zeMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti ka-1997, ngokuxoxisana nezinhlangano eziningi kanye namalungu azo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinqubomgomo ziwumphumela wombono ophumelelayo wokuthi yini ebhekwa njengokusebenza kahle ekuholeni nasekuphathekeni kwezinhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali, kungakhathaliseki usayizi wenhlangano. Ukugxila kugxile kakhulu ezicini ezifana nokusebenza ngokulingana, ukugcina izindaba zokuphatha, ukuhweba, nokucabangela umphakathi othintekile. Kulindeleke ukuthi ngalezi ziqondiso, zonke izinhlangano ezibhaliswe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti zamukele lezi ziqondiso, zisebenzisa ukuze zithuthukise futhi zikhuthaze lesi sikhala lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona izindawo ezintathu ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kulo mthetho wokuziphatha, ezihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwedokhumenti eyodwa. Kucacile ukuthi inhlangano engaphansi kwemali ephumelelayo izuza ezisebenzisaneni phakathi kwabanikeli, abahwebi, kanye nalabo abaphatha izinsiza nezenzo zenhlangano. Umthetho wokuziphatha ubalulekile, kodwa awukhombisi kahle izinga elibekiwe lokuziphatha.
Kukhona izindawo ezintathu ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kulo mthetho wokuziphatha, ezihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwedokhumenti eyodwa. Kucacile ukuthi inhlangano engaphansi kwemali ephumelelayo izuza ezisebenzisaneni phakathi kwabanikeli, abahwebi, kanye nalabo abaphatha izinsiza nezenzo zenhlangano. Umthetho wokuziphatha ubalulekile, kodwa awukhombisi kahle izinga elibekiwe lokuziphatha. Ababhekele izikhundla zenhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali banemithwalo yokubheka nokuphatha inhlangano ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo ngenkathi behlonipha imithetho elawulwa umthethosisekelo wenhlangano. Ngokucabangela ukuthi lo mthetho uzosetshenziswa yizinhlangano ezahlukene ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, le dokhumenti ivulekile futhi ibhalwe ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda nokuyisebenzisa. Umphakathi - umuntu owenziwe ukuba aqaphe isimo sezimali zenhlangano nsuku zonke. Lokhu kungaba umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele noma wesikhathi esithile, unikezwa umuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle, noma kwenziwa ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano, inani lemali eliqoqiwe, noma leyo ekhishwayo. Umphathi wehhovisi - umuntu onikezwe umsebenzi wokubheka ihhovisi nsuku zonke ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Le ndima ingaba isikhathi esigcwele noma esithile, noma kwenziwe ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano. Umphathi - umuntu onikezwe ukuba abe yisikhulu senhlangano ngokuphelele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. Lo muntu uqashwe yibhodi elawulayo ye-NPO futhi ubika kulowo msebenzi ngakho konke okwenzekayo enhlangano nsuku zonke.
Le ndima ingaba isikhathi esigcwele noma esithile, noma kwenziwe ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano. Umphathi - umuntu onikezwe ukuba abe yisikhulu senhlangano ngokuphelele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. Lo muntu uqashwe yibhodi elawulayo ye-NPO futhi ubika kulowo msebenzi ngakho konke okwenzekayo enhlangano nsuku zonke. Umeluleki - izinhlangano eziningi ezingekho phansi kwemali azinazo izinsiza nezimali zokuhola bonke abantu abadingekayo kanye nobuchwepheshe ukuze ziqhube izinhlelo, zenze umsebenzi, futhi ziqoqe imali. Ezinye zalezi zabelo zinganikezwa kubeluleki bangaphandle abaziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngalolo buchwepheshe. Lezi zinqumo zingase zibe ngqo ezicini zalezi zabelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zifushane noma zaphakathi. Abanikeli - umuntu noma isikhungo noma inhlangano enikela ngezinsiza ngokuzithandela izikhathi eziningi, ezingaba yimali, emva kokucela okuningana okwenziwe yinhlangano, ukuze kusekelwe izinhlelo nezindleko zansuku zonke. Umhwebi - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, enhlangano engaphansi kwemali ukuze athole izinsiza noma imali ukuze ahlangabezane nezinhlelo, izenzo ezihlosiwe, nezindleko zokusebenza. Le ndima inganikezwa kumuntu noma kumuntu wangaphandle noma ibhizinisi elizobhekana nokuhweba. Ibhodi elawulayo - iqoqo lamalungu enhlangano engaphansi kwemali akhethwe noma anikezwe ukuba abe abaholi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Ibhodi elawulayo lingabizwa ngokuthi iBhodi, Ibhodi Labaphathi, Ikhansela, noma Ikhansela Lokuphatha.

Isitatimende somsebenzi - isitatimende esifushane esichaza inhloso nezinto ezihlosiwe zenhlangano engaphansi kwemali, sichaza isizathu sokuba khona kwenhlangano. Isitatimende somsebenzi kufanele sihlolwe njalo. Umphakathi - umuntu onikezwe igunya lokubamba isikhundla futhi abe namandla okuphatha nokubhekelela ngaphakathi kwenhlangano noma i-NPO. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke ngokukhonza ngenhloso yokuhola inhlangano nokuhola ngokuziphatha kahle noma ngokuphatha; njengomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. I-NPO yamukela izimiso zokuzilawula ezimweni ezibalulekile ezidinga ukucaciswa. Iziqu zikhomba izindinganiso ezisemqoka zenhlangano futhi zisebenza njengemiyalezo eyisisekelo yesitatimende somsebenzi wenhlangano. Lezi zinciphisa imibuzo mayelana nokuthi inhlangano isebenza kanjani ezingeni elihlukene futhi zikhombisa ukuthi izosetshenziswa kanjani esikhathini esizayo. Umphathi wephrojekthi - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, kwi-NPO njengomphathi noma uhlelo olwakhiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso. Umhwebi - umuntu noma isikhungo esisekela i-NPO ngokuqondile, noma izenzo zayo noma imicimbi, kuvame ukukhuthaza abaxhasi noma imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zabaxhasi.

Umuntu ozithandela - umuntu osiza i-NPO ezinhlelweni zayo, ezinhlelweni zehhovisi, noma ekutholeni imali, ngaphandle kokufuna ukukhokhelwa noma ukukhokhelwa. uSerena Williams: Ibhola Lencwadi Yempumelelo Ngiyavuma, akekho omunye umphakathi odumile njengoSerena Williams. Uthandwa kakhulu emhlabeni wonke, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yempumelelo yakhe emhlabeni wezokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuba yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. USerena, owazalwa ngoSepthemba 26, 1981, eSaginaw, eMichigan, ubonise ukuthi ukuphumelela akukona nje ukuncintisana, kodwa futhi ukulwa nobunzima, ukuqina, nokuba nesibindi. Kodwa ake sibuyele emuva kancane. USerena kanye nesizalwane sakhe, uVenus, baqala ukudlala ibhola elizimele ngaphambi kokuba babe neziqinisekiso ezinkulu emhlabeni. Abazali babo, uRichard noOracene, babezama konke okusemandleni ukuze baphakamise lezi zingane zabo, benze konke okusemandleni ukuze zifinyelele ephakamisweni. USerena uthathe lezi zifundo ezivela kubazali bakhe waze waphumelela emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSerena waba umphumela wezemidlalo, ethola iziqu eziningi, amakhono akhe emhlabeni wonke. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, esebenzisa isikhundla sakhe ukuze aqhubekele phambili izinto eziningi ezinhle. Akekho umphakathi ongalokothi ubonge kanjani uSerena; umphakathi wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ezemidlalo zabesifazane, uthole izikhumbuzo eziningi ngenxa yokuthi uSerena udlale indima ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwalesi sikhala. Ngokwengeziwe, uSerena ubhale uhambo lwakhe, efuna izindlela zokuvula amathuba kubantu abasha, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, ukuze bazitholele izikhala eziphakeme. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi noma ubani angakwenza, ngaphandle kokubheka ukuthi uvelaphi.
Akekho umphakathi ongalokothi ubonge kanjani uSerena; umphakathi wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ezemidlalo zabesifazane, uthole izikhumbuzo eziningi ngenxa yokuthi uSerena udlale indima ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwalesi sikhala. Ngokwengeziwe, uSerena ubhale uhambo lwakhe, efuna izindlela zokuvula amathuba kubantu abasha, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, ukuze bazitholele izikhala eziphakeme. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi noma ubani angakwenza, ngaphandle kokubheka ukuthi uvelaphi. Uhlale esebenza kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi lokho kuveza ukuthi impumelelo yeyakho, ingekho ematheni. Ngaphandle kwemidlalo, uSerena ungena kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokuphupha, yena nomndeni wakhe benza izinhlelo eziningi zokugcina izimpilo zabanye zikhanya. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo esiqinile kumasiko ahlukeneyo, lapho eveza khona ukuthi umhlaba ungcono uma ubumbene, unokuhloniphana. Uhlale ethanda ukuzama izinto ezintsha, kanti lokho kumenza abe nesithakazelo esijulile esikhathini samanje. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lungakwenza ube yisithombe esihle, kodwa uSerena uyazi ukuthi ubukhulu bempumelelo buncike kumzamo, ubunzima, nomqondo oqinile. Uthumele imiyalezo emihle ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukubonisa ukuthi akukhona nje ukuncintisana nokuhlakanipha, kodwa futhi ukufuna izindlela zokuxhasa abanye. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo sokukhuthaza abanye, hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabo. Kodwa akukhona konke okuhle, hayi? USerena ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi empilweni yakhe. Uthole izigwegwe ezinzima, izinkinga zomndeni, nezikhathi lapho engazange azizwe kahle. Kodwa, ngokuhlakanipha, uSerena waqhubeka nokunqoba, ebamba izifundo eziphuma kulokhu.
USerena ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi empilweni yakhe. Uthole izigwegwe ezinzima, izinkinga zomndeni, nezikhathi lapho engazange azizwe kahle. Kodwa, ngokuhlakanipha, uSerena waqhubeka nokunqoba, ebamba izifundo eziphuma kulokhu. Lokhu kunceda abanye ukuthi bazi ukuthi kuyenzeka, nakuba ungase udlule ezinkingeni. Uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo luhlale lukhanya. USerena uqhubekele phambili, esebenzisa izifundo, ubuchwepheshe, nesikhathi sokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokuncintisana. Uthanda ukubonisa umphakathi ukuthi ibhola elizimele liwumdlalo, kodwa futhi liwumsebenzi ongenza kahle. Uhlonipha imvelaphi yakhe, futhi uSerena uvezile ukuthi ukuphumelela akuphathelene nokubamba izinto ezinkulu, kodwa kudinga ukwenza kahle, futhi uthande lokho okwenzayo. Ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungowakho, ungathanda ukufaka isandla, futhi ungathanda ukubona abanye bephumelela. Kusukela phansi, uSerena Williams ubonisa ukuthi uma unethemba, uthando, nomzamo, yonke into iyenzeka. Uhlale elwa, ebonisa abanye indlela. Lokhu kwenza kube sobala ukuthi uSerena akayena nje umdlali, kodwa ungumholi, umqondisi, nomphakathi. Hamba phambili, uSerena! Uzokwenza izinkanyezi zikhanye!
Umlando weSoweto Uprising: Ukuhlola Umoya Wokulwa Umcimbi weSoweto Uprising, owenzeka ngomhla ziyi-16 kuNhlangulana ka-1976, ungomunye wemigubho ebalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi lwesiBhunu ezikoleni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esiqinile sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo yayihlanganisa abantu bonke, ikakhulukazi intsha. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ubonisa ukuthi abantwana, nakuba bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima, bangaba namandla okwenza umehluko. Abantwana abaningi babebonakala benesibindi sokuphikisa ukungabi nabulungiswa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, noma ubudala bethu buncane, singaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ngiyakhumbula izithombe ezinhle zabantwana abavela ezikoleni, bejabulile, kodwa bazi kahle ukuthi impilo yabo ibhekene nezithiyo ezinzima. Umlando weSoweto Uprising akuwona umcimbi owawenzeka ngosuku olulodwa; ubonisa umoya wokulwa okwakukhona phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Abantwana baphakamisa izwi labo, baphikisa ukungabi nabulungiswa, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlanganisa amandla ukuze ufinyelele izinguquko. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi weSoweto Uprising waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo ayizange iphele. Ngemuva kokubulawa kwabantu abaningi, umphakathi wawudinga ukuvuka, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba izimo zazingezinhle, abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo.
Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi weSoweto Uprising waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo ayizange iphele. Ngemuva kokubulawa kwabantu abaningi, umphakathi wawudinga ukuvuka, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba izimo zazingezinhle, abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi lwesiBhunu ezikoleni. Abesifazane benza ingxenye enkulu yokuhlala kwabantu eNingizimu Afrika, yingakho izwi labesifazane kufanele lifakwe ezinqumweni nasekudalweni kwemithetho. Le nkwakha yabesifazane ezinqumweni iyilungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Abesifazane kumele babambe iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngoba ukuhlinzekwa kwemithetho nezinhlelo zik gouvernement kuthinta izimpilo zabo nsuku zonke. Kubalulekile, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi uma abesifazane bebamba iqhaza ezinqumweni, kuholela ekwandeni kokunakwa nokwabiwa kwezinsiza ezithuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu. Ukwanda kokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho kungaholela ekutholeni kalula izinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. UMsunguli weNingizimu Afrika uthi umphakathi kumele wazi futhi ubambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende nasemisebenzini yalo. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Abesifazane bangabamba iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngokuvota iqembu lezepolitiki abakholwa ukuthi lizobonisa kangcono imibono nezinkathazo zabo kwiPhalamende. Bangase futhi babambe iqhaza ekuhleleni nasekusebenzeni kweqembu abakhethile futhi ngokukhethwa ezakhiweni zalo. Abesifazane baphakame ezikhundleni eziphakeme ngalendlela. Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuyindaba umphakathi ofuna ukuyizwa, iKomidi leSishayamthetho noma iBhunga leSifunda lingase linqume ukuhlela izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze ukufakwa kwemibono. Umphakathi ungazisa iKomidi leSishayamthetho noma iBhunga leSifunda ngemibono yabo ngezindaba eziphikisanayo.
Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuyindaba umphakathi ofuna ukuyizwa, iKomidi leSishayamthetho noma iBhunga leSifunda lingase linqume ukuhlela izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze ukufakwa kwemibono. Umphakathi ungazisa iKomidi leSishayamthetho noma iBhunga leSifunda ngemibono yabo ngezindaba eziphikisanayo. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana neMenenja yePhalamende ukuze aveze umbono wabo ngendaba ethile yemithetho. UMsunguli weNingizimu Afrika unikeza uhlaka lokukhuthaza ukulingana kobulili nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho. UMsunguli uqukethe izinhlinzeko ezikhuthaza ukulingana kobulili. IBill of Rights iqinisekisa ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika. Ivinjwa ukucwaswa okungadingekile ngokobuhlanga nobulili. IBill of Rights igcizelela ukuthi izinyathelo kumele zithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kokulingana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. UMsunguli unikeza izikhungo ezisekela ukufakwa kwabantu abaningi nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane. Lezi zikhungo zifaka iKomidi Lokulingana Kobulili neKomidi Lezobuntu laseNingizimu Afrika. Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane kwiPhalamende yizikhathi zokhetho. Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweSishayamthetho neBhunga leSifunda. Ukhetho lwesizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abakuthandayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi ibeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa.
Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweSishayamthetho neBhunga leSifunda. Ukhetho lwesizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abakuthandayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi ibeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa. Umgwaqo omusha weZinsiza Zabesifazane, Izingane, nabantu abaneZinkinga Zokusebenza usunguliwe ukuze uqinise imizamo yohulumeni yokukhuthaza nokuvikela abantu abahluphekayo emphakathini wethu. Nakuba abesifazane bebaningi kubantu eNingizimu Afrika, bahlala bengabantu abancane uma kuziwa ezinqumweni. Kunezinkinga eziningi ezivimbela abesifazane ekudlaleni indima ephelele futhi ebonakalayo, kanti eyodwa enkulu yilezi ubumpofu. Ubumpoor buwumsebenzi obhekene nabesifazane abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane basemaphandleni. Ukuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nemfundo, amanzi, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kuvinjwa ubulili, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Ukuze abesifazane babambe iqhaza ngokuphelele ekudalweni kwemithetho, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile kubabesifazane kumele kuthuthukiswe. Abesifazane abahluphekayo banokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ezikhungweni zokudala imithetho. Abaningi babesifazane babhekene nezinselelo zokwakha umnotho. Abesifazane ngokujwayelekile bangumphakathi ophakeme kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi bangase babe ngaphansi kokusebenza noma bengenamsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS luthinta kakhulu ingxenye enkulu yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasha eminyakeni yabo yokukhulelwa.
