U-Karabo Peele no-Moss Malo. U-Thando Lolwane ubengakakhona. Ngomhla ziyi-29 kuSepthemba 2009, uhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development Program lwabamba umcimbi omkhulu - ukujabulisa amalungu e-250 Ton Club. Uhlelo lwe-Farmer Development Program lwezokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu eNingizimu Afrika luhlose ukuphakamisa abalimi abamnyama ngecala elikhulu e-Fanie Ferreira hall e-NAMPO ukuze wamukele futhi wabonga abalimi abafanelekayo ukuba bahlale emhlanganweni wabalimi abamnyama - labo abakhiqiza ngaphezu kwama-250 tons nge-hectare yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu. Indlela yokuba umlimi omnyama wokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu ayilula, futhi awekho amakhono okuthola khona kalula. Ukulima kuyinselele enzima, futhi inzuzo ivame ukuba ncane. Lezi zinkampani zixhaswa abantu abasebenza kuhlelo lwe-Grain Producers Development Program eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa kukhona nabanye abaningi abahlinzeka ngosizo, njengamabhange, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezinikeza izinto zokulima, iziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi oluvela eMnyangweni Wezolimo, nabanye abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Ngonyaka owedlule saphinde savuselela i-250 Ton Club ukuze wamukele labo abalimi abakhiqiza ngaphezu kwama-250 tons njengamanje futhi abaseduze kokubizwa ngokuthi "abalimi bezomnotho." Abaningi balesi sigaba bazoba yingxenye yohlelo lwethu eminyakeni ezayo, ngakho sifuna ukuqaphela umsebenzi wabo omuhle. Amalungu e-250 Ton Club aqhubeka ekhula. Njengamanje sinezikhulu eziyisixhenxe ku-1,000 Ton Club, amalungu ayi-13 ku-500 Ton Club, kanye namalungu ayi-21 ku-250 Ton Club. Kulonyaka, amalungu ayisishiyagalombili angena kuleli Club.
Amalungu e-250 Ton Club aqhubeka ekhula. Njengamanje sinezikhulu eziyisixhenxe ku-1,000 Ton Club, amalungu ayi-13 ku-500 Ton Club, kanye namalungu ayi-21 ku-250 Ton Club. Kulonyaka, amalungu ayisishiyagalombili angena kuleli Club. Emcimbini walonyaka, sethule okuthile okusha - i-Smallholder Farmer Competition yonyaka. E-Mpumalanga nase-Eastern Cape, kukhona abalimi abaningi abakha umhlaba owodwa noma owabili emphakathini. Lezi zabalimi zenze umsebenzi omuhle wokuletha ukudla emphakathini njalo. Ingxenye yale nhlangano ihlose ukuqeqesha nokuxhasa lezi zabalimi ezincane ukuze bakwazi ukuthuthukisa izindlela zabo zokulima. Ngakho-ke, saqala lo mqhudelwano ukuze siqaphele umsebenzi wabo omuhle. Kulonyaka, u-F.J. Mhlanga ophuma e-Mpumalanga no-S.E. Shabhu ophuma e-Eastern Cape bathuthuke. Nokho, lezi zabalimi zisebenzisa izindawo ezincane kahle, ziletha izinto ezinhle emphakathini wazo.
Ukubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke iziguli zikhishwa kahle, zisebenzisa izinsiza ezikhona, futhi ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zithola usizo olufanele. Le nqubo ibalulekile eqinisweni lokuthi iziguli kufanele zaziwa kahle ukuze zikwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okudingayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka okufanele zithathwe ukuze kubhaliswe iziguli ezibhedlela. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlela Ukuvakashela Okokuqala, iziguli kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlela ukuvakashela esibhedlela. Lokhu kungenziwa ngocingo, nge-inthanethi, noma ngezinhlelo zokuqasha ezitholakalayo. Kubalulekile ukuba nesikhathi esithile sokuvakasha ukuze kuqedwe izinkathazo ezihlobene nezikhathi. Isinyathelo 2: Ukulungisa Amadokhumenti Ngaphambi kokuvakasha, iziguli kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinalo lonke ulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Idokhumenti yokuhlonza: Lokhu kungaba ubulawa, ipasipoti, noma enye idokhumenti ekhaliphile. - Amarekhodi empilo: Iziguli kufanele zibe namarekhodi ahlobene nezimo zempilo zazo, izidakamizwa ezithathwayo, nezinkinga ezikhona. - Imininingwane yezezimali: Uma kufaneleka, iziguli kumele zibe nolwazi lwemali yokuhola, uma kudingeka. Isinyathelo 3: Ukufika Esibhedlela Lapho iziguli zifika esibhedlela, kufanele ziqedele izinqubo zokuthola indawo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubhalisela indawo yokuphumula. - Ukulinda ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa kokuphila, okuzobandakanya ukuhlola ingcindezi yegazi, izinga lokushisa, nokuhlola izimpawu zomzimba. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubhaliswa Uma sekuqedile ukuhlolwa, iziguli zizodingeka ukuthi zibhalise.
Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubhalisela indawo yokuphumula. - Ukulinda ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa kokuphila, okuzobandakanya ukuhlola ingcindezi yegazi, izinga lokushisa, nokuhlola izimpawu zomzimba. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubhaliswa Uma sekuqedile ukuhlolwa, iziguli zizodingeka ukuthi zibhalise. Ukwenza lokhu, iziguli kufanele: - Zifake izicelo zazo kumphathi wezokwelapha. - Zikhumbule ukwabelana ngemininingwane ethile, efana nomlando wezokwelapha, izimo zezempilo ezikhona, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. - Ngena kumarekhodi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke iziguli ziqoshwe. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlolwa Ngodokotela Ngemva kokubhaliswa, iziguli zizohlangana nodokotela. Lokhu kulandela izinyathelo ezilandelayo: - Ukuphendula imibuzo ehambisana nezehlakalo zempilo. - Ukujula emishinini ethile yokwazisa, uma kudingekile, njengezithombe noma ukuhlolwa kwegazi. - Ukuxhumana nodokotela mayelana nezinketho zokwelapha. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nezisebenzi Zesibhedlela Iziguli zidinga ukuxhumana nezisebenzi zendawo ukuze ziqonde izinqubo ezithile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: - Ukuqonda imiyalelo yokwelashwa. - Ukuthola ulwazi olunembile mayelana nemithi edingekayo. - Ukucacisa imihlahlandlela yokuphila kahle ngesikhathi sokuphuma. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuphuma Esibhedlela Uma iziguli seziphothule ukwelashwa, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqedele inqubo yokuphuma. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukuthola imiyalelo yokunakekelwa kwekhaya. - Ukukhumbula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuxhumana uma kudingeka. - Ukuthola izinkokhelo eziphelele, uma kufaneleka.
Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukuthola imiyalelo yokunakekelwa kwekhaya. - Ukukhumbula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuxhumana uma kudingeka. - Ukuthola izinkokhelo eziphelele, uma kufaneleka. Isiphetho Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kuyinqubo ebalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ukuqonda lezi zinyathelo ezisemqoka kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezokwelapha, nokwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kweziguli nodokotela. Kubalulekile ukuthi iziguli ziqonde zonke izinqubo ukuze zibe nekhono lokuphila kahle. Ngalolu lwazi, iziguli zingasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze ziqinisekise impilo yazo.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni Lunikeza abalimi imibhalo eningiliziwe mayelana nezolimo njalo ngenyanga ngephephandaba lethu - iPula/Imvula. Izinkulungwane eziyi-18,000 ze-iPula/Imvula zabelwa abalimi ngolimi lwezizathu eziyi-7 njalo ngenyanga - isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiNorthern Sotho, isiZulu, nesiXhosa. Njalo ngenyanga, iPula/Imvula iqukethe amakhasi ayisishiyagalombili asekelwe yiMaize Trust. Kukhona namakhasi amane aphelile ngesiSesotho ngoMashi, ngoJuni, ngoSepthemba, nangoDisemba asekelwe yiWinter Cereals Trust. IIOPOT nayo inamakhasi amane aphelile ngazo zonke izilimi (ngaphandle kwesiXhosa) ngoJanuwari, ngoAprili, ngoJulayi, nangoOkthoba. Sihlala sizama ukufaka imibhalo ezosiza abalimi kulonyaka. Le mibhalo ixoxa ngezindaba eziphathelene nezwe, ezolimo, izindlela zokukhiqiza, ukumaketha, imishini, nokuphathwa kwezindawo zokulima. Sifuna futhi ukubonga abaxhasi bohlelo lwethu ngokusinika ithuba lokufaka isandla emsebenzini wethu wokuthuthukisa nokuguqula ezolimo ezweni lethu.
Umbiko: Ukusetshenziswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ezikoleni Isingeniso Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni sekuyinto ebalulekile emfundweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa amathuluzi afana namakhompyutha, ama-tablet, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile, okwenza kube lula ukufunda nokufundisa. Ubulungiswa bokufunda bukhula ngokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsiza zingasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinga lemfundo. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezemfundo Izikhungo zemfundo ziye zathola izinzuzo eziningi ngokwethula ubuchwepheshe. Ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile kunceda abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olusha kalula. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi zenza kube khona ukufinyelela kwezinsiza eziningi, okwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Lokhu kuthuthukisa umqondo wokuzimela nokuzifundela. Ukuxhumana Nokuqonda Ubuchwepheshe buphinde busebenze njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi. Izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi zenza kube lula ukuxhumana, futhi abafundi bangabeka imibuzo yabo kalula. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuxhumana esivulekile, lapho abafundi bezwa bekhululekile ukufaka imibono yabo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bejabule futhi bephokophele ekufundeni. Ukuphuculwa Kwamakhono Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, abafundi bakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ahlukene. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile, ama-apps, kanye nevidiyo zokufundisa akwazi ukusiza abafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhono okucabanga, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, kanye namakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo.
Ukuphuculwa Kwamakhono Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, abafundi bakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ahlukene. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile, ama-apps, kanye nevidiyo zokufundisa akwazi ukusiza abafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhono okucabanga, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, kanye namakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bukhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokusebenza ngokuqhubekayo, okubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni akukhululekile. Kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalokhu, njengokuntuleka kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuxhumeka ku-inthanethi, kanye nokungabi namakhono afanele kubafundisi. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokufundisa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Ukwenza imihlangano yokufundisa kubafundisi mayelana nezobuchwepheshe kungasiza ekwandiseni amakhono abo. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthuthukisa imfundo. Ngokusebenzisa amakhompyutha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi, abafundi bangathola ulwazi olusha, bathuthukise amakhono, futhi bakhulise ukuxhumana. Nokho, izinkinga ezithile zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi bayathola lezi zinsiza. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zazo zokufundisa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ubuchwepheshe busebenza kahle emfundweni. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele kuzoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emfundweni, kuzo zonke izigaba zempilo yabafundi.
Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Imijondolo 1. Isingeniso Imijondolo iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhiqiza kakhulu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga eliphezulu lempilo nokuphila kwabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa imijondolo ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zesikhathi samanje nezesikhathi esizayo. Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Le nqqubo yokuthuthukisa imijondolo ibhekene nezinhlelo, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlinzekwe ukufinyelela ezimweni ezinhle zokuhlala. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zingoziwa ngezidingo zendawo, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimiso zokuhlala ezifanele. Izinjongo Zokuthuthukiswa Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zinezinto eziningi ezibalulekile: - Ukuhlinzeka indawo ephumelelayo yokuhlala. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imijondolo ihlangabezana nezidingo zokuphepha. - Ukukhuthaza izindlela zokuphila eziphusile nezokuhlala. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo. Uhlelo Lokusebenza Ukuze le nqobo ibe yimpumelelo, kudingeka uhlelo lokusebenza olunembile oluzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukubambisana nohulumeni, izinkampani, nemiphakathi. - Ukuhlelwa kwezinsiza zezimali ukuze kutholakale uxhaso lwezimali. - Ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu abahlala emijondolo ukuze bakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ukubandakanywa Kwemiphakathi Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibenengxenye ekuthuthukiseni imijondolo. Ukubandakanywa kwemiphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezintweni ezidingekayo, kuqinisekiswe ukwamukelwa kwezinhlelo, nokwakha umqondo wokubambisana. Lokhu kungahlanganisa: - Ukuhlanganiswa kwemibono yabantu abahlala emijondolo. - Ukusungulwa kwemihlangano yokubambisana.
Ukubandakanywa kwemiphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezintweni ezidingekayo, kuqinisekiswe ukwamukelwa kwezinhlelo, nokwakha umqondo wokubambisana. Lokhu kungahlanganisa: - Ukuhlanganiswa kwemibono yabantu abahlala emijondolo. - Ukusungulwa kwemihlangano yokubambisana. - Ukuxhumana ngokuqondile phakathi kwabantu nabaholi bendawo. Ukuxhaswa Kwemali Ukuze izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zisebenze kahle, kudingeka imithombo ethile yokuxhaswa kwemali. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni. - Ukuthola uxhaso olubhalwe phansi. - Ukubambisana nezinkampani ezingase zibe nezinhloso ezihlangene. Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Ukuze uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuhlela nokuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile zokuhlala, ukuvikela izinsiza, nokusebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi. Ukubeka Phambili Izidingo Zomphakathi Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele zibe nokuqondisa okuphelele kwezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo njengamanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Ukubeka phambili izidingo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza. Lokhu kufanele kube: - Ukuhlolwa okwenziwa minyaka yonke. - Ukuhlaziywa kwemiphumela yokuphila kwabantu. - Ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi izinhlelo ziyaqhubeka zisebenza ngokuphumelelayo. 10. Isiphetho Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nowanelisayo.
- Ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi izinhlelo ziyaqhubeka zisebenza ngokuphumelelayo. 10. Isiphetho Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nowanelisayo. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze, kudingeka ukubambisana okuphelele phakathi kwabaholi bendawo, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukiswa kwemijondolo, kulethe inhlalakahle nokuthula kubantu bonke abahlala kulezi zindawo. 11. Ukubhaliswa Nokuxhumana Imiphakathi ivunyelwe ukufaka imibono nezicelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemijondolo kuhulumeni ukuze kuhanjiswe izidingo ezithile. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngendlela yokuxhumana eqondile, ngempela kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zendawo. 12. Izinsiza Zokuqhuba Ukuze sithuthukise le nqobo, sinezinsiza ezithile ezibandakanya: - Izikhungo zokuqeqesha. - Amathuluzi okuxhumana. - Izinsiza zokufinyelela. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo ziyaphumelela, zigcine abantu bethu bephila kahle. 13. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemiyalelo Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele zinikeze imiyalelo ecacile nezinyathelo ezithile ezizodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisheshayo nezimisele ukufeza izinjongo ezibekwe. 14. Uhlaka Lwezomthetho Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa imijondolo lufanele luhambisane nemithetho nemigomo efanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imijondolo iyavikeleka futhi iyahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizobhekana nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuthuthukisa imijondolo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu.
14. Uhlaka Lwezomthetho Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa imijondolo lufanele luhambisane nemithetho nemigomo efanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imijondolo iyavikeleka futhi iyahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizobhekana nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuthuthukisa imijondolo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu. Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele lube yisisekelo sokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwezindawo ezisempilweni.
Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni (AI in public administration) Umbuzo 1: Yini ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) futhi kungani kubalulekile kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) ubhekisela kumakhono wekhompuyutha okwenza izinqumo, ukufunda, nokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngendlela efana nokuhlangenwe nakho komuntu. Kubalulekile kuhulumeni ngoba kungenza izinqubo zibe nezindlela eziphumelelayo, kunciphise isikhathi sokusebenza, futhi kuthuthukise ukuxhumana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nezakhamuzi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izindlela ezilula zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ziningi izindlela zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza: I-AI ingasiza ekuphatheni izinsiza zomphakathi ngokuhlaziya idatha futhi inikeze izincomo zokuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswe kanjani kahle. Izinsizakalo zokuxhumana: Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa i-AI zingathuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kukahulumeni nezakhamizi, njengokusebenzisa ama-chatbots ukuze kube lula ukuphendula imibuzo. Ukuxilongwa kwezinkinga: I-AI ingasiza ekuhloleni nasekuxilongeni izinkinga ezithile emphakathini, ikakhulukazi lezo eziyingozi, ukuze uHulumeni uthole izixazululo ezisheshayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni zifaka: - Ukuphumelela: I-AI ingasiza ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisheshayo nezisebenza kahle, okwenza izinqubo zibe ngcono. - Ukunciphisa izindleko: Ngokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-AI ingase isize ukunciphisa izindleko zokusebenza.
Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni zifaka: - Ukuphumelela: I-AI ingasiza ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisheshayo nezisebenza kahle, okwenza izinqubo zibe ngcono. - Ukunciphisa izindleko: Ngokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-AI ingase isize ukunciphisa izindleko zokusebenza. - Ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo: I-AI ingahlinzeka ngensizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu, ukwenyusa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinselelo zihlanganisa: - Ukuphepha kwedatha: Ukusebenzisa i-AI kudinga ukuvikeleka kwedatha, njengoba izinkampani nohulumeni badinga ukuvikela imininingwane yabantu. - Ukungabi nankinga kwezobuchwepheshe: Uhlelo lwe-AI lungase lungasebenzi kahle uma kungekho ubuchwepheshe obufanele, okungaholela ekunganeliseki. - Ukwamukela: Abantu abaningi bangase babe nezinselelo zokwamukela ubuchwepheshe obusha, okungase kube nomthelela ekuphumeleleni kokusebenzisa i-AI. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni emhlabeni? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona izibonelo eziningi: - E-Estonia: UHulumeni wase-Estonia usebenzisa i-AI ukuphatha izicelo zokuhweba, ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula. - E-United States: Izinhlelo zokuhlaziya idatha ezisebenzisa i-AI ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze kuhlolwe izidingo zabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo.
Umbuzo 5: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni emhlabeni? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona izibonelo eziningi: - E-Estonia: UHulumeni wase-Estonia usebenzisa i-AI ukuphatha izicelo zokuhweba, ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula. - E-United States: Izinhlelo zokuhlaziya idatha ezisebenzisa i-AI ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze kuhlolwe izidingo zabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. - E-Singapore: Uhlelo lwe-AI lwenziwa ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga zomphakathi, ngaphandle kokubanga ukwephula umthetho. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uHulumeni aqhubeke nokusebenzisa i-AI? Impendulo: Ukuze uHulumeni aqhubeke nokusebenzisa i-AI, izinyathelo ezibalulekile zifaka: 1. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqeqeshwe kahle ukuze basebenzise i-AI ngempumelelo. Ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo: Uhlelo oluqinile lwezokuphepha nolwezemvelo luzodingeka ukuvimbela imiphumela emibi ehambisana ne-AI. Ukubambisana: Ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, uhulumeni kufanele ubambisane nezinkampani ezizimele kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ibhekwane kakhulu uma kuziwa ekusetshenzisweni kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Okokuqala, ukuvikeleka kwedatha kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yabantu ivikelwe. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuhle kwabasebenzi nabantu, ukuze kube neziqondiso ezicacile nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene kuhulumeni. Umbuzo 8: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa kanjani?
Impendulo: Okokuqala, ukuvikeleka kwedatha kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yabantu ivikelwe. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuhle kwabasebenzi nabantu, ukuze kube neziqondiso ezicacile nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene kuhulumeni. Umbuzo 8: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa kanjani? Impendulo: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa ngokuhlola imiphumela engaba khona, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-AI ayikhubazi izigaba ezithile zomphakathi futhi ithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza kubo bonke. Ukuhlola njalo ukusebenza kwe-AI kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okuhle kwezinguquko ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 9: Ubulungiswa besimo se-AI kungakhuthazwa kanjani? Impendulo: Ukuze bulungiswe, kubalulekile ukufaka imithetho eqinile yokulawula i-AI, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kwabantu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa izimiso zokulingana, ubulungiswa, nokulungiselela izidingo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 10: Yintoni esikhathini esizayo esilindelekile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Esikhathini esizayo, silindele ukuthi uHulumeni uzokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ezindaweni eziningi, okubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, ukuxilongwa kwezinkinga, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza ngendlela ethuthukile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi ngokwenanela kwezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngale ndlela, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buphakathi kwezinsiza ezibaluleke kakhulu ezizokwenza uhulumeni ube nokusebenza okuhle nokuphumelelayo, ngaphakathi komphakathi.
Umphakathi ungumuntu owawulwa empini yeMpi Yezwe Yokuqala noma yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili noma owawulwa empini yaseKorea. Labo abathola usizo lwezenhlalakahle, abangakwazi ukuzinakekela futhi badinga ukunakekelwa ngaso sonke isikhathi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olungaphezu kwalolo lwezenhlalakahle. Imali yokusiza abadala abavela ku-2008 kuyi-R960 ngenyanga. Kufanele uhlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola isimo sezimali. Ukuhlola isimo sezimali kwabantu abahlala ekhaya kuwukuthi uhulumeni uhla izimo zezimali zalowo mndeni. Ukuze uthole usizo, imali yakho kufanele ibe phansi kwenani elithile. Ngo-2008, ukuhlola kwezimali kokusiza abadala abavela kumuntu ongashadile kwakhomba ukuthi uma impahla yakho ibalwe ngaphezulu kwe-R451,200, awuzotholi usizo. Umndeni ophila kuwo awubalwa uma kuhlolwa, futhi imali yakho kufanele ibe phansi kwe-R26,928 ngonyaka uma ungashadile. Uma ushade, awuzotholi usizo uma impahla yenu ihlanganiswe ibalwe ngaphezulu kwe-R902,400. Umndeni ophila kuwo awubalwa uma kuhlolwa. Imali yenu ehambisanayo kufanele ibe phansi kwe-R53,856 ngonyaka. Awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abahlala ezindlini zikahulumeni futhi awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abathola usizo lwezimali ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Icheki yenani elithile ngosuku oluthile efakwe ku-akhawunti yomuntu siqu ingatholakala ngeposi ezindaweni ezithile, njengasezindaweni lapho abantu abadala behlala khona. Uma ungasebenzi kahle noma ugula kakhulu futhi ungakwazi ukuhamba ehhovisi, cela omunye umuntu ukuba acela ukuthi ihhovisi likuvakashele.
Awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abahlala ezindlini zikahulumeni futhi awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abathola usizo lwezimali ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Icheki yenani elithile ngosuku oluthile efakwe ku-akhawunti yomuntu siqu ingatholakala ngeposi ezindaweni ezithile, njengasezindaweni lapho abantu abadala behlala khona. Uma ungasebenzi kahle noma ugula kakhulu futhi ungakwazi ukuhamba ehhovisi, cela omunye umuntu ukuba acela ukuthi ihhovisi likuvakashele. Lo muntu kufanele aze neposi elivela kuwe noma iposi elivela kudokotela elikhombisa ukuthi awukwazi ukuza ehhovisi ngoba ugula. Izinhlelo zingahlelwa ukuze bavakashele. Thumela ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo elandelayo: ubufakazi bokuthi wakhonza emkhosini bungaba isiqinisekiso somkhosi noma amarekhodi omkhosi. I-affidavit eqinisekiswe yilungu elihloniphekile lomphakathi elaziwa umfakisicelo. Uma ungashadile, isitatimende sokuthi ungashadile; uma ushade, isiqinisekiso somshado; uma uhlukaniswe nomkakho, isiqinisekiso sokuhlukaniswa; uma umkakho eshonile, isiqinisekiso sokufa. Uma usemsebenzini, iphephandaba; uma ungasebenzi, incwadi eluhlaza ekhombisa ukuthi awusebenzi noma isiqinisekiso sokupheliswa emsebenzini wakho wangaphambilini uma unepenshini yangasese, ubufakazi balo msebenzi; uma unayo i-akhawunti yasebhange, isitatimende seminyaka emithathu elandelanayo uma kukhona lapho ufake khona imali, ulwazi ngenzalo yakho ku-imeyili yakho noma isabelo sayo. Thola i-receipt futhi uyigcine njengobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo. Uzokwaziswa ngeposi ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanseliwe, ihhovisi lezokuphepha kwezenhlalakahle izokubhalela incwadi echaza izizathu zokukhansela isicelo sakho.
Thola i-receipt futhi uyigcine njengobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo. Uzokwaziswa ngeposi ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanseliwe, ihhovisi lezokuphepha kwezenhlalakahle izokubhalela incwadi echaza izizathu zokukhansela isicelo sakho. Uma ungavumelani nesinqumo sabo, ungafaka isikhalazo kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezokuhlala noma ilungu lekhansela echaza ukuthi kungani ungavumelani nesinqumo sabo. Isikhalazo kufanele sithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 ngemuva kokuthola impendulo yesicelo sakho. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-21 ukuze processing yesicelo sakho. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uzokhokhelwa kusukela ngosuku olufake isicelo. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhelwa.
Ibhizinisi elifuna ukushintsha imininingwane yokubhaliswa kumele liqedele ifomu lesicelo njengoba kudingwa umthetho. Imininingwane encane kuphela ingashintshwa ngaphandle kokuhambisa ifomu. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela ku-website: I-Companies and Intellectual Property Registration Office. Shintsha imininingwane yebhizinisi ku-inthanethi. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo sokubhaliswa ku-inthanethi ngeke kukuvumele ukufinyelela endaweni yokusebenza evumela ukuthi wenze izinguquko eminininingwaneni yebhizinisi lakho. Ukuvunywa kokubhaliswa kuthatha usuku olulodwa noma ezimbili, futhi uzokwazi ukwenza izinguquko kuphela ngemuva kokuvunywa. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa. Shintsha imininingwane yebhizinisi ku-inthanethi.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuxazulula izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqhubeka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Kagesi uyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke, futhi izinkinga ezihlobene nakho zingaba nemiphumela emibi emiphakathini nasemabhizinisini. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkinga ezithinta ugesi zihlolwe ngokuqinile futhi zixazululwe ngendlela efanele. ### Isizathu Sokulalelwa Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kuvame ukwenzeka uma kukhona izikhalazo ezivela kubantu, amabhizinisi, noma iziphathimandla ezikhathazekile ngalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkinga ezifana nokuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, izindleko eziphezulu zokusebenzisa ugesi, noma izinkinga zokuphepha ezihlobene nokusetshenziswa kukagesi. Ukulalelwa kwenziwa ukuze kuhlanganyelwe imibono, iziphakamiso, nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. ### Izinyathelo Zokulalelwa 1. Ukubiza Ukulalelwa: IPhalamende libiza ukulalelwa ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga ezithile. Lokhu kungenziwa ngamalungu ePhalamende, iziphathimandla, noma ngababambiqhaza abavela emiphakathini. Ukubamba Izingxoxo: Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngogesi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi ziba nezingxoxo ezijulile. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kwemibono kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe kahle izinkinga ezikhona. Ukulalela Izinkulumo: IPhalamende lihlola izinkulumo ezivela kubabambiqhaza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abamele izinkampani zikagesi, osomabhizinisi, nabantu abajwayelekile abathintekayo. Izinkulumo zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene.
Ukulalela Izinkulumo: IPhalamende lihlola izinkulumo ezivela kubabambiqhaza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abamele izinkampani zikagesi, osomabhizinisi, nabantu abajwayelekile abathintekayo. Izinkulumo zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene. Ukuhlola Ubufakazi: Ngemuva kokulalela, iPhalamende ihlola ubufakazi obuhambisana nezinkulumo ezitholakele. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokubheka imibiko, izifundo, nezifundo ezenziwe ngocwaningo. Ubufakazi buhloswe ukusiza ekuthatheni izinqumo eziphusile. Ukuthuthukisa Izixazululo: Ngemva kokuhlola ubufakazi, iPhalamende idinga ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezintsha, ukwandisa izinsiza, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezixazululo eziphumelelayo. ### Izinselelo Eziyinhloko Noma kunjalo, ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kunezinselelo ezithile. Lezi zifaka phakathi: - Ukungabi Nabo Ubuchwepheshe Obuphezulu: Ezinye izinkampani zikagesi zingase zingabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlola izinkinga, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. - Ukungavumi Kwezinhlaka: Abanye abantu bangase bangavumi izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe, okwenza kube nzima ukuvuma izinqumo ezithile. - Izinsiza Ezinganele: Ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngogesi emiphakathini ethile kungaholela ekutheni izinkinga zibe nzima kakhulu.

Le nqubo idinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga zihlolwe ngokujulile, futhi izixazululo eziphumelelayo zikhishwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezithuthukisa ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola ugesi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila impilo engcono.
Umthwali wezintela angafaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi sokuhambisa ifomu lakhe lokubuyisela izintela. Uma ikheli lomthwali wezintela lingaziwa yiMnyango Wezintela waseNingizimu Afrika. Uma irekhodi yomthwali wezintela ingakhombisi ukuthi ubhalisiwe. Uma inkampani noma ubudlelwano bungakhombisi ukuthi kusebenze. Uma umthwali wezintela eshintshe indawo. Uma irekhodi yomthwali wezintela ikhombisa ukuthi ushonile, noma usebenzisa zonke izimali zakhe. Uma imibhalo yezintela yale nyaka ingakatholwanga yiMnyango wezintela. Uma iMnyango wezintela ithumele incwadi ephuthumayo icela umthwali wezintela ukuthi ahambise imibhalo yakhe yezintela ngonyaka othile. Uma imibhalo yezintela ingakathunyelwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo sesidlule. Uma inani lezintela lingakakhokhwa futhi izinhlelo zokwandiswa kwesikhathi zingakwenziwanga. Uma imibhalo yezintela yale nyaka ingakakhishwa yiMnyango wezintela. Uma umthwali wezintela engabophelelwe ukukhokha izintela zonyaka lowo. Uma umuntu efaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi ngaphezu kwesikhathi esibekiwe uma kubhekwa izimo zomthwali wezintela. Uma amarekhodi omthwali wezintela ehlonyiswe kwenye isigaba. Uma imibhalo yezintela noma inani le-VAT lingakakhokhwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo sesidlule noma engakaceli ukwandisa isikhathi sokuhambisa inani le-VAT.
Uma umuntu efaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi ngaphezu kwesikhathi esibekiwe uma kubhekwa izimo zomthwali wezintela. Uma amarekhodi omthwali wezintela ehlonyiswe kwenye isigaba. Uma imibhalo yezintela noma inani le-VAT lingakakhokhwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo sesidlule noma engakaceli ukwandisa isikhathi sokuhambisa inani le-VAT. Uma isitatimende se-PAYE, noma imibhalo yezintela noma inani lezintela lingakathunyelwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo nezitatimende sesidlule noma engakaceli ukwandisa isikhathi sokuhambisa inani lezintela. Faka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi sokukhokha izintela ngokuvakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-SARS noma nge-imeyili. Bhala incwadi ecela ukwandiswa kwesikhathi esikhethekile sokukhokha izintela, uyithumele ehhovisi le-SARS eliseduzane. Uma isicelo sivunyiwe, uzothola isaziso nge-imeyili, usebenzisa ikheli le-imeyili olinikezile. Uma ungahlinzeki ngekheli le-imeyili, ungaxhumana nehhovisi le-SARS eliseduzane ngemva kosuku olunye lokusebenza. Le nsizakalo iyamahala. Bhalisela ku-inthanethi.
Ikhansela lezeMvelo laseNingizimu Afrika livuma ukuthi abanye abantu abatholanga ithuba lokufunda baphinde bafinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu elidingekayo yikhansela elibhalisela abantu emisebenzini ethile. Nokho, lezi zinsizwa zitholwe zidlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini wezobuchwepheshe eminyakeni edlule futhi zingaqhubeka nokwenza njalo eminyakeni ezayo. Ikhansela lenze isinqumo sokunikeza lezi zinsizwa ithuba lokufaka izicelo zokubhaliswa njengabaFundi Bezemvelo emsebenzini abazifundele ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Noma ubani ongenawo amaphepha emisebenzi noma owaziwa yikhansela angafaka isicelo. Bahlonishwa ngababambisene nabo ngolwazi abanalo emsebenzini abawukhethile kanye nendima ethile abayidlalile emphakathini wezobuchwepheshe, banolwazi abafundile okungaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi futhi abangabancane ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo somsebenzi abawufakayo. Isixwayiso: uma usushiyile umsebenzi owafundele eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, ngeke uvunyelwe ukubhaliswa ngaphansi kwalo hlelo. Gcwalisa ifomu lokubhaliswa elisemthethweni. Ubufakazi bokufunda esikoleni nasemakhaya - amakhophi ezitifiketi zokufunda ezibhalwe uphiko lwezepolitiki nazo zidingeka kanye nemininingwane efundwe esikoleni, amarekhodi ajulile olwazini oluhambisana nomsebenzi ofundwe, uhlu lwamaphepha noma izincwadi ozibhalele, ubufakazi bokuba yilungu ezinhlelweni zabantu abafundile ezifana neSouth African Food Science Association, noma iSouth African Chemical Society; iSouth African National and Mining Organization. Izibalo ezintathu ozibhalele noma lapho udlale indima ebalulekile ekubhaleni kwazo. Uma ungakwazi ukufaka ezinye izibalo ngenxa yokuthile okuphikisana, kuzodingeka ubufakazi bokuthi uzibhalele.
Ubufakazi bokufunda esikoleni nasemakhaya - amakhophi ezitifiketi zokufunda ezibhalwe uphiko lwezepolitiki nazo zidingeka kanye nemininingwane efundwe esikoleni, amarekhodi ajulile olwazini oluhambisana nomsebenzi ofundwe, uhlu lwamaphepha noma izincwadi ozibhalele, ubufakazi bokuba yilungu ezinhlelweni zabantu abafundile ezifana neSouth African Food Science Association, noma iSouth African Chemical Society; iSouth African National and Mining Organization. Izibalo ezintathu ozibhalele noma lapho udlale indima ebalulekile ekubhaleni kwazo. Uma ungakwazi ukufaka ezinye izibalo ngenxa yokuthile okuphikisana, kuzodingeka ubufakazi bokuthi uzibhalele. Izifungo ezivela kubantu ababili abangakwazi ukufakazela kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle lo msebenzi. Ukubhaliswa kungathatha amasonto angu-6 kuya kwangu-8 kuye ngokuthi imibhalo edingekayo igcwele. Abantu ababili abakhethwe yikomidi elinconyiwe kulowo msebenzi bazokubuza imibuzo ephathelene nesicelo sakho. Umphumela wokuhlola kwakho uzokwaziswa ngemuva komhlangano omkhulu wekhansela. Imininingwane yekhompyutha yeBhange nokufaka imali ebhange: Sicela usebenzise amahlamvu okuqala amagama akho nesibongo ukukhombisa ukukhokha kwethu kwi-akhawunti yethu yebhange futhi uhlanganise ubufakazi bokukhokha kanye nekhasi lokuqala lesicelo sakho ku-841 1057.
Ithini leli qembu lokufunda? Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zehlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabathengisi bezolimo ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuphatha amaqembu okufunda. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukukhuthaza abakhiqizi abasafufusa abangenasemafamu ukuba bakhe amaqembu okufunda ukuze bahlangane njalo ukuze baphinde bahlolisise ukuqeqeshwa okukhona nolwazi oluhambelana nokukhiqizwa kweziphuzo. Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS: Isingeniso Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo sekuyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wamanje. I-GEMS, inhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo, ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu luhlala lukhuselekile. Lesi sithangami sizogxila ekubalulekeni kokuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, izinqubo ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwa yi-GEMS ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kolwazi lwezempilo. Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi lwezempilo Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo kubandakanya izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwabantu oluhambisana nezempilo luhlala lukhuselekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ulwazi lwezempilo luyimfihlo futhi lungase luthinteke kalula uma lungavikelwe kahle. I-GEMS ibona ukuvikelwa kolwazi njengomgomo ophambili, okubonakala ezinqubweni zayo ezikhethekile. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ulwazi I-GEMS ithatha izinyathelo eziningi ukuze iqinisekise ukuphepha kolwazi lwezempilo. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zayo zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi luhlala lukhona kuphela kubantu abafanele. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinjengezokufihla ulwazi, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula ukufinyelela kolwazi. Okwesibili, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayo baqeqeshwa ngokuqinile mayelana nokuvikelwa kolwazi. Ukuqeqeshwa kubalulekile ukuze bonke abasebenzi baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangaluvikela kanjani ulwazi lwabantu.
Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinjengezokufihla ulwazi, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula ukufinyelela kolwazi. Okwesibili, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayo baqeqeshwa ngokuqinile mayelana nokuvikelwa kolwazi. Ukuqeqeshwa kubalulekile ukuze bonke abasebenzi baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangaluvikela kanjani ulwazi lwabantu. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kuhlanganisa izifundo ezisemthethweni, izinkulumo, kanye nezifundo ezibukhoma. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma i-GEMS ithatha izinyathelo eziningi, izinkinga zokuphepha kolwazi zisekhona. Ukuhlaselwa kwezobuchwepheshe, okungaba yizigebengu ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze zithole ulwazi, kuyinkinga enkulu. I-GEMS ibhekana nalezi zinkinga ngokuqinisa izinhlelo zayo zokuphepha, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zayo zihlala zisesikhathini nezinguquko ezibhekene nezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibambisana nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zayo zokuvikelwa kolwazi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana nezinhlangano eziphethe izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, kanye nokubambisana nezinhlangano eziphethe izifundo zokuvikela ulwazi. Ukubaluleka Kokuvikelwa Kolwazi Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akukhona nje kuphela okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kolwazi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuze kwandiswe ukwethenjwa kwabantu. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luhlala lukhuselekile, bazoba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni izinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni i-GEMS ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle kakhulu, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emphakathini.
Ukubaluleka Kokuvikelwa Kolwazi Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akukhona nje kuphela okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kolwazi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuze kwandiswe ukwethenjwa kwabantu. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luhlala lukhuselekile, bazoba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni izinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni i-GEMS ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle kakhulu, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Isiphetho I-GEMS ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, futhi izinyathelo zayo zokuphepha ziqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwabantu luhlala lukhuselekile. Ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zayo, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokubambisana nezinhlangano ezahlukene, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zayo zihlala ziphephile futhi zethembekile. Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo kuzoba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, futhi kuzokwenza abantu bazethembise ekutholeni izinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS izoqhubeka nokuba isibonelo sokuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, iqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zayo zihlala ziphambili emhlabeni wezempilo.
Ukuphathwa kwemali okulindelekile, ngokwezimvo ezithile, unyaka nonyaka kulolu hlelo lwezimali oluhlelwe isikhathi esithile, kuhlukanisa imali etholakalayo naleyo esetshenziswe ngaleso sikhathi. Ungangitshela ngezinto ezibalulekile kuwe. Ngikhombise lapho uchitha khona imali yakho, bese ngikutshela ukuthi lezo zinto zingobani. Namuhla, sizobonisa amalungu anhloniphekile lapho sihlose ukusebenzisa khona imali yethu, bese usitshela ukuthi lokhu kuhambisana nezinto ezibalulekile esifundazweni sethu. Kodwa khumbula, "Imali iyinsiza kuphela. Ingakuthola lapho ofuna ukuya khona, kodwa ayikwazi ukuthatha indawo yakho njengomshayeli." Noma, ngamagama kaMadiba wethu othandekayo, "Imali ayikwazi ukudala impumelelo; kuyilungelo lokudala elizokwenza." Unyaka ka-2010 unyaka lapho sizokwenza izinto ngendlela ehlukile. Indlela entsha yokwenza izinto ibonisa umbono wethu wezwe lethu nesifunda sethu futhi iboniswa kahle ngama-12 imiphumela. Uhulumeni waseKwaZulu-Natal wenza lokhu ngokwethembeka, ngokushesha, nangokuzikhandla. Ukuze sifinyelele umbono wethu ophakathi kwalezi zimpumelelo, isifunda sihlinzeke ngohlelo lokuqoqa idatha oluholwa ihhovisi lePhini. Lolu hlelo lwenziwa ngokuhola abantu abazithandayo. Basebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze benze ucwaningo futhi babhale izidingo zomphakathi wethu behamba emakhaya. Idatha ephelele yeziqalo izosivumela ukuthi sibone amazinga obubha, isimo sempilo, kanye nezinga lemfundo emphakathini. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka isifunda ngemininingwane eyanele ukuze kuqhamuke nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo ezizoba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bethu.
Basebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze benze ucwaningo futhi babhale izidingo zomphakathi wethu behamba emakhaya. Idatha ephelele yeziqalo izosivumela ukuthi sibone amazinga obubha, isimo sempilo, kanye nezinga lemfundo emphakathini. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka isifunda ngemininingwane eyanele ukuze kuqhamuke nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo ezizoba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bethu. Izindleko ezihambisana nokuhola abantu abazithandayo abaningi ukuze benze ucwaningo lwezindlu emiphakathini ziyaqoqwa, ngakho-ke imali yalolu hlelo izotholakala uma isabelomali sithathwa sika-2010/11. Okwamanje, iminyango kahulumeni ephethe lolu hlelo kufanele isebenzise imali etholakalayo ukuze iqhube lezi zinhlelo. Izinto ezibalulekile esifundeni ukuze sifinyelele lezi zimpumelelo eziyi-12 zisazothola ukwesekwa, futhi ozakwethu, oNgqongqoshe, bazochaza lokhu uma beveza izabelomali zabo. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlalisana kahle nokuziphatha okuhle emphakathini. Isimo somnotho esingesihle samanje sikhulise imibuzo mayelana nokuziphatha nokubaluleka, futhi kukhona umuzwa oqinile wokuthi umhlaba udinga umqondo omusha wezomnotho ozosibonisa intuthuko. Kumele sifunde eziphuthumayo esizenzile kanye nezokwenziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Sizokwenza le mkhankaso ngombhalo othi YENZA OKUNGEKHO KAHLE NGOKUNCANE. Asizukwehlisa izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu, kodwa sizogxila ekusebenzeni ngokuzikhandla, ngokucophelela, nangokuhlakanipha ukuze siphumelele kulolu simo somnotho esingesihle. Nokho, namuhla sihlangana emoyeni wokubheka impumelelo. Umnotho wethu awuhambi kahle njengamanje.
Asizukwehlisa izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu, kodwa sizogxila ekusebenzeni ngokuzikhandla, ngokucophelela, nangokuhlakanipha ukuze siphumelele kulolu simo somnotho esingesihle. Nokho, namuhla sihlangana emoyeni wokubheka impumelelo. Umnotho wethu awuhambi kahle njengamanje. Empeleni, sikhula ngesilinganiso esiphezulu kunalokho okulindelekile ngenxa yesinqubomgomo sethu somnotho. Njengoba unyaka odlule sahlulelwa ukuba ngu-15 emncintiswaneni wezomnotho emhlabeni, iNingizimu Afrika manje ibalwa ku-6 phakathi kwezizwe eziyi-133 "ngokubonga ukusebenza kahle kwamabhange." Umnotho womhlaba ukhula ngesivinini esikhulu kunalokho okwakucatshangwa ngaphambili. Njengoba umnotho womhlaba uzinzile kusukela ekwehlisweni komnotho kuka-2009, iMali Yomhlaba (IMF) iphoqelekile ukuba ibuyekeze ukubikezela kwayo kokukhula komnotho phezulu kuya ku-3.9% kulonyaka no-4.3% ku-2011. ENingizimu Afrika, iNhlangano Yezimali Yezwe ibikezela ukukhula kwe-GDP yangempela okungu-2.3% ku-2010 no-3.2% ku-2011. Ukubuyela ezingeni lokukhula elingu-5% nangaphezulu minyaka yonke kuzodinga ukuthi sisebenze kanzima. Sidinga ukuqinisa imizamo yethu, ikakhulukazi ekubandakanyeni intsha emnothweni, ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, nakubantu abaphucukile. Nokho, ngenkathi sinesithakazelo, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi asikaphumi emathafeni. Ngaphandle kokukhula komnotho okwenzeka esigabeni sokugcina sika-2009, kokubili umnotho wesizwe kanye nowesifunda kube nokuqina unyaka nonyaka. Ukwanda kwe-25% kwemali yokukhanyisa ngama-Eskom kuncane kunalokho okwakuphakanyisiwe.
Nokho, ngenkathi sinesithakazelo, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi asikaphumi emathafeni. Ngaphandle kokukhula komnotho okwenzeka esigabeni sokugcina sika-2009, kokubili umnotho wesizwe kanye nowesifunda kube nokuqina unyaka nonyaka. Ukwanda kwe-25% kwemali yokukhanyisa ngama-Eskom kuncane kunalokho okwakuphakanyisiwe. Imiphumela yale ngqungquthela yezomnotho ibalulekile futhi ihluke-hluke. Kube nentuthuko enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho nasezikhathini zomsebenzi kusukela ngo-2001-2008. I-International Labour Organization ibika ukuthi abantu abalinganiselwa ku-34 million balahlekelwe yimisebenzi emhlabeni jikelele ezinyangeni ezingu-18 ezedlule. IBhange Lomhlaba libikezela ukuthi abantu abangu-200 million bangase baphume emnothweni ngenxa yale ngqungquthela yezomnotho. ENingizimu Afrika, abantu abangu-870,000 balahlekelwe yimisebenzi, baqala le ngqungquthela. Esifundeni saseKwaZulu-Natal, abantu abangu-220,000 balahlekelwe yimisebenzi ngenyanga yesine ka-2009. Ngempela, lezi zimpumelelo ezimbi zivame ukuhlasela kakhulu labo abalready bephucukile. Ngokuvamile, ithinta intsha nabesifazane, abenza ingxenye enkulu yokuhlala okuphucukile. Lezi zibalo eziphansi zisihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokungabi nemisebenzi ngokwenhlangano yobudala. Kucacile ukuthi kumele sigxile kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi entsha. Uhulumeni unendlela ephindwe kabili yokubhekana nale nkinga - isixazululo sesikhashana esizobhekana nalabo abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi ngenxa ye ngqungquthela yezomnotho njengoba kuboniswe emgqeni wesivumelwano, bese kuba nezinhlelo ezizobhekana nalabo abangasebenzi nabantu abashiywe emuva ekufuneni umsebenzi.
Lezi zibalo eziphansi zisihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokungabi nemisebenzi ngokwenhlangano yobudala. Kucacile ukuthi kumele sigxile kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi entsha. Uhulumeni unendlela ephindwe kabili yokubhekana nale nkinga - isixazululo sesikhashana esizobhekana nalabo abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi ngenxa ye ngqungquthela yezomnotho njengoba kuboniswe emgqeni wesivumelwano, bese kuba nezinhlelo ezizobhekana nalabo abangasebenzi nabantu abashiywe emuva ekufuneni umsebenzi. Ngalesi sizathu, ngifuna ukuphinda ngiphinde ngikhumbuze ngokubiza kwePhini okwenziwe ngesikhathi sikhuluma esifundeni sokuthi izinkampani kumele zithole ithuba lokuhola uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluhlinzekiwe. Ukwehla komnotho nakho kuyazwakala ezimali zikahulumeni. Ukuqoqwa kwemali ezingeni lesizwe akuzange kusebenze kahle ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2009/10, kwehla ngaphezu kwe-R69 billion. Kulindeleke ukuthi le ndlela izoqhubeka ngisho nasekukhuleni kwezezimali ka-2010/11 ngenxa yokwehla kokuhola kwemali. Ngenkathi iNingizimu Afrika ikwazile ukugcina igama elihle "lokuba namabhange asebenza kahle" ekubolekeni ngemali enenzuzo ephansi, sonke siyazi ukuthi imali iyimpahla ebizayo, futhi kumele siqaphele ukuthi singazifaka kanjani ezikweletini. Ngokuvamile, amazwe abolekayo kakhulu (iJapane, iGreece, ne-Italy) kulindeleke ukuthi akhule umnotho wawo kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kunamazwe anokweleta okuncane (iChina neChile). Ukwanda kwezinga lokubolekwa kwemali kuholele ekwandeni okukhulu kwezikweletu zesizwe, okwenza kube nom
Uhulumeni uqale uhlelo lokwabelana ngama-parcel okudla emindenini ehluphekayo kakhulu. Kubalwe ukuthi uhulumeni uzosebenzisa u-R230 million kulo nyaka ukusiza emindenini engu-200,000 ebhekene nezinkinga zokuphila ukuze ifinyelele ekudleni okunempilo ngenkathi iphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka ezinzima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imindeni enezingane. Okwamanje, kunezimuli eziyi-12,000 ezithola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Iminye imindeni izothola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo oluzoqala ngoMashi 2003. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ekudleni okunempilo okugcwele ama-vitamini nezinto ezidingekayo (ukuthuthukiswa kokudla). Izigaba zezeMidlalo, Ezolimo, Ezempilo, Ezemfundo, Uhlelo Lokuxhumana Nohulumeni (GCIS), iNational Development Agency, kanye ne-Independent Development Trust zisebenze ndawonye nezinhlelo zokholo, izinyunyana, umkhakha wezokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo ezingekho kuhulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imindeni ehluphekayo inekudla. Isahluko 1: Ukuqonda Izikhathi Zokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezinsukwini zethu, ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kubaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma kwenzeka ingozi, umcimbi ongamukeleki, noma isimo sokuhlukumeza, kufanele sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Isikhathi sokuphendula sisho ukuthi sithatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze sithole usizo noma sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze silungise isimo. Ukuze sithuthukise lesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu nezinto ezifanele. Isahluko 2: Izimbangela Zokuphendula Ngaphezu Kwesikhathi Kunezimo eziningi ezingadala ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula sibe sephuthumayo. Okokuqala, inkinobho yokuqala yenza kubaluleke kakhulu ukwazi izindawo zokugcina ulwazi, njengemithombo yolwazi ejwayelekile, abantu abazinikele, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olufanele ngokushesha. Kwesiqalo, abantu abangahambisani nomawuwela badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukubambisana. Amaphoyisa, abenhliziyokwezinye izinhlelo, nezinduna zempilo bahlala beqedela imicimbi yokuphendula eziphuthumayo, ukuze baziqonde izindlela ezinhle zokuphendula. Isahluko 3: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphendula Ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zamphakathi, izinhlelo zokuphendula kufanele zakhiwe kahle, zibe nesikhalazo sokuxhumana okuhle. Ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphuthumayo, cenayo amandla okuvuselela imiyalezo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele uthakasele imihlangano yokubaluleka. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi uqonde izinyathelo zokuphendula, kube nenhloso yokuzivikela ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo.
Ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphuthumayo, cenayo amandla okuvuselela imiyalezo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele uthakasele imihlangano yokubaluleka. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi uqonde izinyathelo zokuphendula, kube nenhloso yokuzivikela ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Izenzo zokuphendula okufanele ziqukathe ukwakha uzwelo nokubumbana komphakathi ukuze kudaleke ujantshi lokuxhumana obukhoma. Isahluko 4: Ukuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe isikhathi sokuphendula, ukuqeqeshwa kuba yisici esibalulekile. Abantu kufanele baqeqeshwe indlela yokuphendula ngezehlakalo eziphuthumayo, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi bangaziphatha kanjani. Iminikelo yokuphendula kufanele ifundiswe ezikoleni, emiphakathini, nakweminye imifundaze, ukuze wonke umuntu abe nolwazi olufanele. Izifundo eziphathelene nezimo eziphuthumayo zisho ukuthi kunconywa ukuhlinzeka ngemikhankaso yokufundisa engaphezu kwempumelelo. Ukubeka izingqinamba ezibikiwe ezindaweni eziphuthumayo, kuchaza izinyathelo ezithathwa khona, kuzokwakha umqondo ohlanzekile wokuthi umehluko ungenziwa yini yilezi zenzo. Isahluko 5: Ukubambisana Nezinhlelo Zokuxhumana Isikhathi sokuphendula siyeza, kanti ukunxenxiselwa kwezingwadule nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kudlondlobala. Ukuhlangana kwezobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela okwandisiwe kwemininingwane nakho kukhuthaza ukusindiswa kwesimo eziphuthumayo.
Ukubeka izingqinamba ezibikiwe ezindaweni eziphuthumayo, kuchaza izinyathelo ezithathwa khona, kuzokwakha umqondo ohlanzekile wokuthi umehluko ungenziwa yini yilezi zenzo. Isahluko 5: Ukubambisana Nezinhlelo Zokuxhumana Isikhathi sokuphendula siyeza, kanti ukunxenxiselwa kwezingwadule nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kudlondlobala. Ukuhlangana kwezobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela okwandisiwe kwemininingwane nakho kukhuthaza ukusindiswa kwesimo eziphuthumayo. Kubasebenzisi, ukufinyelela emithonjeni yokuxhumana, ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zeselula ukuthola ulwazi, nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezifana nezemidlalo, zonke lezi zinto zithuthukisa izinga lokuphendula. Isahluko 6: Ukusebenza Ngaphandle Kwezithiyo Ngokugcinwayo, isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo sithinta ubumqoka bokusebenza ngaphandle kwezingqinamba. Ubuchwepheshe bukhona, kepha kufanele futhi kube nezigameko zokuphatha isikhathi sokuphendula. Izinkinga ezivela ekuxhumekeni okuphunyukayo, izinhlelo eziphuthumayo ezingavuselelwa, kungadala izinkinga. Ukwakha ubufakazi bokuthi izinyathelo zisebenza, ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula nakho kudinga ukuqashelwa: iSikhalazo somphakathi, ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuphutha kwemali, kanye nezinhlelo eziphuthumayo ezikhethiweyo, kusiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezibhalile. Isiphetho Kokuphetha, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqeqeshwa, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nezinhlelo ezicebisa ukuxhumana. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, ukuphendula kulezi zimo kuzoba nzima, kufuna imizamo eqhubekayo kumphakathi wonke.
Ukwakha ubufakazi bokuthi izinyathelo zisebenza, ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula nakho kudinga ukuqashelwa: iSikhalazo somphakathi, ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuphutha kwemali, kanye nezinhlelo eziphuthumayo ezikhethiweyo, kusiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezibhalile. Isiphetho Kokuphetha, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqeqeshwa, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nezinhlelo ezicebisa ukuxhumana. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, ukuphendula kulezi zimo kuzoba nzima, kufuna imizamo eqhubekayo kumphakathi wonke. Ukuba nesikhumbuzo sokuthi singawushintsha kanjani umphakathi ngezenzo ezilungile zokuphendula, kubaluleke kakhulu — kungenzeka siphumelele ezimeni eziphuthumayo, siqinisekise ukuthi siqhubeka sinesibindi, sihlakaniphile, futhi sikhona ngesikhathi.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqonda Amabhange Amabhange ayizikhungo ezibalulekile ezisebenza kwezomnotho emphakathini. Zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukugcina imali, ukuhweba, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemalimboleko. Ukuze uqonde amabhange kahle, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokuqonda izinjongo zawo kanye nezindlela ezisebenzisayo. Isahluko 2: Izinhlobo Zamabhange Amabhange ahlukaniswa ngalezi zinhlobo: 1. Amabhange Abantu (Commercial Banks): Lezi zikhungo zisebenza abantu ngabanye, zinikela ngezinsizakalo ezifana nokuvula ama-akhawunti, ukuhlinzeka ngemalimboleko, nokuhweba. Amabhange Ezinsizakalo (Investment Banks): Lezi zikhungo zigxile ekuphathweni kwezimali ezinkulu, zisebenza ngokuhweba ngezimpahla kanye nokuhlinzeka ngocwaningo lwezimali. Amabhange Kahulumeni (Development Banks): Lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga ukwakhiwa. Isahluko 3: Ukuvula I-Akhawunti Ebhangi Ukuvula i-akhawunti ebhange, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Khetha Uhlobo Lwe-Akhawunti: Thola uhlobo lwe-akhawunti oluhambelana nezidingo zakho, njenge-akhawunti yokonga noma yokuhweba. Hamba Ebhangeni: Vakashela ibhange ofuna ukuvula kulo i-akhawunti. Qiniseka ukuthi ubhonga izinsuku nezikhathi ezivulekile. Letha Imibhalo Ebalulekile: Uzodinga imibhalo efana ne-ID, isitatimende somholo, kanye nezinye izincwadi ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ubunikazi bakho. Gcwalisa Ifomu Lokuvula I-Akhawunti: Uma usukhona, gcwalisa ifomu lokuvula i-akhawunti, uqinisekise ukuthi ufunda kahle yonke imininingwane ngaphambi kokusayina.
Qiniseka ukuthi ubhonga izinsuku nezikhathi ezivulekile. Letha Imibhalo Ebalulekile: Uzodinga imibhalo efana ne-ID, isitatimende somholo, kanye nezinye izincwadi ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ubunikazi bakho. Gcwalisa Ifomu Lokuvula I-Akhawunti: Uma usukhona, gcwalisa ifomu lokuvula i-akhawunti, uqinisekise ukuthi ufunda kahle yonke imininingwane ngaphambi kokusayina. Thola I-ATM Card: Ngemuva kokuvula i-akhawunti, uzothola ikhadi le-ATM elizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imali yakho. Isahluko 4: Ukusebenzisa I-Akhawunti Uma usuvule i-akhawunti, ungasebenzisa izinsizakalo zebhange. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukufaka Imali: Ungafaka imali kwi-akhawunti yakho ngezikimu zebhange, ama-ATM, noma ngokuqondile kumphakathi. Ukukhwezela Imali: Ungathola imali usebenzisa ikhadi le-ATM noma ngokuhamba ebhange. Ukudlulisa Imali: Ungakwazi ukudlulisa imali kwabanye noma emakhawuntini ahlukene, ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zebhange. Ukubheka Isimo Se-Akhawunti: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlole isimo se-akhawunti yakho njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi awunayo imali engaphelele. Isahluko 5: Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Nezokuxhumana Amabhange ahlinzeka ngezinsiza ezahlukene zokuxhumana: 1. Ucingo: Ungaxhumana nebanga ngefoni ukuze uthole usizo noma imibuzo. I-imeyili: Amabhange avame ukuba ne-imeyili yokuxhumana ukuze uthumele imibuzo noma izicelo. Izinsizakalo Zokusebenza Kwi-Intanethi: Amabhange amaningi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokusebenza kwi-intanethi, okuvumela abathengi ukwenza izinqubo eziningi online.
Ucingo: Ungaxhumana nebanga ngefoni ukuze uthole usizo noma imibuzo. I-imeyili: Amabhange avame ukuba ne-imeyili yokuxhumana ukuze uthumele imibuzo noma izicelo. Izinsizakalo Zokusebenza Kwi-Intanethi: Amabhange amaningi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokusebenza kwi-intanethi, okuvumela abathengi ukwenza izinqubo eziningi online. Isahluko 6: Ukuhweba Ngezinsizakalo Zebhange Ukuze uzuze kakhulu ezinsizakalweni zebhange, qonda izinzuzo ezitholakalayo: 1. Izintela Nezimali: Qonda izintela ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zebhange ukuze ungaboni izindleko eziphakeme. Izinhlelo Zokonga: Amabhange ahlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokonga ezikhethekile, ezikuvumela ukuba ube nemali eningi. Izinsiza Zokuthuthukiswa: Qonda izinsiza zokuthuthukiswa ezitholakalayo, ezinjengezimali zokwakha, ukuze uthole usizo oludingayo. Isahluko 7: Ukuqonda Imigomo Nezimo Ngaphambi kokwenza izinqumo, kubalulekile ukuqonda imigomo nezimo zebhange. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle izibopho zakho nezinsizakalo ozitholayo. Qiniseka ukuthi ufunda zonke izivumelwano ngaphambi kokusayina. Isahluko 8: Ukuhlola Izinketho Ezingcono Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, hlola izinketho ezahlukene zamabhange. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi yibuphi ubhange obuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili nezikahle kakhulu. Qhathanisa izintela, izinhlelo zokonga, nezinsizakalo ukuze ukhethe kahle. Isahluko 9: Ukubheka Izinguquko Amabhange ahlale enza izinguquko ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zawo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale ubuyekeza izinhlelo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono.
Qhathanisa izintela, izinhlelo zokonga, nezinsizakalo ukuze ukhethe kahle. Isahluko 9: Ukubheka Izinguquko Amabhange ahlale enza izinguquko ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zawo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale ubuyekeza izinhlelo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono. Isahluko 10: Isiphetho Amabhange ayizikhungo ezibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuqonda indlela yokusebenzisa amabhange nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene kubalulekile ukuze sithole inzuzo ezimali zethu. Ukulandela lezi zinyathelo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvula i-akhawunti, ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo, nokuhlola izinketho ezihlukahlukene ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono. Qhubeka ufunde futhi uqonde amabhange ukuze ube nezezimali eziphumelelayo.
### Ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi (GEMS employer contribution coordination) Kwake kwaba nesikhathi lapho abantu bebengazi kahle ukuthi yini eyayichaza ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abathintekayo kuhlelo lweGEMS. Lokhu kwenzeka emzaneni omncane, lapho abantu babengazi ukuthi izimali abazinikezayo zisebenza kanjani ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi banelungelo lokuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhle. Emuva kweminyaka ethile, lezi zindleko zempilo zazingekho phansi, futhi izinkampani zazidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zikhokha iminikelo efanele ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bathola okudingekayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMnu. Dlamini, umphakathi onothile wombuso, wayengumqashi ophumelelayo. Wayevuma ukuthi uhwebo lwempilo lwaluhamba kancane, kodwa wayekwazi ukuthi uma engafaki izimali ezanele, kuzophumela ekutheni abasebenzi bakhe bangatholi ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Ngakho-ke, uMnu. Dlamini wathintana noNkk. Mpofu, ongumeluleki wezokuphatha, ukuze athole impendulo. U-Nkk. Mpofu, onolwazi olunzulu ngale ndaba, wathi: "Uhlelo lweGEMS luyindlela enhle yokuhlanganisa iminikelo yomqashi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umqashi efaka imali, le mali izogcinwa ukuze isetshenziswe ezindlekweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zabasebenzi." UMnu. Dlamini, enomqondo ovulekile, wavuma ukuthi kufanele akwazi kahle indlela lezi zimali ezihlanganiswa ngayo. "Ngabe lokhu kusho ukuthi ngizodinga ukudala izinhlelo ezithile zokuhlanganisa lezi zinkokhelo?" wabuza. U-Nkk.
"Ngabe lokhu kusho ukuthi ngizodinga ukudala izinhlelo ezithile zokuhlanganisa lezi zinkokhelo?" wabuza. U-Nkk. Mpofu wamkhumbuza ukuthi yebo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakwazi ukujabulisa izinhlelo zabo zezempilo. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana, uMnu. Dlamini wathola ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo kwakubalulekile, hhayi kuphela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imishwalense yokunakekelwa kwezempilo iyahamba kahle, kodwa futhi ukuze kube nokuxhumana okucacile phakathi kwabantu abahlinzekayo kanye nabathengi. Lokhu kwavula umqondo omusha kumphakathi, futhi uMnu. Dlamini wazizwa ethokozile ngokwazi ukuthi akahlanganyela kuphela ekwenzeni kahle kodwa futhi uthola umqondo wobumbano. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlanganiswa kweminikelo. Waqala ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakhe bazi kahle ukuthi iminikelo yabo iyahlanganiswa kanjani. Wabavumela ukuthi babuze imibuzo futhi banikeze imibono, okwakwenza kube lula ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komqashi nomsebenzi. Ngemuva kokwengeza izinhlelo ezihlukile, uMnu. Dlamini wanquma ukuba nezinye izifundo ezithile. Lezi zifundo zazihlanganisa indlela yokuphatha izimali, izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, kanye nokuthi kanjani izimali ezithile zingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bekwazi kakhulu futhi baguquka baziqhenya ngeminikelo yabo. Ukwengeza, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano nabanye abaqashi emzaneni. Waqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umphakathi uqonda kahle izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, futhi waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi.
Ukwengeza, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano nabanye abaqashi emzaneni. Waqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umphakathi uqonda kahle izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, futhi waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha, lapho wonke umuntu ebona ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo akukhona nje kuphela umqondo omuhle, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukubona izinzuzo ezithile. Abasebenzi babeyazi kahle indlela yokusebenzisa izinsiza zempilo, futhi imishwalense yempilo yakhula, yenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo. Umsebenzi wakhula, futhi uMnu. Dlamini waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungaba namandla uma uhamba phambili ndawonye. Njengoba lezi zinhlelo ziqhubeka, umphakathi waba nekhono lokwenza izinqumo eziphusile mayelana neminikelo yabo, futhi lezi zimpumelelo zakhula nangaphezu kokulindelekile. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, umphakathi, nabaphathi baziwa njengephazili elihamba phambili. Ekugcineni, uMnu. Dlamini waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi kwakungaphezulu kokukhokha – kwakungukwakha umphakathi onokuthula, ukuhleleka, nokubumbana. Iminikelo yabo yahlala ibalulekile, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula, uqhubeka ufinyelela phezulu. Lokhu kwakuwukwenzeka kwempumelelo okwakubhalwe emlandweni, futhi kwaba isikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha izizinda eziqinile zokuphila ezintsha.
Ukusebenza ukude ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika Emini ethokozisayo, uThandi wayevele esenkampanini enkulu yaseNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wakhe wawuyinjongo yokukhulisa ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu emsebenzini. Kodwa lokho kwashintsha ngesikhathi izwe lilwa nezinkinga eziningi ezahlukene, kusukela emikhakheni yezomnotho, kuthela lokho ekukhuleni kwezobuchwepheshe. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu ngempela, akakaze acabange ngalokho okuzokwenzeka. Njengoba iba nesikhathi sokusebenza odokotela, umphakathi wawasala uzolile, ngemva kokuba neziyezi ezimnandi lokho obekungabhalwa. Ngokuphenduka kwesimo, uThandi wathola ukuthi kudingeka kwenziwe izinto ngendlela ehlukile. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwaba sekuqhamuka umqondo ophawulekayo — ukusebenza ukude. Ngobubanzi, uThandi wayengezwi ubuhlungu bokuhamba ezinsukwini ezilandelayo ngenxa yokuzikhandla kude. Noma kunjalo, ubuhlungu obuncane bangaba usizo ngoba kwaholela ekutholakaleni kwezinsizakalo ezimangalisayo. Yiqiniso, kumshayeli ohlakaniphile, lokhu kwakhombisa indlela yokusebenza efanelana nezidingo zamanje. Umphakathi wezokuphathwa kwempilo uhambisana nezinguquko ezisemqoka ezinzima ezake zenzeka. UThandi, owayenobuhlakani bokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, wayezikhandla ukwakha ifa elisha lokusebenza sokukhombisa ngendlela yokubambisana. Ngaphandle kokushaywa yimvula yokuhluleka, izinkampani eziningi zathola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Uhlelo lokusebenza lukasipinat hlangene nohlelo lwakhe lwezokuphathelene nezinkampani ezikude. Waqala ukuphenya imikhuba emisha yokusebenza, efaka phakathi ukuxhumana nge-inthanethi, izinkulumo ezibukhoma, kanye namathuluzi okubambisana.
Ngaphandle kokushaywa yimvula yokuhluleka, izinkampani eziningi zathola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Uhlelo lokusebenza lukasipinat hlangene nohlelo lwakhe lwezokuphathelene nezinkampani ezikude. Waqala ukuphenya imikhuba emisha yokusebenza, efaka phakathi ukuxhumana nge-inthanethi, izinkulumo ezibukhoma, kanye namathuluzi okubambisana. Abasebenzi babengase balungiseleleke ukuphila, kodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo, benza izinqumo ezinkulu zokuphumelela. Noma umsebenzi wokugcina Wayenezingane ezimnandi, uThandi wayevame ukuqhubeka phambili. Abantu bebebhalela izinkampani zezokuxhumana, kanti ngesikhathi esifanayo, izinyathelo ezithile ezakhayo zaholela ekwandeni kwemizamo. UThandi wanakekela izifundo, eqhubeka efunda ngamasu ahlukeneyo. Ngesikhathi umndeni wakhe ufinyelela kuye ngezingxoxo zikaBaba noMama, kwaba njengokuhambisana nomphakathi. Izifundo ngobuchwepheshe, izifundo zokuphila, nezifundo zezimali zazinokuhlangana, zazenzelwa ukuba zibe ngempumelelo. Kukhona okukhudlwana kokuba abantu bahlale bebambisana. UThandi wayebona ukwenziwa kwemikhiqizo, ngisho nasezihlalweni ezimnandi. Umehluko phakathi kwabavakashi nabasebenzi baba yisixazululo esiphumelelayo kakhulu. Ubuqotho bokusebenzisana buhamba phambili kuhlala phansi, uThandi nozakwethu bakhe benza izinto zenzeke. Uzakwabo uMandla, owayesebenza nezingane embonini yezezimali, wakhombisa uthando lwezobuchwepheshe. UThandi noMandla babengabantu abazalayo, bemelele ukuphakamisa, behlola ijubane lempilo. Kwakungumbono omuhle, uhlelo lokuphila luhamba phambili, ngabe uThandi uMandla sikhumbule, ngisho naloko okulungile.
Uzakwabo uMandla, owayesebenza nezingane embonini yezezimali, wakhombisa uthando lwezobuchwepheshe. UThandi noMandla babengabantu abazalayo, bemelele ukuphakamisa, behlola ijubane lempilo. Kwakungumbono omuhle, uhlelo lokuphila luhamba phambili, ngabe uThandi uMandla sikhumbule, ngisho naloko okulungile. Lokhu waqonda ukukhokhela uMandla kuqala ukuhlola izinkampani ezaziwa okufanele kedahliwa. Lokhu kwaba yinzuzo enkulu kumuntu ofuna kakhulu ukukhokhela izikole. UThandi waqaphela ukuthuthukiswa okwandisa igunya lokusebenza kude. Lezi zinkampani, kusukela emkhakheni wezokuxhumana zezimali de kube yizinkampani eziyindida, zafeza isivuno esihle. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uThandi noMandla baqala ukuze basebenze Imininingwane Iglobal, ezobuchwepheshe obulinganayo. Lokhu kwakukhipha isithombe esikhangayo somphakathi lapho bezohamba beqhamuka nezimo ezijabulisayo. Imininingwane ifana nezithombe ezizwakala kumatasa abendzeli bezenhlalakahle, izifundo ezihleliwe. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside esisebenza kude, uThandi wakhumbula ukuthi kuyafana njengenhliziyo, okukhombisa umphakathi. Ubhekanisa nosuku olukhejwayo lokulawulwa, nesikhathi sokusebenza sinobudlelwane obuphambili. Esethulela umbono wakho, akekho ozokwazi ukuhamba phambili, uThandi noMandla basibangela umnotho. Ekugcineni, uThandi wajabula ngezithukuthuku ezinhle nezinkanyezi, futhi uMandla wanxusa abafowabo ukuthi bahlale bephila kahle. Njengabantu abasaqalayo, umsebenzi ukude wakwenza kumzamo omkhulu khona kulolu chungechunge olunobuhlakani. Bayazisola, kanti kwayenqaba izithombe ezinzima.
Ekugcineni, uThandi wajabula ngezithukuthuku ezinhle nezinkanyezi, futhi uMandla wanxusa abafowabo ukuthi bahlale bephila kahle. Njengabantu abasaqalayo, umsebenzi ukude wakwenza kumzamo omkhulu khona kulolu chungechunge olunobuhlakani. Bayazisola, kanti kwayenqaba izithombe ezinzima. Ubuqotho, uMandla noThandi babungangezwi, kanti lesi sikhathi sikhulu silindele ukuhamba phambili — lokhu kube ubufakazi buluntu lwezakhiwo. Baphelelisa imijikelezo, begxila kulokhu, ukukhokhela ukuqonda okwandile, okubonisa ukuba khona okumqoka kokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi nombono wakhe wezokuxhumana,behlanganisa kubasebenzi kodwa bebenza okwabelana ngayo. Uthando lwezokuphathelene nomsebenzi ukude lwaba umcabango omuhle, lwenza lokhu kube okufunayo. Isifundo esephuma emsebenzini ukushintsha umphakathi. Ukusebenza ukude kubalulekile, ukugcina umoya omuhle, nokuhamba phambili kuhlangene ngokuthandekayo yemibono ehamba phambili nezizathu ezinzima zomsakazo. UThandi wayekwazi ukuhamba phambili, kwakuyisikhathi esihle sabo. Lokhu kube yindaba emangalisayo, enokuthuthuka okukhulu endaweni yokusebenza!
Mphakathi ohloniphekile weKwaZulu-Natal, udokotela ophakeme, uS.J. Sihlalo, ngivuka lapha ukuze ngethule ibhajethi yonyaka wezezimali ka-2008/2009 yeVoti 8 (uMnyango Wezindlu) ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: "Indlu ayikhethwa kuphela kodwa iyisisekelo sokushintsha." Lesi sihloko sihambisana nokugxila ekuhlanganiseni izindawo zokuhlala njengoba sisondela ekupheleni kohlelo lweminyaka emihlanu. Sisesimweni lapho kufanele sihlolisise ngokucophelela umnikelo wohlelo lwezindlu njengengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza futhi sikhumbule nesimo sokuhlanganiswa kwezomnotho, kwezokuhlalisana, nezinhlelo zomhlaba. Njengoba siqala ukuhlola umthelela wohlelo lokwakha izindlu, siqonda ukuthi ukusebenza kwethu akukwazi ukukalwa kuphela ngenani lezindlu ezakhiwe. Siyaqonda ukuthi izindlu ziyisisekelo esibalulekile lapho ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, ukufinyelela ezidingweni eziyisisekelo, nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kubantu kwakhiwa khona. Kungalesi sizathu sathatha isihloko esihlanganisa lesi siqondiso se "kuhlanganiswa." Njengomnyango, siqonda kahle izinkinga ezikhona kwezindlu esifundazweni sethu. Siqhubeka nokuzibophezela esinqumweni sethu sokukhipha ukuhlinzekwa kwezakhamuzi, ukungaphephi kokuhlala, ukungazinzi kwezakhiwo, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni, izingozi zempilo nokuphepha, nezinye izimo ezikhona ezindaweni zokuhlala ezisemthethweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zethu zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezithuthukile.
Kungalesi sizathu sathatha isihloko esihlanganisa lesi siqondiso se "kuhlanganiswa." Njengomnyango, siqonda kahle izinkinga ezikhona kwezindlu esifundazweni sethu. Siqhubeka nokuzibophezela esinqumweni sethu sokukhipha ukuhlinzekwa kwezakhamuzi, ukungaphephi kokuhlala, ukungazinzi kwezakhiwo, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni, izingozi zempilo nokuphepha, nezinye izimo ezikhona ezindaweni zokuhlala ezisemthethweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zethu zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezithuthukile. Ekufezeni izinhloso zethu, sithola umyalo wethu kwiFreedom Charter, umqondo wayo uqhubeka usinika ukuhlakanipha, nakuba sekwedlule iminyaka engamashumi amahlanu selokhu yamukelwa yizikhungo zethu zokulwa, futhi sizohlale sikwazisa ngakho. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, kwakubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume "ngemithwalo nezinsiza" lapho sethula ibhajethi yeVoti 8 eminyakeni yokuqala yalo msebenzi weminyaka emihlanu. Izinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngezidingo ngaleso sikhathi zazinzima, futhi umsebenzi omkhulu owayekhuluma phambili wawubuhlungu. Nokho, asizange sishintshe ukuzibophezela kwethu emthwalweni weqembu, njengoba kugcizelelwe nguMongameli uMandela mayelana nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kubantu nokukhuthaza umphakathi ohlanganisiwe njengesisekelo sokukhululeka kwethu. Ukuze siqinisekise ukufezeka kwalomyalo, besinokuhlangana okuningi ukuze sihlolisise izindlela zokusebenza, ngaphezu kwemihlangano yonyaka yokwakha izindlu eyath attended by many stakeholders in this province.
