Izikhukhula eKwaZulu-Natal: Isikhumbuzo Sokuhlupheka Nokuphila Izikhukhula eKZN zibe yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini eminingi. Lokhu kuthinta imvelo kwenza kube nezindaba ezinzima nezivuselelayo. Kukhona ubuhlungu, uthando, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho, ngathatha isikhathi sokubhala lokhu ukuze ngiqonde ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje kuphela njengezingozi, kodwa zikhombisa nezinselele esibhekene nazo. Zenzeka ngezinsuku ezinzima, lapho imvula ingena emanzini, ikha amanzi amaningi ezindaweni eziphakeme. Okwesabekayo ngalesi sikhathi yindlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Abangane, odadewabo, nabangani bahlala bekhathazekile, befuna indawo ephephile. Izinga lokuhlupheka lishintsha kalula, kanti abanye bahlala benqena ukuvuka kulokho okubanjwe yimvula. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje izinyembezi, kodwa zikhumbuza ukuthi ukuphila kuncike kumoya wethu wokuqhubeka. Njengoba abantu besinda ezikhukhuleni, bahlangana, benza izinhlelo zokwakha kabusha. Izikhukhula ziveza umfanekiso onzima, kodwa zikhuthaza ubumbano. Lokhu kubumbene kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuvuma, besebenzisana ukuze bakhe imiphakathi eqinile. Ngibona ukuthi iminyaka yokuphila ebusuku ibonakala empilweni yabantu. Abahlali bahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile, kanti abanye bahlala benethemba lokubona usuku olukhazimulayo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi, kodwa umoya wethu uyasiza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo iyinsika yokusebenza, futhi abantu baphakathi kokuphila. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima, siphinde sihlole izindlela esizisebenzisayo. Siphakamisela ukunakekela imvelo.
Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo iyinsika yokusebenza, futhi abantu baphakathi kokuphila. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima, siphinde sihlole izindlela esizisebenzisayo. Siphakamisela ukunakekela imvelo. Izinhlelo zokuvikela imvelo zidingeka ukuze sinciphise imiphumela yalezi zinsuku ezinzima. Umthelela wezikhukhula awukhawulelwanga, kodwa udlula ezicini ezahlukene zokuphila kwabantu. Ngiyavuma, izikhukhula zikhumbuza izinkumbulo ezimbi, kodwa ziqinisa ukholo lwethu empilweni. Ukuhlupheka kuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihlakaniphile, lapho abantu bevela emazweni ahlukahlukene behamba ngezinyawo. Izibonelo zomphakathi ezinhle zikhona, lapho abavakashi bahlala bechubeka bethu. Ngifisa intuthuko e-KZN. Ukuze sibe nezikhumbuzo ezinhle ngezikhukhula, kufanele sithinte izinselelo zokuvikela imiphakathi. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhlungu bukhona, kodwa bangenza izinhlelo ezinhle. Ubuqotho bokubambisana, ukucabanga, nezinqubomgomo ezifanele zingasiza abantu bakhule. Ngemva kwesikhathi esinzima, umoya wezinkumbulo ulethe umuzwa wokuphila. Izikhukhula zikhumbuza ubuNkulunkulu bomphakathi, obhukuza abantu ukuba babekezelele, bese bezivumelanisa nezinhlelo zempilo. Kukhona ukuphila kwemiphakathi ethe xaxa, izikhukhula zikhuthaza ucwaningo nolwakhiwo. Ngaphezu kwamazwi, zikhumbuza ukuthi ukugcina imikhuba emihle kuyadingeka. Imizamo yokwakha ibhodi lokuphila ingaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo. Namuhla, ngikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba aphinde athathe izinyathelo eziningi, ukuphila okwaziyo.
Ngaphezu kwamazwi, zikhumbuza ukuthi ukugcina imikhuba emihle kuyadingeka. Imizamo yokwakha ibhodi lokuphila ingaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo. Namuhla, ngikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba aphinde athathe izinyathelo eziningi, ukuphila okwaziyo. Ngiyavuma, izikhukhula eKZN zikhumbuza ukuhlupheka, kodwa zihlala zikhuthaza ukuqhubeka. Kumele sizame lezi zinto, sizisebenzise njengomthombo wezinkumbulo. Kukhona amandla okuhlanganisa imiphakathi enothando. Ekugcineni, izikhukhula ziveza izinselele ezinzima, zikhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Sithanda ukubona imiphakathi ibonisa uthando oluphakeme, futhi sizokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo.
Byline: UF.B. Peairs, waseColorado State University Extension, ungumcwaningi ogxile ekuphathweni kwezinsongo futhi unguprofesa wezifundo zokulima nezokuphathwa kwezinsongo. Dala ibhokisi leziqiniso: Iziqiniseko ezisheshayo... I-Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) iyibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ekhiqiza i-toxin ebulala izinsongo. Izinhlobo zemvelo ezitholakala ku-Bt zingafakwa ezitshalweni zokudla, zinika amandla okukhulisa i-toxin ebulala ezinye izinsongo, ngakho azilimali yilezo zinsongo. Ama-hybrids e-corn aqukethe lezi zinhlobo ze-Bt awalimali izinsongo ezivame ukuba yingozi enkulu. I-Bt corn isebenza kahle ekunciphiseni izinsongo futhi iyindlela eshibhile yokuphikisa ama-pesticides emichiza. Le teknoloji entsha ivula indlela yokuthuthukisa izinhlobo ezintsha zezitshalo ngokufaka izinhlobo zemvelo kwezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo. Lokhu kuhle ngoba singashintsha ezinye izici zezithombo ukuze zikwazi ukuphikisa ezinye izinsongo - lokhu kulula ngoba akufani nokukhetha izitshalo ezinamandla ngendlela ejwayelekile. Enye indlela ephumelelayo yale teknoloji entsha ukuthi ama-hybrids e-corn angaphikisa izinsongo ezithile - efaka izinhlobo zemvelo ezivela kubhaktheriya zomhlabathi. Lezi hybrids zibizwa ngokuthi "transgenic," kodwa hhayi zonke zingaphikisa izinsongo. I-Bt imele ibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ebizwa nge-Bacillus thuringiensis. I-Bt iphinde ibhekisele kumkhiqizo we-pesticide owenziwe kulezi bhaktheriya. Yini indima ye-Bt mayelana nezifo zezinsongo?
I-Bt imele ibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ebizwa nge-Bacillus thuringiensis. I-Bt iphinde ibhekisele kumkhiqizo we-pesticide owenziwe kulezi bhaktheriya. Yini indima ye-Bt mayelana nezifo zezinsongo? Ezinye izinhlobo ze-Bt zibulala izinsongo zisebenzisa ama-toxins az known as insecticidal crystal proteins noma delta endotoxins. Lezi toxins ngokuvamile azibeki engozini abantu noma ezinye izinhlanga ezingezona izinsongo. Yini i-Bt corn? Ukukhiqizwa kwe-delta endotoxins kulawulwa yizinhlobo zemvelo eyodwa phakathi kwalezi bhaktheriya. Izinhlobo ezishintshiwe zingafakwa ezitshalweni ze-corn. Isitshalo se-corn esinolezi zinhlobo zemvelo singakhiqiza ama-delta endotoxins azobulala izinsongo ezithambekele kulolo hlobo lwe-protein. Kungani sisebenzisa izinhlobo zemvelo ezifana ne-Bt ku-corn? Ama-delta endotoxins ashiswa ezitshalweni ngokuvamile alahlekelwa ukusebenza ngenxa yokukhanya okwaziwa njenge-UV light. Nokho, ama-delta endotoxins akhiqizwa ngaphakathi kwesitshalo awalimali ukukhanya kwe-UV. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifo eziningi ezidalwa izinsongo zihluke ukuphathwa, zidinga ukusetshenziswa okukhulu kwamapesticides ajwayelekile, kodwa zingabulawa ama-delta endotoxins akhiqizwa ngaphakathi kwesitshalo. Kukhona futhi teknoloji yokufaka le toxin edala lezi zinhlobo zemvelo. Ingabe wonke amasimu e-Bt corn anama-toxins? Kuya ngezimo. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezinqumayo ukuthi kuphumephi ama-delta endotoxins esitshalo: indlela akhiqizwa ngayo kanye nesimo esiqala inqubo yokukhiqiza.
Ingabe wonke amasimu e-Bt corn anama-toxins? Kuya ngezimo. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezinqumayo ukuthi kuphumephi ama-delta endotoxins esitshalo: indlela akhiqizwa ngayo kanye nesimo esiqala inqubo yokukhiqiza. Izinkampani zezim seed zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukukhiqiza ama-delta endotoxins, ngakho izinhlobo zama-hybrids zizohluka. Okukhona kwenzeka lokhu: igene ye-Bt ifakwa ezinsizeni zemvelo (material genetic) zesitshalo. Lokhu kukhombisa indawo lapho igene ye-Bt ingena khona (yikuphi i-chromosome nokuthi ikuphi kulowo chromosome, njll.). Indawo lapho igene ifakwa khona esitshalo izokhombisa ukuthi kuphumephi ama-endotoxins nokuthi mangaki azokhiqizwa. Okwamanje, teknoloji ayivumeli ukuphathwa kwendawo lapho igene ye-Bt ingena khona, ngakho ukufakwa kwale gene kuyahluka futhi izitshalo ezahlukene zikhishwa ezikhiqiza ama-endotoxins ahlukene. Isimo esiqala le nqubo sifana neswishi esitshela igene ye-Bt ukuthi nini nendawo yokuthi iqale ukukhiqiza ama-endotoxins. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezingaqala le nqubo futhi zihluke ngendlela ezisebenza ngayo, ngakho isimo esithile sizokhiqiza ama-endotoxins endaweni ethile nangemali ethile, kuholele kuma-hybrids ahlukene. Zingaki izinhlobo ze-corn ezine-Bt? Kukhona ama-hybrids ahlukene ane-Bt, amanye angavimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo kanti amanye ahlasela imizi. Ingabe wonke ama-hybrids e-Bt asebenza ngendlela efanayo? Ukuphatha izinsongo ezithile kuhambisana nenani lezinto ezikhiqiza inqubo yokukhiqiza efakiwe kwi-hybrid ethile.
Kukhona ama-hybrids ahlukene ane-Bt, amanye angavimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo kanti amanye ahlasela imizi. Ingabe wonke ama-hybrids e-Bt asebenza ngendlela efanayo? Ukuphatha izinsongo ezithile kuhambisana nenani lezinto ezikhiqiza inqubo yokukhiqiza efakiwe kwi-hybrid ethile. Khetha i-hybrid enezinto ezikhiqiza inqubo yokukhiqiza efanelekile endaweni okhulima kuyo - buza ukuthi i-hybrid ethile izokwazi ukuphatha izinsongo ezinzima kakhulu endaweni yakho. Ingabe i-Bt corn izosebenza kahle endaweni yami yokulima? Izinto ze-Bt azizokwenzi zibe nzima ukukhula kwama-hybrids. Ingabe i-Bt iyinto eyodwa efakwe ezinsizeni zemvelo ze-corn (genetically engineered)? Kukhona ama-hybrids amaningi anezici ezengeziwe, njengokumelana ne-herbicides. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezisakhangiswa, ezingatholakala esikhathini esizayo. Ingabe i-corn iyona kuphela isitshalo esishintshiwe nge-Bt? Cha, kunezitshalo eziningi ezishintshiwe ukukhiqiza ama-endotoxins. Nokho, i-corn ne-cotton zisetshenziswa kakhulu ngalendlela. Ingabe kukhona enye inzuzo yokusebenzisa i-Bt ngaphandle kokuvimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo ze-corn? I-Bt corn ivimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo ze-corn kodwa ayibulali ezinye izinsongo ezisizayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuphatha ezinye izifo ezifana ne-rootworms. Ingabe kukhona okubi ngokusebenzisa i-Bt corn uma kuqhathaniswa nokuphathwa kwezinsongo okujwayelekile kwezinsongo ezihlasela izithombo? Izimpande ze-Bt corn ngokuvamile zibiza kakhulu kunezinye. Ungazitshala ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi lezo zinsongo zikhona noma cha.
Ingabe kukhona okubi ngokusebenzisa i-Bt corn uma kuqhathaniswa nokuphathwa kwezinsongo okujwayelekile kwezinsongo ezihlasela izithombo? Izimpande ze-Bt corn ngokuvamile zibiza kakhulu kunezinye. Ungazitshala ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi lezo zinsongo zikhona noma cha. Ukuphatha ngamakhemikhali kukunika isikhathi sokubona ukuthi lezo zinsongo zikhona, futhi uma zivele ungakhokha ukuze uzisuse. Futhi, ukulandela izidingo ze-refuge kungakwenza kube nzima ukukhetha nokuvuna. Ngingakwazi ukutshala i-Bt corn ngikhohlwe ngezinsongo nezinsongo? Cha, i-Bt corn ayikwazi ukukwenza ukhohlwe ngezinkinga zalezi zinsongo. Kukhona ezinye okufanele zihlolwe futhi ziphathwe njalo. Ingabe kukhona okubi ngokusebenzisa i-Bt corn uma kuqhathaniswa nokuphathwa kwezinsongo okujwayelekile? Kungase kube nezinkinga zokumaketha nge-Bt corn, ikakhulukazi i-corn ethengiswa phesheya. Nokho, imakethe yomhlaba iyashintsha njalo, futhi asazi ukuthi imiyalezo mayelana nama-hybrids izokhuluma ngani esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyinkinga kuphela uma umkhiqizo omusha wethulwa owenza lo msebenzi esitshalo. Kuphi engingasebenzisa khona i-Bt corn ekulimaleni kwami? I-Bt corn kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela ezindaweni lapho ubungozi bezinsongo buphezulu. Yini eyenzeka ukuvimbela insongo ehlasela izithombo ze-corn ukuba ijwayele i-Bt corn futhi iphile? Abacwaningi emanyuvesi, izinkampani zezim seed, kanye ne-EPA bonke basebenza ndawonye ukuthola amasu okuvimbela lokhu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezidingo ze-refuge nezindlela zokusetshenziswa. Isingeniso IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liyisikhungo esiyinhloko sokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi, elibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umthetho, ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zomphakathi, nasekuphatheni izinqumo ezithinta izakhamuzi zethu. Ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi iPhalamende lisebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukwazi izigaba ezihlukene ezisemqoka, izinqubo, kanye nezimiso ezilawula ukusebenza kwalo. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukwakheka kwePhalamende IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liqukethe izingxenye ezimbili ezisemqoka: iNdlu ePhakeme (Senate) kanye neNdlu ePhansi (National Assembly). INdlu ePhakeme ibhekelela izindaba ezithinta izifunda, kanti iNdlu ePhansi ibhekelela izindaba ezijwayelekile zomphakathi. Ukuze ube yilungu lePhalamende, umuntu kufanele abe ngumuntu ophethe iziqu ezithile, athole ukhetho, futhi abe nekhono lokuhola. Isigaba sesibili: Ukhetho lwePhalamende Ukhetho lwePhalamende lwenziwa njalo eminyakeni emine. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukuvota, kubalulekile ukuthi izakhamuzi ziqonde izinqubo zokubhaliswa. Abantu kufanele babhalise ukuze bavote, futhi lokhu kungenziwa ezikhungweni ezikhethekile noma online. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, izakhamuzi zithola ithuba lokuvota, lapho zikhuluma khona ngezintandokazi zabo, zikhombisa ukuthi zifuna ubani ukuba ummeleli wazo. Isigaba sesithathu: Ukusebenza kwePhalamende Uma ukhetho sekuqedile, iPhalamende iqala ukusebenza. Izigameko zokuqala zifaka phakathi umhlangano wokuqala, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ahlangana khona ukuze aqinisekise izikhundla ezibalulekile, njengeMenenja yePhalamende (Speaker) kanye noMholi weMpumalanga.
Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, izakhamuzi zithola ithuba lokuvota, lapho zikhuluma khona ngezintandokazi zabo, zikhombisa ukuthi zifuna ubani ukuba ummeleli wazo. Isigaba sesithathu: Ukusebenza kwePhalamende Uma ukhetho sekuqedile, iPhalamende iqala ukusebenza. Izigameko zokuqala zifaka phakathi umhlangano wokuqala, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ahlangana khona ukuze aqinisekise izikhundla ezibalulekile, njengeMenenja yePhalamende (Speaker) kanye noMholi weMpumalanga. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iPhalamende iyakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Isigaba sesine: Ukubhala umthetho Umthetho ubhalwa ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamalungu ePhalamende. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela iziphakamiso, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokwenza izinguquko uma kudingeka. Ukuze umthetho uphumelele, kufanele udlule ezinyathelweni ezithile, kuhlanganise nokuvunywa kwamaKomidi, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ebheka khona iziphakamiso ngokucophelela. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ukuhlola umthetho Ngemuva kokuba umthetho ubhalwe, iPhalamende kufanele ihlole ukuthi umthetho uyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlola kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho awubangeli umonakalo, futhi ufinyelela ezinjongo ezithile zomphakathi. Uma umthetho uthola ukugunyazwa, uqala ukusebenza, futhi izakhamuzi ziqala ukuwusebenzisa. Isigaba sesithupha: Ukubambisana nezakhamuzi IPhalamende linomsebenzi wokubambisana nezakhamuzi. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuhlela imihlangano, lapho izakhamuzi zingabamba iqhaza khona, zikhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi wazo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze iPhalamende iqonde izidingo nezifiso zabantu, futhi ikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nalezi zidingo lapho ibhala khona imithetho.
Isigaba sesithupha: Ukubambisana nezakhamuzi IPhalamende linomsebenzi wokubambisana nezakhamuzi. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuhlela imihlangano, lapho izakhamuzi zingabamba iqhaza khona, zikhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi wazo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze iPhalamende iqonde izidingo nezifiso zabantu, futhi ikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nalezi zidingo lapho ibhala khona imithetho. Isigaba sesixhenxe: Ukuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yePhalamende Ukuze iPhalamende iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlola imisebenzi yayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi imithetho ibhalwe kahle, ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngendlela efanele, nokuthi izakhamuzi zifinyelela kanjani ezinsizeni ezitholakala ngaphansi kwemithetho. Ukuhlola lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuphendula izikhalazo ezivela kubantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi iPhalamende iyakwazi ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona. Isigaba sesishiyagalombili: Ukubuyekeza umthetho Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izidingo zomphakathi zishintsha. IPhalamende kufanele ibuyekeze imithetho yayo ukuze ihambisane nezimo ezikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umthetho uhlale uvumelana nezidingo zabantu, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlala zikhululekile futhi ziphila kahle. Isiphetho IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuqonda izinqubo zalo, ukusebenza kwalo, nokubambisana nezakhamuzi kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azibandakanye, aqonde, futhi abe neqhaza ekwakheni iPhalamende elisebenzayo, elihloniphekile, nelikhululekile.
Isiphetho IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuqonda izinqubo zalo, ukusebenza kwalo, nokubambisana nezakhamuzi kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azibandakanye, aqonde, futhi abe neqhaza ekwakheni iPhalamende elisebenzayo, elihloniphekile, nelikhululekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvota, ukwakha umthetho, nokuhlola imisebenzi yePhalamende, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlala zikhululekile futhi zikhuluma ngezidingo zazo.
Isomiso: Umthelela Waso Emiphakathini Nasemvelweni Isomiso, okuyisimo sokungabi namanzi, sithinta izindawo eziningi emhlabeni jikelele, futhi siba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ezilwaneni, kanye nasemvelweni. Le nkinga ibangelwa izizathu ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukungaphumeleli kwezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, kanye nokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wesomiso, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nalesi simo. Izizathu Zesomiso Isizathu esiyinhloko sokwanda kwesomiso sitholakala ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu, okukhuluma ngakho izazi zezulu. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokushisa, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi izindawo ezithile zibe namanzi anele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi namvula okuphindaphindiwe kubangela ukuthi izindawo ezithile zibe nezimo ezinzima zokukhulisa izitshalo, okukhuthaza isomiso. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ukuphathwa okungafanele kwezinsiza zamanzi, njengokungasebenzisi kahle amanzi emasimini, nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi eziphumelelayo zidinga ukucabangela izidingo zomphakathi, izimo zemvelo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Uma lezi zinto zingahlangani kahle, umphakathi uthola ubunzima bokuphila, okukhuthaza isimo sokungabi namanzi. Umthelela Wesomiso Emiphakathini Isomiso sithinta kakhulu imiphakathi yasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi lezo ezincike kakhulu ekulimaleni nasekukhuleni kwezolimo. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imindeni ikwazi ukuziphilisa.
Uma lezi zinto zingahlangani kahle, umphakathi uthola ubunzima bokuphila, okukhuthaza isimo sokungabi namanzi. Umthelela Wesomiso Emiphakathini Isomiso sithinta kakhulu imiphakathi yasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi lezo ezincike kakhulu ekulimaleni nasekukhuleni kwezolimo. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imindeni ikwazi ukuziphilisa. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka, njengoba abantu bephoqwa ukuba baphume emakhaya abo ukuze bafune amathuba okusebenza kwezinye izindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isomiso sithinta impilo yomphakathi. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuhlobene nokwanda kwezifo, njengoba abantu bengenayo imithombo ewusizo yokuhlanza. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezithathelwana kalula, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imiphakathi ibhekane nezinkinga zempilo. Umthelela Wesomiso Emvelweni Ngaphandle komthelela emiphakathini, isomiso sinesithombe esikhulu emvelweni. Izitshalo nezilwane zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule futhi ziphile. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuholela ekwehleni kwezinga lokuphila kwezilwane, okungaholela ekufeni kwazo. Lokhu kubangela ukuguquka kwemvelo, njengoba izilwane zidinga ukuhamba zifuna amanzi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi zihlale ezindaweni ezithile. Isomiso sibuye sibe nomthelela ezinhlelweni zokuphila ezihlukahlukene, njengokuphila kwezilwane zasendle. Uma izilwane zingatholi amanzi anele, ziba sengozini yokuphela. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwezinhlelo zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imvelo ibuyisele emuva. Izixazululo Zokulwa Nesomiso Ukuze siqedele isomiso, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo.
Uma izilwane zingatholi amanzi anele, ziba sengozini yokuphela. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwezinhlelo zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imvelo ibuyisele emuva. Izixazululo Zokulwa Nesomiso Ukuze siqedele isomiso, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi ezisebenzayo, ezifaka phakathi ukulondolozwa kwamanzi, ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo kubalulekile ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa imiphakathi mayelana nezindlela zokulima ezihlala zikhona, ezifana nokusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi, kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi imiphakathi ibhekane nezimo ezinzima zokungabi namanzi. Isiphetho Isomiso yinkinga enkulu ethinta imiphakathi emhlabeni jikelele. Umthelela walesi simo ubalulekile, njengoba uthinta impilo, ezolimo, kanye nemvelo. Ukuze siqedele le nkinga, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ezihlanganisa ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zamanzi, ukufundisa imiphakathi, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, elinamanzi anele, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imiphakathi yethu iyaphila futhi iyakhula.

Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma emsebenzini uma uphOutside kwezwe. Nikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ungum resident ophakade lapho ufaka izicelo. Izingcwephe zakho azizothathwa ukuze zirekhodwe kwi-register yokuhlala kwabantu kazwelonke. Futhi thumela nezithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-pasipoti. Le sevisi ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-6 ukuze iphumelele.
Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Ngokwanda kwezimo zomnotho, izinkampani zidinga abasebenzi abanamakhono ahlukahlukene ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokwakha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi, ukuze baqhubeke nokufuna izixazululo ezintsha nezingcono, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephambili emncintiswaneni. Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zisiza abasebenzi ukuthi bathole ulwazi olusha nolwabantu. Lokhu kulungele kakhulu izinkampani, njengoba abasebenzi abaqeqeshwayo banemigomo emisha yokusebenza, bazi kahle izinqubo ezintsha, futhi banamathuba okukhuthaza amakhono abo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinkampani zithola izinzuzo zokuphuculwa kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo, okwandisa imakethe yazo. Kwakhiwa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuqeqesha, kuhlanganisa nezifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, izifundo eziphakathi kokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana nezikhungo zemfundo. Lokhu kuhlelwa ngendlela yokuthi kube lula kubasebenzi ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babe nezinjongo ezicacile zokuphumelela, ukuze bakwazi ukukhipha okungcono emizimbeni yabo. Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha aluhlinzeki kuphela ngokuqeqeshwa kwemikhakha ethile, kodwa futhi luhlinzekela abasebenzi ithuba lokuthola amakhono empilo, okubandakanya ukuxhumana, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezinto ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemvelo yokusebenza ehloniphekayo, enokuthula, futhi enempumelelo. Izinkampani ezithatha lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha zikhombisa ukwethembeka ezinhlelweni zazo zokuthuthukisa abasebenzi.
Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha aluhlinzeki kuphela ngokuqeqeshwa kwemikhakha ethile, kodwa futhi luhlinzekela abasebenzi ithuba lokuthola amakhono empilo, okubandakanya ukuxhumana, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezinto ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemvelo yokusebenza ehloniphekayo, enokuthula, futhi enempumelelo. Izinkampani ezithatha lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha zikhombisa ukwethembeka ezinhlelweni zazo zokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Lokhu kudala isimo esihle sokusebenza, okwaholela ekwenzeni kahle emsebenzini. Abasebenzi bazizwa bebalulekile, futhi lokhu kubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze ngaphezulu nangokuzikhandla. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha akukhona nje kuphela ukwandisa amakhono abasebenzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isiko lokuphumelela. Ukwakhiwa kosuku nosuku lokuphumelela nokwenza kahle kuncike ekusebenzisaneni kwababambiqhaza bonke, kusukela kubaphathi kuze kube sekusebenzeni kwabantu abasebenzayo. Iziphumo zezinqubo zokuqeqeshwa zicacile. Izinkampani ezikhipha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuqeqesha zihlala ziphumelela ngezinga eliphezulu, zehlisa izindleko zokuhola, futhi zithola imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophumelelayo lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nezinkampani eziningi ezithumele abasebenzi babo emikhakheni ehlukene ukuze baqhubeke nezifundo zabo. Ngokuphetha, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinkampani ezibheka phambili ziqonda ukuthi abasebenzi abaqeqeshwayo nabathuthukisiwe bangumgogodla wezimpumelelo zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinkampani zithathe lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha ngokungathi sína, ukuze zifeze imigomo yazo, zikhule, futhi ziqhubeke zihlala phambili emncintiswaneni. Uhlelo oluqinile lokuqeqesha luzogcina luholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi okhangayo, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphumelela.
Abantu abanokukhubazeka banelungelo lokuthola ukwesekwa okungama-R25,580 nangaphezulu ngenxa yezidingo ezengeziwe ezifana nezitini zokwakha ezisemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokungena endlini, izithiyo, nezindawo zokugeza; imihlahlandlela eholela emnyango ngebhodi lokushaya elingaboni. Lokhu kusekela kutholakala kubantu abafuna ukuthenga indlu noma indawo ehlanganisa nokwesekwa kwemakethe okukhona. Lolu hlobo lokwesekwa lutholakala ngokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abahlanganisiwe abavumelekile, abangaba ngabantu noma amaqembu akhiwe ngokomthetho angakha futhi aphathe isakhiwo sokuhlala esihlanganisiwe. Lolu hlobo lokwesekwa luvumela u-R23,100.00 kumuntu ngamunye noma emndenini ophuma ngaphansi kuka-R3,500.00 ngenyanga. Le nhlelo yokubolekwa isebenza ngendlela yokuphula. Le ndlela yokuphula iphethwe ngqo ngumphakathi, futhi uhlelo lokubolekwa lusekela lezo zindlu ezinezinga eliphansi ukuze lusize ekwakheni, ekugcineni, nasekukhuthazeni ukwakhiwa kwabo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala ngaleso sikhathi esithile. Kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezineziphumo ezithengiswa nguhulumeni, unelungelo lokuthola le nsizakalo echazwe. Lezi zindlu zakhiwe ngababambiqhaza abaqashwe nguhulumeni wesifunda noma ohulumeni bendawo kulezi ziqembu ezivumelekile. Esifundazweni saseLimpopo, ukwesekwa okungama-5 okuqhubekayo kuvela kuhlelo lokweseka izindlu zendawo, kuhlukanisa abanikazi bezimali be-Angishana, okuhambisana nemali yokonga yomndeni obolekayo. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abafuna ukwakha izindlu zabo.

Le nhlelo ihluke kulena ehambisana nezinye izinhlelo lapho abaqashi bakha izindlu zabantu abaningi, kuyilapho le nhlelo yabantu ivumela abantu ukuba bakhe noma balungise futhi bakhe izindlu zabo. Abantu banikezwa amathuba okwakha izindlu zabo, bese besizwa inhlangano esekelayo, ngokukhokha le nhlangano esekelayo ngokusekelwa. Uhulumeni uveze ukuthi umamukeli kumele akhokhe ukuze afinyelele kuhlelo lokwesekwa. Inhloso yale nto iwukuthi umamukeli naye abe nengxenye ekuxazululeni inkinga yezidingo zezindlu, ukukhuthaza isiko lokonga, nokuthi umamukeli akwazi ukuqonda le nsizakalo evumelekile kusukela ngomhlaka-1 kuMbasa 2002, abamukeli kulindeleke ukuthi babe nengxenye futhi. Abadala, abakhubazekile, kanye nalabo abanesimo sempilo esingesihle kodwa abahola ngaphansi kuka-R3,500 ngenyanga. Lokhu kusekela kuhlelwe kulabo abanamalungelo endawo abawasebenzisayo kodwa bengawatholi. Le ndawo ayikathathi hlangothi ngaphansi kokulawula kukahulumeni ngaphansi komthetho wezihlonipho. Lokhu kusekela kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngezinye zezinhlelo lapho kukhona abaxhasi noma izinhlangano ezisizayo. Umamukeli unenketho yokukhetha ukuthi ukwesekwa kuzokwenza kube nezithakazelo.
Le ndawo ayikathathi hlangothi ngaphansi kokulawula kukahulumeni ngaphansi komthetho wezihlonipho. Uma kukhulunywa ngokuqashwa kwemali, noma ekwakheni indlu noma inhlanganisela yombili. Phambilini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezimnyama ezifana neSoweto, eMamelodi, nakwezinye, uhulumeni wangaphambili wakha izindlu zokuhlala. Abahlali ababeqashwe kulezi zindlu ngaphambi kukaMashi 15, 1991, bangafaka isicelo sokuthola isaphulelo ekuthengeni lezi zindlu kuze kube ngu-R7,500.00. Ngokuvamile lezi zindlu zinikezwa mahhala ngenxa yesaphulelo esingu-R7,500.00 esedlula inani langempela lendlu. Izinga langaphambilini lokwesekwa elingu-R579.00 lingasetshenziswa ezingeni eliphansi lobuchwepheshe bokwakha. Imali esele engu-R12,521.00 ingasetshenziswa ekwakheni okuphezulu, bese okungena ngaphansi kwemitha eyisikwele engama-30 (30m) yendawo ephelele yendlu. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu kumele bakhokhe kuqala imali engu-R2,479.00. Uhlelo lwezindlu ezizimele, uhlelo lokukhipha amanzi, kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kuyizidingo ezibalulekile. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu zabantu kumele bafake imali yabo. Abalingani bethu ohlelweni lokwakha izindlu nokuqhuba umsebenzi?
Uhlelo lwezindlu ezizimele, uhlelo lokukhipha amanzi, kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kuyizidingo ezibalulekile. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu zabantu kumele bafake imali yabo. Abalingani bethu ohlelweni lokwakha izindlu nokuqhuba umsebenzi? Uhlelo lokususa ezindlini luhloselwe ukuba lube yindlela yokulungisa izimo ezifanele zalezi zindlu, le nhlelo yenziwa ngokubambisana nezinkampani zebhange nohulumeni ukuze kuhlanganyelwe ekusebenziseni uhlelo lokwakha ukuze kulungiswe izimo ezifanele zezindlu. Isidingo solwazi nemininingwane mayelana nezindlu ezidingekayo ngentengo efanele. I-Servcon izoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka i-Thubelisha Homes ngemininingwane ejulile mayelana nezindlu ezihambile esivumelwaneni esifanele. Le mininingwane izosetshenziswa yi-Thubelisha Homes ukuze iqhathanise futhi ihlaziye isimo sendawo nokuthi kukhona yini amakhono akhona uma kubhekwa inani, imvelo, kanye nekhadi lezindlu ezidingekayo. I-NURHA inegunya lokuhlola ukutholakala kwemali kulezi zindawo ezihluphekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zabantu abahola kancane. Futhi ibhekelele uhlelo lokonga imali yokwakha izindlu. Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa amakhono ezakhiwo zezindlu. Ukukhuthaza nokusabalalisa kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwelizwe, ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa noma ukuhlanganisa bonke ababambiqhaza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zenhlangano, ukuze babelane ngolwazi namakhono futhi basebenze ngokubambisana.
Futhi ibhekelele uhlelo lokonga imali yokwakha izindlu. Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa amakhono ezakhiwo zezindlu. Ukukhuthaza nokusabalalisa kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwelizwe, ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa noma ukuhlanganisa bonke ababambiqhaza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zenhlangano, ukuze babelane ngolwazi namakhono futhi basebenze ngokubambisana. I-NHBRF inegunya lokumela amalungu ohlelo lokwakha izindlu ngokuhlinzeka ngesiqinisekiso sokuvikela izakhiwo eziphukile ezindlini ezintsha, nokuvikela abanikazi bezindlu, abaqashi, labo abavumelekile ngezidingo, kanye nezibopho lapho kungase kube nezinkinga, ukuze kulungiswe ngaphansi kwalesi simiso. Izwe elakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile sezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle.
Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha: Izizathu Nezixazululo Emphakathini wethu wanamuhla, ukungasebenzi kwentsha sekuyinkinga ebonakala ngokucacile. Intsha, eyinhlangano ebalulekile yomphakathi, ibhekene nezithiyo eziningi ezithinta impilo yabo, futhi inhloso yabo iwukwakha ikusasa elihle. Nokho, inkinga yokungasebenzi ibalulekile, ithinta izigidi zabantu abasha. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu eziholela kulokhu kanye nezixazululo eziphakanyisiwe ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Okokuqala, izizathu zokungasebenzi kwentsha ziningi futhi zihluke kakhulu. Enye yezizathu eziyinhloko ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Nakuba izinkampani zikhula emhlabeni jikelele, imisebenzi ethile ayitholakali kalula. Lokhu kubangelwa yizinguquko emnothweni, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, futhi izimboni zidinga abasebenzi abanamakhono athile. Intsha ethola iziqu eziphezulu ibhekene nenkinga yokuthi imisebenzi ethile ayitholakali, noma izidingo zayo zishintsha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungasebenzi kwentsha kuhambisana nezimo zomphakathi. Ezinye izindawo zinezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza, izikole eziphakeme, noma izinhlelo zokuxhasa intsha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphoxeka, lapho intsha ibona ukuthi imizamo yabo ayiholeli emiphumeleni emihle. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye baphumelele, kanti abanye bahlale behluleka, okwenza kube nzima ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokubheka lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokufundisa kufanele ziguqulwe ukuze zifanele izidingo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola amakhono adingekayo emakethe.
Ngokubheka lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokufundisa kufanele ziguqulwe ukuze zifanele izidingo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola amakhono adingekayo emakethe. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezinkampani. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuxhasa intsha kufanele zikhulise amathuba okusebenza. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokufundisa amakhono, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane. Uma intsha inethuba lokufunda nokusebenza, izoba namathuba amaningi okuphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukubaluleka kokuxhasa intsha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu, kusukela kumalungu omphakathi kuya kubaholi, kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizokwenza intsha ibonakale. Lokhu kungabandakanya imicimbi yokukhuthaza, izinhlelo zokuxhasa, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezizinda ezahlukene. Ekugcineni, ukungasebenzi kwentsha akuyona inkinga engathathwa kalula. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izizathu eziholela kulokhu, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho intsha ingakwazi ukufinyelela emisebenzini, futhi ibone ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi intsha ibone ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi umphakathi wethu ube ngcono. Ngakho-ke, asithathe isinyathelo sokuxhasa intsha, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho intsha ingakwazi ukufinyelela emisebenzini, futhi ibone ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi intsha ibone ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi umphakathi wethu ube ngcono. Ngakho-ke, asithathe isinyathelo sokuxhasa intsha, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukungasebenzi kwentsha akuyona inkinga engathathwa kalula, kodwa uma sihlanganyela, singakwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza umehluko.
UMnyango Wokuhumusha Nokuhlela weSevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) uhlukaniswe ngezindawo ezilandelayo zolimi: Afrikaans, English, Izilimi Zangaphandle, isiZulu, isiXhosa, isiNdebele, isiSepedi, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiSwati, isiTshivenda, nesiXitsonga. Uhulumeni omusha uhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seMthethosisekelo, uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi "uhulumeni wesizwe nohulumeni bezifunda basebenzisa noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni ngenhloso zohulumeni, kubhekwa ukusetshenziswa, ukufinyeleleka, izindleko, kanye nesimo sezifunda kanye nezinye izintandokazi zabahlali." Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala indawo lapho iminyango kahulumeni ixhumana ngempumelelo, phakathi kwezinye izinto, nabo bonke abantu bomphakathi ngolimi lwabo olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. ISevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) isebenza njengengqalasizinda yokwesekwa kwezilimi kwezobuchwepheshe kuhulumeni. Kukhona uhlelo lokuthola ulwazi ngocingo. Izinhlobo zedokhumenti ezihumushwayo ikakhulukazi zifaka lezo eziqondiswe emphakathini, njengezincwadi ezimhlophe, izincwadi eziluhlaza, umthetho ophakanyisiwe ophumeleleke ukuze uthole imibono yomphakathi, izaziso zohulumeni, imithetho, imibiko yonyaka yeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni, imibiko ye-commission kanye nezinkomiti, izivumelwano zomhlaba, izinkulumo zomongameli, izinkulumo zabaminisitiri, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikaHulumeni, amadokhumenti ezinkontileka, amaphephandaba nemikhankaso, ulwazi lwezindaba, njll.
ISevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) isebenza njengengqalasizinda yokwesekwa kwezilimi kwezobuchwepheshe kuhulumeni. Kukhona uhlelo lokuthola ulwazi ngocingo. Izinhlobo zedokhumenti ezihumushwayo ikakhulukazi zifaka lezo eziqondiswe emphakathini, njengezincwadi ezimhlophe, izincwadi eziluhlaza, umthetho ophakanyisiwe ophumeleleke ukuze uthole imibono yomphakathi, izaziso zohulumeni, imithetho, imibiko yonyaka yeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni, imibiko ye-commission kanye nezinkomiti, izivumelwano zomhlaba, izinkulumo zomongameli, izinkulumo zabaminisitiri, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikaHulumeni, amadokhumenti ezinkontileka, amaphephandaba nemikhankaso, ulwazi lwezindaba, njll. Uma idokhumenti kufanele ihumushwe ngaphezu kolimi olulodwa, kuyakhethwa ukuthi ihlelwe ngaphambi kokuhumusha ukuze igcine umqondo wayo nomyalezo. Umbhalo ohumushiwe uqhathaniswa nomthombo ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa nokubekwa kolimi nokuqinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokucophelela nokugcwalisa umbhalo, kanye nokuhlelwa kahle kwamadokhumenti ezomthetho nezaziso zohulumeni, njll. Iminyango esebenza nohulumeni, izinhlangano, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ithola izinsizakalo zeSevisi Yezilimi Zangaphandle, futhi basebenza namadokhumenti afana nezivumelwano zomhlaba, imibiko yeMnyango Wezokuphepha, izincwadi ezibhaliwe ngababhalisile, njll. Uhlelo lwefoni lunikezwa ukuze kuxazululwe ngokushesha izinselelo zokusebenzisa, ukubhala, nokufaka lezi zilimi ezisemthethweni ngochwepheshe bezilimi bomnyango abaphatha lezi zinkinga. Uma kudingeka, ucwaningo lwenziwa.
Iminyango esebenza nohulumeni, izinhlangano, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ithola izinsizakalo zeSevisi Yezilimi Zangaphandle, futhi basebenza namadokhumenti afana nezivumelwano zomhlaba, imibiko yeMnyango Wezokuphepha, izincwadi ezibhaliwe ngababhalisile, njll. Uhlelo lwefoni lunikezwa ukuze kuxazululwe ngokushesha izinselelo zokusebenzisa, ukubhala, nokufaka lezi zilimi ezisemthethweni ngochwepheshe bezilimi bomnyango abaphatha lezi zinkinga. Uma kudingeka, ucwaningo lwenziwa. Nokho, akukho ukuhumusha okuzokwenziwa ngocingo. Uma kubonakala ukuthi umsebenzi okhona uphuthumayo futhi unomthamo omkhulu futhi isikhathi esidingekayo siseduze, ngeke silinde ochwepheshe abasebenzela uMnyango Wezilimi; kuzothunyelwa ngaphandle ukuze kwenziwe ngokushesha. Umthamo omkhulu womsebenzi ovela kuMnyango Wezilimi Zangaphandle uthunyelwe ngaphandle kubachwepheshe bangaphandle njengoba isidingo eNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe siqhubeka sikhula ngokushesha. Ngokuhambisana nezihloko 3, 6, kanye no-31 zeMthethosisekelo, izinsizakalo zokuhumusha nokuhlela zeNLS ziyasiza uhulumeni ekufezeni izibopho zawo kubantu ngokweMthethosisekelo. Abathengi abakhulu balolu mnyango wokuhumusha nokuhlela bangeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni ezinomsebenzi nezinyathelo nohulumeni bezwe. Kukhona iminyango kahulumeni enezinsizakalo zayo zolimi, futhi zihumusha zodwa, njengeMnyango Wezokulungiswa, iMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanye neSevisi Yezobulungiswa.

Abathengi abakhulu balolu mnyango wokuhumusha nokuhlela bangeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni ezinomsebenzi nezinyathelo nohulumeni bezwe. Kukhona iminyango kahulumeni enezinsizakalo zayo zolimi, futhi zihumusha zodwa, njengeMnyango Wezokulungiswa, iMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanye neSevisi Yezobulungiswa. Nokho, iNLS iyasiza le minyango lapho ibhujiswa umsebenzi noma uma kudingeka ubuchwepheshe obuthile, njengokuthi uma kukhona amadokhumenti adinga ukuhumushwa ezilimini zangaphandle noma akhishwe ezilimini zangaphandle. Ezinye izifunda zinezinsizakalo zazo zolimi, kodwa zifuna usizo ku-NLS uma kudingeka. I-NLS ingancoma izifunda ngababhalisile abathembekile bezilimi ezithile abangasebenzisa. Ukuze kusebenze ngendlela ezokhiqiza imiphumela esezingeni eliphezulu nephumelelayo, ihhovisi lezilimi kumele libheke izidingo zayo ukuze abahumushi nabahleli bakwazi ukugxila emsebenzini wabo ngenkathi abasebenzi behhovisi besiza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Idokhumenti kanye nesampula kulandela indlela futhi kudlula ezinyathelweni ezithile, ezinye zazo zingase zibe zokuphatha kanti ezinye zixhumene nokuhumusha nokuhlela. a. Idokhumenti yamukelwa kwiRegistry bese ibekwa uphawu ekhasini langaphandle elikhombisa usuku lokwamukelwa kwayo bese ithunyelwa kumqondisi walowo Mnyango ukuze iphathwe kanye nesinqumo sokuthi kufanele isebenze.
Ukuze kusebenze ngendlela ezokhiqiza imiphumela esezingeni eliphezulu nephumelelayo, ihhovisi lezilimi kumele libheke izidingo zayo ukuze abahumushi nabahleli bakwazi ukugxila emsebenzini wabo ngenkathi abasebenzi behhovisi besiza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Idokhumenti kanye nesampula kulandela indlela futhi kudlula ezinyathelweni ezithile, ezinye zazo zingase zibe zokuphatha kanti ezinye zixhumene nokuhumusha nokuhlela. a. Idokhumenti yamukelwa kwiRegistry bese ibekwa uphawu ekhasini langaphandle elikhombisa usuku lokwamukelwa kwayo bese ithunyelwa kumqondisi walowo Mnyango ukuze iphathwe kanye nesinqumo sokuthi kufanele isebenze. b. Uma idokhumenti kufanele ihumushwe ngaphezu kolimi olulodwa, labo abaphethe umsebenzi wehhovisi benza amakhophi olimi lapho kudingeka ukuhumusha. c. Amakhophi athunyelwa kumakhanda alezo zindawo zolimi ezidingekayo ukuze kuhunyushwe leyo dokhumenti. d. Umphathi waleyo ndawo yolimi ubuyekeza idokhumenti, uxoxisana nabanye, bese ethatha isinqumo sokuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle. e. Idokhumenti ithunyelwa kumakhalekhukhwini noma kumuntu osebenza ngolimi ophatha incwadi yokurekhoda lapho ezobhala khona zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo ezifana nosuku idokhumenti yamukelwa, inani lamakhasi, igama leminyango ethumele idokhumenti noma umthengi, kanye nalowo ozokwenza umsebenzi wokuhumusha noma wokuhlela. f. Idokhumenti ithathwa umgibeli wombhalo wokurekhoda bese ithunyelwa kumuntu ozosebenza kuyo, futhi uma kufanele ithunyelwe ngaphandle, ithunyelwa kumqondisi ukuze uthole imvume yokuthi idokhumenti ithunyelwe ngaphandle.
d. Umphathi waleyo ndawo yolimi ubuyekeza idokhumenti, uxoxisana nabanye, bese ethatha isinqumo sokuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle. e. Idokhumenti ithunyelwa kumakhalekhukhwini noma kumuntu osebenza ngolimi ophatha incwadi yokurekhoda lapho ezobhala khona zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo ezifana nosuku idokhumenti yamukelwa, inani lamakhasi, igama leminyango ethumele idokhumenti noma umthengi, kanye nalowo ozokwenza umsebenzi wokuhumusha noma wokuhlela. f. Idokhumenti ithathwa umgibeli wombhalo wokurekhoda bese ithunyelwa kumuntu ozosebenza kuyo, futhi uma kufanele ithunyelwe ngaphandle, ithunyelwa kumqondisi ukuze uthole imvume yokuthi idokhumenti ithunyelwe ngaphandle. g. Ngemuva kokuthola le mvume, idokhumenti ithunyelwa ehhovisi lokuphatha ukuze inikezwe inombolo efanele bese ithunyelwa kumhumushi wangaphandle, osevele enze amalungiselelo ngaphambi kokukhuluma njengokukhuluma esigabeni (d) ngenhla. Umuntu osebenza ehhovisi lokuphatha wenza amakhophi omsebenzi ohumushiwe bese ethumela eyodwa kumthengi kanti enye iya esigabeni lapho umsebenzi ophelile ugcinwa khona, bese incwadi ecela ukukhokhelwa kumhumushi ibhekwa ukuze kulungiswe okuthile okufanele kubo. Ngokulandela le nqubo, umsebenzi wehhovisi lezilimi wenziwa ngendlela ehlelekile kakhulu ngoba zonke izinyathelo ezithathwayo ngedokhumenti zaziwa njengoba zirekhodwa. Ngaso sonke isikhathi, izikhathi ezihlukene kumele zilandelwe ukuze kuhunyushwe amadokhumenti eminyangweni ezodinga ngaphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezingama-20 nezilimi ezahlukene zangaphandle, okuyinto enzima, kodwa kulula kakhulu ngosizo nokwesekwa kwehhovisi lezilimi.
Umuntu osebenza ehhovisi lokuphatha wenza amakhophi omsebenzi ohumushiwe bese ethumela eyodwa kumthengi kanti enye iya esigabeni lapho umsebenzi ophelile ugcinwa khona, bese incwadi ecela ukukhokhelwa kumhumushi ibhekwa ukuze kulungiswe okuthile okufanele kubo. Ngokulandela le nqubo, umsebenzi wehhovisi lezilimi wenziwa ngendlela ehlelekile kakhulu ngoba zonke izinyathelo ezithathwayo ngedokhumenti zaziwa njengoba zirekhodwa. Ngaso sonke isikhathi, izikhathi ezihlukene kumele zilandelwe ukuze kuhunyushwe amadokhumenti eminyangweni ezodinga ngaphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezingama-20 nezilimi ezahlukene zangaphandle, okuyinto enzima, kodwa kulula kakhulu ngosizo nokwesekwa kwehhovisi lezilimi. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi ezivela, amalungu e-NLS azinikele ekukhiqizeni umsebenzi osezingeni eliphezulu. Kulokhu, kuvamile ukuthi basebenze ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile noma uma becelwa ukuthi benze njalo noma uma kudingeka ukuba benze njalo. Abathengi balolu mnyango bababheka njengomthombo wokuba khona kwehhovisi labo lezilimi. Njengoba laba bathengi bengabalingani,
I-Abe-EIMA inikeza usizo kubathumeli bezimpahla ngoxhaso lwezezimali ukuze bakwazi ukukhombisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zabo emazweni angaphandle futhi ibasize enqubweni yokuthola ukuthunyelwa kwezimpahla zokuthumela kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okuqondile ezweni. I-Abe-EIMA iphinde isize ngokunciphisa izindleko zokuthumela. Amafomu wokufaka izicelo kanye nemihlahlandlela yawo kumele afundwe ngokuhambisana nezakho. Isicelo sizophumelela kuphela uma sihlangabezana nezidingo ezibekwe ezincwadini zemihlahlandlela. Funda lezi zinkampani ngokucophelela ukuze uqonde imigomo nokuphathwa. Uhlu oluphelele lwezincwadi okufanele zifakwe kanye nesicelo lunikezwa. Izincwadi zemihlahlandlela zizokhombisa uma kukhona ezinye izincwadi ezidingekayo. Amabhizinisi avunyelwe ukufaka izicelo eziyisithupha ngonyaka, kodwa kuphela ezine zingafakwa ngaphansi kwescheme eyodwa. Noma yini ehlukile kulokhu kumele ivunywe ukuphathwa okuphakeme kwe-EMIA. Amafomu wokufaka izicelo kumele agcwaliswe kahle futhi afakwe phakathi nesikhathi esibekiwe kwi-EMIA. Izicelo eziphuthumayo ngeke zicatshangelwe. Uma isicelo sakho siqedile futhi sihlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zezincwadi ezisekelayo futhi silandela izinqubo zokwamukela, singabhekwa ukuze sivunywe. I-Abe-EMIA izokwazi ukukwazisa uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe noma saphikiswa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-48 ngemva kokuthathwa kwesinqumo sokugcina. Izicelo ngeke zamukelwe ngokuqondile. Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukuvunywa okubhalwe phansi kwesicelo sakho ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili.

Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukuvunywa okubhalwe phansi kwesicelo sakho ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili. Ikhophi yesaziso sokuvuma kumele ihambisane nazo zonke izincwadi zokuxhumana noma/ukufakwa kwezinye izincwadi kwi-EMIA. Uma i-Abe-EMIA ithola noma yiziphi izincwadi noma imibhalo evela kuwe engafaki incwadi yokuvuma yesicelo, i-Abe-EMIA ngeke ibhekelele uma lezi zincwadi zilahlekile noma zifakwe kwenye indawo ngendlela engafanele. Uma lezi zincwadi zilahlekile noma zibekwe endaweni engafanele, lokhu kungaphazamisa noma kuvimbe inqubo ye-ofisi. Uma isicelo sosizo sivunywa, ifomu lesicelo se-EMIA kumele ligcwaliswe, kanye nezincwadi ezisekelayo kanye nohlu lwezinkinga okufanele zigcwaliswe, bese kufakwa kwi-EMIA phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu kusukela ngosuku okufanele ibuyiselwe endaweni yebhizinisi evunywe. Uma ifomu lesicelo noma izincwadi ezihlobene nesicelo zingafakiwe phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu, isicelo ngeke sisavunywa. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngesevisi liyahluka kuye ngesevisi kanye nesevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Izinkampani noma abanikazi bamabhizinisi ngabanye kumele bafake izitifiketi zokukhokha zentela ezisemthethweni ukuze bazuze kulolu hlelo. Sicela ubheke ku-website ye-dti. Le sevisi inefomu layo lokufaka izicelo nemihlahlandlela. Amafomu wesicelo atholakala futhi kwezinye izinsizakalo.
Kwakwakukhathala okukhulu kwabahlengikazi ngosuku olungelanga elishisayo eGoli, lapho umoya uhlehla izihlahla ezincane ezisemathafeni. UThandi, umhlengikazi, wayehamba esuka emsebenzini, enezinyembezi eziphuma emehlweni akhe. Usuku lonke ubhekene nezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezimkhathazayo, ezimshiya edinga ukuphumula. UThandi waqonda ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile, kodwa namuhla, ubuhlungu bokukhathala kwakhe babungaphezu kokujwayelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wakhumbula izinsuku ezinhle lapho wayezwa umoya wokuzimisela. Eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule, waqala umsebenzi wakhe emnyangweni wezempilo, futhi wathokozisa ukusiza abantu, ukuletha ithemba, nokubuyisela impilo. Nokho, njengoba izinsuku zidlula, umthwalo wempilo wabahlali bendawo waba nzima kakhulu. Abantu abaninzi befinyelela ezibhedlela bezinokukhathala nezifo ezinzima, futhi uThandi wababona bebheda, ezwa sengathi umhlaba ubambelele emuva. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi waba noMnumzane Dlamini, indoda ethwele kanzima. Wayengumuntu omdala, futhi izimpawu zokukhathala zazicacile ebusweni bakhe. UThandi wamthanda, ngoba wayebona ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini uzama ukulwa nezinkinga zempilo, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babungaphezu kokubekezelela. Waqala ukuxoxa naye, uMnumzane Dlamini wabelana ngendaba yakhe, ethi: “Ngiyazama, kodwa ngiyakhathala. Ngithanda umndeni wami, kodwa ngizizwa ngisolwa, ngingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono.” UThandi wathola ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ungumuntu onothando, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babumshiya edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu, futhi lokhu kumkhathaza.
Waqala ukuxoxa naye, uMnumzane Dlamini wabelana ngendaba yakhe, ethi: “Ngiyazama, kodwa ngiyakhathala. Ngithanda umndeni wami, kodwa ngizizwa ngisolwa, ngingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono.” UThandi wathola ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ungumuntu onothando, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babumshiya edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu, futhi lokhu kumkhathaza. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe akukhona kuphela emzimbeni, kodwa nakweminye imizwa. Wayebona ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa bahlala bephila ngethemba. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, uThandi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano noMnumzane Dlamini. Wamfundisa ukuthi akufanele azizwe edinga ukulwa yedwa. Wamkhuthaza ukuba axoxe nomndeni wakhe, abavumele ukuba bamsize. UThandi wathola ukuthi umndeni kaMnumzane Dlamini wawulungele ukusiza, kodwa babengazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani. Waba yisixhumanisi phakathi kwabo, wakhuthaza ukuxhumana, futhi waba umgibeli wothando. Nokho, njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokusebenza, waqala ukuzizwa edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe akukwazi ukuncipha. Wazama ukuxhumana nabanye abahlengikazi, kodwa abanye babebonakala bephila kahle, bejabulile. Wacabanga ukuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi abanye abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa bahlala bejabulile. Waziswa ukuthi lokhu kwakuyinto ejwayelekile, kodwa wayezwa sengathi akakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noNokuthula, omunye umhlengikazi. UNokuthula wayenobungane, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ungumngane omuhle.
Waziswa ukuthi lokhu kwakuyinto ejwayelekile, kodwa wayezwa sengathi akakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noNokuthula, omunye umhlengikazi. UNokuthula wayenobungane, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ungumngane omuhle. Bakhuluma ngezinsuku zabo ezinzima, futhi uNokuthula wabelana ngendlela abawasebenzisa ngayo ukuze baphile kahle. Wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi sikhathala, kodwa kufanele sithole izindlela zokuphila. Ngithanda ukuhamba, nokwenza izinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kusisiza ukuba sibe namandla.” UThandi wathola ukuthi uNokuthula wayenamakhono okwenza izinto ezithokozisayo, futhi wathola ukuthi lokhu kwakuyindlela yokuphila. Baphuma ndawonye, bahamba emathafeni, baphumula, futhi baphinde baxoxe ngezinto ezinhle. UThandi waqala ukubona ukuthi ukukhathala akukhona kuphela ukungabi namandla, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokukhula. Waqonda ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi badinga ukuphumula, badinga ukuthokozisa. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe kwancipha. Waqonda ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu, kodwa wathola ukuthi kufanele azame ukuxhumana nabanye. Waqhubeka nokusebenza noMnumzane Dlamini, futhi wathola ukuthi umndeni wakhe wawulungele ukusiza. UThandi waba yisixhumanisi phakathi kwabo, futhi lokhu kumjabulisa. Ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala akukhona kuphela ukungabi namandla, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokukhula. Waqonda ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi badinga ukuphumula, badinga ukuthokozisa. Wathola ukuthi umhlaba ungaba mnyama, kodwa uma sikhumbula ukuthi sikhona ukuze sisize abanye, sizothola amandla okuphila.
Ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala akukhona kuphela ukungabi namandla, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokukhula. Waqonda ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi badinga ukuphumula, badinga ukuthokozisa. Wathola ukuthi umhlaba ungaba mnyama, kodwa uma sikhumbula ukuthi sikhona ukuze sisize abanye, sizothola amandla okuphila. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukukhathala akukhona kuphela ukungabi namandla, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokukhula. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi umhlaba ungaba mnyama, kodwa uma sikhumbula ukuthi sikhona ukuze sisize abanye, sizothola amandla okuphila.
Lo mthetho uqala ukusebenza ngosuku lokuqala lwezinhlinzeko zokuhlola umthelela wezimo, zika-2006 ezasungulwa ngaphansi kwengxenye 24 yeMthetho, ezashicilelwa kuMbiko Wokuhulumeni No R. 385 ka-2006. Indawo yokumbiwa ithathwa njengendawo echazwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokuphehla, u-2002 Umthetho No. Ukuhweba kwemigodi kusho ukusebenza njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokuphehla, u-2002 Umthetho No. Ilungelo lokwenza ukuhweba kwemigodi lisho ilungelo njengoba lichazwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokuphehla, u-2002 Umthetho No. Lo Mthetho ubonisa iMithetho Yokuphathwa Kwezimo Zomhlaba, u-1998 Umthetho No. Izinqubomgomo zisho Izinqubomgomo Zokuhlola Umthelela Wezimo, u-2006. Noma iyiphi uhlelo noma umsebenzi odinga imvume noma igunya ngaphansi komthetho ophatha ukukhululwa kwemithombo, ukungcoliswa, udoti, noma ukulahla futhi engakadalulwa kuMbiko Wokuhulumeni No. R. Igunya elifanele lezi zenzakalo ezibalwe kule ngxenye yeshejuli nguMnyango wezokuhlala endaweni lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa khona ngaphandle uma kuyisicelo sephrojekthi njengoba kucatshangwa ngaphansi kwengxenye 24C yeMthetho, lapho igunya linguNgqongqoshe noma ilungu leziphathimandla elithunywe njengokunjalo ngokuhambisana nengxenye 42 yeMthetho njengoba kuhlelwe kabusha.
Kungani kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakanyisiwe? Ukujabula umuntu akuthola uma eqhathanisa ukusebenza noma ukusetshenziswa kwalokho akutholayo ngokulindelwe kwakhe. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakanyisiwe ezingeni lomhlaba kuthuthukisa izinga lenkonzo esihlinzeka ngayo kumakhasimende ethu ngokushintsha umqondo wabasebenzi bethu ukusuka emcabangweni wesikhashana uye emcabangweni wokuzinza kumakhasimende - ngokwenza kanjalo, sizohlangabezana futhi sidlule kulokho abakulindele kulolu bhange kanye nezinsizakalo zalo. Ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe yikho esikufunayo ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngoba siyazi ukuthi ulindele ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe kulolu Bhange lwezeMali. Uma usizo olutholile namuhla lukujabulisile, sicela ubike kumngane. Uma ungenelisekile, sicela wazise umphathi wesikhungo. Ukubaluleka kokugxila ekugcineni amakhasimende kuye kwanda. Ubhange lwezeMali luzokwazi kuphela ukugcina amakhasimende alo uma luthuthukisa ekuhlangabezaneni nasekuthokoziseni izidingo zamakhasimende. Esikhathini esedlule, uBhange lwezeMali beluphakeme, futhi bekungadingeki ukuba lwenze imizamo ekhethekile yokugcina amakhasimende. Manje, uBhange lwezeMali luncintisana namakhasimende nabanye amabhange ezohwebo. Abantu manje bangakhetha ukuthi yimaphi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo abafuna. Amakhasimende anjengamanje afundile futhi ayahlola. Izinga lokulindela lamakhasimende lenyukile ngenxa yezinga lemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo.
Abantu manje bangakhetha ukuthi yimaphi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo abafuna. Amakhasimende anjengamanje afundile futhi ayahlola. Izinga lokulindela lamakhasimende lenyukile ngenxa yezinga lemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Uma uBhange lwezeMali luzinikele ekugcineni amakhasimende alo nasekugcineni isikhundla saso emkhakheni wezezimali, kudingeka imibono emisha noma imiqondo, ngoba izodlula izinkampani ezibeka amakhasimende azo phambili ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ephezulu. Umsebenzi wokugcina amakhasimende awuwona umthwalo kuphela weMnyango Wokumaketha Nezokuthengisa. UMnyango Wokumaketha ungaphumelela kuphela uma uhambisana kahle nezinye izigaba nabasebenzi ukuze bahlele futhi bafeze amasu okuncintisana aphezulu nezinsiza ezibalulekile kumakhasimende. Yini ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe? Lokhu kusho ukwenza konke okusemandleni akho nangaphezulu ukuze uxazulule inkinga yekhasimende. Kubandakanya ukwenza "okungaphezu kokulindelwe." Ukwenza okungaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywe emsebenzini wakho, okungaphezu kokwenzelwa abanye. Konke kukhona NGAWE. Hlale ulindele izinto ezinhle, ube nomdlandla wokusebenza, ube nezinhliziyo ezishisayo nezisebenzayo. Hlale uzama ukwenza okungcono kakhulu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuthanda umsebenzi wakho nokuzigqaja ngalokho okwenziwayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuzigqaja ngokusebenza kuBhange lwezeMali. Yini uhlelo Lokusiza lweBhange leMali? Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesithokozisayo kubo bobabili abasebenzi namakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza luyisikhombandlela sokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakubona phambi kwakho."
Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesithokozisayo kubo bobabili abasebenzi namakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza luyisikhombandlela sokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakubona phambi kwakho." Omunye wemigomo ehleliwe yeBhange leMali ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ekuphatheni izinga lempilo kubo bonke. Wena, njengommeleli webhange, unethuba elikhulu lokuba yingxenye yokushintsha ikusasa labantu! Ungowokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela amandla abo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-akhawunti abangawasebenzisa ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo. Asigxili kuphela ekuthuthukiseni abantu ngaphandle kwebhange kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Lolu hlelo luzosiza futhi ukuba ube ngumuntu onakekela abanye futhi unakekele usizo oluhlinzekwayo. Bhalisela amakhasimende ngokushesha ngokubabheka emehlweni. Uma ungakwazi ukusiza ikhasimende ngokushesha, wazise ukuthi uzobasiza masinyane. Thola ukuthi ubani ikhasimende futhi usebenzise igama labo phakathi kwengxoxo. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakhipha kahle igama labo. Xoxa nomuntu ngokuba nengxoxo emfushane nabo uma kungenzeka. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda konke abakukhulumayo, noma uma lokho kusho ukuthola umuntu ozokuhumusha. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda inkinga ethulwe kuwe ngaphambi kokuzama ukuyixazulula. Phatha bonke abantu ngenhlonipho enkulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babukeka kanjani. Phatha wonke umuntu sengathi uphatha igolide. Uma ikhasimende lingakwazi ukuhlinzekwa ngenkokhelo ngokusekelwe ezicini zeBronze, Silver, noma Gold, ubabhekisele kwenye uhlobo lwezikweletu oluphansi (isikweletu seBronze singaba yisinyathelo sokuqala). Ungagxeki amaphutha enziwe ngenye ibhange noma ibhange elikhulu. Yenza inkinga yakho futhi ungaboleka ikhasimende imali okwesikhashana uma isimo sivumela. Ngenxa yezizathu ezithile, njengentshisekelo yomphakathi, bangakhetha ukuwuphonsa icala. Ungalindela ukuthi umphakathi uzofuna ulwazi olufanele ukuze uthole inqubekelaphambili ekuphenyweni futhi uluhlonze enkantolo, uqinisekise ukuthi isinqumo sokuvumela noma sokwenqaba ukugcina umsolwa sithathwa sikhumbula izifiso zakho nemizwa yakho. Ngaphambi kokwamukela imvume yakho yokuthi ubekwe phansi, umphakathi uzocabangela izidingo zakho nezomndeni wakho. Amaphoyisa azokwazi ukukwazisa uma kudingeka ubonakale enkantolo. Izigameko eziningi zizwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, kanti lezo ezinzima kakhulu ziya enkantolo ephezulu. Ukufaka icala enkantolo kungaba nzima, ikakhulukazi uma kuhlobene nabantu abaningi. Labo abathintekayo kuleli cala bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze kuze kucace enkantolo ngokushesha okukhulu. Ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo kungaba yinkinga. Uma uthinteka, amapolisa, abaphakanyisi, nabasebenzi bekhaya bazokwazi ukukwazisa, bakulungele, futhi bakuhlinzeke ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nalokho okungenzeka. Ungaqonda futhi eqenjini labaphakanyisi, abazokwazi ukuphendula noma yimiphi imibuzo yakho mayelana nenqubo. Umphakathi ophatha icala lakho uzokwazi ukukutshela ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuthi unikeze ubufakazi. Umphakathi uzokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubizwa ukuba unikeze ubufakazi ngokushesha okukhulu. Umphakathi ohlangene necalalakho, lapho kudingeka, uzokhuluma nawe ngaphambi kokuthi ubizwe ukuba unikeze ubufakazi. Nokho, kwesinye isikhathi kungase kube nezikhathi zokulibazisa. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ukhona enkantolo ngesikhathi. Kufanele uqinisekise umphakathi uma uzobe ulahlekile noma uma ungakwazi ukuya enkantolo ngosuku lwecala. Uma kudingeka unikeze ubufakazi, kwesinye isikhathi cela umngane noma othile ophakathi kwecala ukuthi akuhambise enkantolo. Ngemuva kokunikeza ubufakazi bakho, uzokwazi ukukwazisa uma ungahamba. Ungase futhi, uma ungaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 noma uma umuntu omele icala (kungaba ummagistrate noma ijaji) ekholelwa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi kungase kubangele ukukhathazeka okungadingekile, kube nomuntu osekelayo (othile ozokhuluma ngokuqondile) uma unikeza ubufakazi ngevidiyo egumbini elivaliwe. Kumele kube nobufakazi obuqinile ngaphambi kokuthi umuntu atholakale enecala. Umphakathi kumele ukhombise ngaphandle kokungabaza ukuthi umsolwa unecala. Lokhu kungase kusho ukuthi umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi unecala utholakala engelona. Lokhu akusho ukuthi isinqumo sakho sikhulu, kodwa kukhombisa amandla wecala lokuphakanyiswa. Umphakathi ngezinye izikhathi uzobiza abaqinisekisi bakahulumeni ukuba bakuhambise kuleli cala elibhekiswe kumsolwa. Umhumushi uzobe ekhona uma kudingeka. Umphakathi uzonika ithuba lokubuza imibuzo, ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi, nokubiza abaqinisekisi. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo izwile yonke imininingwane evela kumphakathi nakuye ophikayo, umsolwa nomphikisi bazothola ithuba lokukhuluma enkantolo ngaphambi kokuthi umphumela udlule. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma umphumela, ummeleli wecala, umphakathi, noma ophikayo bangacela ukuthi ummeleli wezisulu noma omunye umuntu onekhono avunyelwe ukuveza umthelela wobugebengu kuwe noma kumsolwa.

Amatekisi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinsiza Zokuhamba Emphakathini Amatekisi, njengendlela yokuhamba, adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhamba emiphakathini ehlukene. Le ndatshana izobheka izici ezahlukene zamatekisi, kuhlanganise nomlando wabo, izinzuzo, izinkinga, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinsiza ukuze zibe usizo olukhulu emphakathini. Umlando Wamatekisi Umlando wamatekisi uqala ezikhathini zasendulo, lapho abantu behamba ngezinyawo noma ngezilwane. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubekela phambili, kwavela izindlela zokuhamba ezithuthukisiwe, okuhlanganisa amatekisi. Emazweni amaningi, amatekisi aqala njengemoto ezithengiswa ngabantu ngabanye, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zinsiza zaba yizinkampani ezinkulu ezihlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo nolulula. E-South Africa, amatekisi aqala ukuvela ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho abantu abaningi behamba besuka emakhaya baye emadolobheni ukuze bafune amathuba emisebenzi. Izinzuzo Zamatekisi Amatekisi anikeza izinzuzo eziningi kubasebenzisi bawo. Okokuqala, ahlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo, olungabizi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezindlela zokuhamba ezinkulu, njengezitimela noma izindiza. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho ukuhamba ngezinyawo noma ngezimoto zomphakathi kungathatha isikhathi eside. Okwesibili, amatekisi avumela abantu ukuba bahambe ngezikhathi ezihlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zabo zansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebenza ezikhungweni ezahlukene abadinga ukufika emsebenzini ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amatekisi anika abantu ithuba lokuhweba emiphakathini.
Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho ukuhamba ngezinyawo noma ngezimoto zomphakathi kungathatha isikhathi eside. Okwesibili, amatekisi avumela abantu ukuba bahambe ngezikhathi ezihlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zabo zansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebenza ezikhungweni ezahlukene abadinga ukufika emsebenzini ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amatekisi anika abantu ithuba lokuhweba emiphakathini. Abashayeli bamatekisi bavame ukuba neziqondiso ezinhle mayelana nezindawo ezithile, okwenza kube lula kubagibeli ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengezindawo zokudlela, izitolo, nezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabashayeli nabagibeli, okukhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Izinkinga Zamatekisi Nokho, amatekisi abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhwalithi yokuphepha. Abashayeli bamatekisi abavame ukuba neziqu eziphezulu noma ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo, okungaholela ezimeni ezimbi zokuphepha. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka kubagibeli, ikakhulukazi uma behamba ebusuku noma ezindaweni ezingaziwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto zamatekisi zihlala zisebenzisa amafutha, okukhulisa izinga lokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Enye inkinga ebalulekile yikhono lokuhweba. Ezinye izinkampani zamatekisi zisebenzisa izindlela zokuhweba ezingafanele, okuholela ekutheni abashayeli bahlupheke ngokwezimali, okungathinta ikhwalithi yokuhamba. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Amatekisi Ukuze amatekisi abe usizo olukhulu emphakathini, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kubashayeli bamatekisi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde izindinganiso zokuphepha, izindlela zokuhweba, kanye nezidingo zabagibeli.
Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Amatekisi Ukuze amatekisi abe usizo olukhulu emphakathini, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kubashayeli bamatekisi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde izindinganiso zokuphepha, izindlela zokuhweba, kanye nezidingo zabagibeli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngama-licence aqinile kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bahlala bephila kahle. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni amatekisi. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhamba, kungasiza abashayeli nabagibeli ukuba baxhumane kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhamba, futhi kunciphise isikhathi sokulinda. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani zamatekisi ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izindawo zokupaka ezikahle, ukuhlinzeka ngama-licence afanele, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisa amatekisi nezinye izindlela zokuhamba. Isiphetho Amatekisi, njengendlela yokuhamba, anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhamba emiphakathini. Nakuba ebhekene nezinselelo eziningi, izinzuzo zawo zikhombisa ukuthi ziwusizo olukhulu. Ngokuthuthukisa amatekisi, singaqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsiza zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaza umnotho, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabagibeli. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayeli, abagibeli, kanye nohulumeni kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lamatekisi.
Kungani kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluqondile? Ukwaneliseka umuntu akuthola uma eqhathanisa ukusebenza noma ukusetshenziswa kwalokho akutholayo nezilindelo zakhe. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluqondile ezingeni lomhlaba kuthuthukisa izinga lenkonzo esinikeza amakhasimende ethu ngokushintsha umqondo wabasebenzi bethu ukusuka emcabangweni wesikhashana uze ube sesimweni sokuzinza kumakhasimende - ngokwenza lokhu, sizohlangabezana futhi sithuthukise lokho amakhasimende alindele kulolu bhange kanye nezinsizakalo zalo. Ukusiza okuqondile yikho esikufunayo ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngoba siyazi ukuthi ulindele ukusiza okuqondile kulolu Bhange Lomhlaba. Uma usizo olutholile namuhla lukwazile ukujabulisa, sicela ubhale kumngane. Uma unganelisekile, sicela wazise umphathi wesigaba. Ukubaluleka kokugxila ekugcineni amakhasimende kuye kwanda. Ubhange Lomhlaba luzokwazi kuphela ukugcina amakhasimende alo uma luthuthukisa ekuhlangabezaneni nasekuthokoziseni izidingo zamakhasimende. Esikhathini esedlule, uBhange Lomhlaba wawungakhathazeki, futhi kwakungekho mfuneko yokwenza imizamo ekhethekile yokugcina amakhasimende. Manje, uBhange Lomhlaba luncintisana namakhasimende namanye amabhangqa ezohwebo. Abantu manje bangakhetha ukuthi yimaphi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo abafuna. Amakhasimende namuhla afundile futhi ayahlakanipha. Izinga lokulindela lamakhasimende lenyukile ngenxa yezinga lemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo.
Abantu manje bangakhetha ukuthi yimaphi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo abafuna. Amakhasimende namuhla afundile futhi ayahlakanipha. Izinga lokulindela lamakhasimende lenyukile ngenxa yezinga lemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Uma uBhange Lomhlaba uzinikele ekugcineni amakhasimende alo nasekugcineni isikhundla sawo emkhakheni wezezimali, kudingeka imicabango emisha noma imibono, ngoba izodlula izinkampani ezibeka amakhasimende azo phambili ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo esezingeni eliphezulu. Umsebenzi wokugcina amakhasimende awuwona umthwalo kuphela weMnyango Wokumaketha Nezokuthengisa. IMnyango Yokumaketha ingaphumelela kuphela uma ixhumana kahle namanye amakhono kanye nabasebenzi ukuze ihlele futhi iqhube amasu okuncintisana aphezulu kanye nosizo olunenzuzo kumakhasimende. Yini ukusiza okuqondile? Lokhu kusho ukwenza konke okusemandleni akho nangaphezulu ukuze uxazulule inkinga yekhasimende. Kubandakanya ukwenza "okungaphezu kokulindelekile." Ukwenza okungaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma ngakho emsebenzini wakho, okungaphezu kwalokho abanye abangakwenza. Konke kukhulu ngawe. Qhubeka ulindele izinto ezinhle, ube nomdlandla wokusebenza, ube nezinhloso ezinhle nezikhuthazayo. Qhubeka uzame ukwenza okungcono kakhulu. Kukho uthando lomsebenzi wakho nokuzigqaja ngalokho okwenza. Kukho ukuzigqaja ngokusebenza kuBhange Lomhlaba. Yini uhlelo Lokusiza lweBhange Lomhlaba? Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesijabulisayo kubasebenzi nakumakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza lungumhlahlandlela wakho wokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakufronti."
Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesijabulisayo kubasebenzi nakumakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza lungumhlahlandlela wakho wokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakufronti." Omunye wemigomo ehleliwe yeBhange Lomhlaba ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo impilo yabantu bonke. Wena, njengommeleli webhange, unethuba elikhulu lokuba yingxenye yokushintsha ikusasa labantu! Ungowokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela amandla abo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-funds abangawasebenzisa ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo. Asigxili kuphela ekuthuthukiseni abantu ngaphandle kwebhange kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Lolu hlelo luzosiza futhi ukuba ukhule ube umuntu okhathalelayo kwabanye futhi uphathe kahle usizo oluhlinzekayo. Siphakamisa bonke abasebenzi beBhange Lomhlaba ukuba babambe iqhaza noma basebenze ngokulandela amaphuzu alandelayo: Masikhuthaze futhi sikhuthazane nsuku zonke, hhayi kuphela ukwenza kahle ngezakhono zethu kodwa futhi ukusabalalisa injabulo ekuphatheni umsebenzi wethu nasekuphileni kwethu! Bhalisela amakhasimende ngokushesha ngokubabheka emehlweni. Uma ungakwazi ukusiza ikhasimende ngokushesha, wazise ukuthi uzobasiza maduze. Bhalisela wonke amakhasimende endaweni yokulinda, noma uzobasiza noma cha, bese ubuza uma sebekwazile ukuthola usizo nokuthi ungabasiza kanjani. Uma usukulungele ukusiza ikhasimende, mushe, bhalisela, uthi "sawubona," uxolise ngokulinda, bese uzethula ngegama, isibonelo, "Sawubona, ngiyaxolisa ngokukugcina ulindile. NgiyiJane (noma uNkk. Smith), ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?"
Uma usukulungele ukusiza ikhasimende, mushe, bhalisela, uthi "sawubona," uxolise ngokulinda, bese uzethula ngegama, isibonelo, "Sawubona, ngiyaxolisa ngokukugcina ulindile. NgiyiJane (noma uNkk. Smith), ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?" Ulimi lomzimba wakho kufanele lukhombise ukuncipha, futhi izwi lakho kufanele libe nomoya opholile. Thola ukuthi ikhasimende ngubani bese usebenzisa igama labo kuyo yonke ingxoxo. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakhipha igama labo kahle. Xhumana nomuntu ngokuba nengxoxo emfushane nabo uma kungenzeka. "Kuyinsuku enhle namuhla, akunjalo?" Yiba nomusa, ungahlukanisi, ulindele izinto ezinhle, futhi ube nomuntu. Khombisa ubuchwepheshe emsebenzini wakho futhi njalo ulindele izinto ezinhle. Ungavumeli amakhasimende ukuba azwe izingxoxo zakho zangasese, noma uma ukhuluma ngefoni noma unenxoxo phakathi kwabantu ababili. Phatha ngokuhlonipha. Ungaphenduli ifoni yakho ye-cell ngaphandle kokuxolisa ku ikhasimende kuqala bese uzixolela ngemva kokuphothula ucingo. Wazise ikhasimende ukuthi uhamba kuphi uma ushiya indawo yakho yokusebenza. Lalela ngokucophelela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubuza yonke imibuzo ezoholela ekutholeni yonke imininingwane efanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda konke abakukhuluma, noma uma lokhu kusho ukuthola umuntu ozokhuluma ngesiNgisi. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda inkinga ethulelwe kuwe ngaphambi kokuzama ukuyixazulula. Phatha abantu bonke ngenhlonipho enkulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babukeka kanjani. Phatha wonke umuntu sengathi uthwele igolide. Thatha isikhathi sokuchaza ikhasimende ukuthi kungani isicelo sabo sesikweletu saphikiswa.
Phatha abantu bonke ngenhlonipho enkulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babukeka kanjani. Phatha wonke umuntu sengathi uthwele igolide. Thatha isikhathi sokuchaza ikhasimende ukuthi kungani isicelo sabo sesikweletu saphikiswa. Uma ikhasimende lingatholi isikweletu ngokusekelwe ezimfuneko zeBronze, Silver, noma Gold, ubabheke kwenye uhlobo lwesikweletu oluphansi (isikweletu seBronze singaba isinyathelo sokuqala). Thatha isikhathi sokuzama ukuhlinzeka ikhasimende ngosizo olufanele kanye nezinsiza zezezimali (ukuhlukaniswa kwezingozi) ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Ungagxeki amaphutha enziwe yibhange elinye noma ibhange eliyinhloko. Yenza inkinga ibe yakho futhi ungaboleka ikhasimende imali ngokwesikhashana uma isimo sivumela. Gwema ukwenza umsebenzi ongekho emthethweni wokuhlinzeka ngosizo lapho abantu bekufronti. Qedela ingxoxo yakho nekhasimende ngokubabonga, ubabize ngegama, futhi ubafisele "ubusuku obuhle." Wazise umamukeli wocingo uma ungakabi nesikhathi sokuthola izingcingo ngalolo suku. Ungakwenzi izingcingo lapho usebenza noma uyeke ifoni ibhange. Xolisa kumuntu uma ucingo lwakho luhamba isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuphendulwa. Umamukeli wocingo kuBhange Lomhlaba "Isigaba," Sawubona, ngingakusiza kanjani?" ungakhetha ulimi ofuna ukhulume ngalo. Sawubona, ngiyi [Igama], ngingakusiza kanjani?
