Lo mthetho uhlanganisa umthethosisekelo. I-Centre isunguliwe njengomuntu ophakathi kwezomthetho okuzobizwa ngokuthi i-South African Science Centre. Iphakamisa ngokuphelele ubuhlakani babantu bonke; futhi inikeza izeluleko ezinhle futhi ikhulisa izenzo mayelana nezidingo zokubambisana, amathuba, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nabo bonke abakha iNingizimu Afrika. Le Centre iyona kuphela i-science centre eyamukelwa nguHulumeni. UNgqongqoshe angayala le Centre ukuba iqhube imisebenzi ethile ehambisana nezinhloso zayo. Kunohlobo olulodwa lokubhaliswa kule Centre, kodwa amalungu angaba amalungu anenhlonipho (labo abahoxile kodwa basahlonishwa) kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka wabo wokusebenza obubanjwe iminyaka engama-70. Ilungu leCentre kulindeleke ukuthi lisize le Centre ukufezekisa izinhloso zayo. Inqubo ezolandela uma kukhethwa amalungu eCentre izoba yimpumelelo enkulu ekuthuthukiseni noma ekusebenziseni isayensi. Abantu abaphakanyiswa ukuba babe amalungu amasha eCentre bazophakanyiswa futhi banikezwe isitifiketi esinqunywe ngamalungu okungenani amane, okungenani amabili kufanele abe nolwazi lomuntu siqu ngomsebenzi wesayensi kanye nendima ebonakalayo edlalwe yilowo muntu esayensi. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sihlanganise incazelo echaza ukuthi ukhetho kwalowo muntu njengelungu leCentre kuzothuthukisa kanjani izinhloso zeCentre. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sibe nekhasi elichaza ukuzibophezela kwalowo muntu ukuba aqashwe njengelungu leCentre, futhi kufanele sibe ne dokhumenti echaza umlando wabo wezokufunda nezokusebenza (curriculum vitae). IBhodi leCentre kufanele ibuyekeze minyaka yonke zonke izicelo ezintsha ezithunyelwe ngonyaka odlule, kulandela inqubo esunguliwe yokufaneleka.
Lesi sitifiketi kumele sihlanganise incazelo echaza ukuthi ukhetho kwalowo muntu njengelungu leCentre kuzothuthukisa kanjani izinhloso zeCentre. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sibe nekhasi elichaza ukuzibophezela kwalowo muntu ukuba aqashwe njengelungu leCentre, futhi kufanele sibe ne dokhumenti echaza umlando wabo wezokufunda nezokusebenza (curriculum vitae). IBhodi leCentre kufanele ibuyekeze minyaka yonke zonke izicelo ezintsha ezithunyelwe ngonyaka odlule, kulandela inqubo esunguliwe yokufaneleka. Bonke abakhona njengamalungu eCentre kuzodingeka bavote, ngovoti olufihlekile, baveze ukuthi bayamukela noma abamukeli umuntu othile ophakanyiswe yiBhodi noma baveze uma besendaweni yokungavoti noma bephakathi. Amalungu eCentre angavoti azobhekwa njengokuthi abavoti. Umuntu othola okungenani amavoti amathathu uzobhekwa njengokhetho njengelungu leCentre, uma okungenani ingxenye yamavoti imamukele. a "Mina, egameni eliphelele, ngiyafunga ukuthi ngizothuthukisa isimo eNingizimu Afrika ngokucabanga kwesayensi futhi ngiphakamise izinhloso ze-South African Science Centre ngokusemandleni ami; futhi b Ngizohlonipha umthethosisekelo osunguliwe kanye nezikhombandlela ezisunguliwe zeCentre njengoba ngisahlala ngilungu leCentre." Noma ilungu leCentre linomsebenzi, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-subsection 9, yokubamba iqhaza ekhetho lamalungu amasha eCentre kanye namalungu eBhodi. ICentre izophathwa futhi ibusiswe yiBhodi ngokweMthetho. IBhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinhloso zeCentre zifezwa ngokuzikhandla futhi kufanele ibheke ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi yeCentre.
Noma ilungu leCentre linomsebenzi, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-subsection 9, yokubamba iqhaza ekhetho lamalungu amasha eCentre kanye namalungu eBhodi. ICentre izophathwa futhi ibusiswe yiBhodi ngokweMthetho. IBhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinhloso zeCentre zifezwa ngokuzikhandla futhi kufanele ibheke ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi yeCentre. e kanye namalungu ayisixhenxe; kanye f ilungu elilodwa leBhodi yeZeluleko Kazwelonke ku-Innovation ezokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe. Amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwalawo malungu akhuluma ngawo ku-subsection 3 f, azokhethwa ngamalungu eCentre phakathi kwabo bese ekhethwa nguNgqongqoshe. IBhodi izosebenzisa amandla anikezwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho futhi iqhube imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngumlomo. a IBhodi izobamba imihlangano yayo ngezikhathi nezindawo ezizokwenziwa nguMongameli. b Amalungu akhona emhlanganweni azokwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano futhi enze izinqumo uma iningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni. b umuntu ophukile ezinkingeni zezimali futhi ongakabuyiselwa ngokomthetho. g ophume emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha okungafanele ngemva kokulalela mayelana nesenzo esingase sibe nomthelela omubi kwiCentre, kodwa leli lungu lingase likhanselwe kuze kube emhlanganweni wonyaka olandelayo lapho leli khanselo kumele libe kubhalwe emaminithini ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nemigomo yale ngxenye, umuntu ophakamisile isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokukhansela kufanele ayithumele kuMongameli futhi iBhodi izomukela le khanselo uma zonke izikweletu zikhokhiwe.
b umuntu ophukile ezinkingeni zezimali futhi ongakabuyiselwa ngokomthetho. g ophume emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha okungafanele ngemva kokulalela mayelana nesenzo esingase sibe nomthelela omubi kwiCentre, kodwa leli lungu lingase likhanselwe kuze kube emhlanganweni wonyaka olandelayo lapho leli khanselo kumele libe kubhalwe emaminithini ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nemigomo yale ngxenye, umuntu ophakamisile isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokukhansela kufanele ayithumele kuMongameli futhi iBhodi izomukela le khanselo uma zonke izikweletu zikhokhiwe. Noma ilungu leBhodi elifuna ukukhansela ubulungu balo kufanele lithumele isaziso esibhaliwe sokukhansela esibhalwe kuMongameli, futhi iBhodi kufanele yamukele lesi saziso uma zonke izikweletu ezidingekayo zikhokhiwe. Uma isikhala selungu leBhodi siba singenalutho ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi salo lungu, uNgqongqoshe, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-subsection 1, kufanele aqashe umuntu ophakanyiswe yiBhodi ukuze agcwalise leso sikhala phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 zokungabi nalutho. IBhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwezinhlelo, ingasebenzisa amandla noma iqhube noma iyiphi imisebenzi yeCentre ebekwe kuyo yiBhodi. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalo ku-subsection 1 lizoba nezinye amalungu eCentre kanye nabasebenzi beCentre abathathwa njengabafanele yiBhodi, uma kukhona, iBhodi ingase isuse noma ibuyisele ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanele. Uma ikomidi linamalungu angaphezu kwelilodwa, iBhodi kufanele iqashe ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe ngumholi walelo komidi.
IBhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwezinhlelo, ingasebenzisa amandla noma iqhube noma iyiphi imisebenzi yeCentre ebekwe kuyo yiBhodi. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalo ku-subsection 1 lizoba nezinye amalungu eCentre kanye nabasebenzi beCentre abathathwa njengabafanele yiBhodi, uma kukhona, iBhodi ingase isuse noma ibuyisele ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanele. Uma ikomidi linamalungu angaphezu kwelilodwa, iBhodi kufanele iqashe ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe ngumholi walelo komidi. IBhodi ayinakubhekelela ukwenza noma iyiphi imisebenzi ebekwe kunoma ikuphi ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi. Ngaphezu kwemisebenzi ethile ebekwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, kuzoba ngummeli ophathelene nokuhlola izimali ezitholakele nokusetshenziswa kwazo futhi kuzoba nomthwalo wokubheka impahla yeCentre. i ingase ikhiphe kumunye ilungu leBhodi amandla anikezwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho noma kulolu mthetho; noma ii ivumele lowo muntu ukuba aqhube imisebenzi ebekwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. b Ukuhlinzekwa kwamandla ngaphansi kwe-subsection a akuvimbele ukuhlinzeka ngalawo mandla noma ukwenza leyo msebenzi kumongameli. Uma ufuna ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho lokulima ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukusetha imigomo nezinhlelo zakho. Awukwazi ukuhamba endleleni ungazi ukuthi uhamba kuphi. Ngokuvamile, abakhiqizi baziwa njengabangenakho noma abaphoxekile ngokungasethi imigomo yebhizinisi noma yokuphila. Kunzima ukuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima ngoba izimo zomsebenzi lo azilula; awazi ukuthi ikusasa lizoba kanjani. Kudinga isikhathi esiningi ukuhlanganisa imigomo ecacile yebhizinisi lokulima. Kokubili lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa izinjongo akufanele kushiywe ngemuva, nakuba kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi. Imigomo nezinhlelo (amasu) zikhombisa indlela phambili; ngaphandle kwazo, awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi uzophumelela noma uphumelele. Ngaphandle kwemigomo, awukwazi ukukala ukuthi usebenza kahle ngoba awunanto oyihlosile. Ukuhlanganisa inhloso nokusetha imigomo emsebenzini wokulima kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi, kodwa kubalulekile ukwenza lo msebenzi; kumele siwenze. Ukusetha nokuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima kuvame ukuza nezinkinga. Isizathu salokhu sitholakala lapha: ukulima kuyindlela yokusebenza komlimi futhi kuyindlela umlimi aphila ngayo (kuwukuphila kwabo). Umndeni wabo ungowengxenye yezinto ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabo wokulima kanye nokuphila kwabo. Ngokuvamile, siyazi ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yebhizinisi ukwenza inzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kodwa ekulimaleni, lokhu akuhambisani njalo ngoba ibhizinisi nempilo yokuphila kuhlangene. Singasho ukuthi imigomo yalomsebenzi ingaba ukwenza inzuzo enhle, kodwa akufanele ilethe umlimi nomndeni wakhe ubunzima. Izinjongo ezihlanganisiwe ngenhla azichaziwe kahle futhi zingabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene.
Ngokuvamile, siyazi ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yebhizinisi ukwenza inzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kodwa ekulimaleni, lokhu akuhambisani njalo ngoba ibhizinisi nempilo yokuphila kuhlangene. Singasho ukuthi imigomo yalomsebenzi ingaba ukwenza inzuzo enhle, kodwa akufanele ilethe umlimi nomndeni wakhe ubunzima. Izinjongo ezihlanganisiwe ngenhla azichaziwe kahle futhi zingabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kodwa uma zisetshenziswa, lezi zinjongo zicacile ngoba akukhona abantu ababili abacabanga ngendlela efanayo noma baphila ngendlela efanayo futhi abavumi umndeni omuhle ngendlela efanayo. Ngakho-ke, isifiso somlimi sokwenza inzuzo sizohluka ngoba omunye ngeke abuke lezi zinto ngendlela efanayo futhi ngeke alandele indlela efanayo yokwenza inzuzo. Nokho, kubalulekile kumlimi othile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi impilo enhle izobiza malini mayelana nomsebenzi wabo wokwenza inzuzo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele kubo kanye nezidingo zabo. Umphakathi udinga umkhakha wezolimo ukuze ukhiqize imikhiqizo ethile - lokhu kuzohambisana namakhono ezwe elithile - ikakhulukazi ukudla nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ngentengo ephansi, futhi siqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinto. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abalimi kumele basebenzise izinsiza zemvelo ikakhulukazi esikhathini eside. Kodwa izinhloso ezivamile zodwa azizukwanele. Iphrojekthi ngayinye idinga imigomo ethile, kodwa le migomo kufanele ihambisane nenhloso evamile. Isibonelo: umlimi ofuna ukukhiqiza ummbila kufanele abe nemigomo ethile yokukhiqiza ummbila, masithi uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamahektare angu-500 ommbila obomvu ngonyaka. Kodwa akupheli lapho.
Iphrojekthi ngayinye idinga imigomo ethile, kodwa le migomo kufanele ihambisane nenhloso evamile. Kumele bazi futhi ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo mayelana nemisebenzi edingekayo nezindleko ezizovela ngoba lokhu kuzobakhombisa ukuthi amasheya abo ahlobene kanjani nezidingo zamakhowe nezifuywa. Umlimi ngamunye kumele aqonde ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo. Siphinda sithi kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izinhloso; umlimi kumele aqonde kahle ukuthi ufuna ukuya kuphi ngebhizinisi lakhe lokulima. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kulezi zinjongo, umlimi kumele ahlale phansi acabange ukukhetha imigomo efanele kubo, ukuphila kwabo, nezidingo zabo. Uma beqala ukwakha amasheya amasha ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambisana nezinjongo ezivamile nezidingo zabo. Konke esikushilo mayelana nokuhlanganisa izinhloso kungafingqwa kulezi zisho ezimbalwa: inhloso yebhizinisi lokulima ukufuna ukufinyelela inzuzo enkulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza zemvelo (izimpahla) ezifana nomhlabathi, amanzi, izindawo zokufuywa, njll., ukuze zisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezinhle esikhathini eside. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bahlela izinhlelo zokubheka ukuze baqhubeke beqoqa ulwazi oluzobavumela ukuba baphendule indlela yabo yokusebenza ngokushesha uma kwenzeka umonakalo.
Uma beqala ukwakha amasheya amasha ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambisana nezinjongo ezivamile nezidingo zabo. Konke esikushilo mayelana nokuhlanganisa izinhloso kungafingqwa kulezi zisho ezimbalwa: inhloso yebhizinisi lokulima ukufuna ukufinyelela inzuzo enkulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza zemvelo (izimpahla) ezifana nomhlabathi, amanzi, izindawo zokufuywa, njll., ukuze zisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezinhle esikhathini eside. Ukuhlanganisa izinhloso kufana nokubuza "lokhu kusho ukuthini" emsebenzini wokulima, okusho ukuthi sifuna impendulo emibuzweni ethi "Sifuna ukwenza ini, sifuna ukufinyelela ini, sifuna ukufika kuphi?" Ezinye izinhloso nezinhlelo zihlupha. Kubalulekile ukusetha inani elithile lemikhiqizo ngehektare - lokhu kusho ukuthi inani lemikhiqizo elibekwe ebhajethi yonyaka kufanele likwazi ukufezeka. Lokhu kuhluka phakathi kwezindawo zokulima ezithile. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yakho ihlangabezana nezidingo zemakethe - umphathi wemikhiqizo kufanele abeke phambili izinhloso ezizohlangabezana nalezi zidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungafaka izinto ezifana nosayizi, umbala, ikhwalithi yangaphakathi, njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo - lokhu kusho ukuthi izici zemvelo zingase zibe sengozini lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, njengezinto ezikhipha izilokazane, izifuywa, njll.

Lokhu kungafaka izinto ezifana nosayizi, umbala, ikhwalithi yangaphakathi, njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo - lokhu kusho ukuthi izici zemvelo zingase zibe sengozini lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, njengezinto ezikhipha izilokazane, izifuywa, njll. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhiqiza kule ndawo kuzokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi usebenza ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeZinhlelo Zokulima Ezinhle (GAP) - i-GAP ifuna ukuthi izinto zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela ngoba zingaba sengozini kulabo abasebenza nazo. Izinto zokubulala izilokazane, izithako, nezifuywa kufanele zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela; amanzi akufanele angcoliswe, futhi kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuvikela ukulahleka, ukungcoliswa, nokuhamba. Kungase kube nezinye izinhloso ezizosebenza ezindaweni zokulima ezithile, kodwa lezi ezichazwe lapha zizokwandisa ukuthi umsebenzi wakho uzophumelela.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma abahlali abaphakade abashintshile ubulili babo ngaphambi kokuthi umthetho weBhidi neMibhalo Yokufa, 1992, uqale ukusebenza, bangafaka isicelo sokushintsha ubulili babo. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-526E kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma emishinini uma ungekho ezweni. Thola isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Uma umuntu enezinhlangothi ezithile ezishintshiwe ngezinqubo zokuhlinzwa noma ukwelashwa kwehormone, bangathumela imibiko echaza uhlobo nemiphumela yenqubo eyenziwe noma ukwelashwa okusetshenziswe noma okukhishwe odokotela abahlinzile noma abaphatha lokho ukwelashwa. Kulolu hlobo, nikeza umbiko ochaza ubulili bamanje bomuntu, obuhambisana nesicelo. Lo mbiko kumele wenziwe udokotela ophenyile isicelo ukuze aqinisekise ubulili abavela kubo. Thola umbiko ophume ku-psychiatrist owanikeze iseluleko, unikeze ulwazi oluphelele ngalesi sihloko, ikakhulukazi umlando walo, kanye nesimo umuntu abukeka sikhona mayelana nemizwa yabo nemicabango mayelana nokushintsha. Uma isicelo sinesikhathi esingama-16 noma ngaphezulu, kufanele kufakwe isicelo sokuhlonza esihlukile. Izithombe zezimfanelo kumele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngokomthetho, futhi ulwazi olusha kumele lungene kwi-database ye-HANIS. Le sevisi ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-8. Ezamabhange: Ukuhlaziywa Kokubaluleka Kwazo Emasikweni Asethu Ezamabhange zisebenza emhlabeni wonke futhi zinemisebenzi ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali. Zithuthukise izindlela zokuphila kwabantu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangagcina imali yabo, okwakha ithuba lokuhlela izindleko zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba ukulahlekelwa yimali. Amabhange awasizi kuphela ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo zokulondoloza, kodwa futhi adlala indima enkulu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezifana nezikweletu, ukutshala izimali, nokwenza ukuhweba kwezimpahla kube lula. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezamabhange ziza nezimo ezahlukene, futhi izinzuzo nezithiyo ezihambisana nazo kumele zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Akubona bonke abantu abathola kalula lezi zinsizakalo, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile, lapho ukuntuleka kokufinyelela nezindleko zokusebenzisa amabhange kungaholela ekuhlukaniseni. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezinzuzweni ezitholakala ezamabhange. Imithetho ethile yokubhalisela amabhange ibalulekile ekuvikeleni abathengi, inika abantu ithuba lokubanga amalungelo abo. Nokho, le mithetho ingase ibangele izithiyo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abanenkinga zokulawula izindleko. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubo ukufaka izicelo zemali, okukhulisa ubunzima. Amabhange adinga ukuthi umphakathi uphathwe kahle ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Ukukhula kwezimali kumabhange kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayi bezezimali, futhi lokhu kudinga umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obufanele. Ukuze amabhange akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende, kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngamasu amasha afanele.
Amabhange adinga ukuthi umphakathi uphathwe kahle ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Ukukhula kwezimali kumabhange kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayi bezezimali, futhi lokhu kudinga umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obufanele. Ukuze amabhange akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende, kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngamasu amasha afanele. Ukuba nolwazi olunembile mayelana nezinsizakalo zamabhange kubalulekile ukuze abathengi baqonde kahle izinqubomgomo ezithinta izimali zabo. Ukuhlakanipha kwabathengi kudinga ukuba kube ngaphezu kokuhlola ibhange elithile; kumqoka ukuthi kube nokuhlonipha nolwazi oluqinile. Ngokuphetha, ezamabhange zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali, futhi umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuxoxa ngalezi zinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bathola izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze umnotho ube muhle, umphakathi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle, ukuze amabhange ahlale enza umthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu.
Ubuxhwanguxhwangu Ezikoleni – Ukubuyekezwa Ubuxhwanguxhwangu ezikoleni, obaziwa ngokuthi "school bullying," yinkinga enkulu ethinta imiphakathi eminingi. Le nkinga ivame ukubonakala ezikoleni, lapho abafundi behlangana khona, futhi ingaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuxhwanguxhwangu, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimbangela, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nemiphumela ethinta abafundi, othisha, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Okokuqala, ubuxhwanguxhwangu bukhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi buphuma ezizindeni ezahlukene. Abafundi bangaba yizisulu ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene, njengokwehluka kwemvelo, izici zomuntu siqu, noma izimo zomndeni. Izinsuku zokuqala zesikole ziba nzima kubafundi abasha, ikakhulukazi uma behlangabezana nabanye abafundi abakhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuzizwa bekhululekile, futhi kungaholela ekutheni bahlale bephoxekile. Izindlela ezisetshenziswa ngabaxhwanguxhwangu zihluke kakhulu. Abanye bangasebenzisa amagama amabi, bahlambalaza, noma baqhamuka nezinsolo, kuyilapho abanye bengasebenzisa izindlela ezibucayi, ezifana nokuhlukumeza ngokomzimba. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga ezinkulu ezisizulweni, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nokwehla kokuzethemba. Abafundi abavame ukuba izisulu balahlekelwa ithemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukuhlala ezikoleni, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphume esikoleni noma baphumelele kahle ezifundweni zabo. Othisha, njengabantu abaphethe izikole, bahlala bebalulekile ekuxazululeni le nkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi othisha bazi izimpawu zokuxhwanguxhwangu ukuze bakwazi ukusiza abafundi abathintekayo.
Abafundi abavame ukuba izisulu balahlekelwa ithemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukuhlala ezikoleni, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphume esikoleni noma baphumelele kahle ezifundweni zabo. Othisha, njengabantu abaphethe izikole, bahlala bebalulekile ekuxazululeni le nkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi othisha bazi izimpawu zokuxhwanguxhwangu ukuze bakwazi ukusiza abafundi abathintekayo. Ukuhlonipha abafundi nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali kudinga ukuba kube yinxenye ebalulekile yokwakha isiko lokuhlalisana kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abafundi ukuze bazi ukuthi bangaxhumana nobani uma bebhekene nezinkinga. Mayelana nemiphumela, ubuxhwanguxhwangu bungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yesisulu. Abafundi abahlukunyezwayo bangase baphatheke kabi, bahlupheke ngokomoya, futhi bahlale bephoxekile. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izisulu zingase zibe nezinselelo zokuxhumana nabanye, zibe nezinselelo zokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi zibe nezinselelo zokuphumelela ezikoleni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuxhwanguxhwangu akukhona nje kuphela udlame phakathi kwabafundi, kodwa kungaba nemiphumela eminingi emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuze sithole isixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke uhlanganyele. Abazali, othisha, nabafundi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe isimo esiphephile nezindawo zokufunda. Ukukhuluma ngale nkinga, ukufundisa abafundi ngezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ubuxhwanguxhwangu.
Ukuze sithole isixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke uhlanganyele. Abazali, othisha, nabafundi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe isimo esiphephile nezindawo zokufunda. Ukukhuluma ngale nkinga, ukufundisa abafundi ngezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ubuxhwanguxhwangu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya ukufundisa abafundi ngezinto ezinjengokuhlonipha, ukuziphatha kahle, nokubambisana. Ekugcineni, ubuxhwanguxhwangu ezikoleni yinkinga edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze siqede le nkinga. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izimbangela, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa, futhi sakhe isiko lokuhlalisana kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusiza abafundi bethu ukuba bakhule, bathole impumelelo, futhi babe nekhono lokuphila kahle empilweni yabo. Ubuxhwanguxhwangu akufanele buphumelele; kumele sibe neqhaza eliqinile ekulweni nalesi simo.
Ikota Umbuzo 1: Yini ikota? Ikota iyisikhathi esithile sokuphila esivame ukwenziwa ngezinyanga ezine. Kubalulekile emikhakheni ehlukene, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, ezemali, nasezinhlelweni zokuphatha. Ikota ibonisa indlela yokusebenza, yokuhlola, nokubika imiphumela ethile ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ikota ibalulekile? Ikota ibalulekile ngoba isiza izinkampani ukuba zihlaziye ukusebenza kwazo, zenze izinqumo ezifanele, futhi zihlale ziqonda izimo zemboni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikota ivumela abaphathi ukuba bahlaziye izindleko, imikhiqizo, nezinsizakalo, ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. Umbuzo 3: Kanjani ikota isetshenziswa ezinkampanini? Ezinkampanini, ikota isetshenziswa ukuze kubonwe ukuthi izinjongo zonyaka zifezekile yini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubika ngezindleko, imali engenayo, kanye nezinga lokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphathi basebenzisa ikota ukuze baphumelele ekwenzeni izinhlelo ezintsha, ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo, noma ukwandisa imakethe. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izigaba ezisemqoka ze ikota? Izigaba ezisemqoka ze ikota zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukucacisa izinjongo: Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhloso ezizofezwa kule nkathi. Ukuhlela: Ukubeka phambili izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinsizakusebenza, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukusebenza: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi yini okufanele ayenze. Ukuhlola: Ukuhlola imiphumela yokusebenza ukuze kutholakale ukuthi izinjongo zifezekile. Ukubika: Ukubika imiphumela kumphakathi, kubaphathi, noma kubanikazi bezinkampani. Umbuzo 5: Ziyini izinselelo ezihambisana ne ikota? Izinkampani zibhekana nezinselelo eziningi uma zisebenzisa ikota.
Ukubika: Ukubika imiphumela kumphakathi, kubaphathi, noma kubanikazi bezinkampani. Umbuzo 5: Ziyini izinselelo ezihambisana ne ikota? Izinkampani zibhekana nezinselelo eziningi uma zisebenzisa ikota. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukungahambisani kwezinsiza, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezimakethe, noma izinkinga zokuphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphathi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhlola imiphumela, ikakhulukazi uma izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokusebenza. Umbuzo 6: Kanjani ikota ingathuthukiswa? Ukuze ikota ithuthuke, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke zihlola izinqubo zazo, zifunde ezivela kwezinye izinkampani, futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene zenkampani kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwe ikota. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kungaba nomthelela omuhle ekusebenzeni kahle. Umbuzo 7: Ikota ingafaka izinguquko ezinkampanini? Yebo, ikota ingafaka izinguquko ezinkampanini. Ngokuhlola nokubheka imiphumela, izinkampani zingathola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, njengokwandisa imikhiqizo, ukunciphisa izindleko, noma ukushintsha izinqubo zokusebenza. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ikota? Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ikota zifaka phakathi: - Ukuqonda kahle ukusebenza kwenkampani. - Ukuthuthukisa izinqumo eziphusile. - Ukukhulisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi. - Ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ikota ibalulekile emkhakheni wezomnotho? Emkhakheni wezomnotho, ikota ibalulekile ngoba isiza ekuhloleni imiphumela yezenzo ezithile.
- Ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ikota ibalulekile emkhakheni wezomnotho? Emkhakheni wezomnotho, ikota ibalulekile ngoba isiza ekuhloleni imiphumela yezenzo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlola kusiza ohulumeni, abacwaningi, kanye nezinkampani ukuba baqonde izimo zomnotho, bahlaziye izinguquko, futhi benze izinqumo eziphusile zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma ikota ingahambanga kahle? Uma ikota ingahambanga kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zihlaziye kahle izizathu. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlola izinqubo, izinsiza, nezinsiza ezisetshenzisiwe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo kungasiza ekutholeni izixazululo eziphusile. Isiphetho Ikota iyinsika ebalulekile ezinkampanini nasemkhakheni wezomnotho. Ukuze ibaluleke, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke zihlola, zithuthukise, futhi zisebenzise izindlela eziphusile. Ngale ndlela, ikota ingaba ithuluzi elinamandla lokuphumelela.
Ngemuva kokutshala kusukela ngo-Okthoba kuya kuDisemba 2010, izindawo eziningi lapho kukhuliswe khona ufulawa zathola imvula enkulu. Ezindaweni eziningi zokulima, lokhu kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo phakathi kwemigqa ye-maize. Abalimi abangakaze basebenzise amakhemikhali ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele ukuze bafeze izihlahla eziphilayo, nabangakaze baphonse amakhambi ngemuva kokuthi izitshalo zivele bazobhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu ngonyaka ozayo nezihlahla eziphilayo. Izitshalo eziphilayo ezisunguliwe ezivele zikhulule izithelo zizokhuphuka lezi zithelo emapulazini ngesikhathi esizayo. Abakhiqizi abangasebenzisi imishini kakhulu ngesikhathi sokutshala (ukunciphisa ukulima) nabo babhekane nezinselelo eziningi emapulazini lapho imishini ingasebenzi khona ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokutshala. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ngokucophelela amapulazi lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukutshala ukuze kutholakale ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla eziphilayo ezizokhula ezindaweni ezithile. Amakhemikhali afanele nezibulala-zinambuzane angathengwa - xhumana nomphathi walezi zimpahla ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ezindaweni eziningi, imvula yafika nango-Agasti, okuzophinde kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo ngemishini emapulazini noma basebenzise amakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, uma ubungasebenzisa imishini kuphela ukuze ube neziqholo (ukulima) izihlahla eziphilayo, kungcono ukucabanga ngokuthenga imishini yokuphonsa (spray rig).
Amakhemikhali afanele nezibulala-zinambuzane angathengwa - xhumana nomphathi walezi zimpahla ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ezindaweni eziningi, imvula yafika nango-Agasti, okuzophinde kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo ngemishini emapulazini noma basebenzise amakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, uma ubungasebenzisa imishini kuphela ukuze ube neziqholo (ukulima) izihlahla eziphilayo, kungcono ukucabanga ngokuthenga imishini yokuphonsa (spray rig). Imishini ehlukene ingatholakala emakethe - kunezimoto ezixhunywe kulawa ma-hitch amathathu anama-tank aphakathi kuka-600 liters kuya ku-1,000 liters anama-booms (izandla) aphakathi kuka-12 m kuya ku-16 m. Imishini enama-tank angabamba u-1,000 liters kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela kumatraktha angakwazi ukuthwala u-1.5 tons noma ngaphezulu. Imishini eyakhiwe lapha ezweni lethu ayibizi kakhulu, futhi izingxenye ezithuthukile zitholakala kalula ngesikhathi sokutshala. Uma uthenga imishini ngaphandle, qiniseka ukuthi umthengisi angakuqinisekisa ukuthi uzokwazi ukuthola amapompo amasha, amafremu, nezibulala-zinambuzane noma nini lapho udinga khona. Indlela eyodwa yokuphonsa amakhemikhali idinga izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanele le ndlela - umkhuba wokuphonsa kanye nokuvula kwezibulala-zinambuzane. Ukulungiswa kwengcindezi kwelinye ibhande kubalulekile ngoba kufanele kukhiqize i-cone ethile ehambelana nohlobo lwezihlahla eziphilayo kanye nohlobo lwamakhemikhali. Uma ungathenga imishini ethwalayo, izokunikeza izinzuzo ezihlukene uma uziqhathanisa nemishini exhunywe kumahitch amathathu.
Indlela eyodwa yokuphonsa amakhemikhali idinga izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanele le ndlela - umkhuba wokuphonsa kanye nokuvula kwezibulala-zinambuzane. Ukulungiswa kwengcindezi kwelinye ibhande kubalulekile ngoba kufanele kukhiqize i-cone ethile ehambelana nohlobo lwezihlahla eziphilayo kanye nohlobo lwamakhemikhali. Uma ungathenga imishini ethwalayo, izokunikeza izinzuzo ezihlukene uma uziqhathanisa nemishini exhunywe kumahitch amathathu. Amatraktha anedrayivu ye-hydraulic yehlile en price, futhi amatraktha asebenza kangcono ngoba awanalo umthwalo ophoqayo umhlabathi. Izibulala-zinambuzane ezikwazi ukuthatha u-2,000 liters zikuvumela ukuthi uphonse indawo enkulu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise nokuhlanganisa amakhemikhali. Khumbula ukulungisa ububanzi bezinhlamvu zemishini ukuze kuhambisane nokuhlukaniswa kwemigqa yokutshala ukuze wena, ophatha, ukwazi ukulungisa indlela imishini esebenza ngayo. Ngokuvamile, ithangi elinokwakhiwa okungama-200 liters lisetshenziswa ukuphonsa i-hectare eyodwa. Ngokufanayo, ithangi le-hitch elinokwakhiwa okungama-600 liters lizophonsa ama-hectare amathathu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uqhubeke nokuphonsa. Lapho ucabanga ukuphonsa i-herbicide, kufanele ucabangele okulandelayo: ukuthi mangaki amapulazi adingeka ukuphonswa, ukuthi ungasithola isikhathi esingakanani sokuphonsa, ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele ukuze uhlanganise amakhemikhali, amandla omatraktha nemishini - kanye ne-trailer enethangi elingabamba u-5,000 liters. Kuzosiza futhi ukufaka ipompo kulolo thangi ukuze ugcwalise ngokushesha amanye amathangi.
Ngokufanayo, ithangi le-hitch elinokwakhiwa okungama-600 liters lizophonsa ama-hectare amathathu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uqhubeke nokuphonsa. Lapho ucabanga ukuphonsa i-herbicide, kufanele ucabangele okulandelayo: ukuthi mangaki amapulazi adingeka ukuphonswa, ukuthi ungasithola isikhathi esingakanani sokuphonsa, ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele ukuze uhlanganise amakhemikhali, amandla omatraktha nemishini - kanye ne-trailer enethangi elingabamba u-5,000 liters. Kuzosiza futhi ukufaka ipompo kulolo thangi ukuze ugcwalise ngokushesha amanye amathangi. Kufanele ulungiselele kahle ngaphambi kwesikhathi futhi uphathe kahle yonke imishini yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga emapulazini ngesikhathi sokutshala. Namuhla, kunzima ukwenza inzuzo ekulimaleni uma ungakaze ube nolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwezihlahla eziphilayo ngamakhambi, ukuphonsa lelo khemi kahle, nokusebenzisa imishini efanele. Ngaso sonke isikhathi funa usizo kulabo abanamava kanye nochwepheshe ukuze bakusize ngokuqhuba nokuphonsa ama-herbicides. Uma ungenayo imishini enamandla noma ungenayo imali yokuthenga le mishini, cabanga ngokukhokhela umphakeli onemishini yokuphonsa enkulu. Labo bantu bavame ukukhokha phakathi kuka-R65 no-R100 nge-hectare, kanye nezindleko ze-diesel. Amapulazi amakhulu angaphonswa phakathi nosuku nangezikhathi zokulala usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-GPS. Nokho, ngaphambi kokungena esivumelwaneni, qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli angafika ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi uzofika ngesikhathi esifanele uma kudingeka futhi yimaphi imishini ezodingeka ukuthi iphathwe ngumlimi noma umphakeli. Khumbula, abanye abaphakeli abanethangi lamanzi noma amabhasi.
Amapulazi amakhulu angaphonswa phakathi nosuku nangezikhathi zokulala usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-GPS. Nokho, ngaphambi kokungena esivumelwaneni, qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli angafika ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi uzofika ngesikhathi esifanele uma kudingeka futhi yimaphi imishini ezodingeka ukuthi iphathwe ngumlimi noma umphakeli. Khumbula, abanye abaphakeli abanethangi lamanzi noma amabhasi. Uma ungakwazi ukukala amanzi adingekayo ngamakhambi afanele okufanele aphonswe, uzobhekana nezinkinga nomphakeli, futhi umsebenzi uzoma. Kufanele uhlaziye izindleko zokuthenga imishini yakho, ukuba namandla okuphonsa i-hectare ethile ngesikhathi esifanele, nezindleko zokukhokhela umphakeli ukuze enze lelo thasku lokuphonsa. Okwesibili, okungakusiza ukuthi abaphakeli abaningi banolwazi mayelana nezinhlobo nezifomula zamakhemikhali okwamanje asetshenziswa. Kuzokusiza ukuhlola ukuthi ukuphonsa kwenziwa kanjani ngezikhathi zonke. Kungasiza futhi ukukhuluma nochwepheshe abasebenza kumafemu ahlukene athengisa amakhemikhali, bese uzokwazi ukuhlola izindleko zamakhemikhali nge-hectare kanye nosizo oluvela kulawo mafemu athengisa amakhemikhali. Khumbula ukuthi abahlinzeki bamakhambi bahlala bephithizela ngesikhathi sokutshala futhi bangase bangakwazi ukusiza bonke abalimi ngokuhlanganisa amakhemikhali ethangini. Uma ungakabi nolwazi, ungase uphonse amakhemikhali kancane noma kakhulu.
Isithombe 1: Imbila embi: bheka ukuthi imbila ikhula kanjani. Isithombe 2: Ukuphathwa kwemibila okungafanele: bheka ukuthi imbewu iphuzi, ibuthakathaka. Isithombe 3: Isorghum esivamile nesorghum esiqinile. Qaphela isorghum esimhlophe esivamile sidlula isorghum esibomvu esiqinile. Isithombe 4: I-Nut Sedge ephuzi etholakala emasimini ommbila. Ukulima kuqhubeka kube inselele, kodwa okwamanje, ngicabanga ukuthi bonke abalimi sebevele bezwe ukuthi imibila kufanele iphathwe kanjani, kodwa cha! Ezindaweni engivakashela kuzo, ngibona ukuthi lokhu kuseyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi imibila efana neYellow Nut Sedge, Uintjies, neMonakaladi. Ngaphandle kokuphathwa kahle kwemibila, ngeke ukwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ezokwenza uzuze imali manje nakusasa. Imbila iyisitha sethu - imibila ibanga ukuncintisana nezitshalo zethu ngamanzi, izakhamzimba, isikhala, nokukhanya. Izindleko zokuhlanza imibila ziphansi; awukwazi ukuvumela imibila ukuthi idle umanyolo owenziwe ngezithombo. Indlela engcono yokuphatha imibila yile: qinisekisa ukuthi imibila ayiqali ukukhula. Uma ulinda isikhathi eside ukushaya imibila, uma ulinda kuze kube imibila ikhule ngaphambi kokuyishaya, izindleko nezingozi ezitshalweni nazo ziya zanda. Impumelelo ekulimaleni ixhunyaniswe nokuphathwa kahle kwemibila. Uma ungazi izitha zakho, ngeke ukwazi ukuzilwela. Uma uthola izinkambu ezintsha ongazazi, kungaba nzima ukusho ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zemibila ezizokhula. Kodwa ngemuva konyaka, kuzoba sobala ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo, futhi uzokwazi ukuzilawula ngaphambi kokukhula.
Uma ungazi izitha zakho, ngeke ukwazi ukuzilwela. Uma uthola izinkambu ezintsha ongazazi, kungaba nzima ukusho ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zemibila ezizokhula. Kodwa ngemuva konyaka, kuzoba sobala ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo, futhi uzokwazi ukuzilawula ngaphambi kokukhula. Kufanele uqonde ukuthi imibila inezinhlaka ezibanzi noma izinhlaka ezifanayo nezitshalo. Kungaba usizo uma uthola amagama ezinhlobo zemibila ezikhona enkundleni ethile, bese uzokwazi ukuthola umlayezo ofanele ukuze uzisuse. Uma usebenzisa imishini yokuhlanza, qinisekisa njalo (kokubili emthonjeni nasemva) ukuthi uyashaya yonke imibila. Qaphela ukuthi imikhono ibukhali ukuze kungabi nendawo phakathi kwazo engashiya eminye imibila. Uma inkambu ibhaki kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuhlanza, khumbula ukuthi imibila oyisusa izophinde ikhule. Kufanele wazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi amakhemikhali ozowasebenzisa ngaphambi kokutshala. Qinisekisa ukuthi umshini wokuphalaza usemkhathini omuhle, i-PTO iyasebenza kahle, kukhona igauge elilinganisa ingcindezi, futhi ama-nozzles afanele. Kukho abantu abanolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwemibila. Khumbula ukuthi indlela yokuphatha imibila enezindleko eziphezulu iyindlela engasebenzi. Ungase ungafuni ukukhokha imali, kodwa khumbula: uzolahlekelwa kakhulu. Amakhemikhali awahlukanisi uhlobo lwezithombo angasetshenziswa kuzo (njengeRoundup noma iGramoxone), noma ungahlanzisa ngemishe. Khumbula uma sikhuluma ngamakhemikhali angakhethi, azobulalela zonke izitshalo eziluhlaza kule nkambu. Qaphela uma usebenzisa lawa makhemikhali ngoba uma usuwasebenzisile, ngeke ukwazi ukuwasusa emhlabathini.
Amakhemikhali awahlukanisi uhlobo lwezithombo angasetshenziswa kuzo (njengeRoundup noma iGramoxone), noma ungahlanzisa ngemishe. Khumbula uma sikhuluma ngamakhemikhali angakhethi, azobulalela zonke izitshalo eziluhlaza kule nkambu. Qaphela uma usebenzisa lawa makhemikhali ngoba uma usuwasebenzisile, ngeke ukwazi ukuwasusa emhlabathini. Ngemuva kokutshala, amakhemikhali abhalisiwe angasetshenziswa ukubulala izinhlobo ezithile zemibila ezitshalweni ezithile ngaphambi kokuthi imibila iqale ukukhula. I-Nut grass ingaba yinkinga ngoba ayifile kalula. I-Yellow Nut Sedge ingaphathwa kahle emmbileni nasezibandleni ngokufaka iServian (amakhemikhali aziwa ngokuthi "Syngenta"). Izinsuku eziyisithupha zokukhula kwezithombo zibalulekile lapho siphatha imibila - ukuncintisana nemibila ngaleso sikhathi kuzokwenza umkhiqizo ube mubi. Imbila kufanele ibulawelwe uma isincane, uma isaqhubeka ikhula kakhulu, ngaphambi kokuthi iqale ukuncintisana nezitshalo. Futhi kufanele ibulawelwe ngaphambi kokuthi ikhiqize imbewu. Uma sekuvele imbewu, imbewu izophinde ikhule futhi ibangele izinkinga futhi. Ukulwa nemibila kuzokwenza umkhiqizo unciphe. Ngisho noma kungabikho izitshalo enkundleni, imibila kufanele ibulawelwe. Imbewu yemibila ingahlala emhlabathini isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi ikhule uma isimo sezulu sikhona. Umsebenzi wenziwa ngokushesha - kungcono kunokuhlanzisa ngemishe. Uma inkambu ibhaki, i-traktor ephethe umshini wokuphalaza ingangena kalula, kodwa i-traktor edonsela umgibeli izobhekana nezinkinga. Ukwazi ukuthi ungababulala kanjani imibila ngaphambi kokuthi iqale ukukhula kusho ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukuncintisana nezitshalo.
Umsebenzi wenziwa ngokushesha - kungcono kunokuhlanzisa ngemishe. Uma inkambu ibhaki, i-traktor ephethe umshini wokuphalaza ingangena kalula, kodwa i-traktor edonsela umgibeli izobhekana nezinkinga. Ukwazi ukuthi ungababulala kanjani imibila ngaphambi kokuthi iqale ukukhula kusho ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukuncintisana nezitshalo. Uma uphalaza, ikhemikhali ifinyelela kuzo zonke izitshalo zemibila futhi ibulale, kodwa uma uhlanza ngemishe, izitshalo zemibila phakathi kwemigqa yommbila zihlala ziphilile. Akudingi abasebenzi abaningi - ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika, sisabamba imibila ngezandla. Lokhu kuyasebenza. Kunenkinga ethile: imibila ivame ukukhula kakhulu ngesikhathi seKhisimusi lapho abantu bengathandi ukusebenza. Uma amaholide sekwedlule, imibila isivele idalile ingozi. Ake sisebenze ndawonye ngo-2010, sikwazi ukwenza kube "Unyaka Wokungabi Nemibila." Uma sithatha le nkinga eyodwa ngamandla, ngikholelwa ukuthi sizophumelela.
Siphinda sithi ukuvikela abalimi akusiyo into elula futhi akwenziwanga ngobusuku obubodwa - kunezinto eziningi ezahlukene abantu abasebenza kulolu hlelo, kunezinto eziningi ezifundwayo futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside. Asikwazi ukwenza konke lokhu sodwa, ngakho sithokozisa kakhulu ngosizo nokuqhubekisela phambili kwabanye abantu abaningi. iMasipala waseMathole. Karel Taljaard - iLime neGypsum yaseNingizimu Afrika. Khula - ukwesekwa ezinsukwini zabalimi. Cliffe Deacon, Agricol - imbewu.
Ukwesekwa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane Ngiyahlanganyela nomuzwa omuhle kulolu daba lwamabhizinisi amancane. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkampani ezikhulayo, ngoba yilezo ezikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza umnotho wethu, futhi ziphinde ziqinise umphakathi. Ngabe ubona kanjani ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane? Ngizokutshela ngakho kahle. Lokhu kuqala, ngizokwenza kucace ukuthi kungani amabhizinisi amancane ebalulekile. Uma ubheka emaphandleni, noma ezindaweni eziphakathi kwedolobha, uzobona ukuthi lezi zinkampani, noma zikhona ezindaweni zokudlela, izitolo, noma izisebenzi ezizimele, zenza umehluko omkhulu. Zivuleka ezindaweni eziningi, zikhulisa umkhiqizo, futhi zenza umphakathi ube nempilo. Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umnotho wethu uphila ngezinyathelo ezincane, ezikhuthazwe yilezi zinkampani. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokwesekwa. Ngabe sikhona yini isiqondiso esikhona ukusekela lezi zinkampani? Yebo, izinhlelo eziningi zikhona, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zikhona ezivela kuhulumeni, ezikhungweni ezizimele, noma ngababambiqhaza emphakathini. Ngokwesibonelo, uhulumeni unikeza izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, njengezimali zokuqala, imihlangano yokufundisa, namathuba okuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane banganqoba izithiyo eziningi uma behola imali, futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhulume ngebhizinisi elizimele. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane bahlushwa izinselele eziningi, kodwa umphakathi ungasiza.
Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane banganqoba izithiyo eziningi uma behola imali, futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhulume ngebhizinisi elizimele. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane bahlushwa izinselele eziningi, kodwa umphakathi ungasiza. Cabanga ngalesi simo: umuntu osebenza emkhakheni webhizinisi, engase abe nezinye izinkinga ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, noma ukwakha igama. Uma umphakathi uqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinselele, ungawasekela ngokuhlinzeka ngemibono, izinsiza, noma ngisho nokuxhumana nabantu abanomqondo ofanayo. Kukhona futhi imibono emisha ezimele ezithola ukwesekwa. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinkampani ezintsha nezobuchwepheshe zidinga ukwesekwa? Ngempela! Lezi zinkampani zikhula ngokushesha, futhi uma zingathola ukwesekwa, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Lokhu kuyakhombisa ukuthi umnotho unguquko, futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile ukuze sizivumele. Uma izinkampani ezintsha zithola ukwesekwa, zizokwazi ukukhulisa imisebenzi, zikhulise imboni, futhi zihlinzeke ngemisindo emisha. Ngaphezu kwezinhlelo ezikhona, kufanele sikhulume ngamasiko. Ukuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane akupheli kuphela ezinhlelweni ezisemthethweni, kodwa kudinga ukuthi siqhakambise amasiko okuxhasana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha umoya wokuxhasana phakathi kwabantu. Cabanga uma umphakathi uqala ukuthanda nokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, kungenzeka kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Sizokwazi ukusiza abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba bahlale beqhubeka, futhi sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele futhi sikhulume ngemininingwane ethile.
Cabanga uma umphakathi uqala ukuthanda nokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, kungenzeka kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Sizokwazi ukusiza abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba bahlale beqhubeka, futhi sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele futhi sikhulume ngemininingwane ethile. Kungani izinkampani ezincane zidinga ukuxhaswa kwezobuchwepheshe? Izinsiza ezinjengezinhlelo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuphatha, nemithombo yokuxhumana ziwusizo kakhulu. Uma umnikazi webhizinisi ethola usizo kwezobuchwepheshe, kungenzeka ukuthi akhuphule ukusebenza kahle, akhulise ukukhiqiza, futhi ahloniphe isikhathi. Lokhu kuhlobene nemicabango yethu yokuthuthukisa umnotho, ngoba uma izinkampani ziqhubeka, umphakathi uthola izinzuzo. Ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akupheli lapha. Kukhona nezinye izindlela eziningi zokuxhasa, ezifanele ukuba sikhulume ngazo. Isibonelo, ukubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi amancane nakakhulu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Uma abanikazi bamabhizinisi bexhumana, bangakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, benze izivumelwano zokuhweba, futhi bakhuthaze umphakathi. Lokhu kudala umoya womsebenzi ongenakuphikwa, futhi kukhuthaza ukuxhaswa phakathi kwabanye. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akuyona into eyodwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nomqondo ofanayo, sisebenzisane, futhi sikhuthaze omunye nomunye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhulumeni, abanikazi bamabhizinisi, noma umphakathi, sonke sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Ngeke sikwazi ukukwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela, futhi lokho kudinga ukuthi sibe nethemba, sibe nokuqonda, futhi sikhuthaze.
Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nomqondo ofanayo, sisebenzisane, futhi sikhuthaze omunye nomunye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhulumeni, abanikazi bamabhizinisi, noma umphakathi, sonke sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Ngeke sikwazi ukukwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela, futhi lokho kudinga ukuthi sibe nethemba, sibe nokuqonda, futhi sikhuthaze. Ngakho, ngicela ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane awusizo kuphela emnothweni, kodwa futhi awusizo ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba nokwesekwa okuhle kungaba nomthelela omkhulu, futhi kuyinsakavukela yempilo yethu. Sihamba phambili!
Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuphila ziye zashintsha, futhi lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emkhakheni wezimali, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinhlelweni zempesheni. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni, ikakhulukazi ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bezempilo nabanye abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Le nqubo ibalulekile, kodwa ibuye ibangele izingxoxo eziningi phakathi kwabathintekayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhilela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu uthola izinzuzo ezifanele ezivela kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudinga ukuba kube nokwethembeka emalini ethunyelwa kumalungu e-GEMS. Uma kungekho ukuqinisekiswa, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuphatha, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali noma ekutholeni izinzuzo ezingalungile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi bezempilo bangatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye baphikisa ukuthi le nqubo iyabambezela abantu. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kudinga isikhathi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlale belindile ukuze bathole izinzuzo zabo. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ikakhulukazi kubantu abahamba phambili empilweni, abadinga ukuxhaswa ngezinsiza ezithile. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi izinqubo zokuqinisekisa kufanele zibe lula futhi zisheshiswe ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela izidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani eziphatha lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise lesi sikhathi sokulinda.
Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ikakhulukazi kubantu abahamba phambili empilweni, abadinga ukuxhaswa ngezinsiza ezithile. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi izinqubo zokuqinisekisa kufanele zibe lula futhi zisheshiswe ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela izidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani eziphatha lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise lesi sikhathi sokulinda. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngesikhathi, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle, ezisheshayo, nezithembekile zidingeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo, futhi kuzokhulula umthwalo ezinkampanini eziphethe lezi zinhlelo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakala kubantu zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubheka ukuthi abantu basebenzisa kanjani lezi zinsiza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azisetshenziswanga ngokungafanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu bezimali, okungaholela ekutheni izinsiza zempesheni zihlale zikhona ukuze zisetshenziswe ngempumelelo. Ngokuhlanganyela, lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kudinga ukuba kube nenqubo eqondile, ehloniphekile, futhi esheshayo. Abantu kumele bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo ngaphandle kokubambezela, kodwa futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo.
Ngokuhlanganyela, lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kudinga ukuba kube nenqubo eqondile, ehloniphekile, futhi esheshayo. Abantu kumele bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo ngaphandle kokubambezela, kodwa futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Nokho, le nqubo kumele ithuthukiswe ukuze ibhekelele izidingo zabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sibe nezinqubo eziphumelelayo, ezisheshayo, nezithembekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola lokho akufanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu, futhi kuzokhulisa ukwaneliseka kwabo ngezinsiza ezitholakala kubo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onothando.
Izinyathelo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Komama Ukuze umama akwazi ukuhlala ephephile, kubalulekile ukubhekelelwa kahle; lokho kubalulekile emisebenzini yokubeletha ezibhedlela. Ukuhlelwa kahle kwalezi zinyathelo kwenza kube lula, kusheshe, futhi kube nekhono, njengoba kubonisa izenzakalo ezisemqoka empilweni yomama nomntwana. Lezi zinyathelo zifaka phakathi ukulungiselela, ukuzalwa, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umama nomntwana baphila kahle ngemva kokubeletha. Isinyathelo Sokuqala: Ukulungiselela Ukubeletha Ukulungiselela ukubeletha kuhilela izinyathelo eziningi ezibalulekile. Umama kufanele ahlole nodokotela noma umnikazi wezempilo ukuze aqonde kahle izidingo zakhe. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela izikhathi zokuhlolwa, ukuhlola isimo somzimba, kanye nokuthola ulwazi ngomsebenzi wezokwelapha ozolandela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhuluma nomyeni noma umndeni kungasiza umama ukuba azizwe ekhululekile, eqiniseka ukuthi akashiywanga yedwa. Ukuvuselela imizwa nokuhlalisana kahle kumama kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola ukwesekwa okwanele ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Isinyathelo Sesibili: Ukuvikeleka Komama Uma kufika isikhathi sokubeletha, umama kufanele abhalise esibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izincwadi zempilo, ukuhlolwa komzimba, kanye nokubamba izihlahla zokubeletha. Esibhedlela, umama udinga ukuxhumana nodokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nabanye ochwepheshe bezokwelapha ukuze baqonde izingozi ezingase zivele. Izinqubomgomo ezibhejwayo zifaka phakathi ukwakha uhla lwezokuxhumana, ukuhlinzeka ngama-lokhs ukuze umama abambisane nabahlengikazi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibuzo iyaphendulwa.
Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izincwadi zempilo, ukuhlolwa komzimba, kanye nokubamba izihlahla zokubeletha. Esibhedlela, umama udinga ukuxhumana nodokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nabanye ochwepheshe bezokwelapha ukuze baqonde izingozi ezingase zivele. Izinqubomgomo ezibhejwayo zifaka phakathi ukwakha uhla lwezokuxhumana, ukuhlinzeka ngama-lokhs ukuze umama abambisane nabahlengikazi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibuzo iyaphendulwa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umama uyazi ukuthi yiziphi izinqubo ezizokwenzeka ngesikhathi sokubeletha, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo Sesithathu: Ukuthola Ukuxhaswa Ngesikhathi Sokubeletha Ngesikhathi sokubeletha, izinhlelo zokuthola ukwesekwa zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngokuphelele. Ukuze kube nokuqhubeka okungakhathazeki, uhla lwabahlengikazi kufanele luhlinzeke ngezinsizakusebenza ezahlukene. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abahlengikazi, ochwepheshe bezokwelapha, nomnyango wezokwelapha ophambili. Abahlengikazi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi umama ulungiselelwe kanjani, bejwayele ukusiza nsuku zonke kokubhekelelwa, bokuqonda ngesikhathi sokuya endimeni ethile yokubeletha. Lokhu akukhona kuphela ukulandela izinjongo zokwelapha, kodwa futhi kufaka phakathi ukungena komoya omuhle nephakethe lokusebenzisana okuyingqayizivele. Isinyathelo Sesine: Ukunakekelwa Ngemuva Kokubeletha Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama nomntwana badinga ukuqhubeka bephathwa kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlola ukuba baphila kahle, ukuphathwa kahle kwengane, nokuthola izeluleko ezibalulekile zomama eziphathelene nokunakekelwa kwezingane.
Lokhu akukhona kuphela ukulandela izinjongo zokwelapha, kodwa futhi kufaka phakathi ukungena komoya omuhle nephakethe lokusebenzisana okuyingqayizivele. Isinyathelo Sesine: Ukunakekelwa Ngemuva Kokubeletha Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama nomntwana badinga ukuqhubeka bephathwa kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlola ukuba baphila kahle, ukuphathwa kahle kwengane, nokuthola izeluleko ezibalulekile zomama eziphathelene nokunakekelwa kwezingane. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umama uyapholisa, ngokuhlanganyela nosizo ezivela kubahlengikazi, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekugcineni. Izinqubo zokubhekelelwa ziqinisekisa ukuba umama uyaphila, ezithobile. Ngaphandle kokuhlola, ukuqonda izinguquko ezimqoka empilweni yomama kubalulekile ekugcineni umphumela ophumelelayo. Isiphetho: Ukuqhubeka Nempilo Izinyathelo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile empilweni yomama nomntwana. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukulungiselela okusemqoka, nokuqonda okwandisayo, zonke lezi zici zithuthukisa impilo. Abantu abafaka isandla kulezi zinyathelo kudinga ukubonga, njengoba inhloso iwukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomama nezingane, kuhlelwe ngendlela ethokozisayo nebanzi. Ubufakazi bokuphila bukhombisa ukuthi izinqubo eziphathelene nokubeletha ziyasebenza, futhi kubalulekile ukugcina ukuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwemindeni nezinhlangano zezempilo.
Umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State UMhlaba wezolimo eFree State uthinteka kakhulu izimo zezulu, ikakhulukazi kumkhiqizo wezolimo. Isomiso, indlala esheshayo emanzini, sishiye umthelela omkhulu ezitsheni, kukhulu kakhulukazi njengemiphumela yeClimate Change. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wesomiso kwezolimo kudinga ukubheka zonke izici ezihambisana nezimo zokutshala, ikakhulukazi ezikhiqizayo ezifana nezitshalo, izinkomo, nezinyoni. Ukwanda kwesomiso empeleni kubalulekile, ngoba kugcizelela imiphumela emibi kubalimi, okubenza bahlupheke kakhulu. Ngonyaka ka-2022, izinga lokushisa eliphezulu, kanye nesomiso, kwaholela ekunciphiseni komkhiqizo wezolimo, okuholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo yabantu abaningi. Ukuncishiswa kwamanzi kuyiwona msebenzi omkhulu wezolimo eFree State, njengoba izitshalo zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule. Ukungabi namanzi okwanele kuholela ekutheni izitshalo zingathuthukisi kahle. Ngokwendlela umhlaba ozolimo ushintsha ngayo, sithola imiphumela emibi kwizindlela zokwakha, ukuzinakekela, kanye nemisebenzi yokulima. Kukhona nezinkundla eziveza izindaba zabalimi okukhuluma ngazo. Izinkulumo zahlanganiswa nomnotho wezolimo – umkhiqizo ophuma ezoliminini kanye nezimali ezitholakala ngemikhiqizo ethengiswa ezitolo. Ubuye ukwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zezimali zomkhakha wezolimo uma kuqhathaniswa nezimo ezijwayelekile. Ukwanda kwesomiso kungaholela ekutheni, izitshalo ezithile zingakwazi ukufakwa emkhakheni wezolimo. Imiphumela emnandi, ngempela, ubonakalisa ukuthi izimfuno zokuhlanga zikhuphuka; kodwa ngemva kokuhla kwechungechunge, abanye abalimi bebheka izitshalo ezidliwayo.
Ubuye ukwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zezimali zomkhakha wezolimo uma kuqhathaniswa nezimo ezijwayelekile. Ukwanda kwesomiso kungaholela ekutheni, izitshalo ezithile zingakwazi ukufakwa emkhakheni wezolimo. Imiphumela emnandi, ngempela, ubonakalisa ukuthi izimfuno zokuhlanga zikhuphuka; kodwa ngemva kokuhla kwechungechunge, abanye abalimi bebheka izitshalo ezidliwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye bakhuluma ngokudinga izixazululo esimeme - ezihlanganisa izitshalo ezidinga amanzi amancane. Lokhu kubalulekile kumhlaba wezolimo eFree State. Ukufana kakhulu, uma sikhuluma ngalesi simo, kuphinde kube nezinselelo zokukhiqiza. Izitshalo ezingaphumeleli kahle kungenzeka zishiye abafundi bejabulile kuphela uma zikhona izinkomo ezincane. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokulima nemikhankaso yokuthola amanzi, okukhuthaza ukuzikhandla komphakathi. Phambilini phakathi nyaka, abanye abalimi basixhume izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalimi anikwa usizo oludingekayo. Nokho, kwezokuthutha, umthelela wesomiso ezingadini ezithile uphinde ube nomthelela. Ukwehla kokuhamba kwezimpahla kubalulekile, njengoba izimpahla ezingalungiswanga kungabathinti abathengi. Izinsuku zokusizakala kuncipha kodwa ungakwazi ukukhokha, ushintsho luveza izinzuzo zamabhizinesi nezimboni ukudala izimo ezithile ezisezingeni. Ngalokhu, umnotho wezolimo uyanda, kodwa ubungozi bemvelo bushayisana nempilo yomphakathi. Ezakhamuzini, umthelela wesomiso ubonakala nakwiqembu labalimi; lokhu okuqukethwe kumkhakha wezolimo. Abalimi banelisekile ngezimo ezibalulekile zomhlaba, ngenkathi bephicha izinkinga ezivela ezimweni ezinzima zokuhamba phambili.
Ngalokhu, umnotho wezolimo uyanda, kodwa ubungozi bemvelo bushayisana nempilo yomphakathi. Ezakhamuzini, umthelela wesomiso ubonakala nakwiqembu labalimi; lokhu okuqukethwe kumkhakha wezolimo. Abalimi banelisekile ngezimo ezibalulekile zomhlaba, ngenkathi bephicha izinkinga ezivela ezimweni ezinzima zokuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abanye balimi bathola izindlela ezithuthukile zokusebenza, ukuze badlule kulezi zimo ezinzima. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yabanye, umthelela wesomiso uzokwandisa futhi uzowela kokubili okuphehlwa kwamanzi. Uma kuhlangene iziftsuko, ukuqhamuka kwezimo ezinhle kuhlale kulindelekile. Umphakathi uyamukeleka, idlanzana labalimi lekhono libhalwa ndawonye; okungase kube nomthelela omuhle emkhakheni wokulima nokukhiqiza. Ngokungakhathali kumele kube nesimangalo sokuvumelana nezimo. Kubalulekile ukuthi oteza ukuhamba phambili naye. Kulezi zimo, abesifazane nabesilisa baye bayaphumelela mudzanga ngemisebenzi yabo yezezimali, ngakho-ke umphakathi ufunda izifundo ezithile ezichaza ubuchopho nophoqelelo wezokuthengisa. Ekugcineni, umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State uphakamisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezidingayo ukubhekwa ngokuphumelelayo. Umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezinhlelo zoLimo, abezindaba, noMkhandlu waseFree State usetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezisizayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukholo kwempilo yokudla, bonke bezokwazi ukunqanda umthelela wezimo zezulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela ezithuthukile zokulima, ukuze siqhubeke siqinisekise ukuhlala komphakathi okuhle ngumthombo wokusebenza kokukhula komnotho.
Ekugcineni, umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State uphakamisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezidingayo ukubhekwa ngokuphumelelayo. Umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezinhlelo zoLimo, abezindaba, noMkhandlu waseFree State usetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezisizayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukholo kwempilo yokudla, bonke bezokwazi ukunqanda umthelela wezimo zezulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela ezithuthukile zokulima, ukuze siqhubeke siqinisekise ukuhlala komphakathi okuhle ngumthombo wokusebenza kokukhula komnotho. Umphakathi wezolimo eFree State kufanele uphinde ubhekele phambili ukuze ubone indlela yokuphefumula kwezimo ezinzima zempilo ngesikhathi esifanele, ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle ekukhiqizeni. Siyavuma ukuthi umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State ungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu, ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo engeyona imfashini, kanye nokwakha umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuzodala isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwemboni yezolimo, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo kanye nezinga lokuphila kwabantu.
Izinkampani Zobuchwepheshe: Uhlaka Nendlela Yokusebenza Isingeniso Ezinsukwini zethu zanamuhla, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zineqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yethu. Zisebenza ekwakheni, ekuthuthukiseni, nasekuhlinzekeni ngezixazululo ezithuthukisa indlela esiphila, sisebenza, futhi sithokozisa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela lezi zinkampani ezisebenza ngayo, ukuthi zixhumeka kanjani nezidingo zabantu, kanye nendlela esingasebenzisa ngayo imikhiqizo yazo ukuze sithole izinzuzo. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Izinkampani Zobuchwepheshe Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zifaka phakathi lezo zikhiqiza isoftware, imishini, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza zedijithali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ama-giants afana ne-Google, Apple, Microsoft, ne-Facebook, kanye nezinkampani ezincane ezithuthukayo ezifana nezinkampani zokuqala ezihlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Ngokubheka ukuziphatha kwemakethe, lezi zinkampani zihlala zikhuthazwa izidingo zabathengi, zifuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhlangabezana nazo. Isigaba 2: Izinqubo Zokwakha Umkhiqizo Ukudala umkhiqizo obuchwepheshe kudinga inqubo ethile. Okokuqala, izinkampani zenza ucwaningo ukuze ziqonde izidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola imakethe, ukufunda ngababhekiswe kwezidingo ezithile, kanye nokuhlola imikhiqizo ekhona. Okwesibili, izinkampani ziqala ukwakha umqondo wombono, okukhuluma ngezixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwethimba lezakhiwo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abathuthukisi, abaklami, nabaphathi. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-prototyping iyenzeka, lapho umkhiqizo wokuqala udalwa ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwawo.
Okwesibili, izinkampani ziqala ukwakha umqondo wombono, okukhuluma ngezixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwethimba lezakhiwo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abathuthukisi, abaklami, nabaphathi. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-prototyping iyenzeka, lapho umkhiqizo wokuqala udalwa ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwawo. Lokhu kuvumela izinkampani ukuba ziqonde ukuthi umkhiqizo uzosebenza kanjani empilweni yangempela. Uma umkhiqizo ubukeka usiza, izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuwuthuthukisa, ziqinisekisa ukuthi uyahlangabezana nezidingo zomsebenzisi. Isigaba 3: Ukwethula Umkhiqizo Uma umkhiqizo sekuqediwe, usuku lokwethulwa lufika. Lokhu kuwumcimbi omkhulu, lapho izinkampani zikhuthaza umkhiqizo kumakethe. Ukwethulwa kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze abathengi bazi kahle ukuthi umkhiqizo usetshenziswayo kanjani. Izinkampani zisebenzisa iziteshi ezahlukene zokuxhumana, njengezikhangiso ze-inthanethi, imicimbi, nezikhangiso ezinkulu ezitolo. Okubalulekile, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zihlala zithola impendulo kubasebenzisi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuqhubekeni nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo. Ngemuva kokwethulwa, izinkampani ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuthola izimvo, nokwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka, ukuze umkhiqizo uhlale uphucukile futhi ufinyelele izidingo zabathengi. Isigaba 4: Ukuhlinzeka Ngesevisi Nezixazululo Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe azikhokhi nje umkhiqizo, kodwa zenza kube lula ukuwusebenzisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yokuxhaswa, izifundo, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Ukuxhaswa okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukusebenzisa umkhiqizo ngendlela efanele, futhi bathole usizo uma kudingeka.
Isigaba 4: Ukuhlinzeka Ngesevisi Nezixazululo Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe azikhokhi nje umkhiqizo, kodwa zenza kube lula ukuwusebenzisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yokuxhaswa, izifundo, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Ukuxhaswa okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukusebenzisa umkhiqizo ngendlela efanele, futhi bathole usizo uma kudingeka. Izinkampani zihlala zikhuthaza ukuxhumana nabathengi, ukuze ziqonde izidingo zabo, kungaba ngokuqondile, nge-imeyili, noma ngezingxoxo eziku-inthanethi. Izinkampani eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe zihlala zifuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhlala ziqhubeka nezinselele nezidingo zabasebenzisi. Isigaba 5: Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zihlala zishintsha, zifuna izinto ezintsha ezithuthuka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokufunda okuphezulu, i-AI (Artificial Intelligence), ne-Blockchain. Lezi zinto ezintsha zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenze ngomqondo omusha, zikhulise imikhiqizo yazo, futhi ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithuthukile. Ngokusebenza nezinhloso ezithile, izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zikhumbula izidingo zabathengi, futhi zithuthukise umkhiqizo wazo ukuze ufinyelele ezimfanelweni ezithile. Isiphetho Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu, ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwakha, ukuthuthukisa, nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezintsha. Ukuqonda indlela lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngayo, kusiza abantu ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi imikhiqizo yazo ingaba kanjani usizo empilweni yabo.
Ngokusebenza nezinhloso ezithile, izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zikhumbula izidingo zabathengi, futhi zithuthukise umkhiqizo wazo ukuze ufinyelele ezimfanelweni ezithile. Isiphetho Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu, ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwakha, ukuthuthukisa, nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezintsha. Ukuqonda indlela lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngayo, kusiza abantu ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi imikhiqizo yazo ingaba kanjani usizo empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, ukuqonda izinkampani zobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinhle kubuchwepheshe obusha nokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa impilo yethu.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Ukuqala Ukukhuluma Iziteleka zabasebenzi zibonisa ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu abavuma ukusebenzisana ukuze babheke izinguquko ezidingekayo emsebenzini. Lokhu akusikho nje ukukhala ngezinkinga, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Kuthiwani, kufanele kube nezindaba ezithakazelisayo? Ngabe zikhona izizathu ezinamandla zokuhlanganisa abantu? Ake siqale. Iziteleka zenzeka kakhulu uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi izimo zabo zokusebenza azihambisani kahle. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukunganeliseki ngemiholo, izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, noma ukungahambisani kahle nezinkambiso zomsebenzi. Abasebenzi bavame ukuhlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izwi labo liyasizwa, futhi lezi zinyathelo zingashintsha izinto ezinhlobonhlobo. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthuthukiswa kwezimali, kodwa lokhu kukhombisa indlela abantu ababona ngayo imisebenzi yabo. Sikhuluma ngebhadi lapho iziteleka zenzeka khona. Kukhona imiqhudelwano eminingi, futhi iziteleka ezithinta abanye zisebenza ngokwezimiso ezithile. Uthando lwabantu emsebenzini lukhombisa izifiso eziphathelene nomsebenzi. Uhlelo lwezizwe lufuna ukusebenza kahle, kodwa ezimeni ezinzima, imizamo yesikhashana izobangela izinguquko. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye bakhumbula ukuthi iziteleka zingaba yithuluzi eliqinile lokushintsha izimo. Abasebenzi bazama ukufakazela ukuthi izinguquko zidingeka. Kukhona abanye abathi, "Lokho akukhona konke," kodwa kukhona abaningi abavuma ukusiza. Siphinde sikhulume ngamasu abamemezeli beziteleka. Ubani ozokwazi ukuhola lo mzila? Abasebenzi badinga ukuba nomoya obambekayo, bezinikele, ukuze bathole umphumela ofanele. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye bazama ukugcina izimpilo zabo zisebenza, nakuba bephila ezimeni ezinzima.
Ubani ozokwazi ukuhola lo mzila? Abasebenzi badinga ukuba nomoya obambekayo, bezinikele, ukuze bathole umphumela ofanele. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye bazama ukugcina izimpilo zabo zisebenza, nakuba bephila ezimeni ezinzima. Iziteleka azilingani; zikhona ezivamile nezizimele. Izinhlangano zisebenza lapho abanye bezama ukudlula emikhakheni, baphuma balwa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuphila kokusebenza kukhona, futhi kuphila. Lokhu kuhlole izinzuzo zesikhathi esifushane, noma izimo ezithile. Ngokuqhubeka, sikhuluma ngamasu okuxhumana okukhuthaza abantu emsebenzini. Iqiniso ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zicacile, zifuna intshiseko, ziqhubekela phambili, futhi zikhuthaza abanye ukuba bawe, banakekele, nokuba bazimisele ekushintsheni. Uhlola Okwengeziwe: Ngabe imizamo yebhizinisi ibonakala? Abasebenzi baye baphawula noma kusezingeni elincane. Ngabe umphakathi ugcwele ubungqina bokusebenza kahle? Iziteleka zithinta abokuqala, nabanye, kubekwe phezulu izimo zempilo, umndeni, nempilo yomsebenzi. Uhlelo lwezeMali luhlobene nezinye izinkinga. Sidinga ukuzibuza: "Yini engase yenzeke?" Uhlelo lwezempilo lugcwele izinkinga ezikhulisa ithuba lokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sikhuluma ngokuqonda, sibhekelele imiphumela, nokuqonda izibalo. Abasebenzi bangase badlale indima, behluleka, bese bethi, "Ngabe lokho kuzoba ngcono?". Kukhona ezinye izikhathi lapho iziteleka zempilo zibalulekile ukuze kusize abavela kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuziqukethwe emiphakathini, kwakha umoya ophilayo phakathi kwamalungelo nezimfanelo zabasebenzi.
Abasebenzi bangase badlale indima, behluleka, bese bethi, "Ngabe lokho kuzoba ngcono?". Kukhona ezinye izikhathi lapho iziteleka zempilo zibalulekile ukuze kusize abavela kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuziqukethwe emiphakathini, kwakha umoya ophilayo phakathi kwamalungelo nezimfanelo zabasebenzi. Lokhu akukhona nje umqondo, kepha kube sisekelo esiqinile sokusebenza kwamaNingizimu, umoya wokuhlonipha nokubambisana kumasiko ambalwa. Ngakho, uma sicabangela iziteleka zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izingxenye ezihlukahlukene, ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umoya wabantu obambekayo ugcwele izinkinga eziningi. Ukugcina izinduna zibambisene, kabhe zinduna ibhizinisi akukona okokudala. Lokhu kucacile, abavoti bangasiza, futhi noma yikuphi ukuxhumana kuzodingeka ukuze kube nezinhloso ezithile. Ngakho, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyahlonishwa. Zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi kufanele benze imizamo yokwakha impilo engcono, bahlanganyele ezintweni ezikhaliphile, futhi bakhuthaze ukunqoba, okuveza okuningi. Lokhu kusenhla kwakho ukwakha udumo lwabantu abavuma ukuzama impi yokuhamba phambili. Ngakho, sithumeza izinsiza, sithumele ukuphikisana, ukuze uthole izinhlelo ezithinta wonke umuntu. Lokhu kwashintsha nendlela uMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo ubheka ngayo ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabafileyo. Kwenzekeni esinqumweni sikaBhe? Ngesikhathi ephila, umufi wayehlala noNksz. Bhe kanye nengane yabo eyodwa ezinsaneni zabo ezimbili eKhayelitsha. Kwakukhona ukungabaza ukuthi umlingani kaBhe nomufi babashadile noma cha. Intombazane yabo yesibili yayihlala noyise womufi eBerlin, okuyindawo eseningizimu yeMpumalanga. Umufi washona ngaphandle kokwenza ifa, ngakho-ke impahla yakhe yabelwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nezifiso. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uyise womufi uzothola yonke impahla, ngaphandle kukaNksz. Ngakho-ke, yayiphelelwe yisikhathi futhi ayikwazi ukuxhumana nezidingo zangempela zezindawo zasemadolobheni nezinguquko ezisemndenini. Isimo samanje sikhombisa ukuthi asihambisani nomkhondo wabaningi ngoba sithola ukwahlukaniswa ngokobulili nasokuzalwa. Zonke impahla yomuntu ofile izokwabiwa ngokomthetho womuntu ofile ongakhulumi ukuthi ufuna ukwabelwa kanjani. Uma umufi eshiya kuphela abashadikazi nezingane, abashadikazi bazokwabelana ngempahla phakathi kwabo. Uma impahla ingafinyeleli ku-R125,000 ngomshado, abashadikazi bazothola ingxenye efanayo yephahla, kanti izingane azizotholi lutho. Ngemuva kwesinqumo sikaBhe, impahla zabantu abafileyo manje ziqhutshelwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwefa Ngaphandle Kwefa ka-1965 (Umthetho 66 ka-1965, njengoba uguqulwe). Abagibeli ngeke baphathe ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabantu abafileyo, kodwa lesi sabelo sishintshele kuMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme.
