Abagibeli ngeke baphathe ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabantu abafileyo, kodwa lesi sabelo sishintshele kuMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme. UMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme akadingi ukuzibandakanya mathupha ekuphathweni kwezindaba zezimali zabafileyo. UMphakathi uzokhetha umuntu ofanele emsebenzini wokuphatha impahla yomuntu ofile. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela impahla, umuntu angasazisa ukuthi impahla izokwabiwa kanjani ngaphansi komthetho wezifiso. Lokhu kufanele kubhalwe kwiWill. UMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza ngcono umthetho ophathelene nezifiso. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngokuvumela umndeni ophumulelayo ukuvumelana ngendlela impahla yomufi kufanele ihlukaniswe. Nokho, uMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme akufanele avumele amaqembu abuthakathaka afana nezingane nabesifazane ukuba aphathwe kabi ngenxa yezivumelwano zomndeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika baqonde lezi zinguquko ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izimpahla zabo ngendlela efanele. UMsunguli Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme usungule umshini wocingo lapho usizo lungatholakala khona.
Bonke abaqashi abaqasha umuntu noma abaqasha mayelana nebhizinisi labo noma ezolimo badinga ukubhaliswa nokukhokha iminikelo yonyaka kuMfundisi Wokubuyiselwa. Lezi zinqwaba zingabuyiselwa kubaqashi. Ukubhaliswa kudingeka kunoma iyiphi igatsha lebhizinisi ngaphandle uma izivumelwano zenziwa zokubhaliswa ngokuhlanganyela. Imali engena kulolu mfundisi ikhiqizwa ikakhulu ngemali yokukhokha yonyaka evela kubaqashi ababhalisiwe ngokususelwa kumaphesenti noma esinqumweni somholo wanyaka okhokhelwa kubasebenzi babo. Nokho, umthetho unikeza ukuhlinzeka ngeminikelo engezansi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukukhokha akwehlisi ngaphansi kwezindleko zokuphatha. Ekupheleni kukaJanuwari unyaka ngamunye, amafomu athunyelwa kubo bonke abaqashi ababhalisiwe. La mafomu kumele agcwaliswe futhi abuyiswe ngaphambi kukaMashi 31. Unyaka wezezimali weMfundisi Wokubuyiselwa uqhubeka kusukela ngoMashi kuze kube sekupheleni kukaFebhuwari konyaka olandelayo. Lo Mfundisi uphinde uvikelwe ngezinhlinzeko ezivumela ukwehliswa kwezijeziso kubaqashi abahluleka ukukhokha, noma ukwenza ukubuyiselwa kwephesenti elingu-10 lenani lokukhokha. Ububanzi bokukhokha, okukhishwa kubaqashi, buxhomeke ohlotsheni lwezokusebenza zebhizinisi labaqashi. Ukuze kuhlukaniswe abaqashi, bahlukaniswa babe ngezigaba ezahlukene nezagatsha ngokususelwa ohlotsheni lwezenzo zabo. Ububanzi bokukhokha bu governed ngumthetho ophoqelela ukuthi imboni ngayinye kufanele ibeke izindleko zezingcuphe zayo futhi kubuyekezwa minyaka yonke. Noma yiziphi izinguquko zenziwa ngokususelwa endleleni ingcuphe ivela ngayo.
Ukuze kuhlukaniswe abaqashi, bahlukaniswa babe ngezigaba ezahlukene nezagatsha ngokususelwa ohlotsheni lwezenzo zabo. Ububanzi bokukhokha bu governed ngumthetho ophoqelela ukuthi imboni ngayinye kufanele ibeke izindleko zezingcuphe zayo futhi kubuyekezwa minyaka yonke. Noma yiziphi izinguquko zenziwa ngokususelwa endleleni ingcuphe ivela ngayo. Amaqashi aziswa minyaka yonke ngobubanzi besinqumo esisemthethweni mayelana nebhizinisi labo lezolimo. Umthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa abasebenzi bakho abalimala emsebenzini. Umqashi uvikelwe kuzo zonke izimo lapho abantu bengabhekisa kubo ngesikhathi senhlekelele eyenzeke emsebenzini, ngisho nasekuphakamiseni izinsolo zokungafaneleki. Umsebenzi owalimala emsebenzini unelungelo lokubuyiselwa ngaphansi kokukhubazeka kwesikhashana, ukukhubazeka okuqhubekayo (ngokwezinga lokukhubazeka), nokufa. Izindleko ezithintekayo zokwelashwa kwezempilo ezivela esenzakalweni esenzeke emsebenzini zikhokhelwa isikhathi esiyiminyaka emibili, noma isikhathi eside uma ukwelashwa kwezempilo kuzokwehlisa izinga lokukhubazeka. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi mayelana nokubika amacala, bheka iphephandaba W. Cl. Ukulungiswa kubaqashi abakhipha inani elikhulu eminikelo ngaphandle kwezindleko zokuhlola ingcuphe, indlela yokunikeza izaphulelo, yasungulwa ngemuva kweminyaka emithathu. Iphesenti lesaphulelo liboniswa njengokwehluka phakathi kwezindleko zokufaka isicelo somqashi kanye nenani lemali yabo yokukhokha. Ukwanda noma ukwehla kwenani lomqashi kuxhomeke ekutheni ingcuphe yabo ihambisana noma ayihambisani nezindleko.
Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Umbuzo 1: Yini imiklomelo yabasebenzi? Imiklomelo yabasebenzi iwumkhankaso ophakathi kwezinkampani wokubonga, ukuqashela, nokuhlonipha abasebenzi ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo emihle. Lokhu kungabandakanya imiklomelo ethile njengezikhumbuzo, izinhlelo zokukhushulwa, noma imali eyengeziwe. Umgomo wemicabango yokunikeza imiklomelo ukuheha abasebenzi ukuba bakhombise ukusebenza kahle. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo? Ukuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo kubalulekile ngoba kuthuthukisa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kudala isimo esikhuthazayo, lapho abasebenzi bezizwa beqondwa futhi bemukelekile. Umphakathi ophilayo wabasebenzi uthuthukisa ukusebenza, ukuncintisana, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokuphila, okwenza kube kuhle kuzo zonke izinhlangothi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo? Izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo zingahluka. Ezinye zezindlela ezijwayelekile zifaka: 1. Imiklomelo Ethile: Njengokuhlinzekwa ngemali, izipho, noma izikhumbuzo. Izinhlelo Zokukhushulwa: Ukuze abasebenzi bathole ithuba lokukhushulwa emisebenzini yabo. Izinsuku Ezinikwe Umsebenzi: Ukuhlinzeka ngaphezulu kwezinsuku zokuphumula uma abasebenzi bekhombisa ukusebenza kahle. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthuka: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo noma amathuba okuthuthuka. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani imiklomelo ithinta ukusebenza kwabasebenzi? Imiklomelo inethonya elikhulu ekusebenzeni kwabasebenzi. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuhlonishwa, bakhuthazwa ukuba benze kahle kakhulu. Lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile futhi bejabulile emsebenzini, okwandisa ukukhiqiza.
Imiklomelo inethonya elikhulu ekusebenzeni kwabasebenzi. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuhlonishwa, bakhuthazwa ukuba benze kahle kakhulu. Lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile futhi bejabulile emsebenzini, okwandisa ukukhiqiza. Izinselelo ezibhekene nabasebenzi zingancipha uma beqinisekisa ukuthi imizamo yabo iyakwaziwa. Umbuzo 5: Kukhona izingozi ezihambisana nokuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo? Yebo, kunezingozi ezithile. Uma imiklomelo inganikezwa ngendlela engafanele, kungaholela ekucasuleni abasebenzi, ikakhulukazi uma abanye bethola imiklomelo engcono. Lokhu kungadala umoya wokuncintisana okungafanele. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo ngendlela efanele, eqondile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayaziswa. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuhlonipha abasebenzi? Ukuhlonipha abasebenzi kubalulekile emsebenzini. Izinzuzo zalesi simo zifaka: 1. Ukukhula Komoya Wokusebenza: Abasebenzi abaziswa bakha umoya omuhle. Ukuthuthukiswa Kokusebenza: Umsebenzi omuhle uholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinga lokusebenza. Ukuncipha Kwezinga Lokuphuma: Abasebenzi abahlonishwa bahlala endaweni yomsebenzi isikhathi eside. Ukukhula Kwenkampani: Izinkampani ezihlonipha abasebenzi zikhula ngokushesha ngenxa yokusebenza kahle kweqembu. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani izinkampani zingabathuthukisa abasebenzi bazo? Izinkampani zingathuthukisa abasebenzi bazo ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, ezifaka: 1. Ukuhlinzeka Ngokuqeqeshwa: Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze bathole amakhono amasha. Ukwenza Izinqumo Ngemigomo: Ukuvumela abasebenzi ukuba babe nengxenye ezinqumweni zenkampani. Ukwakhiwa Kweqembu: Ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yokwakha iqembu ukuze umoya wokusebenza uthuthukiswe.
Ukuhlinzeka Ngokuqeqeshwa: Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze bathole amakhono amasha. Ukwenza Izinqumo Ngemigomo: Ukuvumela abasebenzi ukuba babe nengxenye ezinqumweni zenkampani. Ukwakhiwa Kweqembu: Ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yokwakha iqembu ukuze umoya wokusebenza uthuthukiswe. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemihlangano: Ukuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yokuxoxisana ngempumelelo. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ikhumbule uma uhlinzeka ngimiklomelo? Kubantu abahlinzeka ngimiklomelo, kubalulekile ukuba bagcine izinto ezimbalwa engqondweni: 1. Ukuqonda Abasebenzi: Qonda izidingo zabo ukuze uhlinzeke ngimiklomelo efanele. Ubulungiswa: Qinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo inikezwa ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokubandlulula. Ukukhuthaza Ukubambisana: Qinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo ibamba iqhaza ekukhuthazeni ubudlelwano. Ukusebenza Ngempumelelo: Hlola njalo ukuthi imiklomelo iyasebenza yini emsebenzini. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani izinkampani zingakwazi ukugcina imiklomelo yabo ihlanzekile? Izinkampani zingaqinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo yabo iphumelelisa izinjongo zenkampani. Lokhu kungabandakanya: 1. Ukuhlola Imiphumela: Qapha imiphumela yemiklomelo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iyathuthukisa ukusebenza. Ukwenza Izinguquko: Khuluma nabasebenzi ukuze uthole impendulo nokuqonda ukuthi yini engasebenza kangcono. Ukugcina Izinga: Qinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo ihlale ibalulekile futhi iyakhanga. Umbuzo 10: Yini esizayo ngenqubomgowo yemiklomelo? Ngokuvamile, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlala zithuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo. Ukubheka izidingo zabasebenzi kuzo zonke izikhathi kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bekwazi ukwenza kahle emsebenzini.
Umbuzo 10: Yini esizayo ngenqubomgowo yemiklomelo? Ngokuvamile, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlala zithuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo. Ukubheka izidingo zabasebenzi kuzo zonke izikhathi kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bekwazi ukwenza kahle emsebenzini. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zihlale ziqhubeka zihlaziya izinqubomgolo zazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza ukuze zifinyelele izinjongo zazo.
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okuhlelelekile KwezeMidlalo Ekhaya elibizwa ngokuthi uZiyanda, kwabusa inhloso yokwakha izikhungo ezizokwenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono. Leli dolobha laliphila ngophondo lwezokwakha, kodwa abanye babebheka kwezokugembula, kwezokudlala, nokwabelana ngempilo. UJohn, umongameli wendawo, wayezwa ukukhathazeka mayelana nezikhungo ezikhona. “Sidinga izikhungo zomphakathi ezilungiselelwe kahle, ezifanele bonke abantu,” wayekhuluma nabanye abaholi bendawo ngenkathi behlangana emhlanganweni. Ngolunye usuku, uJohn wahlangana noThandi, umqashi onokubona okukhulu. “Ngihuguza injabulo yokwakha izikhungo, kodwa kufanele sikwazi ukusiphatha kahle. Kumele sizame ukufaka izici zokwakha ezizokwenza abantu babe nentshisekelo, hhayi izikhungo ezivamile ezixhaphakile,” kusho uThandi, ephakamisa amehlo akhe ehlakaniphele. Bangena ejimini encane lapho besebenza khona. Bafuna ukuphakamisa imicabango, bachitha isikhathi bephosa iziphakamiso. UThandi wancome uZiyanda ngokwakha isikhungo esisha senkonzo, nesigubungela izidingo zezingane, abantu abadala, nabampofu. “Sizogxila ezikhungweni zokudlulisa imicabango nokuqonda, ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi,” wajabula uJohn. Baye balungiselela uhlelo lokwakha olwanemibono eminingi. Njengoba lithemba elenzeka, umphakathi wawudibene nabantu abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abacabangi, abadayisi, nochwepheshe kwezempilo, ukuze kunikezwe izindawo ezihlukahlukene ezizokwenziwa izikhungo ezithuthukile. Kwakufanele wonke umuntu avume, ngakho baqhuba izinkulumo ezijule mayelana nezidingo zabantu.
Baye balungiselela uhlelo lokwakha olwanemibono eminingi. Njengoba lithemba elenzeka, umphakathi wawudibene nabantu abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abacabangi, abadayisi, nochwepheshe kwezempilo, ukuze kunikezwe izindawo ezihlukahlukene ezizokwenziwa izikhungo ezithuthukile. Kwakufanele wonke umuntu avume, ngakho baqhuba izinkulumo ezijule mayelana nezidingo zabantu. Ngemuva konyaka wesikhumbuzo sokwakha, izikhungo ezintsha zaqala ukunqamuka emoyeni. ISikhungo Sokwakha Ubufakazi, esizokwaziwa ngokuthi "Ubufakazi". Le ndawo yabe isebenzisa izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okubalwa nemithombo ekhangayo, izindawo zokwenza imidlalo, nendawo yokudlela enezimnandi. Izikhungo ziqalile ukumangaza futhi abantu babesezandleni ezinkulu. Ubulunga zombili izikhungo, uBani noNandi, babekhanya lapho behlola. "Akusizi nje kuphela ukuthi sikhona, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izidingo zabanye zifanele ukusisiza," kusho uBani. Nombono, umphakathi wawubona ukuthi lezi zikhungo zaziqinisa imiphakathi, zine nganso – zihlangene kwezobuchwepheshe, zikhululekile. Hhayi kancane, izikhungo zokuqala zithola impumelelo. UJabu, owayesephila eZiyanda, wasukuma wancome uJohn ngokuhola le nqaba. “Nkulunkulu akusisize, kuhle isikhungo sethu, sikhuluma ngempilo, sicumelela. Empilweni, sithole umkhondo.” NgoMsombuluko, uJabu abesekanye noLinda baphinde bebamba isikhumbuzo. Bathe beqinisekisa ukuthi bazogxila kulokhu banhlonishwa, kulokhu kwaziswa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uJohn wabuyela emhlanganweni. “Ngabe sicabanga ngabantu bonke?
Bathe beqinisekisa ukuthi bazogxila kulokhu banhlonishwa, kulokhu kwaziswa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uJohn wabuyela emhlanganweni. “Ngabe sicabanga ngabantu bonke? Ngabe lezi zikhungo zikhumbula izidingo zethu? Hhayi ukuthi ngizoyiqinisa into ethile, kodwa izikhungo zikhona ukuze zixazulule izimo,” wawubona. UThandi waphakamisa okukhulu, yaze yadalwa imicabango emisha. "Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukwakheka kwezikhungo kuthinta indlela esiphila ngayo, indlela esixhumana ngayo; siyaqhubeka nesigaba esisha, sigodluke siqonde phambili." Kwakukhona umoya wokucacisa izinto ezinzima, okubalwa umphakathi odinga ukwakheka okuhamba phambili nangokuphumelela. Ngakho, leli dolobha elisha liqhubeka liphila phakathi kwezikhungo ezakhiwe ngenhloso, kumelwe kube yindawo yokholo, ngokuhambisana. UJohn, uThandi, uJabu noLinda bahlala behlangana, behlola izindlela zokuphucula ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni zomphakathi. Umoya omusha uphakamisa, uZiyanda wabe usuphumelele njengombono ongaphezu komphezulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, izikhungo zasilokhu ziqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizukulwane. Ezinsukwini ezilandelayo, uJohn wathola izindaba ezimnandi, izikhungo sezenzele kahle. Abantu bemabhuqa baphila kahle, izifundo zenzeka, imicimbi ihlalisana, izinkanyezi zikhanya esibhakabhakeni. E-Ziyanda, imifula yezenzo, ubuhlobo, noshintsho, izikhungo zikhona ukwazisa lokho okuhle ngendlela yesikhathi esizayo. Kona, lokhu kwaba yincwadi yokwakha, eyachazela ngesimo esisha sokuphila, umuzwa omuhle, okwakukhanya phakathi.
Abantu bemabhuqa baphila kahle, izifundo zenzeka, imicimbi ihlalisana, izinkanyezi zikhanya esibhakabhakeni. E-Ziyanda, imifula yezenzo, ubuhlobo, noshintsho, izikhungo zikhona ukwazisa lokho okuhle ngendlela yesikhathi esizayo. Kona, lokhu kwaba yincwadi yokwakha, eyachazela ngesimo esisha sokuphila, umuzwa omuhle, okwakukhanya phakathi. Njengoba uZiyanda wandla, abakhi bezokuvakasha baphinda baqondise ukwakheka kwezikhungo ezizoshintsha impilo yazo zonke izizukulwane ezizayo. Ekugcineni, uZiyanda waba isibonelo sobumbano nokwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi, okwakha indlela entsha yokuphila enezinto eziningi ezilungile.
uhulumeni uveze ukuthi umkhakha wezolimo ubalulekile ku-conomy kanye nokuhlinzekwa kokuphepha kokudla, kuqala ekukhiqizeni kuya ekumaketheni. Isu likahulumeni lihlose ukudala uhlelo oluhlanganyelwe oluhlanganisa imithombo, abathengisi abaphakathi, nezinsizakalo zezolimo ezithuthukisa ukukhiqiza, ukusabalalisa, nokushintshisana kwezimpahla zokudla. Lesi isu sibalulekile kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ezolimo ezikhethekile, ukwakha idolobha, nezinye izitayela zomnotho. Uhulumeni uhlose ukukhulisa inqubo yokukhiqiza ethuthukisa inani lemikhiqizo yezolimo, izindawo, isikhathi, kanye nekhwalithi yezimpahla zokulima. Lokhu kukhuphuka kwenani emkhakheni wezolimo kuhlanganisa nezinqubo zokukhiqiza emasimini. Isu likahulumeni lidala uxhumano olubalulekile phakathi kwabakhangisi bokudla nabathengi, oluxhaswe yizinsiza zendawo, ubuchwepheshe, nemithetho yomphakathi. Isu lezolimo lishintshile ngenxa yezidingo ezishintshayo zabakhiqizi nabathengi. Isu lezolimo lifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eqala ezingeni lokuqala iye emkhiqizweni wokugcina, njengokuthandwa kwabathengi. Ulwazi lwemakethe, ukuthengisa, nokuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kwezolimo kuthinta ukwethemba emakethe, kuthinta amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kumfanelo raw noma enezinhlaka ezingeziwe. Ukuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kubalulekile, futhi ukusebenza kahle kwesu lezolimo kunomthelela omkhulu kumakethe evunyelwe abakhiqizi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthinta izinqumo zabo.
Isu lezolimo lifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eqala ezingeni lokuqala iye emkhiqizweni wokugcina, njengokuthandwa kwabathengi. Ulwazi lwemakethe, ukuthengisa, nokuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kwezolimo kuthinta ukwethemba emakethe, kuthinta amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kumfanelo raw noma enezinhlaka ezingeziwe. Ukuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kubalulekile, futhi ukusebenza kahle kwesu lezolimo kunomthelela omkhulu kumakethe evunyelwe abakhiqizi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthinta izinqumo zabo. Imakethe ichazwa njengendawo lapho abathengi (abathengi) nabathengisi (abakhiqizi) behlangana futhi bashintshisana ngezimpahla noma ngezinsizakalo ngentengo abavumelana ngayo. Ukuxhasa inqubo yokwenza izinqumo mayelana nokuphathwa kwezolimo kubalulekile, kuhlanganisa nokuqonda ukuthi nini nokuthi kuphi ukuthengisa. Ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kulwazi lwemakethe oluchanile kubalulekile. Amanani nezindleko kudlala indima enkulu ezinqumweni ezithinta ezolimo. Amanani nezindleko kuthinta ukusabalalisa nokwabiwa kwezinsiza zezolimo. Intengo evunyelwe ibonisa ukuthi uma kukhona ukuphazamiseka emakethe, amanani, izinga lokusetshenziswa, nezinga lokukhiqiza konke kulawulwa yisikhathi nezinsiza. Abathengi babhekana nenkinga yokwenza ukukhetha. Banemfuno ehlukahlukene, kuhlanganisa lezo ezidinga izinketho - okusho ukuthi ukuthandwa kwabo akukhawulelwe emikhiqizweni ethile. Bazama ukukhetha imikhiqizo ehambelana nezidingo zabo kangcono, ngaphandle kokukhawulelwa yizindleko zemikhiqizo abayithandayo. Ukunikezwa kungachazwa njengobudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani elinikeziwe.
Banemfuno ehlukahlukene, kuhlanganisa lezo ezidinga izinketho - okusho ukuthi ukuthandwa kwabo akukhawulelwe emikhiqizweni ethile. Bazama ukukhetha imikhiqizo ehambelana nezidingo zabo kangcono, ngaphandle kokukhawulelwa yizindleko zemikhiqizo abayithandayo. Ukunikezwa kungachazwa njengobudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani elinikeziwe. Uma intengo yemikhiqizo iphezulu, abathengi bangase bangayithengi ngama-quantities amakhulu, kanti uma intengo iphansi, abathengi bazothenga kakhulu. Uma amanani ephezulu, kungase kube nabathengi abambalwa abavuma ukuthenga, kanti uma amanani ephansi, abathengi abaningi bazothenga. Lokhu kubudlelwano kungabhekwa njengoxhumano phakathi kwentengo nenani eliceliwe emakethe. Umthetho wokunikezwa uthi njengoba amanani ekhuphuka, inani elinikeziwe lenyuka, futhi njengoba amanani ehla, inani elinikeziwe lehla. I-curve yokucela ibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani eliceliwe. I-curve yokunikezwa ibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani elinikeziwe. Ukuphuma kwalezi zikhala kubonisa ukulingana kwemakethe. Intengo yokulingana iyindawo lapho inani eliceliwe lingama-quantities anikeziwe, futhi inani lokulingana lingumthamo abathengi abazimisele ukuwuthenga ngale ntengo. Intengo yokulingana ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "intengo yokucacisa emakethe," njengoba ihlangabezana nabathengi nabathengisi emakethe - abathengi bangathenga konke abakufunayo, kanti abakhiqizi bangathengisa konke abakufunayo. Izici ezithinta ukunikezwa zifaka izindleko zokukhiqiza, izimo zezulu, izifo, nezinye izinto ezingathinta ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo. Izici zokucela zifaka ukuthandwa kwabathengi, amanani, kanye nokutholakala kwezinketho.
Intengo yokulingana ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "intengo yokucacisa emakethe," njengoba ihlangabezana nabathengi nabathengisi emakethe - abathengi bangathenga konke abakufunayo, kanti abakhiqizi bangathengisa konke abakufunayo. Izici ezithinta ukunikezwa zifaka izindleko zokukhiqiza, izimo zezulu, izifo, nezinye izinto ezingathinta ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo. Izici zokucela zifaka ukuthandwa kwabathengi, amanani, kanye nokutholakala kwezinketho. Imakethe yezolimo ithonywa izindleko zokukhiqiza, amanani, kanye nokutholakala kwezinsiza. Imakethe yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ithonywa izitayela zemakethe yomhlaba, njengoba leli lizwe linengxenye encane emakethe yezolimo yomhlaba. Amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika athonywa ukunikezwa kwendawo nokucela, kanye nezimo zemakethe zamazwe omhlaba. Kukhona ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene ezibangela ukushintsha kwamamanani ezolimo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinguquko ezinqumweni zabakhiqizi mayelana nokukhiqiza, izimo zezulu, izifo, nezinye izinto zingathinta imakethe. Abakhiqizi bangaphatha ezinye izici zokunikezwa, kodwa hhayi zonke. Ngenkathi abakhiqizi bezama ukuhlela ukunikezwa nokucela, isimo semakethe singaba nezimo ezingalindelekile. Abakhiqizi bangalungisa amanani ngokuya ngezindleko ezilindelekile noma izimo ezithinta ukukhiqizwa kwabo. Esikhathini esedlule, kwakuvame ukucabanga ukuthi ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika zanele futhi zingahlangabezana nezidingo zendawo ngaphandle kokuthembela kumalungelo. Nokho, lokhu akusasebenzi. Emnothweni wanamuhla ophakathi kwezwe, akukho mkhakha wezimali, kuhlanganisa nezolimo, ongazinzile ngokuphelele.

Izindlela Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Ukubeletha kuwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yomama nabantwana, futhi izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuvikeleka nokuphumelela kwalolu hlelo. Lezi zinqubo ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukubeletha kwenzeka ngendlela ephephile, efanele, futhi ethokozisayo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinqubo ezahlukene zokubeletha ezibhedlela, imithetho ethinta lezi zinqubo, kanye nezidingo zokunakekelwa kwemindeni nabesifazane abakhulelwe. Ukuze uqale, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lezi zindlela zifaka phakathi ukubeletha ngokwemvelo, ukubeletha okwenziwa ngesiphuthuma, kanye nokubeletha ngekesekwazi. Ukubeletha ngokwemvelo, okuyindlela evamile, kubandakanya ukugcinwa kwemvelo nokuhamba kwezinyathelo zokubeletha ngaphandle kokusebenzisa imithombo yokwelapha eyengeziwe. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umama uzizwa ephephile futhi ekhuthazekile, futhi umntwana uthola umoya ophilayo lapho ezalwa. Ngokuphambene, ukubeletha okwenziwa ngesiphuthuma kudinga ukusebenzisa izindlela eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka komama kanye nomntwana uma kunezinkinga eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa imishanguzo, izikhali zokusebenza, noma amakhono okwelapha ukuze kube neqhaza eliphumelelayo. Izinselele ezahlukene zingavela ngesikhathi sokubeletha, njengezinkinga zokuphefumula noma ukungatholakali kahle komntwana, futhi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Enye indlela yokubeletha ibizwa ngokuthi "ukubeletha ngekesekwazi," lapho umama esebenzisa imishanguzo ethile ukuze anciphise ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha.
Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa imishanguzo, izikhali zokusebenza, noma amakhono okwelapha ukuze kube neqhaza eliphumelelayo. Izinselele ezahlukene zingavela ngesikhathi sokubeletha, njengezinkinga zokuphefumula noma ukungatholakali kahle komntwana, futhi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Enye indlela yokubeletha ibizwa ngokuthi "ukubeletha ngekesekwazi," lapho umama esebenzisa imishanguzo ethile ukuze anciphise ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Le ndlela iyanda, ikakhulukazi ezibhedlela, ngoba inikeza umama ithuba lokuba nakho okuhle ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Noma kunjalo, kubalulekile ukuqapha ukuthi le mishanguzo isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ukuze kugwenywe imiphumela eyongeziwe. Ngaphezu kwezindlela zokubeletha, izinqubo zokwakha indawo yokubeletha nayo ibalulekile. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezindawo ezikhethekile zokubeletha ezihlanganisa izinsiza ezifanele, njengokukhanya okungapheli, izigubungelo zezwi, nezinsiza zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinsiza ezikahle ezihambisana nezidingo zabesifazane abakhulelwe, ukuze bakwazi ukujabulela le nqubo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba nezinhlelo ezithile zokwelashwa kwabantu abakhulelwe. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundisi, odokotela, nezisebenzi zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane bathola ukwesekwa okuhle. Ukuhlola izinga lokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha zisebenza kahle. Izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukugxila ezicini eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuphathwa kwezempilo, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo.
Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundisi, odokotela, nezisebenzi zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane bathola ukwesekwa okuhle. Ukuhlola izinga lokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha zisebenza kahle. Izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukugxila ezicini eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuphathwa kwezempilo, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zempilo kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze kubonakale impumelelo kulezi zinqubo, kudingeka izinhlelo ezingcono zokusebenza, ezihlanganisa ukuxilongwa okuqondile, ukulawulwa kwezinsizakusebenza, kanye nokuphathwa komthwalo wokubeletha. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwabazali mayelana nezinqubo zokubeletha. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi yini ezokwenzeka ngesikhathi sokubeletha, bezwa ukuthi izinqubo zenzelwe ukuvikela impilo yabo nomntwana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezindlela zokubeletha, imishanguzo ethile, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka nokuphumelela kokubeletha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zempilo, abazali, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze lezi zinqubo zenziwe kahle. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokubeletha ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo yomama nabantwana, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bazizwa bephephile, futhi bathola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi sokubeletha.
Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka nokuphumelela kokubeletha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zempilo, abazali, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze lezi zinqubo zenziwe kahle. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokubeletha ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo yomama nabantwana, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bazizwa bephephile, futhi bathola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukubeletha akuyona nje inqubo yokuzalwa, kodwa kuyisigaba esibalulekile sokwakha umndeni, futhi lezi zinqubo kufanele zihlale zibe sezingeni eliphezulu.
Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Abathengisi basemgwaqeni, noma abathengisi bejuba, bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Bangabantu abathengisa imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene emigwaqweni, izikhala zomphakathi, nakuma-park, bahlala bejabulisa abathengi ngezinto ezithengiswayo. Nokho, leli qembu labathengisi libhekene nezinselele eziningi, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuxoxa ngalezi zinkinga kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Imvamisa, abathengisi bahlala besebenzisa izinsiza ezincane, futhi bahlala bejolisa ekutholeni imali yokuphila. Lokhu kubavimbela ekutholeni izikhala ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi bahlala bephikisana nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezivamile, okungaholela ekutheni bahlukunyezwe noma bahlaselwe yizinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuba siqonde kahle ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukwesekwa, hhayi ukugxekwa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangenza kube nzima ukuthola izikhala ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa. Ukuze kube khona ukuhweba okuhle, kudingeka izindawo ezithile ezitholakalayo, kodwa abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bejolisa emigwaqweni, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni komgwaqo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamiseni umphakathi, futhi kungase kube nomthelela ongemuhle ezindaweni ezikufuphi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi bathole izixazululo ezisemthethweni, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuphazamisa abanye.
Ukuze kube khona ukuhweba okuhle, kudingeka izindawo ezithile ezitholakalayo, kodwa abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bejolisa emigwaqweni, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni komgwaqo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamiseni umphakathi, futhi kungase kube nomthelela ongemuhle ezindaweni ezikufuphi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi bathole izixazululo ezisemthethweni, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuphazamisa abanye. Ukuphikisana kulokhu, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangenza kube nzima ukuthola izikhala ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba abathengisi bejolisa emigwaqweni ethile, okungaholela ezimeni ezimbi. Nokho, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benza umsebenzi oncomekayo, futhi bahlala bekhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, kunesidingo sokubheka izindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Bahlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, futhi bahlala bejabulisa abathengi ngezinto ezithengiswayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kuqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukuxhaswa, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele, futhi baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kubekhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni nohulumeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa, ezizovumela abathengisi ukuba baphile kahle.
Ngakho-ke, abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukuxhaswa, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele, futhi baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kubekhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni nohulumeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa, ezizovumela abathengisi ukuba baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abathengisi, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo kahle, futhi bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Nokho, bahlala bephikisana nezinkinga eziningi, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuxoxa ngalezi zinkinga kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukwesekwa, hhayi ukugxekwa. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi nohulumeni, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphila kahle, futhi baqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ehlukahlukene emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobumbano. Abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benza umsebenzi oncomekayo, futhi badinga ukuba siwasekele, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Usain Bolt: Umqeqeshi Wezimbangi Zokugijima Umbuzo: Ubani uUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli odumile waseJamaica, owaziwa kakhulu njengomgibeli ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wezimbangi zokugijima. Uzalwe ngomhla ka-21 kuNhlangulana 1986 eSherwood Content, eJamaica. Ubephakeme emqhudelwaneni wezimbangi zokugijima, ikakhulukazi emigqeni ye-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m relay. Umbuzo: Yini eyamkhumbuza uUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt wakhula enethemba lokudlala ibhola, kodwa wathola uthando lokugijima ngesikhathi esesikoleni. Uthole ukuqashelwa ngesikhathi enza kahle emqhudelwaneni wezokugijima, futhi lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphila kwakhe njengomgibeli. Wazithola esebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze afeze amaphupho akhe. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izimpumelelo ezinkulu zikaUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ungumqeqeshi ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wezimbangi. Uthole amahlandla ama-8 eMidlalo ye-Olympic, lapho ahlula khona izimbangi zakhe emigqeni ye-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m relay. Ubuye waphumelela imiqhudelwano ye-World Championships, lapho athola khona izindondo eziningi. Uthole irekhodi lomhlaba emigqeni ye-100m no-200m, okuyizikhathi ezingu-9.58 seconds no-19.19 seconds, ngokulandelana. Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kanjani emlandweni wezokugijima? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezokugijima ngoba waguqula indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngale midlalwano. Waba isibonelo sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuphumelela.
Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kanjani emlandweni wezokugijima? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezokugijima ngoba waguqula indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngale midlalwano. Waba isibonelo sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuphumelela. Ubuye waba yisithonjana sokukhuthaza abanye abantwana, ikakhulukazi eJamaica, ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. Uthandwa kakhulu, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yezimpumelelo zakhe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuzithoba kwakhe nendlela ahlangana ngayo nabalandeli. Umbuzo: Yini eyamkhuthaza uUsain Bolt ukuba aqhubeke? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt uthi ukusebenzela umndeni wakhe kanye nezwe lakhe kube yinto eyamkhuthaza kakhulu. Uqonda ukuthi impumelelo yakhe ibaluleke kakhulu, hhayi kuphela kuye, kodwa nakubantu abaninzi abamlandelayo. Ubuye akhuthaze abanye ukuba basebenzise amathuba abawatholayo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ngekhono, ukusebenza kanzima, kanye nokuzinikela, umuntu angafinyelela noma yiziphi izinjongo. Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubhekana kanjani nezinselelo? Impendulo: Njengomgibeli ophumelelayo, uUsain Bolt ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukulwela ukuhlala uphumelelayo emqhudelwaneni, ukugwema ukulimala, nokuphatha ingcindezi yokuba ngumgibeli ophumelele, konke kwaba yizinto ezinzima. Nokho, uBolt uthembisa ukuthi umsebenzi onzima, ukuzikhandla, kanye nokubambisana nabanye kuhlale kumphumelela. Ubuye waba nomoya ophakeme, okwenza akwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo: Yini uUsain Bolt ayisebenzisela umphakathi? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt usebenzisa impumelelo yakhe ukuze asize umphakathi.
Ubuye waba nomoya ophakeme, okwenza akwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo: Yini uUsain Bolt ayisebenzisela umphakathi? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt usebenzisa impumelelo yakhe ukuze asize umphakathi. Uthembisa ukweseka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantwana, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, futhi uhlanganisa imithombo yokuxhasa ezempilo kanye nemfundo. Ubuye abambe imicimbi yokukhuthaza abantwana ukuba bakhule bezithanda imidlalo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi imidlalo ingaba yindlela yokuphila engcono. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola kuUsain Bolt? Impendulo: Izifundo eziningi zingafundwa kuUsain Bolt. Okokuqala, ukusebenza kanzima kuyisihluthulelo sempumelelo. Ubuye ufundise ukuthi ukuphikelela, nokungayeki, kubalulekile ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo zakho. Ubuye ubonise ukuthi ukuhlala uzithoba nokuhlonipha abanye kubalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uphumelele kangakanani. UUsain Bolt ungumfanekiso ophilayo wokuthi, uma unethemba, ungafeza noma yini. Umbuzo: Yini ezayo kuUsain Bolt? Impendulo: Njengoba uUsain Bolt eseshayile emqhudelwaneni, ubheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ubonisa intshiseko yokuba umphakathi, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa abanye. Uthanda ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, futhi uqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli ophawulekayo, futhi impumelelo yakhe izohlala ibhalwe emlandweni. Ubonisa ukuthi, ngekhono, umsebenzi onzima, kanye nokuzinikela, umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, uUsain Bolt uzohlala engumfanekiso wempumelelo, futhi izifundo zakhe zizohlala zikhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo.
Impilo Yabantu Abasebenzayo: Ukuhlola Izimo Nezinselelo Impilo yabantu abasebenzayo, eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-working class, iyinkinga edidayo futhi eyahlukene. Laba bantu, abaneziqu eziphansi, bavame ukuba neziqu eziphansi, bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, besebenza imisebenzi eminingi ethwalisa kanzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi impilo yabo ibhekane nezinkinga. Le ndatshana izama ukufakazela ukuthi impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi akufanele ibonakale njengento engcolile. Ukuze siqonde kahle impilo yabo, kudingeka sihlolisise izici ezisemqoka. Okokuqala, lezi zisebenzi zithwalaniswa imithwalo eminingi, zikhungathekile ngezinto ezilula eziphathelene nosuku nosuku. Imisebenzi engaphandle kwezokuphila, efana nokusebenza ezindlini, ezinyangeni, noma emakhaya, ibabamba phansi, ikakhulukazi lapho ivame ukuzenzakalela ngaphandle kokunakekelwa. Abantu abasebenzayo bahlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezimali, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulisa imindeni yabo. Lokhu kubuhlungu, njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kanti izinkampani ziphakamisa umholo ngendlela engahambisani nezindleko ezikhulayo zokuphila. Ukuhlupheka kwalezi zisebenzi kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu, ngoba akukhona nje ukusweleka kwemali, kodwa nakukwazi ukuzitholela isikhathi sokuphumula, sokuxhumana, nempilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibonakala iphazamiseka ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi. Izinselelo zomsebenzi, ezifana nokushoda kokuhlela isikhathi, ziye zashintsha. Abantu abahlala emakhaya bahlushwa ukuba basebenze imisebenzi eminingi ukuze baphile, okuholela ekucindezelekeni kwengqondo, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulela impilo.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibonakala iphazamiseka ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi. Izinselelo zomsebenzi, ezifana nokushoda kokuhlela isikhathi, ziye zashintsha. Abantu abahlala emakhaya bahlushwa ukuba basebenze imisebenzi eminingi ukuze baphile, okuholela ekucindezelekeni kwengqondo, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulela impilo. Izinhlangano ezinjengama-syndicate, ezivamise ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, zisebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinkinga ziyaqondwa. Nokho, kunzima ukuphikisa umgomo omubi ophakanyisiwe. Abantu abasebenzayo banamazinga angaphezulu okungafaneleka. Impilo yabo ibonisa amagugu amakhulu - ukufaka isandla, ukuzinikela emsebenzini, nokuqamba amasu. Lokhu kuyazwakala lapho abantu beqalaza imiphakathi yabo, bezama ukufinyelela izimfuno eziphakeme. Ubumbano lwabo luwumphumela wezinhlelo ezithinta izifunda, ezithokozisa impilo yabo yonke. Umphakathi ojabulayo ungavela lapho abantu beqonda ukuthi kufanele bahlale bexhumene, bezama ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Baningi abantu abasebenzayo abaneliseka. Nakuba abaningi babo behlangabezana nezinselelo ezinzima, balindele ukuphila okuhle. Imali engaphezulu ayithathwa njengomzamo ophelele, kodwa ukuhamba phambili kumayelana nokuthi umuntu uzitholele ubumba emhlabeni. Lokhu kwenziwa ekuthuthukiseni izakhono, noma ukwandisa ukuxhumana emsebenzini ukuze baziqhenye ngendlela eqondile. Empeleni, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ikhuluma ngempilo ebucayi, ngoba ibonisa indlela ubudlelwano bethu nomphakathi. Lokhu kubhaliwe kumele kube uphawu lokuqonda, lokudlela abanye, kanye nokuphikelela emakhazeni ukuqhubeka.
Lokhu kwenziwa ekuthuthukiseni izakhono, noma ukwandisa ukuxhumana emsebenzini ukuze baziqhenye ngendlela eqondile. Empeleni, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ikhuluma ngempilo ebucayi, ngoba ibonisa indlela ubudlelwano bethu nomphakathi. Lokhu kubhaliwe kumele kube uphawu lokuqonda, lokudlela abanye, kanye nokuphikelela emakhazeni ukuqhubeka. Abavukeli balesi simo kumele baqenjwe kahle, ukuze ubuhlungu babo buwuphawu lwezinguquko ezidingekayo emiphakathini yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kumele kufake imizamo yokukhulisa izinkolelo ezisemqoka, efana nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza emakhaya, kuxhunywe nemiphequlwano emisha yempilo. Kungakhathaliseki izinkinga ezinzima noma izimo eziphikisana nazo, abantu abasebenzayo baziqhenye ngamavolontiya, bazilungiselele imiphakathi. Akukho lutho olukhona olungasukumela ibanga wendawo, uma abantu basukuma, begqugquzela nabo bakhe le mpilo. Ngakho-ke, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa izama ukuhamba phambili. Ukwazi nokubona lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezinye, futhi kuthuthukise impilo yomphakathi wonke. Lokhu akusiyona nje imicabango, kodwa kuyinkanyezi ethile yomusa ezimele, ebhalwe enhliziyweni zabantu. Lokhu kuzovula amathuba amasha, kuthi ibhande lothando nomoya wokuchuma lungene emiphakathini, ukuze sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili.
Njengoba ukubhaliswa kwenkampani enenhlangano yokwabelana kungaba nzima, kunconywa ukuthi abafake izicelo bacele usizo lwezithunywa zomthetho. I-Memorandum kanye neziqondiso zenkampani kumele zilungiswe futhi zibe nohlaka lokuhambisana nenkampani engenashares, futhi lokhu kumele kuqinisekiswe ngu-notary public ochwepheshe. Inkampani yomphakathi ingamukela i-Table A yefomu lesicelo ngokuphelele noma njengoba kushintshiwe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ze-memorandum, uma ihambisana neMthetho Wezinkampani, 1973. Inkampani yangasese ingamukela i-Table B yefomu lesicelo ngokuphelele noma njengoba kushintshiwe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ze-memorandum ngokuphelele, uma ihambisana neMthetho Wezinkampani, 1973. Nikeza igunya elisemthethweni kummeleli wezomthetho, uveze ukuthi uyawavuma ukuba benze izenzo egameni lakho. CM2: I-Memorandum yokuvumelana nezinye - CM2A - CM2B - CM2C uma kukhona abanikazi abaningi, noma 2D uma kukhona umnikazi oyedwa. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-5 ukubhalisa inkampani enenhlangano yokwabelana ukuze iqale ukusebenza.
Ukufezwa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Semizuzu Eyi-15 Ekuhloleni nasekuphenduleni imibuzo, isikhathi sokuphendula siba yinto ebalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezidinga impendulo esheshayo, njengokuhlolwa, izivivinyo, noma izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15 kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphenduli banesikhathi esanele sokucabanga, ukuhlela, nokubhala impendulo yabo ngendlela efanele. Isizathu Sokubaluleka Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula Isikhathi sokuphendula sithinta kakhulu ikhwalithi yempendulo. Uma umphenduli enesikhathi esincane, kungenzeka ukuthi angakwazi ukuhlela kahle imicabango yakhe, okungaholela ekutheni impendulo yakhe ingabi nekhwalithi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma unikezwa isikhathi esanele, umphenduli angakwazi ukuhlela kahle, abhale kahle, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi yonke imicabango yakhe ibhalwe phansi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezidinga ukucaciswa, njengokuhlola izifundo noma izivivinyo. Ukuphendula Ngokushesha Ngesikhathi Esifanele Ukuphendula emibuzweni ngesikhathi esifanele kudinga amakhono athile. Okokuqala, umphenduli kufanele abe nekhono lokuhlela imicabango yakhe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele akwazi ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izimpendulo ezibalulekile, futhi azihlele ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlela izimpendulo ngokwezigaba, ukuqala ngombono omkhulu bese kuthi kancane kancane ahlukanise izici ezithile. Okwesibili, umphenduli kufanele akwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abe nekhono lokucabanga ngokushesha, ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo, kodwa futhi enembile. Ukuze uthole leli khono, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza.
Okwesibili, umphenduli kufanele akwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abe nekhono lokucabanga ngokushesha, ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo, kodwa futhi enembile. Ukuze uthole leli khono, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza. Ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle, umphenduli angazama ukuphendula imibuzo eminingi ngezikhathi ezimfushane, ukuze azijwayeze nokuphendula ngokushesha. Izindlela Zokuphendula Ngempumelelo Ukuze ufike ekuphenduleni kahle, kunezindlela ezithile ongazisebenzisa. Okokuqala, ungasebenzisa indlela yokubhala emishweni emifushane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicabango yakho, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda. Okwesibili, ungasebenzisa izithombe noma amamephu ukuze ubonise imicabango yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicabango yakho, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo ecacile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izibonelo ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imicabango yakho iyacaca. Izibonelo zenza kube lula ukuveza umqondo wakho, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi uqonda kahle isihloko. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi noma abahloli ukuqonda impendulo yakho. Ukuzijwayeza Nokuhlola Ukuzijwayeza kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza ukuphendula imibuzo ngezikhathi ezimfushane. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imicabango yakho ihlelekile. Ungasebenzisa izivivinyo ezithile, noma ungazama ukuphendula imibuzo ethile esikhathini esinqunyiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlola impendulo yakho kuyasiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ubuyekeze impendulo yakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iyacaca, futhi ibhalwe kahle.
Ungasebenzisa izivivinyo ezithile, noma ungazama ukuphendula imibuzo ethile esikhathini esinqunyiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlola impendulo yakho kuyasiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ubuyekeze impendulo yakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iyacaca, futhi ibhalwe kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awuphuthelwa yizinto ezibalulekile, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo enembile. Isiphetho Ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15 kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphenduli banesikhathi esanele sokucabanga, ukuhlela, nokubhala impendulo yabo. Ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza, ukuhlela imicabango, nokuphendula ngokushesha. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zindlela, umphenduli angakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo enembile, ecacile, futhi efanele, ngaleso sikhathi esinqunyiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufezekisa imigomo yokuhlola, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abaphenduli bahlonishwa futhi bahlonipha isikhathi sabo.
Ukufakwa kwengane kusho ukuvuma ukuba ngumgadi omthetho wengane, kulandela inqubo yesiko neyomthetho yengane engazalwanga kubazali abafaka. Ubaba wengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado. I-oda yokufakwa kwengane ikhipha yinkantolo yezingane esifundeni lapho ingane ikhona. Inkantolo yezingane ingakhipha i-oda ngemuva kokuthola umbiko owethulwe ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana ogunyaziwe. Isicelo se-oda yokufakwa kwengane kufanele senziwe enkantolo yezingane esifundeni lapho ingane okufanele ifakwe khona ikhona. Njengoba zonke izinkantolo zamagistrate zisebenza njengezinkantolo zezingane, ungafaka isicelo kumlawuli wenkantolo yezingane. Usizo lwenkantolo luzokwenza, uma lokhu kungakakwenziwanga, ukucela umsebenzi wezokuxhumana ogunyaziwe ukuba ahlole isicelo. Ekupheleni kokuhlola, umsebenzi wezokuxhumana uzothumela umbiko enkantolo yezingane lapho isicelo senziwe khona. Ngaphandle kokuthi inkantolo ifune, umbiko ngeke ubonise ukuthi ubani abazali bezinhliziyo futhi ukuthi bafuna ukufaka ingane ngokomthetho - noma ingane, uma sebesendaweni yabo - ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe. Uma inkantolo ikholwa umbiko, kanye nanoma iyiphi enye imininingwane mayelana nabazali abafuna ukufaka ingane ngokomthetho, ingase, ngokuthanda kwayo, ivume isicelo futhi ikhiphe i-oda yokufakwa ngaphandle kokulalela omunye umuntu. Nokho, ingakwenza kuphela uma kungekho muntu ophikisa isicelo. Uma isicelo singaqedwa, noma asikaphelwanga, kuzobekwa usuku lokulalela isicelo enkantolo yezingane.

Umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane uzokhipha isaziso kuFomu 1A Isaziso kubazali abafuna ukufaka ukuze bazi abazali bezinhliziyo zengane mayelana nolalelo lwesicelo sokufakwa. Abazali bezinhliziyo zengane ngeke babe nelungelo lokuba khona enkantolo ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba lokufakwa kwengane yabo, ngaphandle kokuthi inkantolo, ngokuthanda kwayo, ivumele ukuba bakhona, uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi ukuba khona kwabo kuzohlangabezana nezidingo zengane. Inkantolo ingacela abazali noma umgadi wengane ukuba banikeze imvume ebhaliwe. Inkantolo ingase futhi icela imvume ebhaliwe enganeni uma seziphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi, futhi inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi ingane iyayiqonda indaba kanye nokubaluleka kwemvume. Uma kunoma yisiphi isikhawu sokulalela, uma inkantolo ithola ukuthi kunezizathu eziphakeme zokuthi imvume ebhaliwe engabazali bezinhliziyo zengane ingafunwa, inkantolo ingacela umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane ukuba ikhiphe isaziso noma iFomu 22 Isaziso kubazali ukuze bathumele izizathu ngokuhambisana nemigomo 21, 21 kulowo bazali. Isaziso sizocela abazali ukuba babe khona enkantolo yezingane uma befuna ukuveza izizathu zokuthi imvume yabo ingabekwa eceleni.
Inkantolo ingase futhi icela imvume ebhaliwe enganeni uma seziphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi, futhi inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi ingane iyayiqonda indaba kanye nokubaluleka kwemvume. Uma kunoma yisiphi isikhawu sokulalela, uma inkantolo ithola ukuthi kunezizathu eziphakeme zokuthi imvume ebhaliwe engabazali bezinhliziyo zengane ingafunwa, inkantolo ingacela umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane ukuba ikhiphe isaziso noma iFomu 22 Isaziso kubazali ukuze bathumele izizathu ngokuhambisana nemigomo 21, 21 kulowo bazali. Isaziso sizocela abazali ukuba babe khona enkantolo yezingane uma befuna ukuveza izizathu zokuthi imvume yabo ingabekwa eceleni. Uma isaziso sithunyelwe kahle kubazali futhi akukho sizathu esiphakeme sokuthi abazali baphume enkantolo, inkantolo ingase iphendule ngokushesha udaba bese ikhipha isinqumo ngodaba. Uma isaziso singathunyelwa kahle kubazali, inkantolo ingase, ngokuthanda kwayo, ikhiphe isaziso kubazali futhi, uma ibona kudingeka, iphendule ngokushesha udaba bese ikhipha isinqumo ngodaba. Lapho inkantolo yezingane icabangela isicelo sokufakwa, ukuhlinzekwa kombiko obhaliwe owenziwe ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana ogunyaziwe, noma omunye umuntu ogunyaziwe, kuzoba ubufakazi obanele mayelana nokuqukethwe kombiko. Noma iyiphi i-parti ethintwa ngqo umbiko ingacela ukuthi okuqukethwe kombiko kukhishwe. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba. Umphakathi ophathelene nodaba uzokhuluma ngokucacile kumuntu othintekayo ngemiphumela yokwehluleka ukuphikisa umbiko nokuphikisa izitatimende ezivela kumbiko.
Noma iyiphi i-parti ethintwa ngqo umbiko ingacela ukuthi okuqukethwe kombiko kukhishwe. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba. Umphakathi ophathelene nodaba uzokhuluma ngokucacile kumuntu othintekayo ngemiphumela yokwehluleka ukuphikisa umbiko nokuphikisa izitatimende ezivela kumbiko. Ngesikhathi sokulalela isicelo, umfaki-sicelo kanye nomzali owathola isaziso bazoba namalungelo namandla afana ne-parti enenkantolo yezenzo, kulandela ukuhlolwa nokuphikiswa kwabafakizolo, ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi, nokukhuluma enkantolo. Isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngesicelo sincike ekwakhiweni kwesicelo. Isaziso kubazali bezinhliziyo zengane okufanele ifakwe abanye sizohlinzeka ngemininingwane eyanele noma izizathu zokungaceli imvume yabo ukuze ingane ifakwe abanye. Isaziso sizonikezwa okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-21 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela udaba. Uma unina wengane enqaba ukuhlinzeka ngemvume, isicelo sizokwenziwa enkantolo yezingane phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14. Ubaba bezinhliziyo zengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa zokukhishwa kwe-oda lenkantolo, afake isicelo sokushintsha imininingwane yakhe kumadokhumenti okubhaliswa kokuzalwa kwengane. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo sokushintsha, ubaba bezinhliziyo zengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele azise umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane lapho isicelo sokufakwa senziwe khona. Kufanele akwenze lokhu ebhalwe phansi, echaza usuku nendawo lapho enze isicelo sokushintsha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Imfashini: Ukuguquka Kwezitayela Nezindlela Zokugqoka Ezweni Lethu Ngonyaka ka-2023, imfashini ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Iphinde ibe yindlela yokuziveza, yokukhombisa ubunikazi, kanye nokwakha izithombe ezihlukahlukene. Ezweni lethu, imfashini ibonakala iguquka njalo, ihambisana nezinguquko zomphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezifiso zabantu. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nezimo zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezimweni zokuphila ezishintshashintshayo. Izitayela Ezidumile Nezinguquko Zazo Izitayela ezidumile zihlala zishintsha, ziqhamuka nezinto ezintsha ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, izitayela ezinjengezimpahla ezikhululekile, ezilula, nezinemibala eminingi ziyaqhubeka nokuthandwa. Lokhu kuhlobene nokukhula kokusebenza kwezemidlalo, lapho abantu bejolise ekutholeni induduzo, kodwa futhi befuna ukuveza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Izimpahla ezikhiqizwa ngama-sustainable materials zikhula kakhulu, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuvikela imvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitayela ze-vintage zibuye zibe nempumelelo enkulu. Abantu abaningi bakhetha ukuhamba ngezimpahla ezindala, ezivela ezikhathini ezahlukene, ukuze bakhombise ubunikazi babo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubuyisela emuva, lapho abantu bejolise ekwakheni izithombe ezihlukile, ezihambisana nezinkumbulo zabo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitayela zifinyelela kubantu abaningi, izinkampani zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze zikhuthaze imikhiqizo yazo. Izithombe ezinhle, ama-video, kanye nezibuyekezo ezivela kubathandi bemfashini zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezitayeleni ezintsha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bexoxa ngezinto abazithandayo, behlanganyela imibono, futhi bejabulisa abanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile zenza kube lula ukuthola izitayela ezithile. Abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezilula ukuze bathole izimpahla ezihambisana nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi imfashini iyatholakala, futhi abantu bangenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo. Imfashini Nezinkinga Zokuhlukumezeka Nokho, imfashini ayinakho konke okuhle. Njengoba izitayela zishintsha, kunezinkinga ezithile ezivela, ikakhulukazi ezokuhlukumezeka. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuziphatha kahle, lapho bezama ukufanisa izithombe ezibukwayo ezitholakala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu kufanele baphile ngendlela ethile ukuze bahlonishwe, okungaholela ekudumazekeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfashini ibonisa izinkinga ezithinta imvelo. Ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla eziningi kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekonakaleni kwemvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfashini ibonisa izinkinga ezithinta imvelo. Ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla eziningi kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekonakaleni kwemvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo. Ukukhuthaza imfashini esebenzisa izinto eziphinde zisetshenziswe, kanye nezindlela zokukhiqiza ezihlakaniphile, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela imvelo. Isiphetho: Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, imfashini izoqhubeka nokuguquka, ihambisana nezimo zomhlaba. Abantu bazoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izitayela ezizayo, njengoba bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobungane nemvelo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabathandi bemfashini, abakhiqizi, kanye nezinkampani kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ngakho-ke, imfashini akuyona nje indlela yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokuphila, yokuziveza, nokwakha umphakathi. Njengoba sithokozisa izitayela ezihlukahlukene, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imfashini ingaba yinsika yokuhlanganyela, yokuhlonipha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, sikhulise imfashini yethu, futhi sithuthukise umhlaba esiphila kuwo.
I-ISS isiza abantu nemindeni abahlangabezana nezinkinga zomuntu siqu noma zomphakathi abadinga ukwesekwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe. Le nsiza itholakala kunoma ubani eNingizimu Afrika noma phesheya. Isifinyezo somcimbi kufanele silungiswe ngokulandela imihlahlandlela ebekwe yi-ISS. Isifinyezo somcimbi sizochaza izimo nezicelo zokwesekwa ezidingekayo phesheya. Ukudluliselwa kuzobhekwa kulandela ukuvunywa kwezicelo. Uma isicelo sokudluliselwa sitholakala kusuka kumnyango wesifunda, i-ISS SA izodlulisa isicelo sokwesekwa kwi-ISS Affiliated Bureau noma kummeleli wayo ezweni langaphandle. Impendulo izoncika ezimweni zendawo. Uma isicelo sokudluliselwa sivunywa phesheya, i-ISS SA izodlulisa icala kummeleli wesifunda wendawo ozokwenza amalungiselelo nezinsizakalo zomphakathi ukuze kuhlolwe udaba futhi kuhanjiswe umbiko kumnyango wesifunda. Uma umbiko uvunywa, uthunyelwa kwi-ISS SA, eyohlola futhi idlulise umbiko ezindaweni ezifanele, kanye nezinkulumo zazo, imibuzo, noma izicelo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, le nsizakalo inikezwa mahhala. Ezinye izinkanyezi, ungakhokha ngezinsizakalo ezithile. Lezi zindleko zihluka ukusuka ezweni ukuya ezweni. Akudingi ukufaka amafomu.

Uma uneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwengu-49, sikukhetha ngaphandle kwemigomo phakathi kwamalungu omndeni abuye abe nethuba elifanayo lokukhethwa, futhi sikumema ukuba ubambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Uma uneminyaka engu-50 noma ngaphezulu, sithanda ukukumema wena nabanye abantu emndenini wakho abahlangene nawe ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Ukhethiwe ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga, yingakho sithanda ukuxoxa nawe. Le mininingwane elandelayo izochaza inhloso yocwaningo, lokho ozobuzwa khona, kanye nobuhlungu nezinsiza ongazilindela. Kuzochazeka futhi ukuthi awudingi ukujoyina lolu cwaningo. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngababonisi abaqeqeshiwe [njengami] ababuya kwi-Human Sciences Research Council. Lolu cwaningo lukhona okwamanje ezweni lonke nasemazweni ambalwa. Unemukelekile ukukhuluma nomfakeli [mna], umcwaningi ophambili, noma noma ubani ofuna ukukhuluma naye ngalolu cwaningo uma unquma ukuthi uzobamba iqhaza noma cha. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama omphenduli... Umfakeli [mna] uzokunikeza ulwazi oluthile oluhambisana nalolu cwaningo - olungase luhlanganise nezinye izincazelo, amagama, noma imibono ongase ungayiqondi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, uzizwe ukhululekile ukuveza imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi sizokunikeza ithuba lokuphendula. Uma uvuma ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo, ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqondwe kangcono izinkinga ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo emphakathini wakho nasemhlabeni - ikakhulukazi impilo nokuphila kahle kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka uhulumeni ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphila nezokuxhasa. Lolu cwaningo ngeke lunikeze izinzuzo eziqondile kuwe. Ukujoyina kwakho kulolu cwaningo kuzohlanganisa ukuphendula imibuzo ngawe, kuhlanganise nempilo yakho nokuphila kahle, isimo sakho sokuxhumana, isimo sakho somnotho nomphakathi, kanye nokusebenzisa kwakho izinsiza zempilo.
Lokhu kuzohlinzeka uhulumeni ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphila nezokuxhasa. Lolu cwaningo ngeke lunikeze izinzuzo eziqondile kuwe. Ukujoyina kwakho kulolu cwaningo kuzohlanganisa ukuphendula imibuzo ngawe, kuhlanganise nempilo yakho nokuphila kahle, isimo sakho sokuxhumana, isimo sakho somnotho nomphakathi, kanye nokusebenzisa kwakho izinsiza zempilo. Sizokwenza kuphela ukuqoqa ulwazi oludingekayo kulolu cwaningo. Le ngxenye ye-questionnaire izothatha cishe imizuzu engu-90. kanye nemibuzo ehambisana nomndeni wakho, umlando wakho wokusebenza, isimo sakho somnotho, impilo yakho kanye nokufinyelela kwakho kwezokwelapha, kanye nemibono yakho ngempilo yakho kanye nesimo sakho sempilo. Siphinde sikumeme ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekuhloleni ukuphefumula kwakho, ukubona, amandla, ukuhamba, kanye nezinkumbulo. Sizokala ingcindezi yegazi lakho, ukuphakama, isisindo, kanye nesilinganiso somgogodla wakho nezinqe. Enye ifomu yokuvuma izosetshenziselwa ukukumema ukuba unikeze isampula encane yegazi, lapho sifinyelela kule ngxenye yocwaningo. Ezinye zezimibuzo ozobuzwa ngazo zingahambisana ngqo nawe futhi zingadala ukungakhululeki noma ukungakhululeki. Ungacela ukubona imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi uzobamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo noma cha. Ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luyimfihlo futhi luyimfihlo futhi ngeke lukhululwe kumuntu. Luzosetshenziswa kuphela ezinhlelweni zokucwaninga nasekucwangcweni. Isitezi sokunakekela izingane siyindawo ebhalisiwe yokunakekela izingane. Izindawo zokunakekela izingane zingafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali njalo ngenyanga kuhulumeni ukuze zisize ngezindleko zokusebenza kwesitezi sokunakekela izingane. Inani lokwesekwa kwemali liyahluka futhi lincike ezindlekweni zokusebenza kwesitezi kanye nenani lezingane ezihlala lapho. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali? Izindawo zokunakekela izingane ezibhalisiwe. Qedela ifomu ehhovisi lezinsizakalo zomphakathi eliseduze. Ifomu eliqediwe kumele lisayinwe nguSihlalo weKomidi Lokuphatha kanye noMphathi weSikhungo Sokunakekela Izingane ofaka isicelo. Thumela isicelo kanye nesitifiketi sokubhaliswa njenge-NPO kanye nezitatimende zebhange kumnyango wezimali. Ukusekelwa kwemali kuyatholakala esikhungweni sezingane ezihlala lapho. Imali yokwesekwa ikhokhelwa esitezi, hhayi ezinganeni. Inqubo yesicelo izothatha ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma usuthumele isicelo sakho, ubuqotho bayo buzohlolwa. Uma uMnyango ujabule ngesicelo, uzonikezwa imali. Isinqumo sisisekela ekutholakaleni kwemali nasekudingekeni kwalesi sevisi. Umnyango wehulumeni unikeza imali yokwesekwa kwezinyanga ezintathu, kuye ngokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yesikhungo sokunakekela izingane. Le sevisi iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhiswa.

Ukuhlonishwa kokuba yiMvikeli Wabantu kanye noMphathi Wokuhlola kubonakala emcimbini nasemlandweni waleli thuluzi, okukhombisa ngokucacile ukuhlela kwezobulili kweMasipala eThekwini futhi kusekelwe ezimisweni eziyisisekelo zokulingana kobulili emthethweni wethu. Ngenxa yalokhu kanye nomsebenzi wethu njengomvikeli wabantu, kumele le ndawo ingavumi kuphela ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa kodwa futhi ivikele, ikhuthaze, futhi ibophezele ngokuphelele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo ayisisekelo abantu bonke eMasipala eThekwini ayafezekiswa. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi umphakathi waseThekwini uthokozisa kakhulu ngomsebenzi weMvikeli Wabantu kanye noMphathi Wokuhlola kanye nabasebenzi babo abazinikele abenza lo msebenzi onhlonipho wokuphila komuntu, hhayi kuphela ngokuhlola, ukuthola, nokunikeza izeluleko ngezindaba ezithinta iMasipala eThekwini, kodwa futhi ngokufundisa umphakathi ngamalungelo awo, ikakhulukazi ilungelo lokufinyelela enkantolo, ilungelo lokwazi, kanye nelungelo lokulingana. Ngakho-ke, ngokufingqa, lokhu kusho ukuthi iMvikeli Wabantu kanye noMphathi Wokuhlola, kanye nabalingani babo, bagcizelela izidingo zomphakathi, phezu kokuvikela amalungelo abhalwe emthethweni wabo, baqinisekisa ubuqotho emizameni yabo yokunciphisa noma iyiphi indlela yokuphazamiseka engase ingaphazamisa noma ithinte kabi ubudlelwano bendlela yokuphatha, kodwa futhi ingavimbela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, ukuphathwa kahle, nokubhekelela. © 2009 iMasipala eThekwini. Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu (GEMS quality care assurance) Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elincane, lapho abantu behlale bejabulile futhi bephila impilo ejabulisayo, kwakukhona isikhungo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo esaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS. Lesi sikhungo sathandwa kakhulu ngababhalisile, ngoba sasinikeza ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Abantu abavakashela i-GEMS babebona ukuthi izidingo zabo zihlala zikhuliswa, futhi lokhu kwakubavusa ithemba. Uthando lokunakekela abantu belwakhiwa ngothando lukaDkt. Mthembu, ongumholi wesikhungo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayenobuchwepheshe obukhulu kwezempilo, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, wayenothando olukhulu lokunakekela abantu. Wazi kahle ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezempilo akukhona nje ukwelapha izifo, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwababhalisile nabahlengikazi. Ngelinye ilanga, uDkt. Mthembu wathola umyalezo ovela kumphakathi, owawukhombisa ukuthi abanye abantu babengajabuli ngempela ngezinqubo ezithile ezikhona e-GEMS. Lokhu kwenza uDkt. Mthembu wacabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezinguquko. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nabasebenzi besikhungo, ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinkinga. “Ngiyazi ukuthi sikhona isikhungo esihle, kodwa kufanele sibe nesibopho sokwenza kube ngcono,” kusho uDkt. Mthembu. “Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhalisile bahlala bejabule futhi bezizwa bekhuthazekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza sibe yisikhungo esihloniphekile, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi.” Abasebenzi bavuma ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqubo ezithile zokuphendula izikhalazo zabantu.
Mthembu. “Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhalisile bahlala bejabule futhi bezizwa bekhuthazekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza sibe yisikhungo esihloniphekile, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi.” Abasebenzi bavuma ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqubo ezithile zokuphendula izikhalazo zabantu. Baphinde bahlanganyele iziphakamiso ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa izinga lokunakekelwa. Kwakukhona umqondo wokwakha uhlelo lokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, olwakha izinyathelo ezithile zokuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uDkt. Mthembu wathumela izincwadi ezithile kubabhalisile, echaza izinguquko ezizayo. Wabavuma ukuba neqhaza ekwakheni izinqubo ezintsha, futhi wababiza ukuba baveze imicabango yabo. Lokhu kwenza abantu bazizwe bebamba iqhaza, futhi kwaba nomthelela omuhle emoyeni wesikhungo. Ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhlelo lwe-GEMS quality care assurance lwaqala ukuvela. Abasebenzi baqala ukuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, behlola ukuthi zifinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Uhlelo lwakha izigaba ezahlukene zokuhlola, kuhlanganiswe nezibuyekezo ezivela kubabhalisile. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuthi abantu baveze izinkinga zabo, futhi kube nendlela yokuthola izixazululo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uDkt. Mthembu waphinde waqala umkhankaso wokuhlonipha imiphumela yokusebenza. Abasebenzi bahlala bejolisa ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo, futhi baqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokusebenza zihlala ziqinile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni isimo sokubambisana phakathi kwabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nababhalisile. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, i-GEMS yathola udumo olukhulu. Abantu babejabulile futhi bezizwa bephumelele.
Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni isimo sokubambisana phakathi kwabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nababhalisile. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, i-GEMS yathola udumo olukhulu. Abantu babejabulile futhi bezizwa bephumelele. Isikhungo sakhula, futhi izinsizakalo zakhula zaba ziningi. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayehlale ebakhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima, futhi baphinde bahlale bephokophele ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinhle. Ekugcineni, i-GEMS yaphumelela ekwakheni isithombe esihle emphakathini. Ababhalisile babebona ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uDkt. Mthembu waphinde wakhumbula ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu akupheli. Kuhlala kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinguquko, futhi kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwabahlengikazi nababhalisile. Wazi ukuthi i-GEMS izoba yisikhungo esihloniphekile, uma bonke abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye. Ngakho, uDkt. Mthembu wagcina ethi, “Ukwenza kahle akupheli. Sidinga ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokunakekelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza i-GEMS ibe yisikhungo esingcono, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi.” Futhi, ngaleso sikhathi, i-GEMS yahlala ibalulekile empilweni yabantu, yaziwa njengendawo yokunakekelwa kwezempilo okukhuthazayo, futhi izinga lokunakekelwa layo laqhubeka nokukhula.
Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi Lwezempilo ku-GEMS Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo kudinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kolwazi lwabantu. Sizobheka izinqubo eziyisisekelo ezihambisana nezokuphepha kolwazi lwezempilo ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Lezi zinqubo zidinga ukulandela ngokucophelela ukuze ziqinisekise ukuvikelwa komkhiqizo we-GEMS. Isigaba 1: Ukuhlonipha Imigomo Yokuvikeleka Kolwazi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi zonke izinqubo eziphathelene nokuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo zibhaliwe ngaphakathi kwemigomo yokuvikeleka ye-GEMS. Le migomo ivumela abasebenzi ukuba baqonde ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lusebenza kanjani, luhlolwa kanjani, futhi lutholakala kanjani. Uhlelo lwezokuphepha kumele lwaziswe kubasebenzi kanye nakuzo zonke izigaba ze-GEMS. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlela Nokugcina Ulwazi Ukuze ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwe ngokuphephile, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokuhlela, zokubhalisela, nokugcina. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zesoftware ezivikelekile, ezisetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala kuphela kubantu abafanele. Umsebenzisi ofinyelela kulezi zinhlelo kumele alandele imiyalo ethile yokuphepha. Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa Ukufinyelela Kwezempilo Ukuze abafuna ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo bakwazi ukwenza kanjalo, kufanele kube nemigomo eqinile yokubopha ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamakhodi avikelekile, lapho kuphela abanolwazi lokufinyelela abavunyelwe ukufinyelela kulezi zinhlelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi alufinyeleli kubantu abangafanele.
Umsebenzisi ofinyelela kulezi zinhlelo kumele alandele imiyalo ethile yokuphepha. Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa Ukufinyelela Kwezempilo Ukuze abafuna ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo bakwazi ukwenza kanjalo, kufanele kube nemigomo eqinile yokubopha ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamakhodi avikelekile, lapho kuphela abanolwazi lokufinyelela abavunyelwe ukufinyelela kulezi zinhlelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi alufinyeleli kubantu abangafanele. Isigaba 4: Ukuqwashisa Nokuqeqesha Abasebenzi Kubantu abasebenzi, kubalulekile ukwazi izinqubo ezimqoka zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha, ezifana ne-workshops, ama-seminars, kanye nemihlangano ebukhoma. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kumele kube njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bahlala beqaphele. Isigaba 5: Ukuphendula Izimo Zokuphula Ubumfihlo Uma kwenzeka izimo eziphula ubumfihlo, kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela iphendulwa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Uhlelo lokuphendula kumele lubeke izinqubo ezicacile, ukuze ulwazi lwezempilo lungatholakali kalula. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinsizwa eziyiqeqeshelwe ukwenza ukuhlola nokuphendula ezimeni ezingalindelekile. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlanganisa Izibuyekezo Nokuhlolwa Kwenqubo Ukuze sithuthukise ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola futhi ziqhube izibuyekezo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, nokubuyekezwa njalo kwemigomo yokuvikeleka.
Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinsizwa eziyiqeqeshelwe ukwenza ukuhlola nokuphendula ezimeni ezingalindelekile. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlanganisa Izibuyekezo Nokuhlolwa Kwenqubo Ukuze sithuthukise ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola futhi ziqhube izibuyekezo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, nokubuyekezwa njalo kwemigomo yokuvikeleka. Isigaba 7: Ukuxhumana Nokubambisana Nabanye Ukuze uhlelo lokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu e-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abakhiqizi bezinsizakalo, nabanye ozakwethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukudlulisela ulwazi nokuhlala uhlanganyela. Isigaba 8: Ukubeka Izinyathelo Zokugcina Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesimo sokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kudinga izinyathelo eziphakeme. Lokhu kubandakanya ukucwaninga njalo ngezindlela eziphephile zokuphathwa kolwazi, ukwakha isithombe esiqinile sokuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luqinisekisiwe. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinyathelo, i-GEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwa luphephile, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, izinqubo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo ku-GEMS kufanele zibe yimpumelelo eqinile, evikelekile, futhi zenze kube lula ukusimama kwemisebenzi ye-GEMS.
Ukusebenza komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi. B. Uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng ubonisile ukuthi kudingeka isu lokusiza amabhizinisi amancane elidlula izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezikhona kanye nezikhungo zezezimali ukuze kusekelwe amabhizinisi amancane ngokwezezimali nangokunye. "Ibhodi" ibhekisela ebhodini le-GEP elisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sesixhenxe somthetho. "Umnyango" ubhekisela kumnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba esifundeni. "Inhloko yoMnyango" ibhekisela enhlokweni yomnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Umthetho" uveza umthetho wesifunda. "MEC" uveza ilungu lekhansela elibhekene nezindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Kwenziwe" kusho okwenziwe ngumlomo. "Isifunda" sisho isifunda saseGauteng. "Umthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi" ubhekisela kumthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi, Umthetho 1 ka-1999. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa uhlu neminye imithetho ephathelene nayo. Ukusebenza komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi. Akukho okukhona kulomthetho okunezikhali zokukhipha imithetho esunguliwe yi-GEP ngaphansi komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi.

Kuzosiza ukuthuthukisa ukusungulwa kwabo, ukuqhubeka, nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo zokweluleka amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuqala izindlela ezizolandela ukuze kuthuthukiswe amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwenza izinhlelo ezisifundeni, ezweni, nasezindaweni zomhlaba ukuze kudonswe labo abafuna ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. Ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi nezinye izinhlobo zokubambisana nezinhlangano zomphakathi nezinye izinhlangano kulesi sifunda, eRiphabhulikhi, nasemazweni angaphandle. Ukuhlanganisa, ukusiza, nokubambisana nezithakazelo nezikhungo ezifunayo ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukuhlanganyela ezinhlakeni ezikhuthaza futhi zikhulisa amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. a Ukwakha amabhizinisi aqinile futhi ancintisanayo, b Ukukhuthaza osomabhizinisi. c Ukudala indawo efanele yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi amancane. d Ukufinyelela okulula kumabhizinisi amancane ukuze bathole usizo lwezezimali nezinye izinsiza, nokuthi basebenzise kanjani nokuthi benza kanjani. e Ukufinyelela okulula kumabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda nakwamanye amazwe.

Ukukhuthaza, ukuhlanganisa, nokukhuthaza uhulumeni bendawo, izinhlangano ezizimele, nezinye izithakazelo ukuba babambisane ukuze i-GEP ifinyelele izinhloso zayo. Ukuhola nokuhlela ucwaningo oluhambisana nezinhlelo ezisiza amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwandisa ukuqwashisa komphakathi mayelana nendima yamabhizinisi amancane ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, nokuphila kahle jikelele. Ukuqala izakhiwo zomphakathi nezasezindaweni ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinhloso zayo ngempumelelo. Ukwenza eminye imithetho ephathelene nalomthetho. Umthetho uyisisekelo seBhodi nokukhethwa kwamalungu. Ngaphambi kokukhetha amalungu eBhodi, i-MEC kumele ixhumane ngazwi ngezaziso ku-Gazette yesifunda, ukhetho lwamalungu afanele okukhethwa. a Representa ingxenye ebalulekile yabantu baseGauteng, egxile kumasiko, ubulili, ukungasebenzi, ukusabalala kwezindawo, nezinhlelo ezikwiindawo zokuhweba. Umthetho wezomthetho ophathelene namabhizinisi amancane. I-MEC ingasungula noma yiziphi izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekukhetheni amalungu. I-CEO iyilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla esibambayo. Bonke amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwe-CEO, bakhethwa ngasikhathi sinye. a Ilungu leBhodi njengomholi. b Elinye ilungu njengomphakathi ophakeme ukuze abambe indawo yomholi weBhodi uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza leyo msebenzi.

Ilungu leBhodi kumele likhishwe esikhundleni uma lelo lungu lenze noma iyiphi yalezi ezishiwo esigabeni sokuqala. a Ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi, ukungabi nolwazi, nokungafaneleki. b Ngenxa yokungawulandeli isigaba 8 2 noma 151. c Uma ilungu ingakwazi ukuya emihlanganweni yeBhodi ngokulandelanayo ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele, d Noma ngenye imbangela efanele. Amagama abhalwe ngokuqinile akhombisa lokho okukhishwe emthethweni osekhona. Amagama agqokwe ngocingo oluqinile akhombisa lokho okubandakanywe emthethweni osekhona. Ukuze kuqaliswe uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawula umkhakha kagesi, ukudala umphakathi wezeMali wezeMali, umgibeli nomshayeli wohla lokulawula kagesi wesizwe; ukuhlinzeka ngamalayisense nokubhaliswa njengendlela yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, ukusabalalisa, ukuhweba, nokwamukela nokuthumela ugesi ukuze kulawulwe; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. Ukudluliswa kusho ukuhanjiswa kukagesi ngohlelo lokudlulisa, kanye nokuhamba nokuhanjiswa kukagesi ngezinkolelo ezihlobene. Futhi umthetho uhlanganisa amagama noma iziqondiso ezenziwe noma ezinikeziwe mayelana nakho. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza kanye nokusebenza kahle kukagesi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuncintisana nokukhetha kwamakhasimende; nokukhuthaza ukukalwa okuhle ngaphakathi kokuthanda kwamakhasimende, abanikazi bamalayisense, abakhiqizi embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kanye nomphakathi. Umphakathi wezeMali wezeMali owasungulwa ngengxenye 3 yoMthetho Wokulawula ugesi ungumgibeli nomgibeli wohla oluhlinzekwe ngalo Mthetho. Ukuze uthole noma uqashe impahla ethile esuswe noma eyashiywa ukuze wenze imisebenzi yayo; nokuthatha noma yisiphi isinyathelo esiyingozi emisebenzini yabo. Umphakathi ungase uthethe izinkomidi eziqukethe amalungu amaningi omphakathi, abasebenzi bomphakathi, nabanye abantu njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze iseluleko kumphakathi ngokujwayelekile noma ngezindaba ezithile.

Ukuze uthole noma uqashe impahla ethile esuswe noma eyashiywa ukuze wenze imisebenzi yayo; nokuthatha noma yisiphi isinyathelo esiyingozi emisebenzini yabo. Umphakathi ungase uthethe izinkomidi eziqukethe amalungu amaningi omphakathi, abasebenzi bomphakathi, nabanye abantu njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze iseluleko kumphakathi ngokujwayelekile noma ngezindaba ezithile. Umphakathi ungase uthethe ama-foramu amakhasimende nabahwebi aqukethe amalungu amaningi omphakathi, abasebenzi bomphakathi, kanye nezikhulumi zamakhasimende nabathengi njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze iseluleko kumphakathi ngezindaba ezihlobene namakhasimende noma abathengi ngokujwayelekile, noma ingxenye ethile yamakhasimende noma abathengi. Umphakathi kumele ucele ilayisense ukuze uqale futhi uhlinzeke ngemali kumphakathi noma foramu yabathengi ngendlela echazwe kumalayisense abanjwe yilowo muntu. Ngaphandle kokubheka isigaba 1, umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywe ngakho kuSheduli II okudingayo ukufaka isicelo noma ukuba nelayisense enikezwe umphakathi akufanele abe nalutho kulomthetho olukhishwe kubo ukuze bahlale beyi-licensee ekuxoxeni ngokuqalisa nokusebenza kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka, ukuhweba, noma noma iyiphi imisebenzi ehambisanayo, ngaphambi kokuphothula isicelo selayisense kumphakathi. Umphakathi kumele uhlinzeke kumfaki-sicelo okukhulunywe ngakho esigabeni a ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zamalayisense.

Umphakathi kumele uhlinzeke kumfaki-sicelo okukhulunywe ngakho esigabeni a ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zamalayisense. Akukho sicelo sokuhlala kwemininingwane, izaziso, noma izingxoxo ezihlobene esigabeni 3 ezingase zithathwe njengokuthinta noma yisiphi ilungelo noma okulindelwe komfaki-sicelo. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi, athole imininingwane kuGazethi mayelana nanoma iyiphi imisebenzi esigabeni 8 edinga ilayisense kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywe kulokhu kuziswa. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi, athole izaziso kuGazethi mayelana nanoma yimuphi umuntu ophakathi kwalesi sikhathi sokuhweba noma ukukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungadingi ilayisense ngaphansi kwesigaba 8 kufanele bhaliswe nomphakathi.
