UNgqongqoshe angase, ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi, athole imininingwane kuGazethi mayelana nanoma iyiphi imisebenzi esigabeni 8 edinga ilayisense kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywe kulokhu kuziswa. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi, athole izaziso kuGazethi mayelana nanoma yimuphi umuntu ophakathi kwalesi sikhathi sokuhweba noma ukukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungadingi ilayisense ngaphansi kwesigaba 8 kufanele bhaliswe nomphakathi. Noma yimuphi umuntu odinga ukubhaliswa nomphakathi kumele akwenze ngendlela kanye nokulandela izinqubo ezibekwe, kanye nesicelo esibekwe esidinga ukuhambisana nezimali zokubhaliswa ezibekwe: uma noma yimuphi umuntu onelayisense ngosuku olukhulunywe esigabeni 9 kufanele anikezwe isitifiketi sokubhaliswa ngaphandle kokulandela izinqubo ezibekwe. Ngemuva kokuthola isicelo ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba 2, umphakathi kumele ubhalise umfaki-sicelo wemisebenzi echazwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa ezonikezwa kulowo muntu. Uma isicelo singafakiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekwe noma singaqhubeki nezimali zokubhaliswa ezibekwe; noma uma isicelo siphikisana nenhloso yalomthetho. Ubufakazi bokulandela uhlelo olufanele lokuhlanganiswa kwamandla ngaleso sikhathi; kanye neminye imininingwane evela kuNgqongqoshe njengoba kuchaziwe. UNgqongqoshe kumele achaze izidingo ezizolandelwa abafaki-sicelo ngaphambi kokuba umphakathi ucabangele isicelo selayisense. Uma ilayisense iceliwe kumphakathi, kufanele icela umfaki-sicelo ukuthi azise isicelo ephephandabeni elifanele noma ezinkundleni ezihlobene nendawo yokusebenza ngolimi oluphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezimbili. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke umfaki-sicelo ngazo zonke izixhaso ukuze avumele umfaki-sicelo ukuthi aphendule kulokhu; futhi angafaka eminye imininingwane njengoba kudingeka ukuze umphakathi ucabangele isicelo ngendlela efanele. Ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka; ukuhweba nokuthumela ugesi; noma ukuhweba. Umphakathi akufanele uphoqelelwe ukuthi usebenzise ilayisense futhi kufanele inikeze kuphela ilayisense eyodwa yesicelo esisodwa semisebenzi echazwe esigabeni 3. Isikhathi sokusebenza kumele sihlanganise ukusebenza; nokunye okukhulunywe. Umphakathi ungase, njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense ezibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, avimbe umnikazi welayisense ekwenzeni noma uphoqele umnikazi welayisense ukuba enze noma yisiphi isinyathelo esichazwe kulayisense. Umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukukhokha noma iyiphi imali kumakhasimende futhi abeke izimo ezivela ezivumelwaneni ezilawulwa noma ezibekwe umphakathi njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense.
Isikhathi sokusebenza kumele sihlanganise ukusebenza; nokunye okukhulunywe. Umphakathi ungase, njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense ezibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, avimbe umnikazi welayisense ekwenzeni noma uphoqele umnikazi welayisense ukuba enze noma yisiphi isinyathelo esichazwe kulayisense. Umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukukhokha noma iyiphi imali kumakhasimende futhi abeke izimo ezivela ezivumelwaneni ezilawulwa noma ezibekwe umphakathi njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense. UNgqongqoshe kumele achaze inqubo ezizolandelwa ekukhanselweni, ekuphakamiseni okwethulwa, ekususweni, noma ekubekweni kwanoma iyiphi isimo selayisense. Noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ofuna ukukhombisa ukuthi angathatha amalungelo namandla omnikazi walelayisense ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalomthetho, futhi ilayisense entsha inikezwa kulowo muntu; noma isimo selayisense asihlonishwanga. Umnikazi welayisense kumele, ezimweni ezichazwe ezigabeni 1a no-b, anikeze umphakathi okungenani izinyanga eziyi-12 izaziso ebhalwe phansi ngenhloso yabo yokumisa ukusebenza, ngaphandle kokuthi umphakathi ubonge okunye. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga noma wehluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho, izimo, noma noma yiziphi izinhlinzeko zalomthetho, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga izaziso eziphathelene nesigaba 2, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwephupho Kwakukhona isikhathi lapho abantu babecabanga ukuthi ukuhamba emkhathini kuyinto engafinyeleleki. Nokho, u-Elon Musk, owayaziwa kakhulu, waphakamisa umbono omusha. Wazalelwa eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa wakhula e-United States, lapho athola khona izifundo ezimfakazela ukuthi umphakathi ungathuthukisa izinkanyezi. Ngemva kokuphumelela kwezinye izinkampani, uMusk wanquma ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokwenza umkhankaso omkhulu: ukuhamba emkhathini. Ngonyaka ka-2002, wasungula iSpaceX, inkampani eyayihlose ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhamba emkhathini. Waqala njengoba inkampani encane, kodwa umgomo wakhe wawukhulu. Wayefuna ukwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuba abantu baphume emhlabeni, baye kwezinye izinkanyezi. Lokhu kwakunzima, kodwa uMusk wayenokholo olukhulu. Isahluko 2: Izithiyo Nezimpumelelo Ngemuva kokwasungulwa, iSpaceX yahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhiqiza izindiza eziphakeme neziphephile kwakuyinselelo enkulu. U-Musk wayazi ukuthi ukuze aphumelele, kwakudingeka abekezelele. Ngemva kokuhluleka okokuqala, lapho iFalcon 1 ingaphumeleli, abanye babebona lokhu njengokuphela. Kodwa uMusk, onobuhlakani obukhulu, wabona lezi zinkinga njengezindlela zokuthuthukisa. Ngemva kokuhluleka okwesithathu, iFalcon 1 ekugcineni yaphumelela. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, futhi kwavula iminyango eminingi. U-Musk waphinde waqinisekisa ukuthi iSpaceX izoba yinkampani yokuqala ezokwazi ukuhamba emkhathini ngaphandle kokuncika ezinkampanini ezinkulu, okwakuyimpumelelo enkulu futhi kwavusa ithemba emhlabeni wonke.
Ngemva kokuhluleka okwesithathu, iFalcon 1 ekugcineni yaphumelela. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, futhi kwavula iminyango eminingi. U-Musk waphinde waqinisekisa ukuthi iSpaceX izoba yinkampani yokuqala ezokwazi ukuhamba emkhathini ngaphandle kokuncika ezinkampanini ezinkulu, okwakuyimpumelelo enkulu futhi kwavusa ithemba emhlabeni wonke. Isahluko 3: Ukuhamba Kwezimoto Zomkhathi Ngemva kokuphumelela kweFalcon 1, iSpaceX yathuthukisa iFalcon 9, imoto yokuhamba emkhathini eyayihloselwe ukuthwala izimpahla ezinkulu. Le moto yathola udumo olukhulu, futhi yaphumelela ekuthumeleni izimpahla ezindaweni ezahlukene. U-Musk wayefuna ukuthi iSpaceX ibe yinkampani eyaziwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Ngonyaka ka-2012, iSpaceX yathumela iDragon kwi-International Space Station (ISS). Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, njengoba iSpaceX yaba yinkampani yokuqala ezokwazi ukuthumela izimpahla kwi-ISS. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi, futhi kwavusa ithemba lokuthi abantu bangase baphume emhlabeni baye kwezinye izinkanyezi. Isahluko 4: Ukuphupha Ngaphezulu U-Elon Musk wayenganeliseki kuphela ngokuhamba emkhathini. Wayefuna ukufinyelela ezinkanyezini. Ngemuva kokuphumelela kweFalcon 9, waqala ukucabanga ngempumelelo enkulu: iStarship. Le moto yayihloselwe ukuhamba abantu baye kwiMars, umhlaba ophakeme. U-Musk wayekholelwa ukuthi abantu kufanele babe nekhaya elisha, futhi iMars iyindawo efanele. Ukuthuthukiswa kweStarship kwakuyinselelo enkulu. U-Musk waphinde wathola izinselelo eziningi, kodwa wayenokholo olukhulu. Ngemva kokuhluleka okukhulu, iStarship ekugcineni yaphumelela.
Ukuthuthukiswa kweStarship kwakuyinselelo enkulu. U-Musk waphinde wathola izinselelo eziningi, kodwa wayenokholo olukhulu. Ngemva kokuhluleka okukhulu, iStarship ekugcineni yaphumelela. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, futhi kwavusa ithemba lokuthi abantu bangase baphume emhlabeni baye kwezinye izinkanyezi. Isahluko 5: Ikusasa Elikhanyayo Namuhla, iSpaceX isiphenduke inkampani eyaziwa emhlabeni wonke. U-Elon Musk ubonakala njengomholi ophumelelayo, futhi abantu baphupha ngempumelelo yakhe. ISpaceX iqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izimoto zokuhamba emkhathini, futhi izinhlelo zayo zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangase baphume emhlabeni baye kwezinye izinkanyezi. U-Musk ubonisa ukuthi ngekhono, ukuzimisela, nokukholelwa, konke kungenzeka. ISpaceX iyisibonelo sokuthi uma umuntu enza umsebenzi oncomekayo, angakwazi ukufinyelela ezinkanyezini. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile, futhi kubonisa ukuthi ukuphupha akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka uma sikholelwa. Isiphetho ISpaceX iyinkampani eyakha amaphupho, futhi u-Elon Musk ungumholi ophumelelayo. Uthando lwakhe lokuhamba emkhathini lukhombisa ukuthi abantu bangase baphume emhlabeni baye kwezinye izinkanyezi. Ngalesi sikhathi, iSpaceX ibonisa ukuthi ukuphupha akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka uma sikholelwa. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile, futhi kubonisa ukuthi umhlaba unamathuba amaningi, uma sikholelwa.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sokwamukelwa njengomfuduki lwenziwa ngumfaki-sicelo ukuze amukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi ungumuntu ophume ezweni lakhe ngenxa yokwesaba ukuphathwa kabi, futhi futhi ufuna ukwamukelwa njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi kulolu suku eNingizimu Afrika. Umfaki-sicelo kumele afune ukuhlala phansi ngenkathi isicelo sakhe sisasebenza. Umfuna ukuhlala phansi uthola imvume engavuselelwa yokuhlala endaweni ethile eNingizimu Afrika. Imvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-14 futhi ivumela umnikazi ukuba abike endaweni ethile yokwamukela abafuduki ebizwa ngeHhovisi Lokwamukela Abafuduki eduze ukuze afake isicelo sokuhlala phansi. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi uthola isimo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi kanye nokuvikelwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nabafuna ukuhlala phansi, iMthetho Wabafuduki ka-1998. Imvume yomfuna ukuhlala phansi iphrintiwe, isayinwe, ibhampathwe, bese ikhishwa kumfuna ukuhlala phansi. Imvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-30, ivumela umfuna ukuhlala phansi ukuba ahlale eNingizimu Afrika okwethuba elithile. Imvume ingavuselelwa kwezinye izinsuku eziyi-30 bese isivuselelwa izinyanga ezintathu. I-RSDO iqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo futhi yenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala phansi. Isimo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi siyasebenza iminyaka emibili, kodwa abafuna ukuhlala phansi kumele babhale incwadi ecela ukubuyekezwa noma ukuvuselelwa kwesimo sabo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemva kokuphela kwemvume yabo yokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukucubungulwa.
I-RSDO iqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo futhi yenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala phansi. Isimo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi siyasebenza iminyaka emibili, kodwa abafuna ukuhlala phansi kumele babhale incwadi ecela ukubuyekezwa noma ukuvuselelwa kwesimo sabo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemva kokuphela kwemvume yabo yokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukucubungulwa. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa.
Izimo zezulu zango-2007/2008 - yini abakuhlanganyelayo? Inani lemvula elirekhodiwe ngonyaka odlule, ikakhulukazi phakathi nesikhathi esibalulekile sikaJanuwari 2007 kuya kuMashi 2007, belingaphansi kwezinga elibi lika-1992. Kwakunezindawo ezifana neGauteng nezingxenye zeMpumalanga esentshonalanga ezathola umswakama ofana nowango-1912. NgokukaMnu. Johan van den Berg ovela ku-ARS, kukhona izimpawu ezikhombisa umphumela onamandla weLa Nina. Kungenzeka ukuthi lo mphumela weLa Nina uzoqhubeka kuze kube kwentwasahlobo ka-2008. Umphumela walokhu ungaba ukuwa kwemvula okukhulu okuvela ngoDisemba 2007 kuya kuMashi 2008. Izibalo 1 - 3 zikhombisa amathuba okuthola izinga lemvula elijwayelekile. Izindawo eziphuma phambili zikhombisa izinga lemvula elijwayelekile, izindawo eziluhlaza zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphakeme kunjengokujwayelekile, kanti izindawo ezinsundu zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphansi kunjengokujwayelekile. Ukuhlela kukhombisa inani elijwayelekile (okuphuzi) eliphakeme kunjengokujwayelekile (okuluhlaza) ezinyangeni ezizayo. Amathuba okuthola imvula enkulu alungile kakhulu ngoDisemba 2007 noJanuwari 2008. Izibalo 1 - 3: Amathuba okuthola izinga elijwayelekile (%). Ezibalo 4 - 7, amathuba okuthola ngaphansi kuka-20 mm yemvula ezinsukwini ezithile akhombiswa. Izilinganiso zesikhathi eside zikhombiswa ngombala obomvu, kanti amathuba akhona (2007/2008) akhombiswa ngombala oluhlaza. Umbala oluhlaza ukhombisa izikhathi ezinomsebenzi omuhle wokuthola imvula ephakeme kunjengokujwayelekile.
Ezibalo 4 - 7, amathuba okuthola ngaphansi kuka-20 mm yemvula ezinsukwini ezithile akhombiswa. Izilinganiso zesikhathi eside zikhombiswa ngombala obomvu, kanti amathuba akhona (2007/2008) akhombiswa ngombala oluhlaza. Umbala oluhlaza ukhombisa izikhathi ezinomsebenzi omuhle wokuthola imvula ephakeme kunjengokujwayelekile. Ngokubheka ukuqhubeka kweLa Nina, imvula enhle ilindeleke ngoDisemba, ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari, nasekuqaleni kukaFebruwari 2008 naseMashi 2008. Ulwazi oluningi luqoqwe nguMnu. Johan van den Berg ovela ku-ARS. Ulwazi olungeziwe lungatholakala ku-website yeGrain SA (www.graansa.co.za).
Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Impilo, Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Kumhlaba wamanje Abathengisi basemgwaqeni badlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhulayo. Nakuba bejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, bavame ukufaka phakathi izinkinga ezihlobene nezezimali, imicimbi, kanye nokwaneliseka kwabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bathinta kanjani umphakathi nempilo yabantu, futhi kufanele sihlaziye izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nabo. Okokuqala, abathengisi basemgwaqeni banikela ngezinsizakalo eziphilayo emphakathini. Bahlala bejolise ekudleni, ezimakethe, nasezindaweni zokuhweba, bahlala eduze kwezakhamuzi. Lokhu kubavumela ukuthi benze imali ngenkathi behlinzeka ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, izitsha ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kanye nezinsiza ezincane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni imisebenzi, kuhlanganise nabathengisi abakhethiwe, futhi kukhulisa umnotho wendawo. Abathengisi basemgwaqeni banikeza ukudla okusheshayo okutholakala kalula, okubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, banomthelela omuhle ekukhuthazeni umoya wokuhweba phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlupheka ngezinkinga eziningi. Bahlala bephikisana nemithetho nezinhlinzeko zikahulumeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi benze imisebenzi yabo. Imithetho ethile ingavimbela ukuthola izindawo ezinhle zokuhweba, okwenza bahlale bezama ukuthola izindawo ezizimele, lapho bengahambisani nezidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, futhi abanye baphinde babe sengozini yokuthunjwa noma ukuxhaphazwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bavame ukuba sengozini yokulahlekelwa impilo ngenxa yokusebenza ezindaweni ezingaphephile.
Imithetho ethile ingavimbela ukuthola izindawo ezinhle zokuhweba, okwenza bahlale bezama ukuthola izindawo ezizimele, lapho bengahambisani nezidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, futhi abanye baphinde babe sengozini yokuthunjwa noma ukuxhaphazwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bavame ukuba sengozini yokulahlekelwa impilo ngenxa yokusebenza ezindaweni ezingaphephile. Izimo zokuhweba zingaba yingozi, futhi uma kwenzeka izenzakalo ezimbi, abathengisi bangase bahlushwe yizingozi eziningi, okudingeka ukuba kube nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesandla ekutholeni izixazululo ezithile zokuvikela abathengisi basemgwaqeni. Ngokuvamile, banamandla okwenza umphakathi ube ngcono, behlisa izindleko zokuphila futhi bekhuthaza ukusabalalisa ukudla okunesithako esihle. Izitsha zabo zihlala ziqhakambisa amasiko ahlukahlukene, zikhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zifunde ngempilo yasezindaweni. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile kumphakathi wonke. Ekugcineni, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bamele izidingo zabantu. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sithuthukise izisombululo eziphusile nezisebenzayo ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo zokuvikela ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokusebenza. Sidinga ukusiza abathengisi basemgwaqeni ukuba baqhubeke phambili, ngenkathi sikhuthaza amandla abathengisi nezinhlelo ezizovumela ukuba bahlanganyele nemithetho yendawo. Umphakathi, ohulumeni, nabathengisi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe indawo ehlanzekile, ekhuthazayo, nephephile kubo bonke.
Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo zokuvikela ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokusebenza. Sidinga ukusiza abathengisi basemgwaqeni ukuba baqhubeke phambili, ngenkathi sikhuthaza amandla abathengisi nezinhlelo ezizovumela ukuba bahlanganyele nemithetho yendawo. Umphakathi, ohulumeni, nabathengisi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe indawo ehlanzekile, ekhuthazayo, nephephile kubo bonke. Ngakho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Bazimisele, futhi bahlala bekhuthaza umqondo wobudlelwano obunempilo. Sidinga ukubabukela ngeso lokhozi ukuze sithuthukise izindlela zokusiza nokubasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokuhweba, bahlale befika emiphakathini yabo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, akufanele sikhumbule lezi zinkampani ezisemqoka ezihlanganyela emnothweni wethu. Ukubavikela, ukubasiza, nokubahlonipha kuyoba umculo ophumayo emiphelandaba yethu.
Imfundo eyisisekelo yomsebenzi wezokwelapha ihlose ukuhlinzeka bonke osomthetho ngolwazi oludingekayo nolwazi ukuze baqonde imibono yabanye kanye nezimo zabo ezihlukahlukene ukuze izinqubo zabo zibe nezinhlonipho futhi zifanele umphakathi abahlala kuwo. Ezinye izinkolelo zihlanganisa ukuhlola isici esithile umuntu anaso ngokusilinganisa nezinhloso noma izici ezingafunwa zeqembu elithile. Angiphakamisi ukuthi abantu basebenzise izinkolelo ezithile ezingafanele ngenhloso, kodwa empeleni, ezinye izinkolelo zobuzwe nezocansi zikhona ezingqondweni zethu, zigcwele izimo zomphakathi futhi ziqhutshwa yisiko elidumile nezindaba. Ngezinye izikhathi zigxile ezikhungweni zethu. Sijwayele ukuzamukela njengamaqiniso. Uma sibhekene nenkinga, sithatha lokhu ngokuzenzakalelayo ngoba kuyinto yemvelo futhi kulula - kulula kakhulu kunokuhlola ngempela inkinga ukuze sithole isixazululo esinengqondo ngokucabanga, ukulalela, nokuhlola. Ukufana phakathi kweqembu nezinto ezihlukile phakathi kwezigaba kungase kube phansi noma kugqanyiswe. Umsebenzi wokubheka amalungu eqembu langaphandle njengokufana kakhulu noma okufana namalungu eqembu langaphakathi. Izifundo zesayensi zikhombisile "ukuthandwa okujwayelekile kokubona amadoda njengokwethembeka kakhulu kunezintombi." Emaphutheni, ukukholwa kuyinsiza ebalulekile kakhulu engase ibe kumuntu, noma ngabe umuntu unegunya njengommeleli, ufakazi, ummangaleli, noma ummangali, futhi ngenxa yalokho, le ndlela yokucwasa ingaba yingozi emiphumeleni yabo nakuqiniso. Ngokufanayo, abahluleli bangase baphuthelwe ububanzi bokwethembeka obungaphazamisa isenzo esibalulekile sokubiza (abantu abathile) ngegama labo noma ukusebenzisa amagama aqukethe uthando.
Izifundo zesayensi zikhombisile "ukuthandwa okujwayelekile kokubona amadoda njengokwethembeka kakhulu kunezintombi." Emaphutheni, ukukholwa kuyinsiza ebalulekile kakhulu engase ibe kumuntu, noma ngabe umuntu unegunya njengommeleli, ufakazi, ummangaleli, noma ummangali, futhi ngenxa yalokho, le ndlela yokucwasa ingaba yingozi emiphumeleni yabo nakuqiniso. Ngokufanayo, abahluleli bangase baphuthelwe ububanzi bokwethembeka obungaphazamisa isenzo esibalulekile sokubiza (abantu abathile) ngegama labo noma ukusebenzisa amagama aqukethe uthando. Ukucwasa kungase kusebenze kunoma yisiphi isigaba, kodwa ngokuhambisana nomqondo wezithombe "zokuhlukahluka," ikakhulukazi mayelana nenkinga noma umuntu, kusala kube inselelo enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo, lapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zizosebenza. Nansi uhlu lwezindlela zokulalela eziphansi neziphakamiso ezithile zokuthi lezi zindlela zingashintshwa kanjani. Ukulalela Okukhona kungase kungabi khona: Le ndlela engasebenzi ivela kumqondo wokuthi abantu abaningi bacabanga isikhathi eside kakhulu kunesikhathi sokukhuluma somuntu ojwayelekile. Ngakho-ke, umlaleli uneminithi emithathu yokucabanga emaminithini ngayinye yokulalela. Ngezinye izikhathi umlaleli usebenzisa lesi sikhathi esengeziwe ukuhlela izinkinga zabo, izintshisekelo, nezinkinga esikhundleni sokulalela, ukuhambisana, nokufingqa lokho okukhuluma okufanele kukhulumiswe. Ukulalela Okubomvu: Kubantu abathile, amagama afana nesikhumbuzo sebhokisi elibomvu akhuthaza anger futhi abenze bame ukulalela. La magama ahluka ukusuka kwelinye inhlangano kuya kwelinye.
Ngezinye izikhathi umlaleli usebenzisa lesi sikhathi esengeziwe ukuhlela izinkinga zabo, izintshisekelo, nezinkinga esikhundleni sokulalela, ukuhambisana, nokufingqa lokho okukhuluma okufanele kukhulumiswe. Ukulalela Okubomvu: Kubantu abathile, amagama afana nesikhumbuzo sebhokisi elibomvu akhuthaza anger futhi abenze bame ukulalela. La magama ahluka ukusuka kwelinye inhlangano kuya kwelinye. Kubantu abathile, amagama afana "nobunzima," "ukuvuleka," "intsha yamanje," njll., yizici esijwayele ukuziphendulela. Ngesikhathi izimpawu zivele, sithola umkhulumeli. Silahlekelwa uxhumano nabo futhi siphumelele ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela ngezindlebe ezivulekile nokuvala ingqondo: Ngezinye izikhathi sithatha isinqumo esisheshayo sokuthi umlaleli noma umkhulumeli uhlinzeka ngokuphoxeka, nokuthi lokho okukhuluma akukwazi. Njalo sithatha isinqumo sokuthi singakhuluma ngakho okukhuluma noma lokho abazokukhuluma - futhi bakhetha ukuthi akukho sizathu sokulalela ngoba akukho okusha okuzokhuluma. Kungcono ukulalela bese uthola ngempela ukuthi lokhu kuyiqiniso noma cha. Ukulalela ngezinyembezi ezikhanyayo: Ngezinye izikhathi sibheka umuntu ngqo sengathi silalela kanti izingqondo zethu zikhona kwenye indawo noma ezindaweni ezikude. Sifaka endaweni ethanda kahle imicabango yethu. Ukukhanya kwezinyembezi (uma kungelona iphupho) kubonakala ebusweni bethu. Singakwazi ukusho uma abantu besibheka ngalendlela. Ngokufanayo, bangase babone okufanayo kithi - sithatha noma ubani njengomhlanya. Phendulela amaphupho kubo ngezinye izikhathi.
Singakwazi ukusho uma abantu besibheka ngalendlela. Ngokufanayo, bangase babone okufanayo kithi - sithatha noma ubani njengomhlanya. Phendulela amaphupho kubo ngezinye izikhathi. Ukulalela Okujulile kimi: Uma silalela imibono edidayo nezinkinga ezinzima kakhulu, kumele siziphoqe ukuba silandele ingxoxo ngensizakalo yokuzama ukuqonda. Kungenzeka ukuthi sithole umkhulumeli nesihloko esikhuluma ngaso sithokozisa uma silalela futhi siqonde lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela okuxhumene nesihloko ngaphezu kokucabanga: Abaningi bethu abathandi ukuba nemibono mayelana nezilwane ezihlangene, ukucwasa, nezikhalazo zethu nezixazululo. Ngakho-ke, uma umkhulumeli esho okuphambene nalokho esikucabangayo, ukukholwa, nokugcina - sithatha isinqumo sokumisa ukulalela noma sizame ukuzivikela ngokulungiselela ukuhlasela. Nokho, uma sifuna ukwenza lokhu noma cha, kungcono ukuthola ukuthi bacabangani, thola enye icala lombuzo ukuze sithole umsebenzi ongcono wokuqonda nokuphendula. Uma bekhuluma ngakho, sifuna ukuthi bazame ukubona imbangela nezizathu zezingqinamba zabo futhi bazame ukubona ukuthi yini engakwenziwa ngakho. Sibonisa ukunaka, sihamba nomunye umuntu, sikhombisa ukunakekela nokwazisa, sikhulula inkinga uma ikhona, silalela ukuze sithole imbangela yenkinga, sisize umkhulumeli ukuba athwale inkinga nezimbangela, sikhuthaze umkhulumeli ukuba athuthukise ikhono lokwenza futhi simkhuthaze ukuba axazulule izinkinga zabo, sifunda ukuba sithule uma kudingeka ukuthula. Abantu abaphumelelayo ngezinye izikhathi bayazi ukuthi kufanele bathule futhi bagcine ukuzola kwabo. Ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ukuze banikeze isinqumo ngokushesha nangokuphuthumayo ukuze banikeze izeluleko. Siphila nezinkinga eziningi ezinzima ezihlanganisa abantu nezimo.
Abantu abaphumelelayo ngezinye izikhathi bayazi ukuthi kufanele bathule futhi bagcine ukuzola kwabo. Ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ukuze banikeze isinqumo ngokushesha nangokuphuthumayo ukuze banikeze izeluleko. Siphila nezinkinga eziningi ezinzima ezihlanganisa abantu nezimo. Isidingo sokulalela ukuze siqonde sibaluleke kakhulu. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda abantu uma singabalaleli. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda isimo uma sibona ingxenye kuphela yesimo, sisiza kancane. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda izinkinga zabantu uma sinolwazi oluphansi kuphela nezici zayo, kuyilapho empeleni, sibhekene nezimpawu, hhayi imbangela. Kumele sibone ukuthi ukulalela kuyisici esiyisisekelo kulwazi nokuqonda. LENA YINDODA ENYE ETHATHA ISINYATHELO. Uvumela ukuthi bakuholele engxoxweni; awuphuthumi kubo ngokushesha ukuze bathathe indlela abafuna ukuyiya. Lokhu kuhlobene nenhlonipho yabo nokwethembeka. LENA YINDODA ENYE EHLANGANISWA NEZIMFUNDO. Lokhu kuyithuba elingajwayelekile kubantu abaningi, futhi bazothatha leli thuba ngokuzithoba futhi baziphatha ngendlela ejwayelekile futhi ngale okwakungokwabo. Uma ukhombisa ukuthi ungathembeka, abanye bazizwa bekhululekile ukwabelana ngezinkathazo zabo, izimfihlo, nezibopho. Umphumela uwukuthi - baziwa kangcono. ABANTU ABANINGI BAHLAZAYO INKINGA. Ukulalela okusebenzayo kusiza abantu ukuba babhekane nalabo abababhekelayo nezinkinga. Bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesimo esingasibheka ngqo, siqonde kangcono, bese sichaza inkinga ngokucacile nangokufanele. ENYE INDODA IHLAZ

Ngokukhethekile mayelana ne-GNSS, ibhekisela ezingeni lokuhambisana kwepharamitha elilinganisiwe, noma indawo ethile noma ijubane lelo ndlela ngesikhathi esithile noma endaweni ethile, kanye nejubane langempela elivame ukuhlinzekwa njengokulinganiswa kwezibalo kokwephutha kwemishini, futhi kuboniswa njengokuhlola okuphindaphindiwe futhi okungafani. uType A1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. uType B1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. b Type B2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezikhumulweni sezindiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. "Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C" ubonisa umshini we-GNSS onama-sensors okulandela i-GNSS ahlinzeka ngemininingwane ngohlelo oluhlanganisiwe lokuhamba kwezindiza futhi uphinde usize ngokukhombisa indlela yokuhamba lapho iphathwa ngumshayeli noma umphathiswa wezindiza ukuze kuncishiswe amaphutha wezobuchwepheshe ezindizeni ze-FTE. uType C1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. b Type C2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezikhumulweni sezindiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM.

Qaphela: Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C uzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nasezindizeni zokuhamba kwezindiza zomhlaba jikelele. Inqubo yokuhamba kwefu ibhekisela ezicwangcweni ezihlelwe zokusebenzisa amathuluzi athile okundiza ukuze kuvikelwe ukuhamba kwezindiza ezithintwa yizithiyo ezingaba khona kumkhondo wayo wokuqala kuze kube kufinyelelwa endaweni lapho izinhlelo zokuxhumana zomhlaba zingasungulwa futhi zibe usizo ekubambeni noma ekujikelezeni kwehamba, bese-ke, ngemuva kwalokho, ingabamba endaweni lapho uhlelo lokuphatha izithiyo zendawo noma izithiyo zendlela zisebenza. I-GNSS ibhekisela kuHlelo Lokuhamba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe lwezindiza ukuze kuhlonishwe isikhundla sezindiza esikhaleni. Uhlelo lokuhlonza indawo nesikhathi emhlabeni wonke oluhilela ubuchwepheshe bezithombe bokuhlola kude noma ukuqoqa kwazo, ama-receivers ezindiza, kanye nohlelo lokulandela olusekela ukuqapha nokuhlola izindiza emoyeni.

Umcimbi we-GNSS ubhekisela ezenzekeni nasezimo ezifanayo nezinkinga zemishini, izinkomba, noma amaphutha abantu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Ukuqina mayelana ne-GNSS kubhekisela ekwazini kwemishini ukuhlinzeka ngezixwayiso kulabo abasebenzisa yona uma ukusebenza kwayo kudlula imikhawulo yokuphepha esunguliwe futhi akufanele isetshenziswe ekulandeleni. Ukuhamba kwe-Side/edge kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuhola ukuhamba ngaphandle kwezinkomba ezithile ezivertical ezihlobene nezindlela zokulandela ukuhamba ngendlela engashayi ngqo umhloli noma yokuyifuna lapho idlula. Uhlelo lokuhamba lwezindiza oluyinhloko lubhekisela ohlelweni lokuhamba emoyeni olwamukelwa nguMphathiswa wezokuhamba noma ngesikhathi esithile sokuhamba, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zezinkomba ezivertical ezithile kanye nokuqina, kodwa akusho ukuthi kuhlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala noma ukuqhubeka.

Ukuqina kolwazi olutholakalayo lwezobuchwepheshe (RAIM) kubhekisela kwisicwangciso lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS luthola ukuqina kwezimpawu zokulawula ukuhamba nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakale ngezinga lokuphuma. "RVSM" ibhekisela ekuhlukaniseni okukhona phakathi kwezinga lokuhamba elingu-290 kuya ku-1000 feet uma kubhekwa ohlangothini olulodwa futhi ama-2000 feet uma kubhekwa ngokuqondile kokuhamba. "Isikhala se-RVSM" sisho isikhala somoya phakathi kwezinga lokuhamba elingu-290 no-410 feet. "Isitifiketi sokuvunywa kwe-RVSM" sisho isitifiketi esibonisa ukuthi ukuhamba kanye nethimba kuhlangabezana nezidingo zokusebenza ze-RVSM. Impilo Yengqondo Entsheni: Ukubaluleka Kokuqonda Nokunakekela Impilo yengqondo yentsha iyisihloko esibalulekile esidinga ukugxilwa kukho, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wanamuhla lapho izinselelo zikhula ngokushesha. Njengoba sikhula, sithola izimo eziningi ezithinta imizwa yethu, izinqumo zethu, kanye nezindlela esibona ngazo umhlaba. Ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyisici esibalulekile sokuphila kwethu. Ngokokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibandakanya izici eziningi, kuhlanganise nemizwa, ukucabanga, nokuziphatha. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu yizinkinga ezihlobene nokucindezeleka, ukwesaba, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kungenxa yokucindezeleka okuvela ezimweni eziningi, njengezidingo zokufunda, ukucindezeleka emndenini, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana nabanye. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, sikhuthaze ukuxhumana, futhi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana nabanye kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo yentsha. Abantu abasha badinga indawo yokukhuluma, yokwabelana ngemizwa yabo, kanye nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kungaba yindawo yokuhlala nabangani, umndeni, noma ngisho nezinsiza ezisemthethweni ezifana nezikhungo zokwelashwa. Ukuxhumana kahle kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo wengqondo, futhi kukhuthaze umuzwa wokuxhaswa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuxhumana ezivulekile, ukuze abantu abasha bakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto ezinzima abahlangabezana nazo. Okwesithathu, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo.
Ukuxhumana kahle kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo wengqondo, futhi kukhuthaze umuzwa wokuxhaswa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuxhumana ezivulekile, ukuze abantu abasha bakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto ezinzima abahlangabezana nazo. Okwesithathu, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Abantu abasha badinga ukufundiswa ukuthi bangaziphatha kanjani uma behlangabezana nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufunda izindlela zokuphumula, ukusebenzisa amasu okucabanga, kanye nokuthola izindlela zokuzithokozisa. Ukuphatha imizwa kahle kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zengqondo, futhi kukhuthaze impilo enempilo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokufunda zifake lezi zifundo, ukuze abantu abasha bakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo. Okwesine, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze umqondo wokwamukela. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu yizinkinga zokuzizwa bengafaneleki, noma bengafaneleki. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphatheke kabi, futhi kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo yengqondo. Ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo yentsha, kufanele sikhuthaze umqondo wokwamukela, sikhuthaze abantu abasha ukuba bazethembe, futhi sibavumele ukuba baphile impilo yabo ngaphandle kokwesaba ukugxekwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi baziqhenye ngabo. Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile, futhi kudingeka ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga. Ukuxhumana, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa, kanye nokwamukela kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuxhasa abantu abasha, sibanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo.
Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile, futhi kudingeka ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga. Ukuxhumana, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa, kanye nokwamukela kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuxhasa abantu abasha, sibanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, lapho abantu abasha bengakwazi ukukhula, baphile, futhi baphumelele. Impilo yengqondo yentsha ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyisici esibalulekile sokuphila kwethu sonke. Ngakho, masithathe izinyathelo ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo yentsha, ukuze sibe nomphakathi onempilo, onothando, futhi onokuthula.

Ngokuvumelanisa nezinselelo nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye, iSamsung Galaxy ibonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zayo azigcini nje ngokuba izinsiza, kodwa ziwumqondo wobuchwepheshe obungokwemvelo, obuhloniphekile, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu.
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kuyisici esibalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokuba negesi, njengokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Nokho, kunokungafani okukhulu phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nezasezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Ukwakhiwa Kwesakhiwo Sokutholakala Kukagesi Ukuze kutholakale ugesi emakhaya, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokwakha nokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi, izintambo zokuhambisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina ugesi. Iziteshi zokukhiqiza zingaba yiziteshi zamandla ezivela emithonjeni ehlukene, njengamandla elanga, amanzi, noma amalahle. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka zisebenza kahle, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ugesi ngendlela elula. Izithiyo Ezinqubweni Zokutholakala Kukagesi Kukhona izithiyo eziningi ezithinta ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi izindleko eziphezulu zokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Izindawo ezisemakhaya zihlala zinezinkinga zokuhamba, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo zokwakha ugesi. Lokhu kudala ukungafani kokutholakala kukagesi, lapho abanye abantu besebenzisa izindlela ezindala zokukhanyisa, ezifana nezibani zezimoto, noma izibani ezisebenza ngogesi ophumayo. Izinzuzo Zokutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Uma ugesi utholakala kalula emakhaya, izinzuzo zikhula. Okokuqala, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nemisebenzi emisha.
Lokhu kudala ukungafani kokutholakala kukagesi, lapho abanye abantu besebenzisa izindlela ezindala zokukhanyisa, ezifana nezibani zezimoto, noma izibani ezisebenza ngogesi ophumayo. Izinzuzo Zokutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Uma ugesi utholakala kalula emakhaya, izinzuzo zikhula. Okokuqala, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nemisebenzi emisha. Lokhu kudala amathuba amaningi okukhula komnotho, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhaya abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ugesi uvumela abantu ukuba basebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengamakhompyutha nemishini yokusebenza, okwenza kube lula ukuphila kwansuku zonke. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukutholakala Kukagesi Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo ezivela kuhulumeni, ezinkampanini, kanye nasemiphakathini. Hulumeni angasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze akhe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwakha iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi ezincane, ezilula, nezisebenza kahle. Izinkampani ezingezona ezikahulumeni zingase zibe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala benokutholakala kukagesi. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Ukubambisana komphakathi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukutholakala kukagesi. Imiphakathi ingase ibambisane ukuze ithole izixazululo ezisemqoka, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina ugesi ezisebenza kahle. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi bangawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi ukuze bathuthukise izinga labo lokuphila.
Imiphakathi ingase ibambisane ukuze ithole izixazululo ezisemqoka, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina ugesi ezisebenza kahle. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi bangawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi ukuze bathuthukise izinga labo lokuphila. Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kuzodinga ukuqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zisebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala benokutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nezinselelo ezikhona, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi sibe nesithakazelo sokubambisana ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akusona nje isidingo, kodwa kuyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuze sithole izinzuzo eziphelele zokutholakala kukagesi, kudinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, sithuthukise izinga lokuphila, futhi sithole amathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, ukuze sifeze ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Impilo Yengqondo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Emphakathini Wethu Impilo yengqondo ibalulekile njengempilo yomzimba, kodwa imvamisa ayithathwa njengokubalulekile. Njengomuntu ophila emhlabeni wanamuhla, ngiyabona ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinselele enkulu, hhayi kuphela kumuntu ngamunye, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngale ndaba, siqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibaluleke kangakanani, futhi sifune izindlela zokuyithuthukisa. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayiyona into ethile ethile, kodwa ibonisa indlela esibona ngayo izinto, indlela esiphila ngayo, nezindlela esixhumana ngazo nabanye. Ukukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, nokukhathazeka ngempilo yethu yengqondo kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ezifana nezifo zengqondo, ezithinta impilo yethu yonke. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Ngokwesiko, sithanda ukucabanga ukuthi izinkinga zengqondo zenzeka kuphela kwabanye, kodwa empeleni, zenzeka kubo bonke. Ngiyakhumbula isikhathi esithile lapho ngibona umngane wami edlula ezinkingeni zengqondo. Wayengazi ukuthi angakwenza kanjani, futhi ngaleso sikhathi, ngazizwa ngingenamandla. Lokhu kwangikhumbuza ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayikhulumi kuphela ngempilo yomuntu, kodwa ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Uma umuntu enezinkinga zengqondo, lokho kuthinta wonke umuntu okukhona eduze kwakhe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Uma abantu benempilo yengqondo enhle, bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, baphile kahle, futhi babe neqhaza elihle emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima lapho abantu bebhekene nezinkinga eziningi.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Uma abantu benempilo yengqondo enhle, bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, baphile kahle, futhi babe neqhaza elihle emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima lapho abantu bebhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukukhuthaza impilo yengqondo kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Kodwa-ke, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo, kudingeka sikhulume ngamasiko ethu. Ezinye izinkolo nezamasiko zethu zikhuthaza ukuba sibe namandla, sithande, futhi sibe neqhaza elihle. Kodwa, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nokukhathazeka akuyona into yokuhluleka. Kunalokho, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, baphinde bazi ukuthi akekho oyedwa ophila ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokwesekwa zingasiza abantu abahlangabezana nezinkinga zengqondo. Ngiyakhumbula ngesikhathi esithile lapho ngithola usizo, futhi ngathola ukuthi akukhona okubi ukufuna usizo. Lokhu kwangikhuthaza ukuba ngikhulume nabanye, futhi ngibakhuthaze ukuba baphinde bazi ukuthi akekho oyedwa ophila ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiyabona ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinselele, kodwa futhi iyithuba. Itholakala ezinkingeni zethu, kodwa futhi iyindlela yokukhula. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu yonke. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka.
Itholakala ezinkingeni zethu, kodwa futhi iyindlela yokukhula. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu yonke. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile empilweni yethu. Akukhona okungaphezu kokuba nekhanda eliphilayo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nekhanda elinempilo. Ngakho, asithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Impilo yengqondo iyinselele, kodwa futhi iyithuba lokukhula, futhi kufanele sithathe leli thuba ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, kanye neyezizukulwane ezizayo.
Umphakathi uvikela ngokwenza uphenyo oluzimele nolungakhethi emva kokuthola ukukhala noma ngokuqhubeka kwabo. Ukukhala okuhlobene nokusebenza kwemisebenzi (kungafaki lokho okuhlobene nezinkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa) kufanele kuthunyelwe kumphathi wesigaba esifanele, njengoba isigaba kufanele sinikezwe ithuba lokuphendula ekukhuleni. Uma ungekwazanga ukuthumela ukukhala esigabeni esifanele, ucela ukuthi wenze kanjalo. Zonke iziteshi zangaphakathi ezikhona kufanele zibe khona. Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe: Imibuzo Nezincazelo Umbuzo 1: Yini izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zifundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise impilo yabo nemisebenzi yabo. Lezi zifundo zihlola indlela ubuchwepheshe obuthinta ngayo izimpilo zethu, izinqubo zethu zokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana. Zifaka phakathi izifundo ezihlukahlukene, njengekhompyutha, ubunjiniyela, ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bemvelo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zinikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, njengoba imikhakha eminingi idinga abantu abanolwazi kwezobuchwepheshe. Zikhuthaza futhi ukucabanga okwakhiwe, lapho abafundi befundiswa khona ukuhlaziya izinkinga nokufuna izixazululo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zikhuthaza ukusungula ubuchwepheshe obusha, okwenza kube nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo emhlabeni. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izifundo ezivamile ngaphakathi kwezifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe ziqukethe izifundo eziningi ezifana ne-Information Technology (IT), ubunjiniyela, ukuthuthukiswa kwesofthiwe, kanye nezifundo ze-robotics. Futhi, izifundo eziphathelene nezokuxhumana, njengezokumaketha kwi-inthanethi, kanye nezokuphepha kwedatha, zibalulekile kakhulu. Umbuzo 4: Kungani kubalulekile ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini yanamuhla? Emiphakathini yanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko ezisheshayo, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini lapho ubuchwepheshe buguqula izinqubo zokusebenza.
Umbuzo 4: Kungani kubalulekile ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini yanamuhla? Emiphakathini yanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko ezisheshayo, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini lapho ubuchwepheshe buguqula izinqubo zokusebenza. Abantu abanobuchwepheshe bangasiza imiphakathi yabo ukuthi ithuthuke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezifana nezempilo, ezemfundo, nezokuxhumana. Umbuzo 5: Yini okufanele ikhulunywe uma sikhuluma ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe? Uma sikhuluma ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuhunyushwa izimfanelo ezibalulekile ezifana nokucabanga okwakhiwe, ukuxhumana kahle, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Abafundi kumele babe nekhono lokuhlaziya izinkinga bese befuna izixazululo ezisebenzayo, okufanele kube yisisekelo sokuphumelela emsebenzini nasempilweni yabo. Umbuzo 6: Zithini izinselelo ezibhekene nabafundi bezifundo zobuchwepheshe? Abafundi bezifundo zobuchwepheshe babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka buhamba phambili, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlala unolwazi olusha. Okwesibili, izindleko zokufunda zingaba phezulu, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Okwesithathu, abanye abafundi bangase bazizwe bedidekile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olujulile ngalesi sikhathi sobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisane nezimboni. Lokhu kuzokwenza abafundi bathole ulwazi olwakhiwe nolwakamuva. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi.
Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisane nezimboni. Lokhu kuzokwenza abafundi bathole ulwazi olwakhiwe nolwakamuva. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops, izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini kukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ibhekwane nayo uma ufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Uma ufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo ovulekile. Abafundi kumele bakwazi ukufunda ngokushesha nokuqonda izinto ezintsha. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokubambisana, njengokusebenza emaphrojekthi, kuzobasiza bathuthukise amakhono abo. Ukufunda ukuhlela kahle isikhathi sabo kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni ezifundweni. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izindlela zokugcina ulwazi olusha ezindabeni zobuchwepheshe? Ukuze ugcine ulwazi olusha ezindabeni zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili nezifundo ezitholakalayo. Ukubhalisela izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi, ukufunda izincwadi ezisematheni, kanye nokubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni yokwabelana ngolwazi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlala unolwazi. Ukuxhumana nabanye abanolwazi olufanayo kungasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi. Umbuzo 10: Yini esiyifunda ngempela ezifundweni zobuchwepheshe? Ekugcineni, izifundo zobuchwepheshe zifundisa abantu ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasetshenziswa kanjani ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomuntu. Zikhiqiza abantu abakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, bahlaziye izinkinga, futhi bathuthukise izixazululo. Zikhuthaza ukucabanga okwakhiwe nokubambisana, okubalulekile empilweni yanamuhla.
Ekugcineni, izifundo zobuchwepheshe zifundisa abantu ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasetshenziswa kanjani ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomuntu. Zikhiqiza abantu abakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, bahlaziye izinkinga, futhi bathuthukise izixazululo. Zikhuthaza ukucabanga okwakhiwe nokubambisana, okubalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqhubeke sithuthuka njengomphakathi, sithuthukise izimboni zethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni. Ngakho-ke, izifundo zobuchwepheshe azigcini nje ngokufundisa amakhono, kodwa zifundisa futhi indlela yokuphila, yokusebenza, nokuxhumana, okuhamba phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
"Umthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wabaphathi Bezempilo Zendabuko, 2004 (Umthetho No. 35 ka-2004); futhi "umphakathi" ubhekisela kumuntu ophila ngokwelashwa kwezendabuko njengoba kuchazwe nguMthetho. Ngokomgomo wokukhetha amalungu abhekiswe ezahlukanisweni c, e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yomthetho, uNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe isaziso kwiGovernment Gazette nakuma-phepha abhalwe okungenani amabili adluliselwa ezwenikazi nasemaphandleni, emema abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abafuna ukuwafaka njengamalungu eBhodi. Isaziso esibhekiswe kule Mthethosisekelo 2 kumele sichaze ulwazi oluzobhekwa uma kufakwa isiphakamiso njengelungu kanye nesikhathi sokufaka amagama aphakanyisiwe. a ye-subsection 7c yomthetho kumele ifakwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma elungu leBhodi elibhekelele impilo lapho umphakathi ophakanyisiwe esebenza khona; futhi b imisebenzi e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yomthetho kumele ifakwe kuNgqongqoshe weSizwe. Elungu leBhodi noma uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kumele athumele amagama abaphathi abathathu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze abheke ukufaneleka kokukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7c yomthetho. Uma uNgqongqoshe engatholi amagama aphakanyisiwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlobo noma uma amagama aphakanyisiwe enganele njengoba kuchaziwe kulolu mema, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha inani elanele labantu abafanele ukukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7 yomthetho noma acela ukuthi amagama engeziwe aphakanyiswe ukuze kufezwe le njongo.

Umuntu ogama lakhe lifakwe ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo 5 ukuze akhethwe ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7i yomthetho kumele abe esebenza ngempumelelo kulolu mkhakha okungenani iminyaka emihlanu ngaphambi kosuku angakhethwa njengelungu. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe kwiGovernment Gazette amagama abantu abakhululiwe njengamalungu eBhodi kanye nosuku abazoqala ngalo imisebenzi yabo njengamalungu eBhodi. Ngiyafunga ukuthi ngifuna ukwamukela isiphakamiso segama lami futhi ngiyazimisela ukserva kwiBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Zendabuko uma uNgqongqoshe engikhetha kulendawo. Mina (igama eliphelele lomuntu ophakanyisiwe kanye nesikhundla sabo) ngiyafunga ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe lapha luyiqiniso, futhi ukuthi kusemthethweni kuNgqongqoshe ukukhetha mina njengelungu leBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Zendabuko.
